10.1002/hec.2855.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，决策者通常对现实临床环境中可供选择的多种治疗或干预措施进行同时比较感兴趣。由于现实临床环境中缺乏随机分配，因此在评估治疗的边际效益时会出现选择偏差问题。传统上，应用工具变量估计方法来减轻选择偏差仅限于同时比较两种治疗/干预措施。以类风湿性关节炎的生物治疗为例，我们描述了一种基于广义矩估计的面板数据工具变量框架（IV-GMM），用于在存在时间变化的选择偏差和时间不变的异质性情况下，同时估计多种治疗效应。为了满足多重内生性的识别顺序和秩条件，我们提出了将每种治疗的滞后值作为排除工具变量的方法。我们评估了工具变量相关性和外生性的假设的有效性。结果表明，IV-GMM模型能够更有效地控制选择偏差和异质性，更重要的是，面板数据框架能够提供有效的排除工具变量，这些工具变量在处理多个内生变量时满足识别的顺序和秩条件。本文提出的方法适用于涉及多种治疗/干预措施的比较效果评估和健康技术评估，使用现实世界的非实验数据。

abstract.text: In this paper, we introduce a tractable social welfare function that is rich enough to disentangle attitudes towards risk in health outcomes from attitudes towards health inequalities across individuals. Given this preference specification, we evaluate how the introduction of uncertainty over the severity of illness and over the effectiveness of treatments affects the optimal allocation of healthcare resources. We show that the way in which uncertainty affects the optimal allocation within our proposed specification may differ sharply from that in the standard expected utility framework.

10.1002/hec.2858.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个可行的社会福利函数，该函数能够充分区分人们对健康结果的risk态度与个体间健康不平等的态度。基于这一偏好设定，我们评估了疾病严重程度和治疗效果的不确定性如何影响医疗资源的最优分配。我们发现，不确定性对我们所提出的设定下最优分配方式的影响，可能与标准期望效用框架中的情况存在显著差异。

abstract.text: We argue that the economic evaluation of health care (cost-benefit analysis) should respect individual preferences and should incorporate distributional considerations. Relying on individual preferences does not imply subjective welfarism. We propose a particular non-welfarist approach, based on the concept of equivalent income, and show how it helps to define distributional weights. We illustrate the feasibility of our approach with empirical results from a pilot survey.

10.1002/hec.2859.abstractZh: 我们认为，对医疗保健的经济评估（成本效益分析）应当尊重个人偏好，并应包含分配方面的考量。依赖个人偏好并不意味着主观的福利主义。我们提出了一种特定的非福利主义方法，该方法基于等价收入的概念，并展示了该方法如何有助于定义分配权重。我们通过一项试点调查的实证结果来说明我们方法的可行性。

abstract.text: Using data for every elective procedure in 2007 in the English National Health Service, we found evidence of socioeconomic inequality in the probability of having a procedure cancelled after admission while controlling for a range of patient and provider characteristics. Whether this disparity is inequitable is inconclusive.

10.1002/hec.2860.abstractZh: 通过对2007年英国国家卫生服务系统中所有选择性手术的数据进行分析，我们发现，在控制了一系列患者和医疗服务提供者特征的情况下，手术因入院而取消的概率存在社会经济不平等现象。然而，这种不平等是否不公平尚不确定。

abstract.text: By examining tourist arrivals and pork output and trade statistics, this analysis estimates the economic impact to the Mexican tourism and pork sectors because of the H1N1 influenza pandemic. It also assesses the role of the international response in the context of this economic impact. For tourism, losing almost a million overseas visitors translated into losses of around $US2.8bn, which extended over a five-month period, mostly because of the slow return of European travellers. For the pork industry, temporal decreases in output were observed in most of the country and related to H1N1 incidence (p = 0.048, r = 0.37). By the end of 2009, Mexico had a pork trade deficit of $US27m. The losses derived from this pandemic were clearly influenced by the risk perception created in tourist-supplying and pork trade partners. Results suggest that the wider economic implications of health-related emergencies can be significant and need to be considered in preparedness planning. For instance, more effective surveillance and data gathering would enable policy to target emergency funding to the sectors and regions hardest hit. These results also stress the importance of being familiar with trade networks so as to be able to anticipate the international response and respond accordingly.

10.1002/hec.2862.abstractZh: 通过考察游客数量、猪肉产量及贸易统计数据，本文估算了H1N1流感大流行对墨西哥旅游业和猪肉产业的经济影响。同时，本文还评估了国际应对措施在这一经济影响中的作用。对于旅游业而言，近百万海外游客的流失导致约28亿美元的损失，这一损失持续了五个月，主要是由于欧洲游客的回流速度缓慢。对于猪肉产业，该国大部分地区的产量出现下降，这与H1N1的流行情况密切相关（p = 0.048，r = 0.37）。到2009年底，墨西哥的猪肉贸易出现了2700万美元的赤字。此次大流行带来的损失显然受到游客供应和猪肉贸易伙伴所面临的风险感知的影响。研究结果表明，与健康相关的紧急事件所带来的更广泛的经济影响可能是显著的，因此在应急规划中需要考虑这些因素。例如，更有效的监测和数据收集将有助于政策能够有针对性地向受冲击最严重的行业和地区提供紧急资金援助。这些结果也强调了熟悉贸易网络的重要性，以便能够预测国际应对措施并作出相应的反应。

abstract.text: This paper presents a new method of assessing the relationship between features of the built environment and obesity, particularly in urban areas. Our empirical application combines georeferenced data on the location of fast-food restaurants with data about personal health, behavioral, and neighborhood characteristics. We define a 'local food environment' for every individual utilizing buffers around a person's home address. Individual food landscapes are potentially endogenous because of spatial sorting of the population and food outlets, and the body mass index (BMI) values for individuals living close to each other are likely to be spatially correlated because of observed and unobserved individual and neighborhood effects. The potential biases associated with endogeneity and spatial correlation are handled using spatial econometric estimation techniques. Our application provides quantitative estimates of the effect of proximity to fast-food restaurants on obesity in an urban food market. We also present estimates of a policy simulation that focuses on reducing the density of fast-food restaurants in urban areas. In the simulations, we account for spatial heterogeneity in both the policy instruments and individual neighborhoods and find a small effect for the hypothesized relationships between individual BMI values and the density of fast-food restaurants.

10.1002/hec.2863.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种评估建成环境特征与肥胖关系的新方法，尤其适用于城市地区。我们的实证分析将快速食品餐厅的位置数据与个人健康、行为和社区特征数据相结合。我们为每个个体定义了一个“本地食品环境”，并围绕其家庭住址划定缓冲区。由于人口和食品店铺的空间分布，个体食品环境可能是内生的；而居住距离相近的个体的体重指数（BMI）值可能因观察到的或未观察到的个体及社区效应而具有空间相关性。我们使用空间计量经济学估计技术来处理与内生性和空间相关性相关的潜在偏差。我们的研究提供了关于城市食品市场中快速食品餐厅距离对肥胖影响的定量估计，并提出了一种政策模拟方案，旨在降低城市地区快速食品餐厅的密度。在模拟中，我们考虑了政策工具和个体社区的空间异质性，发现个体BMI值与快速食品餐厅密度之间的假设关系效果较小。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the price elasticity of demand for prescription drugs using an exogenous shift in consumer co-payment caused by a reform in the Danish subsidy scheme for the general public. Using purchasing records for the entire Danish population, I show that the average price response for the most commonly used drug yields demand elasticities in the range of -0.36 to -0.5. The reform is shown to affect women, the elderly, and immigrants the most. Furthermore, this paper shows significant heterogeneity in the price response over different types of antibiotics, suggesting that the price elasticity of demand varies considerably even across relatively similar drugs.

10.1002/hec.2864.abstractZh: 本文通过丹麦对普通民众补贴方案改革导致消费者共同支付额的外生变化，估算了处方药需求的价格弹性。利用整个丹麦人口的购买记录，我们发现最常用的药物的平均价格反应呈现出-0.36到-0.5的需求弹性范围。改革对女性、老年人和移民的影响最为显著。此外，本文还发现不同类型抗生素的价格反应存在显著差异，这表明即使是在相对相似的药物中，需求的价格弹性也存在着相当大的变化。

abstract.text: We formulate a stylized structural model of health, wealth accumulation and retirement decisions building on the human capital framework of health and derive analytic solutions for the time paths of consumption, health, health investment, savings and retirement. We argue that the literature has been unnecessarily restrictive in assuming that health is always at the 'optimal' health level. Exploring the properties of corner solutions, we find that advances in population health decrease the retirement age, whereas at the same time, individuals retire when their health has deteriorated. This potentially explains why retirees point to deteriorating health as an important reason for early retirement, whereas retirement ages have continued to fall in the developed world, despite continued improvements in population health and mortality. In our model, workers with higher human capital invest more in health and, because they stay healthier, retire later than those with lower human capital whose health deteriorates faster.

10.1002/hec.2865.abstractZh: 我们基于人力资本框架，构建了一个关于健康、财富积累和退休决策的结构化模型，并推导出消费、健康、健康投资、储蓄和退休时间路径的分析解。我们认为，现有文献在假设健康始终处于“最优”水平方面过于限制性。通过研究角点解的性质，我们发现人口健康的进步会降低退休年龄，而与此同时，个体在健康状况恶化时才会退休。这或许可以解释为什么退休人员将健康状况恶化视为提前退休的重要原因，尽管在发达国家，尽管人口健康和死亡率持续改善，退休年龄却仍在下降。在我们的模型中，拥有较高人力资本的工作者会在健康方面投入更多，因此他们比那些健康恶化更快、人力资本较低的工作者更早退休。

abstract.text: This work considers whether planning matters with respect to the effect of a new sibling on another siblings' health. Objective health outcomes are observed before and after a new addition to the family. To date, the literature on family size has focused on a quality-quantity trade-off; the more children in a family, the less resources devoted to each child. We present a theoretical framework which highlights that the quantity-quality trade-off may only be relevant in the case of an unplanned sibling. We also suggest that a planned sibling may result in health gains for the other children. We use two waves of data for more than 1800 children from Peru from the Young Lives Project to test our hypothesis. The data relate to the children at 1 and 5 years. For health outcomes, height for age and weight for age Z are considered. The results highlight significant negative independent effects on height for age when an unplanned sibling is added to the household. In addition, we find positive sibling effects on height for age when a planned sibling arrives. We find only small planning effects for weight for age. We view our hypothesis as a pathway that can further explain the quantity-quality trade-off.

10.1002/hec.2866.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了新添的兄弟姐妹对另一个兄弟姐妹的健康影响是否值得规划。在家庭中新增一个成员之前和之后，观察了客观的健康结果。迄今为止，关于家庭规模的文献主要关注质量与数量之间的权衡：家庭中的孩子越多，分配给每个孩子的资源就越少。我们提出了一个理论框架，指出这种质量与数量之间的权衡可能仅适用于计划外的兄弟姐妹。我们还认为，计划中的兄弟姐妹可能会为其他孩子带来健康收益。我们使用来自秘鲁的“青年生活项目”中超过1800名儿童的两波数据来检验我们的假设。这些数据涉及1岁和5岁的儿童。在健康结果方面，我们考虑了年龄别身高和年龄别体重Z。研究结果表明，当家庭中出现计划外的兄弟姐妹时，年龄别身高存在显著的负向独立效应。此外，我们发现当计划中的兄弟姐妹到来时，年龄别身高存在正向的兄弟姐妹效应。对于年龄别体重，我们发现规划效应很小。我们将我们的假设视为进一步解释质量与数量之间权衡的一条路径。

abstract.text: It has already been pointed out that the bootstrap can be used to calculate the expected value of perfect information (EVPI) when individual-level data from a randomized controlled trial (RCT) is at hand. However, as mentioned by others, it is not clear if and how such a method can be extended to calculate the expected value of sample information (EVSI). In this article, we provide a nonparametric definition for EVPI and EVSI, which is based on considering the entire population distribution as the uncertain entity for which the current RCT provides partial information. This enables a theoretical justification for using the bootstrap for EVPI calculation and allows us to propose a two-level resampling method for EVSI calculation. What is considered as the sampling unit in this algorithm can range from the individual level net benefits to the full panel of the RCT data for an individual, enabling the analyst to decide on a trade-off between computational efficiency and comprehensiveness in value of information analysis. As such, we argue that this method, in addition to being consistent with the popular bootstrap method of RCT-based economic evaluations, is a flexible approach for EVPI and EVSI calculations.

10.1002/hec.2869.abstractZh: 已有研究指出，当拥有随机对照试验（RCT）的个体层面数据时，可以使用自举法来计算完全信息的期望值（EVPI）。然而，正如其他学者所指出的，目前尚不清楚是否以及如何将这种方法扩展到计算样本信息的期望值（EVSI）。在本文中，我们为EVPI和EVSI提供了一个非参数定义，该定义基于将整个人群分布视为不确定因素，而当前的RCT仅提供了部分信息。这一理论依据使得使用自举法计算EVPI成为可能，并允许我们提出一种两级重采样方法来计算EVSI。在这一算法中，采样单位可以从个体的净收益到整个RCT数据中的个体数据不等，从而让分析者能够在计算效率和信息分析的价值全面性之间做出权衡。因此，我们认为，除了与流行的基于RCT的经济评估自举法一致之外，这种方法还是计算EVPI和EVSI的灵活方法。

abstract.text: This article explores the determinants of road traffic crash fatalities in India. In addition to income, the analysis considers the sociodemographic population structure, motorization levels, road and health infrastructure and road rule enforcement as potential factors. An original panel data set covering 25 Indian states is analyzed using multivariate regression analysis. Time and state fixed-effects account for unobserved heterogeneity across states and time. The rising motorization, urbanization and accompanying increase in the share of vulnerable road users, that is, pedestrians and two-wheelers, are the major drivers of road traffic crash fatalities in India. Among vulnerable road users, women form a particularly high-risk group. Higher expenditure per police officer is associated with a lower fatality rate. The results suggest that India should focus, in particular, on road infrastructure investments that allow the separation of vulnerable from other road users on improved road rule enforcement and should pay special attention to vulnerable female road users.

10.1002/hec.2870.abstractZh: 本文探讨了印度道路交通事故死亡人数的决定因素。除了收入因素外，分析还考虑了社会人口结构、机动车化水平、道路与卫生基础设施以及道路规则执行情况等潜在因素。研究采用了涵盖印度25个州的原始面板数据集，并通过多元回归分析进行了分析。时间效应和州固定效应被用来解释各州和时间上的异质性。机动车化的增加、城市化的进程以及弱势道路使用者的比例上升——即行人和两轮车使用者的增加——是印度道路交通事故死亡人数上升的主要驱动因素。在弱势道路使用者中，女性属于特别高风险群体。每位警察的支出越高，死亡率就越低。研究结果表明，印度应特别关注道路基础设施投资，以将弱势道路使用者与其他道路使用者区分开来，同时加强道路规则的执行，并特别关注弱势女性道路使用者。

abstract.text: Observed variation in hospital costs may be attributable to differences in patients' health outcomes. Previous studies have resorted to inherently incomplete outcome measures such as mortality or re-admission rates to assess this claim. This study makes use of a novel dataset of routinely collected patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) linked to inpatient records to (i) access the degree to which cost variation is associated with variation in patients' health gain and (ii) explore how far judgement about hospital cost performance changes when health outcomes are accounted for. We use multilevel modelling to address the clustering of patients in providers and isolate unexplained cost variation. We find some evidence of a U-shaped relationship between risk-adjusted costs and outcomes for hip replacement surgery. For three other procedures (knee replacement, varicose vein and groin hernia surgery), the estimated relationship is sensitive to the choice of PROM instrument. We do not observe substantial changes in cost performance estimates when outcomes are explicitly accounted for.

10.1002/hec.2871.abstractZh: 观察到的医院成本差异可能归因于患者健康结果的差异。以往的研究通常采用诸如死亡率或再入院率等不完全的结果指标来评估这一现象。本研究利用了一组常规收集的患者报告结果指标（PROMs）与住院记录相关联的数据集，以（i）了解成本差异与患者健康改善程度之间的关联程度，以及（ii）在考虑健康结果后，对医院成本绩效的判断会发生多大的变化。我们采用多层模型来分析患者在医疗服务提供者中的聚集现象，并找出无法解释的成本差异。我们发现，在髋关节置换手术中，风险调整后的成本与结果之间存在U形关系。对于其他三种手术（膝关节置换、静脉曲张和腹股沟疝手术），估计出的关系对所选用的PROM指标较为敏感。在明确考虑健康结果后，我们并未观察到成本绩效估计值的显著变化。

abstract.text: The criteria used by the National Institute for Health and Clinical Excellence (NICE) for accepting higher incremental cost-effectiveness ratios for some medicines over others, and the recent introduction of the Cancer Drugs Fund (CDF) in England, are assumed to reflect societal preferences for National Health Service resource allocation. Robust empirical evidence to this effect is lacking. To explore societal preferences for these and other criteria, including those proposed for rewarding new medicines under the future value-based pricing (VBP) system, we conducted a choice-based experiment in 4118 UK adults via web-based surveys. Preferences were determined by asking respondents to allocate fixed funds between different patient and disease types reflecting nine specific prioritisation criteria. Respondents supported the criteria proposed under the VBP system (for severe diseases, address unmet needs, are innovative--provided they offered substantial health benefits, and have wider societal benefits) but did not support the end-of-life premium or the prioritisation of children or disadvantaged populations as specified by NICE, nor the special funding status for treatments of rare diseases, nor the CDF. Policies introduced on the basis of perceived--and not actual--societal values may lead to inappropriate resource allocation decisions with the potential for significant population health and economic consequences.

10.1002/hec.2872.abstractZh: 英国国家健康与临床卓越研究所（NICE）在评估某些药物的增量成本效益比时，会采用特定的标准，并最近在英格兰引入了癌症药物基金（CDF）。这些做法被认为反映了社会对国家卫生服务资源分配的偏好。然而，目前缺乏足够的实证证据来支持这一观点。为了探究社会对这些标准以及其他标准的偏好，包括未来基于价值的定价体系下对新型药物的奖励标准，我们在4118名英国成年人中通过网络调查进行了选择实验。受访者被要求在不同患者和疾病类型之间分配固定资金，同时参考了九项具体的优先级标准。受访者支持基于价值定价体系下的标准（针对严重疾病、解决未满足的需求、具有创新性——前提是能带来显著的健康效益，并且具有更广泛的社会效益），但不支持NICE所提出的临终关怀附加费、儿童或弱势群体的优先待遇、罕见疾病治疗的特殊资助地位，也不支持癌症药物基金。基于感知而非实际的社会价值观制定的政策可能导致不恰当的资源分配决策，进而对人群健康和经济产生重大影响。

abstract.text: From a policy standpoint, the spread of health conditions in social networks is important to quantify, because it implies externalities and possible market failures in the consumption of health interventions. Recent studies conclude that happiness and depression may be highly contagious across social ties. The results may be biased, however, because of selection and common shocks. We provide unbiased estimates by using exogenous variation from college roommate assignments. Our findings are consistent with no significant overall contagion of mental health and no more than small contagion effects for specific mental health measures, with no evidence for happiness contagion and modest evidence for anxiety and depression contagion. The weakness of the contagion effects cannot be explained by avoidance of roommates with poor mental health or by generally low social contact among roommates. We also find that similarity of baseline mental health predicts the closeness of roommate relationships, which highlights the potential for selection biases in studies of peer effects that do not have a clearly exogenous source of variation. Overall, our results suggest that mental health contagion is lower, or at least more context specific, than implied by the recent studies in the medical literature.

10.1002/hec.2873.abstractZh: 从政策角度来看，社会网络中健康状况的传播程度需要被量化，因为这涉及到外部性以及健康干预措施消费过程中可能出现的市场失灵。最近的研究表明，幸福感和抑郁情绪可能在社会关系中具有高度传染性。然而，这些结果可能存在偏差，因为受到选择和共同冲击的影响。我们通过使用大学室友分配产生的外生变量来提供无偏估计。我们的研究结果表明，心理健康状况总体上没有显著的传染性，特定心理健康指标的传播效应也不大，没有证据表明幸福感具有传染性，而焦虑和抑郁情绪的传染性则有一定的证据。这种传播效应的弱小并不能用避免与心理健康状况不佳的室友相处来解释，也不能用室友之间普遍较低的社会接触程度来解释。我们还发现，基线心理健康状况的相似性可以预测室友关系的紧密程度，这突显了在没有明确外生变量来源的研究中，同伴效应可能存在选择偏差。总体而言，我们的结果表明，心理健康状况的传染性较低，或者至少更具情境特异性，这与医学文献中的最新研究结论相符。

abstract.text: We develop a theoretical model of a local healthcare system in which consumers, health insurance companies, and healthcare providers interact with each other in markets for health insurance and healthcare services. When income and health status are heterogeneous, and healthcare quality is associated with fixed costs, the market equilibrium level of healthcare quality will be underprovided. Thus, healthcare reform provisions and proposals to cover the uninsured can be interpreted as an attempt to correct this market failure. We illustrate with a numerical example that if consumers at the local level clearly understand the linkages between health insurance coverage and the quality of local healthcare services, health insurance coverage proposals are more likely to enjoy public support.

10.1002/hec.2874.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个关于地方医疗系统的理论模型，其中消费者、健康保险公司和医疗服务提供者通过健康保险和医疗服务市场进行互动。当收入和健康状况存在异质性，且医疗质量与固定成本相关时，医疗质量的市场均衡水平将会低于实际需求。因此，医疗改革措施以及为未投保人群提供保险的建议，可以被视为纠正这一市场失灵的尝试。我们通过一个数值示例说明，如果地方层面的消费者能够清楚地理解健康保险覆盖与当地医疗服务质量之间的联系，那么关于健康保险覆盖的提案更有可能获得公众的支持。

abstract.text: Recent research documents that socioeconomic health inequality has its origins in early childhood, that is, children from high-income families have better health than their peers from low-income families. In this article, we investigate the determinants of the evolution of socioeconomic health inequality in the UK. We analyze the relation between household income and both the prevalence and the consequences of adverse health conditions by following up infants throughout early childhood. We find evidence for the hypothesis that parental income operates through two different channels: it reduces the likelihood of incurring certain illnesses and it cushions the consequences of health conditions. Our results also indicate that a higher household income increases the probability that children fully recover from some diseases within a given period.

10.1002/hec.2876.abstractZh: 近期的研究表明，社会经济健康不平等的起源可以追溯到幼儿时期，也就是说，来自高收入家庭的儿童比来自低收入家庭的同龄人拥有更好的健康状况。在本文中，我们探讨了英国社会经济健康不平等演变的决定因素。我们通过跟踪婴儿在幼儿时期的状况，分析了家庭收入与不良健康状况的普遍程度及其后果之间的关系。我们发现，父母收入通过两种不同的途径影响健康：一是降低某些疾病发生的可能性，二是减轻健康状况带来的后果。我们的研究结果还表明，较高的家庭收入会增加儿童在一段时间内完全康复某些疾病的概率。

abstract.text: This article uses data from the Health and Retirement Study for 1998-2010 to investigate whether households respond to the financial stress caused by health problems by increasing their unsecured debt. Results show both the probability of having unsecured debt and the amount of debt increase after an adverse health event among households with low financial assets, who are uninsured, or who have less generous health insurance. The effect of health problems on borrowing is caused by both medical expenditures and disruptions to the income stream. Unsecured debt seems to remain on some households' balance sheets for an extended period.

10.1002/hec.2877.abstractZh: 本文利用1998-2010年的健康与退休研究数据，调查了家庭是否会通过增加无担保债务来应对由健康问题引发的财务压力。结果显示，在金融资产较低、未投保或健康保险条件较差的家庭中，发生健康问题的概率以及债务金额都会增加。健康问题对借贷行为的影响源于医疗费用以及收入流的中断。无担保债务似乎会在某些家庭的资产负债表上持续存在较长时间。

abstract.text: The US federal government has recently made a substantial investment to enhance the US health information technology (IT) infrastructure. Previous literature on the impact of IT on firm performance across multiple industries has emphasized the importance of a process of co-invention whereby organizations develop complementary practices to achieve greater benefit from their IT investments. In health care, employment of physicians by hospitals can confer greater administrative control to hospitals over physicians' actions and resources and thus enable the implementation of new technology and initiatives aimed at maximizing benefit from use of the technology. In this study, I tested for the relationship between hospital employment of physicians and hospitals' propensity to use health IT. I used state laws that prohibit hospital employment of physicians as an instrument to account for the endogenous relationship with hospital IT use. Hospital employment of physicians is associated with significant increases in the probability of hospital health IT use. Therefore, subsidization of health IT among hospitals not employing physicians may be less efficient. Furthermore, state laws prohibiting hospitals from employing physicians may inhibit adoption of health IT, thus working against policy initiatives aimed at promoting use of the technology.

10.1002/hec.2878.abstractZh: 美国联邦政府最近投入了大量资金以提升美国的健康信息技术基础设施。以往关于信息技术对多个行业企业绩效影响的文献强调了共同创新过程的重要性，即组织通过开发互补的实践来从信息技术投资中获得更大的收益。在医疗保健领域，医院雇佣医生可以赋予医院对医生行为和资源的更大管理权，从而推动新技术的采用，并最大化利用这些技术的效益。在这项研究中，我探讨了医院雇佣医生与医院使用健康信息技术倾向之间的关系。我利用禁止医院雇佣医生的州法律作为工具，来解释医院信息技术使用与雇佣医生之间的内生关系。医院雇佣医生与医院使用健康信息技术的可能性显著增加相关。因此，对不雇佣医生的医院提供健康信息技术的补贴可能效率较低。此外，禁止医院雇佣医生的州法律可能会阻碍健康信息技术的采用，从而阻碍旨在促进该技术使用的政策举措。

abstract.text: Interpreting the outcomes of cost utility analyses requires an appropriately defined threshold for costs per quality-adjusted life year (QALY). A common view is that the threshold should represent the (consumption) value a society attaches to a QALY. So far, individual valuations of personal health gains have mainly been studied rather than potentially relevant social values. In this study, we present the first direct empirical estimates of the willingness to pay for a QALY from a societal perspective. We used the contingent valuation approach, valuing QALYs under uncertainty and correcting for probability weighting. The estimates obtained in a representative sample of the Dutch population (n = 1004) range from €52,000 to €83,000, depending on the specification of the societal perspective. The scale sensitivity was weak, however.

10.1002/hec.2879.abstractZh: 解读成本效用分析的结果需要为每质量调整生命年（QALY）的成本设定一个合适的阈值。普遍的观点认为，这个阈值应代表社会对于每个QALY的（消费）价值。迄今为止，关于个人健康收益的个人评估研究较多，而关于潜在相关的社会价值的研究则相对较少。在本研究中，我们首次从社会角度直接估算了人们愿意为每个QALY支付的价格。我们采用了条件价值评估方法，在不确定性条件下对QALY进行估值，并进行了概率加权校正。在荷兰人口的代表性样本（n=1004）中获得的估算值范围从52,000欧元到83,000欧元，具体取决于社会视角的设定。然而，价格敏感度较低。

abstract.text: Unlabelled This article examines whether providing informal eldercare to an older dependent person predicts employees' intentions to change jobs or exit the labor market and, if so, which particular aspects of both caregiving (e.g. time demands, physical/cognitive care burden) and their current work environment shape these intentions. We used data from a sample of 471 caring and 431 noncaring employees in Austria and split the analyses by gender. We found different aspects of informal caregiving to be associated with the intention to change jobs and with the anticipated labor market withdrawal of male and female workers. A time-based conflict between informal eldercare and paid work was significantly and positively related to the intended job change of female workers but not of their male counterparts. Flexible work arrangements were found to facilitate the attachment of female workers to their jobs and the labor market. Intentions to exit the labor market of male workers appeared to be triggered by a physical care burden rather than time demands. Highlights We studied the effects of providing informal eldercare on the turnover intention of men and women in a group of workers who were also the main carers providing support to a dependent older person with substantial care needs. The intention of male and female workers to change jobs and exit the labor market is shaped by the different characteristics of informal caregiving. Time-based conflicts between informal care and paid work are associated with a higher relative risk of anticipating job changes for female workers. Flextime facilitates the job and labor market attachment of female workers with eldercare responsibilities. The intensity of personal care provided to an older relative is significantly positively related to male workers' relative risk of anticipated labor market exit. Care to an older person in need of supervision makes the labor market exit of female workers less likely, lending thus support to the idea of the respite effect of work.

10.1002/hec.2880.abstractZh:
本文探讨了为年长需要照顾的家人提供非正式护理服务是否会影响员工更换工作或退出劳动力市场的意愿。如果确实如此，那么护理工作的具体方面（如时间要求、身体/认知护理负担）以及当前的工作环境，会对这些意愿产生何种影响。我们采用了奥地利471名从事护理工作的员工和431名不从事护理工作的员工的数据，并按性别进行了分析。研究发现，非正式护理服务的不同方面与更换工作的意愿以及男女工人预期退出劳动力市场的意愿有关。非正式护理与有偿工作之间在时间上的冲突，与女性工人更换工作的意愿呈正相关，而男性工人则没有这种关联。灵活的工作安排有助于女性工人保持对工作的投入以及与劳动力市场的联系。男性工人退出劳动力市场的意愿似乎是由身体护理负担而非时间要求所引发的。

我们研究了为年长需要照顾的家人提供非正式护理服务对男女工人离职意愿的影响，这些工人同时也是主要的照顾者，负责照顾那些需要大量护理的老年人。男女工人更换工作和退出劳动力市场的意愿，受到非正式护理服务不同特征的影响。非正式护理与有偿工作之间在时间上的冲突，与女性工人预期更换工作的风险较高有关。灵活的工作安排有助于有护理责任的女性工人保持与工作和劳动力市场的联系。对年长亲属提供的个人关怀程度与男性工人预期退出劳动力市场的相对风险之间存在显著的正相关关系。对需要监督的年长人的关怀，使得女性工人退出劳动力市场的可能性降低，从而支持了工作带来的休息效应的观点。

abstract.text: Informal payments-payments made from patients to health personnel in excess of official fees--are widespread in low-income countries. It is not obvious how such payments affect health worker effort. On the one hand, one could argue that because informal payments resemble formal pay for performance schemes, they will incite higher effort in the health sector. On the other hand, health personnel may strategically adjust their base effort downwards to maximise patients' willingness to pay informally for extra services. To explore the relationship between informal payments and health worker effort, we use a unique data set from Tanzania with over 2000 observations on the performance of 156 health workers. Patient data on informal payments are used to assess the likelihood that a particular health worker accepts informal payment. We find that health workers who likely accept payments do not exert higher average effort. They do however have a higher variability in the effort they exert to different patients. These health workers are also less sensitive to the medical condition of the patient. A likely explanation for these findings is that health workers engage in rent seeking and lower baseline effort to induce patients to pay.

10.1002/hec.2881.abstractZh: 在低收入国家，患者向医护人员支付的超出正式薪酬的非正式报酬非常普遍。然而，这种报酬如何影响医护人员的努力程度尚不清楚。一方面，有人可能会认为，由于非正式报酬类似于正式的绩效奖励机制，它们会激励医护人员付出更多的努力。另一方面，医护人员可能会通过策略性地降低基本努力程度来最大化患者对额外服务的非正式支付意愿。为了探讨非正式报酬与医护人员努力之间的关系，我们使用了坦桑尼亚的一个独特数据集，该数据集包含156名医护人员的2000多项观察数据。通过患者关于非正式报酬的数据，我们可以评估特定医护人员接受非正式报酬的可能性。研究发现，那些可能接受非正式报酬的医护人员并没有表现出更高的平均努力程度。不过，他们对不同患者的努力程度变化幅度更大。这些医护人员对患者的病情也较为不敏感。这些发现的一个可能解释是，医护人员通过租金获取行为来降低基本努力程度，以诱导患者支付报酬。

abstract.text: We analyze the spread of sexually transmitted infections in an environment where individuals search for a sexual partner and, when found, cannot verify whether his partner is infected. Decisions are based on a variety of factors including the proportion infected, the likelihood of safe sex, the rate of detection and treatment, the cost of infection, and the length of search. The model demonstrates how directed search induces a separating equilibrium and, as a result, supports empirical evidence demonstrating the importance of sero-sorting. Furthermore, the model reinforces arguments that decreasing the costs of infection increases the infection rate. The model is calibrated, and the policy implications are analyzed within the context of men who have sex with men.

10.1002/hec.2882.abstractZh: 我们分析了在个体寻找性伴侣且无法确认伴侣是否感染的情况下，性传播感染的传播情况。决策基于多种因素，包括感染比例、安全性行为的可能性、检测和治疗率、感染成本以及寻找伴侣的时间长度。模型表明，有方向的搜索行为会导致分离均衡的出现，从而支持了血清分类重要性的实证证据。此外，该模型进一步支持了这样一个观点：降低感染成本会提高感染率。模型已进行校准，并在男男性行为者的背景下分析了其政策含义。

abstract.text: We present an approach to rank order new programs in ways that accommodate uncertainty of different outcomes occurring, on the basis of the size and nature ('bad' or 'good') of those outcomes. This represents an improvement on the way uncertainty has been accommodated in existing approaches (e.g., threshold approach to cost-effectiveness analysis). We illustrate the approach using the decision making plane, which explicitly incorporates opportunity costs and relaxes the assumptions of perfect divisibility and constant returns to scale of the cost-effectiveness plane. The nature of the bad (or good) outcome is determined by the quadrant that it falls into (i.e., a 'quadrant effect') and its magnitude by its location within the quadrant (i.e., 'within quadrant effect'). By explicitly defining the loss function, the process of accepting (or rejecting) a new program becomes transparent. We illustrate the approach using a loss function and a net gain function. We show that by recognizing that, not all bad (or good) outcomes are equal and the choice of a loss or a net gain function can result in different ranking of resource allocation options. Further implications of the proposed approach are discussed.

10.1002/hec.2883.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种对新的项目进行排序的方法，该方法能够考虑到不同结果出现的不确定性，依据这些结果的规模和性质（即“不良”或“良好”）来进行排序。这比现有方法在处理不确定性时的方式有所改进（例如，成本效益分析的阈值方法）。我们通过决策平面来说明这种方法，该平面明确包含了机会成本，并放宽了成本效益平面中完全可分割性和规模报酬不变等假设。不良（或良好）结果的性质取决于它所处的象限（即“象限效应”），而其规模则取决于它在象限内的位置（即“象限内效应”）。通过明确定义损失函数，接受或拒绝一个新项目的过程变得透明。我们通过损失函数和净收益函数来说明这种方法。我们表明，通过认识到并非所有不良（或良好）结果都是相同的，选择损失函数或净收益函数可以导致资源分配选项的不同排序。此外，还讨论了所提出方法的进一步含义。

abstract.text: This study examines whether privately insured patients avoid hospitals with large Medicaid populations. I use a conditional logit model of hospital choice to determine whether the size of a hospital's Medicaid population affects the probability that a privately insured patient will choose that hospital. I focus on the metropolitan area of Tampa, Florida, in the years 1994-1996. I control for hospital fixed effects, hospital-specific time trends, patients' driving time to the hospital, and interactions between patient and hospital characteristics. I also instrument for the Medicaid population using the predicted Medicaid population. The results show that privately insured patients are less likely to choose a hospital if it served a larger number of Medicaid patients who were admitted through the emergency department in the previous 6 months. The effect persists over time-an additional 6-month lag cuts the effect in half. Capacity constraints do not seem to be the reason for the effect. I show that the Medicaid effect size could have a moderate effect on the profits of some hospitals. Although limited in scope, this study suggests that hospitals may experience a negative effect on their private revenues when they admit a large population of Medicaid patients.

10.1002/hec.2884.abstractZh: 本研究探讨私人保险患者是否会避开拥有大量医疗补助患者的医院。我采用条件逻辑模型来分析医院选择行为，以确定医院医疗补助患者的数量是否会影响私人保险患者选择该医院的概率。研究重点为1994至1996年佛罗里达州坦帕市的大都市区域。我控制了医院固定效应、医院特定时间趋势、患者前往医院的行驶时间，以及患者与医院特征之间的交互作用。我还使用预测的医疗补助患者数量作为工具变量。研究结果表明，如果某医院在过去6个月内有较多通过急诊部门收治的医疗补助患者，私人保险患者选择该医院的可能性会降低。这种影响会持续一段时间——额外的6个月滞后会使影响减半。容量限制似乎不是造成这种影响的原因。研究还表明，医疗补助患者的数量对部分医院的利润有中等程度的影响。尽管研究范围有限，但本研究提示，当医院收治大量医疗补助患者时，可能会对其私人收入产生负面影响。

abstract.text: We extend the existing literature on food taxes targeting obesity. We systematically incorporate the implicit substitution between added sugars and solid fats into a comprehensive food demand system and evaluate the effect of taxes on sugars and fats. The approach conditions how food and obesity taxes affect total calorie intake. The proposed methodology accounts for the ability of consumers to substitute leaner low-fat and low-sugar items for rich food items within the same food group. We calibrate this demand system approach using recent food intake data and existing estimates of price and income elasticities of demand. The demand system accounts for both the within-food group substitution and the substitution across these groups. Simulations of taxes on added sugars and solid fat show that the tax impact on consumption patterns is understated and the induced welfare loss is overstated when not allowing for the substitution possibilities within food groups.

10.1002/hec.2885.abstractZh: 我们扩展了现有关于针对肥胖问题的食品税研究的文献。我们系统地将添加糖和固体脂肪之间的隐性替代关系纳入一个全面的食品需求系统中，并评估了对糖和脂肪征税的影响。该方法考虑了食品税和肥胖税对总热量摄入的影响。所提出的方法论考虑了消费者在同一食品组内用更瘦、低脂肪、低糖的食品替代富含脂肪的食品的能力。我们使用最新的食品摄入数据以及现有的价格和需求弹性估计值来校准这一需求系统模型。该需求系统模型同时考虑了食品组内的替代关系以及不同食品组之间的替代关系。对添加糖和固体脂肪征税的模拟结果显示，如果不考虑食品组内替代的可能性，那么税收对消费模式的影响会被低估，而由此引发的福利损失则会被高估。

abstract.text: The Earned Income Tax Credit is the largest antipoverty program in the USA. In 1993, the Earned Income Tax Credit benefit levels were changed significantly based on the number of children in the family such that families with two or more children experienced an exogenous expansion in their incomes. Using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 cohort, we use a triple-difference plus fixed effects framework to examine the effect of this change on the probability of smoking among low-educated mothers. We find that the probability of smoking for White low-educated mothers of two or more children significantly decreased relative to those with only one child, and this result is robust to various specification tests. This result provides new evidence on the protective effect of income on health through changes in a health-related behavior and therefore has important policy implications.

10.1002/hec.2886.abstractZh: 劳动收入税收抵免是美国最大的反贫困计划。1993年，根据家庭子女数量的不同，劳动收入税收抵免的福利水平发生了显著变化，使得有两个或更多孩子的家庭收入得到了额外增加。我们利用1979年青年纵向调查的数据，采用三重差分加固定效应框架来研究这一变化对低教育水平母亲吸烟概率的影响。研究发现，有两个或更多孩子的白人低教育水平母亲吸烟的概率显著低于只有一个孩子的母亲，这一结果在各种统计检验中均保持稳定。这一研究结果为通过改变与健康相关的行为来提升收入对健康的保护作用提供了新的证据，因此具有重要的政策意义。

abstract.text: This paper studies price determination in pharmaceutical markets using data for 25 countries, 6 years, and a comprehensive list of products from the MIDAS IMS database. A key finding is that the USA has prices that are not significantly higher than those of countries with similar income levels, especially those that are 'lightly regulated'. More importantly, price differences to the US levels increase for 'branded', world top selling, or innovative products, and decrease, regardless of the level of regulation for mature or widely diffused molecules. Because prices for top selling molecules may be easier to perceive and recollect and more important for companies, they may bias the public discussion about international price differences.

10.1002/hec.2887.abstractZh: 本文利用MIDAS IMS数据库中的25个国家、6年的数据以及全面的产品列表，研究了药品市场的价格确定问题。研究发现，美国的药品价格并不显著高于收入水平相似的国家，尤其是那些监管较为宽松的国家。更重要的是，对于“品牌化”、全球销量领先或具有创新性的产品而言，价格与美国的差距会增大；而对于成熟或广泛普及的分子产品来说，这种差距则会减小。由于销量领先的分子产品更容易被消费者感知和记忆，并且对公司而言更为重要，这些因素可能会影响公众对国际价格差异的讨论。

abstract.text: We show that individual utilities can be measured in units of healthy life years. Social preferences over these life metric utilities are assumed to satisfy the Pareto principle, anonymity, and invariance to a change in origin. These axioms generate a utilitarian social welfare function implying the use of cost-effectiveness analysis in ordering health projects, based on maximizing the healthy years equivalents gained from a fixed health budget. For projects outside the health sector, our cost-effectiveness axioms imply a form of cost-benefit analysis where both costs and benefits are measured in equivalent healthy life years.

10.1002/hec.2889.abstractZh: 我们表明，个体效用可以用健康年数作为计量单位来衡量。社会对这些健康年数效用的偏好被假设满足帕累托原则、匿名性以及对起源变化的不变性。这些公理产生了一个功利主义社会福利函数，这意味着在排序健康项目时，应基于最大化从固定健康预算中获得的健康年数当量来进行成本效益分析。对于非健康领域的项目，我们的成本效益公理意味着一种成本效益分析形式，其中成本和收益都以健康年数当量来衡量。

abstract.text: Pay for performance (P4P) incentives for physicians are generally designed as additional payments that can be paired with any existing payment mechanism such as a salary, fee-for-services and capitation. However, the link between the physician response to performance incentives and the existing payment mechanisms is still not well understood. In this article, we study this link using the recent primary care physician payment reform in Ontario as a natural experiment and the Diabetes Management Incentive as a case study. Using a comprehensive administrative data strategy and a difference-in-differences matching strategy, we find that physicians in a blended capitation model are more responsive to the Diabetes Management Incentive than physicians in an enhanced fee-for-service model. We show that this result implies that the optimal size of P4P incentives vary negatively with the degree of supply-side cost-sharing. These results have important implications for the design of P4P programs and the cost of their implementation.

10.1002/hec.2890.abstractZh: 针对医生的绩效支付激励措施通常设计为额外的报酬，可以与现有的支付机制相结合，例如工资、服务收费和承包制。然而，医生对绩效激励的反应与现有支付机制之间的联系仍不甚明了。在本文中，我们以安大略省最近对初级保健医生支付制度的改革作为自然实验，并以糖尿病管理激励措施作为案例研究，来探讨这一联系。通过采用全面的行政数据策略和差异匹配策略，我们发现，在混合承包制模式下工作的医生对糖尿病管理激励措施的响应程度高于在强化服务收费模式下工作的医生。这一结果表明，绩效支付激励措施的最佳规模会随着供应方成本分担程度的降低而发生变化。这些结果对绩效支付项目的设计及其实施成本有着重要意义。

abstract.text: Hurdle models are frequently used to model count data. Recent developments in the count data literature make it possible to relax commonly imposed assumptions of these models. On the basis of these findings, two extensions of hurdle models that make popular specifications more flexible are developed. Both extensions nest the models that have been used so far, so they can be tested by appropriate parametric restrictions. An example from health economics illustrates the relevance of both model extensions.

10.1002/hec.2892.abstractZh: 障碍模型常被用于计数数据的建模。计数数据领域的最新进展使得可以放宽这些模型通常所要求的假设。基于这些发现，我们开发了两种扩展的障碍模型，使常用的模型设定更加灵活。这两种扩展都基于现有的模型，因此可以通过适当的参数限制来进行检验。一个来自健康经济学的例子说明了这两种模型扩展的相关性。

abstract.text: We present a two-period framework, which combines real option and decision-theoretic approaches to health technology assessment under uncertainty. By viewing adoption, treatment and research decisions as a single economic project, we illustrate how their key dimensions affect optimal rules. We consider the results in relation to the existing literature and argue that developments in this direction could contribute substantially to efficiency gains in resource allocation.

10.1002/hec.2893.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个双时期框架，该框架结合了实物期权方法和决策理论方法，用于在不确定的情况下评估健康技术。通过将采用、治疗和研究决策视为一个单一的经济项目，我们说明了这些关键维度如何影响最优规则。我们将这些结果与现有文献进行比较，并认为朝这个方向的发展可以显著促进资源分配的效率提升。

abstract.text: The time tradeoff (TTO) method is frequently used to calculate the quality adjustment of the quality adjusted life year and is therefore an important element in the calculation of the benefits of medical interventions. New specifications of TTO, known as 'lead time' TTO and 'lag time' TTO, have been developed to overcome methodological issues of the 'classic' TTO. In the lead time TTO, ill-health is explicitly placed in the future, after a period of good health, whereas in lag time TTO, a health state starts immediately and is followed by a 'lag time' of good health. In this study, we take advantage of these timing properties of lead and lag time TTO. In particular, we use data from a previous study that employed lead and lag time TTO to estimate their implied discounting parameters. We show that individuals prefer being ill later, rather than now, with larger per-period discount rates for longer durations of the health states.

10.1002/hec.2894.abstractZh: 时间权衡（TTO）方法常被用于计算质量调整生命年的质量调整值，因此它是计算医疗干预效益的重要工具。为了克服“经典”TTO的方法论问题，人们开发了新的TTO规格，即“提前时间”TTO和“延迟时间”TTO。在提前时间TTO中，健康状况不佳被明确置于未来，即在一段良好健康状况之后；而在延迟时间TTO中，健康状况立即开始，随后是“延迟时间”内的良好健康状况。在本研究中，我们利用了这些提前时间和延迟时间TTO的时间特性。具体来说，我们使用了之前一项研究的数据，该研究使用提前时间和延迟时间TTO来估计其隐含的折现参数。我们发现，个体更倾向于在较晚的时候生病，而不是现在生病，且健康状况持续的时间越长，每期的折现率就越高。

abstract.text: There has been recent controversy about whether aid directed specifically to health has caused recipient governments to reallocate their own funds to non-health areas. At the same time, general budget support (GBS) has been increasing. GBS allows governments to set their own priorities, but little is known about how these additional resources are subsequently used. This paper uses cross-country panel data to assess the impact of GBS programmes on health spending in low-income and middle-income countries, using dynamic panel techniques to estimate unbiased coefficients in the presence of serial correlation. We found no clear evidence that GBS had any impact, positive or negative, on government health spending derived from domestic sources. GBS also had no observed impact on total government health spending from all sources (external as well as domestic). In contrast, health-specific aid was associated with a decline in health expenditures from domestic sources, but there was not a full substitution effect. That is, despite this observed fungibility, health-specific aid still increases total government health spending from all sources. Finally, increases in total government expenditure led to substantial increases in domestic government health expenditures.

10.1002/hec.2895.abstractZh: 近期存在关于专门针对卫生领域的援助是否导致受援国政府将自身资金重新分配到非卫生领域的争议。与此同时，一般预算支持（GBS）的数量却在增加。GBS允许政府自行设定优先事项，但关于这些额外资源后续如何使用的情况却知之甚少。本文利用跨国面板数据，评估GBS计划对低收入和中等收入国家卫生支出的影响，并采用动态面板技术来估计在存在序列相关性的情况下无偏系数。我们发现，GBS对政府来自国内来源的卫生支出没有产生明显的影响，无论是正面还是负面。此外，GBS对政府来自所有来源的总卫生支出也没有产生显著影响（包括外部和国内来源）。相比之下，针对卫生领域的援助与国内来源卫生支出的减少有关，但并没有完全替代效应。也就是说，尽管存在这种可替代性，针对卫生领域的援助仍然增加了政府来自所有来源的总卫生支出。最后，政府总支出的增加导致了国内政府卫生支出的大幅增加。

abstract.text: The way to treat the correlation between circumstances and effort is a central, yet largely neglected issue in the applied literature on inequality of opportunity. This paper adopts three alternative normative ways of treating this correlation championed by Roemer, Barry and Swift and assesses their empirical relevance using survey data. We combine regression analysis with the natural decomposition of the variance to compare the relative contributions of circumstances and efforts to overall health inequality according to the different normative principles. Our results suggest that, in practice, the normative principle on the way to treat the correlation between circumstances and effort makes little difference on the relative contributions of circumstances and efforts to explained health inequality.

10.1002/hec.2896.abstractZh: 在处理机会不平等相关问题中，环境与努力之间的关联是一个核心但被广泛应用文献所忽视的问题。本文采用Roemer、Barry和Swift提出的三种不同的规范方法来处理这一关联，并通过调查数据评估它们的实证相关性。我们结合回归分析与自然方差分解方法，比较了根据不同规范原则，环境与努力对整体健康不平等的相对贡献。研究结果表明，在实践中，关于如何处理环境与努力之间关联的规范原则，对环境与努力对解释健康不平等的相对贡献几乎没有影响。

abstract.text: This study investigates heterogeneity in Thai doctors' job preferences at the beginning of their career, with a view to inform the design of effective policies to retain them in rural areas. A discrete choice experiment was designed and administered to 198 young doctors. We analysed the data using several specifications of a random parameter model to account for various sources of preference heterogeneity. By modelling preference heterogeneity, we showed how sensitivity to different incentives varied in different sections of the population. In particular, doctors from rural backgrounds were more sensitive than others to a 45% salary increase and having a post near their home province, but they were less sensitive to a reduction in the number of on-call nights. On the basis of the model results, the effects of two types of interventions were simulated: introducing various incentives and modifying the population structure. The results of the simulations provide multiple elements for consideration for policy-makers interested in designing effective interventions. They also underline the interest of modelling preference heterogeneity carefully.

10.1002/hec.2897.abstractZh: 本研究调查了泰国医生在职业生涯初期的工作偏好差异，旨在为制定有效政策以留住他们在农村地区提供参考。研究人员设计并实施了一项离散选择实验，对198名年轻医生进行了调查。我们通过多种随机参数模型对数据进行分析，以解释偏好差异的各种来源。通过建模偏好差异，我们发现不同人群对不同激励措施的敏感度有所不同。具体而言，来自农村背景的医生对45%的薪资增长以及居住在家乡附近的工作地点更为敏感，但对减少值班夜数的敏感度较低。基于模型结果，研究人员模拟了两种干预措施的效果：引入各种激励措施以及调整人口结构。模拟结果为政策制定者提供了多个考虑因素，同时也强调了仔细建模偏好差异的重要性。

abstract.text: Explaining individual, regional, and provider variation in health care spending is of enormous value to policymakers but is often hampered by the lack of individual level detail in universal public health systems because budgeted spending is often not attributable to specific individuals. Even rarer is self-reported survey information that helps explain this variation in large samples. In this paper, we link a cross-sectional survey of 267 188 Australians age 45 and over to a panel dataset of annual healthcare costs calculated from several years of hospital, medical and pharmaceutical records. We use this data to distinguish between cost variations due to health shocks and those that are intrinsic (fixed) to an individual over three years. We find that high fixed expenditures are positively associated with age, especially older males, poor health, obesity, smoking, cancer, stroke and heart conditions. Being foreign born, speaking a foreign language at home and low income are more strongly associated with higher time-varying expenditures, suggesting greater exposure to adverse health shocks.

10.1002/hec.2916.abstractZh: 解释个人、地区以及医疗服务提供者在医疗支出上的差异对政策制定者来说具有巨大价值，但由于普遍公共卫生系统中缺乏个人层面的详细信息，这一工作往往受到阻碍，因为预算支出通常无法明确归属于特定个体。而通过自我报告的调查数据来解释大样本中的这种差异则更为罕见。在本文中，我们将一项针对267,188名45岁及以上澳大利亚人的横断面调查数据与基于多年医院、医疗和药品记录计算出的年度医疗成本面板数据集进行了关联。我们利用这些数据来区分由于健康冲击导致的成本变化与那些在三年时间内属于个体固有（固定）的成本变化。研究发现，较高的固定支出与年龄、尤其是年长的男性、健康状况不佳、肥胖、吸烟、癌症、中风和心脏病等风险因素呈正相关。而外国出生、家庭使用外语以及低收入等因素则与更高的随时间变化的支出有更强的关联，这表明个体更容易受到不利健康冲击的影响。

abstract.text: The quantile regression (QR) framework provides a pragmatic approach in understanding the differential impacts of covariates along the distribution of an outcome. However, the QR framework that has pervaded the applied economics literature is based on the conditional quantile regression method. It is used to assess the impact of a covariate on a quantile of the outcome conditional on specific values of other covariates. In most cases, conditional quantile regression may generate results that are often not generalizable or interpretable in a policy or population context. In contrast, the unconditional quantile regression method provides more interpretable results as it marginalizes the effect over the distributions of other covariates in the model. In this paper, the differences between these two regression frameworks are highlighted, both conceptually and econometrically. Additionally, using real-world claims data from a large US health insurer, alternative QR frameworks are implemented to assess the differential impacts of covariates along the distribution of medication adherence among elderly patients with Alzheimer's disease.

10.1002/hec.2927.abstractZh: 分位数回归框架提供了一种实用的方法，用于理解协变量在结果分布上的不同影响。然而，在应用经济学文献中普遍使用的分位数回归框架是基于条件分位数回归方法的。它用于评估在其它协变量特定值条件下，一个协变量对结果分位数的影响。在大多数情况下，条件分位数回归可能会产生无法普遍化或无法在政策或人群背景下进行解释的结果。相比之下，无条件分位数回归方法提供了更可解释的结果，因为它将效应与其他协变量在模型中的分布分离开来。本文重点讨论了这两种回归框架在概念和经济计量学上的差异。此外，利用美国一家大型健康保险公司提供的真实索赔数据，实施了不同的分位数回归框架，以评估协变量在老年阿尔茨海默病患者药物依从性分布上的不同影响。

abstract.text: We explore two unexpected changes in flight regulations to estimate the causal effect of aircraft noise on health. Detailed measures of noise are linked with longitudinal data on individual health outcomes based on the exact address information. Controlling for individual heterogeneity and spatial sorting into different neighborhoods, we find that aircraft noise significantly increases sleeping problems and headaches. Models that do not control for such heterogeneity and sorting substantially underestimate the negative health effects, which suggests that individuals self-select into residence based on their unobserved sensitivity to noise. Our study demonstrates that the combination of quasi-experimental variation and panel data is very powerful for identifying causal effects in epidemiological field studies.

10.1002/hec.2948.abstractZh: 我们探讨了飞行法规中的两项意外变化，以评估飞机噪音对健康的影响。通过基于确切地址信息的纵向数据，对噪音进行详细测量，并将其与个体健康结果联系起来。在控制个体异质性和空间分布差异后，我们发现飞机噪音显著增加了睡眠问题和头痛的发生。那些没有控制这些异质性和空间分布差异的模型，严重低估了噪音对健康的负面影响，这表明个体会根据其对噪音的未观测敏感性选择居住地点。我们的研究表明，在流行病学领域研究中，结合准实验变量和面板数据对于识别因果效应非常有效。

abstract.text: When health insurance reforms involve non-linear price schedules tied to payment periods (for example, fees levied by quarter or year), the empirical analysis of its effects has to take the within-period time structure of incentives into account. The analysis is further complicated when demand data are obtained from a survey in which the reporting period does not coincide with the payment period. We illustrate these issues using as an example a health care reform in Germany that imposed a per-quarter fee of €10 for doctor visits and additionally set an out-of-pocket maximum. This co-payment structure results in an effective 'spot' price for a doctor visit that decreases over time within each payment period. Taking this variation into account, we find a substantial reform effect-especially so for young adults. Overall, the number of doctor visits decreased by around 9% in the young population. The probability of visiting a physician in any given quarter decreased by around 4 to 8 percentage points.

10.1002/hec.2955.abstractZh: 当健康保险改革涉及与支付周期相关的非线性价格安排时（例如，按季度或年度征收的费用），对其影响的实证分析必须考虑周期内激励结构的差异。当需求数据来自调查，而报告周期与支付周期不一致时，分析会变得更加复杂。我们以德国的一项医疗改革为例，该改革规定每次就诊需支付10欧元的费用，并设定了最高自付金额。这种共同支付结构导致每次就诊的“实时”价格随时间在支付周期内下降。考虑到这种变化，我们发现这项改革对年轻人产生了显著的影响。总体而言，年轻人群次的就诊次数减少了约9%。任何给定季度就诊医生的概率下降了约4到8个百分点。

abstract.text: This paper studies short-run cyclical behaviour of public (government and social) and private health expenditure and GDP using both time series and panel data techniques. First, national time series data have been used within a multivariate Beveridge-Nelson decomposition framework to construct the permanent and cyclical components. The correlation analysis results for the cyclical components suggest that current public health expenditure is pro-cyclical while there is no clear evidence of a correlation between cycles in private health expenditure and in GDP growth. Next, using an instrumental variable method and the generalised method of moments estimator, provincial-level panel data analyses confirm pro-cyclical impacts of government spending on health. The provincial analysis also suggests that private health expenditure in urban China has a pro-cyclical association with GDP growth, but a lack of good instruments makes it difficult to identify a clear causal link between cycles in income growth and private health expenditure. The results suggest two policy recommendations relevant to public health expenditure, in line with China's current health reforms.

10.1002/hec.2957.abstractZh: 本文研究了公共（政府和民间）及私人健康支出与GDP在短期内的周期性行为，采用了时间序列和面板数据技术进行分析。首先，利用国家时间序列数据，通过多元Beveridge-Nelson分解框架构建了永久性成分和周期性成分。相关性分析结果表明，当前的公共健康支出具有顺周期性，而私人健康支出与GDP增长之间的周期性关联并不明显。其次，通过工具变量方法和广义矩估计方法，对省级面板数据进行分析，发现政府支出对健康的顺周期性影响显著。省级数据分析还表明，中国城市地区的私人健康支出与GDP增长存在顺周期性关联，但由于缺乏有效的工具变量，难以确定收入增长周期与私人健康支出之间的明确因果关系。研究结果提出了两项与公共健康支出相关的政策建议，这些建议与中国当前的卫生改革方向相一致。

abstract.text: This paper exploits state health education (HED) reforms as quasi-natural experiments to estimate the causal impact of HED received by children on their parents' physical activity. We use data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics for the period 1999-2005 merged with data on state HED reforms from the National Association of State Boards of Education Health Policy Database and the 2000 and 2006 School Health Policies and Programs Study. To identify the spillover effects of HED requirements on parents' behavior, we use several methodologies (triple differences, changes in changes, and difference in differences) in which we allow for different types of treatments. We find a positive effect of HED reforms at the elementary school on the probability of parents doing light physical activity. Introducing major changes in HED increases the probability of fathers engaging in physical activity by between 6.3 and 13.7 percentage points, whereas on average, this probability for mothers does not seem to be affected. We analyze several heterogeneous impacts of the HED reforms to unveil the mechanisms behind these spillovers. We find evidence consistent with hypotheses such as gender specialization of parents in childcare activities or information sharing between children and parents.

10.1002/hec.2958.abstractZh: 本文利用州级健康教育改革作为准自然实验，来估计儿童接受健康教育对其父母体力活动的影响。我们采用了1999-2005年《收入动态面板研究》的数据，并结合了《州教育委员会健康政策数据库》中关于州级健康教育改革的数据，以及2000年和2006年的《学校健康政策与项目研究》数据。为了识别健康教育要求对父母行为的溢出效应，我们采用了多种方法（三重差异法、变化中的变化法、差异中的差异法），并考虑了不同类型的处理因素。研究发现，小学阶段的健康教育改革对父母进行轻度体力活动的概率有积极影响。而健康教育改革中的重大变化使父亲参与体力活动的概率增加了6.3至13.7个百分点，而母亲参与体力活动的概率则没有明显变化。我们还分析了健康教育改革带来的多种异质影响，以揭示这些溢出效应的机制。我们的研究结果与诸如父母在育儿活动中的性别分工或儿童与父母之间的信息共享等假设相符。

abstract.text: Disability may impact on employment through entitlement to social housing. Estimates of an original dynamic panel data model of disability, labour market and housing tenure transitions in England indicate that up to one-quarter of the lower employment probability of the disabled can be attributed to the effect of qualifying for social housing. Short-lived disabilities can result in long spells in social housing that reduce incentives to participate in the labour market. This suggests that authorities should reform the welfare system and the allocation of social housing to limit the persistent and unfavourable consequences of allocating social housing to the disabled.

10.1002/hec.2962.abstractZh: 残疾可能通过获得社会住房而影响就业。对英格兰残疾、劳动力市场和社会住房持有权转变的原始动态面板数据模型的估计表明，残疾人群体较低的就业概率中，有多达四分之一可以归因于获得社会住房资格的影响。短暂的残疾可能导致长期居住在社会住房中，从而削弱他们参与劳动力的积极性。这表明，相关部门应改革福利制度和社会住房的分配方式，以限制将社会住房分配给残疾人的持续且不利的后果。

abstract.text: I analyse intertemporal decisions on undertaking breast cancer screening by women aged 50-64 years in the UK and provide estimates of the rate of discounting potential future benefits of screening. I also analyse education differences in mammography decisions and examine the underlying mechanisms by which education influences breast cancer screening attendance. I estimate a structural model, which reveals that although there are differences in the disutility of breast cancer screening between education groups, there is no difference in the estimated discount factor. These results suggest that the observed education gradient is mainly due to differences in health behaviours and healthcare attitudes.

10.1002/hec.2963.abstractZh: 我分析了英国50-64岁女性进行乳腺癌筛查的跨时决策，并估算了筛查潜在未来利益的折现率。我还分析了教育程度对乳腺X光检查决策的影响，并探讨了教育如何影响乳腺癌筛查的参与率。我建立了一个结构模型，结果显示尽管不同教育程度群体在乳腺癌筛查的效用上存在差异，但估计的折现率并无差异。这些结果表明，观察到的教育程度差异主要源于健康行为和医疗态度上的差异。

abstract.text: Do episodes of mental health (MH) problems cause future MH problems, and if yes, how strong are these dynamics? We quantify the degree of persistence in MH problems using nationally representative, longitudinal data from Australia and system generalized method of moments (GMM), and correlated random effects approaches are applied to separate true from spurious state dependence. Our results suggest only a moderate degree of persistence in MH problems when assuming that persistence is constant across the MH distribution once individual-specific heterogeneity is accounted for. However, individuals who fell once below a threshold that indicates an episode of depression are up to five times more likely to experience such a low score again a year later, indicating a strong element of state dependence in depression. Low income is a strong risk factor in state dependence for both men and women, which has important policy implications.

10.1002/hec.2967.abstractZh: 心理健康问题是否会导致未来的心理健康问题？如果确实如此，这种影响有多强？我们使用澳大利亚具有全国代表性的纵向数据，并通过系统广义矩估计（GMM）和相关的随机效应方法来量化心理健康问题的持续性程度，以区分真实状态依赖性和虚假状态依赖性。我们的研究结果表明，在考虑到个体特异性异质性后，心理健康问题的持续性程度仅为中等水平。然而，那些一度低于表明存在抑郁发作的阈值的个体，在一年后再次经历类似低分的可能性高达五倍，这表明抑郁存在明显的状态依赖性。低收入对男女来说都是状态依赖性的重要风险因素，这对政策制定具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper demonstrates how Bayesian hierarchical modelling can be used to evaluate the performance of hospitals. We estimate a three-level random intercept probit model to attribute unexplained variation in hospital-acquired complications to hospital effects, hospital-specialty effects and remaining random variations, controlling for observable patient complexities. The combined information provided by the posterior means and densities for latent hospital and specialty effects can be used to assess the need and scope for improvements in patient safety at different organizational levels. Posterior densities are not conventionally presented in performance assessment but provides valuable additional information to policy makers on what poorly performing hospitals and specialties may be prioritized for policy action. We use surgical patient administrative data for 2005/2006 for 16 specialties in 35 public hospitals in Victoria, Australia. We use posterior means for latent hospital and specialty effects to compare hospital performance in patient safety. Posterior densities and variances are also compared for different specialties to identify clinical areas with greatest scope for improvement. We also show that the same hospital may rank markedly differently for different specialties.

10.1002/hec.2972.abstractZh: 本文展示了如何利用贝叶斯层次建模来评估医院的绩效。我们采用三级随机截距Probit模型，将医院获得并发症的未解释变异归因于医院效应、医院专科效应以及剩余的随机变异，同时控制可观测的患者复杂性。通过潜在医院和专科效应的后验均值和密度，我们可以评估不同组织层面在患者安全方面的改进需求和范围。后验密度通常不会在绩效评估中直接呈现，但它为政策制定者提供了宝贵的信息，帮助他们确定哪些表现不佳的医院和专科需要优先采取政策行动。我们使用了澳大利亚维多利亚州35家公立医院在2005/2006年度针对16个专科的外科患者行政数据。通过潜在医院和专科效应的后验均值，我们可以比较医院在患者安全方面的绩效。同时，我们还比较了不同专科的后验密度和方差，以识别具有最大改进潜力的临床领域。此外，我们还发现同一家医院在不同专科的表现可能会有很大差异。

abstract.text: Hospital Value Based Purchasing (VBP) aims to incentivize inpatient providers to delivery high value, as opposed to high volume, health care. The formal mandate of hospitals to provide high value health care through financial incentives marks an important change in Medicare and Medicaid policy. In this opportune review of VBP, we discuss the relevant historical changes in the reimbursement environment of U.S. hospitals that have set the stage for VBP. We describe the structure of the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services' VBP program, with a focus on which hospitals are eligible to participate in the program, the specific outcomes measured and incentivized, how rewards and penalties are allocated, and how the program will be funded. In an effort to anticipate some of the issues that lie ahead, we then highlight a number of potential challenges to the success of VBP, and discuss how VBP will impact the delivery and reimbursement of inpatient care services. We conclude by examining how the VBP program is likely to evolve over time.

10.1002/jhm.2045.abstractZh: 基于医院价值的采购（Hospital Value Based Purchasing，VBP）旨在激励住院服务提供者提供高价值的医疗服务，而非仅仅追求高数量的服务。医院通过财务激励提供高价值医疗服务的正式要求，标志着医疗保险和医疗补助政策的重要变革。在这篇关于VBP的综述中，我们讨论了美国医院报销环境的相关历史变化，这些变化为VBP的实施奠定了基础。我们详细介绍了医疗保险和医疗补助服务局的VBP计划的结构，包括哪些医院有资格参与该计划、具体衡量和激励的目标、奖励和惩罚的分配方式，以及该计划的资金来源。为了预见未来可能出现的一些问题，我们还指出了VBP成功面临的一些潜在挑战，并讨论了VBP将如何影响住院护理服务的提供和报销。最后，我们探讨了VBP计划未来可能的发展方向。

abstract.text: Some fear that the profit‐maximizing orientation of private entrepreneurs conflicts with societal goals expected in the provision of complex public services. Received contractual theories advocate that private involvement in public services will result in cost reductions at the expense of quality. Using prisons as our empirical context, we benefit from an event involving the outsourcing and subsequent statization of correctional facilities in B razil. Triangulating between quantitative and qualitative information, we do not find evidence of quality deterioration in outsourced prisons and suggest that a key mechanism driving this result is the presence of public supervisors closely working on‐site with private entrepreneurs in a hybrid governance fashion. We then deliver a set of new propositions that move beyond hazard considerations to examine how the combination of heterogeneous public and private capabilities might yield learning and spillover effects unattainable through pure government management or full‐fledged privatization.

10.1002/sej.1149.abstractZh: 一些人担心，私人企业追求利润最大化的行为会与提供复杂公共服务时所期望的社会目标产生冲突。现有的契约理论认为，私人参与公共服务会导致成本降低，但质量会下降。以巴西的矫正设施外包和随后归为国有为例，我们通过定量和定性信息的综合分析发现，外包的矫正设施并未出现质量下降的情况。我们认为，推动这一结果的关键机制在于，公共监督人员与私人企业以混合治理方式紧密合作。在此基础上，我们提出了一系列新的观点，这些观点超越了单纯的风险考量，探讨了不同性质的公共和私人能力结合如何产生无法通过单纯的政府管理或完全私有化实现的学习和溢出效应。

abstract.text: The main argument for the ongoing privatization process is that privatization will lead to an increase in efficiency, which has been confirmed by a large number of studies. An important argument against privatization is that privatization may lead to employment reductions. In the hospital sector, potential employment reductions might also lead to a decrease in the quality of care. This is the first study to investigate the employment effects of different types of hospital privatization (i.e., for-profit vs non-profit privatization) on different categories of staff. A combination of propensity score matching and difference-in-difference methods was used to identify the causal effect. We found large employment reductions after for-profit privatization, while there were no permanent reductions after non-profit privatization. Moreover, even for-profit privatization does not affect all types of staff. While there are large reductions in non-clinical staff, we could not detect any reduction in the number of physicians. The consequences of the detected employment effects of privatization have to be addressed in greater detail in future research.

10.1007/s10198-013-0520-1.abstractZh: 当前私有化进程的主要论点是，私有化将提高效率，这一点已得到大量研究的证实。然而，反对私有化的一个重要观点是，私有化可能导致就业减少。在医院领域，潜在的就业减少也可能导致护理质量的下降。这是第一项研究不同类型的医院私有化（即营利性私有化与非营利性私有化）对不同类别员工就业影响的调查。本研究采用了倾向得分匹配和差异-差异方法相结合的方法来确定因果效应。研究发现，营利性私有化后就业人数大幅减少，而非营利性私有化后则没有永久性就业减少。此外，即使是营利性私有化，也不会影响所有类型的员工。虽然非临床员工的就业人数大幅减少，但我们未能发现医生数量的减少。关于私有化对就业影响的后果，未来的研究需要更详细地探讨。

abstract.text: We test the robustness of the results of Cutler and Lleras-Muney (2010) on the role of personality in explaining the education-health gradient by using alternative measures of child personality available in the National Child Development Study. We show that, alternatively to the authors, conclusions, personality contributes to the education-health gradient to an extent nearly as large as that of cognition.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.07.005.abstractZh: 我们通过使用《国家儿童发展研究》中可用的其他儿童人格测量方法，来检验Cutler和Lleras-Muney（2010）关于人格在解释教育-健康梯度中的作用的研究结果的稳健性。研究表明，与作者们的结论不同，人格对教育-健康梯度的贡献程度几乎与认知一样大。

abstract.text: We present a Hotelling model of price and advertising competition between prescription drugs that differ in quality/side effects. Promotional effort results in the endogenous formation of two consumer groups: brand loyal and non-brand loyal ones. We show that advertising intensities are strategic substitutes, with the better quality drugs being the ones that are most advertised. This positive association stems from the higher rents that firms can extract from consumers whose brand loyalty is endogenously determined by promotional effort. The model's main results on advertising and pricing strategies are taken to the data. The latter consists of product level data on prices and quantities, product level advertising data, as well as the qualitative information on drug quality contained in the Orange Book compiled by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The empirical results provide strong support to the model's predictions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.07.006.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于处方药之间在价格和广告竞争的热林模型，这些处方药在质量/副作用方面存在差异。促销努力导致两个消费者群体的内生形成：品牌忠诚者和非品牌忠诚者。我们表明，广告强度是战略性的替代品，质量更好的药物会被更多的广告所宣传。这种正相关关系源于企业可以从那些品牌忠诚度由促销努力内生决定的消费者身上获得更高的租金。模型关于广告和定价策略的主要结果得到了数据验证。这些数据包括产品层面的价格和数量数据、产品层面的广告数据，以及美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）编纂的《橙皮书》中所包含的药物质量定性信息。实证结果强烈支持了模型的预测。

abstract.text: Internationally, there is wide cross-country heterogeneity in government responses to dual practice in the health sector. This paper provides a uniform theoretical framework to analyze and compare some of the most common regulations. We focus on three interventions: banning dual practice, offering rewarding contracts to public physicians, and limiting dual practice (including both limits to private earnings of dual providers and limits to involvement in private activities). An ancillary objective of the paper is to investigate whether regulations that are optimal for developed countries are adequate for developing countries as well. Our results offer theoretical support for the desirability of different regulations in different economic environments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.08.005.abstractZh: 在国际上，各国政府在健康领域的双重执业问题上的应对措施存在显著差异。本文提供了一个统一的理论框架，用于分析和比较一些最常见的监管措施。我们重点关注三种干预措施：禁止双重执业、为公立医院的医生提供奖励性合同，以及限制双重执业（包括限制双重执业者的私人收入以及限制其参与私人活动）。本文的另一个目标是探讨，对于发达国家来说最理想的监管措施是否也适用于发展中国家。我们的研究结果为不同经济环境下不同监管措施的必要性提供了理论支持。

abstract.text: We show, with three longitudinal datasets, that cigarette taxes and prices affect smoking initiation decisions. Evidence from longitudinal studies is mixed but generally find that initiation does not vary with price or tax. We show that the lack of statistical significance partly results because of limited policy variation in the time periods studied, truncated behavioral windows, or mis-assignment of price and tax rates in retrospective data (which occurs when one has no information about respondents' prior state or region of residence). Our findings highlight issues relevant to initiation behavior generally, particularly those for which individuals' responses to policy changes may be noisy or small in magnitude.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.08.006.abstractZh: 我们通过三个纵向数据集表明，香烟税和价格会影响吸烟的起始决策。纵向研究的证据并不一致，但总体上发现，吸烟的起始行为并不随价格或税率的变动而变化。我们发现，统计上不显著的结果部分是由于所研究时间段内的政策变化有限、行为窗口被截断，或者 retrospect 数据中对价格和税率的误判（这种情况发生在没有关于受访者之前居住地区的信息时）。我们的发现强调了与起始行为相关的问题，特别是那些个体对政策变化的反应可能不稳定或幅度较小的现象。

abstract.text: Given the preferential tax treatment afforded nonprofit firms, policymakers and researchers have been interested in whether the nonprofit sector provides higher nursing home quality relative to its for-profit counterpart. However, differential selection into for-profits and nonprofits can lead to biased estimates of the effect of ownership form. By using "differential distance" to the nearest nonprofit nursing home relative to the nearest for-profit nursing home, we mimic randomization of residents into more or less "exposure" to nonprofit homes when estimating the effects of ownership on quality of care. Using national Minimum Data Set assessments linked with Medicare claims, we use a national cohort of post-acute patients who were newly admitted to nursing homes within an 18-month period spanning January 1, 2004 and June 30, 2005. After instrumenting for ownership status, we found that post-acute patients in nonprofit facilities had fewer 30-day hospitalizations and greater improvement in mobility, pain, and functioning.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.08.007.abstractZh: 鉴于非营利组织享有税收优惠待遇，政策制定者和研究人员一直关注非营利部门是否比营利性组织提供更高质量的护理服务。然而，选择进入营利性或非营利性组织的方式不同，可能会导致对所有权形式影响的估计出现偏差。通过利用“距离指标”，即居民到最近的营利性护理机构与非营利性护理机构的距离，我们模拟了居民被随机分配到更多或较少接触非营利性护理机构的情况，从而评估所有权对护理质量的影响。我们利用与医疗保险索赔相关的全国最低数据集评估数据，选取了2004年1月1日至2005年6月30日期间新入住护理机构的急性病后患者作为研究对象。在考虑了所有权状况后，我们发现，在非营利机构中治疗的急性病后患者，30天内的住院次数较少，且行动能力、疼痛程度和功能恢复情况也更好。

abstract.text: We exploit plausibly exogenous variation in overseas deployment assignment to estimate the effect of combat exposure on psychological well-being. Controlling for pre-deployment mental health, we find that active-duty soldiers deployed to combat zones are more likely to suffer from post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) than their counterparts deployed outside the United States in non-combat zones. Among those deployed to combat zones, those deployed to locales where they engage in enemy firefight or witness allied or civilian deaths are at an increased risk for suicidal ideation and PTSD relative to their active-duty counterparts deployed to combat zones without enemy firefight.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.09.001.abstractZh: 我们利用海外部署任务中可合理假设的外部变化来估计战斗经历对心理健康的影響。在控制部署前的心理健康状况后，我们发现，被部署到战区现役士兵比被部署到美国以外的非战区士兵更容易患上创伤后应激障碍。在那些被部署到战区的士兵中，那些在战区参与与敌人交火或目睹盟军或平民死亡的人，与那些被部署到没有敌人交火的战区现役士兵相比，自杀念头和创伤后应激障碍的风险更高。

abstract.text: This study asks why hospitals provide direct financial support to nursing schools and faculty. This support is striking because nursing education is clearly general, clearly paid by the firm, and information asymmetries appear minimal. Using AHA and survey data, I find hospitals employing a greater share of their MSA's registered nurses are more likely to provide direct financial support to nursing schools and faculty, net of size and other institutional controls. Given the institutional context, I interpret this result as unusually specific evidence that technologically general skill training may be made de facto-specific by imperfect and costly mobility.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.09.002.abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨为什么医院会直接向护理学校和教职员工提供经济支持。这种支持令人惊讶，因为护理教育显然是通用的，费用由企业承担，信息不对称性也显得很小。通过美国心脏协会的数据和调查数据，我发现，那些将更多的管理服务费用用于注册护士的医院，更有可能向护理学校和教职员工提供直接经济支持，这一结果是在考虑规模和其他机构因素后的净结果。考虑到机构背景，我将这一结果视为一个非常具体的证据，表明由于不完美且成本高昂的流动性问题，技术上的通用技能培训可能会变得具体化。

abstract.text: In this paper, we examine the effects of recent parental Medicaid eligibility expansions on Medicaid participation and private insurance coverage. We present a new approach for estimating these policy effects that explicitly models the particular policy instrument over which legislators have control-income eligibility thresholds. Our approach circumvents estimation problems stemming from misclassification or measurement error. Moreover, it allows us to assess how the policy effects may vary at different initial threshold levels. Using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation, we find three main results. First, the eligibility expansions result in significant increases in Medicaid participation; a "typical" expansion increases Medicaid participation by about four percent of baseline coverage rates. Second, the participation effect is larger for lower initial thresholds and the effect decreases as Medicaid thresholds increase. Third, we find no statistically significant evidence of crowd out regardless of initial threshold level.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.09.003.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了近期父母医疗补助资格扩展对医疗补助参与率和私人保险覆盖率的影响。我们提出了一种新的方法来估计这些政策效应，该方法明确模拟了立法者能够控制的特定政策工具——收入资格门槛。我们的方法避免了由于错误分类或测量误差导致的估计问题。此外，它使我们能够评估政策效应在不同初始门槛水平上的变化。利用《收入与计划参与调查》的数据，我们得到了三个主要结论。首先，资格扩展显著增加了医疗补助的参与率；一个“典型的”扩展会使医疗补助的参与率比基线覆盖率增加约4%。其次，对于较低的初始门槛，参与效应更大；而随着医疗补助门槛的提高，这种效应会减小。第三，我们没有发现任何统计上显著的排斥证据，无论初始门槛水平如何。

abstract.text: One of the core goals of a universal health care system is to eliminate discrimination on the basis of socioeconomic status. We test for discrimination using patient waiting times for non-emergency treatment in public hospitals. Waiting time should reflect patients' clinical need with priority given to more urgent cases. Using data from Australia, we find evidence of prioritisation of the most socioeconomically advantaged patients at all quantiles of the waiting time distribution. These patients also benefit from variation in supply endowments. These results challenge the universal health system's core principle of equitable treatment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.09.004.abstractZh: 全民医疗体系的核心目标之一，就是消除基于社会经济地位的歧视。我们通过公共医院中非紧急治疗的患者等待时间来检验是否存在歧视现象。等待时间应反映患者的临床需求，并优先处理更为紧急的病例。根据澳大利亚的数据，我们发现，在等待时间的各个区间，社会经济条件较好的患者都得到了优先处理。这些患者还受益于供应资源的不均衡分配。这些结果挑战了全民医疗体系中公平治疗的核心原则。

abstract.text: Most existing work on the demand for health insurance focuses on employees' decisions to enroll in employer-provided plans. Yet any attempt to achieve universal coverage must focus on the uninsured, the vast majority of whom are not offered employer-sponsored insurance. In the summer of 2008, we conducted a survey experiment to assess the willingness to pay for a health plan among a large sample of uninsured Americans. The experiment yields price elasticities of around one, substantially greater than those found in most previous studies. We use these results to estimate coverage expansion under the Affordable Care Act, with and without an individual mandate. We estimate that 35 million uninsured individuals would gain coverage and find limited evidence of adverse selection.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.09.005.abstractZh: 目前关于健康保险需求的研究大多集中在员工选择参加雇主提供的保险计划上。然而，任何实现全民覆盖的努力都必须关注那些没有保险的人，而他们中的绝大多数并没有获得雇主提供的保险。2008年夏天，我们进行了一项调查实验，以评估大量无保险美国人愿意支付健康保险费用的情况。实验得出的价格弹性约为1，远高于大多数先前研究的结果。我们利用这些结果来估算《平价医疗法案》实施后的保险覆盖情况，包括有无个人强制保险的规定。我们的估计显示，约3500万无保险人士将获得保险覆盖，并且几乎没有证据表明存在逆向选择现象。

abstract.text: Conflicting trends confound the pharmaceutical industry. The productivity of pharmaceutical innovation has declined in recent years. At the same time, the cohort of large companies who are the leading engines of pharmaceutical R&D has become increasingly concentrated. The concurrent presence of these trends is not sufficient to determine causation. In response to lagging innovation prospects, some companies have sought refuge in mergers and acquisitions to disguise their dwindling prospects or gain R&D synergies. On the other hand, the increased concentration brought on by recent mergers may have contributed to the declining rate of innovation. In this paper, we consider the second of these causal relationships: the likely impact of the recent merger wave among the largest pharmaceutical companies on the rate of innovation. In other words, have recent mergers, which may have been taken in response to lagging innovation, represented a self-defeating strategy that only made industry outcomes worse?

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.09.006.abstractZh: 相互冲突的趋势让制药行业陷入混乱。近年来，制药创新的生产力有所下降。与此同时，作为制药研发主要推动力的大型公司群体也变得越来越集中。这些趋势同时存在，并不足以确定因果关系。为了应对落后的创新前景，一些公司通过并购来掩盖其日益萎缩的前景或获得研发协同效应。另一方面，最近发生的并购带来的公司集中度增加，可能也导致了创新率的下降。在本文中，我们考虑了这两种因果关系中的第二种：最近发生在最大制药公司之间的并购浪潮，可能对创新率产生的影响。换句话说，这些可能出于应对落后创新而进行的并购，是否是一种适得其反的策略，反而使行业状况更加恶化？

abstract.text: We consider the effect of legal access to alcohol on student achievement. Our preferred approach identifies the effect through changes in one's performance after gaining legal access to alcohol, controlling flexibly for the expected evolution of grades as one makes progress towards their degree. We also report RD-based estimates but argue that an RD design is not well suited to the research question in our setting. We find that students' grades fall below their expected levels upon being able to drink legally, but by less than previously documented. We also show that there are effects on women and that the effects are persistent. Using the 1997 National Longitudinal Survey of Youth, we show that students drink more often after legal access but do not consume more drinks on days on which they drink.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.09.009.abstractZh: 我们研究了合法饮酒对学生学业成绩的影响。我们的研究方法通过考察获得合法饮酒权后学生表现的变化来识别这种影响，并灵活地控制了学生成绩随着学业进展而变化的预期趋势。我们还使用了随机设计估计方法，但认为这种设计并不适合我们研究的问题。研究发现，学生获得合法饮酒权后，成绩下降幅度小于之前报道的幅度。此外，我们还发现这种影响对女性学生更为显著，并且这种影响是持续性的。通过1997年《全国青年纵向调查》的数据，我们发现学生获得合法饮酒权后饮酒频率增加，但在实际饮酒的日子里，他们饮用的酒量并没有增加。

abstract.text: Using a rich Italian cross-sectional dataset, we estimate the effect of a neighborhood problems aggregate (including pollution, crime, and noise) on self-assessed health, presence of chronic conditions and limitations in daily activities. We address the self-selection of the residents in their neighborhoods, as well as the possible endogeneity of income with respect to health, through instrumental variable methods and several endogeneity tests. The main novelty is the sound estimation of the neighborhood effect on health using observational data, which has the advantage of providing general results that are not dependent on any experimental design. This allows us to fully compare the neighborhood effect with the traditional socioeconomic determinants of health. Our main findings are that low quality neighborhoods are strongly health damaging. This effect is comparable to the primary/upper secondary education health differential and is even higher than the impact that poor economic circumstances have on health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.09.010.abstractZh: 我们利用一个丰富的意大利横断面数据集，估计了社区问题综合指标（包括污染、犯罪和噪音）对自我评估健康状况、慢性疾病的存在以及日常活动能力的影响。我们探讨了居民在社区中的自我选择行为，以及收入与健康之间的可能内生关系，通过工具变量方法和多种内生性检验进行了研究。我们的主要创新之处在于，利用观察性数据对社区对健康的影响进行了可靠的估计，这一方法能够得出不受任何实验设计影响的普遍结论。这使我们能够全面比较社区效应与传统的健康社会经济决定因素。我们的主要发现是，低质量的社区对健康有严重的负面影响。这种影响与初等/中等教育对健康的差异相当，甚至超过了不良经济环境对健康的冲击。

abstract.text: How does increasing access to treatment affect the demand for preventive testing? In this paper we present results from a field experiment in Nigeria in which we offered cervical cancer screening to women at randomly chosen prices. To test our hypothesis, we also offered women a lottery where the payoff was a subsidy towards the cost of cervical cancer treatment (conditional upon a diagnosis of cervical cancer). We find that women randomly selected to receive the conditional cancer treatment subsidy were about 4 percentage points more likely to take up screening than those in the control group. We also show that reducing the price of screening by 10 cents increased take-up by about 1 percentage point. These results offer compelling evidence that the optimal set of subsidies to increase take-up of preventive testing in developing countries, must include subsidies towards treatment costs (in addition to price subsidies).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.001.abstractZh: 增加治疗机会如何影响预防性检测的需求？在本文中，我们展示了在尼日利亚进行的一项实地实验的结果。实验中，我们以随机选定的价格向女性提供宫颈癌筛查服务。为了验证我们的假设，我们还为女性提供了一种彩票机制，中奖者将获得用于支付宫颈癌治疗费用的补贴（前提是被诊断出宫颈癌）。研究发现，那些被随机选中获得条件性癌症治疗补贴的女性，接受筛查的可能性比对照组高出约4个百分点。此外，将筛查价格降低10美分，使接受筛查的比例增加了约1个百分点。这些结果有力地证明了，在发展中国家增加预防性检测接受度的理想补贴方案，必须包括治疗费用的补贴（除了价格补贴之外）。

abstract.text: Increased health care spending has placed pressure on public and private payers to prioritize spending. Cost-effectiveness (CE) analysis is the main tool used by payers to prioritize coverage of new therapies. We argue that reimbursement based on CE is subject to a form of the "Lucas critique"; the goals of CE policies may not materialize when firms affected by the policies respond optimally to them. For instance, because 'costs' in CE analysis reflect prices set optimally by firms rather than production costs, observed CE levels will depend on how firm pricing responds to CE policies. Observed CE is therefore endogenous. When CE is endogenously determined, policies aimed at lowering spending and improving overall CE may paradoxically raise spending and lead to the adoption of more resource-costly treatments. We empirically illustrate whether this may occur using data on public coverage decisions in the United Kingdom.
