10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.002.abstractZh: 增加的医疗保健支出给公共和私人支付者带来了优先安排支出的压力。成本效益分析是支付者用于优先覆盖新疗法的主要工具。我们认为，基于成本效益的报销方式受到“卢卡斯批判”的影响；当受政策影响的公司最优地响应政策时，成本效益政策的目标可能无法实现。例如，成本效益分析中的“成本”反映的是公司最优设定的价格，而非生产成本，因此观察到的成本效益水平将取决于公司定价对政策的响应。因此，观察到的成本效益是内生的。当成本效益内生决定时，旨在降低支出并提高整体成本效益的政策可能会反而增加支出，导致采用更多资源成本较高的治疗方法。我们通过英国公共覆盖决策的数据实证说明了这种情况是否可能发生。

abstract.text: In response to increased risks of second-hand smoke exposure for children travelling in cars and its resulting deleterious health impacts, several jurisdictions passed legislation that bans smoking in private vehicles when children are present. In this study, I exploit a unique quasi-experiment from Canada and employ the difference-in-differences and triple-differences techniques to empirically evaluate this legislation. I find that the legislation reduces exposure to second-hand smoke inside cars for children. Further, there appears no marked increase in smoking at home after the implementation of the legislation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.003.abstractZh: 为了应对儿童在车内接触二手烟的风险增加及其对健康造成的负面影响，一些地区通过了禁止在儿童在场时私人车辆内吸烟的立法。在这项研究中，我利用来自加拿大的一个独特准实验，并采用差异-差异法和三重差异技术来实证评估这一立法的影响。研究发现，该立法确实减少了儿童在车内接触二手烟的情况。此外，在立法实施之后，家庭中的吸烟行为也没有出现明显的增加。

abstract.text: Quality-Adjusted Life Years (QALYs) are the most widely used measure of health in economic evaluations of health care. Within a welfarist framework QALYs are consistent with people's preferences under stringent assumptions. Several authors have argued that QALYs are a valid measure of health within an extra-welfarist framework. This paper studies the applicability of QALYs within the best-known extra-welfarist framework, Sen's capability approach. We propose a procedure to value capability sets and provide a foundation for QALYs within Sen's capability approach. We show that, under appropriate conditions, the ranking of capabilities can be represented locally by a QALY measure and that a willingness to pay for QALYs can be defined. The validity of QALYs as a general measure of health requires the same stringent conditions as in a welfarist framework.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.004.abstractZh: 质量调整生命年（QALYs）是医疗健康经济评估中最常用的健康衡量指标。在福利主义框架下，QALYs在严格的假设条件下与人们的偏好一致。一些学者认为，在超福利主义框架下，QALYs也是一种有效的健康衡量指标。本文研究了在最著名的超福利主义框架——Sen的能力主义框架下，QALYs的适用性。我们提出了一种评估能力集的方法，并为Sen的能力主义框架下的QALYs提供了基础。研究表明，在适当的条件下，能力的排序可以局部地用QALY指标来表示，并且可以定义出对QALYs支付意愿。将QALYs作为一般健康衡量指标的有效性，需要符合与福利主义框架相同的严格条件。

abstract.text: Using the 2006 Homescan panel, we estimate the changes in energy, fat and sodium purchases resulting from a tax that increases the price of sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) by 20% and the effect of such a tax on body weight. In addition to substitutions that may arise with other beverages, we account for substitutions between SSBs and 12 major food categories. Our main findings are that the tax would result in a decrease in store-bought energy of 24.3kcal per day per person, which would translate into an average weight loss of 1.6 pounds during the first year and a cumulated weight loss of 2.9 pounds in the long run. We do not find evidence of substitution to sugary foods and show that complementary foods could contribute to decreasing energy purchases. Despite their significantly lower price elasticity, the tax has a similar effect on calories for the largest purchasers of SSBs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.005.abstractZh: 利用2006年的Homescan面板数据，我们估计了征收20%的税收后，含糖饮料的能源、脂肪和钠购买量会发生怎样的变化，以及这种税收对体重的影响。除了其他饮料的替代行为外，我们还考虑了含糖饮料与12个主要食品类别之间的替代行为。我们的主要发现是，这项税收将导致每人每天购买的店内能源减少24.3千卡，这相当于在一年内平均减重1.6磅，长期来看累计减重可达2.9磅。我们没有发现对含糖食品的替代行为，并且表明补充食品可能有助于减少能源的购买。尽管含糖饮料的价格弹性明显较低，但这项税收对最大消费群体的卡路里摄入产生了类似的影响。

abstract.text: Cross-sectional evidence in the United States finds that informal caregivers have less attachment to the labor force. The causal mechanism is unclear: do children who work less become informal caregivers, or are children who become caregivers working less? Using longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study, we identify the relationship between informal care and work in the United States, both on the intensive and extensive margins, and examine wage effects. We control for time-invariant individual heterogeneity; rule out or control for endogeneity; examine effects for men and women separately; and analyze heterogeneous effects by task and intensity. We find modest decreases-2.4 percentage points-in the likelihood of working for male caregivers providing personal care. Female chore caregivers, meanwhile, are more likely to be retired. For female care providers who remain working, we find evidence that they decrease work by 3-10hours per week and face a 3 percent lower wage than non-caregivers. We find little effect of caregiving on working men's hours or wages. These estimates suggest that the opportunity costs to informal care providers are important to consider when making policy recommendations about the design and funding of public long-term care programs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.006.abstractZh: 美国的横断面研究发现，非正式照顾者对劳动力的依附程度较低。其因果机制尚不清楚：是工作较少的孩子成为了非正式照顾者，还是成为照顾者的孩子工作较少？利用“健康与退休研究”的纵向数据，我们探讨了美国非正式照顾与工作之间的关系，包括密集型和扩展型两种情况，并研究了工资效应。我们控制了时间不变的个体异质性；排除了或控制了内生性；分别研究了男性和女性的效应；并分析了按任务和强度划分的异质效应。我们发现，男性照顾者提供个人护理的工作可能性降低了2.4个百分点。与此同时，女性家务照顾者更有可能退休。对于继续工作的女性照顾者，我们发现她们每周减少3-10小时的工作时间，并且工资比非照顾者低3%。我们发现照顾工作对男性工作时间或工资的影响很小。这些估计表明，在制定关于公共长期护理计划的设计和资金政策的建议时，需要考虑非正式照顾者所承担的机会成本。

abstract.text: This paper introduces the discrete choice model-paradigm of Random Regret Minimisation (RRM) to the field of health economics. The RRM is a regret-based model that explores a driver of choice different from the traditional utility-based Random Utility Maximisation (RUM). The RRM approach is based on the idea that, when choosing, individuals aim to minimise their regret-regret being defined as what one experiences when a non-chosen alternative in a choice set performs better than a chosen one in relation to one or more attributes. Analysing data from a discrete choice experiment on diet, physical activity and risk of a fatal heart attack in the next ten years administered to a sample of the Northern Ireland population, we find that the combined use of RUM and RRM models offer additional information, providing useful behavioural insights for better informed policy appraisal.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.007.abstractZh: 本文介绍了随机遗憾最小化模型在健康经济学领域中的应用。随机遗憾最小化是一种基于遗憾的模型，其选择的驱动因素与传统的基于效用的随机效用最大化模型不同。随机遗憾最小化方法的核心理念是，个体在做出选择时，旨在最小化他们的遗憾——遗憾是指当选择集中的非选择方案在某个或多个属性上优于选择方案时所经历的体验。通过对北爱尔兰人口进行的关于饮食、体力活动以及未来十年致命心脏病风险的相关离散选择实验数据进行分析，我们发现，将随机效用最大化模型和随机遗憾最小化模型结合使用，能够提供更丰富的信息，为更明智的政策制定提供有用的行为洞察。

abstract.text: In this paper we estimate the causal effects on child mortality from moving into less distressed neighborhood environments. We match mortality data covering the period from 1997 to 2009 with information on every child in public housing that applied for a housing voucher in Chicago in 1997 (N=11,680). Families were randomly assigned to the voucher wait list, and only some families were offered vouchers. The odds ratio for the effects of being offered a housing voucher on overall mortality rates is equal to 1.13 for all children (95% CI 0.73-1.70), 1.34 for boys (95% CI 0.85-2.05) and 0.21 for girls (95% CI 0.01-1.04).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.008.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们估计了搬入较不紧张的社区环境对儿童死亡率的因果效应。我们将1997至2009年的死亡数据与芝加哥公共住房项目中1997年申请住房券的每名儿童的资料进行了匹配（样本量11,680人）。家庭被随机分配到住房券等待名单上，只有部分家庭获得了住房券。对于获得住房券对儿童总体死亡率的影响，比值比为1.13（95%置信区间0.73-1.70），男孩为1.34（95%置信区间0.85-2.05），女孩为0.21（95%置信区间0.01-1.04）。

abstract.text: Explanations of growth in health expenditures have restricted attention to the mean. We explain change throughout the distribution of expenditures, providing insight into how expenditure growth and its explanation differ along the distribution. We analyse Dutch data on actual health expenditures linked to hospital discharge and mortality registers. Full distribution decomposition delivers findings that would be overlooked by examination of changes in the mean alone. The growth rate of hospital expenditures is greatest at the middle of the distribution and is driven mainly by changes in the distributions of determinants. Pharmaceutical expenditures increase most rapidly at the top of the distribution and are mainly attributable to structural changes, including technological progress, making treatment of the highest cost cases even more expensive. Changes in hospital practice styles make the largest contribution of all determinants to increased spending not only on hospital care but also on pharmaceuticals, suggesting important spill over effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.009.abstractZh: 关于医疗支出增长的解释往往只关注平均水平。我们则着眼于支出的整个分布，从而揭示支出增长及其变化在分布上的差异。我们分析了荷兰的实际医疗支出数据，这些数据与医院出院记录和死亡率登记数据相关联。通过完整的分布分解，我们能够发现那些仅通过关注平均水平的变化所忽略的现象。医院支出的增长率在分布的中间部分最高，这主要是由各种决定因素的分布变化所驱动的。药品支出在分布的高端部分增长最快，其主要原因包括技术进步等结构性变化，使得对成本最高的病例的治疗变得更加昂贵。医院护理实践方式的变化对所有决定因素的影响最大，不仅增加了对医院护理的支出，也增加了对药品的开支，这表明存在重要的溢出效应。

abstract.text: There is ample evidence that bereavement is associated with heightened mortality. Regardless of whether this strong association is truly causal, little is known about the factors contributing to it. This study begins to unpack the black box of the bereavement-mortality puzzle by investigating the extent to which heath behaviors and health care utilization patterns vary among chronically ill elderly males living with a spouse and those who are widowed, and by asking whether these differences contribute to the well-documented correlation between widowhood and health deterioration. In order to separate the effect of health care utilization from other potential channels it uses a unique dataset of doctor-patient encounters that allows in-depth analysis of the organization and effectiveness of medical care. Changes in health care utilization attributable to bereavement have a negative effect on survival but account for a small part of the overall negative effect of widowhood on longevity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.010.abstractZh: 有大量证据表明，丧亲与死亡率上升之间存在关联。尽管这种强烈关联是否真正具有因果关系尚不明确，但关于导致这一关联的因素却知之甚少。本研究试图通过调查长期患病老年男性在丧偶者与有配偶者之间的健康行为和医疗利用模式的差异，来揭示丧亲与死亡率之间的复杂关系。同时，研究还探讨了这些差异是否有助于解释丧偶与健康状况恶化之间的已知关联。为了将医疗利用的影响与其他潜在因素区分开来，本研究使用了独特的医生-患者互动数据集，以便深入分析医疗服务的组织结构和有效性。由丧亲导致的医疗利用变化对生存时间有负面影响，但这一影响在丧偶对寿命的负面影响中所占比例很小。

abstract.text: Despite the presence of Medicare, out-of-pocket medical spending is a large expenditure risk facing the elderly. While women live longer than men, elderly women incur higher out-of-pocket medical spending than men at each age. In this paper, we examine whether differences in marital status and living arrangements can explain this difference. We find that out-of-pocket medical spending is approximately 24 percent higher when an individual becomes widowed, a large portion of which is spending on nursing homes. Our results suggest a substantial role of living arrangements in out-of-pocket medical spending. Our estimates combined with differences in rates of widowhood across gender suggest that marital status can explain about one third of the gender difference in total out-of-pocket medical spending, leaving a large portion unexplained. On the other hand, gender differences in widowhood more than explain the observed gender difference in out-of-pocket spending on nursing homes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.011.abstractZh: 尽管有医疗保险制度，老年人的自付医疗费用仍然是一个较大的支出风险。虽然女性的寿命比男性长，但老年女性在各个年龄段的自付医疗费用都高于男性。在本文中，我们探讨了婚姻状况和居住安排是否能够解释这种差异。研究发现，当一个人成为寡妇时，自付医疗费用大约高出24%，其中很大一部分是用于养老院的费用。我们的结果表明，居住安排在自付医疗费用中起着重要作用。结合不同性别的寡妇比例差异，我们的估计表明，婚姻状况可以解释总自付医疗费用中约三分之一的性别差异，而仍有很大一部分无法解释。另一方面，性别差异在寡妇比例上的影响足以解释观察到的老年女性在养老院方面的自付费用差异。

abstract.text: This article discusses measurement of socioeconomic inequalities in the prevalence of a health condition, in response to the recent exchange between Guido Erreygers and Adam Wagstaff, in which they discuss the merits of their own corrections to the frequently used concentration index. We first reconcile their debate and discuss the value judgments implicit in their indices. Next, we provide a formal definition of the previously undefined value judgment in Wagstaff's correction. Finally, we show empirically that the choice of index matters, as illustrated by comparisons between countries using data from the European Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.10.012.abstractZh: 本文讨论了在健康状况的患病率方面衡量社会经济不平等的方法，这一讨论是针对Guido Erreygers和Adam Wagstaff最近的一次交流而展开的。在交流中，他们讨论了自己对常用浓度指数的修正方法的优点。我们首先梳理了他们的争论，并探讨了这些指数所隐含的价值判断。接下来，我们为Wagstaff的修正中之前未明确界定的价值判断提供了一个正式的定义。最后，我们通过使用欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查的数据进行跨国比较，实证地证明了指数选择的重要性。

abstract.text: Using the German 1970 census to study educational and labor market outcomes of cohorts born during the German food crisis after World War II, I document that those born between November 1945 and May 1946 have significantly lower educational attainment and occupational status than cohorts born shortly before or after. Several alternative explanations for this finding are tested. Most likely, a short spell of severe undernutrition around the end of the war has impaired intrauterine conditions in early pregnancies and resulted in long-term detriments among the affected cohorts. This conjecture is corroborated by evidence from Austria.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.001.abstractZh: 利用1970年德国人口普查数据，研究二战后德国食品危机期间出生的群体在教育与劳动力市场方面的表现。研究发现，1945年11月至1946年5月期间出生的群体，其教育水平和职业地位明显低于同期出生的人群。针对这一发现，提出了多种可能的解释。最有可能的原因是，战争结束前后的一段时间内严重的营养不良影响了早期妊娠的宫内环境，从而导致受影响群体的长期损害。这一推测得到了奥地利相关数据的支持。

abstract.text: Violence against women is a major health and human rights problem yet there is little rigorous evidence as to how to reduce it. We take advantage of the randomized roll-out of Ecuador's cash transfer program to mothers to investigate how an exogenous increase in a woman's income affects domestic violence. We find that the effect of a cash transfer depends on a woman's education and on her education relative to her partner's. Our results show that for women with greater than primary school education a cash transfer significantly decreases psychological violence from her partner. For women with primary school education or less, however, the effect of a cash transfer depends on her education relative to her partner's. Specifically, the cash transfer significantly increases emotional violence in households where the woman's education is equal to or more than her partner's.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.002.abstractZh: 针对女性的暴力行为是一个重大的健康与人权问题，然而关于如何减少这一问题的严格证据却很少。我们利用了厄瓜多尔对母亲实施的现金转移计划的随机实施方式，来研究女性收入的外生增加如何影响家庭暴力。研究发现，现金转移的效果取决于女性的教育水平以及她与伴侣的教育水平对比。结果显示，对于拥有小学以上教育水平的女性来说，现金转移显著减少了来自伴侣的心理暴力。然而，对于拥有小学或更低教育水平的女性来说，现金转移的效果则取决于她与伴侣的教育水平对比。具体来说，在女性教育水平与伴侣相当或更高的家庭中，现金转移显著增加了情感暴力。

abstract.text: The last time that federal excise taxes on alcoholic beverages were increased was 1991. The changes were larger than the typical state-level changes that have been used to study price effects, but the consequences have not been assessed due to the lack of a control group. Here we develop and implement a novel method for utilizing interstate heterogeneity to estimate the aggregate effects of a federal tax increase on rates of injury fatality and crime. We provide evidence that the relative importance of alcohol in violence and injury rates is directly related to per capita consumption, and build on that finding to generate estimates. A conservative estimate is that the federal tax (which increased alcohol prices by 6% initially) reduced injury deaths by 4.5% (6480 deaths), in 1991, and had a still larger effect on violent crime.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.003.abstractZh: 上次对酒精饮料征收联邦消费税是在1991年。这次的变动比通常用于研究价格效应的州级变动更为显著，但由于缺乏对照组，其后果尚未得到评估。在这里，我们开发并采用了一种新方法，利用州际差异来估算联邦税收增加对伤害死亡率和犯罪率的总体影响。我们的证据表明，酒精在暴力和伤害率中的相对重要性直接与人均消费水平相关，并在此基础上进行了估算。保守估计，联邦税收（最初使酒精价格上涨了6%）在1991年减少了4.5%的伤害死亡人数（6480人），并对暴力犯罪产生了更大的影响。

abstract.text: The targeting of an UK extra-cost disability benefit for older people, Attendance Allowance, is analyzed using longitudinal data from the British Household Panel Survey. First, a binary model of benefit participation is used to investigate whether receipt is responsive to the onset of disability. Second, matching estimators are used to evaluate the consequences of missed participation on later financial wellbeing. Results indicate that participation is highly responsive to the onset of disability, although the chance of delays in receipt emerges. Personal characteristics unrelated to eligibility also appear to influence benefit receipt, translating into sizeable differences in the amount of cash support received. The comparison of recipients with observationally equivalent non-recipients confirms that timely participation reduces disabled older people's financial strain.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.004.abstractZh: 本文利用英国家庭面板调查的长期数据，分析了针对老年人额外费用残疾福利——护理津贴的发放情况。首先，采用二元模型研究福利领取情况是否对残疾的发生有响应。其次，通过匹配估计方法评估错过福利领取对后期经济状况的影响。研究结果表明，福利领取情况对残疾的发生具有高度响应性，尽管领取时间可能会延迟。与资格无关的个人特征似乎也会影响福利领取情况，从而导致领取现金支持金额存在显著差异。将领取福利者与观察上等同的非领取者进行比较后证实，及时领取福利能够有效减轻老年残疾人的经济压力。

abstract.text: We investigate the dynamic relationship between several dimensions of health and health care expenditures for older individuals. Health data from the Longitudinal Aging Survey Amsterdam is combined with data on hospital and long term care use. We estimate a latent variable based jointly on observed health indicators and expenditures. Annual transition probabilities between states of the latent variable are estimated using a Markov model. States associated with good current health and low annual health care expenditures are not associated with lower cumulative health care expenditures over remaining lifetime. We conclude that, although the direct health care cost saving effect is limited, the considerable gain in healthy lifeyears can make investing in the improvement of health of the older population worthwhile.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.005.abstractZh: 我们研究了老年人健康与医疗保健支出几个维度之间的动态关系。利用阿姆斯特丹纵向老龄化调查的健康数据，结合医院和长期护理使用的数据，我们基于观察到的健康指标和支出数据，估计了一个潜在变量。使用马尔可夫模型估计了潜在变量各状态之间的年度转换概率。与当前健康状况良好和年度医疗保健支出较低的状态相关的个体，其剩余生命周期内的累计医疗保健支出并不会减少。我们的结论是，尽管直接节省医疗保健成本的效果有限，但健康年数的显著增加使得投资于改善老年人群体的健康状况是值得的。

abstract.text: In recent years, consumer choice has become an important element of public policy. One reason is that consumers differ in their tastes and needs, which they can express most easily through their own choices. Elements that strengthen consumer choice feature prominently in the design of public insurance markets, for instance in the United States in the recent introduction of prescription drug coverage for older individuals via Medicare Part D. For policy makers who design such a market, an important practical question in the design phase of such a new program is how to deduce enrollment and plan selection preferences prior to its introduction. In this paper, we investigate whether hypothetical choice experiments can serve as a tool in this process. We combine data from hypothetical and real plan choices, elicited around the time of the introduction of Medicare Part D. We first analyze how well the hypothetical choice data predict willingness to pay and market shares at the aggregate level. We then analyze predictions at the individual level, in particular how insurance demand varies with observable characteristics. We also explore whether the extent of adverse selection can be predicted using hypothetical choice data alone.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.006.abstractZh: 近年来，消费者选择已成为公共政策中的一个重要要素。其中一个原因是，消费者的品味和需求各不相同，而这些差异可以通过他们的选择来最直观地表达出来。在公共保险市场的设计中，强化消费者选择的要素尤为突出，例如在美国，最近通过Medicare Part D为老年人引入了处方药保险。对于设计此类市场的政策制定者来说，在计划引入前的设计阶段，一个重要的问题是如何推断出参保和计划选择的偏好。在本文中，我们探讨了假设性选择实验是否可以作为这一过程的工具。我们结合了在Medicare Part D引入时进行的假设性选择和实际计划选择的数据。我们首先分析了假设性选择数据在整体层面上对支付意愿和市场份额的预测能力。然后，我们分析了个体层面的预测结果，特别是保险需求如何随可观察特征而变化。我们还探讨了是否仅使用假设性选择数据就能预测逆向选择的程度。

abstract.text: We examine the role of information in understanding the differential effects of income on the demand for health. In the health capital framework of Grossman (JPE, 1972), we derive the testable hypotheses that individuals adjust their diet in a healthier direction upon receiving negative health information, and that the effect is greater for richer individuals. Based on unique Chinese longitudinal data and a regression discontinuity design that exploits the exogenous cutoff of systolic blood pressure in the diagnosis of hypertension, we find that, upon receiving hypertension diagnosis, individuals reduce fat intake significantly, and richer individuals reduce more. Our results also indicate that among the rich, hypertension diagnosis is more effective for individuals with lower education.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.007.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息在理解收入对健康需求差异影响中的作用。根据Grossman（1972年）的健康资本框架，我们得出了以下可检验的假设：当个体收到负面健康信息时，他们会调整饮食以更健康的方向；而且这一效应在较富裕的个体中更为显著。基于独特的中国纵向数据以及利用高血压诊断中收缩压外源性 cutoff的回归 discontinuity设计，我们发现，在收到高血压诊断后，个体会显著减少脂肪摄入，且较富裕的个体减少的幅度更大。我们的结果还表明，在富裕人群中，高血压诊断对教育程度较低的个体更为有效。

abstract.text: Public reporting of health care quality has become a popular tool for incenting quality improvement. A fundamental question about public reporting is whether it causes providers to select healthier patients for treatment. In the nursing home post-acute setting, where patients must achieve a minimum length of stay to be included in quality measures, selection may take the form of discharge from the nursing home using rehospitalization, a particularly costly and undesirable outcome. We study the population of post-acute patients of skilled nursing facilities nationwide during 1999-2005 to assess whether selective rehospitalization occurred when public reporting was instituted in 2002, using multiple quasi-experimental designs to identify effects. We find that after public reporting was implemented, rehospitalizations before the length-of-stay cutoff increased. We conclude that nursing homes rehospitalize higher-risk post-acute patients to improve scores, providing evidence for selection behavior on the part of nursing home providers in the presence of public reporting.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.008.abstractZh: 公开披露医疗保健质量已成为激励质量提升的常用手段。关于公开披露的一个基本问题是，它是否会促使医疗机构选择更健康的病人进行治疗。在养老院等术后康复环境中，病人必须达到一定的住院时长才能被纳入质量评估范围，因此选择行为可能表现为通过再次住院来出院，而再次住院是一种成本高昂且不理想的后果。我们研究了1999年至2005年间全国各类专业护理机构中的术后康复病人，以评估2002年实施公开披露后是否存在选择性再次住院现象，并采用多种准实验设计来识别相关影响。研究发现，在公开披露实施后，未达到住院时长截止点的病人再次住院的情况有所增加。我们得出结论，养老院为了提升评分，会再次将高风险术后康复病人收治入院，这证明了在公开披露的情况下，医疗机构存在选择性行为。

abstract.text: Increasing evidence shows that hospital competition under fixed prices can improve quality and reduce cost. Concerns remain, however, that competition may undermine socio-economic equity in the utilisation of care. We test this hypothesis in the context of the pro-competition reforms of the English National Health Service progressively introduced from 2004 to 2006. We use a panel of 32,482 English small areas followed from 2003 to 2008 and a difference in differences approach. The effect of competition on equity is identified by the interaction between market structure, small area income deprivation and year. We find a negative association between market competition and elective admissions in deprived areas. The effect of pro-competition reform was to reduce this negative association slightly, suggesting that competition did not undermine equity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.009.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，在固定价格下进行医院竞争可以提高医疗质量并降低成本。然而，人们仍然担心，竞争可能会破坏在医疗利用方面的社会经济公平。我们在2004年至2006年间英国国家卫生服务系统逐步实施竞争改革的情况下，对这一假设进行了测试。我们使用了2003年至2008年间对32,482个英国小区域的跟踪数据，并采用了差异差异法来分析数据。通过市场结构、小区域收入贫困程度以及年份之间的相互作用，我们发现了市场竞争与贫困地区择期住院人数之间的负相关关系。竞争改革的效果略微减少了这种负相关关系，这表明竞争并没有破坏社会经济公平。

abstract.text: This paper studies the role of Medicare's premium policy in sorting beneficiaries between traditional Medicare (TM) and managed care plans in the Medicare advantage (MA) program. Beneficiaries vary in their demand for care. TM fully accommodates demand but creates a moral hazard inefficiency. MA rations care but disregards some elements of the demand. We describe an efficient assignment of beneficiaries to these two options, and argue that efficiency requires an MA program oriented to serve the large middle part of the distribution of demand: the "middle class." Current Medicare policy of a "single premium" for MA plans cannot achieve efficient sorting. We characterize the demand-based premium policy that can implement the efficient assignment of enrollees to plans. If only a single premium is feasible, the second-best policy involves too many of the low-demand individuals in MA and a too low level of services relative to the first best. We identify approaches to using premium policy to revitalize MA and improve the efficiency of Medicare.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.010.abstractZh: 本文研究了医疗保险保费政策在将受益人分配到传统医疗保险和医疗保险优势计划中的管理式护理计划之间的作用。受益人对护理的需求各不相同。传统医疗保险能够完全满足需求，但存在道德风险导致的效率低下。医疗保险计划则分配护理服务，但忽略了需求的一些要素。我们描述了一种将受益人高效分配到这两种选项的方法，并认为效率要求医疗保险计划面向需求分布中的大部分人群——即“中产阶级”。目前医疗保险计划中“单一保费”的政策无法实现高效的分配。我们提出了一种基于需求的保费政策，该政策可以实现对参保人高效分配到不同计划的方式。如果只能采用单一保费政策，那么次优政策会导致许多需求较低的个体被分配到医疗保险计划中，而相对于最优方案而言，服务的水平会过低。我们提出了利用保费政策来振兴医疗保险计划并提高其效率的方法。

abstract.text: How do medical errors affect physician behavior? Despite the importance of this question empirical evidence about it remains limited. This paper studies the impact of obstetricians' medical errors that resulted in malpractice litigation on their subsequent choice of whether to perform a C-section, a common procedure that is thought to be sensitive to physician incentives. The main result is that C-section rates jumped discontinuously by 4% after a medical error, establishing an association between medical errors and treatment patterns. C-section rates continued to increase afterwards, bringing the cumulative increase 2.5 years after a medical error to 8%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.11.011.abstractZh: 医疗错误如何影响医生的行为？尽管这个问题非常重要，但相关的实证证据仍然有限。本文研究了产科医生因医疗错误而引发的医疗事故诉讼对其随后是否选择进行剖宫产手术的影响。剖宫产手术通常被认为容易受到医生动机的影响。主要研究发现，在医疗错误发生后，剖宫产率突然上升了4%，这表明医疗错误与治疗方案之间存在关联。此后，剖宫产率继续上升，在医疗错误发生两年后，累积增幅达到了8%。

abstract.text: From 1994 to 2009, forty-three states changed the design of their driver's license/state identification cards in an effort to reduce underage access to and consumption of alcohol and tobacco. In these states, individuals under the age of 21 are issued licenses that are vertically oriented, whereas licenses for individuals 21 and older retain a traditional horizontal shape. This paper examines the effect of this design change on underage alcohol and tobacco use. Using a difference-in-differences methodology, we find a reduction in drinking and smoking for 16 year olds. These results are upheld in a triple difference model that uses a within state control group of teens that did not receive a vertical license to control for state-specific unobserved factors. Interestingly, we find that the effects of the design change are concentrated in the 1-2 years after a state begins issuing vertical licenses. We consider various explanations for our findings: teen learning, the availability of false identification, and changes in retailer behavior.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.12.001.abstractZh: 从1994年到2009年，43个州对驾驶执照/州身份证的设计进行了修改，旨在减少未成年人接触和消费酒精及烟草的行为。在这些州，21岁以下的个人获得的执照为垂直型，而21岁及以上的个人获得的执照则保持传统的水平型。本文探讨了这一设计变更对未成年人酒精和烟草使用的影响。通过差异-差异方法分析，我们发现16岁青少年的饮酒和吸烟行为有所减少。这些结果在采用三重差异模型的情况下得到了验证，该模型使用了未观察到州内特定因素的对照组青少年，以控制州际差异。有趣的是，我们发现设计变更的影响集中在州开始发放垂直型执照后的1-2年内。我们考虑了多种解释这些发现的原因：青少年学习能力的提升、虚假身份证的可用性，以及零售商行为的变化。

abstract.text: A longitudinal analysis of married physicians labor supply is carried out on Norwegian data from 1997 to 1999. The model utilized for estimation implies that physicians can choose among 10 different job packages which are a combination of part time/full time, hospital/primary care, private/public sector, and not working. Their current choice is influenced by past available options due to a habit persistence parameter in the utility function. In the estimation we take into account the budget constraint, including all features of the tax system. Our results imply that an overall wage increase or less progressive taxation moves married physicians toward full time job packages, in particular to full time jobs in the private sector. But the overall and aggregate labor supply elasticities in the population of employed doctors are rather low compared to previous estimates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.12.002.abstractZh: 本研究基于1997至1999年的挪威数据，对已婚医生的劳动力供给进行了纵向分析。所使用的模型表明，医生可以在10种不同的工作选择中做出选择，这些选择包括兼职/全职、医院/基层医疗、私营/公共部门以及不工作。他们当前的选择受到过去可用选项的影响，这一影响源于效用函数中的习惯持续性参数。在估计过程中，我们考虑了预算约束，包括税收体系的所有特征。研究结果表明，整体工资的增加或较低的税收制度会使已婚医生更倾向于选择全职工作，尤其是私营部门的全职工作。然而，与之前的估计相比，在职医生的总体和综合劳动力供给弹性相对较低。

abstract.text: This study examines if health care costs in the United States are affected by Baumol's cost disease. It relies on an empirical test proposed by Hartwig (2008) and extended by Colombier (2010) and uses a panel data set of 50 states over the 1980-2009 period. The results suggest that health care costs grow more rapidly when economy-wide wage increases exceed productivity gains. The findings are fairly robust with respect to time- and state-fixed effects, individual state time trends, and two-stage least square estimation. Consequently, this study suggests that the U.S. health care sector suffers from Baumol's cost disease.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.12.003.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了美国的医疗保健成本是否受到Baumol成本病的影响。研究基于Hartwig（2008）提出的实证检验，并由Colombier（2010）进一步扩展，使用了1980至2009年间50个州的面板数据。研究结果表明，当经济范围内的工资增长超过生产率增长时，医疗保健成本的增长速度会更快。研究结果在时间效应、州固定效应、各州随时间的变化趋势以及两阶段最小二乘估计方面都相当稳健。因此，本研究认为美国的医疗保健行业确实受到了Baumol成本病的影响。

abstract.text: We explore how and to what extent prescription drug insurance expansions affect incentives for pharmaceutical advertising. When insurance expansions make markets more profitable, firms respond by boosting advertising. Theory suggests this effect will be magnified in the least competitive drug classes, where firms internalize a larger share of the benefits from advertising. Empirically, we find that the implementation of Part D coincides with a 14-19% increase in total advertising expenditures. This effect is indeed concentrated in the least competitive drug classes. The additional advertising raised utilization among non-elderly patients outside the Part D program by about 3.6%. This is roughly half of the direct utilization effect of Part D on elderly beneficiaries. The results suggest the presence of considerable spillover effects from publicly subsidized prescription drug insurance on the utilization and welfare of consumers outside the program.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.01.001.abstractZh: 我们探讨了处方药保险扩展在多大程度上影响了制药广告的激励因素。当保险扩展使市场更具盈利能力时，企业会通过增加广告投入来应对。理论表明，这种效应在竞争最不激烈的药物类别中更为显著，因为企业会更多地内部化广告带来的收益。实证研究表明，Part D政策的实施伴随着总广告支出增加14-19%。这种效应确实集中在竞争最不激烈的药物类别中。额外的广告使得非老年患者对Part D项目的利用率提高了约3.6%，这大约相当于Part D对老年受益者直接利用率的影响的一半。这些结果表明，公共补贴的处方药保险对项目外消费者的使用率和福利产生了显著的溢出效应。

abstract.text: Public policies intended to induce behavioral change, specifically incentives to reduce interpersonal contacts or to "social distance," increasingly play a prominent role in public disease response strategies as governments plan for and respond to major epidemics. I compare social distancing incentives and outcomes under decentralized, full control social planner, and constrained social planner, without health class specific control, decision making scenarios. Constrained social planner decision making, based on non-health class specific controls, can in some instances make society worse off than decentralized decision making (i.e. no intervention). The oft neglected behavior of recovered and immune individuals is important for welfare and health outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.01.002.abstractZh: 旨在引导行为改变的公共政策，特别是减少人际接触或“社交距离”的激励措施，在公共疾病应对策略中发挥着越来越重要的作用，尤其是在政府规划和应对重大疫情时。我比较了在去中心化、完全控制的社会规划者和受限制的社会规划者两种情况下，社交距离激励措施及其效果。受限制的社会规划者基于非健康类别特定的控制措施进行决策，在某些情况下可能会使社会状况比去中心化决策（即不采取任何干预措施）更糟。康复者和免疫个体的行为往往被忽视，但他们对福利和健康结果具有重要影响。

abstract.text: I investigate how changes in fees paid to Medicaid physicians affect take-up among children in low-income families. The existing literature suggests that the low level of Medicaid fee payments to physicians reduces their willingness to see Medicaid patients, thus creating an access-to-care problem for these patients. For the identical service, current Medicaid reimbursement rates are only about 65 percent of those covered by Medicare. Increasing the relative payments of Medicaid would increase its perceived value, as it would provide better access to health care for Medicaid beneficiaries. Using variation in the timing of the changes in Medicaid payment across states, I find that increasing Medicaid generosity is associated with both an increase in take-up and a reduction in uninsured rate. These results provide a partial answer to the puzzling question of why many low-income children who are eligible for Medicaid remain uninsured.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.01.003.abstractZh: 我研究了支付给医疗补助医生的费用变化如何影响低收入家庭儿童的就医情况。现有文献表明，医疗补助向医生支付的费用较低，这降低了医生为医疗补助患者提供服务的意愿，从而导致了这些患者的就医问题。对于相同的服务，当前医疗补助的报销比例仅约为医疗保险的65%。提高医疗补助的相对支付金额将提升其价值，因为这将为医疗补助受益人提供更好的医疗服务。通过研究各州医疗补助支付金额变化的时间差异，我发现提高医疗补助的慷慨程度既会增加就医需求，也会降低无保险率。这些结果部分回答了为什么许多有资格享受医疗补助的低收入儿童仍然无保险这一令人困惑的问题。

abstract.text: A growing literature suggests that stressful events in pregnancy can have negative effects on birth outcomes. Some of the estimates in this literature may be affected by small samples, omitted variables, endogenous mobility in response to disasters, and errors in the measurement of gestation, as well as by a mechanical correlation between longer gestation and the probability of having been exposed. We use millions of individual birth records to examine the effects of exposure to hurricanes during pregnancy, and the sensitivity of the estimates to these econometric problems. We find that exposure to a hurricane during pregnancy increases the probability of abnormal conditions of the newborn such as being on a ventilator more than 30min and meconium aspiration syndrome (MAS). Although we are able to reproduce previous estimates of effects on birth weight and gestation, our results suggest that measured effects of stressful events on these outcomes are sensitive to specification and it is preferable to use more sensitive indicators of newborn health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.01.004.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究表明，妊娠期间的压力事件可能对分娩结果产生负面影响。这些研究中的一些估计结果可能受到样本规模较小、遗漏变量、对灾难的反应导致的行为变化以及妊娠时间测量误差的影响，同时还可能存在妊娠时间延长与暴露风险之间的机械性关联。我们利用数百万份个体出生记录来研究妊娠期间遭遇飓风的影响，以及这些计量经济学问题对估计结果的影响。研究发现，妊娠期间遭遇飓风会增加新生儿出现异常情况的概率，如需要使用呼吸机超过30分钟或发生胎粪吸入综合征。尽管我们能够复现之前关于出生体重和妊娠时间影响的估计结果，但我们的研究结果表明，压力事件对这些结果的影响对模型设定非常敏感，因此建议使用更敏感的指标来评估新生儿健康状况。

abstract.text: There is a consensus that statistical agencies should report medical data by disease rather than by service. This study computes price indexes that are necessary to deflate nominal disease expenditures and to decompose their growth into price, treated prevalence and output per patient growth. Unlike previous studies, it uses methods that can be implemented by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). For the calendar years 2005-2010, I find that these feasible disease based indexes are approximately 1% lower on an annual basis than indexes computed by current methods at BLS. This gives evidence that traditional medical price indexes have not accounted for the more efficient use of medical inputs in treating most diseases.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.01.005.abstractZh: 学术界普遍认为，统计机构应该按照疾病而非服务类型来报告医疗数据。本研究计算了必要的价格指数，以对名义上的疾病支出进行 deflation，并将其增长分解为价格、治疗率以及每位患者的产出增长。与以往的研究不同，本研究采用了劳工统计局能够实施的方法。在2005至2010年期间，我们发现，基于疾病的这些可行指数在年度基础上比劳工统计局当前使用的方法计算出的指数低约1%。这表明，传统的医疗价格指数未能反映在治疗大多数疾病时医疗资源的更高效使用方面。

abstract.text: In this paper we explore the implications of normative principles for the evaluation of population health. We formalize those principles as axioms for social preferences over distributions of health for a given population. We single out several focal population health evaluation functions, which represent social preferences, as a result of combinations of those axioms. Our results provide new rationale for popular theories in health economics, such as the unweighted aggregation of quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) or healthy years equivalents (HYEs) and generalizations of the two, aimed to capture concerns for distributive justice, without resorting to controversial assumptions on individual preferences.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.01.006.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了规范原则对人口健康评估的影响。我们将这些原则形式化为关于给定人口健康分配的社会偏好的公理。我们列举了几种代表社会偏好的人口健康评估函数，这些函数是由这些公理组合而成的。我们的研究结果为健康经济学中的流行理论提供了新的理论依据，例如无权重的质量调整生命年（QALYs）或健康年当量（HYEs）的汇总方法，以及对这些方法的推广，旨在解决分配正义问题，而无需依赖有争议的个体偏好假设。

abstract.text: Many health risks are ambiguous in the sense that reliable and credible information about these risks is unavailable. In health economics, ambiguity is usually handled through sensitivity analysis, which implicitly assumes that people are neutral towards ambiguity. However, empirical evidence suggests that people are averse to ambiguity and react strongly to it. This paper studies the effects of ambiguity aversion on two classical medical decision problems. If there is ambiguity regarding the diagnosis of a patient, ambiguity aversion increases the decision maker's propensity to opt for treatment. On the other hand, in the case of ambiguity regarding the effects of treatment, ambiguity aversion leads to a reduction in the propensity to choose treatment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.02.001.abstractZh: 许多健康风险具有模糊性，因为关于这些风险的可靠和可信信息难以获得。在健康经济学中，模糊性通常通过敏感性分析来处理，这种方法隐含地假设人们对模糊性持中立态度。然而，实证证据表明，人们实际上对模糊性持厌恶态度，并且会对模糊性产生强烈的反应。本文研究了模糊厌恶对两个经典医疗决策问题的影响。如果患者的诊断存在模糊性，模糊厌恶会增加决策者选择治疗的倾向。另一方面，如果治疗的效果存在模糊性，模糊厌恶会导致选择治疗的倾向降低。

abstract.text: Globally, suicide has emerged as the second leading cause of death among youth aged 10-24 years old. In order to better understand the causes of this phenomenon, we investigate the relationship between suicidal ideation and cannabis use. Our empirical analysis is based on a 30-year longitudinal study of a birth cohort. We find that intensive cannabis use - at least several times per week - leads to a higher transition rate into suicidal ideation for males. We find no evidence that suicidal ideation leads to cannabis use for either males or females.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.02.002.abstractZh: 在全球范围内，自杀已成为10至24岁青少年中的第二大死亡原因。为了更好地理解这一现象的原因，我们研究了自杀念头与大麻使用之间的关系。我们的实证分析基于一项为期30年的出生队列纵向研究。我们发现，每周至少使用大麻数次会导致男性更容易产生自杀念头。我们没有发现自杀念头会导致男性或女性使用大麻的证据。

abstract.text: This paper explores whether the state provision of school meals in the 1980s crowded out private provision by examining two policy reforms that radically altered the UK school meal service. Both reforms effectively increased the cost of school meals for one group (the treated), leaving another unaffected (the controls). I find strong evidence of crowd out: the reforms reduced school meal take-up among the treated by 20-30 percentage points, with no difference among the controls. I then examine whether this affected children's body weights, using a large, unique, longitudinal dataset of primary school children from 1972 to 1994. The findings show no evidence of any effects on child body weight.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.02.003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了20世纪80年代国家提供学校餐食是否挤占了私人提供餐食的市场，通过研究两项彻底改变了英国学校餐食服务的政策改革来进行分析。这两项改革实际上增加了某一群体（被干预组）的学校餐食成本，而另一组则未受影响（对照组）。我发现有力的证据表明存在挤出效应：这些改革使被干预组的学校餐食使用率降低了20-30个百分点，而对照组则没有变化。随后，我利用一个包含1972年至1994年大量、独特的学龄儿童纵向数据集，研究这一变化是否影响了儿童的体重。研究结果表明，这一变化并未对儿童体重产生任何影响。

abstract.text: Studies on health effects of unemployment usually neglect spillover effects on spouses. This study specifically investigates the effect of an individual's unemployment on the mental health of their spouse. In order to allow for causal interpretation of the estimates, it focuses on plant closure as entry into unemployment, and combines difference-in-difference and matching based on entropy balancing to provide robustness against observable and time-invariant unobservable heterogeneity. Using German Socio-Economic Panel Study data the paper reveals that unemployment decreases the mental health of spouses almost as much as for the directly affected individuals. The findings highlight that previous studies underestimate the public health costs of unemployment as they do not account for the potential consequences for spouses.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.02.004.abstractZh: 关于失业对健康影响的研究通常忽略了其对配偶的溢出效应。本研究特别探讨了个人失业对其配偶心理健康的影响。为了对估计结果进行因果解释，研究以工厂关闭作为失业的触发因素，并采用差异-差异方法和基于熵平衡的匹配方法，以抵御可观测和随时间不变的不可观测异质性。利用德国社会经济面板研究数据，研究发现失业对配偶的心理健康影响几乎与对直接受影响个体的影响相当。研究结果表明，以往的研究低估了失业对公共健康的危害，因为它们没有考虑对配偶的潜在影响。

abstract.text: We evaluate the health effects of a reduction in New Zealand's minimum legal purchase age for alcohol. Difference-in-differences (DD) estimates show a substantial increase in alcohol-related hospitalizations among those newly eligible to purchase liquor, around 24.6% (s.e.=5.5%) for males and 22% (s.e.=8.1%) for females. There is less evidence of an effect among ineligible younger cohorts. There is little evidence of alcohol either complementing or substituting for drugs. We do not find evidence that earlier access to alcohol is associated with learning from experience. We also present regression discontinuity estimates, but emphasize DD estimates since in a simulation of a rational addiction model DD estimates are closer than regression discontinuity estimates to the policy's true effect.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.02.006.abstractZh: 我们评估了新西兰将酒精最低法定购买年龄降低所带来的健康影响。差异-差异法估计显示，新符合购买资格的人群中，与酒精相关的住院率显著上升，男性约为24.6%（标准误差为5.5%），女性约为22%（标准误差为8.1%）。对于不符合资格且年龄较小的群体，这种影响的证据较少。此外，几乎没有证据表明酒精能够补充或替代药物的作用。我们没有发现更早接触酒精与从经验中学习之间存在关联。我们还提供了回归不连续法估计结果，但更强调差异-差异法估计，因为在理性成瘾模型的模拟中，差异-差异法估计与政策真实效果更为接近。

abstract.text: The relationship between retirement and mortality is studied with a unique administrative data set covering the full population of Norway. A series of retirement policy changes in Norway reduced the retirement age for a group of workers but not for others. Difference-in-differences estimation based on monthly birth cohorts and treatment group status show that the early retirement programme significantly reduced the retirement age; this holds true also when we account for programme substitution, for example into the disability pension. Instrumental variables estimation results show no effect on mortality of retirement age; neither do estimation results from a hazard rate model.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.03.001.abstractZh: 本研究通过挪威完整人口特有的行政数据集，探讨了退休与死亡率之间的关系。挪威的一系列退休政策调整使得某些群体的退休年龄降低，而另一些群体的退休年龄并未发生变化。基于月度出生队列和待遇组状态的差异估计结果显示，早期退休计划显著降低了退休年龄；即使考虑到政策替代情况，例如转向残疾抚恤金，这一结果依然成立。工具变量估计结果显示，退休年龄对死亡率没有影响；风险率模型的估计结果也表明这一点。

abstract.text: Crowd-out, the switching from private to public insurance, is often found, but estimates are rarely consistent with prior measurements. Cutler and Gruber (1996) found crowd-out in up to half of the newly eligible children, while Card and Shore-Sheppard (2004) found almost none. This paper exploits many regression discontinuity (RD) designs to estimate heterogeneous effects of public insurance eligibility. Crowd-out and its impact on spending and utilization is documented across the income spectrum, but effects are smaller at higher income levels. These differences vary by state and correspond to changes in the reimbursement rates of public insurance plans.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.03.002.abstractZh: 从私人保险转向公共保险的现象并不少见，但相关估计结果往往与先前的测量结果不一致。Cutler和Gruber在1996年的研究中发现，高达一半的新符合条件儿童出现了这种转变，而Card和Shore-Sheppard在2004年的研究则发现这种情况几乎不存在。本文利用多种回归不连续性设计来估计公共保险资格对个体影响的异质性。研究记录了这种转变对支出和利用率的影响，但这一影响在较高收入水平下更为微弱。这些差异因州而异，并对应于公共保险计划报销率的变化。

abstract.text: Using patient experience survey data, the paper investigates whether hospital ownership affects the level of quality reported by patients whose care is funded by the National Health Service in areas other than clinical quality. We estimate a switching regression model that accounts for (i) some observable characteristics of the patient and the hospital episode; (ii) selection into private hospitals; and (iii) unmeasured hospital characteristics captured by hospital fixed effects. We find that the experience reported by patients in public and private hospitals is different, i.e. most dimensions of quality are delivered differently by the two types of hospitals, with each sector offering greater quality in certain specialties or to certain groups of patients. However, the sum of all ownership effects is not statistically different from zero at sample means. In other words, hospital ownership in and of itself does not affect the level of quality of the average patient's reported experience. Differences in mean reported quality levels between the private and public sectors are entirely attributable to patient characteristics, the selection of patients into public or private hospitals and unobserved characteristics specific to individual hospitals, rather than to hospital ownership.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.03.003.abstractZh: 本文利用患者体验调查数据，研究医院所有权是否会影响由国家卫生服务系统资助的护理患者的质量水平，而非临床质量方面。我们建立了一个转换回归模型，该模型考虑了以下因素：(i) 患者和医院事件的一些可观测特征；(ii) 选择进入私立医院的情况；以及(iii) 通过医院固定效应捕捉的未测量医院特征。研究发现，公立医院和私立医院中患者的体验存在差异，即两种类型的医院在质量的不同方面表现不同，每个行业在某些专业领域或针对某些患者群体时提供了更高的质量。然而，所有所有权效应的总和在样本均值上并不具有统计学上的显著差异。换句话说，医院所有权本身并不会影响患者报告体验的平均质量水平。私立和公立部门之间报告的质量水平差异完全归因于患者特征、患者选择进入公立或私立医院的情况，以及个别医院特有的未观测特征，而非医院所有权本身。

abstract.text: This study investigates the effect of early-life exposure to malaria on disease and work level in old age over the past one and a half centuries. Using longitudinal lifetime records of Union Army veterans, I first estimate that exposure to a malarial environment in early life (c.1840) substantially increased the likelihood of having various chronic diseases and not working in old age (c.1900). Second, from data on US cohorts born between 1891 and 1960, I find that those exposed to a higher level of the anti-malaria campaign, which began in 1921, had lower levels of work disability in old age. Third, I seek the same implications for the modern period by linking WHO's country statistics on DALYs among older populations in 2004 to country-level malaria risk in pre-eradication era. In the paper, I discuss possible mechanisms and propose the significance of malaria eradication and early-life conditions from a long-term perspective.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.03.004.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了早年感染疟疾对过去一个半世纪中老年时期疾病和劳动水平的影响。通过利用联邦军队退伍军人的纵向终身记录，我首先估计出，在早年（约1840年）接触疟疾环境会显著增加罹患各种慢性疾病以及在老年时期不工作的可能性（约1900年）。其次，通过对1891年至1960年间出生的美国人群的数据分析，我发现那些在1921年开始的疟疾防治运动中处于较高风险环境中的人群，在老年时期的劳动残疾率较低。第三，我通过将世界卫生组织在2004年对老年人口造成的残疾调整生命年数的统计数据与根除疟疾前时期的疟疾风险联系起来，探讨了现代时期的类似影响。在论文中，我讨论了可能的机制，并从长期角度提出了疟疾根除和早年生活条件的重要性。

abstract.text: Health-related external benefits are of potentially large importance for public policy. This paper investigates health-related external benefits using a stated-preference discrete-choice experiment framed in a health care context and including choice scenarios defined by six attributes related to a recipient and the recipient's condition: communicability, severity, medical necessity, relationship to respondent, location, and amount of contribution requested. Subjects also completed a set of own-treatment scenarios and a values-orientation instrument. We find evidence of substantial health-related external benefits that vary as expected with the scenario attributes and subjects' value orientations. The results are consistent with a number of hypotheses offered by the general theoretical analysis of health-related externalities and the analysis of externalities specific to health care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.03.005.abstractZh: 与健康相关的外部效益对公共政策具有潜在的重要意义。本文通过一项在医疗背景下进行的偏好离散选择实验，研究了与健康相关的外部效益。实验包含了由六个属性定义的多种选择情景，这些属性涉及受惠者及其健康状况：传染性、严重程度、医疗必要性、与受访者的关系、地理位置以及请求的贡献金额。参与者还完成了一系列关于自身治疗情景的问卷，并填写了价值观导向问卷。我们发现，与健康相关的外部效益存在显著差异，这种差异与情景属性以及参与者的价值观取向密切相关。研究结果与关于健康相关外部性的一般理论分析以及针对医疗领域外部性的分析所提出的若干假设一致。

abstract.text: Recent studies examining the relationship between family income and child health in the UK have produced mixed findings. We re-examine the income gradient in child general health and its evolution with child age in this country, using a very large sample of British children. We find that there is no correlation between income and child general health at ages 0-1, that the gradient emerges around age 2 and is constant from age 2 to age 17. In addition, we show that the gradient remains large and significant when we reduce the endogeneity of income. Furthermore, our results indicate that the gradient in general health reflects a greater prevalence of chronic conditions among low-income children and a greater severity of these conditions. Taken together, these findings suggest that income does matter for child health in the UK and may play a role in the intergenerational transmission of socioeconomic status.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.03.006.abstractZh: 最近关于英国家庭收入与儿童健康关系的研究结果并不一致。我们利用大量英国儿童样本，重新分析了儿童整体健康状况随收入变化的趋势以及这一趋势随年龄的变化情况。研究发现，在0-1岁期间，收入与儿童整体健康状况之间没有相关性；收入与儿童健康状况的关联在2岁左右开始显现，并在2岁至17岁期间保持恒定。此外，当我们减少收入的内生性影响时，这种收入与儿童健康状况之间的关联仍然显著。我们的研究还表明，儿童整体健康状况的关联反映了低收入儿童中慢性疾病的普遍程度较高，且这些疾病的严重程度也较高。综合这些研究结果，我们认为收入对英国儿童健康确实具有重要影响，并且可能在社会经济地位的代际传递中起到一定作用。

abstract.text: While the prevalence of smokeless tobacco (ST) is low relative to smoking, the distribution of ST use is highly skewed with consumption concentrated among certain segments of the population (rural residents, males, whites, low-educated individuals). Furthermore, there is suggestive evidence that use has trended upwards recently for groups that have traditionally been at low risk of using ST, and thus started to diffuse across demographics. This study provides the first estimates, at the national level, of the effects of magazine advertising on ST use. The focus on magazine advertising is significant given that ST manufacturers have been banned from using other conventional media since the 1986 Comprehensive ST Act and the 1998 ST Master Settlement Agreement. This study is based on the 2003-2009 waves of the National Consumer Survey (NCS), a unique data source that contains extensive information on the reading habits of individuals, matched with magazine-specific advertising information over the sample period. This allows detailed and salient measures of advertising exposure at the individual level and addresses potential bias due to endogeneity and selective targeting. We find consistent and robust evidence that exposure to ST ads in magazines raises ST use, especially among males, with an estimated elasticity of 0.06. There is suggestive evidence that both ST taxes and cigarette taxes reduce ST use, indicating contemporaneous complementarity between these tobacco products. Sub-analyses point to some differences in the advertising and tax response across segments of the population. The effects from this study inform the debate on the cost and benefits of ST use and its potential to be a tool in overall tobacco harm reduction.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.03.007.abstractZh: 虽然无烟烟草的使用率相对于吸烟来说较低，但其分布却存在高度偏斜，使用主要集中在某些人群群体中，如农村居民、男性、白人以及教育程度较低的个体。此外，有证据表明，那些传统上使用无烟烟草风险较低的群体，其使用率近年来有所上升，这表明无烟烟草的使用范围正在逐渐扩大。本研究首次在全国范围内估算了杂志广告对无烟烟草使用的影响。由于自1986年《全面无烟烟草法案》和1998年《无烟烟草主协议》实施以来，无烟烟草制造商被禁止使用其他传统媒体，因此关注杂志广告尤为重要。本研究基于2003-2009年的全国消费者调查数据，该数据来源独特，包含有关个人阅读习惯的详细信息，同时还有样本期间特定杂志的广告信息。这使得我们能够详细且准确地衡量个人层面的广告暴露情况，并避免了由于内生性和选择性目标定位带来的潜在偏差。我们发现，杂志中的无烟烟草广告确实会增加无烟烟草的使用率，尤其是在男性中，估计的弹性为0.06。此外，有证据表明，无烟烟草税和香烟税都能减少无烟烟草的使用，这表明这两种烟草产品之间存在互补性。子分析还指出，不同人群在广告和税收反应上存在一些差异。本研究的结果为关于无烟烟草使用的成本和收益的讨论提供了依据，同时也为将其作为减少整体烟草危害的工具提供了依据。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effects of attending medical school on health outcomes by exploiting that admission to medical school in the Netherlands is determined by a lottery. Among the applicants for medical school, people who attended medical school have on average 1.5 more years of completed education than people who did not. They are also more likely to have been exposed to a health-related education curriculum. The results show only modest impacts on health outcomes. Attending medical school reduces alcohol consumption and being underweight somewhat, and has a small positive impact on self-reported health status. It has, however, a small negative effect on the frequency of physical exercise and no significant impact on smoking, and being overweight or obese. Attending medical school does have a large positive impact on the probability of being registered for donations of organs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.04.001.abstractZh: 本文通过利用荷兰医学院的录取是通过抽签决定的这一特点，来估计就读医学院对健康结果的影响。在申请医学院的人群中，就读过医学院的人平均比没有读过医学院的人多1.5年的教育经历。此外，他们更有可能接受过与健康相关的教育课程。研究结果显示，就读医学院对健康结果的影响较为温和。它在一定程度上减少了酒精消费和体重过轻的情况，并对自我报告的健康状况有轻微的正面影响。然而，它对体育锻炼的频率有轻微的负面影响，而对吸烟、体重过重或肥胖则没有显著影响。此外，就读医学院对器官捐赠登记的概率有显著的正面影响。

abstract.text: Preference elicitation methods require respondents to predict the impact a change in health might have on their future selves. The focus on the change in health is at the possible expense of other experiences of life once in that health state. We analyse personal preferences to a pairwise choice task involving trade-offs between quality and length of life, where satisfaction levels with life or health are introduced in the description of the health states. We find that a health scenario including low levels of satisfaction increases the likelihood of preferring to die sooner in full health, whereas scenarios including high levels of satisfaction increase the likelihood of preferring to live for longer in poor health. The differences highlight the sensitivity of preferences to what is described in health states and therefore show the importance of on-going discussions about precisely what respondents should be asked to consider in preference elicitation studies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.04.002.abstractZh: 偏好引导方法要求受访者预测健康状况的变化对其未来自身的影响。这种对健康状况变化的关注可能会以牺牲其他生活体验为代价。我们分析了个人在一项涉及质量与寿命之间权衡的成对选择任务中的偏好，其中健康状态的描述中包含了对生活或健康的满意度。研究发现，包含低满意度水平的健康情景会增加人们选择在完全健康状态下更早死亡的倾向，而包含高满意度水平的情景则会增加人们选择在健康状况较差的情况下延长寿命的倾向。这些差异凸显了偏好对健康状态描述的敏感性，从而表明在偏好引导研究中，需要持续讨论应要求受访者考虑的具体因素。

abstract.text: The substantial increase in female employment rates in Europe over the past two decades has often been linked in political and public rhetoric to negative effects on child development, including obesity. We analyse this association between maternal employment and childhood obesity using rich objective reports of various anthropometric and other measures of fatness from the IDEFICS study of children aged 2-9 in 16 regions of eight European countries. Based on such data as accelerometer measures and information from nutritional diaries, we also investigate the effects of maternal employment on obesity's main drivers: calorie intake and physical activity. Our analysis provides little evidence for any association between maternal employment and childhood obesity, diet or physical activity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.04.003.abstractZh: 过去二十年里，欧洲女性就业率的显著增长在政治和公共言论中常常被联系在一起，认为这对儿童发展有负面影响，包括导致肥胖问题。我们利用IDEFICS研究提供的丰富客观数据，对16个欧洲国家8个地区的2至9岁儿童进行各项人体测量学及其他肥胖指标的研究，以分析母亲就业与儿童肥胖之间的关联。基于加速度计测量数据以及营养日记信息，我们还研究了母亲就业对肥胖主要影响因素——热量摄入和体力活动的影响。我们的分析并未发现母亲就业与儿童肥胖、饮食或体力活动之间存在任何关联。

abstract.text: We report results from two surveys of representative samples of Americans with private health insurance. The first examines how well Americans understand, and believe they understand, traditional health insurance coverage. The second examines whether those insured under a simplified all-copay insurance plan will be more likely to engage in cost-reducing behaviors relative to those insured under a traditional plan with deductibles and coinsurance, and measures consumer preferences between the two plans. The surveys provide strong evidence that consumers do not understand traditional plans and would better understand a simplified plan, but weaker evidence that a simplified plan would have strong appeal to consumers or change their healthcare choices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.04.004.abstractZh: 我们报告了两项针对拥有私人健康保险的美国人的代表性样本的调查结果。第一项调查探讨了美国人对传统健康保险覆盖范围的了解程度以及他们认为自己对此的理解程度。第二项调查则探讨了那些采用简化型全费用保险计划的人是否更有可能采取降低成本的行动，与那些采用带有免赔额和共同承担费用的传统保险计划的人相比。这两项调查都提供了强有力的证据，表明消费者并不了解传统保险计划，而更了解简化型保险计划。不过，这些调查也显示，简化型保险计划对消费者的吸引力并不大，也不会改变他们的医疗选择。

abstract.text: Employers are increasingly adopting workplace wellness programs designed to improve employee health and decrease employer costs associated with health insurance and job absenteeism. This paper examines the outcomes of 2635 workers across 24 worksites who were offered financial incentives for weight loss that took various forms, including fixed payments and forfeitable bonds. We document extremely high attrition and modest weight loss associated with the financial incentives in this program, which contrasts with the better outcomes associated with pilot programs. We conclude by offering suggestions, motivated by behavioral economics, for increasing the effectiveness of financial incentives for weight loss.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.04.005.abstractZh: 雇主们越来越多地采用工作场所健康计划，旨在改善员工的健康状况，并降低与健康保险和缺勤相关的企业成本。本文研究了24个工作场所中的2635名员工的情况，这些员工获得了各种形式的财务激励措施以促进体重减轻，包括固定支付和可没收的债券。我们发现，该计划中的财务激励措施导致了极高的员工流失率和相对较小的体重减轻幅度，这与试点计划中的更好效果形成了对比。最后，本文基于行为经济学的观点，提出了提高体重减轻财务激励措施有效性的建议。

abstract.text: In response to the dramatic rise in childhood obesity, the Centers for Disease Control (CDC) and other organizations have advocated increasing the amount of time that elementary school children spend in physical education (PE) classes. However, little is known about the effect of PE on child weight. This paper measures that effect by instrumenting for child PE time with the state's mandated minimum number of minutes of PE, using data from the Early Childhood Longitudinal Study, Kindergarten Cohort (ECLS-K) for 1998-2004. Results from IV models indicate that PE lowers BMI z-score and reduces the probability of obesity among 5th graders. This effect is concentrated among boys; we find evidence that this gender difference is partly attributable to PE being a complement with other physical activity for boys, whereas they are substitutes for girls. This represents some of the first evidence of a causal effect of PE on youth obesity, and thus offers at least some support for the assumptions behind the CDC recommendations. We find no evidence that increased PE time crowds out time in academic courses or has spillovers to achievement test scores.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.04.006.abstractZh: 针对儿童肥胖问题的急剧上升，疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）及其他机构建议增加小学生参加体育课程的时间。然而，关于体育对儿童体重的影响，目前了解甚少。本文通过利用1998-2004年幼儿纵向研究的数据，以州政府规定的体育课程最低分钟数作为工具变量，来测量体育课程对儿童体重的影响。实证模型的结果表明，体育课程能够降低儿童的体质指数评分，并减少五年级学生肥胖的可能性。这种效应在男孩中更为明显；我们发现这种性别差异部分是由于体育课程与其他体育活动相结合，而女孩则更倾向于替代其他体育活动。这代表了关于体育课程对青少年肥胖具有因果效应的首批证据，因此至少为CDC的建议提供了一定的支持。我们没有发现增加体育课程时间会挤占学术课程的时间，也不会对学业成绩产生负面影响。

abstract.text: Despite its success, Medicare Part D has been widely criticized for the gap in coverage, the so-called "doughnut hole". We compare the use of prescription drugs among beneficiaries subject to the coverage gap with usage among beneficiaries who are not exposed to it. We find that the coverage gap does, indeed, disrupt the use of prescription drugs among seniors with diabetes. But the declines in usage are modest and concentrated among higher cost, brand-name medications. Demand for high cost medications such as antipsychotics, antiasthmatics, and drugs of the central nervous system decline by 8-18% in the coverage gap, while use of lower cost medications with high generic penetration such as beta blockers, ACE inhibitors and antidepressants decline by 3-5% after reaching the gap. More importantly, lower adherence to medications is not associated with increases in medical service use.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.04.007.abstractZh: 尽管Medicare Part D取得了成功，但因其覆盖范围的缺口，即所谓的“ doughnut hole”，而受到广泛批评。我们比较了处于覆盖缺口中的受益人与非覆盖受益人之间的处方药使用情况。研究发现，覆盖缺口确实影响了糖尿病老年患者对处方药的使用。不过，使用量的下降幅度较小，且主要集中在价格较高、品牌药品上。在覆盖缺口期间，如抗精神病药、抗哮喘药和中枢神经系统药物等高成本药物的需求下降了8-18%，而如β阻滞剂、ACE抑制剂和抗抑郁药等低成本且通用性较高的药物的使用量则下降了3-5%。更重要的是，药物依从性的降低并未导致医疗服务使用的增加。

abstract.text: We develop a model where a genetic test reveals whether an individual has a low or high probability of developing a disease. Testing is not mandatory, but agents have to reveal their test results to the insurers, facing a discrimination risk. A costly prevention effort allows agents with a genetic predisposition to decrease their probability to develop the disease. We study the individual decisions to take the test and to undertake the prevention effort as a function of the effort cost and of its efficiency. If effort is observable by insurers, agents undertake the test only if the effort cost is neither too large nor too small. If the effort cost is not observable by insurers, moral hazard increases the value of the test if the effort cost is low. We offer several policy recommendations, from the optimal breadth of the tests to policies to do away with the discrimination risk.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.04.008.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个模型，其中基因测试可以揭示个体患病的概率高低。测试并非强制性的，但代理人必须向保险公司披露测试结果，从而面临歧视风险。昂贵的预防措施可以让具有遗传倾向的代理人降低患病的概率。我们研究了个体是否选择进行测试以及是否采取预防措施的决定，这些决定取决于预防措施的成本及其效果。如果保险公司能够观察到预防措施的成本，那么代理人只有在成本既不太高也不太低的情况下才会进行测试。如果预防措施的成本无法被保险公司观察到，那么如果成本较低，道德风险会增加测试的价值。我们提出了一些政策建议，包括确定测试的最佳范围以及消除歧视风险的政策。

abstract.text: A basic prediction of theoretical models of insurance is that if consumers have private information about their risk of suffering a loss there will be a positive correlation between risk and the level of insurance coverage. We test this prediction in the context of the market for private health insurance in Australia. Despite a universal public system that provides comprehensive coverage for inpatient and outpatient care, roughly half of the adult population also carries private health insurance, the main benefit of which is more timely access to elective hospital treatment. Like several studies on different types of insurance in other countries, we find no support for the positive correlation hypothesis. Because strict underwriting regulations create strong information asymmetries, this result suggests the importance of multi-dimensional private information. Additional analyses suggest that the advantageous selection observed in this market is driven by the effect of risk aversion, the ability to make complex financial decisions and income.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.05.001.abstractZh: 保险理论模型的一个基本预测是，如果消费者拥有关于自身损失风险的个人信息，那么风险与保险覆盖程度之间会存在正相关性。我们在澳大利亚私人健康保险市场的背景下对这一预测进行了测试。尽管澳大利亚有提供住院和门诊护理全面覆盖的全民公共保险体系，但大约一半的成年人仍然持有私人健康保险，其主要好处是能够更及时地获得选择性住院治疗服务。与其他国家关于不同类型保险的研究类似，我们没有发现支持正相关性假设的证据。由于严格的承保规定导致信息严重不对称，这一结果表明多维私人信息的重要性。进一步的分析表明，该市场中观察到的有利选择是由风险厌恶、做出复杂财务决策的能力以及收入等因素所驱动的。

abstract.text: In two important health policy contexts - private plans in Medicare and the new state-run "Exchanges" created as part of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) - plan payments come from two sources: risk-adjusted payments from a Regulator and premiums charged to individual enrollees. This paper derives principles for integrating risk-adjusted payments and premium policy in individual health insurance markets based on fitting total plan payments to health plan costs per person as closely as possible. A least squares regression including both health status and variables used in premiums reveals the weights a Regulator should put on risk adjusters when markets determine premiums. We apply the methods to an Exchange-eligible population drawn from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.05.002.abstractZh: 在两项重要的健康政策背景下——Medicare中的私人计划以及作为《平价医疗法案》一部分而新设立的州立“交易所”——计划支付来自两个来源：监管机构提供的风险调整支付，以及向个人参保者收取的保费。本文基于尽可能使总计划支付与每人健康计划成本相匹配的原则，提出了整合风险调整支付和保费政策的原则。包括健康状况和保费相关变量的最小二乘回归分析，揭示了监管机构在市场确定保费时应给予风险调整者的权重。我们将这些方法应用于从医疗支出调查中抽取的符合交易所资格的人群。

abstract.text: We examine provider responses to the Medicare inpatient rehabilitation facility (IRF) prospective payment system (PPS), which simultaneously reduced marginal reimbursement and increased average reimbursement. IRFs could respond to the PPS by changing the number of patients admitted, admitting different types of patients, or changing the intensity of care. We use Medicare claims data to separately estimate each type of provider response. We also examine changes in patient outcomes and spillover effects on other post-acute care providers. We find that costs of care initially fell following the PPS, which we attribute to changes in treatment decisions rather than the characteristics of patients admitted to IRFs within the diagnostic categories we examine. However, the probability of admission to IRFs increased after the PPS due to the expanded admission policies of providers. We find modest spillover effects in other post-acute settings and negative health impacts for only one of three diagnostic groups studied.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.05.003.abstractZh: 我们研究了医疗服务提供者对医疗保险住院康复设施（IRF）前瞻性支付系统（PPS）的反应。该支付系统同时降低了边际报销金额并提高了平均报销金额。IRF可以通过改变入院患者数量、收治不同类型的患者或调整护理强度来应对PPS。我们利用医疗保险索赔数据分别估算每种类型的响应。我们还研究了患者结果的变化以及对其他慢性后期护理提供者的溢出效应。我们发现，在PPS实施初期，护理成本有所下降，我们认为这是由于治疗决策的变化而非入院患者特征的变化所致。然而，由于提供者的入院政策放宽，PPS实施后进入IRF的概率有所增加。我们发现其他慢性后期护理环境中存在适度的溢出效应，但在所研究的三个诊断组中，只有一个诊断组出现了负面的健康影响。

abstract.text: We use unique data on abortions performed in New York State from 1971 to 1975 to demonstrate that women traveled hundreds of miles for a legal abortion before Roe. A 100-mile increase in distance for women who live approximately 183 miles from New York was associated with a decline in abortion rates of 12.2 percent whereas the same change for women who lived 830 miles from New York lowered abortion rates by 3.3 percent. The abortion rates of nonwhites were more sensitive to distance than those of whites. We found a positive and robust association between distance to the nearest abortion provider and teen birth rates but less consistent estimates for other ages. Our results suggest that even if some states lost all abortion providers due to legislative policies, the impact on population measures of birth and abortion rates would be small as most women would travel to states with abortion services.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.05.004.abstractZh: 我们利用1971至1975年间纽约州堕胎数据的独特资料，发现女性在罗诉韦德案之前会前往数百英里之外的地方寻求合法堕胎服务。对于居住在距离纽约约183英里之外的女性来说，距离增加100英里会导致堕胎率下降12.2%；而对于居住在距离纽约830英里之外的女性来说，同样的改变则会使堕胎率下降3.3%。非白人女性的堕胎率对距离的变化更为敏感。我们发现，距离最近的堕胎服务提供者之间的距离与青少年生育率之间存在正相关关系，但其他年龄段的估计结果则不太一致。我们的研究结果表明，即使某些州由于立法政策而失去了所有的堕胎服务提供者，对人口生育率和堕胎率的影响仍然很小，因为大多数女性仍会前往有堕胎服务的州。

abstract.text: This paper examines the role of both cost-sharing schemes in health insurance systems and the regulation of entry into the pharmaceutical sector for pharmaceutical R&D expenditure and drug prices. The analysis suggests that both an increase in the coinsurance rate and stricter price regulations adversely affect R&D spending in the pharmaceutical sector. In contrast, entry deregulation may lead to higher R&D spending of pharmaceutical companies. The relationship between R&D spending per firm and the number of firms may be hump-shaped. In this case, the number of rivals which maximizes R&D expenditure per firm is decreasing in the coinsurance rate and increasing in labor productivity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.06.001.abstractZh: 本文探讨了健康保险系统中的费用分担机制以及药品研发支出和药品价格监管对药品行业的影响。分析表明，共同承担费用率的提高和更严格的价格监管都会对药品行业的研发支出产生负面影响。相反，药品行业的准入管制放松可能会促进药品公司的研发支出。单个公司的研发支出与公司数量之间的关系可能呈现驼峰型分布。在这种情况下，共同承担费用率上升和劳动生产率提高时，能够最大化单个公司研发支出的竞争对手数量会减少。

abstract.text: Uganda is widely viewed as a public health success for curtailing its HIV/AIDS epidemic in the early 1990s. The period of rapid HIV decline coincided with a dramatic rise in girls' secondary school enrollment. We instrument for this enrollment with distance to school, conditional on a rich set of demographic and locational controls, including distance to market center. We find that girls' enrollment in secondary education significantly increased the likelihood of abstaining from sex. Using a triple-difference estimator, we find that some of the schooling increase among young women was in response to a 1990 affirmative action policy giving women an advantage over men on University applications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.06.002.abstractZh: 乌干达被广泛认为是20世纪90年代初控制HIV/AIDS流行取得的公共卫生成就。HIV感染率迅速下降的时期，与女孩进入中学的比例急剧上升相吻合。我们通过距离学校的距离作为这一变化的工具变量，并基于一系列人口统计和地理位置控制变量，包括距离市场中心的距离。研究发现，女孩进入中学的比例显著增加了她们避免性行为的可能性。利用三重差分估计方法，我们发现年轻女性受教育程度提高的部分原因是由于1990年实施的平权行动政策，使得女性在大学申请中比男性具有优势。

abstract.text: Parental involvement (PI) laws require that physicians notify or obtain consent from a parent(s) of a minor seeking an abortion before performing the procedure. Several studies suggest that PI laws curb risky sexual behavior because teens realize that they would be compelled to discuss a subsequent pregnancy with a parent. We show that prior evidence based on gonorrhea rates overlooked the frequent under-reporting of gonorrhea by race and ethnicity, and present new evidence on the effects of PI laws using more current data on the prevalence of gonorrhea and data that are novel to this literature (i.e., chlamydia rates and data disaggregated by year of age). We improve the credibility of our estimates over those in the existing literature using an event-study design in addition to standard difference-in-difference-in-differences (DDD) models. Our findings consistently suggest no association between PI laws and rates of sexually transmitted infections or measures of sexual behavior.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.06.003.abstractZh: 家长参与法律要求医生在为未成年人进行堕胎手术前，必须通知其家长或获得家长的同意。多项研究表明，家长参与法律能够抑制高风险性行为，因为青少年意识到如果不与家长讨论后续怀孕的问题，他们可能会面临法律约束。我们的研究指出，现有的基于淋病发病率的统计数据忽略了不同种族和族裔群体中对淋病的频繁漏报现象。我们基于更最新的淋病发病率数据，以及该领域的新数据（如衣原体感染率及按年龄分组的统计数据），提出了关于家长参与法律影响的新证据。通过使用事件研究设计，并结合标准的差异-差异-差异模型，我们提高了估计结果的可信度。我们的研究结果一致表明，家长参与法律与性传播感染率或性行为指标之间不存在关联。

abstract.text: Hospital readmission rates are increasingly used as signals of hospital performance and a basis for hospital reimbursement. However, their interpretation may be complicated by differential patient survival rates. If patient characteristics are not perfectly observable and hospitals differ in their mortality rates, then hospitals with low mortality rates are likely to have a larger share of un-observably sicker patients at risk of a readmission. Their performance on readmissions will then be underestimated. We examine hospitals' performance relaxing the assumption of independence between mortality and readmissions implicitly adopted in many empirical applications. We use data from the Hospital Episode Statistics on emergency admissions for fractured hip in 290,000 patients aged 65 and over from 2003 to 2008 in England. We find evidence of sample selection bias that affects inference from traditional models. We use a bivariate sample selection model to allow for the selection process and the dichotomous nature of the outcome variables.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.06.004.abstractZh: 医院再次入院率越来越多地被用作医院绩效的指标和医院报销的依据。然而，由于患者存活率的差异，其解读可能会变得复杂。如果患者的特征并非完全可观测，且不同医院之间的死亡率存在差异，那么死亡率较低的医院可能会拥有更多病情较重的患者，这些患者面临再次入院的风险。在这种情况下，这些医院在再次入院方面的表现可能会被低估。我们研究了放宽许多实证应用中隐含的死亡率与再次入院之间独立性假设的医院绩效。我们使用了2003年至2008年英格兰65岁及以上患者因髋部骨折而急诊入院的医院病例统计数据。我们发现存在样本选择偏差，这影响了传统模型的推断结果。我们采用了双变量样本选择模型，以考虑选择过程以及结果变量的二分性质。

abstract.text: Medicaid provides health insurance for 54 million Americans. Using the Census Bureau's Supplemental Poverty Measure (which subtracts out-of-pocket medical expenses from family resources), we estimated the impact of eliminating Medicaid. In our counterfactual, Medicaid beneficiaries would become uninsured or gain other insurance. Counterfactual medical expenditures were drawn stochastically from propensity-score-matched individuals without Medicaid. While this method captures the importance of risk protection, it likely underestimates Medicaid's impact due to unobserved differences between Medicaid and non-Medicaid individuals. Nonetheless, we find that Medicaid reduces out-of-pocket medical spending from $871 to $376 per beneficiary, and decreases poverty rates by 1.0% among children, 2.2% among disabled adults, and 0.7% among elderly individuals. When factoring in institutionalized populations, an additional 500,000 people were kept out of poverty. Overall, Medicaid kept at least 2.6 million-and as many as 3.4 million-out of poverty in 2010, making it the U.S.'s third largest anti-poverty program.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.06.005.abstractZh: 医疗补助为5400万美国人提供健康保险。利用人口普查局补充贫困衡量指标（该指标从家庭资源中扣除自付医疗费用），我们估算了取消医疗补助的影响。在反事实假设下，医疗补助受益人将失去保险或获得其他保险。反事实下的医疗支出是从没有医疗补助的 propensity-score匹配个体中随机选取的。虽然这种方法体现了风险保护的重要性，但由于医疗补助与非医疗补助个体之间存在未观察到的差异，这种方法可能低估了医疗补助的影响。尽管如此，我们发现医疗补助将每位受益人的自付医疗费用从871美元降至376美元，并将儿童的贫困率降低1.0%，残疾成年人的贫困率降低2.2%，老年人的贫困率降低0.7%。考虑到被机构收容的人群，还有额外50万人摆脱了贫困。总体而言，医疗补助在2010年至少使260万人以及多达340万人摆脱贫困，使其成为美国第三大反贫困计划。

abstract.text: We study the Medicare Part D prescription drug insurance program as a bellwether for designs of private, non-mandatory health insurance markets, focusing on the ability of consumers to evaluate and optimize their choices of plans. Our analysis of administrative data on medical claims in Medicare Part D suggests that fewer than 25% of individuals enroll in plans that are ex ante as good as the least cost plan specified by the Plan Finder tool made available to seniors by the Medicare administration, and that consumers on average have expected excess spending of about $300 per year, or about 15% of expected total out-of-pocket cost for drugs and Part D insurance. These numbers are hard to reconcile with decision costs alone; it appears that unless a sizeable fraction of consumers place large values on plan features other than cost, they are not optimizing effectively.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.06.006.abstractZh: 我们研究了Medicare Part D处方药保险计划，将其作为私人、非强制性的健康保险市场设计的风向标，重点关注消费者评估和优化选择计划的能力。我们对Medicare Part D医疗索赔的行政数据分析表明，只有不到25%的参与者选择那些与Medicare管理部门为老年人提供的Plan Finder工具所推荐的最低成本计划相当的计划。平均而言，消费者预计每年会有约300美元的额外支出，这大约占药物和Part D保险预期总自付成本的15%。这些数字很难仅与决策成本相调和；除非相当一部分消费者重视除成本之外的计划特性，否则他们实际上并没有实现最优选择。

abstract.text: For the affluent elderly, continuing care retirement communities (CCRCs) have become a popular option for long term care and other health care needs related to aging. While CCRCs have experienced significant growth over the last few decades, very little is known about the quality of care CCRCs provide. This paper is the first to rigorously study CCRCs on a national scale and the only study that focuses on nursing home quality. Using a national sample from 2005, we determine if the quality of post-acute care provided by CCRC nursing homes is superior to traditional nursing homes. To mimic randomization of patients, instrumental variables analysis is used with relative distance as an exclusion restriction to handle the endogeneity of the type of facility where care is provided. After adjusting for endogeniety, we find that CCRC nursing homes provide post-acute care quality that is similar or lower to traditional nursing homes, depending on the quality measure.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.06.007.abstractZh: 对于经济条件较好的老年人来说，持续护理退休社区已成为满足长期护理及其他与老龄化相关的健康护理需求的流行选择。尽管持续护理退休社区在过去几十年中取得了显著发展，但关于这些社区所提供的护理质量，我们知之甚少。本文首次在全国范围内对持续护理退休社区进行了深入研究，也是唯一一项专注于养老院护理质量的研究。通过2005年的全国样本数据，我们探讨了持续护理退休社区中的养老院所提供的术后护理质量是否优于传统养老院。为了模拟患者的随机分配情况，本研究采用了工具变量分析方法，并以相对距离作为排除限制条件，以处理护理提供机构类型的内生性问题。在调整了内生性问题后，我们发现，持续护理退休社区中的养老院所提供的术后护理质量，根据所采用的质量衡量标准，要么与传统养老院相当，要么更低。

abstract.text: Employment-contingent health insurance may create incentives for ill workers to remain employed at a sufficient level (usually full-time) to maintain access to health insurance coverage. We study employed married women, comparing the labor supply responses to new breast cancer diagnoses of women dependent on their own employment for health insurance with the responses of women who are less dependent on their own employment for health insurance, because of actual or potential access to health insurance through their spouse's employer. We find evidence that women who depend on their own job for health insurance reduce their labor supply by less after a diagnosis of breast cancer. In the estimates that best control for unobservables associated with health insurance status, the hours reduction for women who continue to work is 8 to 11% smaller. Women's subjective responses to questions about working more to maintain health insurance are consistent with the conclusions from observed behavior.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.06.008.abstractZh: 基于就业条件的健康保险可能会激励患病工人保持足够的就业状态（通常是全职），以维持健康保险覆盖。我们研究了已婚女性的就业情况，比较了那些依赖自身就业获取健康保险的女性的劳动力供给反应，与那些因配偶雇主的实际或潜在健康保险覆盖而减少依赖自身就业的女性的反应。我们发现，依赖自身就业获取健康保险的女性在乳腺癌诊断后减少劳动力供给的程度要小一些。在能够控制与健康保险状态相关的不可观测因素的估计中，继续工作的女性减少的工时幅度要小8%到11%。女性对为了维持健康保险而增加工作的主观反应与观察到的行为结果一致。

abstract.text: The usual starting point for understanding changes in income-related health inequality (IRHI) over time has been regression-based decomposition procedures for the health concentration index. However the reliance on repeated cross-sectional analysis for this purpose prevents both the appropriate specification of the health function as a dynamic model and the identification of important determinants of the transition processes underlying IRHI changes such as those relating to mortality. This paper overcomes these limitations by developing alternative longitudinal procedures to analyse the role of health determinants in driving changes in IRHI through both morbidity changes and mortality, with our dynamic modelling framework also serving to identify their contribution to long-run or structural IRHI. The approach is illustrated by an empirical analysis of the causes of the increase in IRHI in Great Britain between 1999 and 2004.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.07.001.abstractZh: 理解收入相关健康不平等随时间变化的一般起点是采用基于回归的分解程序来研究健康集中指数。然而，这种依赖重复的横断面分析的方法，既无法正确设定作为动态模型的健康函数，也无法识别导致健康不平等变化的重要决定因素，比如与死亡率相关的因素。本文通过开发替代的纵向分析程序来克服这些限制，以研究健康决定因素如何通过发病率变化和死亡率变化来推动健康不平等的变化，同时我们的动态建模框架也有助于识别这些决定因素对长期或结构性健康不平等的贡献。该方法通过英国1999年至2004年间健康不平等增加原因的实证分析得到了验证。

abstract.text: Research in the health sciences reports persistent racial differences in health care access, utilization, and outcomes. This study investigates three potential sources of these disparities - differential quality of care, physician discrimination, and patient response to therapy. It uses a unique panel dataset of physician-patient encounters, the resulting medication therapies and the patients' adherence to those medical recommendations. Equalizing access to quality health care will not erase the racial differences in mortality among chronically ill patients. Targeted programs aimed at improving adherence with medication therapy among disadvantaged groups must be an integral part of any policy aimed at achieving equality in health outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.07.002.abstractZh: 健康科学领域的研究表明，在医疗保健的获取、利用以及治疗效果方面，种族间存在持续的差异。本研究探讨了这些差异的三种潜在来源：医疗质量的差异、医生歧视以及患者对治疗的反应。该研究使用了独特的医生-患者互动数据面板，包括由此产生的药物治疗以及患者对这些医疗建议的遵守情况。尽管平等获得高质量的医疗保健，但并不能消除慢性病患者中存在的种族差异导致的死亡率差异。针对弱势群体的药物治疗依从性改善计划，必须成为任何旨在实现健康结果平等的政策的重要组成部分。

abstract.text: This study investigates the lasting health effects of leaving school in a bad economy. Three empirical patterns motivate this study: Leaving school in a bad economy has persistent and negative career effects, career and health outcomes are correlated, and fluctuations in contemporaneous economic conditions affect health in the short-run. I draw data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 Age 40 Health Supplement. Members of my sample left school between 1976 and 1992. I find that men who left school when the school-leaving state unemployment rate was high have worse health at age 40 than otherwise similar men, while leaving school in a bad economy lowers depressive symptoms at age 40 among women. A 1 percentage point increase in the school-leaving state unemployment rate leads to a 0.5% to 18% reduction in the measured health outcomes among men and a 6% improvement in depressive symptoms among women.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.07.003.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了在经济不景气时期辍学对健康影响的长期影响。研究基于以下三个实证发现：在经济不景气时期辍学会导致持续的负面职业影响；职业状况与健康状况之间存在相关性；同时期的经济波动会在短期内影响健康。我采用1979年《全国青年纵向调查》40岁健康补充数据作为研究依据。样本中的个体在1976年至1992年间辍学。研究发现，在失业率较高的时期辍学的男性，在40岁时的健康状况比其他同龄男性要差；而在经济不景气时期辍学的女性，在40岁时的抑郁症状有所减轻。学校辍学状态下失业率每上升1个百分点，男性健康指标的下降幅度为0.5%至18%，而女性抑郁症状的改善幅度为6%。

abstract.text: Many countries are moving from employer-based to universal health coverage, which can generate crowd out. In Mexico, Seguro Popular provides public health coverage to the uninsured. Using the gradual roll-out of the system at the municipality level, we estimate that Seguro Popular had no effect on informality in the overall population.
