Informality did increase by 1.7% for less educated workers, but the wage gains for workers who switch between the formal and the informal sector were not significantly affected. This suggests that marginal workers do not choose between formal and informal jobs on the basis of health insurance coverage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.07.004.abstractZh: 许多国家正在从以雇主为基础的医疗体系转向全民健康保险制度，这可能会引发就业市场的挤出效应。在墨西哥，Seguro Popular为未参加保险的人群提供公共健康保障。通过逐步在市级层面实施该制度，我们估计Seguro Popular对整体人口的非正式就业状况没有显著影响。不过，受教育程度较低的工人的非正式就业比例确实增加了1.7%，但那些在正式与非正式部门之间转换的工人的工资增长并未受到显著影响。这表明，边缘劳动者并不会基于健康保险覆盖情况来选择正式或非正式的工作。

abstract.text: Although a positive association is found between HIV prevalence and intimate partner violence, a causal interpretation is hard to establish due to the endogeneity of HIV prevalence. Using the distance from the origin of the virus as an instrument, I find that an exogenous increase in HIV prevalence in a cluster has a sizable positive effect on the risk of physical and sexual violence against women within marriage. The results of this study confirm a gender-specific negative externality of the disease and encourage policy efforts to incorporate services for violence against women into existing HIV programs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.07.005.abstractZh: 尽管发现HIV感染率与亲密伴侣暴力之间存在正相关关系，但由于HIV感染率的内生性，很难确立因果关系。通过使用病毒起源距离作为工具变量，我发现，某一地区HIV感染率的外部增加会对婚姻内针对女性的身体和性暴力风险产生显著的正面影响。本研究的结果证实了该疾病对性别具有的负面外部性，并鼓励政策努力将针对女性暴力的服务纳入现有的HIV防控计划中。

abstract.text: We examine the role of early childhood health in human capital accumulation. Using a unique data set from Ghana with comprehensive information on individual, family, community, school quality characteristics and a direct measure of intelligence together with test scores, we examine the long-term cognitive effects of the 1983 famine on survivors. We show that differences in intelligence test scores can be robustly explained by the differential impact of the famine in different parts of the country and the impacts are most severe for children under two years of age during the famine. We also account for model uncertainty by using Bayesian Model Averaging.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.08.001.abstractZh: 我们研究了早期儿童健康在人力资本积累中的作用。利用来自加纳的独特数据集，该数据集包含了关于个人、家庭、社区、学校质量特征的全面信息，以及直接的智力测量数据和测试成绩，我们研究了1983年饥荒对幸存者长期认知影响的研究。我们发现，智力测试成绩的差异可以通过饥荒在不同地区的影响来稳健地解释，而这一影响在饥荒期间对两岁以下的儿童最为严重。我们还通过贝叶斯模型平均法来考虑模型的不确定性。

abstract.text: From 2004 to 2006, a community-based health insurance (CBI) scheme was rolled out in Nouna District, Burkina Faso, with the objective of improving access to health services and population health. We explore the random timing of the insurance rollout generated by the stepped wedge cluster-randomized design to evaluate the welfare and health impact of the insurance program. Our results suggest that the insurance had limited effects on average out-of-pocket expenditures in the target areas, but substantially reduced the likelihood of catastrophic health expenditure. The introduction of the insurance scheme did not have any effect on health outcomes for children and young adults, but appears to have increased mortality among individuals aged 65 and older. The negative health effects of the program appear to be primarily driven by the adverse provider incentives generated by the scheme and the resulting decline in the quality of care received by patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.08.003.abstractZh: 在2004年至2006年间，布基纳法索的努纳区实施了基于社区的医疗保险计划，旨在改善人们对医疗服务的获取以及民众的健康状况。我们通过逐步楔形群随机设计方法，研究了该保险计划实施的随机时机，以评估其福利和健康影响。研究结果表明，该保险计划对目标地区的平均自付费用产生了有限的影响，但显著降低了灾难性医疗支出的可能性。该保险计划的实施对儿童和年轻人健康结果没有显著影响，但似乎增加了65岁及以上人群的死亡率。该计划带来的负面健康影响主要源于该计划引发的医疗服务提供者的不利激励，以及由此导致的患者接受医疗服务质量的下降。

abstract.text: We estimate causal effects of breast and colorectal cancer on labour market outcomes 1-3 years after the diagnosis. Based on Danish administrative data we estimate average treatment effects on the treated by propensity score weighting methods using persons with no cancer diagnosis as control group. We conduct robustness checks using matching, difference-in-differences methods and an alternative control group of later cancer patients. The different methods give approximately the same results. Cancer increases the risks of leaving the labour force and receiving disability pension, and the effects are larger for the less educated. Effects on income are small and mostly insignificant. We investigate some of the mechanisms which may be important in explaining the educational gradient in effects of cancer on labour market attachment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.08.004.abstractZh: 我们估计了乳腺癌和结直肠癌在诊断后1-3年内对劳动力市场结果的影响。基于丹麦的行政数据，我们使用倾向得分加权方法估计了治疗组的平均处理效应，并将未患癌症的人作为对照组。我们通过匹配、差异-差异方法和另一种替代对照组（即后期患癌患者）进行了稳健性检验。不同的方法得出的结果大致相同。癌症增加了退出劳动力市场和领取残疾养老金的风险，且这种影响在受教育程度较低的人群中更为显著。对收入的影响较小，且大多不显著。我们研究了一些可能在解释癌症对劳动力市场影响的教育梯度方面起重要作用的机制。

abstract.text: We conduct an applied welfare economics analysis of cigarette tax avoidance. We develop an extension of the standard formula for the optimal Pigouvian corrective tax to incorporate the possibility that consumers avoid the tax by making purchases in nearby lower tax jurisdictions. To provide a key parameter for our formula, we estimate a structural endogenous switching regression model of border-crossing and cigarette prices. In illustrative calculations, we find that for many states, after taking into account tax avoidance the optimal tax is at least 20% smaller than the standard Pigouvian tax that simply internalizes external costs. Our empirical estimate that tax avoidance strongly responds to the price differential is the main reason for this result. We also use our results to examine the benefits of replacing avoidable state excise taxes with a harder-to-avoid federal excise tax on cigarettes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.08.005.abstractZh: 我们对香烟税收规避行为进行了应用性福利经济学分析。我们扩展了标准公式，以纳入消费者通过选择在税收较低的邻近地区购买商品来规避税收的可能性。为了为我们的公式提供一个关键参数，我们建立了一个关于跨境行为和香烟价格的结构性内生切换回归模型。在示例计算中，我们发现对于许多州而言，考虑到税收规避行为后，最优税收至少比单纯内部化外部成本的标准皮古维税低20%。我们的实证结果表明，税收规避行为对价格差异的响应程度很高，这是这一结果的主要原因。我们还利用这些结果来探讨用更难以规避的联邦香烟消费税替代可规避的州消费税所带来的好处。

abstract.text: It is well-known that expected utility (EU) has empirical deficiencies. Cumulative prospect theory (CPT) has developed as an alternative with more descriptive validity. However, CPT's full function had not yet been quantified in the health domain. This paper is therefore the first to simultaneously measure utility of life duration, probability weighting, and loss aversion in this domain. We observe loss aversion and risk aversion for gains and losses, which for gains can be explained by probabilistic pessimism. Utility for gains is almost linear. For losses, we find less weighting of probability 1/2 and concave utility. This contrasts with the common finding of convex utility for monetary losses. However, CPT was proposed to explain choices among lotteries involving monetary outcomes. Life years are arguably very different from monetary outcomes and need not generate convex utility for losses. Moreover, utility of life duration reflects discounting, causing concave utility.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.08.006.abstractZh: 众所周知，期望效用存在实证上的缺陷。累积前景理论作为一种替代理论，具有更明确的描述性有效性。然而，累积前景理论的完整功能在健康领域尚未被量化。因此，本文首次在同一领域同时测量了生命持续时间的效用、概率权重和损失厌恶。我们观察到，对于收益和损失，都存在损失厌恶和风险厌恶，而收益方面的损失厌恶可以通过概率性悲观来解释。收益效用几乎是线性的。对于损失，我们发现概率权重为1/2，且效用呈凹形。这与货币损失通常呈现凸形效用的常见发现不同。不过，累积前景理论最初是为了解释涉及货币结果的彩票选择而提出的。生命年限与货币结果有很大不同，因此损失情况不一定会产生凸形效用。此外，生命持续时间的效用反映了折现效应，从而导致凹形效用。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between schizophrenia and employment. We use longitudinal register data and show a considerable drop in the employment rate for people with schizophrenia six years before the first treatment at a psychiatric facility. After the first treatment, the employment rate stabilizes at 18%. The difference in the employment rate in 2007 for siblings with and without schizophrenia is estimated at 67%. This difference is reduced to 62% when we include additional control variables. The results remain unchanged when we apply a sibling fixed effects approach that controls for the unobserved family specific characteristics that the siblings share.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.08.007.abstractZh: 本文探讨了精神分裂症与就业之间的关系。我们使用了纵向登记数据，发现精神分裂症患者在接受精神科机构首次治疗前的六年内，就业率显著下降。首次治疗后，就业率稳定在18%。2007年，有精神分裂症和没有精神分裂症的兄弟姐妹之间的就业率差异估计为67%。当纳入其他控制变量后，这一差异降至62%。当采用控制兄弟姐妹共同拥有的家庭特定特征的固定效应模型时，研究结果保持不变。

abstract.text: This paper investigates physician altruism toward patients' health benefit using behavioral data from Hennig-Schmidt et al.'s (2011) laboratory experiment. In the experiment, medical students in the role of physicians decide on the provision of medical services. The experimental setup allows us to identify the influence of profits and patients' health benefit on the choice of medical treatment. We estimate physician altruism, the weight individuals attach to patients' health benefit, by fitting mixed logit and multinomial logit regression models to the experimental data. Estimation results provide evidence for physician altruism. We find, however, substantial variation in the degree of physician altruism. We also discuss some implications of our results for the design of physician payment schemes in the light of the theoretical literature.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.08.008.abstractZh: 本文利用Hennig-Schmidt等人（2011年）实验室实验中的行为数据，研究了医生对患者健康利益的利他行为。在实验中，以医生身份出现的医学生负责决定提供医疗服务。实验设置使我们能够识别利润与患者健康利益对医疗选择的影响。我们通过将混合逻辑模型和多项逻辑回归模型应用于实验数据，来估计医生的利他行为，即个体对病人健康利益的重视程度。估计结果支持了医生利他行为的存在。然而，我们发现医生利他行为的程度存在显著差异。我们还讨论了这些结果对医生薪酬制度设计的一些启示，这些启示基于相关理论文献。

abstract.text: This paper uses data from the 1970 British Cohort Study to quantify the intergenerational persistence of mental health, and the long-run economic costs associated with poor parental mental health. We find a strong and significant intergenerational correlation that is robust to different covariate sets, sample restrictions, model specifications and potential endogeneity. Importantly, the intergenerational persistence is economically relevant, with maternal mental health associated with lasting effects on the child's educational attainment, future household income and the probability of having criminal convictions. These results do not disappear after controlling for children's own childhood and adulthood mental health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.001.abstractZh: 本文利用1970年英国队列研究的数据，量化了心理健康状况的代际持续性，以及父母心理健康状况不佳所带来的长期经济成本。我们发现，这种代际相关性非常显著，且不受不同的协变量设置、样本限制、模型规格以及潜在内生性因素的影响。重要的是，这种代际持续性在经济上具有重要意义：母亲的健康状况会对孩子未来的教育成就、家庭收入以及犯罪定罪的可能性产生持久影响。即使在控制了儿童自身的童年和成年期心理健康状况后，这些结果仍然成立。

abstract.text: Do sudden, large wealth losses affect mental health? We use exogenous variation in the interview dates of the 2008 Health and Retirement Study to assess the impact of large wealth losses on mental health among older U.S. adults. We compare cross-wave changes in wealth and mental health for respondents interviewed before and after the October 2008 stock market crash. We find that the crash reduced wealth and increased feelings of depression and use of antidepressant drugs, and that these effects were largest among respondents with high levels of stock holdings prior to the crash. These results suggest that sudden wealth losses cause immediate declines in subjective measures of mental health. However, we find no evidence that wealth losses lead to increases in clinically-validated measures of depressive symptoms or indicators of depression.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.002.abstractZh: 突然的巨大财富损失是否会影响心理健康？我们利用2008年健康与退休研究中的访谈日期的随机变化，来评估巨大财富损失对美国老年人心理健康的影响。我们比较了2008年10月股市崩盘前后受访者的财富和心理健康状况的变化。研究发现，股市崩盘导致财富减少，同时增加了抑郁感和使用抗抑郁药物的情况，而这些影响在之前持有大量股票的人群中最为明显。这些结果表明，突然的财富损失会导致心理健康主观指标的立即下降。然而，我们没有发现财富损失会导致临床验证的抑郁症状或抑郁指标上升的证据。

abstract.text: The CMS-HCC risk adjustment system for Medicare Advantage (MA) plans calculates weights, which are effectively relative prices, for beneficiaries with different observable characteristics. To do so it uses the relative amounts spent per beneficiary with those characteristics in Traditional Medicare (TM). For multiple reasons one might expect relative amounts in MA to differ from TM, thereby making some beneficiaries more profitable to treat than others. Much of the difference comes from differences in how TM and MA treat different diseases or diagnoses. Using data on actual medical spending from two MA-HMO plans, we show that the weights calculated from MA costs do indeed differ from those calculated using TM spending. One of the two plans (Plan 1) is more typical of MA-HMO plans in that it contracts with independent community providers, while the other (Plan 2) is vertically integrated with care delivery. We calculate margins, or average revenue/average cost, for Medicare beneficiaries in the two plans who have one of 48 different combinations of medical conditions. The two plans' margins for these 48 conditions are correlated (r=0.39, p<0.01). Both plans have margins that are more positive for persons with conditions that are managed by primary care physicians and where medical management can be effective. Conversely they have lower margins for persons with conditions that tend to be treated by specialists with greater market power than primary care physicians and for acute conditions where little medical management is possible. The two plan's margins among beneficiaries with different observable characteristics vary over a range of 160 and 98 percentage points, respectively, and thus would appear to offer substantial incentive for selection by HCC. Nonetheless, we find no evidence of overrepresentation of beneficiaries in high margin HCC's in either plan. Nor, using the margins from Plan 1, the more typical plan, do we find evidence of overrepresentation of high margin HCC's in Medicare more generally. These results do not permit a conclusion on overall social efficiency, but we note that selection according to margin could be socially efficient. In addition, our findings suggest there are omitted interaction terms in the risk adjustment model that Medicare currently uses.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.003.abstractZh: CMS-HCC风险调整系统用于计算Medicare Advantage计划的权重，这些权重实际上代表了具有不同可观察特征的受益人的相对价格。为此，该系统使用了传统Medicare计划中具有相同特征受益人的相对支出金额。由于多种原因，预计Medicare Advantage中的相对支出金额会与传统Medicare有所不同，因此某些受益人的治疗成本可能会高于其他人。这种差异主要源于传统Medicare和Medicare Advantage在对待不同疾病或诊断方面的处理方式不同。通过对比两个Medicare Advantage-HMO计划的实际医疗支出数据，我们发现从Medicare Advantage成本计算出的权重确实与从传统Medicare支出计算出的权重有所不同。其中一项计划（计划1）更典型地代表了Medicare Advantage-HMO计划，因为它与独立的社区医疗服务提供者合作，而另一项计划（计划2）则实现了医疗服务的垂直整合。我们计算了这两项计划中患有48种不同医疗状况的受益人的边际利润或平均收入/平均成本。这48种状况的边际利润在两项计划中存在相关性（r=0.39，p<0.01）。两项计划对于由初级保健医生管理且医疗管理有效的状况，其边际利润都较高。相反，对于需要由市场力量较大的专科医生治疗的状况，以及对于无法进行有效医疗管理的急性状况，两项计划的边际利润较低。具有不同可观察特征的受益人的两项计划边际利润相差160至98个百分点，因此似乎为HCC的选择提供了显著的激励。然而，我们并未发现任何证据表明，在利润较高的高利润率医疗计划中，受益者的比例存在过度代表现象。同样，使用利润较高的典型计划——计划1的数据，我们也未能发现医疗保险中高利润率医疗计划的受益者比例存在过度代表的现象。这些结果并不能直接推断出整体社会效率如何，但我们注意到，根据利润来选拔参与者可能是符合社会效率的。此外，我们的研究还表明，医疗保险目前使用的风险调整模型中存在被忽略的交互项。

abstract.text: Bidding has been proposed to replace or complement the administered prices that Medicare pays to hospitals and health plans. In 2006, the Medicare Advantage program implemented a competitive bidding system to determine plan payments. In perfectly competitive models, plans bid their costs and thus bids are insensitive to the benchmark. Under many other models of competition, bids respond to changes in the benchmark. We conceptualize the bidding system and use an instrumental variable approach to study the effect of benchmark changes on bids. We use 2006-2010 plan payment data from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, published county benchmarks, actual realized fee-for-service costs, and Medicare Advantage enrollment. We find that a $1 increase in the benchmark leads to about a $0.53 increase in bids, suggesting that plans in the Medicare Advantage market have meaningful market power.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.004.abstractZh: 有人提议采用竞标机制来替代或补充Medicare向医院和健康计划支付的行政定价方式。2006年，Medicare Advantage计划实施了竞标系统以确定计划支付金额。在完全竞争模型中，各计划会提出自己的成本报价，因此竞标结果对基准价格并不敏感。而在许多其他竞争模型中，竞标会响应基准价格的变化。我们构建了竞标系统的概念模型，并采用工具变量方法研究基准变化对竞标的影响。我们利用了Medicare和Medicaid服务中心提供的2006-2010年计划支付数据、公布的县级基准价格、实际的服务费用成本以及Medicare Advantage的注册情况。研究发现，基准价格每上涨1美元，竞标金额会相应增加约0.53美元，这表明Medicare Advantage市场的各计划具有显著的市场力量。

abstract.text: More than a quarter of Medicare beneficiaries are enrolled in Medicare Advantage, which was created in large part to improve the efficiency of health care delivery by promoting competition among private managed care plans. This paper explores the spillover effects of the Medicare Advantage program on the traditional Medicare program and other patients, taking advantage of changes in Medicare Advantage payment policy to isolate exogenous increases in Medicare Advantage enrollment and trace out the effects of greater managed care penetration on hospital utilization and spending throughout the health care system. We find that when more seniors enroll in Medicare managed care, hospital costs decline for all seniors and for commercially insured younger populations. Greater managed care penetration is not associated with fewer hospitalizations, but is associated with lower costs and shorter stays per hospitalization. These spillovers are substantial - offsetting more than 10% of increased payments to Medicare Advantage plans.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.005.abstractZh: 超过四分之一的医疗保险受益人参加了医疗保险优势计划，该计划主要是为了通过促进私人管理式护理计划之间的竞争来提高医疗服务的效率。本文探讨了医疗保险优势计划对传统医疗保险计划及其他患者产生的溢出效应，并利用医疗保险优势计划的支付政策变化来分离医疗保险优势计划参保人数的外生增长，并追踪更大程度的管理式护理普及对整个医疗系统的医院使用率和支出的影响。我们发现，当更多老年人参加医疗保险管理式护理时，所有老年人的医院费用以及商业保险覆盖的年轻人群的医院费用都会下降。更大的管理式护理普及并不导致住院次数减少，但会降低每次住院的费用和住院时间。这些溢出效应相当显著，足以抵消医疗保险优势计划支付增加的10%以上。

abstract.text: This study introduces a new framework for measuring and analyzing medical-care expenditures. The framework focuses on expenditures at the disease level that are decomposed between price and utilization. We find that both price and utilization differences are important contributors to expenditure differences across commercial markets. Further examination shows that for some diseases utilization drives variation while for others price is more important. Finally, when disease-specific measures are aggregated across diseases, much of the important disease-specific variation is masked, leading to much smaller measures of aggregate variation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.006.abstractZh: 本研究提出了一个用于衡量和分析医疗支出的新框架。该框架重点关注疾病层面的支出，并将支出分解为价格因素和利用因素。我们发现，价格因素和利用因素的差异都是导致不同商业市场之间支出差异的重要因素。进一步分析表明，对于某些疾病而言，利用因素起着主导作用，而对于另一些疾病则价格因素更为重要。最后，当将特定疾病的指标汇总到整个疾病类别时，许多重要的疾病特异性差异会被掩盖，从而导致总体变异指标大大减小。

abstract.text: This research utilizes a laboratory experiment to evaluate the effectiveness of alternative public policies targeted at increasing the rate of deceased donor organ donation. The experiment includes treatments across different default choices and organ allocation rules inspired by the donor registration systems applied in different countries. Our results indicate that the opt-out with priority rule system generates the largest increase in organ donation relative to an opt-in only program. However, sizeable gains are achievable using either a priority rule or opt-out program separately, with the opt-out rule generating approximately 80% of the benefits achieved under a priority rule program.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.007.abstractZh: 本研究通过实验室实验来评估旨在提高逝世捐赠者器官捐献率的替代性公共政策的有效性。实验包含了不同默认选择以及受各国器官分配系统启发的器官分配规则的各种处理方案。研究结果表明，采用优先规则的自选退出制度能够相对比单纯的自选加入制度实现更大的器官捐献增长。然而，单独使用优先规则或自选退出制度也能取得显著成效，其中自选退出制度所带来的效益约占优先规则制度的80%。

abstract.text: Understanding what drives households to seek medical services is challenging because the factors affecting the perceived benefits and costs of professional health care can be the same. In this paper, we disentangle the channels through which different factors affect the use of medical services, whether through perceived benefits and/or costs. We do this by exploiting data on why individuals have not visited a health care professional. Amongst a sample of impoverished Colombian households, we find that health knowledge reduces the use of medical services through decreasing mothers' perceived benefits of seeking professional care for ill children; birth parity, distance to health facilities and violent shocks all decrease medical care use due to increasing the perceived costs; and education decreases both the perceived benefits and costs, with no overall effect on use. We propose two specification tests, both of which our model passes, as well as a series of robustness checks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.008.abstractZh: 了解是什么驱动家庭寻求医疗服务是一项挑战，因为影响专业医疗保健感知收益和成本的因素可能是相同的。在本文中，我们梳理了不同因素通过感知收益和/或成本影响医疗服务使用的渠道。我们通过分析个体为何未寻求医疗专业服务的数据来进行分析。在一项针对贫困哥伦比亚家庭的样本中，我们发现健康知识通过降低母亲寻求专业护理以治疗患病孩子的感知收益，从而减少了对医疗服务的使用；出生次数、距离医疗机构的距离以及暴力冲击都会因增加感知成本而降低医疗服务的使用；而教育水平则同时降低了感知收益和成本，但对整体使用率没有显著影响。我们提出了两个模型验证测试，我们的模型均通过了这些测试，同时还进行了一系列稳健性检验。

abstract.text: We analyse stated preference data over nursing jobs collected from two different discrete choice experiments: a multi-profile case best-worst scaling experiment (BWS) prompting selection of the best and worst among alternative jobs, and a profile case BWS wherein the respondents choose the best and worst job attributes. The latter allows identification of additional utility parameters and is believed to be cognitively easier. Results suggest that respondents place greater value on pecuniary over non-pecuniary gains in the multi-profile case. There is little evidence that this discrepancy is induced by the extra cognitive burden of processing several profiles at once in the multi-profile case. We offer thoughts on other likely mechanisms.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.009.abstractZh: 我们分析了从两种不同离散选择实验中收集到的护理工作的偏好数据：一种是多偏好情况的最佳-最差排序实验（BWS），该实验要求受访者选择最佳和最差的工作；另一种是单偏好情况的最佳-最差排序实验，受访者在此情况下选择最佳和最差的工作属性。后一种实验有助于识别额外的效用参数，并且被认为在认知上更为简单。研究结果表明，在多偏好情况下，受访者更看重金钱上的收益而非非金钱收益。几乎没有证据表明这种差异是由多偏好情况下同时处理多个偏好所带来的额外认知负担所引发的。我们提出了其他可能的机制。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of U.S. states' adoption of the partnership long-term care (LTC) insurance program on households' purchases of private coverage. Targeting middle-class households, this program increases the benefits of privately insuring via a higher asset threshold for Medicaid eligibility for LTC coverage. We find that the program generates few new purchases of LTC insurance, and that those it generates are almost entirely by wealthy individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.010.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国各州长期护理保险计划的长期实施对家庭私人保险购买行为的影响。针对中产阶级家庭，该计划通过提高 Medicaid 资格所需的资产门槛，增加了私人保险的好处。我们发现，该计划几乎没有产生新的长期护理保险购买行为，而这些新购买的保险几乎全部由富裕个体购买。

abstract.text: Exploiting preintervention variation in mortality from various infectious diseases, together with the time variation arising from medical breakthroughs in the late 1940s and the 1950s, this study examines how a large positive shock to life expectancy influenced the formation of human capital within countries during the second half of the 20th century. The results establish that the rise in life expectancy was behind a significant part of the increase in human capital over this period. According to the baseline estimate, for one additional year of life expectancy, years of schooling increase by 0.17 year. Moreover, the evidence suggests that declines in pneumonia mortality are the underlying cause of this finding, indicating that improved childhood health increases human capital investments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.011.abstractZh: 本研究利用干预前各种传染病死亡率的变异，以及20世纪40年代末和50年代医学突破带来的时间变化，探讨了20世纪下半叶人类资本形成如何受到预期寿命大幅上升的积极影响。研究结果表明，预期寿命的上升是这一时期人类资本增长的重要驱动力。根据基线估计，每多一年预期寿命，受教育年限会增加0.17年。此外，研究数据表明，肺炎死亡率的下降是这一现象的根本原因，这说明儿童健康的改善能够增加对人类资本的投资。

abstract.text: Public providers have no financial incentive to respect their legal obligation to exempt the poor from user fees. Health Equity Funds (HEFs) aim to make exemptions effective by giving NGOs responsibility for assessing eligibility and compensating providers for lost revenue. We use the geographic spread of HEFs over time in Cambodia to identify their impact on out-of-pocket (OOP) payments. Among households with some OOP payment, HEFs reduce the amount paid by 35%, on average. The effect is larger for households that are poorer and mainly use public health care. Reimbursement of providers through a government operated scheme also reduces household OOP payments but the effect is not as well targeted on the poor. Both compensation models raise household non-medical consumption but have no impact on health-related debt. HEFs reduce the probability of primarily seeking care in the private sector.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.012.abstractZh: 公共提供者没有经济动机去履行其法律义务，即免除贫困人群的用户费用。健康公平基金旨在通过让非政府组织负责评估资格并补偿提供者因费用减免而损失的收入，来实现免除义务的有效性。我们通过观察柬埔寨健康公平基金随时间在地理上的分布，来研究其对个人支付额的影响。在有一定个人支付能力的家庭中，健康公平基金平均减少了35%的支付金额。对于较贫困且主要依赖公共医疗保健的家庭来说，这种影响更为显著。通过政府运营的补偿机制来偿还提供者的费用也能减少家庭的个人支付额，但这一措施对贫困人群的影响并不明显。这两种补偿模式都会增加家庭的非医疗消费，但不会对与健康相关的债务产生影响。健康公平基金还降低了家庭主要寻求私人部门医疗服务的可能性。

abstract.text: This study analyses the effect of a change in the remuneration system for physicians on the treatment lengths as measured by the number of doctor visits using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel over the period 1995-2002. Specifically, I analyse the introduction of a remuneration cap (so called practice budgets) for physicians who treat publicly insured patients in 1997. I find evidence that the reform of 1997 did not change the extensive margin of doctor visits but strongly affected the intensive margin. The conditional number of doctor visits among publicly insured decreased while it increased among privately insured. This can be seen as evidence that physicians respond to the change in incentives induced by the reform by altering their patient mix.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.09.013.abstractZh: 本研究通过分析1995-2002年期间德国社会经济面板数据，探讨医生薪酬制度变化对就诊时长的影响。具体而言，我们研究了1997年对治疗公共保险患者的医生实施薪酬上限（所谓的执业预算）这一改革措施。研究发现，1997年的改革并未改变就诊次数的总体范围，但显著影响了就诊次数的密集程度。公共保险患者的就诊次数减少，而私人保险患者的就诊次数增加。这表明，医生会根据改革带来的激励变化调整其患者组合。

abstract.text: In recent decades, China has experienced double-digit economic growth rates and rising inequality. This paper implements a new decomposition approach using the China Health and Nutrition Survey (1991-2006) to examine the extent to which changes in level and distribution of incomes and in income mobility are related to health disparities between rich and poor. We find that health disparities in China relate to rising income inequality and in particular to the adverse health and income experience of older (wo)men, but not to the growth rate of average incomes over the last decades. These findings suggest that replacement incomes and pensions at older ages may be one of the most important policy levers for reducing health disparities between rich and poor Chinese.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.10.002.abstractZh: 近几十年来，中国经历了两位数的经济增长率以及不平等现象的加剧。本文采用中国健康与营养调查数据（1991-2006年）实施了一种新的分解方法，以研究收入水平和分布的变化以及收入流动性变化与贫富之间健康差异之间的关联程度。研究发现，中国的健康差异与收入不平等的加剧有关，尤其是与老年女性的健康和收入状况不佳有关，但与过去几十年平均收入的增长率无关。这些发现表明，在老年时期提供替代收入和养老金可能是减少中国贫富之间健康差异的重要政策手段之一。

abstract.text: Classic preference reversal, where choice and valuation procedures generate inconsistent preference orderings, has rarely been tested in hypothetical health care treatment scenarios. Two studies - the first non-incentivised and the second incentivised - are reported in this article. In both studies, respondents are asked to make decisions that affect themselves (a personal decision making frame) and those for whom they are responsible (a social decision making frame). The results show non-negligible and systematic rates of preference reversal in both frames, although these rates are slightly, but non-significantly, lower in the incentivised condition. Moreover, in both studies, the rate of predicted preference reversal was somewhat higher in the social than in the personal decision making frame, a finding that is explained by greater risk aversion when choosing treatment options for others than when choosing treatments for oneself.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.10.003.abstractZh: 在假设性的医疗保健治疗场景中，经典偏好反转现象——即选择和评估程序导致不一致的偏好排序——很少被研究。本文报道了两项研究：第一项研究没有激励因素，第二项研究则包含了激励因素。在这两项研究中，受访者需要做出影响自身（个人决策框架）和他人（社会决策框架）的决策。研究结果显示，两种决策框架下偏好反转的发生率均不可忽视且具有系统性，不过在有激励因素的情况下，这些发生率略低，但差异并不显著。此外，在两项研究中，社会决策框架下预测的偏好反转率略高于个人决策框架，这一发现可以解释为：在为他人选择治疗方案时，人们面临的风险厌恶程度高于为自己选择治疗方案时。

abstract.text: Using administrative data from Norway, we examine the extent to which family doctors influence their clients' propensity to claim sick-pay. The analysis exploits exogenous switches of family doctors occurring when physicians quit, retire, or for other reasons sell their patient lists. We find that family doctors have significant influence on their clients' absence behavior, particularly on absence duration. Their influence is stronger in geographical areas with weaker competition between physicians. We conclude that it is possible for family doctors to contain sick-pay expenditures to some extent, and that there is a considerable variation in the way they perform this task.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2013.10.005.abstractZh: 我们利用挪威的行政数据，研究家庭医生在多大程度上影响客户申请病假的行为。分析发现，当家庭医生因辞职、退休或其他原因出售患者名单时，会出现一些外生性的变化。我们发现，家庭医生对客户的缺勤行为有显著的影响，尤其是在缺勤持续时间方面。在竞争较弱的地理区域，家庭医生的影响力更为明显。我们得出结论，家庭医生在一定程度上能够控制病假支出，而且他们在执行这一任务的方式上存在相当大的差异。

abstract.text: It is folklore among monetary theorists that, under laissez faire, without ad hoc assumptions that favor money over bonds, there do not exist equilibria in which government-issued fiat money coexists with nominal default-free, interest-bearing government bonds with similar physical characteristics. This proposition is the basis for the strongest version of the rate-of-return-dominance puzzle. In this paper I show that if--as has been the case throughout monetary history--the physical object used as fiat money is heterogeneous in an extraneous attribute, then there exist equilibria in which money coexists with interest-bearing bonds.

10.1086/669681.abstractZh: 在货币理论家中，有一种普遍的说法，即在自由放任的体制下，如果不做出任何有利于货币而非债券的假设，那么就不会存在政府发行的法定货币与名义上无违约风险、具有相似物理特性的有息政府债券共存的均衡状态。这一命题正是“回报率支配之谜”最有力的解释基础。在本文中，我证明了——正如货币历史中的实际情况那样——如果作为法定货币使用的实物在某一外部属性上存在异质性，那么就会存在货币与有息债券共存的均衡状态。

abstract.text: Do intellectual property (IP) rights on existing technologies hinder subsequent innovation? Using newly-collected data on the sequencing of the human genome by the public Human Genome Project and the private firm Celera, this paper estimates the impact of Celera's gene-level IP on subsequent scientific research and product development. Genes initially sequenced by Celera were held with IP for up to two years, but moved into the public domain once re-sequenced by the public effort. Across a range of empirical specifications, I find evidence that Celera's IP led to reductions in subsequent scientific research and product development on the order of 20 to 30 percent. Taken together, these results suggest that Celera's short-term IP had persistent negative effects on subsequent innovation relative to a counterfactual of Celera genes having always been in the public domain.

10.1086/669706.abstractZh: 知识产权对现有技术的后续创新是否构成了阻碍？本文利用人类基因组计划由公共机构完成、私人公司Celera完成的基因组测序数据，估算了Celera在基因层面上的知识产权对后续科学研究和产品开发的影响。Celera最初测序的基因被赋予了长达两年的知识产权，但一旦被公共机构重新测序，这些基因便进入了公共领域。通过一系列实证分析，我发现Celera的知识产权导致后续科学研究和产品开发的效率下降了20%到30%。综合这些结果可以看出，与Celera的基因始终处于公共领域这一假设相比，Celera的短期知识产权对后续创新产生了持续的负面影响。

abstract.text: We study criminal recidivism in Argentina by focusing on the rearrest rates of two groups: individuals released from prison and individuals released from electronic monitoring. Detainees are randomly assigned to judges, and ideological differences across judges translate into large differences in the allocation of electronic monitoring to an otherwise similar population. Using these peculiarities of the Argentine setting, we argue that there is a large, negative causal effect on criminal recidivism of treating individuals with electronic monitoring relative to prison.

10.1086/669786.abstractZh: 我们研究了阿根廷的犯罪再犯现象，重点关注了两类人群的重新逮捕率：从监狱释放的人和从电子监控中释放的人。被拘留者被随机分配给不同的法官，而法官之间的意识形态差异导致对类似人群实施电子监控的分配存在巨大差异。利用阿根廷这一特殊环境的特点，我们认为，相对于从监狱释放的人，对实施电子监控的人进行处理的做法对犯罪再犯有显著的负面影响。

abstract.text: Multinational production (MP) can lead to large gains through international technology sharing. However, empirical evidence suggests that geography matters for MP: Affiliate sales fall in distance from the headquarters. We introduce intrafirm trade into a standard model of exports and MP and show that the model is consistent with firm-level and aggregate evidence. Using a maximum likelihood estimator, we find that intrafirm trade plays a crucial role in shaping the geography of MP. An implication of our work is that MP and exports are very similar activities. Consequently, shutting down MP leads to relatively small welfare losses.

10.1086/669877.abstractZh: 跨国生产可以通过国际技术共享带来巨大收益。然而，实证证据表明，地理位置对跨国生产具有重要影响：总部距离越远，附属销售就会下降。我们将企业间贸易引入到出口和跨国生产的标准模型中，发现该模型与企业的整体表现以及实证数据一致。通过最大似然估计方法，我们发现企业间贸易在塑造跨国生产的地理分布方面起着关键作用。我们的研究还表明，跨国生产和出口是高度相似的活动。因此，停止跨国生产所带来的福利损失相对较小。

abstract.text: Motivated by the low retention rates of US Military Academy and Reserve Officer Training Corps graduates, the Army recently introduced incentives programs in which cadets could bid 3 years of additional service obligation to obtain higher priority for their desired branches. The full potential of this incentives program is not utilized because of the ROTC's deficient matching mechanism. I propose a design that eliminates these shortcomings and mitigates several policy problems the Army has identified. In contrast to the ROTC mechanism, my design utilizes market principles more extensively, and it is a hybrid between a market mechanism and a priority-based allocation mechanism.

10.1086/669915.abstractZh: 由于美国军事学院和后备军官训练团毕业生的保留率较低，陆军最近推出了激励计划，学员可以通过竞标额外的3年服役义务来获得他们希望加入的部队的更高优先权。但由于后备军官训练团缺乏有效的匹配机制，这一激励计划的全部潜力并未得到充分发挥。我提出了一种设计方案，旨在消除这些缺陷，并缓解陆军所面临的若干政策问题。与后备军官训练团的机制不同，我的设计方案更广泛地运用了市场原则，是一种结合了市场机制与基于优先级的分配机制的混合模式。

abstract.text: This paper quantifies the gains from openness arising from trade and multinational production (MP). We present a model that captures key dimensions of the interaction between these two flows: trade and MP are competing ways to serve a foreign market, MP relies on imports of intermediate goods from the home country, and foreign affiliates of multinationals can export part of their output. The calibrated model implies that the gains from trade can be twice as high as the gains calculated in trade-only models, while the gains from MP are slightly lower than the gains computed in MP-only models.

10.1086/670136.abstractZh: 本文量化了贸易和跨国生产带来的开放收益。我们提出了一个模型，该模型能够捕捉这两种经济活动之间的关键互动关系：贸易和跨国生产是服务外国市场的两种竞争方式；跨国生产依赖于从本国进口中间产品，而跨国公司的外国子公司可以出口其部分产品。经过校准的模型表明，贸易带来的收益可能是仅依赖贸易模型计算出的收益的两倍，而跨国生产带来的收益则略低于仅依赖跨国生产模型计算出的收益。

abstract.text: I study a model of mobilization and rebel tactical choice. Rebel leaders choose between conventional tactics that are heavily reliant on mobilization, irregular tactics that are less so, and withdrawal from conflict. The model yields the following results, among others. Increased nonviolent opportunity has a nonmonotone effect on the use of irregular tactics. Conflict has option value, so irregular campaigns last longer than the rebels' short-term interest dictates, especially in volatile military environments. By demonstrating lack of rebel capacity and diminishing mobilization, successful counterinsurgencies may increase irregular violence. Conflict begets conflict by eroding outside options, thereby increasing mobilization.

10.1086/670137.abstractZh: 我研究了一个关于动员与叛军战术选择的模型。叛军领袖需要在依赖大量动员的传统战术、依赖性较低的非常规战术，以及退出冲突之间做出选择。该模型得出的结果包括：非暴力机会的增加对非常规战术的使用产生非单调的影响。冲突具有选择价值，因此在动荡的军事环境中，非常规战役的持续时间往往超过叛军短期利益的预期。通过展示叛军能力的不足以及动员力的下降，成功的反叛乱行动可能会增加非常规暴力行为。冲突通过侵蚀外部选择来引发更多冲突，从而加剧动员的必要性。

abstract.text: Child sponsorship is a leading form of direct aid from wealthy country households to children in developing countries. Over 9 million children are supported through international sponsorship organizations. Using data from six countries, we estimate impacts on several outcomes from sponsorship through Compassion International, a leading child sponsorship organization. To identify program effects, we utilize an age-eligibility rule implemented when programs began in new villages. We find large, statistically significant impacts on years of schooling; primary, secondary, and tertiary school completion; and the probability and quality of employment. Early evidence suggests that these impacts are due, in part, to increases in children's aspirations.

10.1086/670138.abstractZh: 儿童赞助是富裕国家家庭对发展中国家儿童的直接援助形式之一。通过国际赞助组织，有超过900万儿童得到了支持。我们利用来自六个国家的数据，估算了由Compassion International这一领先的儿童赞助组织所提供的赞助对多个结果的影响。为了识别项目的效果，我们采用了项目在新村庄启动时实施的年龄资格规则。我们发现，赞助对儿童受教育年限、完成小学、中学和高等教育的概率以及就业的机会和质量产生了显著且统计学上显著的影响。早期的证据表明，这些影响部分是由于儿童抱负的增加所导致的。

abstract.text: We quantitatively analyze the role of financial frictions and resource misallocation in explaining development dynamics. Our model economy with financial frictions converges to the new steady state slowly after a reform triggers efficient reallocation of resources; the transition speed is half that of the conventional neoclassical model. Furthermore, in the model economy, investment rates and total factor productivity are initially low and increase over time. We present data from the so-called miracle economies on the evolution of macro aggregates, factor reallocation, and establishment size distribution that support the aggregate and micro-level implications of our theory.

10.1086/670271.abstractZh: 我们定量分析了金融摩擦和资源错配在解释发展动态中的作用。我们的金融摩擦模型经济在改革触发资源有效重新分配后，会缓慢地收敛到新的稳定状态；这一转变速度仅为传统新古典模型的一半。此外，在模型经济中，投资率和全要素生产率最初较低，并随时间逐渐上升。我们引用了所谓“奇迹经济”的数据，这些数据支持了我们的理论在宏观总量、要素重新分配以及企业规模分布方面的宏观和微观层面的结论。

abstract.text: We propose a methodology for studying changes in bilateral commodity trade due to goods not exported previously or exported only in small quantities. Using a panel of 1,900 country pairs, we find that increased trade of these "least-traded goods" is an important factor in trade growth. This extensive margin accounts for 10 percent of the growth in trade for NAFTA country pairs, for example, and 26 percent in trade between the United States and Chile, China, and Korea. Looking at country pairs with no major trade policy change or structural change, however, we find little change in the extensive margin.

10.1086/670272.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种研究方法，用于分析由于商品之前未出口或仅少量出口而导致的双边商品贸易变化。通过研究1,900对国家组合的数据，我们发现这些“最少贸易商品”的贸易增加是贸易增长的一个重要因素。例如，在北美自由贸易协定国家组合中，这一广泛边际因素占贸易增长的10%，而在美国与智利、中国和韩国之间的贸易中，这一比例高达26%。然而，对于那些没有重大贸易政策变化或结构变化的国家组合来说，我们发现这一广泛边际因素的变化很小。

abstract.text: We propose a theory of the market for venture capital that links the excess return to venture equity to the scarcity of venture capitalists (VCs). High returns make the VCs more selective and eager to terminate nonperforming ventures because they can move on to new ones. The scarcity of VCs enables them to internalize their social value, and the competitive equilibrium is socially optimal. Moreover, the bilaterally efficient contract is a simple equity contract. We estimate the model for the period 1989-2001 and compute the excess return to venture capital, which turns out to be 8.6 percent. Finally, we back out the return of solo entrepreneurs, which is increasing in their wealth and ranges between zero and 3.5 percent.

10.1086/670359.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种风险投资市场的理论，该理论将风险投资股权的高回报与风险资本家的稀缺性联系起来。高回报使得风险资本家更加挑剔，并倾向于终止表现不佳的风险项目，因为他们可以转向新的项目。风险资本家的稀缺性使他们能够内化其社会价值，而竞争均衡则具有社会最优性。此外，双边高效契约实际上是一种简单的股权契约。我们对1989至2001年的模型进行了估算，计算出风险投资的高回报率为8.6%。最后，我们估算了单打独斗的企业家的回报，其回报随着财富的增加而增加，范围在0%到3.5%之间。

abstract.text: This paper provides a theoretical foundation that supports the degressive proportionality principle in apportionment problems, such as the allocation of seats in a federal parliament. The utility assigned by an individual to a constitutional rule is a function of the frequency with which each collective decision matches the individual's own will. The core of the argument is that, if the function is concave, then classical utilitarianism at the social level recommends decision rules that exhibit degressive proportionality with respect to the population size.

10.1086/670380.abstractZh: 本文为在分配问题中的递减比例原则提供了理论依据，例如联邦议会席位分配问题。个人对宪法规则的效用是每次集体决策与个人意愿相匹配的频率的函数。论点的核心在于，如果该函数是凹函数，那么社会层面的古典功利主义建议采用与人口规模呈递减比例决策的规则。

abstract.text: We extend five principles of tax incidence under perfect competition to a general model of imperfect competition. The principles cover (1) the independence of physical and economic incidence, the (2) qualitative and (3) quantitative manner in which taxes are split between consumers and producers, (4) the determinants of tax pass-through, and (5) the integration of local incidence to determine the overall division of surplus. We show how these principles can be used to simplify and generalize the analysis of a range of economic questions such as the optimal procurement of new markets and the welfare effects of third-degree price discrimination.

10.1086/670401.abstractZh: 我们将完全竞争下的五个税收负担原则扩展到不完美竞争的一般模型。这些原则包括：(1)物理负担与经济负担的独立性；(2)税收在消费者和生产者之间分配的定性与定量方式；(3)税收传递的决定因素；(4)将局部负担整合成整体剩余分配。我们展示了如何利用这些原则来简化和概括一系列经济问题的分析，例如新市场的最佳获取方式以及三级价格歧视的福利效应。

abstract.text: We revisit two well-known facts regarding life cycle expenditures: the "hump"-shaped profile of nondurable expenditures and the increase in cross-household consumption inequality. We document that the behavior of total nondurables masks surprising heterogeneity in the life cycle profile of individual consumption subcomponents. We provide evidence that the categories driving life cycle consumption either are inputs into market work or are amenable to home production. Using a quantitative model, we document that the disaggregated life cycle consumption profiles imply a level of uninsurable permanent income risk that is substantially lower than that implied by a model using a composite consumption good.

10.1086/670740.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了关于生命周期支出的两个众所周知的事实：非耐用性支出的“驼峰”形分布特征，以及家庭间消费不平等的加剧。我们发现，非耐用性消费的总量分布掩盖了个人消费各子成分在生命周期中的显著异质性。我们有证据表明，驱动生命周期消费的因素要么是市场运作的投入品，要么是可以家庭自产的物品。通过定量模型分析，我们发现，分解后的生命周期消费分布表明，不可保险的固定收入风险水平明显低于使用复合消费品的模型所暗示的风险水平。

abstract.text: Hereditary economic inequality is unknown among mobile foragers, but hereditary class distinctions between elites and commoners exist in some sedentary foraging societies. With agriculture, such stratification tends to become more pronounced. We develop a model to explain the associations among productivity, population, property rights, and inequality. Using Malthusian dynamics, we show that regional productivity growth leads to enclosure of the best sites first, creating inequality between insiders and outsiders. Hereditary elite and commoner classes subsequently arise at the best sites. Food consumption becomes more unequal and commoners become poorer. These predictions are consistent with a wide range of archaeological evidence.

10.1086/670741.abstractZh: 在流动的觅食者中，遗传性经济不平等并不存在，但在一些定居的觅食社会中，精英与平民之间存在遗传性阶级差异。随着农业的出现，这种分层现象变得更加明显。我们建立了一个模型来解释生产力、人口、产权与不平等之间的关联。利用马尔萨斯动态模型，我们发现区域生产力的增长会导致最佳土地首先被圈占，从而在内部人士与外部人士之间产生不平等。随后，遗传性精英和平民阶级会在最佳土地上形成。食物消费变得更加不平等，平民也变得更加贫困。这些预测与大量的考古证据是一致的。

abstract.text: We investigate learning by doing using detailed data from a major auto producer's assembly plant. We focus on the acquisition, aggregation, transmission, and embodiment of the knowledge stock built through learning. We find that most knowledge was not retained by plant workers despite their importance as a learning conduit. This is consistent with the plant's systems for productivity measurement and improvement. We further explore how learning at the hundreds of processes along the production line undergirds plantwide productivity. Our results shed light on how productivity gains accrue at the plant level and how firms apply managerial inputs to expand production.

10.1086/671137.abstractZh: 我们利用一家大型汽车制造商装配厂的详细数据，研究了通过实践学习的过程。我们重点关注通过学习积累的知识被获取、整合、传递和具体应用的过程。我们发现，尽管工人作为学习渠道非常重要，但他们并没有很好地保留所学的知识。这与工厂的生产效率测量和改进系统是一致的。我们进一步探讨了生产线上的数百个工序中的学习如何支撑整个工厂的生产效率。我们的研究结果揭示了生产效率的提升是如何在工厂层面实现的，以及企业是如何运用管理手段来扩大生产的。

abstract.text: Assuming Brownian/Poisson uncertainty, a certainty equivalent (CE) based on the smooth second-order expected utility of Klibanoff, Marinacci, and Mukerji is shown to be approximately equal to an expected-utility CE. As a consequence, the corresponding continuous-time recursive utility form is the same as for Kreps-Porteus utility. The analogous conclusions are drawn for a smooth divergence CE, based on a formulation of Maccheroni, Marinacci, and Rustichini, but only under Brownian uncertainty. Under Poisson uncertainty, a smooth divergence CE can be approximated with an expected-utility CE if and only if it is of the entropic type. A nonentropic divergence CE results in a new class of continuous-time recursive utilities that price Brownian and Poissonian risks differently.

10.1086/671179.abstractZh: 在假设布朗运动/泊松不确定性的情况下，基于Klibanoff、Marinacci和Mukerji提出的平滑二阶期望效用的确定性等价值，被证明约等于期望效用确定性等价值。因此，相应的连续时间递归效用形式与Kreps-Porteus效用理论中的形式相同。对于基于Maccheroni、Marinacci和Rustichini理论提出的平滑发散确定性等价值，同样可以得出类似的结论，但仅适用于布朗运动不确定性。在泊松不确定性下，平滑发散确定性等价值可以近似为期望效用确定性等价值，前提是它属于熵类型。非熵类型的发散确定性等价值则会产生一类新的连续时间递归效用，这些效用对布朗运动和泊松风险的处理方式不同。

abstract.text: This paper explores the economics of diversity-enhancing policies. A model is proposed in which heterogeneous agents, distinguished by skill level and social identity, purchase productive opportunities in a competitive market. We analyze policies designed to raise the status of a disadvantaged identity group. When agent identity is contractible, efficient policy grants preferred access to slots but offers no direct assistance for acquiring skills. When identity is not contractible, efficient policy provides universal subsidies to skill development when the fraction of the disadvantaged group at the skill development margin is larger than their share at the slot assignment margin.

10.1086/671180.abstractZh: 本文探讨了提升多样性的政策经济学。文中提出了一个模型，其中具有不同技能水平和社会身份的异质主体在竞争市场中购买生产机会。我们分析了旨在提升弱势群体地位的政策。当主体身份可契约时，有效的政策会提供优先获取生产机会的待遇，但不会直接提供技能提升的帮助。而当身份不可契约时，有效的政策会在弱势群体在技能提升方面的比例高于他们在生产机会分配方面的比例时，提供普遍的技能发展补贴。

abstract.text: Stock and Treasury bond comovement, volatilities, and their relations to their price valuations and fundamentals change stochastically over time, in both magnitude and direction. These stochastic changes are explained by a general equilibrium model in which agents learn about composite economic and inflation regimes. We estimate our model using both fundamentals and asset prices and find that inflation news signal either positive or negative future real economic growth depending on the times, thereby affecting the direction of stock-bond comovement. The learning dynamics generate strong nonlinearities between volatilities and price valuations. We find empirical support for numerous predictions of the model.

10.1086/671799.abstractZh: 股票和国债的波动性与风险性，以及它们与价格估值和基本面变化的相互关系，在时间和幅度、方向上都会发生随机变化。这些随机变化可以通过一个一般均衡模型来解释，该模型中的参与者会了解综合的经济和通货膨胀状况。我们通过使用基本面数据和资产价格来估计我们的模型，发现通货膨胀消息会向未来实际经济增长传递正面或负面的信号，这取决于具体的时间点，从而影响股票和债券的波动方向。学习过程会导致波动性与价格估值之间存在强烈的非线性关系。我们发现该模型的许多预测得到了实证支持。

abstract.text: We introduce a model in which agents in a network can trade via bilateral contracts. We find that when continuous transfers are allowed and utilities are quasi-linear, the full substitutability of preferences is sufficient to guarantee the existence of stable outcomes for any underlying network structure. Furthermore, the set of stable outcomes is essentially equivalent to the set of competitive equilibria, and all stable outcomes are in the core and are efficient. By contrast, for any domain of preferences strictly larger than that of full substitutability, the existence of stable outcomes and competitive equilibria cannot be guaranteed.

10.1086/673402.abstractZh: 我们引入了一个模型，其中网络中的代理可以通过双边合同进行交易。我们发现，当允许连续转移且效用为准线性时，偏好的完全可替代性足以保证任何基础网络结构下稳定结果的存在。此外，稳定结果的集合本质上等同于竞争均衡的集合，所有稳定结果都属于核心结果，并且是有效的。相比之下，对于任何严格大于完全可替代性的偏好域，都无法保证稳定结果和竞争均衡的存在。

abstract.text: This paper studies models of credit with limited commitment and, therefore, endogenous debt limits. There are multiple stationary equilibria plus nonstationary equilibria in which credit conditions change simply because of beliefs. There can be equilibria in which debt limits display deterministic cyclic or chaotic dynamics, as well as stochastic (sunspot) equilibria in which they fluctuate randomly, even though fundamentals are deterministic and time invariant. Examples and applications are discussed. We also consider different mechanisms for determining the terms of trade and compare the setup to other credit models in the literature.

10.1086/673472.abstractZh: 本文研究了具有有限承诺的信用模型，因此存在内生性的债务限制。存在多个静态均衡以及非静态均衡，在这些均衡中，信用条件会因信念的变化而发生变化。在某些均衡中，债务限制表现出确定性周期性或混沌动态，而在其他均衡中，债务限制则呈现随机波动，尽管基本经济因素具有确定性且时间不变。文中还讨论了相关示例和应用案例。此外，我们还考虑了确定贸易条件的不同机制，并将该模型与其他文献中的信用模型进行了比较。

abstract.text: How do discount rates affect agents' decisions and valuations? This paper provides a general method to analyze this question, allowing stochastic and managed cash flows, stochastic discount rates, and time inconsistency and including arbitrary learning and payoff or utility processes. We show that some of these features can lead to counterintuitive answers (e.g., "a more patient agent stops earlier"), but we also establish, under simple conditions, theorems yielding robust predictions concerning the impact of discount rates on control and stopping decisions and on valuations. We apply our theory to models of search, experimentation, bankruptcy, optimal growth, investment, and social learning.

10.1086/673867.abstractZh: 折扣率如何影响代理人的决策和估值？本文提供了一种通用方法来分析这一问题，适用于随机和受管理的现金流、随机折扣率，以及时间不一致性，还包括任意的学习和收益或效用过程。我们指出，某些特征可能导致违反直觉的回答（例如，“更耐心的代理人会更早停止”），但在简单条件下，我们建立了能够稳健预测折扣率对控制决策、停止决策以及估值影响的定理。我们将这一理论应用于搜索、实验、破产、最优增长、投资和社会学习等模型。

abstract.text: We present a theory of context-dependent choice in which a consumer's attention is drawn to salient attributes of goods, such as quality or price. An attribute is salient for a good when it stands out among the good's attributes relative to that attribute's average level in the choice set (or, more broadly, the choice context). Consumers attach disproportionately high weight to salient attributes, and their choices are tilted toward goods with higher quality/price ratios. The model accounts for a variety of disparate evidence, including decoy effects and context-dependent willingness to pay. It also suggests a novel theory of misleading sales.

10.1086/673885.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种情境依赖选择的理论，其中消费者的注意力会被商品中的显著属性所吸引，例如质量或价格。当一个属性在商品的其他属性中相对突出时，该属性就具有显著性。消费者会赋予显著属性不成比例的高权重，因此他们的选择会倾向于那些质量/价格比率较高的商品。该模型解释了多种不同的现象，包括诱饵效应和情境依赖的支付意愿。它还提出了一种关于误导性销售的新理论。

abstract.text: Economic variables move asymmetrically over the business cycle: quickly during crises but slowly during recoveries. I show that this asymmetry is stronger in countries with less developed financial systems and greater financial frictions. Then I explain this fact using a learning model with endogenous information about economic conditions. Financial frictions, which I capture by higher bankruptcy costs, magnify the reaction of lending rates and economic activity to negative shocks and then delay their recovery by restricting information after the crisis. Empirical evidence and a quantitative exploration of the model show that this explanation is consistent with the data.

10.1086/673886.abstractZh: 经济变量在商业周期中的变动是不对称的：在危机期间变化迅速，而在复苏期间则变化缓慢。我发现，这种不对称性在金融体系较为落后且金融摩擦较大的国家更为明显。我利用一个包含经济状况内生信息的学习模型来解释这一现象。金融摩擦通过增加破产成本来加剧借贷利率和经济活动对负面冲击的反应，并因危机后信息的限制而延迟经济的复苏。实证数据和对该模型的定量分析表明，这一解释与数据结果一致。

abstract.text: Competition and intellectual property (IP) protections are complements in stimulating innovation. When IP is appropriable, a market for inventions forms and competitive pressures increase incentives to innovate. Competition among producers, the demand side of the market for inventions, and competition among inventors, the supply side of the market for inventions, create incentives to innovate. When IP is not fully appropriable, markets for inventions are limited and competitive pressures can decrease incentives to innovate. Firms vertically integrate R&D and production and share technology to appropriate the returns to IP. This implies that antitrust policy and IP protections are complements.

10.1086/674134.abstractZh: 竞争与知识产权保护在促进创新方面是互补的。当知识产权可以被独占时，发明市场就会形成，竞争压力会增加创新的动力。生产者之间的竞争、发明市场的需求方竞争以及发明者之间的竞争，都能激发创新的动力。而当知识产权不能完全被独占时，发明市场就会受到限制，竞争压力可能会降低创新的动力。企业通过垂直整合研发和生产，并共享技术，从而独占知识产权的收益。这意味着反垄断政策和知识产权保护是互补的。

abstract.text: This paper studies the optimal redistribution of income inequality caused by the presence of search and matching frictions in the labor market. We study this problem in the context of a directed search model of the labor market populated by homogeneous workers and heterogeneous firms. The optimal redistribution can be attained using a positive unemployment benefit and an increasing and regressive labor income tax. The positive unemployment benefit serves the purpose of lowering the search risk faced by workers. The increasing and regressive labor tax serves the purpose of aligning the cost to the firm of attracting an additional applicant with the value of an application to society.

10.1086/674135.abstractZh: 本文研究了由于劳动力市场中搜寻与匹配摩擦的存在而导致的收入不平等的最优再分配问题。我们在一个由同质工人和异质企业构成的定向搜寻模型背景下研究这一问题。通过实施积极的失业救济金政策以及增加且递减的劳动力所得税，可以实现最优的再分配。积极的失业救济金有助于降低工人的搜寻风险，而增加且递减的劳动力所得税则有助于使企业吸引额外求职者的成本与社会获得的收益达到平衡。

abstract.text: We study the cyclical implications of credit market imperfections in a quantitative dynamic, stochastic general equilibrium model wherein firms face persistent shocks to aggregate and individual productivity. In our model economy, optimal capital reallocation is distorted by two frictions: collateralized borrowing and partial investment irreversibility. We find that a negative shock to borrowing conditions can, on its own, generate a large and persistent recession through disruptions to the distribution of capital. This recession, and the subsequent recovery, is distinguished both quantitatively and qualitatively from that driven by an exogenous shock to total factor productivity.

10.1086/674142.abstractZh: 我们在一个定量动态随机一般均衡模型中研究了信贷市场不完善所带来的周期性影响。在该模型中，企业面临持续的总量和个体生产率的冲击。我们的模型经济中，最优的资本再分配受到两种摩擦的扭曲：抵押借款和部分投资不可逆性。我们发现，对借款条件的负面冲击本身就能通过破坏资本分配来引发大规模且持续的衰退。这种衰退以及随后的复苏，在数量和质量上都与由总要素生产率的外生冲击所引发的衰退有所不同。

abstract.text: The international diversification puzzle is the fact that country portfolios are on average biased toward domestic assets, while one-good international macro models with nondiversifiable labor income risk predict the opposite pattern of diversification. This paper embeds a portfolio choice decision in a two-good international business cycle model and provides a closed-form solution for equilibrium country portfolios. Equilibrium portfolios are biased toward domestic assets because endogenous international relative price fluctuations make domestic assets a good hedge against labor income risk. Evidence from developed economies in recent years is qualitatively and quantitatively consistent with the mechanisms highlighted by the theory.

10.1086/674143.abstractZh: 国际资产多元化之谜在于，各国投资组合平均倾向于国内资产，而仅考虑一国且不包含劳动收入风险的非多元化国际宏观模型则预测出相反的多元化模式。本文将投资组合决策纳入一个涉及两国的国际商业周期模型中，并给出了均衡国家投资组合的封闭形式解。均衡投资组合倾向于国内资产，因为内在的国际相对价格波动使得国内资产成为抵御劳动收入风险的有效对冲工具。近年来来自发达经济体的证据在质量和数量上都与理论所强调的机制一致。

abstract.text: We provide experimental evidence that subjects blame others on the basis of events they are not responsible for. In our experiment an agent chooses between a lottery and a safe asset; payment from the chosen option goes to a principal, who then decides how much to allocate between the agent and a third party. We observe widespread blame: regardless of their choice, agents are blamed by principals for the outcome of the lottery, an event they are not responsible for. We provide an explanation of this apparently irrational behavior with a delegated-expertise principal-agent model, the subjects' salient perturbation of the environment.

10.1086/674409.abstractZh: 我们提供了实验证据，表明受试者会基于他们无需负责的事件而责怪他人。在我们的实验中，一个代理人需要在彩票和安全资产之间做出选择；选择后获得的报酬将归主方所有，主方随后决定在代理人和第三方之间分配多少报酬。我们观察到一种普遍的责怪行为：无论代理人选择哪个选项，他们都会因彩票的结果而受到主方的责怪，而这一结果并非代理人的责任。我们通过委托专家型主体-代理人模型对这一看似非理性的行为进行了解释，该模型解释了受试者对环境的显著扰动行为。

abstract.text: We present a method of ranking U.S. undergraduate programs based on students’ revealed preferences. When a student chooses a college among those that have admitted him, that college “wins” his “tournament.” Our method efficiently integrates the information from thousands of such tournaments. We implement the method using data from a national sample of high-achieving students. We demonstrate that this ranking method has strong theoretical properties, eliminating incentives for colleges to adopt strategic, inefficient admissions policies to improve their rankings. We also show empirically that our ranking is (1) not vulnerable to strategic manipulation; (2) similar regardless of whether we control for variables, such as net cost, that vary among a college’s admits; (3) similar regardless of whether we account for students selecting where to apply, including Early Decision. We exemplify multiple rankings for different types of students who have preferences that vary systematically.

10.1093/qje/qjs043.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于学生揭示的偏好来排名美国本科项目的方法。当学生从被录取的学院中选择一所学院时，该学院就“赢得”了学生的“锦标赛”。我们的方法能够高效整合来自数千场此类锦标赛的信息。我们使用全国范围内成绩优异学生的数据来实施该方法。我们证明，这种排名方法具有强大的理论特性，能够消除学院采用战略性、低效的招生政策以提高排名的动机。我们还通过实证研究表明，我们的排名方法：(1)不易受到战略性操纵的影响；(2)无论是否控制诸如净成本等变量，其结果都是相似的；(3)无论是否考虑学生选择申请地点的因素，包括提前决定申请，其结果都是相似的。我们通过多种类型的学生的例子来说明，这些学生的偏好存在系统性差异，而我们的排名方法能够考虑到这些差异。

abstract.text: A long-standing question in social science is to what extent differences in management cause differences in firm performance.To investigate this we ran a management field experiment on large Indian textile firms.We provided free consulting on modern management practices to a randomly chosen set of treatment plants and compared their performance to the control plants.We find that adopting these management practices had three main effects.First, it raised average productivity by 11% through improved quality and efficiency and reduced inventory.Second, it increased decentralization of decision making, as better information flow enabled owners to delegate more decisions to middle managers.Third, it increased the use of computers, necessitated by the data collection and analysis involved in modern management.Since these practices were profitable this raises the question of why firms had not adopted these before.Our results suggest that informational barriers were a primary factor in explaining this lack of adoption.Modern management is a technology that diffuses slowly between firms, with many Indian firms initially unaware of its existence or impact.Since competition was limited by constraints on firm entry and growth, badly managed firms were not rapidly driven from the market.

10.1093/qje/qjs044.abstractZh: 社会科学中一个长期存在的疑问是，管理上的差异在多大程度上导致了企业绩效的差异。为了研究这个问题，我们在印度的大型纺织企业开展了一项管理实地实验。我们向随机选取的试验企业提供了现代管理实践的免费咨询，并将其绩效与对照企业进行了比较。研究发现，采用这些管理实践主要产生了三个效果：首先，通过提高质量和效率以及减少库存，平均生产率提高了11%。其次，由于信息流通更加顺畅，企业主能够向中层管理人员授权更多的决策权，从而增强了决策的权力分散程度。第三，由于现代管理需要数据收集和分析，计算机的使用也增加了。由于这些实践具有盈利性，这就引出了一个问题：为什么企业之前没有采用这些实践。我们的研究结果表明，信息障碍是解释这种缺乏采用行为的主要因素。现代管理是一种在企业间传播缓慢的技术，许多印度企业最初并不了解其存在或影响。由于企业进入和增长的限制，管理不善的企业并没有被迅速淘汰出市场。

abstract.text: Veiling among Muslim women is modeled as a commitment mechanism that limits temptation to deviate from religious norms of behavior. The analysis suggests that veiling is a strategy for integration, enabling women to take up outside economic opportunities while preserving their reputation within the community. This accounts for puzzling features of the new veiling movement since the 1970s. Veiling also has surprising effects on the intergenerational transmission of values. Compulsory veiling laws can lead to a decline in religiosity. Bans on veiling can inhibit social integration and increase religiosity.

10.1093/qje/qjs045.abstractZh: 穆斯林女性的头巾佩戴被模型化为一种约束机制，能够限制人们偏离宗教行为规范的诱惑。分析表明，头巾佩戴是一种融合策略，使女性能够在保留社区内声誉的同时，抓住外部经济机会。这解释了自20世纪70年代以来新出现的头巾佩戴运动的一些令人困惑的特点。头巾佩戴还对价值观的代际传递产生了意想不到的影响。强制性的头巾佩戴法律可能导致宗教虔诚度的下降，而禁止头巾佩戴则可能会抑制社会融合并增加宗教虔诚度。

abstract.text: We study explicit gender discrimination in a population of ads on a Chinese Internet job board. Gender-targeted job ads are common, favor women as often as men, and are much less common in jobs requiring higher levels of skill. Employers’ relative preferences for female versus male workers, on the other hand, are more strongly related to the preferred age, height, and beauty of the worker than to job skill levels. Almost two thirds of the variation in advertised gender preferences occurs within firms, and one third occurs within firm*occupation cells. Overall, these patterns are not well explained by a firm-level animus model, by a glass-ceiling model, or by models in which broad occupational categories are consistently gendered across firms. Instead, the patterns suggest a model in which firms have idiosyncratic preferences for particular job-gender matches, which are overridden in skilled positions by factors such as thinner labor markets or a greater incentive to search broadly for the most qualified candidate.

10.1093/qje/qjs046.abstractZh: 我们研究了中国互联网招聘平台上的广告中明显的性别歧视现象。针对女性的招聘广告很常见，且对女性的青睐程度与对男性的相似，但在需要较高技能的工作岗位中，这类广告则较为少见。另一方面，雇主对女性与男性工人的相对偏好更多地与工人的年龄、身高和外貌相关，而非与技能水平相关。广告中性别偏好差异的近三分之二是由企业内部因素造成的，三分之一则是由企业所属的职业类别内部因素造成的。总体而言，这些模式无法用企业层面的敌意模型、玻璃天花板模型，或那些认为广泛职业类别在不同企业中具有一致性别倾向的模型来解释。相反，这些模式表明，企业对于特定的工作-性别匹配组合有独特的偏好，而在技能要求较高的职位上，这种偏好会被诸如劳动力市场更紧张或需要更广泛寻找最合格候选人等因素所抵消。

abstract.text: Unlike economies as a whole, manufacturing industries exhibit strong unconditional convergence in labor productivity. The article documents this at various levels of disaggregation for a large sample covering more than 100 countries over recent decades. The result is highly robust to changes in the sample and specification. The coefficient of unconditional convergence is estimated quite precisely and is large, at between 2–3% in most specifications and 2.9% a year in the baseline specification covering 118 countries. The article also finds substantial sigma convergence at the two-digit level for a smaller sample of countries. Despite strong convergence within manufacturing, aggregate convergence fails due to the small share of manufacturing employment in low-income countries and the slow pace of industrialization. Because of data coverage, these findings should be as viewed as applying to the organized, formal parts of manufacturing.

10.1093/qje/qjs047.abstractZh: 与整体经济不同，制造业在劳动生产率方面表现出强烈的无条件收敛性。本文通过大量样本数据，对近几十年来超过100个国家的制造业在不同层次上的表现进行了研究。研究结果对样本和模型参数的变化具有高度稳健性。无条件收敛系数被精确估计，在大多数模型中其值在2-3%之间，而在覆盖118个国家的基线模型中，该系数为每年2.9%。此外，对于规模较小的国家样本，本文还发现两位数级别的σ收敛性显著。尽管制造业内部存在强烈的收敛性，但由于低收入国家制造业就业比例较低以及工业化进程缓慢，整体收敛性未能实现。由于数据覆盖范围的限制，这些发现应被视为适用于有组织的、正规制造业领域。

abstract.text: This article evaluates the long-term effects of class size in primary school. We use rich data from Sweden and exploit variation in class size created by a maximum class size rule. Smaller classes in the last three years of primary school (age 10 to 13) are beneficial for cognitive and noncognitive ability at age 13, and improve achievement at age 16. Most important, we find that smaller classes have positive effects on completed education, wages, and earnings at age 27 to 42. The estimated wage effect is large enough to pass a cost-benefit test.

10.1093/qje/qjs048.abstractZh: 本文评估了小学班级规模对长期影响的效应。我们利用了瑞典的丰富数据，并分析了由最大班级规模规定所引发的班级规模变化。在小学最后三年（10至13岁）中，较小的班级对13岁时的认知和非认知能力有积极影响，并提高了16岁时的学业成绩。最重要的是，我们发现较小的班级对27至42岁时的完成教育程度、工资和收入都有积极影响。估计的工资效应足够大，足以通过成本效益测试。

abstract.text: We present a generally applicable theory of focusing based on the hypothesis that a person focuses more on, and hence overweights, attributes in which her options differ more. Our model predicts that the decision maker is too prone to choose options with concentrated advantages relative to alternatives, but maximizes utility when the advantages and disadvantages of alternatives are equally concentrated. Applying our model to intertemporal choice, these results predict that a person exhibits present bias and time inconsistency when—such as in lifestyle choices and other widely invoked applications of hyperbolic discounting—the future effect of a current decision is distributed over many dates, and the effects of multiple decisions accumulate. But unlike in previous models, in our theory (1) present bias is lower when the costs of current misbehavior are less dispersed, helping explain why people respond more to monetary incentives than to health concerns in harmful consumption; and (2) time inconsistency is lower when a person commits to fewer decisions with accumulating effects in her ex ante choice. In addition, a person does not fully maximize welfare even when making decisions ex ante: (3) she commits to too much of an activity—for example, exercise or work—that is beneficial overall; and (4) makes “future-biased” commitments when—such as in preparing for a big event—the benefit of many periods’ effort is concentrated in a single goal.

10.1093/qje/qjs049.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于以下假设的一般适用聚焦理论：一个人会更关注那些选项差异较大的属性，并因此更重视这些属性。我们的模型预测，决策者容易选择具有相对集中优势的选项，但在选项的优势和劣势均相对集中时，决策者会最大化效用。将我们的模型应用于跨期选择，这些结果表明，当当前决策的未来影响分布在多个日期上，且多个决策的影响会累积时，人们会表现出当前偏见和时间不一致性。但与之前的模型不同，在我们的理论中：（1）当当前不当行为的成本分布较广时，当前偏见较低，这有助于解释为什么人们在有害消费问题上更受金钱激励的影响而非健康问题的困扰；（2）当一个人做出的决策较少且这些决策的影响在事前选择中累积时，时间不一致性较低。此外，即使是在事前做出决策时，一个人也不会完全最大化福利：（3）她会过度参与某种总体上有益的活动，例如锻炼或工作；（4）在准备重大事件等情况下，当多个时期的努力所带来的收益集中在单一目标上时，她会做出“未来导向”的承诺。

abstract.text: We investigate the determinants of regional development using a newly constructed database of 1,569 subnational regions from 110 countries covering 74% of the world’s surface and 97% of its GDP. We combine the cross-regional analysis of geographic, institutional, cultural, and human capital determinants of regional development with an examination of productivity in several thousand establishments located in these regions. To organize the discussion, we present a new model of regional development that introduces into a standard migration framework elements of both the Lucas (1978) model of the allocation of talent between entrepreneurship and work, and the Lucas (1988) model of human capital externalities. The evidence points to the paramount importance of human capital in accounting for regional differences in development, but also suggests from model estimation and calibration that entrepreneurial inputs and possibly human capital externalities help understand the data.

10.1093/qje/qjs050.abstractZh: 我们利用一个新构建的数据库来研究区域发展的决定因素，该数据库涵盖了110个国家的1,569个次国家级区域，这些区域覆盖了世界74%的表面积和97%的GDP。我们结合了对地理、制度、文化和人力资本等区域发展决定因素的跨区域分析，以及对这些区域内数千家企业的生产力情况的考察。为了组织讨论，我们提出了一个新的区域发展模型，该模型将Lucas（1978）关于人才在创业与工作之间分配模型的要素，以及Lucas（1988）关于人力资本外部性的模型元素引入到标准的迁移框架中。证据表明，人力资本在解释区域发展差异方面具有极其重要的意义，但模型估计和校准的结果也表明，创业投入以及可能的人力资本外部性有助于理解相关数据。

abstract.text: Extending Barro (1999) and Luttmer and Mariotti (2003), we introduce a new model of time preferences: the instantaneous-gratification model. This model applies tractably to a much wider range of settings than existing models. It applies to both complete- and incomplete-market settings and it works with generic utility functions. It works in settings with linear policy rules and in settings in which equilibrium cannot be supported by linear rules. The instantaneous-gratification model also generates a unique equilibrium, even in infinite-horizon applications, thereby resolving the multiplicity problem hitherto associated with dynamically inconsistent models. Finally, it simultaneously features a single welfare criterion and a behavioral tendency towards overconsumption.

10.1093/qje/qjs051.abstractZh: 在延续Barro（1999）和Luttmer与Mariotti（2003）的研究基础上，我们提出了一个新的时间偏好模型：即时满足模型。该模型能够适用于比现有模型更广泛的情境，既适用于完全市场情境，也适用于不完全市场情境，并且可以适用于多种通用的效用函数。该模型适用于具有线性政策规则的情形，也适用于均衡无法由线性规则支撑的情形。即时满足模型还能在无限期应用中产生唯一的均衡状态，从而解决了以往动态不一致模型所面临的均衡多重性问题。最后，该模型同时具备单一的福利标准以及过度消费的行为倾向。

abstract.text: Over the past 30 years, many states have abolished parole boards, which traditionally have had the discretion to release inmates before the expiration of their full sentence, in favor of fixed-sentence regimes in which the original sentence is binding. However, if prison time lowers recidivism risk and if parole boards can accurately estimate inmates’ recidivism risk, then relative to a fixed-sentence regime, parole can provide allocative-efficiency benefits (costly prison space is allocated to the highest-risk offenders) and incentive benefits (prisoners know they must reduce their recidivism risk to gain an early release, so invest in their own rehabilitation). Exploiting quasi-experiments from the state of Georgia, I show that prison time reduces recidivism risk and that parole boards set prison time in an allocatively efficient manner. Prisoners respond to these incentives; after a reform that eliminated parole for certain offenders, they accumulated a greater number of disciplinary infractions, completed fewer prison rehabilitative programs, and recidivated at higher rates than inmates unaffected by the reform. I estimate that eliminating parole for all prisoners would increase the prison population by 10% while also increasing the crime rate through deleterious effects on recidivism.

10.1093/qje/qjs052.abstractZh: 在过去的30年里，许多州废除了假释委员会制度，该制度传统上有权在囚犯刑期届满前将其释放。如今，许多州采用了固定刑期制度，即最初的刑期具有约束力。然而，如果监禁时间能够降低再犯风险，且假释委员会能够准确评估囚犯的再犯风险，那么与固定刑期制度相比，假释制度可以带来分配效率上的好处（将昂贵的监狱空间分配给风险最高的罪犯），以及激励性好处（囚犯意识到必须降低再犯风险才能获得提前释放，因此会投入精力进行自我改造）。通过佐治亚州的准实验数据，我证明监禁时间确实能降低再犯风险，且假释委员会在分配监狱资源方面具有效率。囚犯们对这些激励措施做出了反应：在取消某些罪犯的假释后，他们出现了更多的纪律违规行为，完成的监狱改造项目数量减少，再犯率也上升。我估计，如果取消所有囚犯的假释，监狱人口将增加10%，同时由于再犯风险的增加，犯罪率也会上升。

abstract.text: Proximity to plants makes it easier for headquarters to monitor and acquire information about plants. In this article, I estimate the effects of headquarters’ proximity to plants on plant-level investment and productivity. Using the introduction of new airline routes as a source of exogenous variation in proximity, I find that new airline routes that reduce the travel time between headquarters and plants lead to an increase in plant-level investment of 8% to 9% and an increase in plants’ total factor productivity of 1.3% to 1.4%. The results are robust when I control for local and firm-level shocks that could potentially drive the introduction of new airline routes, when I consider only new airline routes that are the outcome of a merger between two airlines or the opening of a new hub, and when I consider only indirect flights where either the last leg of the flight (involving the plant’s home airport) or the first leg of the flight (involving headquarters’ home airport) remains unchanged. Moreover, the results are stronger in the earlier years of the sample period and for firms whose headquarters is more time-constrained. In addition, they also hold at the extensive margin, that is, when I consider plant openings and closures.

10.1093/qje/qjs073.abstractZh: 靠近工厂使得总部更容易监控和获取有关工厂的信息。在本文中，我估计了总部与工厂的距离对工厂层面投资和生产力的影响。以引入新的航空路线作为距离变化的外生变量来源，我发现，那些能够缩短总部与工厂之间旅行时间的新航空路线，会使工厂层面的投资增加8%到9%，工厂的总要素生产率提高1.3%到1.4%。当控制住可能导致新航空路线引入的局部和公司层面的冲击后，当只考虑由两家航空公司合并或新枢纽开通而产生的新航空路线时，以及当只考虑那些最后一程（涉及工厂的母机场）或第一程（涉及总部的母机场）保持不变的间接航班时，这些结果依然成立。此外，这些结果在样本期的早期以及总部时间限制较严格的公司中更为显著。而且，这些结果在广泛层面上同样成立，即当考虑工厂的开设和关闭时也是如此。

abstract.text: For two-person complete-information strategic games with transferable utility, all major variable-threat bargaining and arbitration solutions coincide. This confluence of solutions by luminaries such as Nash, Harsanyi, Raiffa, and Selten, is more than mere coincidence. Staying in the class of two-person games with transferable unility, the article presents a more complete theory that expands their solution. Specifically, it presents: (1) a decomposition of a game into cooperative and competitive components, (2) an intuitive and computable closed-form formula for the solution, (3) an axiomatic justification of the solution, and (4) a generalization of the solution to games with private signals, along with an arbitration scheme that implements it. The objective is to restart research on cooperative solutions to strategic games and their applications.

10.1093/qje/qjs074.abstractZh: 对于具有可转移效用的两人完全信息战略博弈，所有主要的变威胁谈判和仲裁解决方案都趋于一致。这种由纳什、哈萨尼、莱法以及塞伦特等著名学者提出的解决方案的融合，并非单纯的巧合。本文在继续研究具有可转移效用性的两人博弈的基础上，提出了更为完整的理论，扩展了这些解决方案。具体来说，本文提出了：(1)将博弈分解为合作与竞争两部分；(2)一种直观且可计算的封闭形式解决方案公式；(3)对解决方案的公理式证明；(4)将解决方案推广到具有私人信号的博弈，并提出了相应的仲裁方案。本文旨在重新启动对战略博弈合作解决方案及其应用的深入研究。

abstract.text: This article presents a perfectly competitive model of firm boundary decisions and study their interplay with product demand, technology, and welfare. Integration is privately costly but is effective at coordinating production decisions; nonintegration is less costly but coordinates relatively poorly. Output price influences the choice of ownership structure: integration increases with the price level. At the same time, ownership affects output, because integration is more productive than nonintegration. For a generic set of demand functions, equilibrium delivers heterogeneity of ownership and performance among ex ante identical enterprises. The price mechanism transmutes demand shifts into industry-wide reorganizations and generates external effects from technological shocks: productivity changes in some firms may induce ownership changes in others. If the enterprise managers have full title to its revenues, market equilibrium ownership structures are second-best efficient. When managers have less than full revenue claims, equilibrium can be inefficient, with too little integration.

10.1093/qje/qjs075.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个完全竞争模型，研究企业边界决策与产品需求、技术和福利之间的相互作用。整合过程虽然成本较高，但能有效协调生产决策；而非整合虽然成本较低，但协调效果较差。产品价格会影响所有权结构的选择：随着价格水平的上升，整合程度会增加。同时，所有权也会影响产量，因为整合比非整合更具生产效率。对于一组通用的需求函数，均衡状态会导致原本相同的企业之间出现所有权和绩效的异质性。价格机制将需求变化转化为整个行业的重组，并引发技术冲击带来的外部效应：某些企业的生产率变化可能会促使其他企业的所有权结构发生变化。如果企业管理者完全拥有其收入，市场均衡下的所有权结构将是次优的。而当管理者对收入的掌控程度低于完全掌控时，均衡可能是低效的，整合程度也会不足。

abstract.text: We consider optimal redistribution in a model where individuals can self-select into one of several possible sectors based on heterogeneity in a multidimensional skill vector. We first show that when the government does not observe the sectoral choice or underlying skills of its citizens, the constrained Pareto frontier can be implemented with a single nonlinear income tax. We then characterize this optimal tax schedule. If sectoral inputs are complements, a many-sector model with self-selection leads to optimal income taxes that are less progressive than the corresponding taxes in a standard single-sector model under natural conditions. However, they are more progressive than in canonical multisector economies with discrete types and without occupational choice or overlapping sectoral wage distributions.

10.1093/qje/qjs076.abstractZh: 我们考虑在一个模型中的最优再分配问题，该模型中的个体可以根据多维技能向量的异质性选择进入几个不同的部门。我们首先证明，当政府无法观察到公民的部门选择或基本技能时，可以通过单一的非线性所得税来实现受限的帕累托前沿。然后，我们描述了这种最优税收安排。如果部门间的投入是互补的，那么一个包含自我选择的多个部门模型所得到的税收比标准单一部门模型在自然条件下的税收更为公平。然而，与具有离散类型且没有职业选择或部门工资分布重叠的典型多部门经济相比，这种税收安排更为公平。

abstract.text: When voters fear that politicians may be influenced or corrupted by the rich elite, signals of integrity are valuable. As a consequence, an honest politician seeking reelection chooses “populist” policies—that is, policies to the left of the median voter—as a way of signaling that he is not beholden to the interests of the right. Politicians that are influenced by right-wing special interests respond by choosing moderate or even left-of-center policies. This populist bias of policy is greater when the value of remaining in office is higher for the politician; when there is greater polarization between the policy preferences of the median voter and right-wing special interests; when politicians are perceived as more likely to be corrupt; when there is an intermediate amount of noise in the information that voters receive; when politicians are more forward-looking; and when there is greater uncertainty about the type of the incumbent. We also show that soft term limits may exacerbate, rather than reduce, the populist bias of policies.

10.1093/qje/qjs077.abstractZh: 当选民担心政治家可能受到富裕精英的影响或腐蚀时，诚信的信号就变得非常重要。因此，一个诚实的政治家在寻求连任时会选择“民粹主义”政策——即那些位于中位选民左翼的政策——以此来表明他不依附于右翼的利益集团。而那些受到右翼特殊利益集团影响的政治家则会选择温和甚至偏左的政策。当政治家继续执政的价值更高时，这种政策上的民粹主义倾向会更强；当中位选民的政策偏好与右翼特殊利益集团之间的分歧更大时；当政治家被认为更有可能腐败时；当选民收到的信息中存在一定程度的噪音时；当政治家更具前瞻性时；以及当对现任政治人物的类型存在较大不确定性时，这种政策上的民粹主义倾向也会增强。我们还发现，宽松的任期限制可能会加剧而非减少政策上的民粹主义倾向。

abstract.text: This article reports the results from a randomized experiment designed to evaluate the direct and indirect (displacement) impacts of job placement assistance on the labor market outcomes of young, educated job seekers in France. We use a two-step design. In the first step, the proportions of job seekers to be assigned to treatment (0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100%) were randomly drawn for each of the 235 labor markets (e.g., cities) participating in the experiment. Then, in each labor market, eligible job seekers were randomly assigned to the treatment, following this proportion. After eight months, eligible, unemployed youths who were assigned to the program were significantly more likely to have found a stable job than those who were not. But these gains are transitory, and they appear to have come partly at the expense of eligible workers who did not benefit from the program, particularly in labor markets where they compete mainly with other educated workers, and in weak labor markets. Overall, the program seems to have had very little net benefits.

10.1093/qje/qjt001.abstractZh: 本文报告了一项随机实验的结果，该实验旨在评估就业援助对法国年轻、受过教育的求职者的劳动力市场结果的直接和间接影响。我们采用了两步设计：第一步，将参与实验的235个劳动力市场（如城市）中的求职者随机分配到不同的处理组，比例分别为0%、25%、50%、75%或100%。然后，在每个劳动力市场中，符合条件的求职者按照这一比例被随机分配到不同的处理组。八个月后，参与该计划的符合条件的失业青年比未参与计划的群体更有可能找到稳定的工作。然而，这些收益是暂时的，而且这些收益似乎是以那些未从计划中受益的符合条件的工人为代价的，尤其是在那些他们主要与其他受过教育的工人竞争的劳动市场，以及劳动力较弱的地区。总体而言，该计划似乎几乎没有带来实际的净收益。

abstract.text: This paper is the first to study vacancies, hires, and vacancy yields at the establishment level in the Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, a large sample of US employers. To interpret the data, we develop a simple model that identifies the flow of new vacancies and the job-filling rate for vacant positions. The fill rate moves counter to aggregate employment but rises steeply with employer growth rates in the cross section. It falls with employer size, rises with worker turnover rates, and varies by a factor of four across major industry groups. We also develop evidence that the employer-level hiring technology exhibits mild increasing returns in vacancies, and that employers rely heavily on other instruments, in addition to vacancies, as they vary hires. Building from our evidence and a generalized matching function, we construct a new index of recruiting intensity (per vacancy). Recruiting intensity partly explains the recent breakdown in the standard matching function, delivers a better-fitting empirical Beveridge curve, and accounts for a large share of fluctuations in aggregate hires. Our evidence and analysis provide useful inputs for assessing, developing, and calibrating theoretical models of search, matching, and hiring in the labor market.

10.1093/qje/qjt002.abstractZh: 本文首次研究了《就业空缺与劳动力流动调查》中美国大量雇主数据中的职位空缺、招聘情况以及空缺产出。为了解释这些数据，我们建立了一个简单模型，该模型能够识别新职位空缺的流入情况以及填补空缺的速率。填补率与总体就业水平呈反向关系，但在不同雇主的成长率方面却呈现显著上升的趋势。填补率随着雇主规模的增加而下降，随着工人流动率的上升而上升，并且在主要行业群体中差异达四倍之多。我们还发现，雇主层面的招聘技术在职位空缺较多的情况下表现出轻微的增加回报效应，而且雇主在决定招聘时除了依赖职位空缺外，还大量依赖其他因素。基于我们的研究结果和广义匹配函数，我们构建了一个新的招聘强度指数（每空缺）。该指数部分解释了标准匹配函数近期出现的波动，能够更精确地拟合经验性贝弗里奇曲线，并解释了总体招聘波动的很大一部分。我们的研究结果和分析为评估、开发和校准劳动力市场中的搜索、匹配和招聘理论模型提供了有用的依据。

abstract.text: Governments in weak states often face an armed opposition and have to decide whether to try to accommodate and contain that adversary or to try to consolidate power and monopolize violence by disarming it. When and why do governments choose to consolidate power and monopolize violence? How fast do they try to consolidate power? When does this lead to costly fighting rather than to efforts to eliminate the opposition by buying it off?
