We study an infinite-horizon model in which the government in each period decides how much to offer the opposition and the rate at which it tries to consolidate its power. The opposition can accept the offer and thereby acquiesce to the government’s efforts to consolidate, or it can fight in an attempt to disrupt those efforts. In equilibrium, the government always tries to monopolize violence when it has “coercive power” against the opposition where, roughly, coercive power is the ability to weaken the opposition by lowering its payoff to fighting. Whether the government consolidates peacefully or through costly fighting depends on the size of any “contingent spoils,” which are benefits that begin to accrue from an increase in economic activity resulting from the monopolization of violence and the higher level of security that comes with it. When contingent spoils are small, the government buys the opposition off and eliminates it as fast as is peacefully possible. When contingent spoils are large, the government tries to monopolize violence by defeating the opposition militarily.

10.1093/qje/qjt003.abstractZh: 在弱小国家的政府往往面临武装反对派，必须决定是试图安抚和遏制这一对手，还是试图巩固权力并通过解除武装来垄断暴力。政府何时以及为何选择巩固权力并垄断暴力？他们试图巩固权力的速度如何？这种情况何时会导致代价高昂的战斗，而不是通过收买反对派来消除他们？我们研究了一个无限期视界模型，在这个模型中，每个时期的政府都决定向反对派提供多少利益，以及其试图巩固权力的速度。反对派可以选择接受这些利益，从而默许政府巩固权力的努力，或者进行战斗以破坏这些努力。在均衡状态下，当政府拥有对反对派的“强制力”时，总会试图垄断暴力，这里的强制力大致是指通过降低反对派战斗的收益来削弱他们的能力。政府是通过和平方式还是代价高昂的战斗来巩固权力，取决于“附带收益”的大小。这些附带收益是指由于垄断暴力所带来的经济活动增加以及随之而来的更高安全水平而开始获得的利益。当附带收益较小时，政府会尽可能和平地收买反对派并消除他们。当附带收益较大时，政府会试图通过军事手段击败反对派来垄断暴力。

abstract.text: We develop a framework for nonparametrically identifying optimization frictions and structural elasticities using notches—discontinuities in the choice sets of agents—introduced by tax and transfer policies. Notches create excess bunching on the low-tax side and missing mass on the high-tax side of a cutoff, and they are often associated with a region of strictly dominated choice that would have zero mass in a frictionless world. By combining excess bunching (observed response attenuated by frictions) with missing mass in the dominated region (frictions), it is possible to uncover the structural elasticity that would govern behavior in the absence of frictions and arguably capture long-run behavior. We apply our framework to tax notches in Pakistan using rich administrative data. While observed bunching is large and sharp, optimization frictions are also very large as the majority of taxpayers in dominated ranges are unresponsive to tax incentives. The combination of large observed bunching and large frictions implies that the frictionless behavioral response to notches is extremely large, but the underlying structural elasticity driving this response is nevertheless modest. This highlights the inefficiency of notches: by creating extremely strong price distortions, they induce large behavioral responses even when structural elasticities are small.

10.1093/qje/qjt004.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于非参数地识别优化摩擦和结构弹性，这些摩擦和结构弹性是通过税收和转移支付政策引入的代理人选择集中的不连续性——即“缺口”。这些缺口在低税收侧造成过度聚集，在高税收侧造成质量缺失，并且通常与一个严格被支配的选择区域相关，而在无摩擦的世界中，该区域的质量为零。通过将过度聚集（受摩擦影响的观测响应）与被支配区域的质量缺失（摩擦因素）结合起来，可以揭示在没有摩擦的情况下支配行为的结构弹性，从而捕捉长期行为。我们将这一框架应用于巴基斯坦的税收缺口问题，使用了丰富的行政数据。虽然观测到的聚集现象非常明显且尖锐，但由于大多数处于被支配范围的纳税人对税收激励反应不佳，优化摩擦也非常大。大量观测到的聚集现象和巨大的摩擦因素表明，无摩擦情况下的行为反应非常大，但驱动这种反应的基本结构弹性仍然相当温和。这凸显了缺口的低效性：通过造成极其强烈的价格扭曲，即使结构弹性很小，它们也能引发巨大的行为反应。

abstract.text: The study examines the historical origins of existing cross-cultural differences in beliefs and values regarding the appropriate role of women in society. We test the hypothesis that traditional agricultural practices influenced the historical gender division of labor and the evolution of gender norms. We find that, consistent with existing hypotheses, the descendants of societies that traditionally practiced plough agriculture today have less equal gender norms, measured using reported gender-role attitudes and female participation in the workplace, politics, and entrepreneurial activities. Our results hold looking across countries, across districts within countries, and across ethnicities within districts. To test for the importance of cultural persistence, we examine the children of immigrants living in Europe and the United States. We find that even among these individuals, all born and raised in the same country, those with a heritage of traditional plough use exhibit less equal beliefs about gender roles today.

10.1093/qje/qjt005.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了现有跨文化差异的历史起源，这些差异涉及关于女性在社会中应扮演的角色的信仰和价值观。我们检验了传统农业实践是否影响了历史上的性别分工以及性别规范的演变这一假设。研究发现，与现有假设一致，那些传统上从事犁耕农业的社会后代，在性别角色观念以及女性在职场、政治和创业活动中的参与度方面，表现出更不平等的性别规范。我们的研究结果在不同国家、不同地区以及不同民族内部都得到了验证。为了检验文化延续性的重要性，我们还研究了生活在欧洲和美国的移民子女。研究发现，即使是在同一国家出生和长大的个体中，那些拥有传统犁耕农业传统的人，其关于性别角色的观念也更为不平等。

abstract.text: We study the role of establishment-specific wage premiums in generating recent increases in West German wage inequality. Models with additive fixed effects for workers and establishments are fit into four subintervals spanning the period from 1985 to 2009. We show that these models provide a good approximation to the wage structure and can explain nearly all of the dramatic rise in West German wage inequality. Our estimates suggest that the increasing dispersion of West German wages has arisen from a combination of rising heterogeneity between workers, rising dispersion in the wage premiums at different establishments, and increasing assortativeness in the assignment of workers to plants. In contrast, the idiosyncratic job-match component of wage variation is small and stable over time. Decomposing changes in mean wages between different education groups, occupations, and industries, we find that increasing plant-level heterogeneity and rising assortativeness in the assignment of workers to establishments explain a large share of the rise in inequality along all three dimensions.

10.1093/qje/qjt006.abstractZh: 我们研究了特定机构工资溢价在导致德国西部工资不平等加剧中的作用。我们将带有工人和机构固定效应的模型拟合到1985年至2009年四个子区间内。我们发现这些模型能够很好地近似描述工资结构，并可以解释德国西部工资不平等的显著上升。我们的估计表明，德国西部工资差异的扩大源于工人之间异质性的增加、不同机构工资溢价的分散性增加，以及工人分配到不同工厂的随机性增加。相比之下，工资变化的特异性成分较小且随时间保持稳定。通过对不同教育群体、职业和行业之间的平均工资变化进行分解，我们发现，工厂层面的异质性和工人分配到不同机构的随机性增加，解释了所有三个维度上不平等加剧的很大一部分原因。

abstract.text: I investigate the effect of financial innovation on portfolio risks when traders have belief disagreements. I decompose traders’ average portfolio risks into two components: the uninsurable variance, defined as portfolio risks that would obtain without belief disagreements, and the speculative variance, defined as portfolio risks that result from speculation. My main result shows that financial innovation always increases the speculative variance through two distinct channels: by generating new bets and by amplifying traders’ existing bets. When disagreements are large, these effects are sufficiently strong that financial innovation increases average portfolio risks, decreases average portfolio comovements, and generates greater speculative trading volume relative to risk-sharing volume. Moreover, a profit-seeking market maker endogenously introduces speculative assets that increase average portfolio risks.

10.1093/qje/qjt007.abstractZh: 我研究了金融创新对投资组合风险的影响，尤其是在交易者存在信念分歧的情况下。我将交易者的平均投资组合风险分解为两个组成部分：不可保险的方差，即在没有信念分歧的情况下会出现的投资组合风险；以及投机性方差，即由投机行为导致的投资组合风险。我的主要结果表明，金融创新总是通过两种不同的途径增加投机性方差：一是通过生成新的赌注，二是通过放大交易者现有的赌注。当分歧较大时，这些效应足够显著，以至于金融创新会增加平均投资组合风险，降低平均投资组合的协同性，并导致相对于风险共享而言，投机性交易量更大。此外，追求利润的市场做市商会内生性地引入投机性资产，从而增加平均投资组合风险。

abstract.text: We study a recent recruitment drive for public sector positions in Mexico. Different salaries were announced randomly across recruitment sites, and job offers were subsequently randomized. Screening relied on exams designed to measure applicants’ intellectual ability, personality, and motivation. This allows the first experimental estimates of (1) the role of financial incentives in attracting a larger and more qualified pool of applicants, (2) the elasticity of the labor supply facing the employer, and (3) the role of job attributes (distance, attractiveness of the municipal environment) in helping fill vacancies, as well as the role of wages in helping fill positions in less attractive municipalities. A theoretical model of job applications and acceptance guides the empirical inquiry. We find that higher wages attract more able applicants as measured by their IQ, personality, and proclivity toward public sector work—that is, we find no evidence of adverse selection effects on motivation; higher wage offers also increased acceptance rates, implying a labor supply elasticity of around 2 and some degree of monopsony power. Distance and worse municipal characteristics strongly decrease acceptance rates, but higher wages help bridge the recruitment gap in worse municipalities.

10.1093/qje/qjt008.abstractZh: 我们研究了墨西哥公共部门职位的最新招聘活动。不同地区的招聘网站随机发布了不同的薪资待遇，而职位 offer 也随机分配。筛选过程依赖于旨在评估申请者智力能力、性格和动机的考试。这使我们能够首次对以下问题进行实验性估计：(1) 财务激励在吸引更多且更合格的申请者方面的作用；(2) 劳动力供应对雇主的弹性；(3) 职位属性（距离、市政环境的吸引力）在填补空缺中的作用，以及工资在填补不太有吸引力的市政职位中的作用。我们建立了一个关于职位申请和接受的理论模型来指导实证研究。研究发现，更高的薪资能够吸引更多具备相应能力的申请者，这些能力体现在他们的智商、性格以及对公共部门工作的倾向上——也就是说，我们没有发现逆向选择对动机产生负面影响的证据；更高的薪资报价也提高了接受率，表明劳动力供应的弹性约为2，并且存在一定程度的买方垄断力量。距离和较差的市政条件会显著降低接受率，但更高的薪资有助于填补较差市政地区的招聘空缺。

abstract.text: We use the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989 to show that personal relationships which individuals maintain for noneconomic reasons can be an important determinant of regional economic growth. We show that West German households who had social ties to East Germany in 1989 experienced a persistent rise in their personal incomes after the fall of the Berlin Wall. Moreover, the presence of these households significantly affects economic performance at the regional level: it increases the returns to entrepreneurial activity, the share of households who become entrepreneurs, and the likelihood that firms based within a given West German region invest in East Germany. As a result, West German regions that (for idiosyncratic reasons) have a high concentration of households with social ties to the East exhibit substantially higher growth in income per capita in the early 1990s. A one standard deviation rise in the share of households with social ties to East Germany in 1989 is associated with a 4.7 percentage point rise in income per capita over six years. We interpret our findings as evidence of a causal link between social ties and regional economic development.

10.1093/qje/qjt009.abstractZh: 我们以1989年柏林墙的倒塌为切入点，表明个人出于非经济原因而维持的人际关系可以成为区域经济增长的重要决定因素。我们发现，1989年时与东德有社会联系的西德家庭，在柏林墙倒塌后其个人收入持续上升。此外，这些家庭的存在显著影响了区域层面的经济表现：它们增加了创业活动的回报、成为企业家的家庭比例，以及位于特定西德地区的企业向东德投资的意愿。因此，那些因特定原因而拥有大量与东德有社会联系的西德家庭所在的地区，在1990年代初的人均收入增长明显更高。1989年时，与东德有社会联系的家庭比例每上升一个标准差，人均收入在六年内就会上升4.7个百分点。我们将这些发现视为社会联系与区域经济发展之间因果关系的证据。

abstract.text: We examine the risk-taking behavior of money market funds during the financial crisis of 2007–2010. We find that (1) money market funds experienced an unprecedented expansion in their risk-taking opportunities; (2) funds had strong incentives to take on risk because fund inflows were highly responsive to fund yields; (3) funds sponsored by financial intermediaries with more money fund business took on more risk; and (4) funds suffered runs as a result of their risk taking. This evidence suggests that money market funds lack safety because they have strong incentives to take on risk when the opportunity arises and are vulnerable to runs.

10.1093/qje/qjt010.abstractZh: 我们研究了2007-2010年金融危机期间货币市场基金的风险承担行为。研究发现：(1)货币市场基金的风险承担机会出现了前所未有的扩大；(2)由于基金流入对基金收益反应强烈，基金有强烈的冒险动机；(3)由资金业务较多的金融中介机构管理的基金承担了更多风险；(4)由于冒险行为，基金出现了资金挤兑。这些证据表明，货币市场基金缺乏安全性，因为它们在有机会时会有强烈的冒险动机，并且容易遭受资金挤兑。

abstract.text: Using data from South Asia, this article examines how arranged marriage cultivates rivalry among sisters. During marriage search, parents with multiple daughters reduce the reservation quality for an older daughter's groom, rushing her marriage to allow sufficient time to marry off her younger sisters. Relative to younger brothers, younger sisters increase a girl's marriage risk; relative to younger singleton sisters, younger twin sisters have the same effect. These effects intensify in marriage markets with lower sex ratios or greater parental involvement in marriage arrangements. In contrast, older sisters delay a girl's marriage. Because girls leave school when they marry and face limited earning opportunities when they reach adulthood, the number of sisters has well-being consequences over the life cycle. Younger sisters cause earlier school-leaving, lower literacy, a match to a husband with less education and a less skilled occupation, and (marginally) lower adult economic status. Data from a broader set of countries indicate that these cross-sister pressures on marriage age are common throughout the developing world, although the schooling costs vary by setting. JEL Codes: J1, I25, O15.

10.1093/qje/qjt011.abstractZh: 本文利用南亚的数据，探讨了包办婚姻如何加剧姐妹间的竞争。在寻找配偶的过程中，拥有多个女儿的父母会优先选择年长的女儿的未婚夫，以加快其婚嫁进程，从而有更多时间将年幼的姐妹嫁出去。与年幼的弟弟相比，年幼的妹妹会增加女孩的婚姻风险；与年幼的单生妹妹相比，年幼的双胞胎妹妹也有同样的影响。在性别比例较低或父母对婚姻安排更为干预的婚姻市场中，这些影响会进一步加剧。相反，年长的姐姐则会推迟女孩的婚嫁时间。由于女孩在结婚时就会辍学，成年后获得的就业机会也有限，因此姐妹数量对女性的福祉在整个生命周期中都会产生重要影响。年幼的妹妹会导致女孩更早辍学、识字率较低、嫁给受教育程度较低的丈夫，并从事技能较低的职业，从而（在某种程度上）降低其成年后的经济地位。来自更多国家的数据表明，这种针对婚姻年龄的姐妹间竞争在发展中国家普遍存在，尽管不同地区的教育成本有所不同。JEL代码：J1, I25, O15。

abstract.text: This article shows that official statistics substantially underestimate the net foreign asset positions of rich countries because they fail to capture most of the assets held by households in offshore tax havens. Drawing on a unique Swiss data set and exploiting systematic anomalies in countries’ portfolio investment positions, I find that around 8% of the global financial wealth of households is held in tax havens, three-quarters of which goes unrecorded. On the basis of plausible assumptions, accounting for unrecorded assets turns the eurozone, officially the world’s second largest net debtor, into a net creditor. It also reduces the U.S. net debt significantly. The results shed new light on global imbalances and challenge the widespread view that after a decade of poor-to-rich capital flows, external assets are now in poor countries and debts in rich countries. I provide concrete proposals to improve international statistics.

10.1093/qje/qjt012.abstractZh: 本文指出，官方统计数据严重低估了富裕国家的净外国资产状况，因为它们未能反映家庭在离岸避税天堂持有的大部分资产。通过利用瑞士的独特数据集以及各国投资组合投资位置的系统性异常，我发现全球家庭金融资产中约有8%存放在避税天堂，其中四分之三未被记录。在合理的假设基础上，将未记录的资产纳入核算后，欧元区——官方上全球第二大净债务国——实际上变成了净债权人。这一结果还显著降低了美国的净债务。这些发现为全球失衡问题提供了新的视角，并挑战了“经过十年从贫到富的资本流动后，外部资产现在位于贫穷国家，债务则位于富裕国家”这一普遍观点。我提出了具体的改进国际统计数据的建议。

abstract.text: To ensure that individual actors take certain actions, community enforcement may be required. This can present a rules-versus-discretion dilemma: it can become impossible to employ discretion based on information that is not widely held, because the wider community is unable to verify how the information was used. Instead, actions may need to conform to simple and widely verifiable rules. We study when discretion in the form of exceptions to a simple rule can be implemented, if the information is shared by the action taker and a second party, who is able to verify for the larger group that an exception is warranted. In particular, we compare protocols where the second party excuses the action taker from taking the action ex ante with protocols where the second party instead forgives a rule-breaking actor ex post.

10.1093/qje/qjt013.abstractZh: 为了确保各个参与者采取某些行动，可能需要社区层面的强制实施。这可能会带来规则与自由裁量之间的困境：如果信息并未被广泛知晓，那么基于这些信息进行自由裁量就变得不可能，因为更广泛的社区无法验证这些信息是如何被使用的。因此，行动可能需要遵循简单且易于验证的规则。我们研究在何种情况下，可以以对简单规则的例外形式实施自由裁量，前提是信息被行动实施者和另一方共享，而后者能够向更广泛的群体证明例外情况是合理的。具体来说，我们比较了那种情况下，另一方在事前为行动实施者免除该行为的情况，以及另一种情况下，另一方在事后为违反规则的行动者宽恕的情况。

abstract.text: When and how do democratic institutions deliver accountable government? In addressing this broad question, we focus on the role played by political norms—specifically, the extent to which leaders abuse office for personal gain and the extent to which citizens punish such transgressions. We show how qualitatively distinct political norms can coexist because of a dynamic complementarity, in which citizens’ willingness to punish transgressions is raised when they expect such punishments to be used in the future. We seek to understand the emergence of accountability by analysing transitions between norms. To do so, we extend the analysis to include the possibility that, at certain times, a segment of voters are (behaviorally) intolerant of transgressions. Our mechanism highlights the role of leaders, offering an account of how their actions can instigate enduring change, within a fixed set of formal institutions, by disrupting prevailing political norms. We show how such changes do not depend on “sun spots” to trigger coordination, and are asymmetric in effect—a series of good leaders can (and eventually will) improve norms, whereas bad leaders cannot damage them.

10.1093/qje/qjt014.abstractZh: 民主制度何时以及如何实现政府问责？针对这一广泛问题，我们重点关注政治规范的作用——具体来说，领导者滥用权力谋取个人利益的程度，以及公民对这类行为进行惩罚的程度。我们发现，由于动态互补性，性质不同的政治规范可以共存。当公民预期未来会实施惩罚时，他们更愿意对违规行为进行惩罚。我们试图通过分析规范之间的转变来理解问责制的出现。为此，我们将分析范围扩展到某些时候，部分选民在行为上无法容忍违规行为。我们的机制强调了领导者的作用，解释了他们的行为如何在固定的正式制度框架内通过打破现有的政治规范来引发持久的变化。我们发现，这种变化并不依赖于“偶然因素”来触发协调，其效果具有对称性——优秀的领导者能够改善规范，而糟糕的领导者则无法破坏这些规范。

abstract.text: This article studies the role of employer behavior in generating “negative duration dependence”—the adverse effect of a longer unemployment spell—by sending fictitious résumés to real job postings in 100 U.S. cities. Our results indicate that the likelihood of receiving a callback for an interview significantly decreases with the length of a worker’s unemployment spell, with the majority of this decline occurring during the first eight months. We explore how this effect varies with local labor market conditions and find that duration dependence is stronger when the local labor market is tighter. This result is consistent with the prediction of a broad class of screening models in which employers use the unemployment spell length as a signal of unobserved productivity and recognize that this signal is less informative in weak labor markets.

10.1093/qje/qjt015.abstractZh: 本文研究了雇主行为在产生“负时长依赖性”中的作用——即更长的失业期所带来的不利影响。我们通过向美国100个城市的实际招聘信息发送虚构的简历来进行研究。研究结果表明，工人失业时间的长短显著影响了获得面试回电的可能性，这种下降主要发生在失业的前八个月内。我们进一步探讨了这一效应如何随当地劳动力市场状况而变化，发现当当地劳动力市场较为紧张时，负时长依赖性更为明显。这一结果与一系列筛选模型的预测一致，这些模型认为雇主会将失业时间作为未观察到的生产力的信号，并意识到在疲软的劳动力市场中，这一信号的信息量较少。

abstract.text: International trade agreements are an important element of the world economic system, but questions remain as to their purpose. The terms-of-trade hypothesis posits that countries use tariffs in part to improve their terms of trade and that trade agreements cause them to internalize the costs that such terms-of-trade shifts impose on other countries. This article investigates whether the most-favored-nation (MFN) tariffs set by World Trade Organization (WTO) members in the Uruguay Round are consistent with the terms-of-trade hypothesis. We present a model of multilateral trade negotiations featuring endogenous participation that leads the resulting tariff schedules to display terms-of-trade effects. Specifically, the model predicts that the level of the importer’s tariff resulting from negotiations should be negatively related to the product of two terms: exporter concentration, as measured by the Herfindahl-Hirschman index (sum of squared export shares), and the importer’s market power, as measured by the inverse elasticity of export supply, on a product-by-product basis. We test this hypothesis using data on tariffs, trade, and production across more than 30 WTO countries and find strong support. We estimate that the internalization of terms of trade effects through WTO negotiations has lowered the average tariff of these countries by 22% to 27% compared to its noncooperative level.

10.1093/qje/qjt016.abstractZh: 国际贸易协定是世界经济体系中的重要组成部分，但其目的仍存在疑问。贸易条件假说认为，各国通过关税在一定程度上改善自身的贸易条件，而贸易协定则促使这些国家内部化因贸易条件变动而对其他国家造成的成本。本文探讨了世界贸易组织成员国在乌拉圭回合谈判中设定的最惠国关税是否符合贸易条件假说。我们提出了一个多边贸易谈判模型，该模型包含内生性参与因素，使得最终的关税安排能够体现贸易条件效应。具体而言，该模型预测，通过谈判确定的进口关税水平应与两个因素的乘积呈负相关：一是出口企业集中度，以赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数衡量（即出口份额的平方和）；二是进口企业的市场力量，以出口供应弹性倒数衡量。我们利用超过30个世贸组织国家的关税、贸易和生产数据对这一假设进行了检验，发现其具有较强支持性。我们估计，通过世贸组织谈判内部化贸易条件效应后，这些国家的平均关税比非合作状态下降低了22%至27%。

abstract.text: We formulate a test of the fungibility of money based on parallel shifts in the prices of different quality grades of a commodity. We embed the test in a discrete-choice model of product quality choice and estimate the model using panel microdata on gasoline purchases. We find that when gasoline prices rise consumers substitute to lower octane gasoline, to an extent that cannot be explained by income effects. Across a wide range of specifications, we consistently reject the null hypothesis that households treat "gas money" as fungible with other income. We compare the empirical fit of three psychological models of decision-making. A simple model of category budgeting fits the data well, with models of loss aversion and salience both capturing important features of the time series.

10.1093/qje/qjt018.abstractZh: 我们基于不同质量等级商品价格的平行变化，提出了一个关于货币可替代性的检验方法。我们将这一检验嵌入到一个离散选择模型中，该模型用于分析产品品质选择，并通过汽油购买的相关面板微观数据对模型进行估计。研究发现，当汽油价格上涨时，消费者会转向使用辛烷值较低的汽油，这种替代行为无法用收入效应来解释。在广泛的参数设定下，我们始终拒绝“家庭将‘汽油钱’视为与其他收入可替代的货币”这一零假设。我们还比较了三种决策心理模型的实证拟合度。简单的类别预算模型与数据非常吻合，而损失厌恶和显著性模型也捕捉到了时间序列中的重要特征。

abstract.text: Accommodating couples has been a long-standing issue in the design of centralized labor market clearinghouses for doctors and psychologists, because couples view pairs of jobs as complements. A stable matching may not exist when couples are present. This article’s main result is that a stable matching exists when there are relatively few couples and preference lists are sufficiently short relative to market size. We also discuss incentives in markets with couples. We relate these theoretical results to the job market for psychologists, in which stable matchings exist for all years of the data, despite the presence of couples.

10.1093/qje/qjt019.abstractZh: 在医生和心理学家集中式劳动力市场清算系统的设计中，如何安排夫妻配对一直是一个长期存在的问题，因为夫妻通常将工作视为互补关系。当存在夫妻配对时，可能不存在稳定的匹配。本文的主要结论是：当夫妻数量相对较少，且偏好列表相对于市场规模足够短时，存在稳定的匹配。我们还讨论了有夫妻参与的市场中的激励问题。我们将这些理论结果与心理学家的工作市场联系起来，发现在所有数据年份中，尽管存在夫妻配对，但仍然存在稳定的匹配。

abstract.text: We investigate the consumption consequences of the 2006–9 housing collapse using the highly unequal geographic distribution of wealth losses across the United States. We estimate a large elasticity of consumption with respect to housing net worth of 0.6 to 0.8, which soundly rejects the hypothesis of full consumption risk-sharing. The average marginal propensity to consume (MPC) out of housing wealth is 5–7 cents with substantial heterogeneity across ZIP codes. ZIP codes with poorer and more levered households have a significantly higher MPC out of housing wealth. In line with the MPC result, ZIP codes experiencing larger wealth losses, particularly those with poorer and more levered households, experience a larger reduction in credit limits, refinancing likelihood, and credit scores. Our findings highlight the role of debt and the geographic distribution of wealth shocks in explaining the large and unequal decline in consumption from 2006 to 2009.

10.1093/qje/qjt020.abstractZh: 我们研究了2006至2009年房地产崩盘对消费的影响，重点关注美国财富损失在地理上的高度不平等分布。我们估计出消费对住房净值有0.6到0.8的高弹性，这一结果强烈反驳了完全消费风险共享的假设。从住房财富中消费的平均边际倾向为5到7美分，且在不同邮政编码区之间存在显著差异。财富较贫乏且负债较高的家庭所在邮政编码区的消费边际倾向明显更高。与边际倾向的结果一致，那些财富损失较大的邮政编码区，尤其是那些财富较贫乏且负债较高的家庭所在的区域，其信用额度、再融资可能性以及信用评分的下降幅度也更大。我们的研究结果强调了债务以及财富冲击在地理分布上的作用，这些因素共同解释了2006至2009年间消费大幅且不平等的下降。

abstract.text: Can protests cause political change, or are they merely symptoms of underlying shifts in policy preferences? We address this question by studying the Tea Party movement in the United States, which rose to prominence through coordinated rallies across the country on Tax Day, April 15, 2009. We exploit variation in rainfall on the day of these rallies as an exogenous source of variation in attendance. We show that good weather at this initial, coordinating event had significant consequences for the subsequent local strength of the movement, increased public support for Tea Party positions, and led to more Republican votes in the 2010 midterm elections. Policy making was also affected, as incumbents responded to large protests in their district by voting more conservatively in Congress. Our estimates suggest significant multiplier effects: an additional protester increased the number of Republican votes by a factor well above 1. Together our results show that protests can build political movements that ultimately affect policy making and that they do so by influencing political views rather than solely through the revelation of existing political preferences.

10.1093/qje/qjt021.abstractZh: 抗议活动能否引发政治变革，还是仅仅反映了政策偏好方面的潜在变化？我们通过研究美国的茶党运动来探讨这个问题。该运动在2009年4月15日税收日通过全国范围内的联合集会而崭露头角。我们利用这些集会当天降雨量的差异作为外部变量，以解释出席情况的变化。研究表明，这一初始的联合集会在天气良好的情况下，对后续茶党运动的本地影响力产生了显著影响，增加了公众对茶党立场的支持，并在2010年的中期选举中使共和党获得的选票增加。政策制定也受到了影响，因为现任政客们在其选区发生大规模抗议活动时，会在国会中采取更为保守的投票立场。我们的估计表明，抗议活动具有显著的乘数效应：每增加一名抗议者，共和党获得的选票数量增加的幅度远超1。综上所述，我们的研究结果表明，抗议活动能够推动政治运动的发展，并最终影响政策制定，其影响方式是通过改变政治观点，而不仅仅是揭示现有的政治偏好。

abstract.text: This article uses linked worker-firm data in the United States to estimate the transitional costs associated with reallocating workers from newly regulated industries to other sectors of the economy in the context of new environmental regulations. The focus on workers rather than industries as the unit of analysis allows me to examine previously unobserved economic outcomes such as nonemployment and long-run earnings losses from job transitions, both of which are critical to understanding the reallocative costs associated with these policies. Using plant-level panel variation induced by the 1990 Clean Air Act Amendments (CAAA), I find that the reallocative costs of environmental policy are significant. Workers in newly regulated plants experienced, in aggregate, more than $5.4 billion in forgone earnings for the years after the change in policy. Most of these costs are driven by nonemployment and lower earnings in future employment, highlighting the importance of longitudinal data for characterizing the costs and consequences of labor market adjustment. Relative to the estimated benefits of the 1990 CAAA, these one-time transitional costs are small.

10.1093/qje/qjt022.abstractZh: 本文利用美国的相关数据，估算了在新环境法规背景下，工人从新受监管的行业重新分配到经济其他部门所带来的过渡成本。以工人而非行业作为分析单位，使我能够研究一些以前未被观察到的经济结果，例如因工作转换而导致的非就业状态以及长期收入损失，这些结果对于理解这些政策带来的重新分配成本至关重要。通过1990年《清洁空气法修正案》引发的工厂层面面板变化，我发现环境政策的重新分配成本相当显著。在新受监管的工厂中，工人在政策变更后的几年里总共损失了超过54亿美元的收入。这些成本主要由非就业状态以及未来就业中的较低收入所驱动，这凸显了纵向数据在描述劳动力市场调整的成本和后果方面的重要性。与1990年《清洁空气法修正案》带来的估计收益相比，这些一次性过渡成本相对较小。

abstract.text: Using a unique 10-year panel that includes more than 13,300 expected stock market return probability distributions, we find that executives are severely miscalibrated, producing distributions that are too narrow: realized market returns are within the executives’ 80% confidence intervals only 36% of the time. We show that executives reduce the lower bound of the forecast confidence interval during times of high market uncertainty; however, ex post miscalibration is worst during periods of high uncertainty. We also find that executives who are miscalibrated about the stock market show similar miscalibration regarding their own firms’ prospects. Finally, firms with miscalibrated executives seem to follow more aggressive corporate policies: investing more and using more debt financing.

10.1093/qje/qjt023.abstractZh: 我们利用一个独特的10年面板数据，该数据包含了超过13,300个预期的股票市场回报概率分布。研究发现，高管们的预测偏差非常严重，他们得出的分布范围过于狭窄：实际市场回报只有在36%的情况下落在高管的80%置信区间之内。我们指出，在高市场不确定性时期，高管们会降低预测置信区间的下限；然而，事后偏差在不确定性最高的时期最为严重。此外，我们发现，对股票市场预测偏差的高管们，在其所在公司的前景预测上也存在类似的偏差。最后，那些高管预测偏差较大的公司，似乎会采取更为激进的企业政策：增加投资并更多地使用债务融资。

abstract.text: In many regulated markets, private, third-party auditors are chosen and paid by the firms that they audit, potentially creating a conflict of interest. This article reports on a two-year field experiment in the Indian state of Gujarat that sought to curb such a conflict by altering the market structure for environmental audits of industrial plants to incentivize accurate reporting. There are three main results. First, the status quo system was largely corrupted, with auditors systematically reporting plant emissions just below the standard, although true emissions were typically higher. Second, the treatment caused auditors to report more truthfully and very significantly lowered the fraction of plants that were falsely reported as compliant with pollution standards. Third, treatment plants, in turn, reduced their pollution emissions. The results suggest reformed incentives for third-party auditors can improve their reporting and make regulation more effective.

10.1093/qje/qjt024.abstractZh: 在许多受监管的市场中，第三方审计员由被审计的公司选择并支付报酬，这可能会导致利益冲突。本文报道了一项在印度古吉拉特邦进行的为期两年的实地实验，该实验通过改变工业工厂环境审计的市场结构，旨在减少这种利益冲突，从而激励审计员提供更准确的报告。实验取得了三个主要成果：首先，现状下的审计体系严重失效，审计员系统性地报告了略低于标准的工厂排放量，尽管实际排放量通常更高。其次，新的激励措施使审计员更加如实报告，并显著降低了被错误报告为符合污染标准的工厂比例。第三，受激励的工厂也减少了污染排放。这些结果表明，对第三方审计员进行改革性的激励措施可以提高他们的报告质量，并使监管更加有效。

abstract.text: Using population and product consumption data from the Demographic and Health Surveys, I construct comparable measures of inequality and migration for 65 countries, including some of the poorest countries in the world. I find that the urban-rural gap accounts for 40% of mean country inequality and much of its cross-country variation. One out of every four or five individuals raised in rural areas moves to urban areas as a young adult, where they earn much higher incomes than nonmigrant rural permanent residents. Equally, one out of every four or five individuals raised in urban areas moves to rural areas as a young adult, where they earn much lower incomes than their nonmigrant urban cousins. These flows and relative incomes are suggestive of a world where the population sorts itself geographically on the basis of its human capital and skill. I show that a simple model of this sort explains the urban-rural gap in living standards.

10.1093/qje/qjt025.abstractZh: 利用人口和产品消费数据，我从人口与健康调查中构建了65个国家的不平等和迁移情况的比较指标，其中包括一些世界上最贫穷的国家。我发现，城乡差距占国家平均不平等的40%，也解释了国家间不平等的很大一部分差异。每四到五个在农村地区长大的个体中，就有一个在年轻时期迁移到城市地区，他们在城市地区的收入远高于非迁移的农村常住人口。同样，每四到五个在城市地区长大的个体中，也有一个在年轻时期迁移到农村地区，他们在农村地区的收入远低于非迁移的城市同胞。这些流动和相对收入表明，人口会根据其人力资本和技能在地理上进行自我排序。我证明，这样一个简单的模型可以解释城乡生活水平的差距。

abstract.text: The inertia of the local currency prices of traded goods in the face of exchange rate changes is a well-documented phenomenon in international economics. This paper develops a structural model to identify the sources of this local currency price stability and applies it to micro data from the beer market. The empirical procedure exploits manufacturers’ and retailers’ first-order conditions in conjunction with detailed information on the frequency of price adjustments following exchange rate changes to quantify the relative importance of local nontraded cost components, markup adjustment by manufacturers and retailers, and nominal price rigidities in the incomplete transmission of such changes to prices. We find that, on average, approximately 60 percent of the incomplete exchange rate pass-through is due to local nontraded costs; 8 percent to markup adjustment; 30 percent to the existence of own-brand price adjustment costs, and 1 percent to the indirect/strategic effect of such costs, though these results vary considerably across individual brands according to their market shares.

10.1093/restud/rds015.abstractZh: 在汇率变动的情况下，交易商品当地货币价格的惯性现象在国际经济学中已被广泛记录。本文构建了一个结构模型，以识别这种当地货币价格稳定的来源，并将其应用于啤酒市场的微观数据。实证分析利用制造商和零售商的一阶条件，结合汇率变动后价格调整频率的详细信息，来量化当地非贸易成本成分、制造商和零售商的价格调整幅度，以及名义价格刚性在汇率变动向价格传递过程中的相对重要性。研究发现，平均而言，约60%的汇率不完全传递是由于当地非贸易成本造成的；8%是由于价格调整幅度；30%是由于自有品牌价格调整成本的存在；1%是由于这些成本的间接/战略效应，不过这些结果因品牌的市场份额不同而有所差异。

abstract.text: This paper studies the maximum level of cooperation that can be sustained in perfect Bayesian equilibrium in repeated games with network monitoring, where players observe each other's actions either perfectly or not at all. The foundational result is that the maximum level of cooperation can be robustly sustained in grim trigger strategies. If players are equally well monitored, comparative statics on the maximum level of cooperation are highly tractable and depend on the monitoring technology only through a simple statistic, its effective contagiousness. Typically, cooperation in the provision of pure public goods is greater in larger groups, while cooperation in the provision of divisible public goods is greater in smaller groups, and making monitoring less uncertain in the second-order stochastic dominance sense increases cooperation. For fixed monitoring networks, a new notion of network centrality is developed, which determines which players cooperate more in a given network, as well as which networks support greater cooperation.

10.1093/restud/rds016.abstractZh: 本文研究了在具有网络监控的重复博弈中，能够在完美贝叶斯均衡下持续达到的最大合作水平。在这种博弈中，玩家要么完全观察到彼此的行为，要么根本无法观察到。基本结论是，即使在严峻的触发策略下，最大合作水平也能得到稳健的维持。如果玩家受到同等的监控，关于最大合作水平的状态比较分析就变得非常容易处理，并且仅依赖于监控技术的简单统计量——其有效传染性。通常，在提供纯公共物品时，较大群体中的合作程度更高；而在提供可分割公共物品时，较小群体中的合作程度更高。在二阶随机优势意义上，增加监控的确定性有助于提升合作水平。对于固定的监控网络，本文提出了一种新的网络中心性概念，该概念能够确定在给定网络中哪些玩家更合作，以及哪些网络能够支持更大的合作水平。

abstract.text: Missing values are endemic in the data sets available to econometricians. This paper suggests a semiparametrically efficient likelihood-based approach to deal with general non-ignorable missing data problems for discrete choice models. Our concern is when the dependent variable and/or covariates are unobserved for some sampling units. A supplementary random sample of observations on all covariates may be available. The key insight of this paper is the recognition of non-response as a modification of choice-based (CB) samples. Semiparametrically efficient generalized method of moments (GMM) estimation appropriate for CB samples is then adapted for the non-response framework considered in this paper. Simulation results for various GMM estimators proposed here are very encouraging.

10.1093/restud/rds018.abstractZh: 在计量经济学家可用的数据集中，缺失值是一种普遍现象。本文提出了一种半参数高效的概率论基础方法，用于处理离散选择模型中的一般非可忽略性缺失数据问题。我们的关注点在于，某些抽样单元的因变量和/或协变量可能未被观测到。尽管如此，关于所有协变量的补充随机样本观测数据可能仍然存在。本文的核心见解在于将无响应视为对基于选择的样本的一种修正。因此，本文为无响应框架调整了适用于基于选择的样本的半参数高效广义矩估计方法。本文提出的各种广义矩估计方法的模拟结果非常令人鼓舞。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the effect immigration has on the wages of native workers. Unlike most previous work, we estimate wage effects along the distribution of native wages. We derive a flexible empirical strategy that does not rely on pre-allocating immigrants to particular skill groups. In our empirical analysis, we demonstrate that immigrants downgrade considerably upon arrival. As for the effects on native wages, we find a pattern of effects whereby immigration depresses wages below the 20th percentile of the wage distribution but leads to slight wage increases in the upper part of the wage distribution. This pattern mirrors the evidence on the location of immigrants in the wage distribution. We suggest that possible explanations for the overall slightly positive effect on native wages, besides standard immigration surplus arguments, could involve deviations of immigrant remuneration from contribution to production either because of initial mismatch or immigrant downgrading.

10.1093/restud/rds019.abstractZh: 本文分析了移民对本地工人工资的影响。与以往大多数研究不同，我们沿着本地工资的分布来估算工资效应。我们提出了一种灵活的实证策略，不依赖于将移民预先分配到特定的技能群体。在我们的实证分析中，我们发现移民在抵达后会出现显著的工资下降。至于对本地工资的影响，我们发现移民的进入会导致工资低于工资分布的第20百分位的趋势，但在工资分布的上层则会导致轻微的工资增长。这一模式与移民在工资分布中的位置相关的证据相吻合。我们认为，除了标准的移民剩余效应之外，对本地工资整体略有正面影响的可能解释还包括移民的报酬与生产贡献之间的偏差，这种偏差可能是由于初始的不匹配或移民自身的工资下降所导致的。

abstract.text: We solve a multi-period model of strategic trading with long-lived information in multiple assets with correlated innovations in fundamental values. Market makers in each asset can only condition their pricing functions on trading in each asset. Using daily non-public data from the New York Stock Exchange, we test the model's predictions on the conditional and unconditional lead–lag relations of institutional order flow and returns within portfolios. We find support for the model prediction of positive autocorrelations in portfolio returns as well as the predictions for how informed order flow positively predicts future returns and future informed order flow. We show that these relations strengthen for portfolios formed from assets within the same industry, which likely have higher correlation of fundamental values. Furthermore, we discuss issues that arise when testing implications of strategic models with imperfect proxies for the underlying strategic behaviour.

10.1093/restud/rds020.abstractZh: 我们解决了一个多期战略交易模型，该模型涉及具有长期信息的多种资产，这些资产的基本价值存在相关性的创新。每个资产的市场做市商只能根据每种资产的交易情况来设定其定价函数。利用纽约证券交易所的每日非公开数据，我们测试了该模型对机构订单流和投资组合回报的条件性和无条件领先-滞后关系的预测。我们发现，模型预测投资组合回报的正自相关性得到了支持，同时也验证了知情订单流如何积极预测未来回报以及未来知情订单流的影响。我们还发现，对于来自同一行业的资产组成的投资组合，这些关系更为显著，因为这些资产的基本价值可能具有更高的相关性。此外，我们还讨论了在测试具有不完美代理的战略模型对潜在战略行为的影响时可能出现的问题。

abstract.text: We examine a model of long-term contracting in which the buyer is privately informed about the stochastic process by which her value for a good evolves. In addition, the realized values are also private information. We characterize a class of environments in which the profit-maximizing long-term contract offered by a monopolist takes an especially simple structure: we derive sufficient conditions on primitives under which the optimal contract consists of a menu of deterministic sequences of static contracts. Within each sequence, higher realized values lead to greater quantity provision; however, an increasing proportion of buyer types are excluded over time, eventually leading to inefficiently early termination of the relationship. Moreover, the menu choices differ by future generosity, with more costly (up front) plans guaranteeing greater quantity provision in the future. Thus, the seller screens process information in the initial period and then progressively screens across realized values so as to reduce the information rents paid in future periods.

10.1093/restud/rds021.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个长期契约模型，在该模型中，买方能够私下了解商品价值的随机变化过程。此外，实际达成的价值也是私人信息。我们描述了一类环境，在这种环境下，垄断者提供的利润最大化长期契约具有特别简单的结构：我们推导出了关于原始数据的充分条件，根据这些条件，最优契约由一系列确定性的静态契约序列组成。在每个序列中，更高的实际价值会导致更多的供应；然而，随着时间的推移，越来越多的买方类型被排除在外，最终导致关系过早的无效终止。此外，不同的未来慷慨程度决定了不同的选择，更昂贵（前期支付更多）的计划能够确保在未来提供更多的供应。因此，卖方在初期筛选过程信息，然后随着实际价值的增加逐步筛选，以减少未来时期的信息租金。

abstract.text: This article investigates how precisely short-term, job search-oriented training programs as opposed to long-term, human capital intensive training programs work. We evaluate and compare their effects on time until job entry, stability of employment, and earnings. Further, we examine the heterogeneity of treatment effects according to the timing of training during unemployment as well as across different subgroups of participants. We find that participating in short-term training reduces the remaining time in unemployment and moderately increases job stability. Long-term training programs initially prolong the remaining time in unemployment, but once the scheduled program end is reached participants exit to employment at a much faster rate than without training. In addition, they benefit from substantially more stable employment spells and higher earnings. Overall, long-term training programs are well effective in supporting the occupational advancement of very heterogeneous groups of participants, including those with generally weak labor market prospects. However, from a fiscal perspective only the low-cost short-term training schemes are cost efficient in the short run.

10.1093/restud/rds022.abstractZh: 本文探讨了短期、以求职为导向的培训计划与长期、需要大量人力资本的培养计划在效果上的差异。我们评估并比较了这两种培训计划对就业进入时间、就业稳定性以及收入的影响。此外，我们还研究了培训时间在不同失业阶段以及不同参与者群体中的效果差异。研究发现，参与短期培训可以缩短失业时间，并适度提高就业稳定性。长期培训计划虽然最初会延长失业时间，但一旦计划结束，参与者离开失业状态的速率比未接受培训的要快得多。此外，长期培训还能带来更稳定的就业状况和高收入。总体而言，长期培训计划对于支持不同背景的参与者（包括那些劳动力市场前景一般较差的群体）的职业发展非常有效。然而，从财政角度来看，只有低成本、短期的培训计划在短期内具有成本效益。

abstract.text: This article develops an elementary theory of global supply chains. We consider a world economy with an arbitrary number of countries, one factor of production, a continuum of intermediate goods and one final good. Production of the final good is sequential and subject to mistakes. In the unique free trade equilibrium, countries with lower probabilities of making mistakes at all stages specialize in later stages of production. Using this simple theoretical framework, we offer a first look at how vertical specialization shapes the interdependence of nations.

10.1093/restud/rds023.abstractZh: 本文发展了一种关于全球供应链的基本理论。我们考虑一个由任意数量的国家、一种生产要素、一系列中间产品和一种最终产品构成的世界经济体系。最终产品的生产是顺序进行的，并且可能会出错。在独特的自由贸易均衡状态下，那些在各个阶段犯错概率较低的国家会专门从事生产的后期阶段。基于这一简单的理论框架，我们首次探讨了垂直专业化如何塑造国家的相互依赖性。

abstract.text: We use variation in the degree of development of local credit markets and matched employer–employee data to assess the role of the firm as an internal credit market. We find that firms operating in less financially developed markets offer lower entry wages but faster wage growth than firms in more financially developed markets. This helps firms finance their operations by implicitly raising funds from workers. We control for local market fixed effects and only exploit time variation in the degree of local financial development induced by an exogenous liberalization, so that the effect we find is unlikely to reflect unobserved local factors that systematically affect wage–tenure profiles. We estimate that the amount of credit generated by implicit lending within the firm is economically important and can be as large as 30 percent of the bank lending. Consistent with credit market imperfections opening up trade opportunities within the firm, we find that the internal rate of return of implicit loans lies between the rate at which workers savings are remunerated in the market and the rate that firms pay on their loans from banks.

10.1093/restud/rds024.abstractZh: 我们利用当地信贷市场发展程度的差异以及匹配的雇主与雇员数据，来评估公司作为内部信贷市场的作用。研究发现，在金融发展程度较低的市场中运营的企业，其进入门槛较低，但工资增长速度较快。这有助于企业通过向员工隐性融资来为运营提供资金。我们控制了当地市场的固定效应，并仅考虑了由外部自由化引起的当地金融发展程度的时变效应，因此我们发现的结果不太可能反映那些系统性影响工资-任期关系的未观测到当地因素。我们估计，企业内部通过隐性借贷产生的信贷金额在经济上非常重要，可能高达银行贷款的30%。与信贷市场不完善为企业内部创造交易机会相一致，我们发现隐性贷款的内部回报率介于工人储蓄在市场上的报酬率与企业从银行借款的利率之间。

abstract.text: This article studies different methods of assigning a good to budget-constrained agents. Schemes that assign the good randomly and allow resale may outperform the competitive market in terms of Utilitarian efficiency. The socially optimal mechanism involves random assignment at a discount—an in-kind subsidy—and a cash incentive to discourage low-valuation individuals from claiming the good.

10.1093/restud/rds025.abstractZh: 本文研究了为预算有限的个体分配商品的不同方法。随机分配商品并允许转售的方案在功利效率方面可能优于竞争市场。社会最优机制包括以折扣价进行随机分配——即实物补贴——以及提供现金激励，以阻止价值较低的个体领取商品。

abstract.text: This article analyzes participation and information aggregation in a common-value election with continuous private signals. In equilibrium, some citizens ignore their private information and abstain from voting, in deference to those with higher-quality signals. Even as the number of highly informed peers grows large, however, citizens with only moderate expertise continue voting, so that voter participation remains at realistic levels (e.g. 50 to 60 percent, for simple examples). The precise level of voter turnout, along with the margin of victory, are determined by the distribution of expertise. Improving a voter's information makes her more willing to vote, consistent with a growing body of empirical evidence, but makes her peers more willing to abstain, providing a new explanation for various empirical patterns of voting. Equilibrium participation is optimal, even though the marginal voter may have very little (e.g. below-average) expertise, and even though nonvoters' information is not utilized.

10.1093/restud/rds026.abstractZh: 本文分析了在具有连续私人信号的共同价值选举中的参与和信息聚合现象。在均衡状态下，一些公民会忽略自己的私人信息而选择弃权，以尊重那些拥有更高质量信息的选民。即便拥有高度信息的同伴数量增加，但仅具备中等专业知识的公民仍会继续投票，从而使选民参与率保持在现实水平（例如，对于简单的例子来说，为50%到60%）。选民的参与程度以及获胜的差距，是由专业知识分布决定的。改善选民的信息水平会使其更愿意投票，这与越来越多的实证证据一致；但同时也会使同伴更愿意弃权，这为各种投票模式提供了新的解释。即使边际选民的专业知识非常有限（例如低于平均水平），且非选民的信息并未被利用，均衡参与仍然是最优的。

abstract.text: We show that in any game that is continuous at infinity, if a plan of action ai is played by a type ti in a Bayesian Nash equilibrium, then there are perturbations of ti for which ai is the only rationalizable plan and whose unique rationalizable belief regarding the play of the game is arbitrarily close to the equilibrium belief of ti. As an application to repeated games, we prove an unrefinable folk theorem: any individually rational and feasible payoff is the unique rationalizable payoff vector for some perturbed type profile. This is true even if perturbed types are restricted to believe that the repeated-game payoff structure and the discount factor are common knowledge.

10.1093/restud/rds027.abstractZh: 我们证明，在任何一个在无穷远处连续的博弈中，如果某种行动方案ai由某种类型ti在贝叶斯纳什均衡中执行，那么存在某种扰动，使得ai成为唯一可合理化的行动方案，并且其关于博弈执行的唯一可合理化的信念与类型ti的均衡信念无限接近。作为对重复博弈的应用，我们证明了一个不可精细化的民间定理：任何个体上合理且可行的收益，都是某个扰动后的类型配置的唯一可合理化的收益向量。即使扰动后的类型被限制为认为重复博弈的收益结构和折扣因子是共同知识，这一结论仍然成立。

abstract.text: A growing consensus in New Keynesian macroeconomics is that nominal cost rigidities, rather than countercyclical markups, account for the bulk of the real effects of monetary policy shocks. We revisit these conclusions using theory and data on inventories. We study an economy with nominal rigidities in which goods are storable. Our theory predicts that if costs of production are sticky and markups do not vary much in response to, say, expansionary monetary policy, firms react by excessively accumulating inventories in anticipation of future cost increases. In contrast, if the data inventories are fairly constant over the cycle and in response to changes in monetary policy. We show that costs must increase and markups must decline sufficiently in times of a monetary expansion in order to reduce firm's incentive to hold inventories and thus bring the model's inventory predictions in line with the data. Versions of the model consistent with the dynamics of inventories in the data imply that countercyclical markups account for a sizable fraction of the response of real variables to monetary shocks.

10.1093/restud/rds028.abstractZh: 新凯恩斯主义宏观经济学中越来越普遍的观点是，名义成本刚性而非反周期加价才是货币政策冲击实际效应的主要来源。我们利用理论和库存数据重新审视了这一结论。我们研究了一个存在名义刚性、商品可以储存的经济体系。我们的理论预测，如果生产成本具有粘性，且加价对货币政策的扩张反应不大，那么企业会过度积累库存以应对未来成本上升。相反，如果数据中的库存在整个周期中保持相对稳定，并且对货币政策的变化反应不大，那么货币扩张时期成本必须上升，加价必须下降，才能减少企业持有库存的动机，从而使模型的库存预测与数据相符。与数据中的库存动态一致的模型版本表明，反周期加价确实占据了实际变量对货币政策冲击响应的相当大一部分。

abstract.text: I extend the Epstein–Zin-lognormal consumption-based asset-pricing model to allow for general i.i.d. consumption growth. Information about the higher moments—equivalently, cumulants—of consumption growth is encoded in the cumulant-generating function. I use the framework to analyse economies with rare disasters, and argue that the importance of such disasters is a double-edged sword: parameters that govern the frequency and sizes of rare disasters are critically important for asset pricing, but extremely hard to calibrate. I show how to sidestep this issue by using observable asset prices to make inferences without having to estimate higher moments of the underlying consumption process. Extensions of the model allow consumption to diverge from dividends, and for non-i.i.d. consumption growth.

10.1093/restud/rds029.abstractZh: 我将Epstein–Zin-lognormal消费基础资产定价模型扩展为能够考虑一般的独立同分布消费增长。关于消费增长的高阶矩——即累积量——的信息被编码在累积量生成函数中。我利用这一框架分析遭受罕见灾难的经济体，并指出这类灾难的重要性是一把双刃剑：控制罕见灾难频率和规模的参数对资产定价至关重要，但极难进行校准。我展示了如何通过利用可观测的资产价格来进行推断，而无需估计基础消费过程的更高阶矩，从而规避这一问题。该模型的扩展允许消费与股息无关，也适用于非独立同分布的消费增长情况。

abstract.text: I develop a model of (individually rational) collective reality denial in groups, organizations and markets. Whether participants' tendencies toward wishful thinking reinforce or dampen each other is shown to hinge on a simple and novel mechanism. When an agent can expect to benefit from other's delusions, this makes him more of a realist; when he is more likely to suffer losses from them this pushes him toward denial, which becomes contagious. This general "Mutually Assured Delusion" principle can give rise to multiple social cognitions of reality, irrespective of any strategic payoff interactions or private signals. It also implies that in hierachical organizations realism or denial will trickle down, causing subordinates to take their mindsets and beliefs from the leaders. Contagious "exuberance" can also seize asset markets, leading to evidence-resistant investment frenzies and subsequent deep crashes. In addition to collective illusions of control, the model accounts for the mirror case of fatalism and collective resignation. The welfare analysis differentiates valuable group morale from harmful groupthink and identifies a fundamental tension in organizations' attitudes toward free speech and dissent.

10.1093/restud/rds030.abstractZh: 我提出了一个关于群体、组织和市场中（个体理性）集体现实否认的模型。参与者们对美好幻想的倾向是否会相互强化或削弱，取决于一个简单而新颖的机制。当某个个体能够期望从他人的错觉中获益时，他就会变得更加现实主义者；而当他更有可能因此遭受损失时，他就会倾向于否认现实，这种否认行为会具有传染性。这一普遍的“相互保证的错觉”原则可以引发多种社会对现实的认知，而不受任何战略收益或私人信号的影响。它还意味着，在层级组织中，现实主义或否认态度会向下传递，导致下属采纳领导者的心态和信念。具有传染性的“乐观情绪”也可能影响资产市场，导致与证据相悖的投资狂热，进而引发严重的市场崩盘。除了集体控制错觉之外，该模型还解释了宿命论和集体放弃现象的反面情况。福利分析区分了有价值的群体士气与有害的群体思维，并揭示了组织在言论自由和异议态度上的根本矛盾。

abstract.text: We explore which financial constraints matter the most in the choice of becoming an entrepreneur. We consider a randomly assigned welfare program in rural Mexico and show that cash transfers significantly increase entry into entrepreneurship. We then exploit the cross-household variation in the timing of these transfers and find that current occupational choices are significantly more responsive to the transfers expected for the future than to those currently received. Guided by a simple occupational choice model, we argue that the program has promoted entrepreneurship by enhancing the willingness to bear risk as opposed to simply relaxing current liquidity constraints.

10.1093/restud/rds031.abstractZh: 我们探讨了在选择成为企业家时，哪些财务限制最为重要。我们研究了一个位于墨西哥农村地区的随机分配的福利计划，发现现金转移显著增加了人们进入创业领域的意愿。接着，我们利用这些转移时间上的家庭间差异，发现当前职业选择对未来预期获得的转移反应更为敏感，而对当前已获得的转移反应则相对较弱。基于一个简单的职业选择模型，我们认为该计划通过增强承担风险的意愿来促进创业，而不仅仅是简单地缓解当前的流动性限制。

abstract.text: The evolution of the U.S. economy over the past 55 years is examined through the lens of a micro-founded model that allows for changes in the behaviour of the Federal Reserve and in the volatility of structural shocks. Agents are aware of the possibility of regime changes and their beliefs matter for the law of motion underlying the macroeconomy. Monetary policy is identified by repeated fluctuations between a Hawk and a Dove regime, with the latter prevailing in the 1970s and during the recent crisis. To explore the role of agents' beliefs I introduce a new class of counterfactual simulations: beliefs counterfactuals. If, in the 1970s, agents had anticipated the appointment of an extremely conservative Chairman, inflation would have been lower and the inflation-output trade-off more favourable. The large drop in inflation and output at the end of 2008 would have been mitigated if agents had expected the Federal Reserve to be exceptionally active in the near future.

10.1093/restud/rds032.abstractZh: 本文通过一种微观基础模型来探讨过去55年美国经济的演变过程，该模型能够反映联邦储备委员会行为的变化以及结构性冲击的波动性。各主体意识到政权更迭的可能性，他们的信念对宏观经济运动规律有着重要影响。货币政策表现为鹰派与鸽派之间的反复波动，其中鸽派在1970年代及最近的危机期间占主导地位。为了探究主体信念的作用，我引入了一类反事实模拟：信念反事实。如果在1970年代，各主体预期将任命一位极其保守的委员会主席，那么通货膨胀率将会更低，通货膨胀与产出之间的权衡也会更加有利。如果各主体预期联邦储备委员会在不久的将来会异常活跃，那么2008年底出现的通货膨胀和产出的大幅下降就会得到缓解。

abstract.text: How did Europe escape the “Iron Law of Wages?” We construct a simple Malthusian model with two sectors and multiple steady states, and use it to explain why European per capita incomes and urbanization rates increased during the period 1350–1700. Productivity growth can only explain a small fraction of the rise in output per capita. Population dynamics—changes of the birth and death schedules—were far more important determinants of steady states. We show how a major shock to population can trigger a transition to a new steady state with higher per-capita income. The Black Death was such a shock, raising wages substantially. Because of Engel's Law, demand for urban products increased, and urban centers grew in size. European cities were unhealthy, and rising urbanization pushed up aggregate death rates. This effect was reinforced by diseases spread through war, financed by higher tax revenues. In addition, rising trade also spread diseases. In this way higher wages themselves reduced population pressure. We show in a calibration exercise that our model can account for the sustained rise in European urbanization as well as permanently higher per capita incomes in 1700, without technological change. Wars contributed importantly to the “Rise of Europe”, even if they had negative short-run effects. We thus trace Europe's precocious rise to economic riches to interactions of the plague shock with the belligerent political environment and the nature of cities.

10.1093/restud/rds034.abstractZh: 欧洲是如何摆脱“工资铁律”的？我们构建了一个包含两个部门、多个稳定状态的简单马尔萨斯模型，并用它来解释为什么在1350至1700年间，欧洲的人均收入和城市化率有所上升。生产力增长只能解释人均产出增长的一小部分。人口动态——出生和死亡计划的变化——才是决定稳定状态的重要因素。我们展示了人口的重大冲击如何触发向更高人均收入的新稳定状态的转变。黑死病就是这样的冲击，它大幅提高了工资。由于恩格尔定律，对城市产品的需求增加，城市规模也随之扩大。欧洲的城市并不健康，不断上升的城市化率推高了总体死亡率。这种效应因战争传播的疾病而得到加强，而战争带来的更高税收收入进一步加剧了这一趋势。此外，贸易的兴起也促进了疾病的传播。这样，更高的工资本身就减少了人口压力。我们通过校准实验表明，我们的模型可以解释欧洲城市化率的持续上升，以及1700年时持续较高的人均收入，而无需技术变革。战争对“欧洲的崛起”起到了重要作用，即使它们在短期内产生了负面影响。因此，我们将欧洲经济繁荣的提前到来归因于瘟疫冲击与敌对政治环境以及城市性质之间的相互作用。

abstract.text: In an economy with distortionary taxes on labour, can subsidies on day care, financed by increased taxes, raise welfare by encouraging women with small children to work? We show, within a stylized life-cycle framework, that the Ramsey optimal policy consists in equalizing consumption/leisure wedges over the life cycle. A simple way to implement this is to make day care expenses tax deductible. Modifying and calibrating our model to fit some key facts about labour supply in Germany, we find that the reform that maximizes a distribution-neutral social welfare function involves subsidizing day care at a rate of 50% and leads to a near doubling of labour supply for mothers with small children. The overall welfare gain from this reform corresponds to a 0.4 percent increase in consumption.

10.1093/restud/rds035.abstractZh: 在一个存在扭曲性劳动税的体系中，通过增加税收来资助日托补贴，是否能够通过鼓励有小孩的女性工作来提高福利？我们在一个简化的生命周期框架内表明，拉姆齐最优政策在于在整个生命周期内使消费/休闲的分配更加均衡。实现这一政策的一个简单方法是允许日托费用在税收上予以扣除。通过对我们的模型进行修正和校准，以符合德国劳动力供应的一些关键事实，我们发现，能够最大化分配中性社会福利功能的改革方案是提供50%的日托补贴，这将使有小孩的母亲们的劳动力供应增加近一倍。这一改革带来的整体福利提升相当于消费增加了0.4%。

abstract.text: Financial market imperfections severely restrict international trade flows because exporters require external capital. This article identifies and quantifies the three mechanisms through which credit constraints affect trade: the selection of heterogeneous firms into domestic production, the selection of domestic manufacturers into exporting, and the level of firm exports. I incorporate financial frictions into a heterogeneous-firm model and apply it to aggregate trade data for a large panel of countries. I establish causality by exploiting the variation in financial development across countries and the variation in financial vulnerability across sectors. About 20%–25% of the impact of credit constraints on trade is driven by reductions in total output. Of the additional, trade-specific effect, one-third reflects limited firm entry into exporting, while two-thirds are due to contractions in exporters' sales. Financially developed economies export more in financially vulnerable sectors because they enter more markets, ship more products to each destination, and sell more of each product. These results have important policy implications for less developed nations that rely on exports for economic growth but suffer from weak financial institutions.

10.1093/restud/rds036.abstractZh: 金融市场的不完善严重限制了国际贸易流动，因为出口商需要外部资本。本文识别并量化了信贷约束影响贸易的三种机制：异质企业进入国内生产的选择、国内制造商选择出口行为，以及企业出口水平。我将金融摩擦纳入异质企业模型中，并将其应用于大量国家的综合贸易数据。通过利用各国金融发展差异以及各部门金融脆弱性差异，我们建立了因果关系。信贷约束对贸易的影响约占总产出减少的20%–25%。在额外的贸易特定效应中，三分之一是由于企业进入出口领域的限制，而三分之二则由于出口商销售额的减少所致。金融发达的经济体在金融脆弱性较高的领域出口更多，因为它们进入更多市场，向每个目的地运送更多产品，并销售更多同类产品。这些结果对于依赖出口实现经济增长但金融机构薄弱的欠发达国家具有重要的政策意义。

abstract.text: We develop a model where: (i) banks take deposits and make investments; (ii) their liabilities facilitate third-party transactions. Other models have (i) or (ii), not both, although we argue they are intimately connected: we show that they both emerge from limited commitment. We describe an environment, characterize desirable allocations, and interpret the outcomes as banking arrangements. Banks are essential: without them, the set of feasible allocations is inferior. As a technical contribution, we characterize dynamically optimal credit allocations with frictions, show they involve backloading, and analyse how this interacts with banking. We also confront the theory with economic history.

10.1093/restud/rds037.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个模型，其中：(i) 银行接受存款并进行投资；(ii) 它们的负债促进了第三方交易。其他模型只包含(i)或(ii)中的一项，尽管我们认为这两者密切相关：我们表明，这两种情况都源于有限的承诺。我们描述了一个环境，描述了理想的分配方式，并将结果解释为银行安排。银行是不可或缺的：没有它们，可行的分配方案就会受到限制。作为技术上的贡献，我们描述了具有摩擦的动态最优信贷分配，展示了这些分配涉及后载效应，并分析了这种效应与银行运作的相互作用。我们还将这一理论与经济历史进行了对比。

abstract.text: I explicitly derive the optimal dynamic incentive contract in a standard continuous-time agency setting where the agent has a shirking action. My solution generates two dynamic contracts new to the literature. Both contracts include phases when the agent frequently shirks. In one contract, the shirking phases are relaxation periods rewarding the agent for good performance. In the other, the shirking phases are suspension-type arrangements punishing the agent for poor performance. In addition, I also explore the relationships between optimal contracting and taxes, bargaining, and renegotiation.

10.1093/restud/rds038.abstractZh: 我明确推导了在标准连续时间代理设置下，当代理人存在偷懒行为时的最优动态激励合同。我的解决方案提出了两种新的动态合同。这两种合同都包含代理人频繁偷懒的阶段。在一种合同中，偷懒阶段是奖励代理人良好表现的放松期；而在另一种合同中，偷懒阶段则是惩罚代理人表现不佳的暂停式安排。此外，我还探讨了最优合同与税收、谈判以及重新谈判之间的关系。

abstract.text: We develop a numerical procedure that facilitates efficient likelihood evaluation in applications involving non-linear and non-Gaussian state-space models. The procedure employs continuous approximations of filtering densities, and delivers unconditionally optimal global approximations of targeted integrands to achieve likelihood approximation. Optimized approximations of targeted integrands are constructed via efficient importance sampling. Resulting likelihood approximations are continuous functions of model parameters, greatly enhancing parameter estimation. We illustrate our procedure in applications to dynamic stochastic general equilibrium models.

10.1093/restud/rds040.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种数值方法，该方法能够高效地进行似然估计，适用于涉及非线性和非高斯状态空间模型的应用。该方法采用连续近似的滤波密度，并能够无条件地获得目标积分函数的最优全局近似，从而实现似然估计的近似。通过高效的重要性抽样方法，可以构建目标积分函数的优化近似。由此得到的似然近似是模型参数的连续函数，极大地提升了参数估计的准确性。我们在动态随机一般均衡模型的应用中展示了该方法的实用性。

abstract.text: What is the role of leaders in large organizations? We propose a model in which a leader helps to overcome a misalignment of followers' incentives that inhibits coordination, while adapting the organization to a changing environment. Good leadership requires vision and special personality traits such as conviction or resoluteness to enhance the credibility of mission statements and to effectively rally agents around them. Resoluteness allows leaders to overcome a time-consistency problem that arises from the fact that leaders learn about the best course of action for the organization over time. However, resoluteness also inhibits bottom-up information flow from followers. The optimal level of resoluteness depends on followers' signal quality and the corporate culture of the organization.

10.1093/restud/rds041.abstractZh: 大型组织中的领导者扮演着怎样的角色？我们提出了一个模型，其中领导者有助于克服追随者激励之间的不一致性，从而促进协调，同时使组织适应不断变化的环境。良好的领导力需要愿景以及诸如信念或果断性等特殊的人格特质，以增强使命宣言的可信度，并有效地凝聚团队成员。果断性使领导者能够克服时间一致性问题，因为领导者会随着时间了解组织的最佳行动方向。然而，果断性也会抑制来自追随者的自下而上的信息流动。最佳的果断性水平取决于追随者的信号质量以及组织的企业文化。

abstract.text: In this article, I develop and estimate a model of on-the-job search in which risk averse workers choose search effort and can borrow or save using a single risk free asset. I derive the implications for optimal savings behaviour in this environment and relate this to the frictions that characterize the endogenous earnings process implied by on-the-job search. Savings behaviour depends in a very intuitive way on the rate at which offers are received, the rate at which jobs are destroyed, and a worker's current rank in the wage distribution. The implication is that workers, who are identical in terms of preferences and opportunities, have substantially different savings behaviour depending on their history and current position in the wage distribution. The mechanism that generates the substantial differences in savings behaviour in the model is the dynamic of the “wage ladder” resulting from the search process. There is an important asymmetry between the incremental wage increases generated by on-the-job search (climbing the ladder) and the drop in income associated with job loss (falling off the ladder). The behaviour of workers in low paying jobs is primarily governed by the expectation of wage growth, while the behaviour of workers near the top of the distribution is driven by the possibility of job loss. The distributions of earnings, wealth, and consumption implied by the model (suitably aggregated) align reasonably well with the data, with the notable exception of implying substantially less concentration of wealth among the richest one percent of the population.

10.1093/restud/rds042.abstractZh: 在本文中，我开发并估计了一个关于在职搜寻的模型，其中风险厌恶的工人选择搜寻努力，并且可以使用单一无风险资产进行借贷或储蓄。我推导了在这种环境下最优储蓄行为的影响，并将其与由在职搜寻所暗示的内生收入过程中的摩擦因素联系起来。储蓄行为以一种非常直观的方式取决于收到的提议率、职位被取消的频率，以及工人当前在工资分布中的排名。这意味着，在偏好和机会方面相同的工人，其储蓄行为会因他们的历史和当前在工资分布中的位置而大相径庭。在模型中产生储蓄行为显著差异的机制是由搜寻过程引发的“工资阶梯”的动态变化。在职搜寻产生的工资增长（攀登阶梯）与因职位丧失而导致的收入下降之间存在重要不对称性。低薪职位的工人的行为主要受工资增长的预期所驱动，而处于工资分布顶端附近的工人的行为则受到职位丧失可能性的影响。模型所暗示的收入、财富和消费分布（经过适当聚合后）与数据相当吻合，唯一的显著例外是，最富有的百分之一人口中的财富集中度明显较低。

abstract.text: Are macro-economists mistaken in ignoring bargaining between spouses? This article argues that models of intra-household allocation could be useful for understanding aggregate labour supply trends in the U.S. since the 1970s. A simple calculation suggests that the standard model without bargaining predicts a 19% decline in married-male labour supply in response to the narrowing of the gender gap in wages since the 1970s. However married-men's paid labour remained stationary over the period from the mid 1970s to the recession of 2001. This article develops and calibrates to U.S. time-use survey data a model of marital bargaining in which time allocations are determined jointly with equilibrium marriage and divorce rates. The results suggest that bargaining effects raised married-men's labour supply by about 2.1 weekly hours over the period, and reduced that of married women by 2.7 hours. Bargaining therefore has a relatively small impact on aggregate labour supply, but is critical for trends in female labour supply. Also, the narrowing of the gender wage gap is found to account for a weekly 1.5 hour increase in aggregate labour supply.

10.1093/restud/rds043.abstractZh: 宏观经济学家是否错误地忽视了夫妻之间的讨价还价行为？本文认为，自20世纪70年代以来，家庭内部分配模型对于理解美国总体劳动力供给趋势具有重要作用。简单的计算表明，没有讨价还价的标准模型预测，由于性别工资差距的缩小，已婚男性的劳动力供给将减少19%。然而，从20世纪70年代中期到2001年经济衰退期间，已婚男性的有偿劳动力供给基本保持不变。本文根据美国时间使用调查数据，开发并校准了一个婚姻讨价还价模型，该模型将时间分配与均衡婚姻率和离婚率结合起来进行预测。研究结果表明，讨价还价行为使得已婚男性的每周劳动力供给增加了约2.1小时，而已婚女性的每周劳动力供给减少了2.7小时。因此，讨价还价对总体劳动力供给的影响相对较小，但对于女性劳动力供给的趋势则至关重要。此外，性别工资差距的缩小还导致总体劳动力供给每周增加了1.5小时。

abstract.text: We propose exact simulation-based procedures for: (i) testing mean-variance efficiency when the zero-beta rate is unknown; (ii) building confidence intervals for the zero-beta rate. On observing that this parameter may be weakly identified, we propose likelihood-ratio-type tests as well as Fieller-type procedures based on a Hotelling-HAC statistic, which are robust to weak identification and allow for non-Gaussian distributions including parametric GARCH structures. The Fieller-Hotelling-HAC procedure also accounts (asymptotically) for general forms of heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation. We propose confidence sets for the zero-beta rate based on “inverting” exact tests for this parameter; for both procedures proposed, these sets can be interpreted as multivariate extensions of the classic Fieller method for inference on ratios. The exact distribution of likelihood-ratio-type statistics for testing efficiency is studied under both the null and the alternative hypotheses. The relevant nuisance parameter structure is established and finite-sample bound procedures are proposed, which extend and improve available Gaussian-specific bounds. Finite-sample distributional invariance results are also demonstrated analytically for the HAC statistic proposed by MacKinlay and Richardson (1991). We study invariance to portfolio repacking for the tests and confidence sets proposed. The statistical properties of the proposed methods are analysed through a Monte Carlo study and compared with alternative available methods. Empirical results on NYSE returns show that exact confidence sets are very different from asymptotic ones, and allowing for non-Gaussian distributions affects inference results. Simulation and empirical evidence suggests that likelihood-ratio-type statistics—with p-values corrected using the Maximized Monte Carlo test method—are generally preferable to their multivariate Fieller-Hotelling-HAC counterparts from the viewpoints of size control and power.

10.1093/restud/rds044.abstractZh: 我们提出了基于精确模拟的程序，用于：(i)在零贝塔率未知的情况下测试均值-方差效率；(ii)构建零贝塔率的置信区间。鉴于该参数可能存在弱识别问题，我们提出了基于Hotelling-HAC统计量的似然比型检验以及Fieller型程序，这些程序对弱识别具有鲁棒性，并允许非高斯分布，包括参数化的GARCH结构。Fieller-Hotelling-HAC程序还（渐近地）考虑了异方差性和自相关的各种形式。我们提出了基于“反转”精确检验的零贝塔率置信集；对于这两种程序，这些置信集可以被解释为经典Fieller方法的多变量扩展，用于比率推断。在零假设和备择假设下，研究了用于测试效率的似然比型统计量的精确分布。建立了相关的干扰参数结构，并提出了有限样本界限程序，这些程序扩展并改进了现有的高斯特定界限。对于MacKinlay和Richardson（1991）提出的HAC统计量，也展示了有限样本分布不变性结果。我们研究了所提出的检验和置信集对投资组合重新打包的不变性。通过蒙特卡洛研究分析了所提出方法的统计特性，并将其与现有的其他方法进行了比较。对纽约证券交易所回报数据的实证结果表明，精确置信集与渐近置信集有很大差异，允许非高斯分布会影响推断结果。仿真和实证证据表明，从尺寸控制和功效的角度来看，似然比型统计方法——采用最大化蒙特卡洛检验方法对p值进行校正——通常优于其多变量Fieller-Hotelling-HAC对应方法。

abstract.text: This article studies efficient allocations in a dynamic private information economy with a continuum of idiosyncratic shocks that are persistent. I develop a first-order approach for this environment and show that the problem has a simple recursive structure that relies on only a small number of state variables, making the problem tractable. I find sufficient conditions that guarantee that the first-order approach is valid. To illustrate the first-order approach I numerically compute the efficient allocations in a Mirrleesean economy with productivity shocks that follow a random walk and verify the validity of the first-order approach. I show that persistent shocks create a new trade-off where the social planner decreases the informational rent of the agent today at the cost of providing higher insurance in the future.

10.1093/restud/rds045.abstractZh: 本文研究在具有持续性的连续特异性冲击的动态私人信息经济中的有效分配问题。我为此环境开发了一种一阶方法，并证明该问题具有简单的递归结构，仅依赖于少数状态变量，使得问题易于处理。我找到了充分条件，保证一阶方法的有效性。为了说明一阶方法，我在一个遵循随机游走的生产力冲击的Mirrleese经济中数值计算有效分配，并验证了一阶方法的有效性。我表明，持续性的冲击创造了一个新的权衡：社会规划者今天降低代理人的信息租金，但代价是在未来提供更高的保险。

abstract.text: Evidence from both psychology and economics indicates that individuals give statements that appear to overestimate their ability compared to that of others. We test three theories that predict such relative overconfidence. The first theory argues that overconfidence can be generated by Bayesian updating from a common prior and truthful statements if individuals do not know their true type. The second theory suggests that self-image concerns asymmetrically affect the choice to receive new information about one's abilities, and this asymmetry can produce overconfidence. The third theory is that overconfidence is induced by the desire to send positive signals to others about one's own skill; this suggests either a bias in judgement, strategic lying, or both. We formulate this theory precisely. Using a large data set of relative ability judgements about two cognitive tests, we reject the restrictions imposed by the Bayesian model and also reject a key prediction of the self-image models that individuals with optimistic beliefs will be less likely to search for further information about their skill because this information might shatter their self-image. We provide evidence that personality traits strongly affect relative ability judgements in a pattern that is consistent with the third theory of social signalling. Our results together suggest that overconfidence in statements is more likely to be induced by social concerns than by either of the other two factors.

10.1093/restud/rds046.abstractZh: 心理学和经济学的研究都表明，人们往往会给出看似高估自己能力的陈述。我们测试了三种理论，这些理论都预测了这种相对过度自信的现象。第一种理论认为，如果个体不知道自己的真实能力类型，那么过度自信可以通过基于共同先验和真实陈述的贝叶斯更新而产生。第二种理论指出，自我形象的问题会不对称地影响个体接受关于自己能力的新信息的意愿，这种不对称可能导致过度自信。第三种理论则认为，过度自信是由于希望向他人传递关于自己能力的积极信号而产生的；这暗示了判断上的偏差、策略性撒谎，或者两者兼而有之。我们对此理论进行了精确的表述。通过大量关于两种认知测试的相对能力判断的数据集，我们否定了贝叶斯模型所施加的限制，同时也否定了自我形象模型的一个关键预测，即持有乐观信念的个体不太可能寻求更多关于自己能力的信息，因为这些信息可能会破坏他们的自我形象。我们的研究还表明，人格特质对相对能力判断有着显著的影响，这一影响模式与第三种社会信号理论一致。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，对陈述的过度自信更可能是由社会因素引起的，而非其他两个因素。

abstract.text: We study stochastic games with an infinite horizon and sequential moves played by an arbitrary number of players. We assume that social memory is finite—every player, except possibly one, is finitely lived and cannot observe events that are sufficiently far back in the past. This class of games includes games between a long-run player and a sequence of short-run players, and games with overlapping generations of players. An equilibrium is purifiable if some close-by behaviour is consistent with equilibrium when agents’ payoffs in each period are perturbed additively and independently. We show that only Markov equilibria are purifiable when social memory is finite. Thus if a game has at most one long-run player, all purifiable equilibria are Markov.

10.1093/restud/rds047.abstractZh: 我们研究具有无限时间范围且由任意数量玩家依次进行的随机博弈。我们假设社会记忆是有限的——除了可能的一个玩家外，每个玩家的历史都是有限的，无法观察到过去足够久远的事件。这类博弈包括长期玩家与一系列短期玩家之间的博弈，以及具有重叠世代的玩家之间的博弈。如果某些邻近行为在代理人的收益被加性且独立地扰动时仍然与均衡一致，那么该均衡是可辨识的。我们证明，当社会记忆有限时，只有马尔可夫均衡是可辨识的。因此，如果一个博弈最多只有一个长期玩家，那么所有可辨识的均衡都是马尔可夫均衡。

abstract.text: We consider a dynamic Mirrlees economy in a life-cycle context and study the optimal insurance arrangement. Individual productivity evolves as a Markov process and is private information. We use a first-order approach in discrete and continuous time and obtain novel theoretical and numerical results. Our main contribution is a formula describing the dynamics for the labour-income tax rate. When productivity is an AR(1) our formula resembles an AR(1) with a trend where: (i) the auto-regressive coefficient equals that of productivity; (ii) the trend term equals the covariance productivity with consumption growth divided by the Frisch elasticity of labour; and (iii) the innovations in the tax rate are the negative of consumption growth. The last property implies a form of short-run regressivity. Our simulations illustrate these results and deliver some novel insights. The average labour tax rises from 0% to 37% over 40 years, whereas the average tax on savings falls from 12% to 0% at retirement. We compare the second best solution to simple history-independent tax systems, calibrated to mimic these average tax rates. We find that age-dependent taxes capture a sizable fraction of the welfare gains. In this way, our theoretical results provide insights into simple tax systems.

10.1093/restud/rds048.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个动态Mirrlees经济模型，该模型基于生命周期框架，并研究了最优保险安排。个体生产率作为马尔可夫过程演化，且为私人信息。我们采用离散时间和连续时间的初阶方法，得到了一些新的理论和数值结果。我们的主要贡献是一个描述劳动收入税率动态变化的公式。当生产率服从AR(1)分布时，该公式类似于一个带有趋势的AR(1)模型，其中：(i)自回归系数等于生产率的自回归系数；(ii)趋势项等于生产率与消费增长的协方差除以劳动力的Frisch弹性；(iii)税率的变动是消费增长的负值。这一特性意味着存在一种短期回归性。我们的模拟结果验证了这些结论，并提供了一些新的见解。平均劳动税在40年内从0%上升到37%，而储蓄的平均税率在退休时从12%降至0%。我们将第二好的解决方案与简单的历史无关税收系统进行了比较，这些税收系统被校准以模拟这些平均税率。我们发现，年龄依赖的税收能够捕获相当一部分福利收益。通过这种方式，我们的理论结果为简单的税收系统提供了深刻的见解。

abstract.text: Credence goods are characterized by informational asymmetries between sellers and consumers that invite fraudulent behaviour by sellers. This article presents a natural field experiment on taxi rides in Athens, Greece, set up to measure different types of fraud and to examine the influence of passengers' presumed information and income on the extent of fraud. We find that passengers with inferior information about optimal routes are taken on significantly longer detours, while lack of information on the local tariff system increases the likelihood of manipulated bills by about fifteen percentage points. Passengers' perceived income seems to have no effect on fraud.

10.1093/restud/rds049.abstractZh: 信任商品的特点在于卖方与消费者之间存在信息不对称，这促使卖方可能采取欺诈行为。本文在希腊雅典进行了关于出租车行程的自然实地实验，旨在测量不同类型的欺诈行为，并探讨乘客所认为的信息和收入对欺诈程度的影响。研究发现，对最优路线了解不足的乘客会被引导走更长的绕行路线，而缺乏当地收费系统信息则会使账单被操纵的可能性增加约15个百分点。乘客所认为的收入似乎对欺诈行为没有影响。

abstract.text: In the 2001 U.S. Survey of Consumer Finances, 27% of households report simultaneously revolving significant credit card debt and holding sizeable amounts of low-return liquid assets; this is known as the “credit card debt puzzle”. In this article, I quantitatively evaluate the role of liquidity demand in accounting for this puzzle: households that accumulate credit card debt may not pay it off using their money in the bank, because they anticipate needing that money in situations where credit cards cannot be used. I characterize the puzzle in survey data, and calibrate a dynamic stochastic heterogeneous-agent model of household portfolio choice, where consumer credit and liquidity coexist as means of consumption and saving, where households consume a cash good and a credit good, and where cash consumption is subject to uncertainty. The model accounts for between 44% and 56% of the households in the data who hold consumer debt and liquidity simultaneously, and for 100% of the liquidity held by a median such household. Under reasonable calibration alternatives, the model can capture the entire puzzle group size as well. One-half of money demand in the model is precautionary.

10.1093/restud/rdt001.abstractZh: 在2001年美国消费者金融调查中，27%的家庭同时背负着大量信用卡债务，并持有数量可观但回报较低的流动资产；这一现象被称为“信用卡债务之谜”。在本文中，我定量评估了流动性需求在解释这一谜题中的作用：积累信用卡债务的家庭可能不会用银行里的钱来偿还债务，因为他们预计在无法使用信用卡的情况下需要这笔钱。我利用调查数据描述了这一谜题，并构建了一个动态随机异质代理模型，用于描述家庭的投资选择。该模型将消费信贷和流动性视为消费和储蓄的手段，家庭既消费现金商品，也消费信贷商品，而现金消费受到不确定性的影响。该模型解释了数据中44%至56%的家庭同时持有消费债务和流动资产的情况，并且能够准确描述中位数这类家庭所持有的流动性情况。在合理的校准条件下，该模型能够涵盖整个谜题群体。模型中一半的货币需求是预防性需求。

abstract.text: This article estimates people's taste for living with own-ethnic-group neighbours using variation from a natural experiment in Singapore: ethnic housing quotas. I develop a location choice model that informs the use of policy variation from the quotas to address endogeneity issues well known in the social interactions literature. I assembled a dataset on neighbourhood-level ethnic proportions by matching more than 500,000 names in the phonebook to ethnicities. I find that all groups want to live with some own-ethnic-group neighbours but they also exhibit inverted U-shaped preferences so that once a neighbourhood has enough own ethnic neighbours, they would rather add a new neighbour from other groups. Welfare simulations show that about 30% of the neighbourhoods are within one standard deviation of the first-best allocation of ethnic groups.

10.1093/restud/rdt002.abstractZh: 本文利用新加坡一项关于种族住房配额的自然实验数据，估算了人们与同种族邻居共同生活的意愿。我们开发了一个区位选择模型，该模型有助于通过政策调整来解决社会互动研究中常见的内生性问题。我们通过将电话簿中的50多万条姓名与种族进行匹配，收集了关于社区内种族比例的数据集。研究发现，所有群体都希望与一些同种族邻居共同生活，但他们也表现出倒U型偏好——当某个社区拥有足够多的同种族邻居时，他们更倾向于引入其他种族的新邻居。福利模拟结果显示，大约30%的社区在种族分配上接近最优状态。

abstract.text: The theory bears some testable predictions. First, the probability of future civil wars increases after each conflict episode. Second, a sequence of "accidental" conflicts can lead to the permanent breakdown of trust, plunging a society into a state of recurrent conflicts (a war trap). This situation is irreversible and is characterized by weak cross-community trade links even in peace times. War traps are robust to additional sources of social learning, such as people learning from the direct observation of the history of cross-community trade. The incidence of conflict can be reduced by policies abating cultural barriers, fostering human capital and targeting beliefs. Coercitive peace policies such as peacekeeping forces or externally imposed regime changes have instead no persistent effects.

10.1093/restud/rdt003.abstractZh: 该理论提出了一些可验证的预测。首先，每次冲突之后，未来发生内战的概率会增加。其次，一系列“偶然”的冲突可能导致信任的永久破裂，使社会陷入反复冲突的状态（即战争陷阱）。这种情况是不可逆的，即使在和平时期，不同社区之间的贸易联系也较为薄弱。战争陷阱对额外的社会学习来源具有抵抗力，例如人们通过直接观察不同社区之间的贸易历史来学习经验。通过消除文化障碍、促进人力资本发展以及针对特定信念的政策，可以减少冲突的发生。而诸如维和部队或外部强加的政权更迭这样的强制性和平政策则没有持久的效果。

abstract.text: The textbook neoclassical growth model predicts that countries with faster productivity growth should invest more and attract more foreign capital. We show that the allocation of capital flows across developing countries is the opposite of this prediction: capital does not flow more to countries that invest and grow more. We call this puzzle the “allocation puzzle”. Using a wedge analysis, we find that the pattern of capital flows is driven by national saving: the allocation puzzle is a saving puzzle. Further disaggregation of capital flows reveals that the allocation puzzle is also related to the pattern of accumulation of international reserves. The solution to the “allocation puzzle”, thus, lies at the nexus between growth, saving, and international reserve accumulation. We conclude with a discussion of some possible avenues for research.

10.1093/restud/rdt004.abstractZh: 新古典增长模型认为，生产率增长较快的国家应该投资更多并吸引更多外国资本。然而，我们发现发展中国家之间的资本分配情况与这一预测相反：资本并不会流向那些投资更多、增长更快的国家。我们将这一现象称为“资本分配悖论”。通过楔形分析，我们发现资本流动的模式是由国民储蓄驱动的：资本分配悖论实际上是一个储蓄悖论。进一步分析资本流动模式后发现，资本分配悖论还与国际储备的积累模式有关。因此，“资本分配悖论”的解决方案在于增长、储蓄和国际储备积累之间的关联。最后，我们讨论了未来研究的一些可能方向。

abstract.text: This article analyses contract cancellation and product return policies in markets in which sellers advise customers about the suitability of their offering. When customers are fully rational, it is optimal for sellers to offer the right to cancel or return on favourable terms. A generous return policy makes the seller's “cheap talk” at the point of sale credible. This observation provides a possible explanation for the excess refund puzzle and also has implications for the management of customer reviews. When customers are credulous, instead, sellers have an incentive to set unfavourable terms to exploit the inflated beliefs they induce in their customers. The imposition of a minimum statutory standard improves welfare and consumer surplus when customers are credulous. In contrast, competition policy reduces contractual inefficiencies with rational customers, but it is not effective with credulous customers.

10.1093/restud/rdt005.abstractZh: 本文分析了在卖方向客户提供产品适用性建议的市场中，关于合同取消和产品退换政策的情况。当顾客完全理性时，卖方以优惠条件提供取消或退换的权利是最优选择。宽松的退换政策使得卖方在销售时的“便宜话”具有可信度。这一观察为“超额退款之谜”提供了可能的解释，同时也对顾客评价的管理提出了启示。而当顾客缺乏判断力时，卖方则有动机设定不利的条款，以利用顾客被夸大的信念。当顾客缺乏判断力时，实施最低法定标准可以提高福利和消费者剩余。相比之下，竞争政策虽然能减少理性顾客的合同纠纷，但对缺乏判断力的顾客来说并不有效。

abstract.text: Voters often dismantle constitutional checks and balances on the executive. If such checks and balances limit presidential abuses of power and rents, why do voters support their removal? We argue that by reducing politician rents, checks and balances also make it cheaper to bribe or influence politicians through non-electoral means. In weakly-institutionalized polities where such non-electoral influences, particularly by the better organized elite, are a major concern, voters may prefer a political system without checks and balances as a way of insulating politicians from these influences.
