When they do so, they are effectively accepting a certain amount of politician (presidential) rents in return for redistribution. We show that checks and balances are less likely to emerge when the elite is better organized and is more likely to be able to influence or bribe politicians, and when inequality and potential taxes are high (which makes redistribution more valuable to the majority). We also provide case study evidence from Bolivia, Ecuador and Venezuela and econometric evidence on voter attitudes from a Latin American survey consistent with the model.

10.1093/restud/rdt007.abstractZh: 选民常常破坏对行政权力的宪法制衡机制。如果这些制衡机制能够限制总统滥用权力和谋取私利，那么为什么选民会支持取消这些制衡机制呢？我们认为，通过减少政客的租金，制衡机制也使得通过非选举手段贿赂或影响政客变得更加容易。在制度化程度较低的政体下，这种非选举手段的影响，尤其是来自组织更严密的精英阶层的影响，是一个主要问题。在这种情况下，选民可能更倾向于选择没有制衡机制的政体，以此来保护政客免受这些影响。当他们这样做时，实际上是在接受一定程度的政客（总统）租金作为交换，以换取资源再分配。我们的研究表明，当精英阶层组织得更严密，能够更有力地影响或贿赂政客时，制衡机制就不太可能出现；同时，当不平等和潜在税收较高时（这使得资源再分配对大多数人更有价值），制衡机制也不太可能出现。我们还提供了来自玻利维亚、厄瓜多尔和委内瑞拉的案例研究证据，以及来自拉丁美洲的一项关于选民态度的计量经济学证据，这些证据与我们的模型一致。

abstract.text: We introduce the financial economics of market microstructure into the financial econometrics of asset return volatility estimation. In particular, we use market microstructure theory to derive the cross-correlation function between latent returns and market microstructure noise, which feature prominently in the recent volatility literature. The cross-correlation at zero displacement is typically negative, and cross-correlations at nonzero displacements are positive and decay geometrically. If market makers are sufficiently risk averse, however, the cross-correlation pattern is inverted. Our results are useful for assessing the validity of the frequently-assumed independence of latent price and microstructure noise, for explaining observed cross-correlation patterns, for predicting as-yet undiscovered patterns, and for making informed conjectures regarding improved volatility estimation methods.

10.1093/restud/rdt008.abstractZh: 我们将市场微观结构的经济学原理引入到资产回报波动性的金融计量学中。具体来说，我们利用市场微观结构理论来推导潜在回报与市场微观结构噪声之间的互相关函数，这一函数在最近的波动性研究中占有重要地位。在零位移时，互相关函数通常为负值，而在非零位移时，互相关函数为正值且呈几何级数衰减。然而，如果做市商具有足够的风险厌恶特性，那么互相关函数模式就会反转。我们的研究结果有助于评估通常认为的潜在价格噪声与微观结构噪声独立性假设的有效性，有助于解释观察到的互相关模式，预测尚未发现的模式，并为改进波动性估计方法提供有根据的猜想。

abstract.text: How do income shocks affect armed conflict? Theory suggests two opposite effects. If labour is used to appropriate resources violently, higher wages may lower conflict by reducing labour supplied to appropriation. This is the opportunity cost effect. Alternatively, a rise in contestable income may increase violence by raising gains from appropriation. This is the rapacity effect. Our article exploits exogenous price shocks in international commodity markets and a rich dataset on civil war in Colombia to assess how different income shocks affect conflict. We examine changes in the price of agricultural goods (which are labour intensive) as well as natural resources (which are not). We focus on Colombia's two largest exports, coffee and oil. We find that a sharp fall in coffee prices during the 1990s lowered wages and increased violence differentially in municipalities cultivating more coffee. This is consistent with the coffee shock inducing an opportunity cost effect. In contrast, a rise in oil prices increased both municipal revenue and violence differentially in the oil region. This is consistent with the oil shock inducing a rapacity effect. We also show that this pattern holds in six other agricultural and natural resource sectors, providing evidence that price shocks affect conflict in different directions depending on the type of the commodity.

10.1093/restud/rdt009.abstractZh: 收入冲击如何影响武装冲突？理论提出了两种相反的影响。如果劳动力被用于暴力掠夺资源，较高的工资可能会通过减少用于掠夺的劳动力来降低冲突。这就是机会成本效应。相反，可争夺收入的增加可能会通过提高掠夺收益来增加暴力行为。这就是掠夺性效应。我们的文章利用国际商品市场中的外部价格冲击以及关于哥伦比亚内战的丰富数据集，来研究不同收入冲击如何影响冲突。我们研究了农产品（劳动密集型）价格的变化以及自然资源（非劳动密集型）价格的变化。我们重点关注哥伦比亚的两个最大出口产品：咖啡和石油。我们发现，在1990年代，咖啡价格急剧下跌导致种植更多咖啡的市镇的工资下降，同时暴力行为增加。这与咖啡价格冲击引发机会成本效应一致。相反，石油价格上升则使石油产区市镇的收入和暴力行为都增加，这与石油价格冲击引发掠夺性效应一致。我们还发现，这种模式在其他六个农业和自然资源领域也普遍存在，这表明价格冲击根据商品类型的不同，会对冲突产生不同的影响。

abstract.text: Principal–agent models in which the agent has access to private information before a contract is signed are a cornerstone of contract theory. We have conducted an experiment with 720 participants to explore whether the theoretical insights are reflected by the behaviour of subjects in the laboratory and to what extent deviations from standard theory can be explained by social preferences. Investigating settings with both exogenous and endogenous information structures, we find that agency theory is indeed useful to qualitatively predict how variations in the degree of uncertainty affect subjects' behaviour. Regarding the quantitative deviations from standard predictions, our analysis based on several control treatments and quantal response estimations shows that agents' behaviour can be explained by social preferences that are less pronounced than in conventional ultimatum games. Principals' own social preferences are not an important determinant of their behaviour. However, when the principals make contract offers, they anticipate that social preferences affect agents' behaviour.

10.1093/restud/rdt010.abstractZh: 在契约理论中，主代理人模型是一个核心概念，其中代理人能够在合同签订之前获得私人信息。我们进行了一项实验，涉及720名参与者，以探讨这些理论见解是否反映在实验室中的受试者行为上，以及标准理论中的偏差在多大程度上可以通过社会偏好来解释。通过研究具有外生信息结构和内生信息结构的情况，我们发现代理理论确实有助于定性预测不确定性程度的变化如何影响受试者的行为。关于标准预测中的定量偏差，我们的分析基于多种控制处理和量子响应估计，表明代理人的行为可以通过社会偏好来解释，这些社会偏好并不像传统的最后通牒游戏那样明显。主代理人自身的社会偏好并不是他们行为的重要决定因素。然而，当主代理人提出契约提议时，他们预期社会偏好会影响代理人的行为。

abstract.text: We develop a model of endogenous productivity change to examine the impact of the investment in knowledge on the productivity of firms. Our dynamic investment model extends the tradition of the knowledge capital model of Griliches (1979) that has remained a cornerstone of the productivity literature. Rather than constructing a stock of knowledge capital from a firm's observed R&D expenditures, we consider productivity to be unobservable to the econometrician. Our approach accounts for uncertainty, non-linearity, and heterogeneity across firms in the link between R&D and productivity. We also derive a novel estimator for production functions in this setting. Using an unbalanced panel of more than 1800 Spanish manufacturing firms in nine industries during the 1990s, we provide evidence of non-linearities as well as economically significant uncertainties in the R&D process. R&D expenditures play a key role in determining the differences in productivity across firms and the evolution of firm-level productivity over time.

10.1093/restud/rdt011.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个内生生产率变化模型，以研究知识投资对企业生产率的影响。我们的动态投资模型扩展了Griliches（1979）的知识资本模型传统，该模型一直是生产率研究的基石。我们并非根据企业观察到的研发支出来构建知识资本的存量，而是认为生产率对计量经济学家来说是不可观测的。我们的方法考虑了不确定性、非线性和企业间的异质性在研发与生产率之间的联系中的作用。我们还为这种情境下的生产函数推导出了一种新颖的估计方法。通过利用1990年代九个行业中的1800多家西班牙制造企业的不平衡面板数据，我们发现了非线性现象以及研发过程中具有经济意义的不确定性。研发支出在决定企业间生产率差异以及企业生产率随时间演变方面起着关键作用。

abstract.text: We study equilibrium wage and employment dynamics in a class of popular search models with wage posting, in the presence of aggregate productivity shocks. Firms offer and commit to (Markov) contracts, which specify a wage contingent on all payoff-relevant states, but must pay equally all of their workers, who have limited commitment and are free to quit at any time. We find sufficient conditions for the existence and uniqueness of a stochastic search equilibrium in such contracts, which is Rank Preserving [RP]: larger and more productive firms offer more generous contracts to their workers in all states of the world. On the RP equilibrium path, turnover is always efficient as workers always move from less to more productive firms. The resulting stochastic dynamics of firm size provide an intuitive explanation for the empirical finding that large employers have more cyclical job creation (Moscarini and Postel-Vinay, 2012). Finally, computation of RP equilibrium contracts is tractable.

10.1093/restud/rdt012.abstractZh: 我们研究了一类具有工资发布机制的流行搜索模型中的均衡工资和就业动态，这些模型存在于总体生产率冲击的环境中。企业提供并承诺执行（马尔可夫）合同，这些合同根据所有与收益相关的状态来指定工资，但必须向所有工人支付相同的报酬，而工人的承诺能力有限，可以随时辞职。我们发现，在这种合同中存在和唯一性随机搜索均衡的充分条件，即保持排名均衡（RP）：更大、更富有生产力的企业会在世界的所有状态下向工人提供更优厚的合同。在保持排名均衡的均衡路径上，人员流动总是有效的，因为工人总是从生产力较低的企业转移到生产力较高的企业。由此产生的企业规模随机动态为实证发现提供了直观的解释，即大型雇主能够创造更多的周期性就业机会（Moscarini和Postel-Vinay，2012年）。最后，计算保持排名均衡的合同是可行的。

abstract.text: Does internet use trigger sex crime? We use unique Norwegian data on crime and internet adoption to shed light on this question. A public program with limited funding rolled out broadband access points in 2000–2008, and provides plausibly exogenous variation in internet use. Our instrumental variables estimates show that internet use is associated with a substantial increase in both reports, charges and convictions of rape and other sex crimes. We present a conceptual framework that highlights three mechanisms for how internet use may affect reported sex crime, namely a reporting effect, a matching effect on potential offenders and victims, and a direct effect on sex crime propensity. To investigate the importance of these mechanisms, we use data on individual reporting behaviour, police investigations, and criminal charges and convictions. None of the analyses we perform suggest that the positive relationship between internet use and sex crime is driven by changes in reporting behaviour. Our findings suggest that the direct effect on sex crime propensity is positive and non-negligible, possibly as a result of increased consumption of pornography.

10.1093/restud/rdt013.abstractZh: 互联网使用是否会引发性犯罪？我们利用挪威关于犯罪和互联网使用情况的独特数据来探讨这一问题。一项资金有限的公共项目在2000至2008年间推出了宽带接入点，这为互联网使用的差异提供了合理的解释。我们的工具变量估计表明，互联网使用与强奸及其他性犯罪的报告、指控和定罪数量都有显著增加有关。我们提出了一个概念框架，强调了互联网使用可能影响性犯罪报告的三种机制：报告效应、对潜在犯罪者和受害者的匹配效应，以及直接对性犯罪倾向的影响。为了研究这些机制的重要性，我们使用了关于个人报告行为、警方调查以及刑事指控和定罪的数据。我们进行的分析均表明，互联网使用与性犯罪之间的正相关关系并非由报告行为的改变所驱动。我们的研究结果表明，对性犯罪倾向的直接影响是积极的且不可忽视的，这可能是由于色情内容的消费增加所致。

abstract.text: Microfinance clients were randomly assigned to repayment groups that met either weekly or monthly during their first loan cycle, and then graduated to identical meeting frequency for their second loan. Long-run survey data and a follow-up public goods experiment reveal that clients initially assigned to weekly groups interact more often and exhibit a higher willingness to pool risk with group members from their first loan cycle nearly 2 years after the experiment. They were also three times less likely to default on their second loan. Evidence from an additional treatment arm shows that, holding meeting frequency fixed, the pattern is insensitive to repayment frequency during the first loan cycle. Taken together, these findings constitute the first experimental evidence on the economic returns to social interaction, and provide an alternative explanation for the success of the group lending model in reducing default risk.

10.1093/restud/rdt016.abstractZh: 小额信贷客户被随机分配到不同的还款小组，这些小组在第一个贷款周期内的会议频率为每周或每月一次，然后在第二个贷款周期中采用相同的会议频率。长期的调查数据和后续的公共物品实验表明，最初被分配到每周会议小组的客户在实验近两年后，与小组成员之间的互动更加频繁，并且更愿意与小组成员共同承担风险。此外，这些客户在第二次贷款中违约的可能性降低了三倍。来自另一个处理组的证据表明，在会议频率固定的情况下，还款频率对实验结果的影响并不显著。综合这些发现，这构成了关于社会互动对经济回报的首个实验性证据，并为小组贷款模式在降低违约风险方面的成功提供了另一种解释。

abstract.text: Sacrifice is widely believed to enhance cooperation in churches, communes, gangs, clans, military units, and many other groups. We find that sacrifice can also work in the lab, apart from special ideologies, identities, or interactions. Our subjects play a modified VCM game-one in which they can voluntarily join groups that provide reduced rates of return on private investment. This leads to both endogenous sorting (because free-riders tend to reject the reduced-rate option) and substitution (because reduced private productivity favours increased club involvement). Seemingly unproductive costs thus serve to screen out free-riders, attract conditional cooperators, boost club production, and increase member welfare. The sacrifice mechanism is simple and particularly useful where monitoring difficulties impede punishment, exclusion, fees, and other more standard solutions.

10.1093/restud/rdt017.abstractZh: 人们普遍认为，牺牲行为能够增强各种群体中的合作，比如教堂、公社、帮派、家族、军事单位等。我们发现，牺牲行为在实验室环境中同样有效，而不需要特殊的意识形态、身份认同或互动方式。我们的实验对象参与了一种改良版的VCM游戏——在这种游戏中，他们可以自愿加入那些能带来较低私人投资回报率的群体。这导致了两种现象：一种是内生性的排序，因为搭便车者往往会拒绝这种低回报选项；另一种是替代效应，因为较低的私人生产力反而促使人们更多地参与群体活动。这些看似无益的代价实际上起到了筛选搭便车者、吸引愿意合作的人、提升群体产出以及增加成员福利的作用。这种牺牲机制在监控困难导致惩罚、排斥、收费等常规解决方案难以实施的情况下尤为有效。

abstract.text: How much income would a woman living alone require to attain the same standard of living that she would have if she were married? What percentage of a married couple's expenditures are controlled by the husband? How much money does a couple save on consumption goods by living together versus living apart? We propose and estimate a collective model of household behaviour that permits identification and estimation of concepts such as these. We model households in terms of the utility functions of its members, a bargaining or social welfare function, and a consumption technology function. We demonstrate generic non-parametric identification of the model, and hence of a version of adult equivalence scales that we call "indifference scales", as well as consumption economies of scale, the household's resource sharing rule or members' bargaining power, and other related concepts.

10.1093/restud/rdt019.abstractZh: 一个独自生活的女性需要多少收入才能达到与已婚女性相同的生活水平？在已婚夫妇的支出中，有多少比例是由丈夫控制的？夫妻同居与分开居住在消费商品上的储蓄金额有何差异？我们提出并估计了一个集体家庭行为模型，该模型能够识别并估算这些概念。我们通过家庭成员的效用函数、谈判或社会福利函数以及消费技术函数来对家庭进行建模。我们展示了该模型的通用非参数识别方法，从而能够识别我们称之为“无差异尺度”的成人等价尺度版本，以及消费规模经济、家庭的资源共享规则或成员的谈判能力等其他相关概念。

abstract.text: This article presents a model of information manipulation and political regime change. There is a regime that can be overthrown but only if enough citizens participate in an uprising. Citizens are imperfectly informed about the regime's ability to resist an uprising and the regime can engage in propaganda that, taken at face-value, makes the regime seem stronger than it truly is. This coordination game with endogenous information manipulation has a unique equilibrium and the article gives a complete analytic characterization of the equilibrium's comparative statics. Holding fixed the number of signals available to citizens, if the per-unit signal precision is sufficiently high then the regime is harder to overthrow. In contrast, if the number of signals increases, so that both total signal precision and the regime's costs of manipulation rise together, then the regime is easier to overthrow unless there are strong economies of scale in information control.

10.1093/restud/rdt020.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个关于信息操纵与政治体制变革的模型。存在一个可以被推翻的政权，但前提是必须有足够的公民参与起义。公民对政权抵抗起义的能力了解并不充分，而政权则可以通过宣传手段来营造一种让政权看起来比实际更强大的假象。这种包含内生信息操纵的协调博弈具有独特的均衡状态，文章对均衡状态的比较静态特性进行了完整的分析描述。在公民可获得的信号数量固定的情况下，如果单位信号的精确度足够高，那么推翻该政权就会更加困难。相反，如果信号数量增加，导致信号总精确度以及政权操纵成本同时上升，那么推翻该政权就会变得更加容易，除非在信息控制方面存在显著的规模经济效应。

abstract.text: This research argues that deep-rooted factors, determined tens of thousands of years ago, had a significant effect on the course of economic development from the dawn of human civilization to the contemporary era. It advances and empirically establishes the hypothesis that, in the course of the exodus of Homo sapiens out of Africa, variation in migratory distance from the cradle of humankind to various settlements across the globe affected genetic diversity and has had a long-lasting effect on the pattern of comparative economic development that is not captured by geographical, institutional, and cultural factors. In particular, the level of genetic diversity within a society is found to have a hump-shaped effect on development outcomes in both the pre-colonial and the modern era, reflecting the trade-off between the beneficial and the detrimental effects of diversity on productivity. While the intermediate level of genetic diversity prevalent among Asian and European populations has been conducive for development, the high degree of diversity among African populations and the low degree of diversity among Native American populations have been a detrimental force in the development of these regions.

10.1257/aer.103.1.1.abstractZh: 本研究认为，数万年前就形成的根深蒂固的因素，对人类文明起源至当代的经济发展历程产生了显著影响。研究提出并实证验证了这样一个假设：在智人从非洲迁出过程中，从人类发源地到全球各地定居点的迁徙距离差异，影响了遗传多样性，并对比较经济发展模式产生了长期影响，而这些影响并非由地理、制度和文化因素所决定。具体而言，一个社会内部的遗传多样性水平对前殖民时期和现代时期的发展结果具有驼峰状影响，反映了多样性对生产力产生的有益与有害影响之间的权衡。虽然亚洲和欧洲人口中较高的遗传多样性水平有助于发展，但非洲人口的高遗传多样性水平以及美洲原住民人口较低的遗传多样性水平，则对这些地区的发展产生了负面影响。

abstract.text: British Master and Servant law made employee contract breach a criminal offense until 1875. We develop a contracting model generating equilibrium contract breach and prosecutions, then exploit exogenous changes in output prices to examine the effects of labor demand shocks on prosecutions. Positive shocks in the textile, iron, and coal industries increased prosecutions. Following the abolition of criminal sanctions, wages differentially rose in counties that had experienced more prosecutions, and wages responded more to labor demand shocks. Coercive contract enforcement was applied in industrial Britain; restricted mobility allowed workers to commit to risk-sharing contracts with lower, but less volatile, wages. (JEL J31, J41, K12, K31, N33, N43)

10.1257/aer.103.1.107.abstractZh: 英国的主从法将员工合同违约行为定为刑事犯罪，这一状况一直持续到1875年。我们建立了一个契约模型，该模型能够产生合同违约与刑事起诉的均衡状态，然后通过分析产出价格的外生变化来研究劳动力需求冲击对刑事起诉的影响。纺织、钢铁和煤炭行业的冲击导致了更多的起诉。在刑事制裁被废除后，那些经历过更多起诉的地区的工资有所上升，并且工资对劳动力需求冲击的反应更为敏感。在工业英国，强制性的合同执行被采用；限制工人的流动性使得工人能够签订风险共担的合同，从而获得较低但波动较小的工资。（JEL J31, J41, K12, K31, N33, N43）

abstract.text: Many important issues in business-to-business markets involve price discrimination and negotiated prices, situations where theoretical predictions are ambiguous. This paper uses new panel data on buyer-supplier transfers and a structural model to empirically analyze bargaining and price discrimination in a medical device market. While many phenomena that restrict different prices to different buyers are suggested as ways to decrease hospital costs (e.g., mergers, group purchasing organizations, and transparency), I find that: (i) more uniform pricing works against hospitals by softening competition; and (ii) results depend ultimately on a previously unexplored bargaining effect. (JEL C78, L13, L14, L64)

10.1257/aer.103.1.145.abstractZh: 在商业对商业市场中，许多重要问题涉及价格歧视和协商定价，这些情况下的理论预测并不明确。本文利用新的面板数据关于买方-供应商转移的数据，并通过结构模型对医疗设备市场中的讨价还价和价格歧视现象进行了实证分析。虽然许多现象被认为可以减少医院成本，例如合并、集团采购组织和透明度提升，但我发现：(i) 更统一的定价会削弱医院的竞争力；(ii) 结果最终取决于一种之前未被探索的讨价还价效应。(JEL C78, L13, L14, L64)

abstract.text: We use employee-level panel data from a single firm to explore the possibility that individuals may select insurance coverage in part based on their anticipated behavioral ("moral hazard") response to insurance, a phenomenon we label "selection on moral hazard." Using a model of plan choice and medical utilization, we present evidence of heterogeneous moral hazard as well as selection on it, and explore some of its implications. For example, we show that, at least in our context, abstracting from selection on moral hazard could lead to over-estimates of the spending reduction associated with introducing a high-deductible health insurance option.

10.1257/aer.103.1.178.abstractZh: 我们利用一家公司的员工层面面板数据，探讨个体是否会根据其对保险的预期行为（“道德风险”）反应来选择保险覆盖，这一现象我们称之为“基于道德风险的选择”。通过构建计划选择和医疗利用的模型，我们发现了异质性的道德风险现象以及基于该风险的选择行为，并探讨了其一些影响。例如，我们指出，至少在我们的研究背景下，忽略基于道德风险的选择行为可能会导致对引入高免赔额健康保险选项所带来的支出减少的过度估计。

abstract.text: We investigate whether car buyers are myopic about future fuel costs. We estimate the effect of gasoline prices on short-run equilibrium prices of cars of different fuel economies. We then compare the implied changes in willingness-to-pay to the associated changes in expected future gasoline costs for cars of different fuel economies in order to calculate implicit discount rates. Using different assumptions about annual mileage, survival rates, and demand elasticities, we calculate a range of implicit discount rates similar to the range of interest rates paid by car buyers who borrow. We interpret this as showing little evidence of consumer myopia. (JEL D12, H25, L11, L62, L71, L81)

10.1257/aer.103.1.220.abstractZh: 我们研究了汽车购买者对未来燃油成本是否存在短视行为。我们估算了汽油价格对不同燃油经济性汽车短期均衡价格的影响。然后，我们将不同燃油经济性汽车支付意愿的相应变化与未来预期汽油成本的变化进行比较，以计算隐性折现率。通过采用不同的年度里程、生存率和需求弹性假设，我们计算出一系列与汽车购买者借款时所支付的利率范围相似的隐性折现率。我们认为这表明消费者并没有表现出明显的短视行为。（JEL D12, H25, L11, L62, L71, L81）

abstract.text: I explore the association between regional variations in physician behavior and the geographical scope of malpractice standards of care. I estimate a 30–50 percent reduction in the gap between state and national utilization rates of various treatments and diagnostic procedures following the adoption of a rule requiring physicians to follow national, as opposed to local, standards. These findings suggest that standardization in malpractice law may lead to greater standardization in practices and, more generally, that physicians may indeed adhere to specific liability standards. In connection with the estimated convergence in practices, I observe no associated changes in patient health. (JEL I11, I18, J44, K13)

10.1257/aer.103.1.257.abstractZh: 我探讨了医生行为区域差异与医疗事故标准治疗范围之间的关联。通过估计，在采用要求医生遵循国家标准而非地方标准的规则后，各州与全国范围内各种治疗和诊断程序的利用率差距将减少30%至50%。这些发现表明，医疗事故法律的标准化可能导致实践中的更大标准化，并且，医生确实可能会遵守特定的责任标准。与估计的实践趋同情况相关的是，我没有观察到患者健康状况的相关变化。（JEL I11, I18, J44, K13）

abstract.text: We find that greater institutional ownership is associated with more innovation. To explore the mechanism, we contrast the “lazy manager” hypothesis with a model where institutional owners increase innovation incentives through reducing career risks. The evidence favors career concerns. First, we find complementarity between institutional ownership and product market competition, whereas the lazy manager hypothesis predicts substitution. Second, CEOs are less likely to be fired in the face of profit downturns when institutional ownership is higher. Finally, using instrumental variables, policy changes, and disaggregating by type of institutional owner, we argue that the effect of institutions on innovation is causal. (JEL G23, G32, L25, M10, O31, O34)

10.1257/aer.103.1.277.abstractZh: 我们发现，较高的机构所有权与更多的创新相关。为了探讨这一机制，我们将“懒惰管理者”假说与一种模型进行了对比，该模型认为机构所有者通过降低职业风险来增加创新的激励。研究结果支持职业关切的观点。首先，我们发现机构所有权与产品市场竞争之间存在互补关系，而懒惰管理者假说则预测了替代关系。其次，当机构所有权较高时，首席执行官在利润下降时更不容易被解雇。最后，通过使用工具变量、政策变化以及按机构所有者类型进行细分，我们认为制度对创新的影响具有因果性作用。（JEL G23, G32, L25, M10, O31, O34）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effect of idiosyncratic (firm-level) policy distortions on aggregate outcomes. Exploiting harmonized firm-level data for a number of countries, we show that there is substantial and systematic cross-country variation in the within-industry covariance between size and productivity. We develop a model in which heterogeneous firms face adjustment frictions (overhead labor and quasi-fixed capital) and distortions. The model can be readily calibrated so that variations in the distribution of distortions allow matching the observed cross-country moments. We show that the differences in the distortions that account for the size-productivity covariance imply substantial differences in aggregate performance. (JEL D24, L25, O47)

10.1257/aer.103.1.305.abstractZh: 本文研究了企业层面的政策扭曲对总体结果的影响。通过利用多个国家的企业层面数据，我们发现不同行业内企业规模与生产率之间的协方差存在显著且系统的跨国差异。我们建立了一个模型，其中不同企业面临调整摩擦（如额外劳动和准固定资本）以及政策扭曲。该模型可以轻松校准，使得扭曲分布的差异能够与观察到的跨国统计特征相匹配。我们指出，导致规模与生产率协方差差异的扭曲因素，实际上意味着整体绩效存在显著差异。（JEL D24, L25, O47）

abstract.text: We model retail-price recommendations (RPRs) as a communication device in vertical supply relations with private manufacturer information on production costs and consumer demand. With static trade, RPRs are irrelevant, and the equilibrium outcome is inefficient. With repeated trade, RPRs can become part of a relational contract, communicating private information from manufacturer to retailer that is indispensable for maximizing joint surplus. We show that this contract is self-enforcing if the retailer's profit is independent of production costs and punishment strategies are chosen appropriately. The predictions of our analysis are consistent with the available empirical evidence. (JEL D21, D24, L11, L14, L22, L60, L81)

10.1257/aer.103.1.335.abstractZh: 我们将零售价格建议模型视为一种在垂直供应链中的沟通工具，其中涉及私人制造商的生产成本信息和消费者需求信息。在静态贸易中，零售价格建议是无关紧要的，均衡结果也是低效的。而在重复贸易中，零售价格建议可以成为关系契约的一部分，能够传递制造商与零售商之间的私人信息，这些信息对于最大化共同收益至关重要。我们证明，如果零售商的利润独立于生产成本，并且惩罚策略选择得当，那么这种契约能够自我执行。我们的分析结果与现有的实证证据是一致的。（JEL D21, D24, L11, L14, L22, L60, L81）

abstract.text: Consider an investor who fears ruin when facing investments that satisfy no-arbitrage. Before investing he can purchase information about the state of nature as an information structure. Given his prior, information structure α investment dominates information structure β if, whenever he is willing to buy β at some price, he is also willing to buy α at that price. We show that this informativeness ordering is complete and is represented by the decrease in entropy of his beliefs, regardless of his preferences, initial wealth, or investment problem. We also show that no prior-independent informativeness ordering based on similar premises exists. (JEL D14, D81, D83, G11)

10.1257/aer.103.1.360.abstractZh: 设想一位投资者，在面对满足无套利条件的投资时，他害怕遭受损失。在投资之前，他可以获取关于市场状况的信息，这些信息构成他的信息结构。根据他的先验信息结构α，如果他在某个价格愿意购买信息结构β，那么他同样愿意以该价格购买信息结构α，那么投资结构α就会优于信息结构β。我们证明这种信息排序是完备的，并且可以通过他信念的熵减少来表示，而不受他的偏好、初始财富或投资问题的影响。我们还证明了，基于类似前提的、与先验无关的信息排序是不存在的。（JEL D14, D81, D83, G11）

abstract.text: Economies at early stages of development are frequently shaken by large changes in growth rates, whereas advanced economies tend to experience relatively stable growth rates. To explain this pattern, we propose a model of technological diversification. Production makes use of input-varieties that are subject to imperfectly correlated shocks. Endogenous variety adoption by firms raises average productivity and provides diversification benefits against variety-specific shocks. Firm-level and aggregate volatility thus decline as a by-product of the development process. We quantitatively assess the model's predictions and find that it can generate patterns of volatility and development consistent with the data. (JEL D21, D24, E23, O33, O47)

10.1257/aer.103.1.378.abstractZh: 处于发展初期经济体往往会受到增长率大幅变化的冲击，而发达经济体则倾向于保持相对稳定的增长率。为了解释这一现象，我们提出了一个技术多元化的模型。该模型利用受不完全相关冲击影响的多种投入品进行生产。企业采用多样化的投入品可以提高平均生产率，并减少特定种类冲击带来的负面影响。因此，随着发展过程的推进，企业层面和整体市场的波动性都会降低。我们对该模型的预测进行了定量评估，发现其能够生成与数据一致的波动性和发展模式。（JEL D21, D24, E23, O33, O47）

abstract.text: We study if and how social preferences extend to risky environments. We provide experimental evidence from different versions of dictator games with risky outcomes and establish that preferences that are exclusively based on ex post or on ex ante comparisons cannot generate the observed behavioral patterns. The more money decision-makers transfer in the standard dictator game, the more likely they are to equalize payoff chances under risk. Risk to the recipient does, however, generally decrease the transferred amount. Ultimately, a utility function with a combination of ex post and ex ante fairness concerns may best describe behavior. (JEL C72, D63, D64, D81)

10.1257/aer.103.1.415.abstractZh: 我们研究社会偏好是否以及如何在风险环境中延伸。我们通过不同版本的具有风险结果的独裁游戏实验数据，证明仅基于事后或事前比较的偏好无法产生观察到的行为模式。在标准独裁游戏中，决策者转移的资金越多，他们在风险情况下平等分配收益的可能性就越大。然而，风险通常会降低转移的金额。最终，结合事后和事前公平考虑的效用函数可能最能描述行为。（JEL C72, D63, D64, D81）

abstract.text: The share of household resources devoted to children is hard to identify because consumption is measured at the household level and goods can be shared. Using semiparametric restrictions on individual preferences within a collective model, we identify how total household resources are divided up among household members by observing how each family member's expenditures on a single private good like clothing vary with income and family size. Using data from Malawi we show how resources devoted to wives and children vary by family size and structure, and we find that standard poverty indices understate the incidence of child poverty. (JEL I31, I32, J12, J13, O12, O15)

10.1257/aer.103.1.438.abstractZh: 难以确定家庭资源中用于儿童的份额，因为消费是在家庭层面进行衡量的，而且商品是可以共享的。通过在一个集体模型中对个体偏好施加半参数限制，我们可以通过观察每个家庭成员在单一私人商品上的支出如何随收入和家庭规模变化，来识别家庭资源如何在家庭成员之间分配。利用马拉维的数据，我们展示了资源在妻子和儿童身上的分配如何随家庭规模和结构而变化，并发现标准的贫困指数低估了儿童贫困的发生率。（JEL I31, I32, J12, J13, O12, O15）

abstract.text: An agent advises a principal on selecting one of multiple projects or an outside option. The agent is privately informed about the projects' benefits and shares the principal's preferences except for not internalizing her value from the outside option. We show that for moderate outside option values, strategic communication is characterized by pandering: the agent biases his recommendation toward “conditionally better-looking” projects, even when both parties would be better off with some other project. A project that has lower expected value can be conditionally better-looking. We develop comparative statics and implications of pandering. Pandering is also induced by an optimal mechanism without transfers. (JEL D23, D82)

10.1257/aer.103.1.47.abstractZh: 一位代理人负责为委托人推荐多个项目或外部选择之一。代理人仅了解项目的收益信息，并遵循委托人的偏好，但不会将外部选择带来的收益纳入考虑。我们指出，在中等外部选择价值的情况下，代理人的策略性沟通表现为“迎合”行为：即使存在其他更优的项目，代理人仍倾向于推荐那些“看起来更优”的项目。那些预期价值较低的项目也可能被认定为“看起来更优”。我们进一步探讨了这种迎合行为背后的经济学原理及其影响。此外，即使没有转移机制，代理人也会出于最优机制选择这种策略性沟通方式。（JEL D23, D82）

abstract.text: This paper develops a learning model of cultural change to investigate why women's labor force participation (LFP) and attitudes toward women's work both changed dramatically. In the model, women's beliefs about the long-run payoff from working evolve endogenously via an intergenerational learning process. This process generically generates the data's S-shaped LFP curve and introduces a novel role for wage changes via their effect on the speed of intergenerational learning. The calibrated model does a good job of replicating the evolution of female LFP in the United States over the last 120 years and finds that the new role for wages was quantitatively significant.

10.1257/aer.103.1.472.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个文化变迁学习模型，以探究为何女性劳动力参与率和对女性工作的态度都发生了巨大变化。在模型中，女性关于长期工作收益的信念通过代际学习过程内生性地演变。这一过程通常会导致数据呈现S形曲线，并引入了工资变化在促进代际学习速度方面的新角色。经过校准的模型能够很好地再现过去120年美国女性劳动力参与率的演变趋势，并发现工资变化在其中的作用具有显著的定量意义。

abstract.text: Both submission fees and response times enable editors to maintain an acceptable refereeing burden by discouraging the submission of articles with low probability of acceptance. When authors differ in their ability or willingness to pay submission fees and deal with delays, journal quality is maximized under a combination of moderate fees and moderate delays.

10.1257/aer.103.1.501.abstractZh: 无论是投稿费还是回复时间，都能帮助编辑维持可接受的审稿负担，从而抑制那些被接受概率较低的文章的提交。当作者在支付投稿费以及应对延迟方面存在能力或意愿差异时，适度收取费用并适度延长回复时间相结合的方式，能够最大化期刊的质量。

abstract.text: We study risk attitudes, ambiguity attitudes, and time preferences of 661 children and adolescents, aged ten to eighteen years, in an incentivized experiment and relate experimental choices to field behavior. Experimental measures of impatience are found to be significant predictors of health-related field behavior, saving decisions, and conduct at school. In particular, more impatient children and adolescents are more likely to spend money on alcohol and cigarettes, have a higher body mass index, are less likely to save money, and show worse conduct at school. Experimental measures for risk and ambiguity attitudes are only weak predictors of field behavior.

10.1257/aer.103.1.510.abstractZh: 我们研究了661名年龄在10至18岁的儿童和青少年的风险态度、模糊态度以及时间偏好，这些研究是在一项激励性实验中进行的，并将实验中的选择与现实行为进行了关联。实验结果显示，急躁情绪是健康相关行为、储蓄决策以及学校行为的重要预测因素。具体而言，更急躁的儿童和青少年更有可能花费金钱购买酒精和香烟，他们的体重指数更高，储蓄意愿较低，并且在学校的行为表现较差。对于风险和模糊态度的实验测量结果则只是对现实行为的较弱预测因素。

abstract.text: We conduct an experiment assessing the extent to which people trade off the economic costs of truthfulness against the intrinsic costs of lying. The results allow us to reject a type-based model. People's preferences for truthfulness do not identify them as only either “economic types” (who care only about consequences) or “ethical types” (who care only about process). Instead, we find that preferences for truthfulness are heterogeneous among individuals. Moreover, when examining possible sources of intrinsic costs of lying and their interplay with economic costs of truthfulness, we find that preferences for truthfulness are also heterogeneous within individuals.

10.1257/aer.103.1.532.abstractZh: 我们进行了一项实验，以评估人们在多大程度上会在诚实的经济成本与说谎的内在成本之间进行权衡。实验结果使我们能够排除基于类型的模型。人们对诚实的偏好并不表明他们只能是“经济型”人物（只关心后果）或“伦理型”人物（只关心过程）。相反，我们发现不同个体对诚实的偏好存在差异。此外，在考察说谎的内在成本的可能来源及其与经济成本之间的相互作用时，我们发现个体内部对诚实的偏好也存在差异。

abstract.text: We provide an example that shows that in the Alesina and Angeletos (2005) model one can obtain multiplicity even if luck plays no role in the economy. Thus, it is not critical that the noise to signal ratio be increasing in taxes, or that desired taxes are increasing in the noise to signal ratio.

10.1257/aer.103.1.549.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个例子，表明在Alesina和Angeletos（2005）的模型中，即使运气在经济中不起作用，也可以获得多重性。因此，税收变化导致噪声与信号比例增加，或者期望的税收随着噪声与信号比例的增加而变化，这些都不是关键性的条件。

abstract.text: This paper responds to the comment of Di Tella and Dubra (2013). We first clarify that the model of Alesina and Angeletos (2005) admits two distinct types of multiplicity: one that is at the core of their contribution, and a separate one that is at work in Di Tella and Dubra's example. We then proceed to show how Alesina and Angeletos's results are robust to alternative specifications of the voting mechanism.

10.1257/aer.103.1.554.abstractZh: 本文回应了Di Tella和Dubra（2013）的评论。我们首先明确，Alesina和Angeletos（2005）的模型承认两种不同类型的多重性：一种是其核心贡献所在，另一种则体现在Di Tella和Dubra的例子中。接着，我们展示了Alesina和Angeletos的研究结果对于投票机制的替代性规格仍然具有稳健性。

abstract.text: In Fall 2009, Chicago authorities abandoned a school assignment mechanism midstream, citing concerns about its vulnerability to manipulation. Nonetheless, they asked thousands of applicants to re-rank schools in a new mechanism that is also manipulable. This paper introduces a method to compare mechanisms by their vulnerability to manipulation. Our methodology formalizes how the old mechanism is at least as manipulable as any other plausible mechanism, including the new one. A number of similar transitions took place in England after the widely popular Boston mechanism was ruled illegal in 2007. Our approach provides support for these and other recent policy changes. (JEL C78, D82, H75, I21, I28)

10.1257/aer.103.1.80.abstractZh: 在2009年秋季，芝加哥当局在过程中放弃了学校排名机制，原因是担心该机制容易被操纵。尽管如此，他们仍要求数千名申请者通过一种新的机制重新对学校进行排名，而这种新机制同样容易被操纵。本文介绍了一种通过比较机制被操纵的可能性来评估其可靠性的方法。我们的方法表明，旧机制至少和其他任何可行的机制一样容易被操纵，包括新的机制。在2007年波士顿机制被宣布非法后，英国也发生了类似的调整。我们的方法为这些以及其它近期政策变化提供了支持。（JEL C78, D82, H75, I21, I28）

abstract.text: We analyze the optimal policy of an antitrust authority towards horizontal mergers when merger proposals are endogenous and firms choose among alternative mergers. In our model, the optimal policy of an antitrust authority that seeks to maximize expected consumer surplus imposes a tougher standard on “larger” mergers, i.e., those involving firms with a larger pre-merger market share. The optimal policy is a response to a bias in firms' proposal incentives: firms always propose a larger merger when it is better for consumers than a smaller one, but sometimes will propose the larger one even when it is worse for consumers.

10.1257/aer.103.2.1006.abstractZh: 我们分析了在合并提案是内生性的情况下，反垄断机构针对横向合并的最优政策。在模型中，反垄断机构旨在最大化预期消费者剩余的最优政策，对“较大规模”的合并提出了更严格的标准，即涉及合并前市场份额较大的企业之间的合并。这一最优政策是对企业合并提案动机中存在的偏差的回应：当合并对消费者更有利时，企业总是会提出更大规模的合并提案；而当合并对消费者更不利时，企业有时也会选择更大规模的合并。

abstract.text: The standard assumption that asset demand increases in income and decreases in price has its origin in Arrow's classic model with one risky and one risk free asset, where both are held long, and preferences exhibit decreasing absolute and increasing relative risk aversion. However if one allows shorting of the risk free asset or decreasing relative risk aversion, the risk free asset can not only fail to be a normal good but can be a Giffen good. This behavior can occur even for members of the popular HARA utility family. More generally, Giffen behavior can occur over multiple income ranges.

10.1257/aer.103.2.1034.abstractZh: 资产需求随收入增加、价格下降这一标准假设源于Arrow的经典模型，该模型包含一种风险资产一种无风险资产，且两者都被长期持有，同时偏好表现为绝对风险厌恶度下降、相对风险厌恶度上升。然而，如果允许对无风险资产进行做空交易或降低相对风险厌恶度，无风险资产不仅可能不再是一种正常商品，反而可能成为一种吉芬商品。这种行为甚至可能出现在HARA效用函数族的成员身上。更普遍地说，吉芬行为可能出现在多个收入范围内。

abstract.text: Using recent results in the measurement error literature, we show that the official US unemployment rate substantially underestimates the true level of unemployment, due to misclassification errors in the labor force status in the Current Population Survey. During the period from January 1996 to August 2011, the corrected monthly unemployment rates are between 1 and 4.4 percentage points (2.1 percentage points on average) higher than the official rates, and are more sensitive to changes in business cycles. The labor force participation rates, however, are not affected by this correction.

10.1257/aer.103.2.1054.abstractZh: 利用近期关于测量误差的研究结果，我们发现美国的官方失业率严重低估了真实的失业水平，这主要是由于当前人口调查中对劳动力状态的分类错误所致。在1996年1月至2011年8月期间，修正后的月度失业率比官方失业率高出1至4.4个百分点（平均2.1个百分点），并且对商业周期的变化更为敏感。然而，劳动力参与率并未受到这种修正的影响。

abstract.text: The Bagwell and Staiger (1990) theory of cooperative trade agreements predicts new tariffs (i) increase with imports, (ii) increase with the inverse of the sum of the import demand and export supply elasticities, and (iii) decrease with the variance of imports. We find US import policy during 1997–2006 to be consistent with this theory. A one standard deviation increase in import growth, the inverse of the sum of the import demand and export supply elasticity, and the standard deviation of import growth changes the probability that the US imposes an antidumping tariff by 35 percent, by 88 percent, and by –76 percent, respectively.

10.1257/aer.103.2.1071.abstractZh: Bagwell和Staiger在1990年提出的合作贸易协定理论预测，新关税的征收情况如下：i) 随着进口量的增加而增加；ii) 随着进口需求与出口供给弹性之和的倒数增加；iii) 随着进口波动幅度的增加而减少。我们发现，1997年至2006年期间美国的进口政策与这一理论相符。进口增长增加一个标准差、进口需求与出口供给弹性之和的倒数增加一个标准差，以及进口增长波动幅度增加一个标准差，分别会使美国征收反倾销关税的概率增加35%、88%和-76%。

abstract.text: We present a theory of charitable fund-raising in which it is costly to solicit donors. We fully characterize the solicitation strategy that maximizes donations net of fund-raising costs. It is optimal for the fund-raiser to target only the “net contributors”––donors who would give more than their solicitation costs. We show that as the income inequality increases, so does the level of the public good, despite a (potentially) non-monotonic fund-raising strategy. This implies that costly fund-raising can provide a novel explanation for the non-neutrality of income redistributions and government grants often found in empirical studies.

10.1257/aer.103.2.1091.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种慈善筹款理论，其中寻求捐赠者的行为成本很高。我们详细描述了一种最大化捐赠净额的筹款策略。对于筹款者来说，最优策略是只针对那些愿意捐赠超过筹款成本的“净贡献者”。我们指出，随着收入不平等的加剧，公共产品的水平也会上升，尽管这种筹款策略可能并非单调的。这意味着，昂贵的筹款行为可以为实证研究中经常发现的收入再分配和政府拨款的非中立性提供新的解释。

abstract.text: Drastic changes in central bank operations and monetary institutions in recent years have made previously standard approaches to explaining the determination of the price level obsolete. Recent expansions of central bank balance sheets and of the levels of richcountry sovereign debt, as well as the evolving political economy of the European Monetary Union, have made it clear that fiscal policy and monetary policy are intertwined. Our thinking and teaching about inflation, monetary policy, and fiscal policy should be based on models that recognize fiscal-monetary policy interactions. (JEL E31, E52, E58, E62, H63)

10.1257/aer.103.2.563.abstractZh: 近年来，中央银行操作和货币机构的剧烈变化使得以往用于解释价格水平决定的方法变得过时。中央银行资产负债表和富国主权债务水平的近期扩张，以及欧洲货币联盟政治经济的演变，都表明财政政策与货币政策是相互交织的。我们关于通货膨胀、货币政策和财政政策的思考与教学应基于能够识别财政与货币政策相互作用的模型。（JEL E31, E52, E58, E62, H63）

abstract.text: Randomization is commonplace in everyday resource allocation. We generalize the theory of randomized assignment to accommodate multi-unit allocations and various real-world constraints, such as group-specific quotas (“controlled choice”) in school choice and house allocation, and scheduling and curriculum constraints in course allocation. We develop new mechanisms that are ex ante efficient and fair in these environments, and that incorporate certain non-additive substitutable preferences. We also develop a “utility guarantee” technique that limits ex post unfairness in random allocations, supplementing the ex ante fairness promoted by randomization. This can be applied to multi-unit assignment problems and certain two-sided matching problems. (JEL C78, D82)

10.1257/aer.103.2.585.abstractZh: 随机化在日常资源分配中非常常见。我们将随机分配的理论推广到多单元分配以及各种现实世界的约束条件，例如学校选择和房屋分配中的群体特定配额（“控制选择”），以及课程分配中的时间安排和课程限制。我们开发了在这些环境中既高效又公平的新机制，并考虑了某些非加性可替代偏好。我们还开发了一种“效用保证”技术，用于限制随机分配后的不公平现象，从而补充了随机化带来的事前公平性。这一技术可以应用于多单元分配问题和某些双边匹配问题。（JEL C78, D82）

abstract.text: We estimate a model of strategic voting and quantify the impact it has on election outcomes. Because the model exhibits multiplicity of outcomes, we adopt a set estimator. Using Japanese general-election data, we find a large fraction (63.4 percent, 84.9 percent) of strategic voters, only a small fraction (1.4 percent, 4.2 percent) of whom voted for a candidate other than the one they most preferred (misaligned voting). Existing empirical literature has not distinguished between the two, estimating misaligned voting instead of strategic voting. Accordingly, while our estimate of strategic voting is high, our estimate of misaligned voting is comparable to previous studies. (JEL D72)

10.1257/aer.103.2.624.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个战略投票模型，并量化了其对选举结果的影响。由于该模型存在多种结果可能性，我们采用了集合估计方法。利用日本大选数据，我们发现有相当大比例（63.4%，84.9%）的选民属于战略投票者，其中只有一小部分（1.4%，4.2%）的选民选择了与他们最不喜欢的候选人投票（即非战略投票）。现有的实证文献并未区分这两种情况，而是将非战略投票作为战略投票的另一种形式进行估计。因此，尽管我们对战略投票的估计较高，但我们对非战略投票的估计与以往研究的结果相当。（JEL D72）

abstract.text: Dynamic matching and bargaining games are models of decentralized markets with trading frictions. A central objective is to investigate how equilibrium outcomes depend on the level of frictions. In particular, does the trading outcome become Walrasian when frictions become small? Existing specifications of such games provide divergent answers. This paper presents a new characterization result for competitive allocations in quasilinear economies. The characterization result is used to investigate what causes these differences and to generalize insights from the analysis of specific matching and bargaining games. (JEL C73, C78, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.103.2.663.abstractZh: 动态匹配与讨价还价游戏是带有交易摩擦的去中心化市场模型。其核心目标是研究均衡结果如何依赖于摩擦的程度。具体来说，当摩擦程度降低时，交易结果是否会变得符合瓦尔拉斯均衡？现有对这些游戏的建模结果存在分歧。本文提出了一种关于准线性经济中竞争分配的新表征结果。该表征结果被用来探究这些差异的原因，并推广对特定匹配与讨价还价游戏分析所得出的见解。（JEL C73, C78, D82, D83）

abstract.text: Languages differ widely in the ways they encode time. I test the hypothesis that the languages that grammatically associate the future and the present, foster future-oriented behavior. This prediction arises naturally when well-documented effects of language structure are merged with models of intertemporal choice. Empirically, I find that speakers of such languages: save more, retire with more wealth, smoke less, practice safer sex, and are less obese. This holds both across countries and within countries when comparing demographically similar native households. The evidence does not support the most obvious forms of common causation. I discuss implications for theories of intertemporal choice.

10.1257/aer.103.2.690.abstractZh: 不同语言在时间编码的方式上存在很大差异。我测试了这样一个假设：那些在语法上将未来和现在联系起来的语言，会促进面向未来的行为。这一预测在将语言结构的已有研究结果与跨时间选择模型相结合时自然产生。从经验数据来看，我发现使用这类语言的说话者会更多地储蓄、以更多的财富退休、吸烟较少、采取更安全的性行为，并且肥胖程度较低。这一结论在跨国和国内比较中均成立，尤其是在比较人口统计特征相似的本土家庭时。这些证据并不支持最常见的因果关联形式。我讨论了这一发现对跨时间选择理论的影响。

abstract.text: We model the dynamics of risk premia during crises in asset markets where the marginal investor is a financial intermediary. Intermediaries face an equity capital constraint. Risk premia rise when the constraint binds, reflecting the capital scarcity. The calibrated model matches the nonlinearity of risk premia during crises and the speed of reversion in risk premia from a crisis back to precrisis levels. We evaluate the effect of three government policies: reducing intermediaries borrowing costs, injecting equity capital, and purchasing distressed assets. Injecting equity capital is particularly effective because it alleviates the equity capital constraint that drives the model's crisis. (JEL E44, G12, G21, G23, G24)

10.1257/aer.103.2.732.abstractZh: 我们模拟了在危机期间资产市场中风险溢价的变化动态，其中边际投资者是金融中介。中介面临股权资本的限制。当这种限制存在时，风险溢价会上升，反映出资本的稀缺性。经过校准的模型能够准确反映危机期间风险溢价的非线性变化以及风险溢价从危机状态恢复到危机前水平的速度。我们评估了三项政府政策的效果：降低中介的借贷成本、注入股权资本以及收购困境资产。注入股权资本尤其有效，因为它能够缓解推动模型危机发生的股权资本限制。（JEL E44, G12, G21, G23, G24）

abstract.text: We consider a model with on-the-job search where current wages depend only on current aggregate labor market conditions and idiosyncratic match-specific productivities. We show theoretically that the model replicates the findings in Bils (1985) and Beaudry and DiNardo (1991) on the history dependence in wages. We develop a method to measure match qualities in the data and show empirically that various variables summarizing past aggregate labor market conditions have explanatory power for current wages only because they are correlated with match qualities. They lose any predictive power once match qualities are accounted for. (JEL E3, E24, J3)

10.1257/aer.103.2.771.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个在职搜寻模型，其中当前工资仅取决于当前整体劳动力市场状况以及特定匹配条件下的生产率。我们从理论上证明了该模型能够复制Bils（1985）和Beaudry与DiNardo（1991）关于工资历史依赖性的研究结果。我们开发了一种方法来衡量数据中的匹配质量，并通过实证分析表明，那些能够概括过去整体劳动力市场状况的各种变量，只有在与匹配质量相关时，才能对当前工资产生解释力。一旦考虑了匹配质量，这些变量便失去了预测能力。（JEL E3, E24, J3）

abstract.text: We use novel data to study genetic testing among individuals at risk for Huntington disease (HD), a hereditary disease with limited life expectancy. Although genetic testing is perfectly predictive and carries little economic cost, presymptomatic testing is rare. Testing rates increase with increases in ex ante risk of having HD. Untested individuals express optimistic beliefs about their health and make decisions (e.g., retirement) as if they do not have HD, even though individuals with confirmed HD behave differently. We suggest that these facts can be reconciled by an optimal expectations model (Brunnermeier and Parker 2005). (JEL D84, I12)

10.1257/aer.103.2.804.abstractZh: 我们利用新颖的数据来研究有亨廷顿病风险个体的基因检测情况。亨廷顿病是一种遗传性疾病，患者的预期寿命较短。尽管基因检测具有极高的预测性且经济成本较低，但症状前检测却较为罕见。检测率随着患亨廷顿病的风险增加而增加。未接受检测的个体对自身的健康状况持乐观态度，并做出诸如退休这样的决定，仿佛自己并未患病一样，而确诊患亨廷顿病的个体则表现出不同的行为。我们认为，这些现象可以通过最优期望模型来解释（Brunnermeier和Parker，2005年）。（JEL D84, I12）

abstract.text: We estimate a spatial model of liquor demand to analyze the impact of government-controlled retailing on entry patterns. In the absence of the Pennsylvania Liquor Control Board, the state would have roughly 2.5 times the current number of stores, higher consumer surplus, and lower payments to liquor store employees. With just over half the number of stores that would maximize welfare, the government system is instead best rationalized as profit maximization with profit sharing. Government operation mitigates, but does not eliminate, free entry's bias against rural consumers. We find only limited evidence of political influence on entry. (JEL D42, D72, L11, L12, L43, L81)

10.1257/aer.103.2.831.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个空间模型来分析政府控制的零售对进入模式的影响。在没有宾夕法尼亚州酒类控制委员会的情况下，该州的商店数量大约会是现在的2.5倍，消费者剩余会更高，而酒类商店员工的薪酬则会更低。由于政府系统下的商店数量仅略多于能最大化福利的数量，因此政府系统更合理地被解释为以利润最大化为基础，同时实现利润共享。政府的运作虽然减轻了自由进入对农村消费者的偏见，但并未完全消除这种偏见。我们发现，政治对进入的影响证据非常有限。（JEL D42, D72, L11, L12, L43, L81）

abstract.text: We provide evidence that increased political influence, arising from CIA interventions during the Cold War, was used to create a larger foreign market for American products. Following CIA interventions, imports from the US increased dramatically, while total exports to the US were unaffected. The surge in imports was concentrated in industries in which the US had a comparative disadvantage, not a comparative advantage. Our analysis is able to rule out decreased trade costs, changing political ideology, and an increase in US loans and grants as alternative explanations. We provide evidence that the increased imports arose through direct purchases of American products by foreign governments. (JEL D72, F14, F54, N42, N72)

10.1257/aer.103.2.863.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明冷战期间中央情报局的干预行为增加了政治影响力，这被用来为美国产品创造更大的国外市场。在中央情报局的干预之后，从美国的进口量急剧增加，而向美国的出口总量则没有受到影响。进口量的激增集中在那些美国具有相对劣势而非相对优势的行业中。我们的分析能够排除贸易成本降低、政治意识形态的变化以及美国贷款和补助增加作为替代解释的可能性。我们提供了证据，表明进口量的增加是通过外国政府直接购买美国产品实现的。（JEL D72, F14, F54, N42, N72）

abstract.text: This paper empirically assesses the incidence and efficiency of Round I of the federal urban Empowerment Zone (EZ) program using confidential microdata from the Decennial Census and the Longitudinal Business Database. Using rejected and future applicants to the EZ program as controls, we find that EZ designation substantially increased employment in zone neighborhoods and generated wage increases for local workers without corresponding increases in population or the local cost of living. The results suggest the efficiency costs of first Round EZs were relatively modest. (JEL H26, H77, J31, R23, R58)

10.1257/aer.103.2.897.abstractZh: 本文通过利用十年一次人口普查和纵向商业数据库的机密微观数据，实证评估了联邦城市赋能区计划第一轮的普及率和效率。以被拒绝和未来的申请者作为对照组，我们发现赋能区的设立显著增加了区域社区的就业人数，并提升了当地工人的工资水平，而人口或当地生活成本并未相应增加。结果表明，第一轮赋能区的效率成本相对较低。（JEL H26, H77, J31, R23, R58）

abstract.text: Cross-country labor productivity differences are larger in agriculture than in non-agriculture. We propose a new explanation for these patterns in which the self-selection of heterogeneous workers determines sector productivity. We formalize our theory in a general-equilibrium Roy model in which preferences feature a subsistence food requirement. In the model, subsistence requirements induce workers that are relatively unproductive at agricultural work to nonetheless select into the agriculture sector in poor countries. When parameterized, the model predicts that productivity differences are roughly twice as large in agriculture as non-agriculture even when countries differ by an economy-wide efficiency term that affects both sectors uniformly. (JEL J24, J31, J43, O11, O13, O40)

10.1257/aer.103.2.948.abstractZh: 跨国的劳动生产率差异在农业领域比在非农业领域更为显著。我们提出了一种新的解释，认为异质工人的自我选择决定了行业生产率。我们在一般均衡的Roy模型中形式化了这一理论，其中偏好以生存性食物需求为特征。在模型中，生存需求促使那些在农业工作中相对不高效的工人仍然选择进入农业部门。当模型参数化后，预测农业领域的生产率差异大约是非农业领域的两倍，即使各国在影响两个行业的整体效率方面存在差异。（JEL J24, J31, J43, O11, O13, O40）

abstract.text: Using a new nationally representative dataset, we find minor differences in test outcomes between black and white infants that disappear with a limited set of controls. However, relative to whites, all other races lose substantial ground by age two. Combining our estimates with results in prior literature, we show that a simple model with assortative mating fits our data well, implying that differences in children's environments between racial groups can fully explain gaps in intelligence. If parental ability influences a child's test scores both genetically and through environment, then our findings are less informative and can be reconciled with a wide range of racial differences in inherited intelligence.

10.1257/aer.103.2.981.abstractZh: 通过利用一个新的全国代表性数据集，我们发现黑人和白人婴儿在测试结果上存在一些细微差异，但这些差异在采用有限的控制变量后消失。然而，与白人相比，所有其他种族在两岁时的智力水平都显著下降。将我们的估计结果与先前文献中的结果结合起来，我们发现一个基于同配交配的简单模型能够很好地解释我们的数据，这意味着不同种族群体之间的儿童环境差异完全可以解释智力上的差异。如果父母的能力通过遗传和环境因素共同影响孩子的测试成绩，那么我们的发现就缺乏足够的说服力，并且可以与种族间在遗传智力上的广泛差异相调和。

abstract.text: The US tolerates more inequality than Europe and believes its economic mobility is greater than Europe's, though they had roughly equal rates of intergenerational occupational mobility in the late twentieth century. We extend this comparison into the nineteenth century using 10,000 nationally-representative British and US fathers and sons. The US was more mobile than Britain through 1900, so in the experience of those who created the US welfare state in the 1930s, the US had indeed been “exceptional.” The US mobility lead over Britain was erased by the 1950s, as US mobility fell from its nineteenth century levels. (JEL J62, N31, N32, N33, N34)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1109.abstractZh: 美国对不平等的容忍程度高于欧洲，并且认为其经济流动性优于欧洲，尽管在20世纪末，两国的代际职业流动性大致相当。我们进一步将这一比较扩展到19世纪，使用了10,000名具有全国代表性的英国和美国父子样本。到1900年，美国的流动性确实高于英国。因此，在那些在20世纪30年代创建美国福利体系的人看来，美国确实“表现突出”。然而，到了20世纪50年代，美国的流动性下降，低于19世纪的水平。（JEL J62, N31, N32, N33, N34）

abstract.text: Using data from a field experiment in Kenya, we document that providing individuals with simple informal savings technologies can substantially increase investment in preventative health and reduce vulnerability to health shocks. Simply providing a safe place to keep money was sufficient to increase health savings by 66 percent. Adding an earmarking feature was only helpful when funds were put toward emergencies, or for individuals that are frequently taxed by friends and relatives. Group-based savings and credit schemes had very large effects.

10.1257/aer.103.4.1138.abstractZh: 通过肯尼亚一项实地实验的数据，我们发现为个人提供简单的非正式储蓄技术可以显著增加预防性健康投资，并降低对健康冲击的脆弱性。仅仅提供一个安全的存放资金的地方就足以使健康储蓄增加66%。只有当资金用于紧急情况，或者针对那些经常受到亲朋好友征税的个人时，添加定向捐赠功能才具有实际意义。基于群体的储蓄和信贷计划则产生了非常显著的效果。

abstract.text: When the zero lower bound on nominal interest rates binds, monetary policy cannot provide appropriate stimulus. We show that, in the standard New Keynesian model, tax policy can deliver such stimulus at no cost and in a time-consistent manner. There is no need to use inefficient policies such as wasteful public spending or future commitments to low interest rates. (JEL E12, E43, E52, E62, H20)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1172.abstractZh: 当名义利率的零下限约束存在时，货币政策无法提供适当的刺激效果。我们证明，在标准的新凯恩斯主义模型中，税收政策可以以低成本且时间一致的方式提供这种刺激。无需采用低效的政策，如浪费性的公共支出或对低利率的未来承诺。（JEL E12, E43, E52, E62, H20）

abstract.text: This paper estimates the dynamic effects of changes in taxes in the United States. We distinguish between changes in personal and corporate income taxes and develop a new narrative account of federal tax liability changes in these two tax components. We develop an estimator which uses narratively identified tax changes as proxies for structural tax shocks and apply it to quarterly post-WWII data. We find that short run output effects of tax shocks are large and that it is important to distinguish between different types of taxes when considering their impact on the labor market and on expenditure components. (JEL E23, E62, H24, H25, H31, H32)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1212.abstractZh: 本文估算了美国税收变化所带来的动态效应。我们区分了个人所得税和企业所得税的变化，并提出了一种新的方法来描述这两种税收成分的变化对联邦税收责任的影响。我们开发了一种估算方法，利用被识别出的税收变化作为结构性税收冲击的代理变量，并将其应用于二战后的季度数据。我们发现，税收冲击在短期内的产出效应较大，因此在考虑税收对劳动力市场及支出成分的影响时，区分不同类型的税收是非常重要的。（JEL E23, E62, H24, H25, H31, H32）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the properties of runoff electoral systems when voters are strategic. A model of three-candidate runoff elections is presented, and two new features are included: the risk of upset victory in the second round is endogenous, and many types of runoff systems are considered. Three main results emerge. First, runoff elections produce equilibria in which only two candidates receive a positive fraction of the votes. Second, a sincere voting equilibrium does not always exist. Finally, runoff systems with a threshold below 50 percent produce an Ortega effect that may lead to the systematic victory of the Condorcet loser. (JEL C72, D72)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1248.abstractZh: 本文分析了选民具有策略性时 runoff 选举系统的特性。文中提出了一个三候选人 runoff 选举模型，并引入了两个新特征：第二轮选举中意外获胜的风险是内生性的，同时考虑了多种类型的 runoff 系统。研究得出三个主要结论：首先，runoff 选举会产生一种均衡状态，在这种状态下只有两名候选人获得超过一半的选票；其次，真诚投票的均衡并不总是存在；最后，当门槛低于 50%时，runoff 系统会产生一种“Ortega 效应”，这可能导致 Condorcet 败选者系统性地获胜。（JEL C72, D72）

abstract.text: This paper applies a regression discontinuity design to the Romanian secondary school system, generating two findings. First, students who have access to higher achievement schools perform better in a (high stakes) graduation test. Second, the stratification of schools by quality in general, and the opportunity to attend a better school in particular, result in significant behavioral responses: (i) teachers sort in a manner consistent with a preference for higher achieving students; (ii) children who make it into more selective schools realize they are relatively weaker and feel marginalized; (iii) parents reduce effort when their children attend a better school. (JEL I21, I28, J13)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1289.abstractZh: 本文采用回归不连续设计对罗马尼亚中学体系进行了研究，得出了两个重要发现。首先，能够进入成绩较好的学校的学生在毕业考试中表现更好。其次，学校质量的分层现象，以及选择更好的学校的机会，导致了显著的行为反应：(i) 教师的行为符合他们对成绩较好的学生的偏好；(ii) 进入更具选拔性的学校的学生意识到自己相对较弱，并感到被边缘化；(iii) 当孩子的学校质量提高时，家长会减少孩子的学习努力。(JEL I21, I28, J13)

abstract.text: Authority and power permeate political, social, and economic life, but empirical knowledge about the motivational origins and consequences of authority is limited. We study the motivation and incentive effects of authority experimentally in an authority-delegation game. Individuals often retain authority even when its delegation is in their material interest—suggesting that authority has nonpecuniary consequences for utility. Authority also leads to overprovision of effort by the controlling parties, while a large percentage of subordinates underprovide effort despite pecuniary incentives to the contrary. Authority thus has important motivational consequences that exacerbate the inefficiencies arising from suboptimal delegation choices. (JEL C92, D23, D82)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1325.abstractZh: 权威与权力渗透于政治、社会和经济生活之中，但关于权威的动机起源及其后果的实证研究仍然有限。我们通过权威委托游戏实验来研究权威的动机与激励效应。个体即使在权威被委托对其有物质利益时，仍会保留权威，这表明权威对效用具有非金钱性的影响。权威还会导致控制方过度付出努力，而大量下属尽管面临相反的金钱激励，仍会减少努力投入。因此，权威具有重要的动机效应，会加剧因最优委托选择而产生的效率低下问题。（JEL C92, D23, D82）

abstract.text: We study how two selection systems for public officials, appointment and election, affect policy outcomes, focusing on state court judges and their criminal sentencing decisions. First, under appointment, policy congruence with voter preferences is attained through selecting judges with homogeneous preferences. In contrast, under election, judges face strong reelection incentives, while selection on preferences is weak. Second, the effectiveness of election in attaining policy congruence critically depends on payoffs from the job, which implies that the effectiveness of election may vary substantially across public offices. Third, reelection incentives may discourage judges with significant human capital from holding office. (JEL D72, K41)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1360.abstractZh: 我们研究了两种公共官员选拔制度——任命制与选举制——对政策结果的影响，重点关注州法院法官及其刑事判决决策。首先，在任命制下，通过选择具有同质偏好的法官来实现与选民偏好的政策一致性。相比之下，在选举制下，法官面临强烈的连任激励，而基于偏好进行选择的效果则较弱。其次，选举制度在实现政策一致性方面的有效性，在很大程度上取决于工作的回报，这意味着不同公共职务的选举制度有效性可能存在显著差异。第三，连任激励可能会阻碍拥有显著人力资本的法官继续担任职务。（JEL D72, K41）

abstract.text: Choices involving risk significantly affect the distribution of income and wealth in society. This paper reports the results of the first experiment, to our knowledge, to study fairness views about risk-taking, specifically whether such views are based chiefly on ex ante opportunities or on ex post outcomes. We find that, even though many participants focus exclusively on ex ante opportunities, most favor some redistribution ex post. Many participants also make a distinction between ex post inequalities that reflect differences in luck and ex post inequalities that reflect differences in choices. These findings apply to both stakeholders and impartial spectators. (JEL D63, D81, H23)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1398.abstractZh: 涉及风险的选择会显著影响社会中的收入和财富分配。本文报告了我们所知的首项实验结果，该实验旨在研究人们对风险承担的看法，特别是这些看法是基于事前机会还是事后结果。我们发现，尽管许多参与者仅关注事前机会，但大多数人更倾向于事后进行某种形式的再分配。许多参与者还区分了反映运气差异的事后不平等与反映选择差异的事后不平等。这些发现适用于利益相关者和中立观察者。（JEL D63, D81, H23）

abstract.text: We analyze the international operations of multinational firms to measure the spatial barriers to transferring knowledge. We model firms that can transfer bits of knowledge to their foreign affiliates in either embodied (traded intermediates) or disembodied form (direct communication). The model shows how knowledge transfer costs can be inferred from multinationals' operations. We use firm-level data on the trade and sales of US multinationals to confirm the model's predictions. Disembodied knowledge transfer costs not only make the standard multinational firm model consistent with the fact that affiliate sales fall in distance but quantitatively accounts for much of the gravity in multinational activity. (JEL F12, F14, F23, L25, O33)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1414.abstractZh: 我们分析了跨国公司的国际运营，以衡量知识转移的空间障碍。我们模拟了能够将知识以具体形式（交易中间产品）或抽象形式（直接沟通）传递给海外子公司的企业。该模型展示了如何根据跨国公司的运营情况推断知识转移成本。我们使用美国跨国公司的贸易和销售数据来验证模型的预测结果。抽象形式的知识转移成本不仅使标准跨国公司模型与子公司销售随距离增加而减少的事实保持一致，而且还能定量解释跨国活动中大部分的引力效应。（JEL F12, F14, F23, L25, O33）

abstract.text: We consider two life cycle models of labor supply that use nonconvexities to generate retirement. In each case we derive a link between hours worked prior to retirement, the intertemporal elasticity of substitution for labor (IES), and the size of the nonconvexities. This link is robust to allowing for credit constraints and human capital accumulation by younger workers and suggests values for the IES that are .75 or higher. (JEL D91, J22, J24, J26)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1445.abstractZh: 我们考虑了两种使用非凸性来模拟退休生命周期的劳动力供给模型。在每种模型中，我们推导出了退休前工作小时数、劳动力跨期替代弹性以及非凸性大小之间的关系。这种关系在考虑信用约束和年轻工人的人力资本积累后仍然成立，并且表明劳动力跨期替代弹性的取值应大于或等于0.75。（JEL D91, J22, J24, J26）

abstract.text: I study a dynamic economy featuring adverse selection in asset markets. Borrowing constrained entrepreneurs sell past projects to finance new investment, but asymmetric information creates a lemons problem. I show that this friction is equivalent to a tax on financial transactions. The implicit tax rate responds to aggregate shocks, generating amplification in the response of investment and cyclical variation in liquidity. (JEL D82, D92, E32, E44, G31, L15)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1463.abstractZh: 我研究了一个在资产市场中存在逆向选择的动态经济体系。资金受限的企业家通过出售过去的项目来为新的投资提供资金，但信息不对称导致了“柠檬问题”。我发现这种摩擦相当于对金融交易征收的税。隐性税率会对整体冲击作出反应，从而加剧投资的反应，并导致流动性的周期性波动。（JEL D82, D92, E32, E44, G31, L15）

abstract.text: I study a dynamic model of strategic reform decisions that potentially affect the stochastic evolution of a publicly observed economic variable. Policy makers maximize their evaluation by a boundedly rational public. Specifically, the public follows a rule that attributes recent changes to the most recent intervention. I analyze subgame perfect equilibrium in this model when the economic variable follows a linear growth trend with noise. Equilibrium is essentially unique and stationary, bearing a subtle formal relation to optimal search models. Policy makers tend to act during crises, display risk aversion conditional on acting, and prefer interventions that induce permanent noise. (JEL D78, D83)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1490.abstractZh: 我研究了一个动态模型，该模型涉及战略改革决策，这些决策可能会影响一个公开观测的经济变量的随机演化。政策制定者通过一个有界理性的公众来最大化他们的评估。具体来说，公众遵循一个规则，将最近的变化归因于最近的干预措施。我分析了该模型中的子博弈完美均衡，其中经济变量遵循带有噪声的线性增长趋势。均衡本质上是唯一的且稳定的，与最优搜索模型之间存在微妙的形式关系。政策制定者倾向于在危机期间采取行动，在采取行动时表现出风险厌恶，并且更倾向于那些能引入永久性噪声的干预措施。（JEL D78, D83）

abstract.text: This paper provides new estimates of the macroeconomic effects of tax changes using a new narrative dataset for the United Kingdom. Identification is achieved by isolating “exogenous” tax policy changes using the Romer and Romer narrative strategy. I find that a 1 percent cut in taxes increases GDP by 0.6 percent on impact and 2.5 percent over three years. The findings are remarkably similar to Romer and Romer narrative estimates for the United States, reinforcing the view that tax changes have powerful and persistent effects. “Exogenous” tax changes are also shown to have contributed to important episodes in the UK business cycle. (JEL E23, E32, E62, H20, H61)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1507.abstractZh: 本文利用新的英国叙事数据集，对税收变化带来的宏观经济效应进行了新的估算。通过采用Romer和Romer叙事策略，将“外生”的税收政策变化分离出来进行识别。研究发现，税收减少1%会使GDP在短期内增加0.6%，三年后增加2.5%。这些结果与Romer和Romer在美国的叙事估算结果非常相似，进一步证实了税收变化具有强大且持久的影响。“外生”的税收政策变化也被证明对英国商业周期的重要阶段产生了影响。（JEL E23, E32, E62, H20, H61）

abstract.text: The purpose of this note is to analyze properties of the risk lovers' utility function beyond the positive sign of its second order derivative. We show that—contrarily to a priori beliefs—risk lovers are prudent and are willing to accumulate precautionary savings. (JEL D81)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1529.abstractZh: 本文旨在分析风险爱好者效用函数的性质，尤其是其二阶导数的正号之外的情况。研究表明，与先前的假设相反，风险爱好者是谨慎的，并且愿意积累预防性储蓄。（JEL D81）

abstract.text: Crainich, Eeckhoudt, and Trannoy (2013) show that mixed risk lovers are prudent. I show that common risk loving utility functions may not exhibit mixed risk loving—as is typical for risk aversion and mixed risk aversion—and thus these traits should be carefully distinguished. In particular, risk lovers may be imprudent. (JEL D81)

10.1257/aer.103.4.1536.abstractZh: Crainich、Eeckhoudt和Trannoy在2013年的研究中指出，混合风险爱好者通常具有谨慎的特质。然而，常见的风险偏好效用函数可能无法体现混合风险偏好——这与风险厌恶和混合风险厌恶的情况有所不同——因此这些特质需要仔细区分。特别是，风险爱好者有时可能会表现得不够谨慎。（JEL D81）

abstract.text: We offer a unified analysis of the growth of low-skill service occupations between 1980 and 2005 and the concurrent polarization of US employment and wages. We hypothesize that polarization stems from the interaction between consumer preferences, which favor variety over specialization, and the falling cost of automating routine, codifiable job tasks. Applying a spatial equilibrium model, we corroborate four implications of this hypothesis. Local labor markets that specialized in routine tasks differentially adopted information technology, reallocated low-skill labor into service occupations (employment polarization), experienced earnings growth at the tails of the distribution (wage polarization), and received inflows of skilled labor. (JEL J24, J31, R23)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1553.abstractZh: 我们提供了一种统一的分析方法，用于研究1980年至2005年间低技能服务职业的增长情况，以及美国就业和工资的同步两极分化现象。我们假设这种两极分化源于消费者偏好与自动化趋势之间的相互作用——消费者更倾向于多样化而非专业化，而常规、可编码的工作任务自动化成本的降低也促进了两极分化。通过应用空间均衡模型，我们证实了这一假设的四个推论：专注于常规任务的本地劳动力市场对信息技术的采用程度不同，低技能劳动力被重新分配到服务职业中（导致就业两极分化），收入在收入分布的高端有所增长（工资两极分化），同时还有技能劳动力的流入。（JEL J24, J31, R23）

abstract.text: This paper develops a structural model of newspaper markets to analyze the effects of ownership consolidation, taking into account not only firms' price adjustments but also the adjustments in newspaper characteristics. A new dataset on newspaper prices and characteristics is used to estimate the model. The paper then simulates the effect of a merger in the Minneapolis newspaper market and studies how welfare effects of mergers vary with market characteristics. It finds that ignoring adjustments of product characteristics causes substantial differences in estimated effects of mergers. (JEL G32, L13, L82, M37)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1598.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个报纸市场的结构模型，以分析所有权整合的影响，不仅考虑了企业的价格调整，还考虑了报纸特性的调整。通过使用新的报纸价格和特性数据集来估计模型。随后，本文模拟了明尼阿波利斯报纸市场中的合并效应，并研究了合并的福利效应如何随市场特性而变化。研究发现，忽略产品特性的调整会导致合并效应的估计结果出现显著差异。（JEL G32, L13, L82, M37）

abstract.text: This paper explores the causes and consequences of regional taste differences. I introduce habit formation into a standard general equilibrium model. Household tastes evolve over time to favor foods consumed as a child. Thus, locally abundant foods are preferred in every region, as they were relatively inexpensive in prior generations. These patterns alter the correspondence between price changes and nutrition. For example, neglecting this relationship between tastes and agro-climatic endowments overstates the short-run nutritional gains from agricultural trade liberalization, since preferred foods rise in price in every region. I examine the model's predictions using household survey data from many regions of India. (JEL D12, I12, O12, O18, R23)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1629.abstractZh: 本文探讨了地区口味差异的原因与后果。我将习惯形成引入到标准的一般均衡模型中。家庭口味随时间演变，倾向于选择儿童时期就经常食用的食物。因此，每个地区都偏好当地丰富的食物，因为这些食物在之前的时代相对便宜。这些模式改变了价格变化与营养之间的对应关系。例如，忽视口味与农业气候禀赋之间的关系会高估农业贸易自由化在短期内的营养收益，因为所有地区都出现了偏好食物的价格上涨现象。我使用印度多个地区的家庭调查数据来验证该模型的预测结果。（JEL D12, I12, O12, O18, R23）

abstract.text: Using data from the American Time Use Survey between 2003 and 2010, we document that home production absorbs roughly 30 percent of foregone market work hours at business cycle frequencies. Leisure absorbs roughly 50 percent of foregone market work hours, with sleeping and television watching accounting for most of this increase. We document significant increases in time spent on shopping, child care, education, and health. Job search absorbs between 2 and 6 percent of foregone market work hours. We discuss the implications of our results for business cycle models with home production and non-separable preferences. (JEL D31, E32, J22)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1664.abstractZh: 通过利用2003年至2010年的美国时间使用调查数据，我们发现家庭生产占到了商业周期频率下被放弃的市场工作时间的大约30%。休闲活动则占到了被放弃的市场工作时间的约50%，其中睡眠和看电视占据了这一增加的大部分。我们还发现，用于购物、儿童照料、教育和健康的时间显著增加。求职活动占到了被放弃的市场工作时间的2%到6%。我们讨论了这些结果对于包含家庭生产和非可分离偏好商业周期模型的影响。（JEL D31, E32, J22）

abstract.text: We investigate the hypothesis that macroeconomic fluctuations are primitively the results of many microeconomic shocks. We define fundamental volatility as the volatility that would arise from an economy made entirely of idiosyncratic sectoral or firm-level shocks. Fundamental volatility accounts for the swings in macroeconomic volatility in the major world economies in the past half-century. It accounts for the “great moderation” and its undoing. The initial great moderation is due to a decreasing share of manufacturing between 1975 and 1985. The recent rise of macroeconomic volatility is chiefly due to the growth of the financial sector. (JEL E23, E32, E44)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1697.abstractZh: 我们探讨了这样一个假设：宏观经济波动最初是由许多微观经济冲击所导致的。我们将基本波动性定义为仅由特定行业或企业层面的冲击引起的波动。基本波动性解释了过去半个世纪主要世界经济体中宏观经济波动的变化情况，也解释了“大缓和”现象及其后果。最初的大缓和是由于1975年至1985年间制造业所占份额的减少所致。而近期宏观经济波动的加剧则主要源于金融部门的增长。（JEL E23, E32, E44）

abstract.text: We consider an economy populated by institutional investors alongside standard retail investors. Institutions care about their performance relative to a certain index. Our framework is tractable, admitting exact closed-form expressions, and produces the following analytical results. We find that institutions tilt their portfolios towards stocks that compose their benchmark index. The resulting price pressure boosts index stocks. By demanding more risky stocks than retail investors, institutions amplify the index stock volatilities and aggregate stock market volatility and give rise to countercyclical Sharpe ratios. Trades by institutions induce excess correlations among stocks that belong to their benchmark, generating an asset-class effect. (JEL G12, G23)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1728.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个由机构投资者和标准散户投资者共同构成的经济体系。机构投资者关注其表现相对于某个指数的情况。我们的框架是可解的，能够得出精确的封闭形式表达式，并得出以下分析结果：我们发现机构投资者将其投资组合倾向于那些构成其基准指数的股票。由此产生的价格压力会提升指数股票的价值。由于机构投资者要求的风险资产比例高于散户投资者，他们会放大指数股票的波动性，并增加整个股市的波动性，从而产生逆周期夏普比率。机构投资者的交易行为会导致其基准指数内股票之间的过度相关性，从而产生资产类别效应。（JEL G12, G23）

abstract.text: This paper studies the effect of additional government revenues on political corruption and on the quality of politicians, both with theory and data. The theory is based on a political agency model with career concerns and endogenous entry of candidates. The data refer to Brazil, where federal transfers to municipal governments change exogenously at given population thresholds, allowing us to implement a regression discontinuity design. The empirical evidence shows that larger transfers increase observed corruption and reduce the average education of candidates for mayor. These and other more specific empirical results are in line with the predictions of the theory. (JEL D72, D73, H77, O17, O18)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1759.abstractZh: 本文通过理论和数据研究，探讨了政府额外收入对政治腐败及政治家素质的影响。理论基础基于一个包含职业考量且候选人进入机制具有内生性的政治代理模型。数据来源于巴西，其中联邦政府对市政政府的转移支付在人口达到特定阈值时外生变化，这使我们能够采用回归不连续设计进行研究。实证结果表明，更大的转移支付会增加腐败现象，并降低市长候选人的平均教育水平。这些及其他具体的实证结果与理论预测一致。（JEL D72, D73, H77, O17, O18）

abstract.text: We present the first causal estimates of the effect of Social Security Disability Insurance benefit receipt on labor supply using all program applicants. We use administrative data to match applications to disability examiners and exploit variation in examiners' allowance rates as an instrument for benefit receipt. We find that among the estimated 23 percent of applicants on the margin of program entry, employment would have been 28 percentage points higher had they not received benefits. The effect is heterogeneous, ranging from no effect for those with more severe impairments to 50 percentage points for entrants with relatively less severe impairments. (JEL H55, J14, J22)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1797.abstractZh: 我们首次使用所有项目申请者数据，对社会保障残疾保险福利领取对劳动力供应的影响进行了因果估计。我们利用行政数据将申请者与残疾评估员进行匹配，并利用评估员津贴率的差异作为福利领取的衡量指标。研究发现，在估计的23%的项目进入边缘申请者中，如果没有领取福利，他们的就业率将高出28个百分点。这种影响具有异质性，对于残疾程度较重的申请者影响较小，而对于残疾程度相对较轻的申请者，影响则高达50个百分点。（JEL H55, J14, J22）

abstract.text: A bidding process can be organized so that offers are submitted simultaneously or sequentially. In the latter case, potential buyers can condition their behavior on previous entrants' decisions. The relative performance of these mechanisms is investigated when entry is costly and selective, meaning that potential buyers with higher values are more likely to participate. A simple sequential mechanism can give both buyers and sellers significantly higher payoffs than the commonly used simultaneous bid auction. The findings are illustrated with parameters estimated from simultaneous entry USFS timber auctions where our estimates predict that the sequential mechanism would increase revenue and efficiency. (JEL D44, L73, Q23)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1830.abstractZh: 竞价过程可以安排为同时提交报价或依次提交报价。在后一种情况下，潜在买家可以根据之前参与者的决策来调整自己的行为。当进入成本较高且具有选择性时，这些机制的相对表现会被研究，这意味着价值较高的潜在买家更有可能参与。简单的依次机制可以让买卖双方获得的收益都比常用的同时竞价拍卖要高得多。研究结果通过从美国森林管理协会木材拍卖中估算的参数来说明，我们的估算表明，依次机制可以提高收入和效率。（JEL D44, L73, Q23）

abstract.text: This paper studies the effect of improved early life health care on mortality and long-run academic achievement in school. We use the idea that medical treatments often follow rules of thumb for assigning care to patients, such as the classification of Very Low Birth Weight (VLBW ), which assigns infants special care at a specific birth weight cutoff. Using detailed administrative data on schooling and birth records from Chile and Norway, we establish that children who receive extra medical care at birth have lower mortality rates and higher test scores and grades in school. These gains are in the order of 0.15–0.22 standard deviations.

10.1257/aer.103.5.1862.abstractZh: 本文研究了改善早期健康护理对儿童死亡率及长期学业成绩的影响。我们借鉴了医疗治疗通常遵循经验法则来分配患者护理的做法，例如对极低出生体重婴儿的分类，这种分类会根据特定的出生体重标准为婴儿提供特殊护理。通过利用智利和挪威的详细教育及出生记录数据，我们发现出生时接受额外医疗护理的儿童具有更低的死亡率以及更高的考试成绩和学业成绩。这些改善幅度约为0.15至0.22个标准差。

abstract.text: We analyze the effects of top tax rates on international migration of football players in 14 European countries since 1985. Both country case studies and multinomial regressions show evidence of strong mobility responses to tax rates, with an elasticity of the number of foreign (domestic) players to the net-of-tax rate around one (around 0.15). We also find evidence of sorting effects (low taxes attract highability players who displace low-ability players) and displacement effects (low taxes on foreigners displace domestic players). Those results can be rationalized in a simple model of migration and taxation with rigid labor demand. (JEL F22, H24, H31, J44, J61, L83)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1892.abstractZh: 我们分析了自1985年以来14个欧洲国家足球运动员国际迁移受到最高税率影响的状况。国家案例研究和多项回归分析均显示，税率对球员流动有强烈的响应，外国（国内）球员数量对税后税率的弹性约为1（约0.15）。我们还发现了排序效应（低税率吸引高能力的球员，从而取代低能力的球员）和位移效应（对外国球员的低税率会导致国内球员的流失）。这些结果可以在一个简单的迁移和税收模型中得到解释，该模型假设劳动力需求是固定的。（JEL F22, H24, H31, J44, J61, L83）

abstract.text: Following Grossman and Rossi-Hansberg (2008) we present a model in which tasks of varying complexity are matched to workers of varying skill in order to develop and test predictions regarding the effects of immigration and offshoring on US native-born workers. We find that immigrant and native-born workers do not compete much due to the fact that they tend to perform tasks at opposite ends of the task complexity spectrum, with offshore workers performing the tasks in the middle. An effect of offshoring and a positive effect of immigration on native-born employment suggest that immigration and offshoring improve industry efficiency. (JEL J24, J41, J61, L24)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1925.abstractZh: 根据Grossman和Rossi-Hansberg（2008）的研究，我们提出了一个模型，该模型将不同复杂度的任务与不同技能水平的工人相匹配，以验证移民和离岸外包对美国本土工人的影响。我们发现，由于移民和本土工人往往从事不同复杂度的任务，因此他们之间的竞争并不激烈，而离岸工人则处于任务复杂度的中间水平。离岸外包对本土就业有积极影响，而移民则有助于提高行业效率。（JEL J24, J41, J61, L24）

abstract.text: A growing body of research examines the regional effects of trade liberalization using a weighted average of trade policy changes across industries. This paper develops a specific-factors model of regional economies that provides a theoretical foundation for this intuitively appealing empirical approach and also provides guidance on treatment of the nontraded sector. In the context of Brazil's early 1990s trade liberalization, I find that regions facing a 10 percentage point larger liberalization-induced price decline experienced a 4 percentage point larger wage decline. The results also confirm the empirical relevance of appropriately dealing with the nontraded sector. (JEL F13, F16, O19, O24)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1960.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究通过采用各行业贸易政策变化的加权平均值，来探讨贸易自由化的区域效应。本文提出了一个特定因素模型，用于分析区域经济，为这一直观且具有吸引力的实证方法提供了理论基础，同时也为处理非贸易部门提供了指导。以巴西20世纪90年代初的贸易自由化为例，我发现，面临10个百分点更大自由化导致的价格下降的地区，其工资下降幅度也增加了4个百分点。这些结果进一步证实了妥善处理非贸易部门的实证重要性。（JEL F13, F16, O19, O24）

abstract.text: Human capital theory predicts that life expectancy will impact human capital attainment. We estimate this relationship using variation in life expectancy driven by Huntington disease, an inherited neurological disorder. We compare investments for individuals who have ex-ante identical risks of HD but differ in disease realization. Individuals with the HD mutation complete less education and job training. The elasticity of demand for college attendance with respect to life expectancy is around 1.0. We relate this to cross-country and over-time differences in education. We use smoking and cancer screening data to test the corollary that health capital responds to life expectancy. (JEL I11, I12, I20, I31, J24)

10.1257/aer.103.5.1977.abstractZh: 人力资本理论预测，预期寿命会影响人力资本的形成。我们通过亨廷顿病这种遗传性神经疾病导致的预期寿命变化来估计这种关系。我们比较了那些在亨廷顿病发病风险上相同，但在实际发病情况上有所不同的个体所进行的投资。携带亨廷顿病突变的个体完成教育和职业培训的时间较短。对大学教育的需求与预期寿命之间的弹性约为1.0。我们将这一结果与各国及不同时期的教育差异联系起来。我们还利用吸烟和癌症筛查数据来检验健康资本对预期寿命的响应这一推论。（JEL I11, I12, I20, I31, J24）

abstract.text: Using historical census and survey data, Long and Ferrie (forthcoming) found a significant decline in social mobility in the United States from 1880 to 1973. We present two critiques of the Long-Ferrie study. First, the data quality of the Long-Ferrie study is more limiting than the authors acknowledge. Second, and more critically, they applied a method ill-suited for measuring social mobility of farmers in a comparative study between 1880 and 1973, a period in which the proportion of farmers dramatically declined in the U.S. We show that Long and Ferrie's main conclusion is all driven by this misleading result for farmers.

10.1257/aer.103.5.2003.abstractZh: 通过历史人口普查和调查数据，Long和Ferrie的研究发现，从1880年到1973年，美国的社会流动性显著下降。我们对Long-Ferrie的研究提出了两点批评。首先，Long-Ferrie研究的数据质量比作者所承认的更为有限。其次，更为关键的是，他们在1880年至1973年的比较研究中采用了一种不适合衡量农民社会流动性的方法，而这一时期美国的农民比例显著下降。我们指出，Long和Ferrie的主要结论完全是由这一对农民群体的误导性研究结果所驱动的。

abstract.text: We reanalyze Long and Ferrie's data. We find that the association of occupational status across generations was quite similar over time and place. Two significant differences were: (i) American farms in 1880 were far more open to men who had nonfarm backgrounds than were American farms in 1973 or British farms in either century; (ii) of the four cases, the intergenerational correlation was strongest in Britain in 1881.
