Structural mobility related to, among other things, economic growth and occupational differentiation, affected mobility most in 1970s America. (JEL J62, N31, N32, N33, N34)

10.1257/aer.103.5.2021.abstractZh: 我们重新分析了Long和Ferrie的数据。我们发现，不同世代之间的职业状况关联在时间和地点上非常相似。两个显著的区别是：(i) 1880年的美国农场对非农场背景的男性更为开放，而1973年的美国农场或任一世纪的英国农场则不然；(ii) 在四个案例中，1881年的英国出现了最强的代际相关性。与经济增长和职业分化相关的结构性流动性，在1970年代的美国对流动性的影响最为显著。(JEL J62, N31, N32, N33, N34)

abstract.text: We respond to several criticisms by Avery Guest and Michael Hout (2013) and Yu Xie and Alexandra Killewald (2013) to Jason Long and Joseph Ferrie (2013). We do not dispute Guest and Hout's characterization of the importance of total mobility in addition to relative mobility. We find much in their additional analyses that supports our original findings. In response to Xie and Killewald, we discuss the limitations of our data and the conceptualization of mobility. (JEL J62, N31, N32, N33, N34)

10.1257/aer.103.5.2041.abstractZh: 我们回应了Avery Guest和Michael Hout（2013年）以及Yu Xie和Alexandra Killewald（2013年）对Jason Long和Joseph Ferrie（2013年）的若干批评。我们并不否认Guest和Hout关于总流动性与相对流动性同样重要的观点。我们发现他们的额外分析中有许多内容支持我们最初的研究结果。针对Xie和Killewald的批评，我们讨论了数据的局限性以及流动性的概念化问题。（JEL J62, N31, N32, N33, N34）

abstract.text: The matching with contracts model (Hatfield and Milgrom 2005) is widely considered to be one of the most important advances of the last two decades in matching theory. One of their main messages is that the set of stable allocations is non-empty under a substitutes condition. We show that an additional irrelevance of rejected contracts (IRC) condition is implicitly assumed throughout their analysis, and in the absence of IRC several of their results, including the guaranteed existence of a stable allocation, fail to hold. (JEL C78, D86)

10.1257/aer.103.5.2050.abstractZh: Hatfield和Milgrom在2005年提出的匹配模型，被广泛认为是过去二十年中匹配理论领域最重要的进展之一。他们的主要观点之一是，在替代条件下，稳定分配的集合是非空的。我们指出，他们的分析过程中隐含了一个额外的“被拒绝合同的不相关性”条件，而在该条件缺失的情况下，包括稳定分配的必然存在在内的多个结果都无法成立。（JEL C78, D86）

abstract.text: A growing literature establishes that high quality early childhood interventions targeted toward disadvantaged children have substantial impacts on later life outcomes. Little is known about the mechanisms producing these impacts. This paper uses longitudinal data on cognitive and personality traits from an experimental evaluation of the influential Perry Preschool program to analyze the channels through which the program boosted both male and female participant outcomes. Experimentally induced changes in personality traits explain a sizable portion of adult treatment effects.

10.1257/aer.103.6.2052.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究证明，针对弱势儿童的优质早期干预对后期生活结果有着显著的影响。然而，关于这些影响的机制尚不明确。本文利用关于认知和人格特征的纵向数据，基于一项对 Perry Preschool 项目影响的实验评估，分析了该项目如何提升男女参与者的生活结果。实验诱导的人格特征变化解释了大部分成人层面的治疗效果。

abstract.text: There is a strong, positive, and well-documented correlation between education and health outcomes. In this paper, we attempt to understand to what extent this relationship is causal. Our approach exploits two changes to British compulsory schooling laws that generated sharp across-cohort differences in educational attainment. Using regression discontinuity methods, we find the reforms did not affect health although the reforms impacted educational attainment and wages. Our results suggest caution as to the likely health returns to educational interventions focused on increasing educational attainment among those at risk of dropping out of high school, a target of recent health policy efforts.

10.1257/aer.103.6.2087.abstractZh: 教育与健康结果之间存在强烈、积极的且已被充分证实的关联。在本文中，我们试图探讨这种关系在多大程度上是因果关系。我们的研究利用了英国义务教育法律的两项变革，这些变革导致不同群体在教育成就上存在显著差异。通过回归不连续方法分析，我们发现这些改革并未对健康产生影响，尽管它们确实影响了教育成就和工资水平。我们的研究结果提醒人们，在针对高中辍学风险人群以提高教育成就的教育干预措施方面，需要谨慎对待可能带来的健康收益。

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of rising Chinese import competition between 1990 and 2007 on US local labor markets, exploiting cross-market variation in import exposure stemming from initial differences in industry specialization and instrumenting for US imports using changes in Chinese imports by other high-income countries. Rising imports cause higher unemployment, lower labor force participation, and reduced wages in local labor markets that house import-competing manufacturing industries. In our main specification, import competition explains one-quarter of the contemporaneous aggregate decline in US manufacturing employment. Transfer benefits payments for unemployment, disability, retirement, and healthcare also rise sharply in more trade-exposed labor markets. (JEL E24, F14, F16, J23, J31, L60, O47, R12, R23)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2121.abstractZh: 我们分析了1990年至2007年间中国进口竞争加剧对美国本地劳动力市场的影响，通过利用不同行业专业化导致的进口暴露差异，并利用其他高收入国家对中国进口的变化来模拟美国进口的影响。进口竞争导致本地劳动力市场的失业率上升、劳动力参与率下降以及工资水平降低，尤其是在那些拥有进口竞争制造业的本地市场中。在我们的主要模型中，进口竞争解释了美国制造业就业总量下降的四分之一原因。对于失业、残疾、退休和医疗保健等福利的支付在更多受到贸易影响的劳动力市场中也显著上升。（JEL E24, F14, F16, J23, J31, L60, O47, R12, R23）

abstract.text: If trade barriers are managed by inefficient institutions, trade liberalization can lead to greater-than-expected gains. We examine Chinese textile and clothing exports before and after the elimination of externally imposed export quotas. Both the surge in export volume and the decline in export prices following quota removal are driven by net entry. This outcome is inconsistent with a model in which quotas are allocated based on firm productivity, implying misallocation of resources. Removing this misallocation accounts for a substantial share of the overall gain in productivity associated with quota removal. (JEL F13, F14, L67, O14, O19, P23, P33)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2169.abstractZh: 如果贸易壁垒由低效的机构管理，贸易自由化可能会带来超出预期的收益。我们研究了在取消外部强加的出口配额之前和之后中国纺织服装出口的情况。在配额取消后，出口量的激增和出口价格的下降都是由净进入驱动的。这一结果与一种基于企业生产力的配额分配模型不符，意味着资源的错误分配。消除这种错误分配可以解释与配额取消相关的整体生产率提升的很大一部分。（JEL F13, F14, L67, O14, O19, P23, P33）

abstract.text: Do the repayment requirements of the classic microfinance contract inhibit investment in high-return but illiquid business opportunities among the poor? Using a field experiment, we compare the classic contract which requires that repayment begin immediately after loan disbursement to a contract that includes a two-month grace period. The provision of a grace period increased short-run business investment and long-run profits but also default rates. The results, thus, indicate that debt contracts that require early repayment discourage illiquid risky investment and thereby limit the potential impact of microfinance on microenterprise growth and household poverty. (JEL A21, G32, I32, L25, L26, O15, O16)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2196.abstractZh: 经典微型金融合同的还款要求是否会抑制贫困群体对高回报但流动性低的商业机会的投资？通过一项实地实验，我们将要求贷款发放后立即立即还款的经典合同与包含两个月宽限期合同进行了比较。提供宽限期虽然增加了短期商业投资和长期利润，但也提高了违约率。因此，结果表明，要求提前还款的债务合同会抑制流动性低且风险高的投资，从而限制了微型金融对微型企业成长和家庭贫困的潜在影响。（JEL A21, G32, I32, L25, L26, O15, O16）

abstract.text: We analyze the emergence of the first socioeconomic institution in history limiting fertility: west of a line from St. Petersburg to Trieste, the European Marriage Pattern (EMP) reduced childbirths by approximately one-third between the fourteenth and eighteenth century. To explain the rise of EMP we build a two-sector model of agricultural production—grain and livestock. Women have a comparative advantage in animal husbandry. After the Black Death in 1348–1350, land abundance triggered a shift toward the pastoral sector. This improved female employment prospects, leading to later marriages. Using detailed data from England, we provide strong evidence for our mechanism. (JEL J12, J13, J16, N33, N53, Q11)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2227.abstractZh: 我们分析了历史上第一个限制生育的社会经济机构的出现。在从圣彼得堡到的里雅斯特的这条线以西地区，欧洲婚姻模式在14世纪至18世纪期间使出生率降低了约三分之一。为了解释欧洲婚姻模式的兴起，我们构建了一个包含粮食生产和畜牧业两个部门的模型。女性在畜牧业方面具有比较优势。1348年至1350年的黑死病之后，土地的丰富促使人们转向畜牧业，这改善了女性的就业前景，从而促进了她们更早的结婚。通过利用英格兰的详细数据，我们为这一机制提供了强有力的证据。（JEL J12, J13, J16, N33, N53, Q11）

abstract.text: We present a new framework to identify supply elasticities of storable commodities where past shocks are used as exogenous price shifters. In the agricultural context, past yield shocks change inventory levels and futures prices of agricultural commodities. We use our estimated elasticities to evaluate the impact of the 2009 Renewable Fuel Standard on commodity prices, quantities, and food consumers' surplus for the four basic staples: corn, rice, soybeans, and wheat. Prices increase 20 percent if one-third of commodities used to produce ethanol are recycled as feedstock, with a positively skewed 95 percent confidence interval that ranges from 14 to 35 percent. (JEL Q11, Q16, Q42, Q48)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2265.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个新的框架，用于识别可储存商品的供应弹性，其中过去的冲击被用作外生价格变动因素。在农业领域，过去的产量冲击会改变库存水平和农产品期货价格。我们利用估算出的弹性来评估2009年可再生燃料标准对四种基本主食——玉米、大米、大豆和小麦的价格、数量以及食品消费者剩余的影响。如果用于生产乙醇的商品中有三分之一被回收作为原料，价格将上涨20%，其正偏态的95%置信区间范围为14%至35%。（JEL Q11, Q16, Q42, Q48）

abstract.text: We use a simple theory of a system of cities to decompose the determinants of the city size distribution into three main components: efficiency, amenities, and frictions. Higher efficiency and better amenities lead to larger cities but also to greater frictions through congestion and other negative effects of agglomeration. Using data on MSAs in the United States, we estimate these city characteristics. Eliminating variation in any of them leads to large population reallocations, but modest welfare effects. We apply the same methodology to Chinese cities and find welfare effects that are many times larger than those in the US. (JEL H71, O18, P25, R11, R23, R41)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2296.abstractZh: 我们采用一个简单的城市系统理论，将城市规模分布的决定因素分解为三个主要因素：效率、便利设施和摩擦。更高的效率和更好的设施会导致城市规模扩大，但同时也因拥堵和其他聚集带来的负面影响而产生更大的摩擦。通过美国市政当局的数据，我们对这些城市特征进行了估算。消除其中任何一个因素的变化会导致大量的人口重新分配，但福利效应相对较小。我们将同样的方法应用于中国城市，发现其福利效应比美国要大得多。（JEL H71, O18, P25, R11, R23, R41）

abstract.text: A manager and a worker are in an infinitely repeated relationship in which the manager privately observes her opportunity costs of paying the worker. We show that the optimal relational contract generates periodic conflicts during which effort and expected profits decline gradually but recover instantaneously. To manage a conflict, the manager uses a combination of informal promises and formal commitments that evolves with the duration of the conflict. Finally, we show that liquidity constraints limit the manager's ability to manage conflicts but may also induce the worker to respond to a conflict by providing more effort rather than less. (JEL C73, D74, D86, J33, J41, M12)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2328.abstractZh: 一位管理者和一位工人处于一种无限重复的关系中，管理者私下观察自己支付工人工资的机会成本。我们表明，最优的关系契约会导致周期性冲突，在冲突期间，努力程度和预期利润会逐渐下降，但会立即恢复。为了管理冲突，管理者会结合使用非正式承诺和正式承诺，这些承诺会随着冲突的持续时间而演变。最后，我们指出，流动性限制限制了管理者管理冲突的能力，但也可能促使工人通过增加努力而非减少努力来应对冲突。（JEL C73, D74, D86, J33, J41, M12）

abstract.text: Contract theory claims that renegotiation prevents attainment of the efficient solution that could be obtained under full commitment. Assessing the cost of renegotiation remains an open issue from an empirical viewpoint. We fit a structural principal-agent model with renegotiation on a set of contracts for urban transport services. The model captures two important features of the industry as only two types of contracts are used (fixed price and cost-plus) and subsidies are greater following a cost-plus contract than following a fixed-price one. We conclude that the welfare gains from improving commitment would be significant but would accrue mostly to operators. (JEL D82, D86, L51, L92, R42, R48)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2352.abstractZh: 契约理论认为，重新谈判会阻碍实现在完全承诺条件下可能获得的有效解决方案。从实证角度来看，重新谈判的成本评估仍然是一个未解决的问题。我们在一个城市交通服务合同集合上构建了一个包含重新谈判的结构性主体代理模型。该模型捕捉了该行业的两个重要特征：仅使用两种类型的合同（固定价格合同和成本加成合同），并且成本加成合同的补贴程度高于固定价格合同。我们得出结论，改善承诺所带来的福利收益是显著的，但这些收益主要会惠及运营商。（JEL D82, D86, L51, L92, R42, R48）

abstract.text: We analyze firms that compete by means of exclusive contracts and market-share discounts (conditional on the seller's share of customers' total purchases). With incomplete information about demand, firms have a unilateral incentive to use these contractual arrangements to better extract buyers' informational rents. However, exclusive contracts intensify competition, thus reducing prices and profits and (in all Pareto undominated equilibria) increasing welfare. Market-share discounts, by contrast, produce a double marginalization effect that leads to higher prices and harms buyers. We discuss the implications of these results for competition policy. (JEL D43, D83, D86, K21, L14, L42)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2384.abstractZh: 我们分析了通过独家合同和市场份额折扣进行竞争的企业（前提是卖方占买方总购买量的一定比例）。在需求信息不完全的情况下，企业有单方面动机利用这些合同安排来更有效地获取买方的信息租金。然而，独家合同会加剧竞争，从而降低价格和利润，并在所有帕累托无占优均衡中提高福利。相比之下，市场份额折扣会产生双重边缘化效应，导致价格上升并损害买方利益。我们讨论了这些结果对竞争政策的影响。（JEL D43, D83, D86, K21, L14, L42）

abstract.text: We consider a dynamic economy in which agents are repeatedly matched and decide whether or not to form profitable partnerships. Each agent has a physical color and a social color. An agent's social color acts as a signal, conveying information about the physical color of agents in his partnership history. Before an agent makes a decision, he observes his match's physical and social colors. Neither the physical color nor the social color is payoff relevant. We identify environments where equilibria arise in which agents condition their decisions on the physical and social colors of their potential partners. That is, they discriminate. (JEL C78, D82, J15, J71, Z13)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2412.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个动态经济系统，其中各个主体会反复匹配，并决定是否形成盈利的合作关系。每个主体都有物理颜色和社交颜色。主体的社交颜色起到信号的作用，传达了其在合作历史中其他主体的物理颜色信息。在做出决策之前，主体会观察其匹配对象的物理颜色和社交颜色。物理颜色与社交颜色均不具有收益相关性。我们识别出一些环境，在这些环境中，主体会根据潜在合作伙伴的物理颜色和社交颜色来做出决策，也就是说，他们进行了区分。（JEL C78, D82, J15, J71, Z13）

abstract.text: In August 2006, the Italian government released one-third of the nation's prison inmates via a national collective pardon. We test for a discontinuous break in national crime rates corresponding to the mass release. We also test for the effect of the return of the incarceration rate to its predicted steady state level on national crime rates. Finally, we exploit regional variation in prison releases based on the province of residence of pardoned inmates. All three sources of variation yield substantial incapacitation effect estimates and suggest that the crime-preventing effects of incarceration diminish with increases in the incarceration rate. (JEL K42)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2437.abstractZh: 2006年8月，意大利政府通过全国性的集体赦免措施，释放了全国三分之一的囚犯。我们研究了与大规模释放相对应的全国犯罪率的非连续下降情况。同时，我们还研究了监禁率恢复到预测的稳定水平对全国犯罪率的影响。最后，我们基于被赦免囚犯所在的省份，探讨了地区性监狱释放的差异。这三种变化因素都显示出显著的惩罚效果，并表明随着监禁率的上升，犯罪的预防效果会减弱。（JEL K42）

abstract.text: This paper develops a model of demand, pricing and advertising in the presence of social learning via word-of-mouth communication between friends. In the model consumers must receive information about a monopolist's product in order to consider purchasing it. The presence of word-of-mouth is not sufficient for demand to be more elastic and prices to be lower compared to an informed population. I derive the comparative static results of connectivity, mean-preserving spread of friendships, and clustering of friends on prices. The optimal targets for advertising are not, generically, the individuals with the most friends. (JEL L12, L14)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2466.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个模型，研究在朋友之间通过口碑传播进行社会学习的情况下，需求、定价和广告的运作机制。模型中，消费者必须获得关于垄断产品的信息才能考虑购买。仅靠口碑传播并不足以使需求更具弹性，并使价格低于信息充分的人群。本文还推导了与社交网络连通性、友谊的均值保持传播以及朋友群聚对价格的影响的比较静态结果。一般来说，广告的最佳目标并非那些拥有最多朋友的人。（JEL L12, L14）

abstract.text: We use data on insurance deductible choices to estimate a structural model of risky choice that incorporates “standard” risk aversion (diminishing marginal utility for wealth) and probability distortions. We find that probability distortions—characterized by substantial overweighting of small probabilities and only mild insensitivity to probability changes—play an important role in explaining the aversion to risk manifested in deductible choices. This finding is robust to allowing for observed and unobserved heterogeneity in preferences. We demonstrate that neither Kőszegi-Rabin loss aversion alone nor Gul disappointment aversion alone can explain our estimated probability distortions, signifying a key role for probability weighting. (JEL D14, D81, G22)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2499.abstractZh: 我们利用保险免赔额选择的数据来估计一个包含“标准”风险厌恶（财富边际效用递减）和概率扭曲的风险选择结构模型。我们发现，概率扭曲——表现为对小概率的显著偏好以及对概率变化的轻微不敏感——在解释免赔额选择中表现出的风险厌恶行为中起着重要作用。这一发现在考虑观察到的和未观察到的偏好异质性时依然成立。我们证明，无论是Kőszegi-Rabin损失厌恶还是Gul失望厌恶都无法完全解释我们估计出的概率扭曲，这表明概率加权在解释这种行为中起着关键作用。（JEL D14, D81, G22）

abstract.text: We measure the change in household spending caused by receipt of the economic stimulus payments of 2008, using questions added to the Consumer Expenditure Survey and variation from the randomized timing of disbursement. Households spent 12–30 percent (depending on specification) of their payments on nondurable goods during the three-month period of payment receipt, and a significant amount more on durable goods, primarily vehicles, bringing the total response to 50–90 percent of the payments. The responses are substantial and significant for older, lower-income, and home-owning households. Spending does not vary significantly with the method of disbursement (check versus electronic transfer). (JEL D12, D14, E21, E62)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2530.abstractZh: 我们通过向消费者支出调查中添加的问题以及经济刺激资金发放时间的随机性差异，来测量2008年经济刺激资金发放对家庭支出变化的影响。在资金发放的三个月期间，家庭将其支付金额的12%至30%（具体比例取决于研究设计）用于非耐用品的购买，而用于耐用品的支出则显著增加，尤其是车辆，这使得总支出占支付金额的50%至90%。这些支出对于年龄较大、收入较低且拥有自有住房的家庭来说尤为显著。资金发放方式（支票与电子转账）对支出变化的影响并不显著。（JEL D12, D14, E21, E62）

abstract.text: Firms face competing needs to expand product variety and reduce production costs. Access to larger markets enables innovation to reduce costs. Although firm scale increases, foreign competition reduces markups. Firms' ability to recapture lost markups depends on the interplay between within-firm competition and across-firm competition. Narrowing product variety eases within-firm competition but lowers market share. I provide a theory detailing the impact of trade policy on product and process innovation. Unbundling innovation provides new insights into welfare gains and innovation policy. Product innovation increases welfare beyond standard gains from trade. The relative returns to innovation policy change with trade liberalization. (JEL D24, F13, O31)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2554.abstractZh: 企业面临扩大产品种类和减少生产成本的双重需求。进入更大的市场有助于创新从而降低成本。尽管企业规模扩大，但外国竞争会降低价格加成。企业能否重新获得失去的价格加成取决于企业内部竞争与跨企业竞争之间的相互作用。减少产品种类会简化企业内部竞争，但会降低市场份额。我提出了一个理论，详细阐述了贸易政策对产品和工艺创新的影响。创新的分拆为福利收益和创新政策提供了新的见解。产品创新带来的福利收益超出了贸易带来的标准收益。随着贸易自由化的推进，创新政策的相对收益会发生变化。（JEL D24, F13, O31）

abstract.text: Expected consumer's surplus rarely represents preferences over price lotteries. Still, I give sufficient conditions for policies which maximize aggregate expected surplus to be interim Pareto Optimal. Besides two standard partial equilibrium conditions, I assume that feasible prices satisfy a single-crossing property; and each consumer's indirect utility satisfies increasing differences in the price and income. I use the result to extend well-known welfare conclusions beyond the knife-edge quasilinear utility case. Since increasing differences puts no upper bound on risk aversion, the result is useful for applications in which risk aversion is important. (JEL D11, D24, D42, D81, D83, L42)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2585.abstractZh: 预期消费者剩余很少代表对价格彩票的偏好。尽管如此，我提出了一些充分条件，使得旨在最大化总预期剩余的政策能够达到临时的帕累托最优。除了两个标准的局部均衡条件外，我还假设可行价格满足单一交叉性质；并且每个消费者的间接效用满足价格和收入差异的递增性。我利用这一结果将众所周知的福利结论扩展到非线性的准线性效用情形之外。由于差异的递增性不会对风险厌恶施加上限，因此这一结果对于需要考虑风险厌恶的应用非常有用。（JEL D11, D24, D42, D81, D83, L42）

abstract.text: We adopt a statistical approach to identify the shocks that explain most of the fluctuations of the slope of the term structure of interest rates. We find that one shock can explain the majority of unpredictable movements in the slope. Impulse response functions lead us to interpret this shock as news about future total factor productivity (TFP). By showing that “slope shocks” are essentially “TFP news shocks” we provide a new explanation for the relationship between the slope and macroeconomic fundamentals. Our results also provide a new empirical benchmark for structural models at the intersection of macroeconomics and finance. (JEL E23, E43, E52, G12, G14)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2612.abstractZh: 我们采用统计方法来确定那些能够解释利率期限结构斜率波动的大部分因素。我们发现，有一种冲击能够解释斜率中大部分不可预测的变化。脉冲响应函数的分析表明，这种冲击实际上代表了关于未来全要素生产率变化的消息。通过证明“斜率冲击”本质上是“全要素生产率消息冲击”，我们为斜率与宏观经济基本面之间的关系提供了新的解释。我们的研究结果还为宏观经济与金融学交叉领域的结构模型提供了新的实证依据。（JEL E23, E43, E52, G12, G14）

abstract.text: The payoff of actions is estimated and the resulting empirical payoff is controlled for in regression analyses to formulate a test of rational expectations in information cascade experiments. We show that the empirical payoff of actions is a function of estimates of choice probabilities and estimates of the information parameters of the game. We introduce an alternative empirical payoff of actions with true values of the information parameters. Our improved measure of the success of social learning confirms that rational expectations are violated, but deviations from rational expectations are statistically significantly smaller than in Weizsacher (2010). (JEL D82, D83, D84)

10.1257/aer.103.6.2633.abstractZh: 我们估计了行动所带来的收益，并在回归分析中控制了这一实际收益，以检验信息级联实验中的理性预期假设。我们发现，行动的收益是选择概率估计值以及游戏信息参数估计值的函数。我们引入了另一种基于真实信息参数值的行动收益模型。我们改进的社交学习成功度量结果表明，理性预期假设被违反了，但偏离理性预期的程度在统计上明显小于Weizsacher（2010）的研究结果。（JEL D82, D83, D84）

abstract.text: This paper investigates consumer inertia in health insurance markets, where adverse selection is a potential concern. We leverage a major change to insurance provision that occurred at a large firm to identify substantial inertia, and develop and estimate a choice model that also quantifies risk preferences and ex ante health risk. We use these estimates to study the impact of policies that nudge consumers toward better decisions by reducing inertia. When aggregated, these improved individual-level choices substantially exacerbate adverse selection in our setting, leading to an overall reduction in welfare that doubles the existing welfare loss from adverse selection.

10.1257/aer.103.7.2643.abstractZh: 本文研究了健康保险市场中的消费者惰性现象，其中逆向选择是一个潜在的担忧问题。我们借助一家大型公司在保险提供方面发生的一次重大变革，来识别显著的惰性现象，并开发并估计了一个选择模型，该模型还量化了风险偏好和事前健康风险。我们利用这些估计结果来研究通过减少惰性来促使消费者做出更好决策的政策的影响。总体而言，这些改善的个体层面选择会显著加剧我们环境中的逆向选择问题，导致整体福利下降，其程度是逆向选择带来的现有福利损失的两倍。

abstract.text: We estimate the impacts of the Earned Income Tax Credit on labor supply using local variation in knowledge about the EITC schedule. We proxy for EITC knowledge in a Zip code with the fraction of individuals who manipulate reported self-employment income to maximize their EITC refund. This measure varies significantly across areas. We exploit changes in EITC eligibility at the birth of a child to estimate labor supply effects. Individuals in high-knowledge areas change wage earnings sharply to obtain larger EITC refunds relative to those in low-knowledge areas. These responses come primarily from intensive-margin earnings increases in the phase-in region. (JEL H23, H24, H31, J22, J23, J31)

10.1257/aer.103.7.2683.abstractZh: 我们通过了解各地区的EITC计划知识差异，来估算EITC对劳动力供应的影响。我们用一个邮政编码区域内的个体在报告自雇收入时调整比例来代理EITC知识情况，以最大化EITC退税。这一指标在不同地区存在显著差异。我们利用孩子出生时的EITC资格变化来估算劳动力供应的影响。在知识水平较高的地区，个体为了获得更高的EITC退税，其工资收入会有显著变化。这些反应主要来自于逐步实施阶段的收入增长。（JEL H23, H24, H31, J22, J23, J31）

abstract.text: We study intertemporal price discrimination when consumers can store for future consumption needs. We offer a simple model of demand dynamics, which we estimate using market-level data. Optimal pricing involves temporary price reductions that enable sellers to discriminate between price sensitive consumers, who stockpile for future consumption, and less price-sensitive consumers, who do not stockpile. We empirically quantify the impact of intertemporal price discrimination on profits and welfare. We find that sales (i) capture 25–30 percent of the gap between non-discriminatory profits and (unattainable) third-degree price discrimination profits, (ii) increase total welfare, and (iii) have a modest impact on consumer welfare. (JEL D11, D12, L11, L12, L81)

10.1257/aer.103.7.2722.abstractZh: 我们研究了消费者能够储存以备未来消费需求的跨时价格歧视现象。我们提出了一个简单的需求动态模型，并使用市场层面的数据对其进行估计。最优定价涉及临时性的价格降低，使卖家能够区分两类消费者：一类是价格敏感的消费者，他们会储存商品以备将来消费；另一类是不太敏感于价格的消费者，他们不会进行储存。我们通过实证方法量化了跨时价格歧视对利润和福利的影响。我们发现，销售活动(i)占据了非歧视性利润与（无法实现的）三度价格歧视利润之间差距的25-30%，(ii)增加了总福利，并且(iii)对消费者福利有轻微的影响。(JEL D11, D12, L11, L12, L81)

abstract.text: We assess the empirical importance of changes in income and relative prices for structural transformation in the postwar United States. We explain two natural approaches to the data: sectors may be categories of final expenditure or value added; e.g., the service sector may be the final expenditure on services or the value added from service industries. We estimate preferences for each approach and find that with final expenditure income effects are the dominant force behind structural transformation, whereas with value-added categories price effects are more important. We show how the input-output structure of the United States can reconcile these findings. (JEL E21, L16)

10.1257/aer.103.7.2752.abstractZh: 我们评估了战后美国结构性转型中收入变化和相对价格变化的重要性。我们解释了两种处理数据的自然方法：部门可以是最终支出的类别，也可以是附加值类别；例如，服务部门可以是服务的最终支出，或者是服务行业的附加值。我们分别估算了这两种方法的偏好，发现以最终支出为基础的模型下，收入效应是结构性转型的主要驱动力，而以附加值为基础的模型下，价格效应则更为重要。我们展示了美国的投入产出结构如何能够调和这些发现。（JEL E21, L16）

abstract.text: This article introduces a new approach to modeling the expanding universe of decision makers in the wake of growing awareness, and invokes the axiomatic approach to model the evolution of decision makers' beliefs as awareness grows. The expanding universe is accompanied by extension of the set of acts, the preference relations over which are linked by a new axiom, invariant risk preferences, asserting that the ranking of lotteries is independent of the set of acts under consideration. The main results are representation theorems and rules for updating beliefs over expanding state spaces and events that have the flavor of “reverse Bayesianism.” (JEL D81, D83)

10.1257/aer.103.7.2790.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种新的方法，用于建模在意识增强背景下决策者的扩展宇宙，并采用了公理化的方法来模拟随着意识增长而变化的决策者信念的演变。这种扩展宇宙伴随着行为集合的扩展，偏好关系通过一个新的公理——不变风险偏好来连接，该公理指出，彩票的排名与所考虑的行为集合无关。主要成果包括表示定理以及更新扩展状态空间中的信念的规则，这些规则具有“逆向贝叶斯主义”的特征。（JEL D81, D83）

abstract.text: We characterize the unique equilibrium of a competitive continuous time game between a resource-constrained informed player and a sequence of rivals who partially observe his action intensity. Our game adds noisy monitoring and impatient players to Aumann and Maschler (1966), and also subsumes insider trading models. The intensity bound induces a novel strategic bias and serial mean reversion by uninformed players. We compute the duration of the informed player's informational edge. The uninformed player's value of information is concave if the intensity bound is large enough. Costly obfuscation by the informed player optimally rises in the public deception. (JEL D82, D83, G14)

10.1257/aer.103.7.2811.abstractZh: 我们描述了在资源有限的知情玩家与部分观察到其行动强度的竞争对手之间进行的竞争性连续时间博弈的独特均衡。我们的博弈在Aumann和Maschler（1966）的基础上增加了噪声监控和不耐烦的玩家，并且还包含了内幕交易模型。强度限制引发了知情玩家以及无知情玩家的新型战略偏差和序列均值回归行为。我们计算了知情玩家信息优势持续的时间。如果强度限制足够大，无知情玩家的信息价值是凹的。知情玩家进行昂贵的混淆行为在公共欺骗中是最优选择。（JEL D82, D83, G14）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes a dynamic lending relationship where the borrower cannot be forced to make repayments, and the lender offers long-term contracts that are imperfectly enforced and repeatedly renegotiated. No commitment and full commitment by the lender are special cases of this model where the probability of enforcement equals zero and one, respectively. I show that an increase in the degree of enforcement can lower social welfare. Furthermore, properties of equilibrium investment dynamics with partial commitment drastically differ from those with full and no commitment. In particular, investment is positively related to cash flow, consistent with empirical findings. (JEL D82, D86, G21)

10.1257/aer.103.7.2848.abstractZh: 本文分析了一种动态借贷关系，在这种关系中，借款人不能被强制偿还债务，而贷款人则提供长期合同，但这些合同的执行并不完善，且会反复重新协商。贷款人的完全不承诺和完全承诺是这种模型的特殊情况，分别对应于执行概率为零和一的情况。研究表明，提高执行力度可以降低社会福利。此外，具有部分承诺的均衡投资动态的性质与具有完全承诺和完全不承诺的情况有着显著的不同。特别是，投资与现金流呈正相关，这与实证研究结果一致。（JEL D82, D86, G21）

abstract.text: If profit maximization is the objective of a firm, new information about quality should affect firm behavior only through its effects on market demand. I consider an alternate model in which suppliers are motivated by a desire to perform well in addition to profit. The introduction of quality “report cards” for cardiac surgery in Pennsylvania provides an empirical setting to isolate the relative role of extrinsic and intrinsic incentives in determining surgeon response. Information on performance that was new to surgeons and unrelated to patient demand led to an intrinsic response four times larger than surgeon response to profit incentives. (JEL D83, I11, L15)

10.1257/aer.103.7.2875.abstractZh: 如果利润最大化是企业的目标，那么关于质量的新信息应该仅通过其对市场需求的影响来影响企业的行为。我考虑了一个替代模型，在该模型中，供应商除了追求利润之外，还受到表现良好的动机驱动。宾夕法尼亚州心脏手术中引入质量“报告卡”提供了一个实证环境，以分离外在激励和内在激励在决定外科医生行为中的相对作用。对于外科医生来说，与患者需求无关的新绩效信息导致的内在反应，是外科医生对利润激励反应的四倍。（JEL D83, I11, L15）

abstract.text: To investigate whether secondary markets aid or harm durable goods manufacturers, we build a dynamic model of durable goods oligopoly with transaction costs in the secondary market. Calibrating model parameters using data from the US automobile industry, we find the net effect of opening the secondary market is to decrease new car manufacturers' profits by 35 percent. Counterfactual scenarios in which the size of the used good stock decreases, such as when products become less durable, when the number of firms decreases, or when firms can commit to future production levels, increase the profitability of opening the secondary market. (JEL L13, L25, L62, L81)

10.1257/aer.103.7.2911.abstractZh: 为了研究二级市场是否对耐用商品制造商有利或有害，我们建立了一个包含二级市场交易成本的耐用商品寡头垄断动态模型。通过美国汽车行业的数据对模型参数进行校准后，我们发现开放二级市场的净效应是使新汽车制造商的利润减少35%。而在二手商品库存减少的反事实情景下，例如产品耐久性降低、企业数量减少或企业能够承诺未来的生产水平时，开放二级市场的盈利能力会提高。（JEL L13, L25, L62, L81）

abstract.text: A large and growing share of world trade travels by air. We model exporters' choice between fast, expensive air cargo and slow, cheap ocean cargo, which depends on the price elasticity of demand and the value that consumers attach to fast delivery. We use US imports data that provide rich variation in the premium paid for air shipping and in time lags for ocean transit to extract consumers' valuation of time. We estimate that each day in transit is equivalent to an advalorem tariff of 0.6 to 2.1 percent. The most time-sensitive trade flows involve parts and components trade. (JEL F13, F14, L93)

10.1257/aer.103.7.2935.abstractZh: 全球贸易中有很大且不断增长的份额是通过空运完成的。我们对出口商在快速、昂贵的空运货物与缓慢、便宜的海洋货物运输之间的选择进行了建模，这一选择取决于需求的弹性以及消费者对快速交付的重视程度。我们利用了美国进口数据，这些数据提供了关于空运附加费与海洋运输时间差异的丰富信息，从而能够准确评估消费者对时间的重视程度。我们的估计表明，每延误一天，空运成本相当于按加权的关税的0.6%到2.1%。最需要时间敏感的贸易流涉及零部件贸易。（JEL F13, F14, L93）

abstract.text: This paper measures the impact of vertically integrated and exclusive software on industry structure and welfare in the sixth-generation of the US video game industry (2000–2005). I specify and estimate a dynamic model of both consumer demand for hardware and software products, and software demand for hardware platforms. I use estimates to simulate market outcomes had platforms been unable to own or contract exclusively with software. Driven by increased software compatibility, hardware and software sales would have increased by 7 percent and 58 percent and consumer welfare by $1.5 billion. Gains would be realized only by the incumbent, suggesting exclusivity favored the entrant platforms. (JEL D12, L13, L22, L63, L86)

10.1257/aer.103.7.2960.abstractZh: 本文研究了垂直整合和独家软件对美国第六代电子游戏产业（2000–2005年）产业结构与福利的影响。我们构建并估计了一个动态模型，该模型涵盖了消费者对硬件和软件产品的需求，以及软件对硬件平台的需求。通过模型模拟，我们发现在平台无法独家拥有或独家与软件合作的情况下，硬件和软件销售额将分别增加7%和58%，消费者福利将增加15亿美元。这些收益仅能由现有企业获得，这表明独家模式更有利于新进入者。（JEL D12, L13, L22, L63, L86）

abstract.text: A growing literature explores differences in subjective well-being across demographic groups, often relying on surveys with high nonresponse rates. By using the reported number of call attempts made to participants in the University of Michigan's Surveys of Consumers, we show that comparisons among easy-to-reach respondents differ from comparisons among hard-to-reach ones. Notably, easy-to-reach women are happier than easy-to-reach men, but hard-to-reach men are happier than hard-to-reach women, and conclusions of a survey could reverse with more attempted calls. Better alternatives to comparing group sample averages might include putting greater weight on hard-to-reach respondents or even extrapolating trends in responses.

10.1257/aer.103.7.3001.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究探讨了不同人口群体在主观幸福感上的差异，这些研究通常依赖于非响应率较高的调查数据。通过对比密歇根大学消费者调查中对参与者的电话尝试次数，我们发现，对于容易联系到的受访者而言，其幸福感与难以联系到的受访者存在差异。值得注意的是，容易联系到的女性比男性更幸福，但难以联系到的男性却比难以联系到的女性更幸福。如果进行更多的电话联系，调查结果可能会发生变化。在比较群体样本平均值时，可以考虑给予难以联系到的受访者更大的权重，或者进一步推断响应趋势。

abstract.text: Over the business cycle young workers experience much greater volatility of hours worked than prime-aged workers. This can arise from age differences in labor supply or labor demand characteristics. To distinguish between these, we document that, for young workers, both the cyclical volatilities of hours and wages are greater than those of the prime-aged. We argue that a general class of models featuring only age-specific labor supply differences cannot reconcile these facts. We then show that a simple model featuring labor demand differences can. (JEL E32, J13, J22, J23, J31)

10.1257/aer.103.7.3022.abstractZh: 在商业周期中，年轻工人的工作时间波动幅度比壮年工人要大得多。这可能是由于劳动力供给或劳动力需求特征的年龄差异所导致的。为了区分这两种情况，我们发现对于年轻工人来说，工作时间和工资的周期波动幅度都大于壮年工人。我们认为，仅以年龄特定的劳动力供给差异为基础的一类模型无法解释这些现象。而一个包含劳动力需求差异的简单模型则可以解释这些现象。（JEL E32, J13, J22, J23, J31）

abstract.text: We explore empirically models of aggregate fluctuations in which consumers form anticipations about the future based on noisy sources of information and these anticipations affect output in the short run. Our objective is to separate fluctuations due to changes in fundamentals (news) from those due to temporary errors in agents' estimates (noise). We show that structural VARs cannot be used to identify news and noise shocks, but identification is possible via a method of moments or maximum likelihood. Next, we estimate our model on US data. Our results suggest that noise shocks explain a sizable fraction of short-run consumption fluctuations. (JEL D84, E13, E21, E32)

10.1257/aer.103.7.3045.abstractZh: 我们通过实证方法研究了消费者基于噪声信息来源对未来进行预期的过程，以及这些预期在短期内对产出的影响。我们的目标是区分由基本面变化（如新闻）引起的波动与由代理人估计的暂时性误差（噪声）引起的波动。我们发现，结构向量自回归模型无法用于识别新闻和噪声冲击，但可以通过矩估计或最大似然法实现识别。接下来，我们在美国数据上估计了我们的模型。我们的结果表明，噪声冲击解释了短期消费波动的相当大一部分。（JEL D84, E13, E21, E32）

abstract.text: We offer a theory of polarization as an optimal response to ambiguity. Suppose individual A's beliefs first-order stochastically dominate individual B's. They observe a common signal. They exhibit polarization if A's posterior dominates her prior and B's prior dominates her posterior. Given agreement on conditional signal likelihoods, we show that polarization is impossible under Bayesian updating or after observing extreme signals. However, we also show that polarization can arise after intermediate signals as ambiguity averse individuals implement their optimal prediction strategies. We explore when this polarization will occur and the logic underlying it. (JEL D81, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.103.7.3071.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种极化理论，作为对模糊性的最佳响应。假设个体A的信念首先序地随机支配个体B的信念。他们观察到共同的信号。如果A的后验支配她的先验，且B的先验支配她的后验，那么他们表现出极化。在条件信号可能性达成一致的情况下，我们表明，在贝叶斯更新之后或观察到极端信号之后，极化是不可能的。然而，我们也表明，在中间信号之后，由于厌恶模糊性的个体会实施他们的最优预测策略，极化仍有可能出现。我们探讨了这种极化何时会发生以及其背后的逻辑。（JEL D81, D82, D83）

abstract.text: This paper axiomatizes a utility function for social preferences under risk. In the model, a single parameter captures a preference for equality of opportunity (i.e., equality of exante expected payoffs) relative to equality of outcome (i.e., equality of ex-post payoffs). In a deterministic environment, the model reduces to the model of Fehr and Schmidt (1999). The model is consistent with recent experiments on probabilistic dictator games. (JEL C72, D71, D81)

10.1257/aer.103.7.3084.abstractZh: 本文为风险下的社会偏好提供了一种效用函数的公理化描述。在该模型中，一个单一参数能够反映对机会平等（即事前预期收益的平等）与结果平等（即事后的收益平等）的偏好。在确定性环境中，该模型可简化为Fehr和Schmidt在1999年提出的模型。该模型与最近关于概率性独裁博弈的实验结果一致。（JEL C72, D71, D81）

abstract.text: This paper shows that smoking intensity, i.e. the amount of nicotine extracted per cigarette smoked, responds to changes in excise taxes and tobacco prices. We exploit NHANES data covering the period 1988 to 2006 across many US states. Moreover, using panel data from the Coronary Artery Risk Development in Young Adults (CARDIA) study, we provide new evidence on the importance of cotinine measures in explaining long-run smoking behavior. We show the importance of smoking intensity as a long-run determinant of smoking cessation. We also investigate the sensitivity of smoking cessation to changes in excise taxes and their interaction with smoking intensity. (JEL H25, H32, I12, L11, L66)

10.1257/aer.103.7.3102.abstractZh: 本文表明，吸烟强度，即每支香烟所吸收的尼古丁量，会对消费税和烟草价格的变化作出反应。我们利用了1988年至2006年间美国多个州的NHANES数据。此外，通过利用冠状动脉风险发展在年轻成人中的研究（CARDIA）的面板数据，我们提供了关于可替宁指标在解释长期吸烟行为中的重要性方面的新证据。我们强调了吸烟强度作为长期戒烟决定因素的重要性。我们还研究了消费税变化对戒烟行为的敏感性，以及它们与吸烟强度的相互作用。（JEL H25, H32, I12, L11, L66）

abstract.text: Most nonelderly Americans purchase health insurance through their employers, which sponsor a limited number of plans. Using a panel dataset representing over ten million insured lives, we estimate employees' preferences for different health plans and use the estimates to predict their choices if more plans were made available to them on the same terms, i.e., with equivalent subsidies and at large-group prices. Using conservative assumptions, we estimate a median welfare gain of 13 percent of premiums. A proper accounting of the costs and benefits of a transition from employer-sponsored to individually-purchased insurance should include this nontrivial gain. (JEL G22, I13, J32)

10.1257/pol.5.1.32.abstractZh: 大多数非老年人美国人通过雇主购买健康保险，而雇主提供的保险计划数量有限。我们利用一个包含超过一千万被保险人的面板数据集，来估计员工对不同健康计划的偏好，并利用这些估计结果来预测，如果提供更多相同条件的保险计划，即提供同等补贴和大型团体价格，他们的选择会如何。在保守的假设下，我们估计从中获得的福利增益为保费总额的13%。对从雇主赞助保险到个人购买保险的转变进行合理的成本效益分析时，应该包括这一非同小的收益。（JEL G22, I13, J32）

abstract.text: (November 2013) - The effect of competition on the quality of health care remains a contested issue. Most empirical estimates rely on inference from nonexperimental data. In contrast, this paper exploits a procompetitive policy reform to provide estimates of the impact of competition on hospital outcomes. The English government introduced a policy in 2006 to promote competition between hospitals. Using this policy to implement a difference-in-differences research design, we estimate the impact of the introduction of competition on not only clinical outcomes but also productivity and expenditure. We find that the effect of competition is to save lives without raising costs.

10.1257/pol.5.4.134.abstractZh: (2013年11月)——竞争对医疗保健质量的影响仍然是一个有争议的问题。大多数实证估计都依赖于非实验数据的推断。相比之下，本文利用一项支持竞争的政策改革，来估算竞争对医院结果的影响。英国政府在2006年引入了一项政策，以促进医院之间的竞争。利用这一政策实施差异-差异研究设计，我们估计了竞争引入不仅对临床结果，而且对生产力和支出的影响。我们发现，竞争的效果是在不增加成本的情况下挽救生命。

abstract.text: In 2011 US health care spending grew 3.9 percent to reach $2.7 trillion, marking the third consecutive year of relatively slow growth. Growth in national health spending closely tracked growth in nominal gross domestic product (GDP) in 2010 and 2011, and health spending as a share of GDP remained stable from 2009 through 2011, at 17.9 percent. Even as growth in spending at the national level has remained stable, personal health care spending growth accelerated in 2011 (from 3.7 percent to 4.1 percent), in part because of faster growth in spending for prescription drugs and physician and clinical services. There were also divergent trends in spending growth in 2011 depending on the payment source: Medicaid spending growth slowed, while growth in Medicare, private health insurance, and out-of-pocket spending accelerated. Overall, there was relatively slow growth in incomes, jobs, and GDP in 2011, which raises questions about whether US health care spending will rebound over the next few years as it typically has after past economic downturns.

10.1377/hlthaff.2012.1206.abstractZh: 2011年，美国医疗保健支出增长了3.9%，达到2.7万亿美元，这是连续第三年增长较为缓慢。2010年和2011年，国家医疗保健支出的增长与名义国内生产总值（GDP）的增长密切相关。从2009年到2011年，医疗保健支出占GDP的比例保持稳定，为17.9%。尽管国家层面的支出增长保持稳定，但个人医疗保健支出的增长在2011年有所加快，从3.7%增加到4.1%，部分原因是处方药以及医生和临床服务的支出增长更快。2011年，不同支付来源的支出增长也存在差异：Medicaid的支出增长放缓，而Medicare、私人健康保险和自付支出的增长则加快。总体而言，2011年收入、就业和GDP的增长较为缓慢，这引发了关于美国医疗保健支出在未来几年是否会像过去经济衰退后那样恢复的问题。

abstract.text: Interim Report of the Committee on Geographic Variation in Health Care Spending and Promotion of High-Value Health Care: Preliminary Committee Observations is designed to provide the committee's preliminary observations for the 113th Congress as it considers further Medicare reform. This report contains only key preliminary observations related primarily to the committee's commissioned analyses of Medicare Parts A (Hospital Insurance program), B (Supplementary Medical Insurance program) and D (outpatient prescription drug benefit), complemented by other empirical investigations. It does not contain any observations related to the committee's commissioned analyses of the commercial insurer population, Medicare Advantage, or Medicaid, which will be presented in the committee's final report after completion of quality-control activities. This interim report excludes conclusions or recommendations related to the committee's consideration of the geographic value index or other payment reforms designed to promote highvalue care. Additional analyses are forthcoming, which will influence the committee's deliberations. These analyses include an exploration of how Medicare Part C (Medicare Advantage) and commercial spending, utilization, and quality vary compared with, and possibly are influenced by, Medicare Parts A and B spending, utilization, and quality. The committee also is assessing potential biases that may be inherent to Medicare and commercial claims-based measures of health status. Based on this new evidence and continued review of the literature, the committee will confirm the accuracy of the observations presented in this interim report and develop final conclusions and recommendations, which will be published in the committee's final report.

10.17226/18308.abstractZh: 《医疗保健支出地理差异及促进高价值医疗服务的委员会中期报告：初步观察》旨在为第113届国会审议进一步的医疗保险改革提供委员会的初步观察结果。该报告仅包含与委员会对医疗保险A部分（医院保险计划）、B部分（补充医疗保险计划）和D部分（门诊处方药福利）的委托分析相关的关键初步观察结果，并辅以其他实证研究。报告未包含与委员会对商业保险公司群体、医疗保险优势计划或医疗补助计划的委托分析相关的观察结果，这些分析将在完成质量控制活动后以委员会的最终报告形式呈现。该中期报告未包含与委员会对地理价值指数或其他旨在促进高价值医疗服务的支付改革相关的结论或建议。后续将会有更多分析，这些分析将影响委员会的审议。这些分析包括探讨医疗保险C部分（医疗保险优势计划）和商业支出、利用情况以及质量与医疗保险A部分和B部分的支出、利用情况以及质量之间的差异，以及可能受到的影响。委员会还在评估可能存在于医疗保险和商业基于索赔的健康状况衡量标准中的潜在偏差。基于这些新证据和对文献的持续审查，委员会将确认本中期报告中提出的观察结果的准确性，并制定最终结论和建议，这些结论和建议将发表在委员会的最终报告中。

abstract.text: Our understanding of the determinants of physician skill and the extent to which skill is valued in the marketplace is superficial. Using a large, detailed panel of new obstetricians, we find that, even though physicians' maternal complication rates improve steadily with years of practice, initial skill (as measured by performance in a physician's first year of practice) explains most of the variation in physician performance over time. At the same time, we find that the trajectories of new physicians' delivery volume develop in a way partially consistent with Bayesian learning about physician quality. In particular, as physicians gain experience, their volume becomes increasingly sensitive to the information in their accumulated prior.

10.3386/w18678.abstractZh: 我们对医生技能的决定因素以及市场中对技能重视程度的了解是肤浅的。通过一项针对大量新妇产科医生的详细研究，我们发现，尽管医生的孕产妇并发症发生率随着执业年限的增加而稳步提高，但初始技能水平（以医生执业第一年的表现来衡量）解释了医生表现随时间变化的大部分差异。同时，我们发现新医生的手术量变化轨迹与贝叶斯学习对医生质量的认知在一定程度上是一致的。具体来说，随着医生经验的积累，他们的手术量对累积的先验信息的敏感度逐渐增强。

abstract.text: Health information technology (IT) adoption, it is argued, will dramatically improve patient care. We study the impact of hospital IT adoption on patient outcomes focusing on the roles of technological and organizational complements in affecting IT's value and explore underlying mechanisms through which IT facilitates the coordination of labor inputs. We link detailed hospital discharge data on all Medicare fee-for-service admissions from 2002-2007 to detailed hospital-level IT adoption information. We employ a difference-in-differences strategy to identify the parameters of interest. For all IT sensitive conditions we find that health IT adoption reduces mortality for the most complex patients but does not affect outcomes for the median patient. This implies that the benefits from IT adoption are skewed to large institutions with a severe case mix. We decompose the impact of health IT into care coordination, clinical information management, and other components. The benefits from health IT are primarily experienced by patients whose diagnoses require cross-specialty care coordination and extensive clinical information management.

10.3386/w18684.abstractZh: 健康信息技术（IT）的采用被认为将显著改善患者护理。我们研究了医院IT采用对患者结果的影响，重点关注技术和组织因素在影响IT价值中的作用，并探索IT促进劳动力协调的机制。我们将2002-2007年间所有Medicare按服务收费住院患者的详细出院数据与医院层面的IT采用信息进行了关联。采用差异-差异策略来识别相关参数。对于所有与IT相关的条件，我们发现健康IT的采用能够降低复杂患者的死亡率，但对中等程度的患者结果没有影响。这表明，IT采用的好处主要惠及那些诊断需要跨专科护理协调以及需要大量临床信息管理的患者。我们将健康IT的影响分解为护理协调、临床信息管理及其他组成部分。健康IT带来的好处主要惠及那些诊断需要跨专科护理协调以及需要大量临床信息管理的患者。

abstract.text: While several types of mental illness, including substance abuse disorders, have been linked with poor labor market outcomes, no current research has been able to examine the effects of childhood ADHD. As ADHD has become one of the most prevalent childhood mental conditions, it is useful to understand the full set of consequences of the illness. This paper uses a longitudinal national sample, including sibling pairs, to show important labor market outcome consequences of ADHD. The employment reduction is between 10-14 percentage points, the earnings reduction is approximately 33%, and the increase in social assistance is 15 points, which are larger than many estimates of the black-white earnings gap and the gender earnings gap. A small share of the link is explained by education attainments and co-morbid health conditions and behaviors. The results also show important differences in labor market consequences by family background and age of onset. These findings, along with similar research showing that ADHD is linked with poor education outcomes and adult crime, suggest that treating childhood ADHD can substantially increase the acquisition of human capital.

10.3386/w18689.abstractZh: 虽然多种精神疾病，包括物质滥用障碍，都与不良劳动力市场结果有关，但目前尚无研究能够探讨儿童期注意力缺陷多动障碍的影响。由于注意力缺陷多动障碍已成为最常见的儿童精神疾病之一，了解该疾病的全部后果具有重要意义。本文采用纵向全国样本，包括兄弟姐妹配对，来揭示注意力缺陷多动障碍对劳动力市场的重要影响。研究发现，就业率下降10-14个百分点，收入减少约33%，而社会援助需求增加15个百分点，这一数值大于许多关于黑人与白人之间收入差距以及性别收入差距的估计值。这种关联中有一小部分可以通过教育水平、共病健康状况及行为来解释。研究结果还显示，劳动力市场后果因家庭背景和发病年龄的不同而存在显著差异。这些发现，加上类似的研究表明注意力缺陷多动障碍与不良教育成果和成人犯罪有关，意味着治疗儿童期注意力缺陷多动障碍可以显著提升人力资本积累。

abstract.text: Adaptation is the only strategy that is guaranteed to be part of the world's climate strategy. Using the most comprehensive set of data files ever compiled on mortality and its determinants over the course of the 20th century, this paper makes two primary discoveries. First, we find that the mortality effect of an extremely hot day declined by about 80% between 1900-1959 and 1960-2004. As a consequence, days with temperatures exceeding 90°F were responsible for about 600 premature fatalities annually in the 1960-2004 period, compared to the approximately 3,600 premature fatalities that would have occurred if the temperature-mortality relationship from before 1960 still prevailed. Second, the adoption of residential air conditioning (AC) explains essentially the entire decline in the temperature-mortality relationship. In contrast, increased access to electricity and health care seem not to affect mortality on extremely hot days. Residential AC appears to be both the most promising technology to help poor countries mitigate the temperature related mortality impacts of climate change and, because fossil fuels are the least expensive source of energy, a technology whose proliferation will speed up the rate of climate change.

10.3386/w18692.abstractZh: 适应是唯一被证明能够融入全球气候战略的策略。本文利用20世纪期间关于死亡率及其决定因素的最全面的数据集，得出了两个重要发现。首先，1900年至1959年与1960年至2004年间，极端高温天气导致的死亡率下降了约80%。因此，在1960年至2004年期间，气温超过90华氏度的天气每年导致约600人过早死亡，而如果1960年之前的气温-死亡率关系仍然适用，则会导致大约3,600人过早死亡。其次，住宅空调的普及几乎完全解释了气温-死亡率关系的下降。相比之下，增加电力和医疗保健的获取似乎并未对极端高温天气导致的死亡率产生影响。住宅空调似乎是最有潜力帮助贫困国家减轻气候变化带来的温度相关死亡率影响的科技，而且由于化石燃料是最便宜的能源来源，这种技术的普及将加速气候变化的进程。

abstract.text: This paper explores the relationship between education and the evolution of wealth after retirement. Asset growth following retirement depends in part on health capital and financial capital accumulated prior to retirement, which in turn are strongly related to educational attainment. These "initial conditions" for retirement can have a lingering effect on subsequent asset evolution. Our aim is to disentangle the effects of education on post-retirement asset evolution that operate through health and financial capital accumulated prior to retirement from the effects of education that impinge directly on asset evolution after retirement. We consider the indirect effect of education through financial resources--in particular Social Security benefits and defined benefit pension benefits--and through health capital that was accumulated before retirement. We also consider the direct effect of education on asset growth following retirement, emphasizing the correlation between education and the returns households earn on their post-retirement investments. Households with different levels of education invest, on average, in different assets, and they may consequently earn different rates of return. Finally, we consider the additional effects of education that are not captured through these pathways. Our empirical findings suggest a substantial association between education and the evolution of assets. For example, for two person households the growth of assets between 1998 and 2008 is on average much greater for college graduates than for those with less than a high school degree. This difference ranges from about $82,000 in the lowest asset quintile to over $600,000 in the highest.

10.3386/w18695.abstractZh: 本文探讨了教育与退休后财富演变之间的关系。退休后的资产增长部分取决于退休前积累的健康资本和金融资本，而这些资本又与教育程度密切相关。这些“初始条件”对后续的资产演变具有持久影响。我们的目的是区分教育对退休后资产演变的影响，这些影响是通过退休前积累的健康资本和金融资本来实现的，以及那些直接作用于退休后资产演变的教育影响。我们考虑了教育通过金融资源——特别是社会保障福利和固定收益养老金福利——以及退休前积累的健康资本所起的间接影响。我们还考虑了教育对退休后资产增长的直接影响，强调了教育水平与家庭退休后投资回报之间的相关性。不同教育水平的家庭平均投资于不同的资产，因此可能获得不同的投资回报。最后，我们考虑了通过这些途径无法捕捉到的教育带来的额外影响。我们的实证研究发现，教育与资产演变之间存在显著关联。例如，对于两人家庭而言，1998年至2008年间，拥有大学学位的家庭资产增长平均比那些只有高中学历的家庭要大得多。这种差异从资产最低五分位数的约82,000美元到资产最高五分位数的超过600,000美元不等。

abstract.text: We present and empirically implement an equilibrium labor market search model where risk averse workers facing medical expenditure shocks are matched with firms making health insurance coverage decisions. Our model delivers a rich set of predictions that can account for a wide variety of phenomenon observed in the data including the correlations among firm sizes, wages, health insurance offering rates, turnover rates and workers' health compositions. We estimate our model by Generalized Method of Moments using a combination of micro data sources including Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP), Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) and Robert Wood Johnson Foundation Employer Health Insurance Survey. We use our estimated model to evaluate the equilibrium impact of the 2010 Affordable Care Act (ACA) and find that it would reduce the uninsured rate among the workers in our estimation sample from 20.12% to 7.27%. We also examine a variety of alternative policies to understand the roles of different components of the ACA in contributing to these equilibrium changes. Interestingly, we find that the uninsured rate will be even lower (at 6.44%) if the employer mandate in the ACA is eliminated.

10.3386/w18698.abstractZh: 我们提出并实证实施了一个均衡劳动力市场搜索模型，该模型将面临医疗支出冲击的风险厌恶型工人与做出健康保险决策的企业进行匹配。我们的模型提供了丰富的预测结果，能够解释数据中观察到的各种现象，包括企业规模、工资水平、健康保险提供率、员工流动率以及员工健康状况之间的相关性。我们通过广义矩估计方法对模型进行估计，并使用了包括收入与计划参与调查、医疗支出面板调查以及罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊基金会雇主健康保险调查在内的多种微观数据来源。我们利用估计出的模型来评估2010年平价医疗法案的均衡影响，发现该法案能够将我们估计样本中的无保险率从20.12%降低到7.27%。我们还研究了多种替代政策，以了解平价医疗法案中不同组成部分对实现这些均衡变化的作用。有趣的是，我们发现如果取消平价医疗法案中的雇主强制保险条款，无保险率将进一步降低到6.44%。

abstract.text: A ubiquitous and largely unquestioned assumption in studies of housing markets is that there is perfect information about local amenities. This paper measures the housing market and health impacts of 1,600 openings and closings of industrial plants that emit toxic pollutants. We find that housing values within one mile decrease by 1.5 percent when plants open, and increase by 1.5 percent when plants close. This implies an aggregate loss in housing values per plant of about $1.5 million. While the housing value impacts are concentrated within 1/2 mile, we find statistically significant infant health impacts up to one mile away.

10.3386/w18700.abstractZh: 在住房市场研究中，一个普遍且几乎不受质疑的假设是，关于当地便利设施的信息是完美的。本文通过测量1600起工业工厂的开设和关闭事件对住房市场及健康的影响，发现当工厂开设时，一英里内的住房价值下降1.5%，而工厂关闭时，住房价值则上升1.5%。这意味着每个工厂导致的总住房价值损失约为150万美元。虽然住房价值的影响集中在半英里范围内，但我们发现，在一英里范围内，婴儿健康方面存在统计学上显著的影响。

abstract.text: The ongoing fragmentation of work has resulted in a narrowing of tasks into smaller pieces that can be sent outside the organization and, in many instances, around the world. This trend is shifting the boundaries of organizations and leading to increased outsourcing. Though the consolidation of volume may lead to productivity improvement, little is known about how this shift toward outsourcing influences learning by providers of outsourced services. When producing output, the content of the knowledge gained can vary from one unit to the next. One dimension along which output can vary --a dimension with particular relevance in outsourcing--is the end customer for whom it is produced. The performance benefits of such customer experience remain largely unexamined. We explore this dimension of volume-based learning in a setting where doctors at an outsourcing firm complete radiological reads for hospital customers. We examine more than 2.7 million cases read by 97 radiologists for 1,431 customers and find evidence supporting the benefits of customer-specific experience accumulated by individual radiologists. Additionally, we find that variety in an individual's customer experience may increase the rate of individual learning from customer-specific experience for a focal task. Finally, we find that the level of experience with a customer for the entire outsourcing firm also yields learning and that the degree of customer depth moderates the impact of customer-specific experience at the individual level. We discuss the implications of our results for the study of learning as well as for providers and consumers of outsourced services.

10.3386/w18723.abstractZh: 当前工作的碎片化趋势导致任务被拆分成更小的部分，这些部分可以被发送到组织外部，甚至全球各地。这一趋势正在改变组织的边界，并导致外包现象的加剧。虽然批量生产的整合可能会提高生产力，但关于这种外包趋势如何影响外包服务提供者的学习，目前知之甚少。在产出过程中，每个单位所获得的知识内容可能会有所不同。在外包中，一个特别重要的维度就是产出的最终客户。这种客户体验所带来的绩效提升效果尚未得到充分研究。我们在一个外包公司的医生为医院客户完成放射影像解读的场景中，探讨了基于批量学习的这一维度。我们分析了97名放射科医生为1,431名客户完成的270多万例病例，发现了支持个别放射科医生通过特定客户体验积累知识的证据。此外，我们发现，个体客户体验的多样性可能会提高个体从特定客户体验中学习的速率。最后，我们发现，整个外包公司对某个客户的经验水平也能带来学习机会，而客户深度的程度会调节特定客户体验对个人层面的影响。我们讨论了这些结果对学习研究以及外包服务提供者和消费者的影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the relationship between alcohol consumption, deterrence, and crime for New York City. We examine high-frequency time-series data from 1983 to 2001 for one specific location to examine the impacts of variations in both alcohol consumption and deterrence on seven "index" crimes. We tackle the endogeneity of arrests and the police force by exploiting the temporal independence of crime and deterrence in these high-frequency data, and we address the endogeneity of alcohol by using instrumental variables where alcohol sales are instrumented with city and state alcohol taxes and minimum drinking age. We find that alcohol consumption is positively related to assault, rape, and larceny crimes but not murder, robbery, burglary, or motor vehicle theft. We find strong deterrence for all crimes except assault and rape. Generally, deterrence effects are stronger than alcohol effects.

10.3386/w18731.abstractZh: 本文研究了纽约市酒精消费、威慑作用与犯罪之间的关系。我们分析了1983年至2001年间某一特定地区的高频时间序列数据，以考察酒精消费和威慑作用的变化对七类“指数”犯罪的影响。通过利用这些高频数据中犯罪与威慑作用的时间独立性，我们解决了逮捕人数和警力数量的内生性问题。同时，我们通过使用工具变量来研究酒精消费的内生性问题，其中酒精销售数据通过城市和州的酒精税以及最低饮酒年龄作为工具变量进行调节。研究发现，酒精消费与袭击、强奸和盗窃犯罪呈正相关，但与谋杀、抢劫、入室盗窃和机动车盗窃犯罪无关。除了袭击和强奸犯罪外，其他犯罪类型都受到较强的威慑作用。总体而言，威慑作用的效果优于酒精消费的影响。

abstract.text: Natural gas has emerged as an increasingly attractive source of energy since it is highly efficient, abundant, and cleaner than any other fossil fuel. In this paper, we examine the impact of widespread adoption of natural gas as a source of fuel on infant mortality in Turkey, using variation across provinces and over time in the intensity of natural gas utilization. Our estimates indicate that the expansion of natural gas infrastructure has resulted in a significant decrease in the rate of infant mortality. Specifically, a one-percentage point increase in natural gas intensity - measured by the rate of subscriptions to natural gas services - would cause the infant mortality rate to decrease by 3.9 percent, which would translate into approximately 340 infant lives saved in 2011 alone.

10.3386/w18736.abstractZh: 天然气作为一种能源，因其高效、丰富且比任何其他化石燃料更清洁，而变得越来越有吸引力。本文研究了在土耳其广泛采用天然气作为燃料对婴儿死亡率的影响，重点关注不同省份以及随时间变化的天然气使用强度差异。我们的估计表明，天然气基础设施的扩展显著降低了婴儿死亡率。具体而言，天然气使用强度增加一个百分点——以使用天然气服务的比例来衡量——将使婴儿死亡率下降3.9%，仅2011年一年就能挽救大约340名婴儿的生命。

abstract.text: We measure the impact of a drastic new technology for producing steel -the minimill -on the aggregate productivity of U.S. steel producers, using unique plant-level data between 1963 and 2002.We find that the sharp increase in the industry's productivity is linked to this new technology, and operates through two distinct mechanisms.First, minimills displaced the older technology, called vertically integrated production, and this reallocation of output was responsible for a third of the increase in the industry's productivity.Second, increased competition, due to the expansion of minimills, drove a substantial reallocation process within the group of vertically integrated producers, driving a resurgence in their productivity, and consequently of the industry's productivity as a whole.

10.3386/w18739.abstractZh: 我们利用1963年至2002年间独特的工厂级数据，来衡量一种新型钢铁生产技术——迷你钢厂——对美国钢铁生产商整体生产率的冲击。研究发现，该行业生产率的显著提升与这种新技术密切相关，并且是通过两种不同的机制实现的。首先，迷你钢厂取代了传统的垂直整合生产技术，这种产出的重新分配是行业生产率提升的三分之一原因。其次，由于迷你钢厂的大量扩张，竞争加剧，导致垂直整合生产商内部发生了显著的重新分配过程，从而推动了他们生产率的提升，进而也提升了整个行业的生产率。

abstract.text: Food purchases differ substantially across countries. We use detailed household level data from the US, France and the UK to (i) document these differences; (ii) estimate a demand system for food and nutrients, and (iii) simulate counterfactual choices if households faced prices and nutritional characteristics from other countries. We find that differences in prices and characteristics are important and can explain some difference (e.g., US-France difference in caloric intake), but generally cannot explain many of the compositional patterns by themselves. Instead, it seems an interaction between the economic environment and differences in preferences is needed to explain cross country differences.

10.3386/w18750.abstractZh: 不同国家的食品购买情况存在显著差异。我们利用来自美国、法国和英国的详细家庭层面数据来（i）记录这些差异；（ii）估算食品和营养需求系统，以及（iii）模拟如果家庭面临其他国家的价格和营养特征时的选择。我们发现，价格和特征的差异确实很重要，可以解释一些差异（例如，美国与法国在热量摄入上的差异），但通常无法单独解释许多组合模式。因此，似乎需要经济环境与偏好差异之间的相互作用来解释国家间的差异。

abstract.text: We examine long-term neighborhood effects on low-income families using data from the Moving to Opportunity (MTO) randomized housing-mobility experiment, which offered some public-housing families but not others the chance to move to less-disadvantaged neighborhoods. We show that 10-15 years after baseline MTO improves adult physical and mental health; has no detectable effect on economic outcomes, youth schooling and youth physical health; and mixed results by gender on other youth outcomes, with girls doing better on some measures and boys doing worse. Despite the somewhat mixed pattern of impacts on traditional behavioral outcomes, MTO moves substantially improve adult subjective well-being.

10.3386/w18772.abstractZh: 我们利用“移居以获取机会”随机住房迁移实验的数据，研究了长期邻里效应对低收入家庭的影响。该实验为部分公共住房家庭提供了迁移到条件较好的社区的机会，而其他家庭则没有。研究发现，在基线条件下，MTO改善了成年人的身心健康；但对经济成果、青少年教育水平和身体健康的影响并不明显；不同性别在青少年其他方面的表现也有差异，女孩在某些指标上表现更好，而男孩则表现较差。尽管对传统行为结果的影响模式存在一定不确定性，但MTO显著提升了成年人的主观幸福感。

abstract.text: Cycling is popular among children, but results in thousands of injuries annually. In recent years, many states and localities have enacted bicycle helmet laws. We examine direct and indirect effects of these laws on injuries. Using hospital-level panel data and triple difference models, we find helmet laws are associated with reductions in bicycle-related head injuries among children. However, laws also are associated with decreases in non-head cycling injuries, as well as increases in head injuries from other wheeled sports. Thus, the observed reduction in bicycle-related head injuries may be due to reductions in bicycle riding induced by the laws.

10.3386/w18773.abstractZh: 骑自行车在儿童中很受欢迎，但每年仍有数千人因此受伤。近年来，许多州和地区都制定了自行车头盔法规。我们研究了这些法规对受伤情况的直接或间接影响。通过医院级面板数据和三重差异模型分析，我们发现头盔法规有助于减少儿童因骑自行车导致的头部受伤。然而，这些法规同时也导致了非头部自行车运动受伤的减少，以及其他轮式运动导致的头部受伤的增加。因此，观察到的自行车相关头部受伤的减少，可能是由于这些法规减少了儿童骑自行车的行为。

abstract.text: Across public junior high schools in 21 Colombian cities, we conducted a randomized evaluation of a mandatory six-month internet-based sexual education course. Six months after finishing the course, we find a 0.4 standard deviation improvement in knowledge, a 0.2 standard deviation improvement in attitudes, and a 55% increase in the likelihood of redeeming vouchers for condoms as a result of taking the course. We find no evidence of spillovers to control classrooms within treatment schools, and we find treatment effects are enhanced when a larger share of a student’s friends also takes the course. The low cost of the online course along with the effectiveness we document suggests this technology is a viable alternative for improving sexual education in middle income countries.

10.3386/w18776.abstractZh: 在哥伦比亚21个城市的所有公立初中中，我们对一项为期六个月的强制性网络性教育课程进行了随机评估。课程结束后六个月，我们发现学生的知识水平提高了0.4个标准差，态度也有所改善，0.2个标准差。此外，参加课程的学生选择兑换避孕套礼券的可能性增加了55%。我们没有发现该课程对控制学校内其他班级产生溢出效应，并且发现当更多学生的朋友也参加该课程时，课程的效果会进一步增强。由于在线课程的成本较低，且我们记录到的效果表明其有效性，因此这项技术可以成为中等收入国家改善性教育的一种可行选择。

abstract.text: If profit maximization is the objective of a firm, new information about quality should affect firm behavior only through its effects on market demand. I consider an alternate model in which suppliers are motivated by a desire to perform well in addition to profit. The introduction of quality "report cards" for cardiac surgery in Pennsylvania provides an empirical setting to isolate the relative role of extrinsic and intrinsic incentives in determining surgeon response. Information on performance that was new to surgeons and unrelated to patient demand led to an intrinsic response four times larger than surgeon response to profit incentives.

10.3386/w18804.abstractZh: 如果利润最大化是企业的目标，那么关于质量的新信息应该仅通过其对市场需求的影响来影响企业的行为。我考虑了一个替代模型，在该模型中，供应商除了追求利润之外，还受到表现良好的动机驱动。宾夕法尼亚州心脏手术中引入质量“报告卡”提供了一个实证环境，以分离外在激励和内在激励在决定外科医生行为中的相对作用。对于外科医生来说，与患者需求无关的新绩效信息导致的内在反应是面对利润激励时外科医生反应的四倍。

abstract.text: We provide new evidence on the extent to which the demand for cigarettes is derived from the demand for weight control (i.e. weight loss or avoidance of weight gain). We utilize nationally representative data that provide the most direct evidence to date on this question: individuals are directly asked whether they smoke to control their weight. We find that, among teenagers who smoke frequently, 46% of girls and 30% of boys are smoking in part to control their weight. This practice is significantly more common among youths who describe themselves as too fat than those who describe themselves as about the right weight. The derived demand for cigarettes has important implications for tax policy. Under reasonable assumptions, the demand for cigarettes is less price elastic among those who smoke for weight control. Thus, taxes on cigarettes will result in less behavior change (but more revenue collection and less deadweight loss) among those for whom the demand for cigarettes is a derived demand. Public health efforts to reduce smoking initiation and encourage cessation may wish to design campaigns to alter the derived nature of cigarette demand, especially among adolescent girls.

10.3386/w18805.abstractZh: 我们提供了新的证据，表明对香烟的需求在多大程度上源于对体重控制的需求（即减肥或避免体重增加）。我们利用了具有全国代表性的数据，这些数据为这一问题提供了迄今为止最直接的证据：直接询问了人们是否为了控制体重而吸烟。研究发现，在经常吸烟的青少年中，46%的女孩和30%的男孩部分原因是为了控制体重而吸烟。这一行为在自认为过于肥胖的青少年中更为常见，而在自认为体重适中的青少年中则较少见。对香烟的需求这一衍生现象对税收政策具有重要意义。在合理的假设下，对于因体重控制而吸烟的人来说，香烟的需求价格弹性较低。因此，对香烟征税会导致行为改变较少（但收入增加且无谓损失减少），对于那些将香烟需求视为衍生需求的人来说尤其如此。公共卫生部门在减少吸烟行为和鼓励戒烟方面，可能需要设计一些活动来改变香烟需求的衍生性质，尤其是在青少年女孩中。

abstract.text: Parental involvement (PI) laws require that physicians notify or obtain consent from a parent(s) of a minor seeking an abortion before performing the procedure. Several studies suggest that PI laws curb risky sexual behavior because teens realize that they would be compelled to discuss a subsequent pregnancy with a parent. We show that prior evidence based on gonorrhea rates overlooked the frequent under-reporting of gonorrhea by race and ethnicity, and present new evidence on the effects of PI laws using more current data on the prevalence of gonorrhea and data that are novel to this literature (i.e., chlamydia rates and data disaggregated by year of age). We improve the credibility of our estimates over those in the existing literature using an event-study design in addition to standard difference-in-difference-in-differences (DDD) models. Our findings consistently suggest no association between PI laws and rates of sexually transmitted infections or measures of sexual behavior.

10.3386/w18810.abstractZh: 家长参与法律要求医生在为未成年人进行堕胎手术前，必须通知其家长或获得家长的同意。多项研究表明，家长参与法律能够抑制高风险性行为，因为青少年意识到如果不与家长讨论后续怀孕的问题，他们可能会面临法律约束。我们的研究指出，现有的基于淋病发病率的统计数据忽略了不同种族和族裔群体中对淋病的频繁漏报现象。我们基于更最新的淋病发病率数据，以及该领域的新数据（如衣原体感染率及按年龄分组的统计数据），提出了关于家长参与法律影响的新证据。通过使用事件研究设计，并结合标准的差异-差异-差异模型，我们提高了估计结果的可信度。我们的研究结果一致表明，家长参与法律与性传播感染率或性行为指标之间不存在关联。

abstract.text: This review discusses the role of consumer-directed and physician-directed promotion in the pharmaceutical market, based on the classic conceptual framework of whether such promotion is "persuasive" and/or "informative". Implications for public health and welfare partly depend on whether, and to what extent, advertising: 1) raises "selective" or brand-specific demand versus "primary" or industry-wide demand; 2) impacts drug costs; and 3) impacts competition. Empirical evidence from the literature bearing on these effects is surveyed. These studies show that pharmaceutical promotion has both informative and persuasive elements. Consumer advertising is more effective at enlarging the market, educating consumers, inducing physician contact, expanding drug treatment, and promoting adherence among existing users. Physician advertising is primarily persuasive in nature, effectively increasing selective brand demand. Evidence bearing on the effects of promotion on competition and prices is more limited. However, there is no strong evidence that drug promotion deters entry, and there is some suggestive evidence that it may even be mildly pro-competitive. With respect to costs, some studies suggests that consumer advertising may weakly raise the average wholesale price, which is a manufacturer's list price, but there is no strong indication that either consumer- or provider-directed promotion substantially raises retail-level prices. However, this is not to imply that potential promotion-driven substitution from non-advertised to advertised drugs cannot have effects on total drug costs. While most of these effects point to potential welfare improvements as a result of pharmaceutical promotion, there is also evidence that consumer ads may induce overuse and overtreatment in certain cases. Market expansion, overtreatment and shifting brands for non-therapeutic reasons further raise the concern of a sub-optimal patient-drug match at least for some marginal patients. A comprehensive evaluation of the welfare effects of pharmaceutical promotion requires a balanced assessment of these benefits and costs.

10.3386/w18830.abstractZh: 本综述探讨了在药品市场中，以消费者为导向和以医生为导向的推广活动所扮演的角色，基于是否这些推广活动具有“说服力”和/或“信息性”的经典概念框架。对公共卫生和福利的影响部分取决于广告是否以及在多大程度上：1）增加“选择性”或特定品牌的需求，而非“基础性”或全行业的需求；2）影响药品成本；3）影响竞争。本文回顾了相关文献中关于这些影响的实证证据。研究表明，药品推广既包含信息性元素，也包含说服力元素。消费者广告在扩大市场、教育消费者、促使医生接触、扩展药物治疗以及促进现有用户用药依从性方面更为有效。医生广告则主要具有说服力，能够有效增加特定品牌的需求。关于推广对竞争和价格影响的证据较为有限。然而，没有强有力的证据表明药品推广会阻止新进入者进入市场，甚至有部分证据表明它可能对竞争有轻微的正面影响。在成本方面，一些研究表明消费者广告可能会略微提高平均批发价格，即制造商的标价，但并没有强有力的证据表明以消费者或医生为导向的推广活动会显著提高零售价格。不过，这并不意味着没有广告的药品被推广后，替代广告药品对总体药品成本没有影响。虽然这些研究大多表明药品推广可能带来福利改善，但也有证据表明消费者广告在某些情况下可能导致过度使用和过度治疗。市场扩张、过度治疗以及出于非治疗目的的品牌更换，进一步引发了对于患者与药物匹配不佳的担忧，至少对于某些边缘患者而言是如此。对药品推广的福利效应进行全面评估时，需要平衡地考虑这些利弊。

abstract.text: The theory of cost-shifting posits that nonprofit hospitals respond to negative financial shocks by raising prices for privately insured patients. We examine how hospitals responded to the sharp reductions in their endowments caused by the 2008 stock market collapse. We find that the average hospital did not engage in cost-shifting, but average hospitals that likely have substantial market power did cost-shift. Investigating further how hospitals responded to the financial setback, we found no evidence of reductions in treatment costs. However, hospitals with large endowment losses delayed purchases of health information technology and curtailed the offering of unprofitable services.

10.3386/w18853.abstractZh: 成本转移理论指出，非营利医院在面对财务冲击时，会通过提高私人保险患者的费用来应对。我们研究了医院在2008年股市崩盘导致资金大幅减少时的应对方式。研究发现，大多数医院并未进行成本转移，但那些可能拥有较大市场势力的医院确实进行了成本转移。进一步调查医院对财务困境的应对情况，我们发现治疗成本并未降低。不过，资金损失较大的医院推迟了健康信息技术的采购，并减少了无利可图的服务提供。

abstract.text: While the link between physical activity and health has been studied, there are several limitations that persist in this literature relating to external and internal validity of the estimates, potential measurement error in self-reported weight and risk factors, failure to account for physical activity beyond exercise, and failure to separate the effects of exercise from other forms of physical activity. This study addresses these gaps and assesses plausibly causal effects of recreational exercise and other physical activity (including work-related activity) on the risk factors for heart disease, utilizing a population-based longitudinal dataset that contains objective information on key risk factors. We estimate fixed effects specifications that account for a host of unobservable confounding factors, and further estimate specifications with lagged outcome measures that allow us to bound plausibly causal effects under reasonable assumptions. There are four key patterns of results that emerge. First, the lagged effect of physical activity is almost always larger than the current effect. This suggests that current risk factors, not only obesity but also high blood pressure and heart rate, take years to develop, which underscores the importance of consistent physical activity to ward off heart disease. Second, we find that in general physical activity reduces risk factors for heart disease even after controlling, to some extent, for unobservable confounding influences. Third, not only recreational but work-related physical activity appears to protect against heart disease. Finally, there is evidence of a dose-response relationship such that higher levels of recreational exercise and other physical activity have a greater protective effect. Our estimates of the contemporaneous and durable effects suggest that the observed declines in high levels of recreational exercise and other physical activity can potentially account for between 12-30% of the increase in obesity, hypertension, diabetes, and heart disease observed over the sample period, ceteris paribus.

10.3386/w18858.abstractZh: 虽然关于体力活动与健康之间的关联已经进行了研究，但相关文献仍存在若干局限性，包括估计值的外部效度和内部效度、自我报告的体重和风险因素的潜在测量误差、未能考虑除运动之外的体力活动，以及未能将运动对其他形式体力活动的效果进行区分。本研究旨在弥补这些不足，并利用包含关键风险因素客观信息的基于人群的纵向数据集，评估休闲运动及其他体力活动（包括与工作相关的活动）对心脏病风险因素的潜在因果效应。我们采用了固定效应模型来考虑大量不可观测的混杂因素，并进一步采用了滞后结果度量方法，以便在合理的假设下界定潜在的因果效应。研究得出四个主要结论：首先，体力活动的滞后效应几乎总是大于当前效应，这表明不仅肥胖，还有高血压和心率等风险因素需要多年才能形成，这强调了持续进行体力活动对预防心脏病的重要性。其次，我们发现即使在控制了部分不可观测的混杂因素后，体力活动仍然能够降低心脏病的风险因素。第三，不仅休闲运动，与工作相关的体力活动也能起到预防心脏病的作用。最后，存在剂量-反应关系，即休闲运动及其他体力活动的水平越高，其保护作用越强。我们对同时期和长期影响的估计表明，观察到的高强度的休闲运动和其他体力活动水平的下降，可能解释了样本期间肥胖、高血压、糖尿病和心脏病发病率上升的12-30%。其他条件不变的情况下。

abstract.text: The purpose of this paper is to help empirical economists think through when and how to weight the data used in estimation. We start by distinguishing two purposes of estimation: to estimate population descriptive statistics and to estimate causal effects. In the former type of research, weighting is called for when it is needed to make the analysis sample representative of the target population. In the latter type, the weighting issue is more nuanced. We discuss three distinct potential motives for weighting when estimating causal effects: (1) to achieve precise estimates by correcting for heteroskedasticity, (2) to achieve consistent estimates by correcting for endogenous sampling, and (3) to identify average partial effects in the presence of unmodeled heterogeneity of effects. In each case, we find that the motive sometimes does not apply in situations where practitioners often assume it does. We recommend diagnostics for assessing the advisability of weighting, and we suggest methods for appropriate inference.

10.3386/w18859.abstractZh: 本文的目的是帮助实证经济学家思考在何时以及如何对用于估计的数据进行加权。我们首先区分了估计的两种目的：一是估计人口描述性统计，二是估计因果效应。在前者类型的研究中，当需要使样本能够代表目标人群时，就需要进行加权处理。而在后者类型的研究中，加权问题则更为复杂。我们讨论了在估计因果效应时可能使用的三种加权动机：(1)通过校正异方差性来实现精确的估计；(2)通过校正内生抽样来实现一致的估计；(3)在存在未建模的效应异质性时识别平均部分效应。我们发现，在某些情况下，这些动机并不适用，而实践者往往假设它们适用。我们推荐了用于评估加权必要性的诊断方法，并提出了适当的推断方法。

abstract.text: We argue that in pharmaceutical markets, variation in the arrival time of consumer heterogeneity creates differences between a producer's ability to extract consumer surplus with preventives and treatments, potentially distorting R&D decisions. If consumers vary only in disease risk, revenue from treatments--sold after the disease is contracted, when disease risk is no longer a source of private information--always exceeds revenue from preventives. The revenue ratio can be arbitrarily high for sufficiently skewed distributions of disease risk. Under some circumstances, heterogeneity in harm from a disease, learned after a disease is contracted, can lead revenue from a treatment to exceed revenue from a preventative. Calibrations suggest that skewness in the U.S. distribution of HIV risk would lead firms to earn only half the revenue from a vaccine as from a drug. Empirical tests are consistent with the predictions of the model that vaccines are less likely to be developed for diseases with substantial disease-risk heterogeneity.

10.3386/w18862.abstractZh: 我们认为，在制药市场中，消费者异质性的到达时间差异会导致生产商通过预防和治疗措施获取消费者剩余的能力产生差异，从而可能扭曲研发决策。如果消费者的差异仅体现在疾病风险上，那么治疗带来的收入——在疾病发生之后出售，此时疾病风险已不再是私人信息的来源——总是高于预防带来的收入。在疾病风险分布足够偏斜的情况下，这种收入比例可以非常高。在某些情况下，疾病发生后对疾病的危害差异可能导致治疗带来的收入超过预防带来的收入。校准结果表明，美国HIV风险分布的偏斜会导致企业从疫苗中获得的收入仅为从药物中获得的收入的一半。实证结果与模型的预测一致，即对于疾病风险差异较大的疾病，疫苗的开发可能性较低。

abstract.text: This paper is the first to estimate the impact of exposure to deceptive advertising on consumption of the advertised product and its substitutes. We study the market for over-the-counter (OTC) weight-loss products, a market in which deceptive advertising is rampant and products are generally ineffective with potentially serious side effects. We control for the targeting of ads using indicator variables for each unique magazine read and television show watched. Our estimates indicate that exposure to deceptive advertising is associated with a lower probability that women, and a higher probability that men, consume OTC weight loss products. We find evidence of spillovers; exposure to deceptive print ads is associated with a higher probability of dieting and exercising for both men and women. We also find evidence that better-educated individuals are more sophisticated consumers of advertising and use it to make more health-promoting decisions.

10.3386/w18863.abstractZh: 本文首次估计了接触误导性广告对广告产品及其替代品消费的影响。我们研究了非处方药减肥产品市场，这个市场上误导性广告泛滥，且这些产品通常无效，还可能带来严重的副作用。我们通过使用每个阅读过的杂志和观看过的电视节目的指示变量来控制广告的针对性。我们的估计表明，接触误导性广告会降低女性消费非处方药减肥产品的可能性，而男性则会增加这种可能性。我们还发现了溢出效应的证据；接触误导性印刷广告会增加男性和女性节食和锻炼的可能性。此外，我们还发现受教育程度较高的个体是更精明的广告消费者，他们会利用广告来做出更有益健康的决策。

abstract.text: Using longitudinal data for 1968-2009 for male household heads, we determine the prevalence of pre- retirement age disability and its association with a wide range of outcomes, including earnings, income, and consumption. We then employ some of these quantities in the optimal social insurance framework of Chetty (2006) to study current compensation for the disabled. Six of our findings stand out. First, disability rates are high. We divide the disabled along two dimensions based on the persistence and severity of their work-limiting condition. We estimate that a person reaching age 50 has a 36 percent chance of having been disabled at least temporarily once during his working years, and a 9 percent chance that he has begun a chronic and severe disability. Second, the economic consequences of disability are frequently profound. Ten years after disability onset, a person with a chronic and severe disability on average experiences a 79 percent decline in earnings, a 35 percent decline in after-tax income, a 24 percent decline in food and housing consumption and a 22 percent decline in food consumption. Third, economic circumstances differ sharply across disability groups. The outcome decline for the chronically and severely disabled is often more than twice as large as that for the average disabled head. Fourth, our findings show the partial and incomplete roles that individual savings, family support and social insurance play in reducing the consumption drop that follows disability. Fifth, time use and detailed consumption data further indicate that disability is associated with a decline in well-being. Sixth, using the quantities we have estimated, we provide the range of behavioral elasticities and preference parameters consistent with current disability compensation being optimal within the Chetty framework.

10.3386/w18869.abstractZh: 我们利用1968-2009年的纵向数据，针对男性户主进行了研究，探讨了退休前残疾的普遍情况及其与多种结果之间的关联，包括收入、收入和消费。随后，我们在Chetty（2006）的最优社会保险框架中运用这些数据，来研究当前对残疾人的补偿情况。我们的研究发现有六个值得注意之处。首先，残疾率很高。我们根据残疾状况的持续时间和严重程度，将残疾者分为两类。我们估计，一个50岁的人至少有36%的可能性在职业生涯中经历过一次暂时性残疾，而9%的可能性会面临长期且严重的残疾。其次，残疾带来的经济后果往往非常严重。在残疾发生后的十年内，患有长期且严重残疾的人平均收入下降79%，税后收入下降35%，食品与住房消费下降24%，食品消费下降22%。第三，不同残疾群体的经济状况差异显著。长期且严重残疾者的收入下降幅度通常是普通残疾户主的两倍以上。第四，我们的研究结果表明，个人储蓄、家庭支持和社会保险在减少残疾后的消费下降方面发挥着部分且不完全的作用。第五，时间使用情况和详细消费数据进一步表明，残疾与福祉的下降有关。第六，利用我们估算出的数据，我们得出了与当前残疾补偿最优性相一致的偏好参数和弹性范围。

abstract.text: We estimate a bargaining model of competition between hospitals and managed care organizations (MCOs) and use the estimates to evaluate the effects of hospital mergers. We find that MCO bargaining restrains hospital prices significantly. The model demonstrates the potential impact of coinsurance rates, which allow MCOs to partly steer patients towards cheaper hospitals. We show that increasing patient coinsurance tenfold would reduce prices by 16%.
