We find that a proposed hospital acquisition in Northern Virginia that was challenged by the Federal Trade Commission would have significantly raised hospital prices. Remedies based on separate bargaining do not alleviate the price increases.

10.3386/w18875.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个关于医院与管理式护理组织之间竞争的讨价还价模型，并利用这些估计结果来评估医院合并的影响。研究发现，管理式护理组织的讨价还价行为显著限制了医院的价格。该模型还展示了共保率的潜在影响，这种机制使得管理式护理组织能够部分引导患者选择价格更低的医院。我们指出，将患者的共保率提高十倍，价格将降低16%。此外，我们发现，联邦贸易委员会对北弗吉尼亚地区一项拟议的医院收购案提出了质疑，该收购案可能会导致医院价格显著上涨。基于单独讨价还价行为的解决方案并不能缓解价格上升的问题。

abstract.text: This paper provides estimates of the effects of in utero exposure to contaminated drinking water on fetal health. We examine the universe of birth records and drinking water testing results for the state of New Jersey from 1997 to 2007. Our data enable us to compare outcomes across siblings who were potentially exposed to differing levels of harmful contaminants from drinking water while in utero. We find small effects of drinking water contamination on all children, but large and statistically significant effects on birth weight and gestation of infants born to less educated mothers. We also show that those mothers who were most affected by contaminants were the least likely to move between births in response to contamination.

10.3386/w18876.abstractZh: 本文对子宫内接触受污染饮用水对胎儿健康的影响进行了估算。我们研究了1997年至2007年间新泽西州的出生记录及饮用水检测结果。我们的数据使我们能够比较那些在子宫内可能接触到不同水平有害污染物的兄弟姐妹的结局。我们发现，饮用水污染对所有儿童的影响较小，但对受教育程度较低的母亲所生的婴儿的出生体重和妊娠时间则产生了较大且显著的负面影响。此外，我们还发现，那些受到污染物影响最严重的母亲，在因污染而更换生育计划时，出现这种情况的可能性最低。

abstract.text: We investigate the effects of broad-based work incentives on female crime by exploiting the welfare reform legislation of the 1990s, which dramatically increased employment among women at risk for relying on cash assistance. We find that welfare reform decreased female property crime arrests by 4-5%, but did not affect other types of crimes. The effects appear to be stronger in states with lower welfare benefits and higher earnings disregards, and in states with larger caseload declines. The findings point to broad-based work incentives--and, by inference, employment--as a key determinant of female property crime.

10.3386/w18887.abstractZh: 我们通过研究1990年代的福利改革立法，来探讨广泛的工作激励措施对女性犯罪的影响。该立法显著增加了那些依赖现金援助的女性的就业机会。研究发现，福利改革使女性财产犯罪的逮捕率下降了4-5%，但并未影响其他类型的犯罪。在福利补贴较低、收入忽视程度较高的州，以及案件数量下降较大的州，这种影响更为明显。这些发现表明，广泛的工作激励措施——以及由此带来的就业机会——是控制女性财产犯罪的关键因素。

abstract.text: This paper seeks to understand the impact of the Medicare Rural Hospital Flexibility (Flex) Program on hospital choice and consumer welfare for rural residents. The Flex Program created a new class of hospital, the Critical Access Hospital (CAH), which receives more generous Medicare reimbursements in return for limits on capacity and length of stay. We find that conversion to CAH status resulted in a 4.7 percent drop in inpatient admissions to participating hospitals, almost all of which was driven by factors other than capacity constraints. The Flex Program increased consumer welfare if it prevented the exit of at least 6.5 percent of randomly selected converting hospitals.

10.3386/w18894.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨《医疗保险农村医院灵活性计划》对农村居民医院选择及消费者福利的影响。该计划催生了一种新的医院类型——关键接入医院，这类医院在获得更优的医疗保险报销待遇的同时，需限制医院规模和住院时间。研究发现，转为关键接入医院后，参与医院的住院人数减少了4.7%，而这一减少几乎完全是由其他因素而非医院规模限制所导致。如果该计划能够阻止至少6.5%的转制医院退出，那么其对消费者福利的提升将是显著的。

abstract.text: Census's Supplemental Poverty Measure (SPM) nearly doubles the elderly poverty rate compared to the "Official" Poverty Measure (OPM), a result of the SPM subtraction of medical out-of-pocket (MOOP) expenditures from income. Neither the SPM nor OPM counts health benefits or assets as resources. Validation studies suggest that subtracting MOOP from resources worsens a poverty measure's predictive validity and excluding assets exacerbates this bias, since assets fund MOOP. The SPM is based on a 1995 NAS report that recommended a health-exclusive poverty measure, despite considering it, conceptually, a "second best" to a Health-Inclusive Poverty Measure (HIPM). We analyze the reasons for the NAS recommendation and argue that constructing a HIPM is now feasible if we conceptualize health needs as a need for health insurance, and if plans with non-risk-rated premiums and caps on MOOP are universally available, a condition largely met by the Affordable Care Act and Medicare Advantage Plans. We describe four HIPM variants and present analyses that suggest the SPM treatment of MOOP results in a less valid measure of elderly poverty and an overstatement of the elderly poverty rate (by up to 5.5 percentage points or 50 percent). Many elderly classified as poor by the SPM's unlimited MOOP deduction are not poorly insured persons with incomes near the poverty line, but well-insured persons with incomes well above the poverty line.

10.3386/w18900.abstractZh: 人口普查的补充贫困指标（SPM）显示的老年人贫困率几乎是“官方贫困指标”（OPM）的两倍。这一结果是由于SPM在收入中扣除了医疗自付费用（MOOP）。无论是SPM还是OPM都不将健康福利或资产计入资源。验证研究表明，从资源中扣除MOOP会降低贫困指标的预测有效性，而排除资产则会加剧这种偏差，因为资产本身就是用于支付MOOP的。SPM基于1995年NAS的一份报告，该报告建议采用仅关注健康的贫困指标，尽管从概念上讲，这被认为是“次优”的选择，因为健康包容型贫困指标（HIPM）更为理想。我们分析了NAS提出这一建议的原因，并认为，如果我们将健康需求视为对健康保险的需求，并且如果具有非风险评级保费和MOOP上限的保险计划普遍可用——这两个条件在很大程度上已经通过《平价医疗法案》和Medicare Advantage计划得到了满足——那么构建HIPM现在是可行的。我们描述了四种HIPM的变体，并提出了分析结果表明，SPM对MOOP的处理方式会导致贫困指标的预测有效性降低，并且高估了老年人贫困率（高达5.5个百分点或50%）。许多被SPM认定为贫困的老年人，其实并非是保险状况不佳、收入接近贫困线的个体，而是保险状况良好、收入远高于贫困线的个体。

abstract.text: We examine how the articulation of government policy affects behavior. Our experiment compares a government mandate to purchase health insurance to a financially equivalent tax on the uninsured. Participants report their probability of purchasing health insurance under one of the two articulations of the policy. The experiment was conducted in four waves, from December 2011 to November 2012. We document the controversy over the Affordable Care Act's insurance mandate provision that changed the political discourse during the year. Pre-controversy, articulating the policy as a mandate, rather than a financially equivalent tax, increased probability of insurance purchase by 10.6 percentage points -- an effect comparable to a $1000 decrease in annual premiums. After the controversy, the mandate is no more effective than the tax. Our results show that how a policy is articulated affects behavior and that persuasion and public opinion management can help achieve policy objectives at lower cost.

10.3386/w18913.abstractZh: 我们研究了政府政策的表述方式如何影响人们的行为。我们的实验将政府强制购买健康保险的政策与财政上等效的对未投保者的征税措施进行了比较。参与者报告了在两种政策表述下购买健康保险的概率。实验分四轮进行，时间从2011年12月持续到2012年11月。我们发现，关于《平价医疗法案》中强制购买保险条款的争议在当年改变了政治话语。在争议之前，将政策表述为强制措施而非财政上等效的征税措施，使购买保险的概率增加了10.6个百分点——这一效果相当于每年保费减少1000美元。争议之后，强制措施的效果并不比征税措施更好。我们的研究结果表明，政策的表述方式确实会影响人们的行为，而说服和舆论管理可以帮助以更低的成本实现政策目标。

abstract.text: Regulatory entry barriers to hospital service markets, namely Certificate of Need (CON) regulations, are enforced in many states; although no longer federally mandated, policy makers in other states are considering reinstating CON policies in tandem with service expansions mandated under the Affordable Care Act. While numerous studies have examined the impacts of CON on hospital volumes, demand responses to actual hospital entry into local hospital markets are not well understood. In this paper, we empirically examine the demand-augmenting, demand-redistribution, and risk-allocation effects of hospital entry by studying the cardiac revascularization markets in Pennsylvania, a state in which dynamic market entry occurred after repeal of CON in 1996. Our findings with respect to demand-augmentation are mixed: we find robust evidence that high entrant market share mitigated the declining incidence of coronary artery bypass graft (CABG), but it had no significant effect on the rising trend in percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) procedures, among patients with coronary artery disease. Consequently, incumbent hospitals experienced a decrease in the likelihood of PCI due to entry, thereby indicating a shift in demand away from incumbents to entrants, namely business-stealing. Results of our analyses further indicate that entry by new cardiac surgery centers tended to sort high-severity patients into the more invasive CABG procedure and low-severity patients into the less invasive PCI procedures. Thus, from a welfare perspective our results are mixed: on the one hand, free-entry may lead to improved access rather than business stealing for CABG procedures; on the other hand, the empirical evidence is in favor of business-stealing for PCI procedures. Moreover, free-entry improves the match between underlying medical risk and treatment intensity. These findings underscore the importance of considering market-level strategic responses by hospitals when regulatory barriers to entry are rescinded.

10.3386/w18926.abstractZh: 许多州都实施着对医院服务市场的监管性进入壁垒，即需求认证制度。虽然这一制度已不再由联邦政府强制实施，但其他州的政策制定者正在考虑在《平价医疗法案》所要求的服务扩展政策中重新引入需求认证制度。尽管已有许多研究探讨了需求认证制度对医院数量的影响，但人们对实际医院进入当地医院市场的需求反应了解甚少。在本文中，我们通过研究宾夕法尼亚州的心脏血管重建市场来实证研究医院进入对需求提升、需求重新分配和风险分配的影响。该州在1996年废除需求认证制度后，市场出现了动态进入现象。关于需求提升的研究结果并不一致：我们发现，高比例的新进入者市场份额确实减缓了冠状动脉旁路移植术的减少趋势，但对冠状动脉疾病患者的经皮冠状动脉介入治疗数量上升趋势没有显著影响。因此，现有医院因新进入者的出现而减少了进行经皮冠状动脉介入治疗的几率，这表明需求从现有医院转向新进入者，即所谓的“商业掠夺”。我们的分析还表明，新的心脏外科中心进入市场时，倾向于将高严重程度的患者安排进行更具侵入性的冠状动脉旁路移植术，而将低严重程度的患者安排进行较不侵入性的经皮冠状动脉介入治疗。因此，从福利角度来看，我们的研究结果并不一致：一方面，自由进入可能有助于改善冠状动脉旁路移植术的获取机会，而不是导致商业掠夺；另一方面，实证证据支持经皮冠状动脉介入治疗存在商业掠夺现象。此外，免费进入机制有助于改善基础医疗风险与治疗强度之间的匹配。这些发现强调了在取消进入壁垒时，考虑医院在市场层面的战略反应的重要性。

abstract.text: This chapter surveys experience with performance pay in developing country health programs. In doing so, it focuses on four key conceptual issues: (1) What to reward, (2) Who to reward, (3) How to reward, and (4) What unintended consequences might performance incentives create. We highlight that the use of performance pay has outpaced growth in corresponding empirical evidence. Moreover, very little research on performance incentives focuses on the underlying conceptual issues that we outline. We consider these to be important constraints to the design of better performance incentives in low- and middle-income country health programs.

10.3386/w18932.abstractZh: 本章回顾了在发展中国家卫生项目中实施绩效薪酬的经验。在研究中，重点关注四个关键概念问题：(1) 应奖励什么，(2) 应奖励谁，(3) 如何奖励，以及(4) 绩效激励可能带来的意外后果。我们发现，关于绩效薪酬的研究与相应实证证据的增长速度相比，发展速度更快。此外，关于绩效激励的研究中，很少关注我们提到的那些基本概念问题。我们认为，这些问题是设计更有效的绩效激励措施时的重要制约因素，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家的卫生项目中。

abstract.text: In this review, we discuss three major contributions economists have made to our understanding of the relationship between the environment and individual well-being. First, in explicitly recognizing how optimizing behavior, particularly in the form of residential sorting, can lead to non-random assignment of pollution, economists have employed a wide range of quasi-experimental techniques to develop causal estimates of the effect of pollution. Second, economic research has placed a considerable focus on the role of avoidance behavior, which is an important component for understanding the difference between biological and behavioral effects of pollution and for proper welfare calculations. Lastly, economic research has expanded the focus of analysis beyond traditional health outcomes to include measures of human capital, including labor supply, productivity, and cognition. Our review of the quasi-experimental evidence on this topic suggests that pollution does indeed have a wide range of effects on individual well-being, even at levels well below current regulatory standards. Given the importance of health and human capital as an engine for economic growth, these findings underscore the role of environmental conditions as an important factor of production.

10.3386/w18935.abstractZh: 在这篇综述中，我们讨论了经济学家在理解环境与个人福祉之间的关系方面所做的三项重要贡献。首先，经济学家明确认识到，优化行为，尤其是通过住宅排序来实现的行为，可以导致污染的非随机分配。为此，他们采用了多种准实验技术来推导污染影响的因果估计。其次，经济研究重点关注回避行为的作用，这是理解污染对生物效应与行为效应的区别以及进行正确福利计算的重要方面。最后，经济研究将分析范围从传统的健康结果扩展到包括人力资本指标，如劳动力供应、生产力和认知能力。我们对这一主题的准实验证据的回顾表明，污染确实会对个人福祉产生广泛影响，即使是在远低于当前监管标准的水平下也是如此。鉴于健康与人力资本作为经济增长引擎的重要性，这些发现强调了环境条件作为重要生产要素的作用。

abstract.text: Many employers have implemented dependent verification (DV) programs, which aim to reduce employee benefits costs by ensuring that ineligible persons are not enrolled in their health plan as dependents. We evaluate a DV program using a panel of health plan enrollment data from a large, single-site employer. We find that dependents were 2.7 percentage points less likely to be reenrolled in the year that DV was introduced, indicating that this fraction of dependents was ineligibly enrolled prior to the program's introduction. We show that these dependents were actually ineligible, rather than merely discouraged from re-enrollment by compliance costs.

10.3386/w18947.abstractZh: 许多雇主实施了依赖关系验证（DV）计划，其目的是通过确保不符合条件的人员不会作为家属加入健康保险计划来降低员工福利成本。我们采用来自一家大型单一地点雇主的健康保险计划注册数据，对DV计划进行了评估。研究发现，在DV计划实施的那一年，家属重新注册的可能性降低了2.7个百分点，这表明这些家属在计划实施前就已经不符合注册条件。我们进一步表明，这些家属实际上是不符合注册条件的，而不仅仅是因合规成本而放弃了重新注册的机会。

abstract.text: Informal care is the largest source of long-term care for elderly, surpassing home health care and nursing home care. By definition, informal care is unpaid. It remains a puzzle why so many adult children give freely of their time. Transfers of time to the older generation may be balanced by financial transfers going to the younger generation. This leads to the question of whether informal care and inter-vivos transfers are causally related. We analyze data from the 1999 and 2003 waves of National Longitudinal Survey of Mature Women. We examine whether the elderly parents give more inter-vivos monetary transfers to adult children who provide informal care, by examining both the extensive and intensive margins of financial transfers and of informal care. We find statistically significant results that a child who provides informal care is more likely to receive inter-vivos transfers than a sibling who does not. If a child does provide care, there is no statistically significant effect on the amount of the transfer.

10.3386/w18948.abstractZh: 非正式照顾是老年人长期照顾的最大来源，其规模超过了家庭护理和养老院护理。从定义上讲，非正式照顾是无偿的。为什么许多成年子女愿意无偿付出时间，这仍然是一个谜题。向老年一代的时间转移可能通过向年轻一代的财务转移来平衡。这就引出了一个问题：非正式照顾与代际间财务转移之间是否存在因果关系。我们分析了1999年和2003年《全国成熟女性纵向调查》的数据。我们研究了老年父母是否会向提供非正式照顾的成年子女进行更多的代际间财务转移，通过考察财务转移和非正式照顾的广泛和密集程度来进行分析。我们发现，有统计学上显著的结果表明，提供非正式照顾的孩子比不提供照顾的兄弟姐妹更有可能收到代际间财务转移。如果孩子确实提供了照顾，那么转移金额方面则没有统计学上的显著影响。

abstract.text: Prior research demonstrates that mortality rates increase during economic booms and decrease during economic busts, but little analysis has been conducted investigating the role of environmental risks as potential mechanisms for this relationship. We investigate the contribution of air pollution to the procyclicality of deaths by combining state-level data on overall, cause-specific, and age-specific mortality rates with state-level measures of ambient concentrations of three types of pollutants and the unemployment rate. After controlling for demographic variables and state and year fixed-effects, we find a significant positive correlation between carbon monoxide (CO) concentrations and mortality rates. Controlling for CO, particulate matter (PM10), and ozone (O3) attenuates the relationship between overall mortality and the unemployment rate by 30 percent. The attenuation is particularly large, although imprecisely measured, for fatalities from respiratory diseases and is frequently substantial for age groups unlikely to be involved in the labor market. Our results are consistent with those of other studies in the economics and public health literatures measuring the mortality effects of air pollution.

10.3386/w18959.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，经济繁荣时期死亡率会上升，经济衰退时期死亡率会下降，但很少有研究探讨环境风险作为这种关系潜在机制的作用。我们通过结合各州总体、特定原因和特定年龄的死亡率数据，以及各州三种污染物的环境浓度和失业率数据，来研究空气污染对死亡趋势的顺周期性影响。在控制人口统计变量以及州和年份固定效应后，我们发现一氧化碳浓度与死亡率之间存在显著的正相关性。在控制一氧化碳、颗粒物（PM10）和臭氧（O3）的影响后，总体死亡率与失业率之间的关系减弱了30%。这种减弱在呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡中尤为明显，且对于不太可能参与劳动力市场的年龄组来说更为显著。我们的结果与经济学和公共卫生领域其他研究的结果一致，这些研究也测量了空气污染对死亡率的影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether an intra-household externality prevents adoption of a technology with substantial implications for population health and the environment: improved cookstoves. Motivated by a model of intra-household decision-making, the experiment markets stoves to husbands or wives in turn at randomly varying prices. We find that women - who bear disproportionate cooking costs - have stronger preference for healthier stoves, but lack the authority to make purchases. Our findings suggest that if women cannot make independent choices about household resource use, public policy may not be able to exploit gender differences in preferences to promote technology adoption absent broader social change.

10.3386/w18964.abstractZh: 本文探讨了家庭内部外部性是否阻碍了具有重大人口健康和环境影响的技术的采用——即改良型炉灶。基于家庭内部决策模型，实验以随机变化的价格向丈夫或妻子轮流出售炉灶。研究发现，承担不成比例烹饪成本的女性更倾向于选择更健康的炉灶，但她们缺乏购买决策的权力。我们的研究结果表明，如果女性无法独立决定家庭资源的使用方式，那么公共政策可能无法利用性别偏好差异来促进技术采用，除非有更广泛的社会变革。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of energy production on newborn health using a recent strike that affected oil refineries in France as a natural experiment. First, we show that the temporary reduction in refining lead to a significant reduction in sulfur dioxide (SO2) concentrations. Second, this shock significantly increased birth weight and gestational age of newborns, particularly for those exposed to the strike during the third trimester of pregnancy. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that a 1 unit decline in SO2 leads to a 196 million euro increase in lifetime earnings per birth cohort. This externality from oil refineries should be an important part of policy discussions surrounding the production of energy.

10.3386/w18974.abstractZh: 本文以法国炼油厂遭遇的近期罢工作为自然实验，研究能源生产对新生儿健康的影响。首先，我们发现炼油活动的暂时减少导致二氧化硫浓度显著下降。其次，这一冲击显著增加了新生儿的出生体重和妊娠年龄，尤其是在妊娠第三期的孕妇中。初步计算表明，二氧化硫浓度每下降1单位，每个出生群体的终身收入将增加1.96亿欧元。来自炼油厂的这种外部性应成为能源生产相关政策讨论的重要议题。

abstract.text: Expert performance is often evaluated in a one dimensional way by assuming that good experts have good outcomes. We examine the example of expertise in medicine and develop a model that allows for two dimensions of physician performance: Procedural decision making and skill performing procedures. Higher procedural skill increases the use of intensive procedures across the board, while better decision making results in fewer intensive procedures for the low risk, but more for the high risk. Deriving empirical analogues to our theoretical measures for the case of C-section, we show that poor diagnosticians can be identified using administrative data and that improving decision making would reduce C-section rates by 15.5% in the bottom half of the risk distribution, and increase them by 5.5% in the top half. Because there are many more C-sections in the high risk, these numbers imply that the overall rate of C-section is too low rather than too high and that reallocating C-sections from low risk to high risk women could improve health outcomes among mothers and babies. Our results suggest that focusing on the choices of experts as well as the outcomes achieved could contribute to evaluating expert performance in other settings.

10.3386/w18977.abstractZh: 专家的表现通常是通过一维方式来评估的，即假设优秀的专家会取得良好的结果。我们以医学领域的专业知识为例，开发了一个模型，该模型能够同时考虑医生表现的两个维度：程序决策能力和操作技巧。较高的操作技巧会促使更多使用复杂手术，而更好的决策能力则会使低风险群体的复杂手术次数减少，而高风险群体的复杂手术次数增加。通过对剖宫产手术案例的理论测量进行实证分析，我们发现可以通过行政数据识别出诊断能力较差的医生，并且改善决策能力可以将高风险群体的剖宫产手术率降低15.5%，而在低风险群体的剖宫产手术率则增加5.5%。由于高风险群体的剖宫产手术次数更多，这些数字表明整体剖宫产手术率可能偏低，而不是过高。将剖宫产手术从低风险群体重新分配到高风险群体，可能会改善母亲和婴儿的健康状况。我们的研究结果表明，除了关注专家的选择以及所取得的成果之外，还有其他方式可以用来评估专家的表现。

abstract.text: This note considers a relatively new form of financing for social services, the "Social Impact Bond." Proponents of Social Impact Bonds argue that they present a solution to several problems in funding social services, including performance measurement and the distribution of risk. Using a simple model, we demonstrate that Social Impact Bonds have many features present in standard financing arrangements. They will lead to greater program success when investors' effort can positively influence outcomes, but are unlikely to do so otherwise. We conclude that the value of this funding innovation will be strongly context-dependent.

10.3386/w18991.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一种相对较新的社会服务融资方式——“社会影响债券”。社会影响债券的倡导者认为，这种融资方式能够解决社会服务资金筹措中的多个问题，包括绩效评估与风险分配等。通过一个简单的模型，我们证明了社会影响债券具有许多标准融资方式所不具备的特点。当投资者的努力能够积极影响项目成果时，社会影响债券将带来更大的项目成功机会，但在其他情况下则不太可能如此。我们得出结论，这种融资创新的价值将严重依赖于具体情境。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of labor market conditions—measured through unemployment, mass layoffs and predicted employment—on child abuse and neglect using county-level data from California. Using these indicators we separately estimate the effects of overall and gender-specific economic shocks. We find only modest evidence of a link between overall economic conditions and child maltreatment. However, analysis by gender reveals robust evidence that maltreatment decreases with indicators for male employment and increases with indicators for female employment. These opposite-signed effects are consistent with a theoretical framework that builds on family-time-use models and is supported by analysis of time-use data.

10.3386/w18994.abstractZh: 本文通过加利福尼亚州的县级数据，研究了劳动力市场状况——通过失业率、大规模裁员和预测就业情况来衡量——对儿童虐待和忽视的影响。利用这些指标，我们分别评估了整体经济冲击和性别特定的经济冲击的影响。我们发现，整体经济状况与儿童虐待之间存在较为有限的关联。然而，按性别分析后发现，男性就业指标下降时，儿童虐待现象减少；而女性就业指标上升时，儿童虐待现象增加。这些相反的符号效应与基于家庭时间使用模型的理论框架一致，并且得到了时间使用数据分析的支持。

abstract.text: In this paper we examine how an education policy intervention - the introduction of a comprehensive school in Sweden that increased the number of compulsory years of schooling, affected cognitive and non-cognitive skills and long-term health. We use detailed administrative data combined with survey information to create a data set with background information, child ability and long-term adult outcomes. We show that extra education results in significant gains in skills among children, but the effects on long-term health are overall negligible. However, we demonstrate that the schooling reform had heterogeneous effects across family socio-economic backgrounds and initial skill endowments, with significant improvements in cognition and skills for lower Socio-economic status individuals and lower ability people.

10.3386/w19002.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了瑞典一项教育政策干预措施——引入综合学校制度，该制度增加了义务教育年限，这一举措对儿童的认知与非认知技能以及长期健康产生了影响。我们结合详细的行政数据与调查信息，构建了一个包含背景信息、儿童能力及长期成人结果的数据集。研究表明，额外的教育确实提升了儿童的技能水平，但对长期健康的影响则微乎其微。不过，我们指出，这一教育改革在不同家庭社会经济背景和初始技能水平的人群中产生了不同的效果，对于较低社会经济地位的个人和技能较低的人群来说，认知与技能方面取得了显著的改善。

abstract.text: We review and extend the economic analysis of risk and uncertainty as it relates to behavior mitigating health shocks. We summarize some central aspects of the vast positive and normative literature on the role of various forms of insurance that attempt to smooth consumption, which can be uneven due to medical spending induced by health shocks. Much of this literature has been concerned with the barriers that prevent full insurance and the role of the government eliminating their adverse consequences. We argue that this large literature is limited in that it is focused largely on consumption smoothing rather than smoothing of health itself. However, a problem with insuring health itself is that human capital cannot be traded; a person diagnosed with an incurable cancer cannot be made whole through reallocation of someone else's health. This lack of tradability in human capital implies that pooling of health risks, through private or public insurance, is infeasible except in rare instances such as transplantations. We argue that medical innovation can be interpreted as an insurance mechanism for a population's health. By enabling treatment of a harmful disease, it completes the previously incomplete market for risk-sharing in health by pooling the health care spending risk. In a sense, medical innovation involves a current certain R&D payment for a reduced future price of health, which is directly comparable to traditional health care insurance where a current premium is paid for a future reduced price of health care. We explore the positive and normative implications of this "health insurance" view of medical R&D and stress the ex ante value of new medical innovations, sometimes for patients that may never even use them. Given the potentially large value of smoothing health itself rather than consumption, we argue that more explicit analysis is needed on the relative value of public programs stimulating medical innovation versus health care reforms largely aimed at enabling consumption-smoothing.

10.3386/w19005.abstractZh: 我们回顾并扩展了关于风险与不确定性对行为缓解健康冲击影响的经济学分析。我们总结了大量关于各种形式保险在平滑消费方面的作用的积极文献和规范性文献的核心内容，这些消费因健康冲击而可能出现波动。这些文献大多关注于阻碍全面保险实现的障碍，以及政府消除这些障碍带来的负面影响。我们认为，这些文献的局限性在于它们主要关注消费平滑，而非健康本身的平滑。然而，为健康本身提供保险存在一个问题，即人力资本无法被交易；一个被诊断出患有不治之症的个体无法通过重新分配他人的健康来恢复健康。这种人力资本不可交易性意味着，除非在罕见情况下如器官移植，否则通过私人或公共保险来汇集健康风险是不可行的。我们认为，医学创新可以被视为一种为人群健康提供保险的机制。通过治疗有害疾病，它弥补了之前在健康风险分担市场中的空白，从而汇集了医疗支出的风险。从某种意义上说，医学创新涉及当前一定的研发投入，以换取未来较低的医疗成本，这与传统的健康保险类似，即当前支付保费以换取未来较低的医疗成本。我们探讨了这种“健康保险”观点对医学研发的积极和规范性影响，并强调了新医学创新的前瞻性价值，即使这些创新可能永远不会被患者使用。鉴于平滑健康本身而非消费可能带来的巨大价值，我们认为有必要对促进医疗创新的公共项目与主要旨在实现消费平滑的医疗保健改革之间的相对价值进行更明确的分析。

abstract.text: Improving the long-term life outcomes of disadvantaged youth remains a top policy priority in the United States, although identifying successful interventions for adolescents - particularly males - has proven challenging. This paper reports results from a large randomized controlled trial of an intervention for disadvantaged male youth grades 7-10 from high-crime Chicago neighborhoods. The intervention was delivered by two local non-profits and included regular interactions with a pro-social adult, after-school programming, and - perhaps the most novel ingredient - in-school programming designed to reduce common judgment and decision-making problems related to automatic behavior and biased beliefs, or what psychologists call cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT). We randomly assigned 2,740 youth to programming or to a control group; about half those offered programming participated, with the average participant attending 13 sessions. Program participation reduced violent-crime arrests during the program year by 8.1 per 100 youth (a 44 percent reduction). It also generated sustained gains in schooling outcomes equal to 0.14 standard deviations during the program year and 0.19 standard deviations during the follow-up year, which we estimate could lead to higher graduation rates of 3-10 percentage points (7-22 percent). Depending on how one monetizes the social costs of crime, the benefit-cost ratio may be as high as 30:1 from reductions in criminal activity alone.

10.3386/w19014.abstractZh: 改善弱势青少年的长期生活状况仍然是美国的首要政策目标，尽管为青少年——尤其是男性青少年——寻找有效的干预措施一直颇具挑战性。本文报告了一项针对芝加哥高犯罪率地区7至10年级弱势男性青少年的大规模随机对照试验的结果。该干预措施由两家当地非营利组织实施，包括与亲社会成年人的定期互动、课后辅导项目，以及一项旨在减少与自动行为和偏见信念相关的判断和决策问题的校内辅导项目，心理学家称之为认知行为疗法（CBT）。我们将2,740名青少年随机分配至干预组或对照组；其中约一半接受了干预，平均每位参与者参加了13次辅导课程。在干预期间，暴力犯罪逮捕率降低了8.1%，相当于减少了44%。此外，该干预措施还带来了持续的教育成果提升，在干预期间提升了0.14个标准差，在后续年份则提升了0.19个标准差，我们认为这可能会使毕业率提高3-10个百分点（7-22%）。根据对犯罪社会成本的核算方式，仅减少犯罪活动所带来的效益成本比可能高达30:1。

abstract.text: Disability Insurance (DI) programs have long been criticized by economists for apparent work disincentives. Some countries have recently modified their programs such that DI recipients are allowed to keep some of their benefits if they return to work, and other countries are considering similar return-to-work policies. However, there is little empirical evidence of the effectiveness of programs that incentivize the return to work by DI recipients. Using a local randomized experiment that arises from a sharp discontinuity in DI policy in Norway, we provide transparent and credible identification of how financial incentives induce DI recipients to return to work. We find that many DI recipients have considerable capacity to work that can be effectively induced by providing financial work incentives. We further show that providing work incentives to DI recipients may both increase their disposable income and reduce program costs. Our findings also suggest that targeted policies may be the most effective in encouraging DI recipients to return to work.

10.3386/w19016.abstractZh: 残疾保险计划长期以来一直受到经济学家的批评，认为这些计划明显降低了人们工作的积极性。一些国家最近对计划进行了修改，允许残疾保险受益人如果在工作期间重返工作岗位，可以保留部分福利。其他国家也在考虑类似的重返工作岗位政策。然而，关于通过残疾保险计划激励受益人重返工作岗位的有效性，目前几乎没有实证证据。我们利用挪威在残疾保险政策上的突然变化所引发的本地随机实验，提供了关于财务激励如何促使残疾保险受益人重返工作的透明且可信的识别方法。我们发现，许多残疾保险受益人具有相当大的工作能力，通过提供财务工作激励可以有效地激发他们的工作积极性。此外，我们进一步表明，为残疾保险受益人提供工作激励不仅可以增加他们的可支配收入，还可以降低计划成本。我们的研究结果还表明，有针对性的政策可能是鼓励残疾保险受益人重返工作的最有效方式。

abstract.text: Many believe that "big data" will transform business, government and other aspects of the economy. In this article we discuss how new data may impact economic policy and economic research. Large-scale administrative datasets and proprietary private sector data can greatly improve the way we measure, track and describe economic activity. They also can enable novel research designs that allow researchers to trace the consequences of different events or policies. We outline some of the challenges in accessing and making use of these data. We also consider whether the big data predictive modeling tools that have emerged in statistics and computer science may prove useful in economics.

10.3386/w19035.abstractZh: 许多人认为，“大数据”将改变商业、政府以及经济的其他领域。在本文中，我们探讨了新数据可能对经济政策和经济研究产生的影响。大规模行政数据集和私营部门的专有数据可以极大地改善我们衡量、追踪和描述经济活动的方式。它们还可以支持新的研究设计，使研究人员能够追踪不同事件或政策的后果。我们概述了获取和利用这些数据所面临的一些挑战。同时，我们也考虑了在统计学和计算机科学领域出现的基于大数据的预测建模工具是否可能在经济学中发挥作用。

abstract.text: We exploit migration patterns from the UK to Australia, South Africa, and the US to investigate whether a person's decision to smoke is determined by culture. For each country, we use retrospective data to describe individual smoking trajectories over the life-course. For the UK, we use these trajectories to measure culture by cohort and cohort-age, and more accurately relative to the extant literature. Our proxy predicts smoking participation of second-generation British immigrants but not that of non-British immigrants and natives. Researchers can apply our strategy to estimate culture effects on other outcomes when retrospective or longitudinal data are available.

10.3386/w19036.abstractZh: 我们利用从英国迁移到澳大利亚、南非和美国的模式，来研究一个人的吸烟决定是否受到文化因素的影响。对于每个国家，我们使用回顾性数据来描述个体在生命历程中的吸烟轨迹。对于英国，我们利用这些轨迹来按队列和队列年龄来衡量文化因素，这种方法比现有文献更为准确。我们的代理变量可以预测第二代英国移民的吸烟参与度，但不能预测非英国移民和本地人的吸烟参与度。当拥有回顾性或纵向数据时，研究人员可以应用我们的策略来估计文化因素对其他结果的影响。

abstract.text: This paper considers the relationship between local economic conditions and health with a focus on different approaches to geographic aggregation. After reviewing the tradeoffs associated with more- and less-disaggregated analyses-including an investigation of the migratory response to changing economic conditions-I update earlier state-level analyses of mortality and infant health and then consider how the estimated effects vary when the analysis is conducted at differing levels of geographic aggregation. This analysis reveals that more-disaggregated analyses severely understate the extent to which downturns are associated with improved health. Further investigation reveals that county economic conditions have an independent effect on mortality but that state and regional economic conditions are stronger predictors. I also leverage county-level data to explore heterogeneity in the link between county economic conditions and health across states, demonstrating that local downturns lead to the greatest improvements in health in low-income states.

10.3386/w19042.abstractZh: 本文探讨了当地经济条件与健康状况之间的关系，重点关注不同地理聚合方法的应用。在回顾了更细致和更粗略的分析之间的权衡之后——包括对经济条件变化下移民响应的研究——我更新了之前关于死亡率和婴儿健康的州级分析，并探讨了在不同的地理聚合层次上进行分析时，估计出的影响如何变化。分析结果显示，更细致的分析严重低估了经济衰退与健康状况改善之间的关联程度。进一步的研究表明，县级经济条件对死亡率有独立的影响，而州级和地区级经济条件则是更强的预测因素。我还利用县级数据来探讨各州之间县级经济条件与健康状况之间的异质性，发现当地经济衰退在低收入州带来了最大的健康改善。

abstract.text: We nested a large-scale field experiment into the national rollout of the introduction of performance pay for medical care providers in Rwanda to study the effect of incentives for health care providers. In order to identify the effect of incentives separately from higher compensation, we held constant compensation across treatment and comparison groups - a portion of the treatment group's compensation was based on performance whereas the compensation of the comparison group was fixed. The incentives led to a 20% increase in productivity, and significant improvements in child health. We also find evidence of a strong complementarity between performance incentives and baseline provider skill.

10.3386/w19046.abstractZh: 我们在卢旺达对医疗提供者实施绩效薪酬的全国推广过程中，开展了一项大规模实地实验，以研究激励措施对医疗提供者的影响。为了将激励措施的影响与更高的薪酬分开进行研究，我们在治疗组和对照组之间保持了相同的薪酬水平——治疗组的一部分薪酬基于绩效，而对照组的薪酬则保持不变。结果表明，激励措施使生产率提高了20%，儿童健康状况也显著改善。我们还发现，绩效激励措施与医疗提供者的基础技能之间存在很强的互补性。

abstract.text: A common heuristic for evaluating robustness of results to omitted variable bias is to look at coefficient movements after inclusion of controls. This heuristic is informative only if selection on observables is proportional to selection on unobservables. I formalize this link, drawing on theory in Altonji, Elder and Taber (2005) and show how, with this assumption, coefficient movements, along with movements in R-squared values, can be used to calculate omitted variable bias. I discuss empirical implementation and describe a formal bounding argument to replace the coefficient movement heuristic. I show two validation exercises suggesting that this bounding argument would perform well empirically. I discuss application of this procedure to a large set of publications in economics, and use evidence from randomized studies to draw guidelines as to appropriate bounding values.

10.3386/w19054.abstractZh: 评估结果对遗漏变量偏差的稳健性的一种常见启发式方法是观察在纳入控制变量后系数的变化。这一启发式方法只有在可观测变量的选择与不可观测变量的选择成正比的情况下才有意义。我基于Altonji、Elder和Taber（2005年）的理论对这一关系进行了形式化，并展示了在这一假设下，如何利用系数的变化以及R平方值的变动来计算遗漏变量偏差。我还讨论了这一方法的实证实施，并提出了一种替代系数变化启发式的正式边界论证。通过两个验证实验，我表明这种边界论证在实证上表现良好。最后，我讨论了将这一程序应用于大量经济学研究文献的情况，并利用随机研究的证据来制定适当的边界值指导方针。

abstract.text: Many national accounts of economic output and prosperity, such as gross domestic product (GDP) or net domestic product (NDP), offer an incomplete picture by ignoring, for example, the value of leisure, home production, and the value of health. Previous discussed shortcomings of such accounts have focused on how unobserved dimensions affect GDP levels but not their cyclicality, which affects the measurement of the business cycle. This paper proposes a new methodology to measure economic fluctuations that incorporates monetized changes in health of the population in the United States and globally during the past 50 years. In particular, we incorporate in GDP the dollar value of mortality, treating it as depreciation in human capital analogous to how net domestic product (NDP) treats depreciation of physical capital. Because mortality tends to be pro‐cyclical, we find that adjusting for mortality reduces the measured deviations of GDP from trend during the past 50 years by about 30% both in the United States and internationally.

10.3386/w19058.abstractZh: 许多关于经济产出和繁荣的国民账户，如国内生产总值（GDP）或国内净产值（NDP），由于忽略了休闲、家庭生产以及健康价值等因素，所提供的图景并不完整。以往对这些账户缺陷的讨论主要集中在未观测因素如何影响GDP水平，而并未关注这些因素对经济周期性的影响，而这正是衡量经济周期的关键所在。本文提出了一种新的经济波动测量方法，该方法将过去50年间美国及全球范围内人口健康的货币化变化纳入考量。具体而言，我们将死亡率的美元价值纳入GDP计算，将其视为人力资本折旧，类似于国内净产值（NDP）对物质资本折旧的处理方式。由于死亡率往往具有顺周期性，我们发现调整死亡率后，过去50年间美国及国际范围内GDP与趋势的偏差减少了约30%。

abstract.text: More than a quarter of Medicare beneficiaries are enrolled in Medicare Advantage, which was created in large part to improve the efficiency of health care delivery by promoting competition among private managed care plans. This paper explores the spillover effects of the Medicare Advantage program on the traditional Medicare program and other patients, taking advantage of changes in Medicare Advantage payment policy to isolate exogenous increases in Medicare Advantage enrollment and trace out the effects of greater managed care penetration on hospital utilization and spending throughout the health care system. We find that when more seniors enroll in Medicare managed care, hospital costs decline for all seniors and for commercially insured younger populations. Greater managed care penetration is not associated with fewer hospitalizations, but is associated with lower costs and shorter stays per hospitalization. These spillovers are substantial - offsetting more than 10% of increased payments to Medicare Advantage plans.

10.3386/w19070.abstractZh: 超过四分之一的医疗保险受益人参加了医疗保险优势计划，该计划主要是为了通过促进私人管理式护理计划之间的竞争来提高医疗服务的效率。本文探讨了医疗保险优势计划对传统医疗保险计划及其他患者产生的溢出效应，并利用医疗保险优势计划的支付政策变化来分离医疗保险优势计划参保人数的外生增长，并追踪更大程度的管理式护理普及对整个医疗系统的医院使用率和支出的影响。我们发现，当更多老年人参加医疗保险管理式护理时，所有老年人的医院费用以及商业保险覆盖的年轻人群的医院费用都会下降。更大的管理式护理普及并不导致住院次数减少，但会降低每次住院的费用和住院时间。这些溢出效应相当显著，足以抵消医疗保险优势计划支付增加的10%以上。

abstract.text: We study the effect of a recent expansion in India's National Old Age Pension Scheme on elderly well-being. Estimates suggest that public pension has a modestly negative effect on the employment of elderly/near elderly men with a primary or lower education but no effect of the employment of similar women. Pension raised family expenditures, lowering poverty, and the effect was smaller on families headed by illiterate persons suggesting lower pension coverage of this most disadvantaged group. Further, households spent most of the pension income on medical care and education. We find some weak evidence that pension raised longevity.

10.3386/w19088.abstractZh: 我们研究了印度国家老年养老金计划近期扩展对老年人福祉的影响。估计表明，公共养老金对受过小学或更低程度教育的老年或接近老年男性的就业有轻微的负面影响，但对类似女性的就业没有影响。养老金增加了家庭支出，降低了贫困率，但对由文盲人士组成的家庭的影响较小，这表明这一最弱势群体的养老金覆盖率较低。此外，家庭将大部分养老金收入用于医疗和教育。我们发现一些微弱的证据表明，养老金延长了寿命。

abstract.text: Medicare currently allows beneficiaries to choose between a government-run health plan and a privately- administered program known as Medicare Advantage (MA). Because enrollment in MA is optional, conventional observational estimates of the program's impact are potentially subject to selection bias. To address this, we use a discontinuity in the rules governing MA payments to health plans that gives greater payments to plans operating in counties in Metropolitan Statistical Areas with populations of 250,000 or more. The sharp difference in payment rates at this population cutoff creates a greater incentive for plans to increase the generosity of benefits and therefore enroll more beneficiaries in MA in counties just above versus just below the cutoff. We find that the expansion of MA on this margin reduces beneficiaries' rates of hospitalization and mortality.

10.3386/w19101.abstractZh: 目前，Medicare允许受益人选择政府运营的医疗保健计划或名为Medicare Advantage（MA）的私人管理计划。由于加入MA是可选的，因此对该计划影响的常规观察性估计可能会受到选择偏差的影响。为了应对这一问题，我们利用了MA对医疗计划支付规则中的不连续性：在人口超过250,000的都市统计区，医疗计划的支付金额会更高。这种支付率的显著差异使得医疗计划更有动力提高福利的慷慨程度，从而在人口数量略高于或略低于这一临界值的县中吸引更多受益人加入MA。我们发现，扩大MA的覆盖范围可以降低受益人的住院率和死亡率。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of a policy change in the province of Quebec, Canada which greatly expanded insurance coverage for prescription medications. We show that the change was associated with a sharp increase in the use of stimulant medications commonly prescribed for ADHD in Quebec relative to the rest of Canada. We ask whether this increase in medication use was associated with improvements in emotional functioning or academic outcomes among children with ADHD. We find little evidence of improvement in either the medium or the long run. Our results are silent on the effects on optimal use of medication for ADHD, but suggest that expanding medication in a community setting had little positive benefit and may have had harmful effects given the average way these drugs are used in the community.

10.3386/w19105.abstractZh: 我们研究了加拿大魁北克省一项政策变化的影响，该政策大幅扩大了处方药的可保险范围。研究表明，这一变化导致魁北克省用于治疗注意力缺陷多动障碍的兴奋剂类药物的使用量显著增加，相对于加拿大其他地区而言。我们探讨了这种药物使用量的增加是否伴随着儿童注意力缺陷多动障碍的情绪功能或学业表现的改善。研究发现，无论是短期内还是长期内，这种改善的迹象都很少。我们的研究结果并未显示出对注意力缺陷多动障碍患者药物最佳使用的积极影响，反而表明在社区环境中扩大药物使用范围可能带来负面影响，因为目前这些药物在社区中的使用方式普遍都是如此。

abstract.text: We evaluate the impact of a health information intervention implemented through mobile phones, using a clustered randomized control trial augmented by qualitative interviews. The intervention aimed to improve sexual health knowledge and shift individuals towards safer sexual behavior by providing reliable information about sexual health. The novel technology designed by Google and Grameen Technology Center provided automated searches of an advice database on topics requested by users via SMS. It was offered by MTN Uganda at no cost to users. Quantitative survey results allow us to reject the hypothesis that improving access to information would increase knowledge and shift behavior to less risky sexual activities. In fact, we find that the service led to an increase in promiscuity, and no shift in perception of norms. Qualitative focus groups discussions support the findings of the quantitative survey results. We conclude by discussing a potential mechanism explaining the counterintuitive findings.

10.3386/w19107.abstractZh: 我们评估了通过手机实施的健康信息干预措施的影响，该研究采用聚类随机对照试验，并辅以定性访谈。该干预措施旨在提高性健康知识，并通过提供关于性健康的可靠信息，促使人们采取更安全的性行为。由谷歌和格拉敏技术中心设计的新技术能够自动搜索用户通过短信请求的主题相关的建议数据库。该服务由MTN乌干达免费提供给用户。定量调查的结果表明，改善信息获取并不会增加知识水平或促使人们采取风险较低的性行为。事实上，我们发现该服务反而导致了滥交现象的增加，而人们对性规范的认知并未发生任何变化。定性焦点小组讨论的结果也支持了定量调查的发现。最后，我们讨论了可能解释这些反直觉发现的机制。

abstract.text: Previous economic research shows that recessions lead to worsening substance abuse. In this paper we study the effect of recessions on admissions to specialty substance abuse treatment using administrative data between 1992 and 2015. Using data from Treatment Episode Data Set and a differences-in-differences empirical strategy, we find no evidence that recessions influence the overall number of admissions. However, we document substantial heterogeneity across drugs of abuse. Combining our findings with previous economic studies suggests that unmet need for substance abuse treatment increases during recessions.

10.3386/w19115.abstractZh: 先前的经济研究表明，经济衰退会导致物质滥用问题的恶化。在本文中，我们利用1992年至2015年的行政数据，研究了经济衰退对特殊物质滥用治疗入院情况的影响。通过“治疗事件数据集”和差异-差异实证策略的数据分析，我们发现经济衰退并未显著影响入院总数。然而，我们发现不同物质滥用类型之间存在显著的异质性。将我们的研究结果与先前的经济研究相结合，可以推断出在经济衰退期间，对物质滥用治疗的未满足需求会增加。

abstract.text: This study aims to measure the causal effect of informal caregiving on the health and health care use of women who are caregivers, using instrumental variables. We use data from South Korea, where daughters and daughters-in-law are the prevalent source of caregivers for frail elderly parents and parents-in-law. A key insight of our instrumental variable approach is that having a parent-in-law with functional limitations increases the probability of providing informal care to that parent-in-law, but a parent-in-law's functional limitation does not directly affect the daughter-in-law's health. We compare results for the daughter-in-law and daughter samples to check the assumption of the excludability of the instruments for the daughter sample. Our results show that providing informal care has significant adverse effects along multiple dimensions of health for daughter-in-law and daughter caregivers in South Korea.

10.3386/w19142.abstractZh: 本研究旨在利用工具变量来衡量非正式照顾对女性照顾者健康和医疗使用的因果效应。我们采用了韩国的数据，在该国，女儿和儿媳是照顾体弱多病的父母和岳父岳母的主要来源。我们的工具变量方法的一个关键发现是，有功能受限的岳父岳母会增加提供非正式照顾的可能性，但岳父岳母的功能受限并不直接影响儿媳的健康状况。我们通过比较女儿和儿媳样本的结果，来验证工具变量对女儿样本的可排除性假设。研究结果表明，在韩国，为女儿和儿媳提供非正式照顾会在多个健康维度上产生显著的负面影响。

abstract.text: In this paper, we examine the effect of food prices on clinical measures of obesity, including body mass index (BMI) and percentage body fat (PBF) measures derived from bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) and dual energy x-ray absorptiometry (DXA), among youths ages 12 through 18. The empirical analyses employ data from various waves of the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) merged with several food prices measured by county and year. This is the first study to consider clinically measured levels of body composition rather than BMI to investigate the effects of food prices on obesity among youths. We also examine whether the effects of food prices on body composition differ by gender and race/ethnicity. Our findings suggest that increases in the real price of one calorie in food for home consumption and the real price of fast-food restaurant food lead to improvements in obesity outcomes among youths. We also find that an increase in the real price of fruits and vegetables has negative consequences for these outcomes. Finally, our results indicate that measures of PBF derived from BIA and DXA are no less sensitive and in some cases more sensitive to the prices just mentioned than BMI.

10.3386/w19143.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了食品价格对青少年肥胖症临床指标的影响，包括通过生物电阻抗分析（BIA）和双能X射线吸收测定法（DXA）得出的身体质量指数（BMI）和体脂百分比（PBF）等指标。实证分析采用了多次全国健康与营养调查（NHANES）的数据，并结合了各年份各县的食品价格数据。这是首次通过考虑临床测量的身体成分指标而非BMI来研究食品价格对青少年肥胖的影响。我们还探讨了食品价格对身体成分的影响是否存在性别和种族/民族差异。研究发现，家庭消费食品每卡路里实际价格的上升以及快餐食品实际价格的上升，都会改善青少年的肥胖状况。此外，水果和蔬菜实际价格的上升则会对肥胖状况产生负面影响。最后，我们的结果表明，通过BIA和DXA得出的PBF指标在检测上述价格变化方面同样敏感，在某些情况下甚至比BMI更为敏感。

abstract.text: A general finding in the empirical literature on charitable giving is that among older individuals, both the probability of giving and the conditional amount of donations decrease with age, ceteris paribus. In this paper, we use data on giving by alumni at an anonymous university to investigate end-of-life giving patterns. Our main finding is that taking into account the approach of death substantially changes the age-giving profile for the elderly-in one segment of the age distribution, the independent effect of an increase in age on giving actually changes from negative to positive. We examine how the decline in giving as death approaches varies with the length of time that a given condition is likely to bring about death, and the individual's age when he died. We find that for individuals who died from conditions that bring about death fairly quickly, there is little decline in giving as death approaches compared to those who died from other causes. Further, the decline in giving as death approaches is steeper for the elderly (for whom death is less likely to be a surprise) than for the relatively young. These findings suggest that our primary result, that failing to take into account the approach of death leads to biased inferences with respect to the age-giving profile, is not merely an artifact of some kind of nonlinearity in the relationship between age and giving.

10.3386/w19145.abstractZh: 在关于慈善捐赠的实证文献中，一个普遍的发现是，对于老年人来说，无论其他条件如何，捐赠的概率和捐赠金额都会随着年龄的增长而减少。在本文中，我们使用了某所匿名大学校友的捐赠数据，来研究临终时的捐赠模式。我们的主要发现是，考虑到死亡的影响，老年人的捐赠年龄分布会发生变化——在年龄分布的某个区间里，年龄对捐赠的影响从负面转变为正面。我们研究了随着死亡临近，捐赠减少的趋势如何随着导致死亡的疾病持续时间的长短以及个体死亡时的年龄而变化。我们发现，对于那些因疾病迅速导致死亡的人来说，与因其他原因死亡的人相比，死亡临近时捐赠减少的趋势并不明显。此外，对于老年人来说（他们不太可能突然遭遇死亡），死亡临近时捐赠减少的趋势比年轻人更为明显。这些发现表明，我们的主要结论——没有考虑死亡的影响会导致对老年人捐赠年龄分布的偏差推断——并不仅仅是由于年龄与捐赠之间的关系存在某种非线性现象所导致的。

abstract.text: We develop a model of selection that incorporates a key element of recent health reforms: an individual mandate. We identify a set of key parameters for welfare analysis, allowing us to model the welfare impact of the actual policy as well as to estimate the socially optimal penalty level. Using data from Massachusetts, we estimate the key parameters of the model. We compare health insurance coverage, premiums, and insurer average health claim expenditures between Massachusetts and other states in the periods before and after the passage of Massachusetts health reform. In the individual market for health insurance, we find that premiums and average costs decreased significantly in response to the individual mandate; consistent with an initially adversely selected insurance market. We are also able to recover an estimated willingness-to-pay for health insurance. Combining demand and cost estimates as sufficient statistics for welfare analysis, we find an annual welfare gain of $335 dollars per person or $71 million annually in Massachusetts as a result of the reduction in adverse selection. We also find evidence for smaller post-reform markups in the individual market, which increased welfare by another $107 dollars per person per year and about $23 million per year overall. To put this in perspective, the total welfare gains were 8.4% of medical expenditures paid by insurers. Our model and empirical estimates suggest an optimal mandate penalty of $2,190. A penalty of this magnitude would increase health insurance to near universal levels. Our estimated optimal penalty is higher than the individual mandate penalty adopted in Massachusetts but close to the penalty implemented under the ACA.

10.3386/w19149.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个选择模型，该模型包含了近期健康改革中的一个关键要素：个人强制保险。我们确定了一组用于福利分析的关键参数，从而能够模拟实际政策的福利影响，并估算出社会最优的惩罚水平。利用马萨诸塞州的数据，我们估算了该模型的关键参数。我们比较了马萨诸塞州与其他州在马萨诸塞州健康改革实施前后在健康保险覆盖、保费以及保险公司平均健康索赔支出方面的差异。在健康保险的个人市场中，我们发现保费和平均成本因个人强制保险的实施而显著下降；这与最初出现的逆向选择现象一致。我们还能够估算出健康保险的市场支付意愿。通过将需求和成本估算作为福利分析的充分统计量，我们发现马萨诸塞州因减少逆向选择而每年每人的福利增益为335美元，或每年7100万美元。我们还发现，改革后个人市场的价格溢价有所降低，这进一步增加了每年每人的福利增益107美元，总体上增加了约2300万美元的福利。从比例上看，这些福利增益占保险公司支付医疗支出的8.4%。我们的模型和实证估算表明，最优的惩罚水平应为2190美元。这样的惩罚水平将使健康保险覆盖率接近全民水平。我们估算的最优惩罚水平高于马萨诸塞州采用的个人强制保险惩罚水平，但接近《平价医疗法案》所实施的惩罚水平。

abstract.text: The old age provisions of the Medicaid program were designed to insure poor retirees against medical expenses. However, it is the rich who are most likely to live long and face expensive medical conditions when very old. We estimate a structural model of savings and endogenous medical spending with heterogeneous agents and use it to compute the distribution of lifetime Medicaid transfers and Medicaid valuations across currently single retirees. We find that retirees with high lifetime incomes can end up on Medicaid and often value Medicaid insurance the most, as they face a larger risk of catastrophic medical needs at old ages and face the greatest consumption risk. Compensating variation calculations indicate that current retirees value Medicaid insurance at more than its actuarial cost, but that most would value an expansion of the current Medicaid program at less than its cost. These findings suggest that for current single retirees, the Medicaid program may be of the approximately right size.

10.3386/w19151.abstractZh: Medicaid计划中的老年保障条款旨在为贫困退休人员提供医疗费用保障。然而，实际上，富人更有可能长寿，并且在年老时面临昂贵的医疗状况。我们建立了一个包含异质代理人的储蓄和内生医疗支出的结构模型，并利用该模型计算当前单身退休人员一生中获得的Medicaid补助和Medicaid保险价值的分布。研究发现，收入较高的退休人员往往能够享受Medicaid保障，并且他们最看重Medicaid保险，因为他们年老时面临更大的医疗需求风险，消费风险也更大。补偿变化计算表明，当前退休人员对Medicaid保险的价值高于其精算成本，但大多数人认为扩大当前的Medicaid计划所带来的价值低于其成本。这些发现表明，对于当前的单身退休人员来说，Medicaid计划的规模可能较为合适。

abstract.text: Following the death of Mao in 1976, agrarian decision-making shifted from the collective to individual households, unleashing rapid growth in farm output and unprecedented reductions in poverty. In new data on reform timing in 914 counties, we find an immediate trend break in the fraction of male children following rural land reform. Among second births that followed a firstborn girl, sex ratios increased from 1.1 to 1.3 boys per girl in the four years following reform. Larger increases are found among families with more education and in counties with larger output gains due to reform. Proximately, increased sex selection was achieved in part through prenatal ultrasounds obtained in provincial capitals. The land reform estimate is robust to controlling for the county-level rollout of the One Child Policy. Overall, we estimate land reform accounted for roughly half of the increase in sex ratios in rural China from 1978-86, or about 1 million missing girls.

10.3386/w19153.abstractZh: 在1976年毛泽东去世后，农业决策从集体层面转向个人家庭，这推动了农业产量的快速增长，并显著减少了贫困现象。通过对914个县的改革时间的新数据分析，我们发现农村土地改革后，男性儿童的比例出现了立即的下降。在土地改革后四年中，第二个出生的孩子中，男孩与女孩的比例从1.1:1上升到1.3:1。受教育程度较高的家庭和因改革而农业产量增长较大的县，性别比例的变化更为明显。大约可以说，通过省级城市提供的产前超声波检查，促进了性别选择的增加。即使控制了“独生子女政策”在县级层面的实施情况，土地改革的估计结果仍然具有可靠性。总体而言，我们估计土地改革在中国农村性别比例的变化中起到了大约一半的作用，相当于约100万女孩的缺失。

abstract.text: A substantial body of research has found that expansions in Medicaid eligibility increased enrollment in Medicaid, reduced the rate of uninsured, and reduced the rate of private health insurance coverage (i.e., crowd out). Notably, there has been little research that has examined the mechanism by which crowd-out occurs. This study examines the effects of expansions in Medicaid eligibility for pregnant women in the late 1980s and the early 1990s on labor supply, which is one of the possible mechanisms underlying crowd out. Estimates suggest that the 20 percentage point increase in Medicaid eligibility during the sample period was associated with a 6% to 7% decrease in the probability that a woman who gave birth in the past year was employed. Among unmarried women with less than a high school education, the change in Medicaid eligibility reduced employment by approximately 13% to 16%.

10.3386/w19161.abstractZh: 大量研究指出，医疗补助资格范围的扩大增加了医疗补助的参保人数，降低了无保险人口的比例，并减少了私人健康保险的使用率（即产生了挤出效应）。值得注意的是，关于这种挤出效应发生机制的研究相对较少。本研究探讨了20世纪80年代末和90年代初对孕妇医疗补助资格范围扩大的影响，以及这一变化对劳动力供应的影响，这是导致挤出效应可能的原因之一。研究估计，在样本期间，医疗补助资格范围扩大20个百分点，导致过去一年内分娩的女性就业概率下降6%至7%。对于未结婚且受教育程度低于高中的女性来说，医疗补助资格范围的扩大使她们的就业率下降了约13%至16%。

abstract.text: We document the correlations between early childhood health (as proxied by height) and educational attainment and investigate the labor market and wealth returns to height for United States cohorts born between 1820 and 1990. The nineteenth century was characterized by low investments in height and education, a small correlation between height and education, and positive but small returns for both height and education. The relationship between height and education was stronger in the twentieth century and stronger in the first part of the twentieth century than later on (when both investments in education and height stalled), but never as strong as in developing countries. The labor market and wealth returns to height and education also were higher in the twentieth compared to the nineteenth century. We relate our findings to the theory of human capital formation and speculate that the greater importance of physical labor in the nineteenth century economy, which raised the opportunity cost of schooling, may have depressed the height-education relationship relative to the twentieth century. Our findings are consistent with an increasing importance of cognitive abilities acquired in early childhood.

10.3386/w19162.abstractZh: 我们研究了儿童早期健康状况（以身高为指标）与教育成就之间的相关性，并探讨了1820年至1990年间出生的美国人群在劳动力市场和财富回报方面的表现。19世纪，对身高和教育的投资较低，身高与教育之间的相关性较小，而身高和教育的回报均为正值但较小。20世纪，身高与教育之间的关系更为紧密，尤其是在20世纪初期，而后期这两种投资都停滞不前，但从未像发展中国家那样紧密。与19世纪相比，20世纪的劳动力市场和财富回报对身高和教育的依赖性更高。我们将这些发现与人力资本形成理论联系起来，推测19世纪经济中体力劳动的重要性较高，这导致教育的机会成本上升，从而可能削弱了身高与教育之间的关系。我们的发现与早期儿童时期获得的认知能力日益重要的趋势相一致。

abstract.text: We study choice over prescription insurance plans by the elderly using government administrative data to evaluate how these choices are made and evolve over time. We find that there is large "foregone savings" from not choosing the lowest cost plan that has grown over time. We develop a structural framework that allows us to exactly decompose the changes in "foregone welfare" from inconsistent choices into supply and demand side factors. We find that foregone welfare increases over time due primarily to supply-side factors such as premiums and out-of-pocket costs; we estimate little learning at either the individual or cohort level.

10.3386/w19163.abstractZh: 我们研究了老年人对处方药保险计划的选择，利用政府行政数据来评估这些选择是如何做出的以及随时间如何演变。我们发现，不选择成本最低的保险计划所带来的“节省福利”随着时间的推移而不断增加。我们建立了一个结构框架，能够精确地分解由于选择不一致而导致的“节省福利”变化，并将其分解为供给和需求方面的因素。我们发现，随着时间的推移，节省福利的增加主要归因于供给方面的因素，如保费和自付费用；在个体或群体层面，我们几乎没有观察到学习效应。

abstract.text: We exploit the occurrence of postpartum depression (PPD), which has a random component according to the medical community, to estimate causal effects of a salient form of mental illness on couples' relationship status. We estimate single-equation models as well as bivariate probit models that address the endogeneity of PPD. We find that this relatively prevalent mental illness reduces the probability the couples are married (by 22-24%) as well the probability that they are living together (married or cohabiting) (by 24-26%) three years after the birth of the child. Models stratified by relationship status at the time of the birth indicate that PPD makes it more likely that unions dissolve (particularly among baseline cohabitors) and less likely that unions are formed (particularly among baseline non-cohabitors). The findings contribute to the literature on the effects of mental illness on relationships and to the broader literature on socioeconomic status and health.

10.3386/w19164.abstractZh: 我们利用产后抑郁症的发生情况作为随机因素，来估计这种常见精神疾病对夫妻关系状态的影响。我们建立了单方程模型以及双变量Probit模型，以探讨产后抑郁症的内生性。研究发现，这种相对常见的精神疾病会使夫妻结婚的概率降低22-24%，同时使他们同居（结婚或同居关系）的概率降低24-26%。按出生时的关系状态分组的模型显示，产后抑郁症使得婚姻破裂的可能性增加（尤其是在基线同居者中），而婚姻形成的可能性则降低（尤其是在基线非同居者中）。这些发现为关于精神疾病对关系影响的研究提供了依据，同时也为关于社会经济地位和健康问题的研究做出了贡献。

abstract.text: Nurse practitioners (NPs) and physician assistants (PAs) now outnumber family practice doctors in the United States and are the principal providers of primary care to many communities. Recent growth of these professions has occurred amidst considerable cross-state variation in their regulation, with some states permitting autonomous practice and others mandating extensive physician oversight. I find that expanded NP and PA supply has had minimal impact on the office-based healthcare market overall, but utilization has been modestly more responsive to supply increases in states permitting greater autonomy. Results suggest the importance of laws impacting the division of labor, not just its quantity.

10.3386/w19172.abstractZh: 在美国，执业护士和医师助理的数量已经超过了家庭医学医生，他们成为许多社区初级医疗服务的主要提供者。这些职业的快速发展伴随着各州在监管方面的显著差异，有些州允许自主执业，而另一些州则要求有严格的医师监督。我发现，执业护士和医师助理数量的增加对以诊所为基础的医疗保健市场整体影响甚微，但在那些允许更大自主权的州，患者的需求对供应增加的反应较为积极。结果表明，影响劳动分工的法律不仅体现在数量上，还体现在其重要性上。

abstract.text: This paper illustrates how one can use causal effects of a policy change to measure its welfare impact without decomposing them into income and substitution effects. Often, a single causal effect suffices: the impact on government revenue. Because these responses vary with the policy in question, I term them policy elasticities, to distinguish them from Hicksian and Marshallian elasticities. The model also formally justifies a simple benefit-cost ratio for non-budget neutral policies. Using existing causal estimates, I apply the framework to five policy changes: top income tax rate, EITC generosity, food stamps, job training, and housing vouchers.

10.3386/w19177.abstractZh: 本文阐述了如何利用政策变化的因果效应来衡量其福利影响，而无需将其分解为收入效应和替代效应。通常，单一的因果效应就足够了：即对政府收入的影响。由于这些反应会随着政策的不同而变化，我将它们称为政策弹性，以区别于希克斯弹性和马歇尔弹性。该模型还正式证明了非预算中性政策存在一个简单的收益成本比。利用现有的因果估计数据，我将这一框架应用于五项政策变化：最高所得税税率、EITC的慷慨程度、食品券、职业培训以及住房券。

abstract.text: In this paper, we use individual level data on purchases of one of the most prescribed categories of drugs (cholesterol-lowering statins) to study the responses of physicians and patients to variation in the cost of drugs. In a sample of first-time statin prescriptions to employees from a group of Fortune 500 firms, we find that copay variation across plans has a relatively small effect on the choice of drug, and this effect does not vary with patient income. After the highly-publicized expiration of the patent for Zocor (simvastatin), however, prescriptions for this drug increased substantially, especially for lower-income patients. Our analysis suggests that physicians can perceive the adherence elasticity of their patients and adjust their initial prescriptions accordingly, but only in response to a large and universal price change. Using prescriber identifiers, we present suggestive evidence that physicians learn about a patient's price sensitivity through their own experience of prescribing to that patient.

10.3386/w19186.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们使用了关于最常用药物类别之一——降胆固醇他汀类药物的购买数据，来研究医生和患者对药物价格变动的反应。通过对一家财富500强企业员工首次使用他汀类药物的病例样本分析，我们发现不同保险计划下的共付额变化对药物选择的影响相对较小，且这种影响并不随患者收入的变化而变化。然而，在Zocor（simvastatin）专利到期后，该药物的处方量显著增加，尤其是针对低收入患者。我们的分析表明，医生能够感知患者的用药依从性，并据此调整初始处方，但这种情况通常只发生在大规模且普遍的价格变动时。通过使用处方者标识符，我们有证据表明，医生是通过自身对特定患者的处方经验来了解该患者的价格敏感性的。

abstract.text: Increasingly in U.S. public insurance programs, the state finances and regulates competing, capitated private health plans but does not itself directly insure beneficiaries through a public fee-for-service (FFS) plan. We develop a simple model of risk-selection in such settings. Capitation incentivizes insurers to retain low-cost clients and thus improve their care relative to high-cost clients, who they prefer would switch to a competitor. We test this prediction using county transitions from FFS Medicaid to capitated Medicaid managed care (MMC) for pregnant women and infants. We first document the large health disparities and corresponding cost differences between blacks and Hispanics (who make up the large majority of Medicaid enrollees in our data), with black births costing nearly double that of Hispanics. Consistent with the model, black-Hispanic infant health disparities widen under MMC (e.g., the black-Hispanic mortality gap grows by 42 percent) and black mothers' pre-natal care worsens relative to that of Hispanics. Remarkably, black birth rates fall (and abortions rise) significantly after MMC--consistent with mothers reacting to poor care by reducing fertility or plans discouraging births from high-cost groups. Implications for the ACA exchanges are discussed

10.3386/w19198.abstractZh: 在美国的公共保险计划中，国家负责为竞争性的、基于包干制的私人健康计划提供资金并对其进行监管，但并不直接通过公共费用支付计划为受益人提供保险。我们为此类情况建立了一个简单的风险选择模型。包干制激励保险公司留住低成本客户，从而改善对高成本客户的护理，因为这些高成本客户更有可能转向竞争对手的保险计划。我们使用县级数据来测试这一预测，这些数据反映了从公共费用支付医疗计划转向基于包干制的医疗管理计划的情况，涉及孕妇和婴儿。首先，我们发现黑人和西班牙裔之间存在巨大的健康差异，且成本也有显著差异（在我们的数据中，西班牙裔占医疗计划参保者的绝大多数），黑人婴儿的出生成本几乎是西班牙裔的两倍。与模型预测一致，在基于包干制的医疗管理计划下，黑人和西班牙裔婴儿的健康差异进一步扩大（例如，黑人和西班牙裔婴儿的死亡率差距增加了42%），同时黑人母亲的产前护理质量也低于西班牙裔母亲。值得注意的是，在基于包干制的医疗管理计划实施后，黑人的出生率显著下降（堕胎率上升）——这与母亲因护理质量差而减少生育或避免让高成本群体生育的情况相符。本文还讨论了这对《平价医疗法案》中的交换计划的影响。

abstract.text: The conventional wisdom in health economics is that large differences in average productivity across hospitals are the result of idiosyncratic, institutional features of the healthcare sector which dull the role of market forces. Strikingly, however, we find that productivity dispersion in heart attack treatment across hospitals is, if anything, smaller than in narrowly defined manufacturing industries such as ready-mixed concrete. While this fact admits multiple interpretations, we also find evidence against the conventional wisdom that the healthcare sector does not operate like an industry subject to standard market forces. In particular, we find that hospitals that are more productive at treating heart attacks have higher market shares at a point in time and are more likely to expand over time. For example, a 10 percent increase in hospital productivity today is associated with about 4 percent more patients in 5 years. Taken together, these facts suggest that the healthcare sector may have more in common with "traditional" sectors than is often assumed.

10.3386/w19200.abstractZh: 在健康经济学领域，传统观点认为医院之间平均生产率的巨大差异是由于医疗保健行业的特有制度特征所导致的，这些特征削弱了市场力量的作用。然而，我们发现，在心脏病治疗方面，医院之间的生产率差异实际上比那些如预拌混凝土这样的狭义制造业还要小。虽然这一事实可以有多种解释，但我们也发现了一些证据，表明医疗保健行业并非像传统行业那样受标准市场力量的影响。具体来说，我们发现，在心脏病治疗方面效率更高的医院，在某一时间点上拥有更高的市场份额，并且更有可能在未来继续扩大规模。例如，今天医院生产效率提高10%，在5年后患者数量可能会增加约4%。综合这些事实来看，这表明医疗保健行业可能与“传统”行业有更多的共同点，而不是人们通常认为的那样。

abstract.text: The conventional wisdom dating back to Yaari (1965) is that households without a bequest motive should fully annuitize their investments. Numerous market frictions do not break this sharp result. We modify the Yaari framework by allowing a household's mortality risk itself to be stochastic. Annuities still help to hedge longevity risk, but they are now subject to valuation risk. Valuation risk is a powerful gateway mechanism for numerous frictions to reduce annuity demand, even without ad hoc "liquidity constraints." We find that most households should not annuitize any wealth. The optimal level of aggregate net annuity holdings is likely even negative.

10.3386/w19211.abstractZh: 根据Yaari（1965年）的研究，传统观点认为，没有遗产继承动机的家庭应该将资产完全转化为年金形式。然而，许多市场摩擦并未打破这一结论。我们通过允许家庭的死亡风险具有随机性来修改Yaari的模型。年金仍然有助于对冲长寿风险，但现在它们还面临着估值风险。估值风险是许多摩擦因素降低年金需求的重要机制，即使没有特定的“流动性限制”。我们发现，大多数家庭不应将任何财富转化为年金形式。总体净年金持有量的最佳水平甚至可能是负数。

abstract.text: This paper provides a systematic analysis of identification in linear social interactions models. This is both a theoretical and an econometric exercise as the analysis is linked to a rigorously delineated model of interdependent decisions. We develop an incomplete information game that describes individual choices in the presence of social interactions. The equilibrium strategy profiles are linear. Standard models in the empirical social interactions literature are shown to be exact or approximate special cases of our general framework, which in turn provides a basis for understanding the microeconomic foundations of those models. We consider identification of both endogenous (peer) and contextual social effects under alternative assumptions on a priori information about network structure available to an analyst, and contrast the informational content of individual-level and aggregated data. Finally, we discuss potential ramifications for identification of endogenous group selection and differences between the information sets of analysts and agents.

10.3386/w19212.abstractZh: 本文对线性社会互动模型中的识别问题进行了系统分析。这既是一项理论研究，也是一项计量经济学研究，因为分析结果与一个严格定义的相互依赖决策模型相关联。我们构建了一个不完全信息博弈模型，用以描述在社会互动背景下个体的选择行为。该模型的均衡策略配置是线性的。实证社会互动文献中的标准模型被证明是我们总体框架的精确或近似特例，这为我们理解这些模型的微观经济基础提供了基础。我们探讨了在分析师对网络结构有先验信息的情况下，内生性（同伴）和情境性社会效应的识别问题，并比较了个体层面数据与汇总数据的信息内容。最后，我们讨论了内生性群体选择识别的潜在影响，以及分析师与代理人之间信息集的差异。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of youth friendship links on student’s own academic performance (grade point average) using the Add Health. We estimate a reduced form, high dimensional fixed effects model of within cohort or grade friendship links, and use this model to predict each student’s number of friends whose mothers have a four year college degree. The effects of friendship links are identified using across-cohort, within school variation in demographic composition of the student’s cohort or grade. We find that increases in number of friendship links with students whose mothers are college educated raises grade point average among girls, but not among boys. Additional analyses suggest a positive view of the school environment and a perception of one’s self as functioning well in that environment as possible mechanisms. The effects are relatively broad based across students over maternal education, racial and ethnic composition and across schools that vary in demographic composition over the same variables.

10.3386/w19215.abstractZh: 本文利用Add Health数据，探讨了青少年友谊关系对学生自身学业成绩（平均绩点）的影响。我们构建了一个简化形式的高维固定效应模型，用于分析同届或同年级内的友谊关系，并利用该模型预测每位学生中母亲拥有四年制大学学位的朋友数量。通过跨届别、同学校内学生群体或年级的人口统计差异，我们识别出友谊关系的影响。研究发现，与母亲受过大学教育的学生建立更多友谊关系，能够提升女生的平均绩点，但对男生则没有这种效果。进一步分析表明，对学校环境的积极看法以及对自己在该环境中表现良好的认知，可能是影响学业成绩的关键因素。这些影响在涉及母亲教育水平、种族和族裔构成以及不同学校的学生群体中都存在，且这些学校在人口统计特征上也存在差异。

abstract.text: Historically, low Medicaid reimbursement rates have limited the willingness of health care providers to accept Medicaid patients, leading to access problems in many communities. This problem has been especially acute in the case of dental care. We combine data from several sources to examine the effect of payment rates on access to dental care among children on Medicaid and on dentists' participation in the program. The main utilization analysis is based on data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation combined with data on Medicaid payment rates and private market dental fees for the years 2001 to 2010. Conditioning on state fixed effects, we find a modest, but statistically significant, positive relationship between Medicaid payment rates and several measures of dental care utilization. We find a comparable effect in aggregate data reported by state Medicaid programs. The most likely explanation for this result is that higher fees increase the number of dentists that accept Medicaid patients. We test this hypothesis directly using data from annual surveys of dentists conducted by the American Dental Association between 1999 and 2009. The results indicate a positive and statistically significant effect of Medicaid payment rates on whether a dentist treats any publicly insured patients and the percent of the practice's patients who have public insurance. Similar to the utilization results, the magnitude of the effect is relatively small. As a result, the estimates imply that increasing Medicaid payments to the level of private market fees would increase access to care, but the incremental cost of the additional visits induced would be very high.

10.3386/w19218.abstractZh: 历史上，较低的医疗补助报销率限制了医疗服务提供者接受医疗补助患者的意愿，导致许多社区在获得医疗服务方面存在困难。在牙科护理领域，这一问题尤为严重。我们结合多个来源的数据，研究了支付率对医疗补助儿童获得牙科护理机会的影响，以及牙医参与该计划的情况。主要的利用分析基于2001至2010年的收入与计划参与调查数据，以及医疗补助支付率和私人市场牙科费用的数据。在考虑州固定效应后，我们发现医疗补助支付率与牙科护理利用的多个指标之间存在适度但统计上显著的正相关关系。在州级医疗补助计划报告的总体数据中，也发现了类似的效果。这一结果最可能的解释是，更高的费用增加了接受医疗补助患者的牙医数量。我们直接使用美国牙科协会在1999至2009年间进行的年度牙医调查数据来检验这一假设。结果表明，医疗补助支付率对牙医是否治疗公共保险患者以及诊所患者中拥有公共保险的比例有积极且统计上显著的影响。与利用结果类似，这种影响的幅度相对较小。因此，估计结果表明，将医疗补助支付提高到与私人市场费用相当的水平，确实可以增加获得服务的机会，但由此带来的额外就诊成本将会非常高。

abstract.text: We study the effect of public health insurance eligibility on labor supply by exploiting the largest public health insurance disenrollment in the history of the United States. In 2005, approximately 170,000 Tennessee residents abruptly lost public health insurance coverage. Using both across- and within-state variation in exposure to the disenrollment, we estimate large increases in labor supply, primarily along the extensive margin. The increased employment is concentrated among individuals working at least 20 hours per week and receiving private, employer-provided health insurance. We explore the dynamic effects of the disenrollment and find an immediate increase in job search behavior and a steady rise in both employment and health insurance coverage following the disenrollment. Our results suggest a significant degree of "employment lock" - workers employed primarily in order to secure private health insurance coverage. The results also suggest that the Affordable Care Act - which similarly affects adults not traditionally eligible for public health insurance - may cause large reductions in the labor supply of low-income adults.

10.3386/w19220.abstractZh: 我们研究了公共健康保险资格对劳动力供应影响的研究，通过利用美国历史上规模最大的公共健康保险退保事件来进行分析。2005年，大约17万田纳西州居民突然失去了公共健康保险覆盖。我们同时考虑了退保事件在不同州之间的影响差异，并估计了劳动力供应的显著增加，主要体现在广泛劳动力市场上。增加的就业集中在每周工作至少20小时且接受私人雇主提供健康保险的人群中。我们进一步探讨了退保事件的动态影响，发现退保后求职行为立即增加，同时就业和健康保险覆盖率也持续上升。我们的研究结果表明，存在一定程度的“就业锁定”现象——工人主要为了获得私人健康保险而就业。此外，研究结果还表明，《平价医疗法案》——该法案同样影响了那些传统上不符合公共健康保险资格条件的成年人——可能导致低收入成年人的劳动力供应大幅减少。

abstract.text: We exploit exogenous variation in college completion induced by draft-avoidance behavior during the Vietnam War to examine the impact of college completion on adult mortality. Our preferred estimates imply that increasing college completion rates from the level of the state with the lowest induced rate to the highest would decrease cumulative mortality by 28 percent relative to the mean. Most of the reduction in mortality is from deaths due to cancer and heart disease. We also explore potential mechanisms, including differential earnings, health insurance, and health behaviors, using data from the Census, ACS, and NHIS.

10.3386/w19222.abstractZh: 我们利用越南战争期间为避免征兵而引发的大学完成率变化，来研究大学完成率对成人死亡率的影响。我们的估计结果显示，将大学完成率从最低水平的州提高到最高水平的州，累计死亡率将降低28%。死亡率降低的主要原因是由于癌症和心脏病导致的死亡。我们还利用人口普查、美国疾病控制与预防局以及国家健康统计系统的数据，探讨了潜在的机制，包括收入差异、健康保险以及健康行为等方面的影响。

abstract.text: Recent studies analyzing the effects of religion on various economic, social, health and political outcomes have been largely associational. Although some attempts have been made to establish causation using instrument variable (IV) or difference-in-difference (DID) methods, the instruments and the spatial and temporal variations used in these studies suffer from the usual issues that threaten the use of these identification techniques--validity of exclusion restrictions, quality of counterfactuals in the presence of spatial assortative sorting of people, and concern about omitted variable bias in the absence of information on family level unobservables and child-specific investment by families. During the adolescent years, religious participation might be a matter of limited choice for many individuals, as it is often heavily reliant on parents and family background more generally. Moreover, the focus of most of the studies has been on religious rites and rituals i.e., religious participation or on the intensity of participation. Using the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health, this paper analyzes the effects of a broad set of measures of religiosity on substance use at different stages of the life course. In contrast to previous studies, we find positive effects of religion on reducing all addictive substance use during adolescence, but not in a consistent fashion during the later years for any other illicit drugs except for crystal meth and marijuana.

10.3386/w19225.abstractZh: 近期关于宗教对各类经济、社会、健康和政治结果影响的研究大多采用关联分析的方法。尽管一些研究尝试使用工具变量或差异-差异方法来确定因果关系，但这些研究所使用的工具以及空间和时间上的变化存在常见的问题，这些问题威胁着这些识别技术的有效性——包括排除限制的合理性、在人们存在空间选择性排序的情况下反事实假设的质量，以及在没有家庭层面不可观测变量和家庭对儿童特定投资信息的情况下对遗漏变量偏差的担忧。在青少年时期，宗教参与对许多人来说可能是有限的选择，因为它往往依赖于父母和家庭背景。此外，大多数研究关注的是宗教仪式或宗教参与的强度。本文利用《全国青少年健康纵向研究》的数据，分析了宗教性指标对生命历程不同阶段物质使用的影响。与以往的研究不同，我们发现宗教对减少青少年时期所有成瘾性物质的使用有积极影响，但在后期年份中，除了冰毒和大麻之外，宗教对其他非法药物的使用并没有一致的影响。

abstract.text: Iodine deficiency is the leading cause of preventable mental retardation in the world today. The condition, which was common in the developed world until the introduction of iodized salt in the 1920s, is connected to low iodine levels in the soil and water. We examine the impact of salt iodization on cognitive outcomes in the US by taking advantage of this natural geographic variation. Salt was iodized over a very short period of time beginning in 1924. We use military data collected during WWI and WWII to compare outcomes of cohorts born before and after iodization, in localities that were naturally poor and rich in iodine. We find that for the one quarter of the population most deficient in iodine this intervention raised IQ by approximately one standard deviation. Our results can explain roughly one decade's worth of the upwardtrend in IQ in the US (the Flynn Effect). We also document a large increase in thyroid related deaths following the countrywide adoption of iodized salt, which affected mostly older individuals in localities with high prevalence of iodine deficiency.

10.3386/w19233.abstractZh: 碘缺乏是当今世界上导致可预防智力障碍的主要原因。在20世纪20年代碘盐引入之前，这种情况在发达国家较为常见，与土壤和水中碘含量低有关。我们利用这种自然地理差异，研究了碘盐添加对美国认知结果的影响。碘盐添加工作仅在很短的时间内开始，即1924年。我们利用了第一次世界大战和第二次世界大战期间收集的军事数据，比较了在碘含量自然较低和较高的地区，碘盐添加前后出生的群体的认知结果。研究发现，对于碘缺乏最严重的四分之一人口来说，这一干预措施使智商提高了大约一个标准差。我们的研究结果可以解释美国智商水平上升趋势中的大约十年时间（即弗林效应）。我们还发现，在全国范围内采用碘盐后，与甲状腺相关的死亡人数显著增加，这一影响主要出现在碘缺乏率较高的地区的老年人中。

abstract.text: Previous studies have shown that recessions are typically associated with better health and health behaviors. However, majority of these studies use data from the periods of relatively milder economic downturns that predate the “Great Recession.” In this paper, we examine the relationship between measures of macroeconomic conditions and a large set of outcomes of health and health behaviors using data from BRFSS between 1990 and 2014 with an emphasis on the period enveloping the Great Recession. Our results provide some support for the notion that weaker macroeconomic conditions are positively associated with health related outcomes, although the evidence is stronger for some of the outcomes (e.g., smoking and physical exercise) than others and is not present for some of the other outcomes (e.g., experiencing poor mental health) at all. But overall, the estimates are too small and imprecisely estimated to have any meaningful implications. Furthermore, the estimates become weaker over time and largely disappear in years prior to the period of the Great Recession and continues to remain small during periods enveloping the recession and the afterwards. Overall, we found no evidence that the Great Recession had a significant influence on the existing trends in health and health behaviors.

10.3386/w19234.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，经济衰退通常与更好的健康状况和健康行为相关。然而，大多数这些研究使用的是“大衰退”之前相对较为温和的经济下滑时期的数据。在本文中，我们利用1990年至2014年间的人口健康调查数据，研究了宏观经济状况指标与一系列健康及健康行为结果之间的关系，重点关注“大衰退”期间的状况。我们的研究结果部分支持了较弱的宏观经济状况与健康相关结果呈正相关的观点，不过某些结果（如吸烟和体育锻炼）的关联更为明显，而另一些结果（如心理健康状况）则完全没有这种关联。但总体而言，这些估计值太小且估计精度不足，无法得出有意义的结论。此外，随着时间的推移，这些估计值逐渐减弱，在“大衰退”之前的年份几乎不存在，而在“大衰退”期间及其之后的时期仍然保持较低水平。总的来说，我们没有发现“大衰退”对现有健康及健康行为趋势有显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper provides new evidence on the interaction between patient information and financial incentives in physician induced demand (PID). Using rich microdata on childbirth, we compare the treatment of physicians when they are patients with that of comparable non-physicians. We exploit a unique institutional feature of California to determine how inducement varies with obstetricians' financial incentives. Consistent with PID, physicians are almost 10 percent less likely to receive a C-section, with only a quarter of this effect attributable to differential sorting of patients to hospitals or obstetricians. Financial incentives have a large effect on C-section probabilities for non-physicians, but physician-patients are relatively unaffected. Physicians also have better health outcomes, suggesting overuse of C-sections adversely impacts patient health.

10.3386/w19242.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于患者信息与财务激励在医生诱导需求中的相互作用的新证据。我们利用关于分娩的丰富微观数据，比较了医生作为患者与非医生在治疗方案上的差异。通过利用加利福尼亚州独特的制度特征，我们研究了激励因素如何随妇产科医生的财务激励而变化。与医生诱导需求理论一致，医生接受剖宫产手术的概率降低了近10%，其中仅有四分之一的效应可归因于患者被分配到不同医院或妇产科医生的情况。对于非医生而言，财务激励对剖宫产概率有显著影响，但医生与患者之间的关系相对不受影响。医生自身的健康状况也更好，这表明过度使用剖宫产手术会对患者健康产生不利影响。

abstract.text: This paper addresses the role of tropical disease in rural demography and land use rights, using data from Onchocerciasis (river blindness) control in Burkina Faso. We combine a new survey of village elders with historical census data for 1975-2006 and geocoded maps of treatment under the regional Onchocerciasis Control Program (OCP). The OCP ran from 1975 to 2002, first spraying rivers to stop transmission and then distributing medicine to help those already infected. Controlling for time and village fixed effects, we find that villages in treated areas acquired larger populations and also had more cropland transactions, fewer permits required for cropland transactions, and more regulation of common property pasture and forest. These effects are robust to numerous controls and tests for heterogeneity across the sample, including time-varying region fixed effects. Descriptive statistics suggest that treated villages also acquired closer access to electricity and telephone service, markets, wells and primary schools, with no difference in several other variables. These results are consistent with both changes in productivity and effects of population size on public institutions.

10.3386/w19245.abstractZh: 本文探讨了热带疾病在农村人口统计和土地使用权利中的作用，以布基纳法索河盲症控制项目的数据为研究基础。我们结合了对村长的新一轮调查、1975至2006年的历史人口普查数据，以及该地区河盲症控制项目下的地理编码治疗地图。该控制项目从1975年持续到2002年，最初通过喷洒药物来阻止疾病的传播，随后则向感染者分发药物。在控制时间和村庄固定效应后，我们发现受治疗地区的村庄人口规模更大，耕地交易次数更多，耕地交易所需的许可数量更少，对公共牧场和森林的管理也更为严格。这些效应在多种控制因素和样本异质性检验中依然成立，包括随时间变化的地区固定效应。描述性统计表明，受治疗的村庄还获得了更便捷的电力和电话服务、市场、水井和小学设施，而其他几个变量则没有显著差异。这些结果与生产力变化以及人口规模对公共机构的影响相一致。

abstract.text: We investigate the role of physician agency and competition in determining health care supply and patient outcomes. A 2005 change to Medicare fees had a large, negative impact on physician profit margins for providing chemotherapy treatment. In response to these cuts, physicians increased their provision of chemotherapy and changed the mix of chemotherapy drugs they administered. The increase in treatment improved patient survival. These changes were larger in states that experienced larger decreases in physician profit margins. Finally while physician response was larger in more competitive markets, survival improvements were larger in less competitive markets.
