10.3386/w19247.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生代理和竞争在决定医疗服务供给和患者结果中的作用。2005年对医疗保险费率的调整对提供化疗治疗的医生利润带来了巨大的负面影响。作为对这一削减的回应，医生增加了化疗服务的提供，并改变了他们使用的化疗药物种类。治疗量的增加提高了患者的生存几率。在医生利润下降幅度较大的州，这些改变更为显著。最后，虽然在竞争更激烈的市场中，医生的反应更为积极，但在竞争较弱的市场中，生存改善的效果更为明显。

abstract.text: Why have some poor countries been able to take off while others are still stuck in the poverty trap? To address this old question, we observe that (i) with similar or higher levels of educational attainment, trapped countries tend to have much poorer health conditions compared to the initially poor countries that later took off, and (ii) improving health conditions in poor countries usually involves large-scale investment where such resources can be easily misallocated. We construct a dynamic general equilibrium model with endogenous health and knowledge accumulation, allowing health-related institutional barriers to affect individual incentives and equilibrium outcomes. We then calibrate the model to fit (i) the U.S. economy (as a benchmark), (ii) a representative trapped economy based on the average economic performance and economic conditions of 41 countries that are still in the poverty trap, (iii) a group of trapped economies with richer institutional data (Bangladesh, Kenya and Nigeria), and (iv) two initially poor countries that later took off (China and India). The results show that, although low among all countries in this study, the U.S. economy still faced a health-related institutional barrier of 15%. The trapped economies all suffered much large barriers ranging from 50% to 73% under which the incentive to invest in health is severely hindered. For China and India, the magnitudes of such barriers were large (about twice as much as for the U.S. and half that for the trapped economies on average) but not enough to undermine the willingness to invest in health. This paper thereby advances our understanding of the role played by barriers to health in the poverty trap.

10.3386/w19263.abstractZh: 为什么一些贫穷国家能够摆脱贫困，而其他国家却仍然陷入贫困陷阱？为了解答这个问题，我们发现：(i)在受教育程度相似或更高的情况下，陷入贫困的国家往往比后来摆脱贫困的国家有着更糟糕的健康状况；(ii)改善贫穷国家的健康状况通常需要大规模投资，而这些资源很容易被误用。我们构建了一个动态一般均衡模型，其中健康和知识积累是内生变量，使得与健康相关的制度障碍能够影响个体激励和均衡结果。然后，我们对模型进行了校准，以拟合：(i)美国经济作为基准；(ii)基于41个仍处于贫困陷阱中的国家的平均经济表现和经济状况的代表性陷入贫困的经济体；(iii)拥有更丰富制度数据的陷入贫困的经济体（如孟加拉国、肯尼亚和尼日利亚）；(iv)两个后来摆脱贫困的贫穷国家（中国和印度）。结果显示，尽管在所有研究国家中美国的经济体面临的与健康相关的制度障碍最低，仅为15%。其他陷入贫困的经济体则面临高达50%至73%的巨大障碍，这严重阻碍了投资健康领域的意愿。对于中国和印度来说，这些障碍的严重程度虽然很高（约为美国的两倍，是平均陷入贫困经济体的二分之一），但还不足以削弱它们投资健康的意愿。本文因此加深了我们对健康障碍在贫困陷阱中所起作用的理解。

abstract.text: The question of whether morbidity is being compressed into the period just before death has been at the center of health debates in the United States for some time. Compression of morbidity would lead to longer life but less rapid medical spending increases than if life extension were accompanied by expanding morbidity. Using nearly 20 years of data from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey, we examine how health is changing by time period until death. We show that functional measures of health are improving, and more so the farther away from death the person is surveyed. Disease rates are relatively constant at all times until death. On net, there is strong evidence for compression of morbidity based on measured disability, but less clear evidence based on disease-free survival.

10.3386/w19268.abstractZh: 关于疾病负担是否集中在死亡前的时期这一议题，长期以来一直是美国健康领域的讨论焦点。疾病负担的集中化意味着寿命延长，但医疗费用的增长幅度会比延长寿命伴随疾病负担增加的情况要小。我们利用Medicare当前受益人调查近20年的数据，研究了健康状况随时间的变化情况。结果显示，功能性的健康指标在改善，且距离死亡越远的个体，健康状况改善得越明显。疾病发生率在死亡前一段时间内相对稳定。总体而言，基于残疾情况的测量数据表明疾病负担存在集中化的趋势，但基于无病生存期的数据则缺乏明确的证据。

abstract.text: Previous research studying the correlation in smoking behavior between spouses has discounted the role of bargaining or learning. Using the Health and Retirement Study (HRS), which contains information on smoking cessation and spouse's preferences, this paper presents an essential investigation of the importance of spousal bargaining or learning on the decision to cease smoking. We find, regardless of gender, when one member of couple ceases smoking this induces the other member to cease smoking through bargaining. Further, we find females demonstrate either altruistic behavior toward a spouse, who has suffered a health shock, or learning from their spouse's health shock.

10.3386/w19274.abstractZh: 先前关于配偶之间吸烟行为相关性的研究忽视了讨价还价或学习的作用。本研究利用包含吸烟戒烟及配偶偏好信息的健康与退休研究数据，对配偶讨价还价或学习对戒烟决策的重要性进行了深入探讨。研究发现，无论性别如何，当一方停止吸烟时，另一方也会通过讨价还价而停止吸烟。此外，我们发现女性在面对配偶遭遇健康冲击时，表现出利他行为，或者从配偶的经历中学习。

abstract.text: Perhaps because health care is a local service sector, health economists have paid little attention to international linkages between domestic health care economies. However, the growth in domestic health care sectors is often attributed to medical innovations whose returns are earned worldwide. Because world returns drive innovation and innovation is central to spending growth, spending growth in a given country is thereby highly affected by health care economies and policies of other countries. This paper analyzes the unique positive and normative implications of these innovation-induced linkages across countries when governments centrally price health care. Providing world returns to medical innovation under such central pricing involves a public-goods problem; the taxation to fund reimbursements involves a private domestic cost with an international benefit of medical innovation. This has the direct normative implication that medical innovations have inefficiently low world returns. It also has the positive implication that reimbursements in one country depend negatively on those of others; reimbursements are "strategic substitutes" through free riding. Because reimbursements are strategic substitutes, world concentration of health care is a significant issue. A small European country has no access-innovation trade-off in its pricing; it will have low reimbursements because it does not affect world returns and sees the same innovations regardless of its reimbursement policy. The public-goods problem of innovation thereby implies that the United States, despite being the world's largest buyer, will pay the highest reimbursements. This problem also implies that free riding counteracts the standard positive impact of larger world markets on innovation when health care concentration falls. Indeed, currently, health care is highly concentrated; about half of world health care spending occurs in the United States, despite that fact that it makes up only about one-fifth of the world economy. We assess the effect that emerging markets will have on this concentration and thus world returns. We use pharmaceutical reimbursement data from 1996-2010 to provide IV estimates of the degree to which domestic reimbursements are strategic substitutes. We find that these estimates imply that world returns from innovation may actually fall from a growth in "market size" of BRICS countries as a result of increased free riding in non-BRICS countries. The overall analysis has important positive implications for spending patterns across countries as well as normative implications for evaluating domestic or regional health care reforms.

10.3386/w19280.abstractZh: 或许因为医疗保健属于本地服务行业，健康经济学家很少关注国内医疗保健经济之间的国际联系。然而，国内医疗保健领域的增长往往归功于医学创新，而这些创新的收益是在全球范围内获得的。由于全球收益推动着创新，而创新又是支出增长的核心，因此一个国家的支出增长会受到其他国家医疗保健经济和政策的影响。本文分析了在政府对医疗保健进行集中定价时，这些由创新引发的跨国联系所带来的独特积极和规范性影响。在集中定价下为医学创新提供全球收益涉及公共物品问题；用于资助报销的税收则涉及国内私人成本，但医学创新却具有国际效益。这直接表明医学创新的全球收益过低。此外，一个国家的报销金额会受其他国家报销金额的影响，报销金额成为“战略替代品”，通过免费搭便车的方式实现。由于报销是战略替代品，医疗保健的全球集中程度成为一个重要问题。一个小的欧洲国家在其定价中没有创新与成本之间的权衡；由于其不影响全球收益，并且无论其报销政策如何，都会看到相同的创新成果，因此其报销金额将会很低。创新的公共物品问题意味着，尽管美国是全球最大的购买者，但它将支付最高的报销金额。这个问题还表明，当医疗保健集中程度下降时，免费搭便车的行为会抵消更大全球市场对创新的积极影响。事实上，目前医疗保健行业高度集中；尽管美国只占世界经济的五分之一，但约有一半的全球医疗保健支出发生在美国。我们评估了新兴市场对该行业集中程度的影响，以及由此带来的全球回报变化。我们利用1996年至2010年的药品报销数据，对国内报销作为战略替代品的程度进行了估算。研究发现，这些估算表明，由于非金砖国家国家的免费搭车行为增加，金砖国家“市场规模”的增长实际上可能导致全球创新的回报下降。这项整体分析对各国支出模式具有重要的积极意义，同时也为评估国内或区域性的医疗保健改革提供了参考。

abstract.text: This paper uses data from the universe of tax returns filed between 2001 and 2010 to test whether parents shift the timing of childbirth around the New Year to gain tax benefits. Filers have an incentive to shift births from early January into late December, through induction or cesarean delivery, because child-related tax benefits are not prorated. We find evidence of a positive, but very small, effect of tax incentives on birth timing. An additional $1000 of tax benefits increases the probability of a late-December birth by only about 1 percentage point. We argue that the response to tax incentives is small in part because of confusion about eligibility and delays in the issuance of Social Security Numbers for newborns, as well as a lack of control over medical procedures on the part of filers with the highest tax values. We also document a precise shifting of reported self-employment income in response to variation in incentives from the Earned Income Tax Credit due to childbirth. We estimate that this reporting response reduces federal revenue by hundreds of millions of dollars per year.

10.3386/w19283.abstractZh: 本文利用2001至2010年间提交的纳税申报表数据，检验了父母是否会在新年期间调整分娩时间以获得税收优惠。纳税人有动机将分娩时间从1月初推迟到12月底，通过引产或剖腹产来实现这一点，因为与儿童相关的税收优惠不会按比例分配。我们发现，税收优惠对分娩时间的影响虽然存在，但非常微小。额外的1000美元税收优惠仅使12月分娩的概率增加约1个百分点。我们认为，对税收优惠的响应之所以如此微弱，部分原因是关于税收优惠资格方面的困惑，以及新生儿社会保障号码的发放延迟，此外，税收负担较重的纳税人还无法控制医疗程序。我们还发现，由于分娩导致的劳动收入激励变化，纳税申报中的自雇收入也出现了精确的调整。据估计，这种纳税申报方式的调整每年会减少数亿美元的联邦收入。

abstract.text: Using data from multiple sources, over the 1976-2009 period, I show that total mortality has shifted over time from strongly procyclical to being essentially unrelated to macroeconomic conditions. The relationship also shows some instability over time and is likely to be poorly measured when using short (less than 15 or 20 year) analysis periods. The secular change in the association between macroeconomic conditions and overall mortality primarily reflects trends in effects for specific causes of death, rather than changes in the composition of total mortality across causes. Deaths due to cardiovascular disease and transport accidents continue to be procyclical (although possibly less so than in the past), whereas strong countercyclical patterns of cancer fatalities and some external sources of death (particularly those due to accidental poisoning) have emerged over time. The changing effect of macroeconomic conditions on cancer deaths may partially reflect the increasing protective influence of financial resources, perhaps because these can be used to obtain sophisticated (and expensive) treatments that have become available in recent years. That observed for accidental poisoning probably has occurred because declines in mental health during economic downturns are increasingly associated with the use of prescribed or illicitly obtained medications that carry risks of fatal overdoses.

10.3386/w19287.abstractZh: 通过1976年至2009年期间的多源数据分析，我发现总死亡率随时间的变化趋势从强烈顺周期性转变为与宏观经济状况基本无关。这种关系随时间表现出一定的不稳定性，在较短的分析周期（小于15或20年）内可能难以准确测量。宏观经济状况与总死亡率之间长期变化的关联主要反映了特定死因的影响趋势，而非各死因在总死亡率构成上的变化。心血管疾病和交通事故导致的死亡仍然表现出顺周期性（尽管可能不如过去那么明显），而癌症死亡以及一些外部死因（尤其是意外中毒）则表现出强烈的逆周期性。宏观经济状况对癌症死亡影响的变化可能部分反映了金融资源的保护作用增强，这可能是因为近年来出现了能够获得复杂且昂贵治疗的手段。意外中毒现象的出现，可能是由于经济衰退期间心理健康状况的下降与处方药物或非法获取的药物使用有关，这些药物存在致命过量风险。

abstract.text: This paper sheds light on previous inconsistencies identified in the literature regarding the relationship between medical marijuana laws (MML) and recreational marijuana use by closely examining the importance of policy dimensions (registration requirements, home cultivation, dispensaries) and the timing of them. Using data from our own legal analysis of state MMLs, we evaluate which features are associated with adult and youth recreational use by linking these policy variables to data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY97), the Youth Risk Behavior Survey (YRBS) and the Treatment Episodes Data System (TEDS). Our analyses control for state and year fixed effects, using within state policy changes over time to estimate the effect on changes in our outcome variables using a difference-in-differences approach. We find that while simple dichotomous indicators are generally not associated with marijuana use, specific dimensions of MMLs, namely home cultivation and legal dispensaries, are positively associated with marijuana use in each data set. Moreover, these same dimensions are tied to binge drinking and fatal alcohol automobile accidents as well. The findings have important implications for states considering legalization of marijuana, as regulating access to and promotion of dispensaries may be key for reducing the harms associated with these policies.

10.3386/w19302.abstractZh: 本文通过深入研究政策维度（注册要求、家庭种植、诊所）及其实施时机，揭示了文献中先前关于医用大麻法律与娱乐性大麻使用之间关系的不一致之处。我们基于自己对各州医用大麻法律的分析数据，评估了哪些政策因素与成人和青少年娱乐性大麻使用相关，并将这些政策变量与《全国青年纵向调查》（NLSY97）、《青年风险行为调查》（YRBS）以及《治疗事件数据系统》（TEDS）的数据进行关联分析。我们的研究控制了州和年份的固定效应，通过州内政策随时间的变化来估计对结果变量变化的影响，采用了差异-差异方法进行分析。研究发现，虽然简单的二分指标通常与大麻使用无关，但医用大麻法律中的特定维度，如家庭种植和合法诊所，与每个数据集中的大麻使用呈正相关。此外，这些维度还与酗酒和致命的酒精驾驶事故有关。这些发现对于考虑大麻合法化的州具有重要意义，因为规范诊所的准入和推广可能是减少这些政策带来的危害的关键措施。

abstract.text: The extant literature on cultural transmission takes competing cultures in society as given and parental cultural preferences as fixed. We relax these assumptions by endogenizing both societal and parental preferences. We use smoking as a case-study of a cultural trait which did not always exist, and which over time has switched from being perceived as socially acceptable to being perceived as undesirable. In our model, parents' preferred cultural traits depend on the perceived health costs of smoking, and societal preferences depend on the behavior of a tobacco industry that aims to maximize smoking prevalence. We derive conditions for the emergence and persistence of the smoking habit, and find new implications for the relationship between parental and societal influences. We then test explicitly for the validity of our theoretical framework using novel US data. We find that our framework is able to capture features of smoking behavior which existing models are unable to explain.

10.3386/w19304.abstractZh: 现有关于文化传播的文献通常将社会中的竞争文化视为既定事实，而父母的文化偏好也被认为是固定的。我们通过使社会偏好和父母偏好具有内生性来放宽这些假设。我们以吸烟这一文化特征作为案例研究，这一特征并非一直存在，并且随着时间的推移，其社会接受度逐渐下降，最终被视为不受欢迎。在我们的模型中，父母所偏好的文化特征取决于吸烟带来的健康成本，而社会偏好则取决于烟草行业试图最大化吸烟普及率的行为。我们推导出了吸烟习惯出现和持续存在的条件，并发现了关于父母与社会影响之间关系的新的启示。随后，我们使用新的美国数据来明确验证我们的理论框架的有效性。我们发现，我们的框架能够捕捉到现有模型无法解释的一些吸烟行为特征。

abstract.text: Cigarettes are experience goods - most of their utility value only gets revealed when one consumes them. We hypothesize a three phase consumer life cycle for experience goods. Consumers initially do not know their utility from the good or their preferences for particular characteristics, and may initially choose the most familiar brand. In the second phase, they are informed about the good and may experiment with different brands. In the third phase, they may become loyal to one brand or exit the market. Firms could target price discounts for each phase, either to encourage experimentation (pay-to-switch), to retain customers (pay-to-stay), or to price-discriminate. We use market-level data on price, sales, in-store discounts, and coupon offers of 15 brands from 1995 to 2007 and individual-level data on brand choices from 1995 to 2004 to explore whether firms discount cigarettes in ways consistent with a life-cycle consumption model. We find that the three highest-selling brands primarily discount as price discrimination and pay-to-stay strategies, while smaller, specialty brands discount to encourage smokers to switch brands.

10.3386/w19310.abstractZh: 香烟属于体验型商品——其大部分效用价值只有在消费者实际消费时才会显现。我们提出了一种体验型商品的消费生命周期模型。消费者最初并不了解该商品的效用或对其特定特性的偏好，可能会选择最熟悉的品牌。在第二阶段，他们会对商品有所了解，并可以尝试不同品牌。在第三阶段，他们可能会对一个品牌产生忠诚度，或者退出市场。企业可以在每个阶段采取价格折扣策略，以鼓励消费者尝试不同品牌（支付转换费）、留住顾客（支付留用费），或进行价格歧视。我们利用了1995年至2007年间15个品牌的价格、销量、店内折扣和优惠券信息，以及1995年至2004年间消费者选择品牌的个体数据，来探讨企业是否以符合生命周期消费模型的方式对香烟进行折扣。研究发现，销量最高的三个品牌主要通过价格歧视和留用策略进行折扣，而规模较小、专业性较强的品牌则通过折扣来鼓励消费者更换品牌。

abstract.text: Starting in 2006, respondents in the U.S. Health and Retirement Study were asked to submit biomarkers and were notified of certain results. Respondents with very high blood pressure were given a card during the interview; all respondents were notified by mail of their BP, hemoglobin A1c, and total and HDL cholesterol readings alongside recommended thresholds. About 5.8 percent received the high blood pressure card, and 5.4 percent had high A1c levels, an indicator of diabetes. Rates of undiagnosed high BP and diabetes according to these biomarkers were 1.5 and 0.7 percent. Average treatment effects of biomarker collection on the panel overall were effectively zero, but notification of rare and dangerous readings triggered new diagnoses, increased pharmaceutical usage, and altered health behaviors among small subsamples of respondents and their spouses. Very high BP or A1c readings raised new diagnosis and medication usage by 20 to 40 percentage points. Uncontrolled high BP triggered reductions in own smoking and own and spouse's drinking. High A1c was associated with a 2.2 percent drop in weight and an increase in exercise among respondents without a previous diagnosis of diabetes, but with no changes among those already diagnosed, whose self-reported health and disability worsened.

10.3386/w19311.abstractZh: 自2006年起，美国健康与退休研究中的受访者被要求提交生物标志物数据，并被告知某些结果。血压极高的受访者在访谈期间会收到一张卡片；所有受访者都会通过邮件收到关于他们的血压、血红蛋白A1c以及总胆固醇和高密度脂蛋白胆固醇的读数以及推荐的阈值。大约5.8%的受访者收到了高血压卡片，5.4%的受访者A1c水平较高，这是糖尿病的一个指标。根据这些生物标志物数据，未诊断出的高血压和糖尿病的比例分别为1.5%和0.7%。总体而言，收集生物标志物数据对整体样本的平均治疗效果几乎为零，但对于少数出现罕见且危险读数的受访者，会触发新的诊断、增加药物使用，并改变其健康行为。血压或A1c读数极高时，新诊断和药物使用的比例分别增加了20%到40%。未控制的高血压会导致个人吸烟量和配偶饮酒量的减少。对于之前未诊断出糖尿病的受访者，A1c水平较高与体重下降2.2%和运动量增加有关，但对于已经确诊的受访者来说，这种情况并没有改变，他们的自我报告健康状况和残疾状况反而恶化了。

abstract.text: Household investment in preventative health products is low in developing countries even though benefits from these products are very high. What interventions most effectively stimulate demand? In this paper, we experimentally estimate demand curves for health products in Kenya, Guatemala, India, and Uganda and test whether (1) information about health risk, (2) cash liquidity, (3) peer effects, and (4) intra-household differences in preferences affect demand. We find households to be highly sensitive to price and that both liquidity and targeting women increase demand. We find no effect of providing information, although genuine learning occurred, and we find no evidence of peer effects, although subjects discussed the product purchase decision extensively.

10.3386/w19312.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，家庭对预防性健康产品的投资较低，尽管这些产品的效益非常高。哪些干预措施能最有效地刺激需求呢？在本文中，我们通过实验方法估算了肯尼亚、危地马拉、印度和乌干达的健康产品需求曲线，并检验了以下因素是否影响需求：（1）健康风险相关信息；（2）现金流动性；（3）同伴效应；（4）家庭内部偏好差异。我们发现，家庭对价格非常敏感，而现金流动性和针对女性的产品都能增加需求。我们并未发现提供信息对需求有显著影响，尽管确实发生了学习效应；同时，也没有证据表明存在同伴效应，尽管参与者广泛讨论了产品购买决策。

abstract.text: There is considerable controversy about the causes of regional variations in health care expenditures. Using vignettes from patient and physician surveys linked to fee-for-service Medicare expenditures, this study asks whether patient demand-side factors or physician supply-side factors explain these variations. The results indicate that patient demand is relatively unimportant in explaining variations. Physician organizational factors matter, but the most important factor is physician beliefs about treatment. In Medicare, we estimate that 35 percent of spending for end-of-life care, and 12 percent of spending for heart attack patients (and for all enrollees) is associated with physician beliefs unsupported by clinical evidence.

10.3386/w19320.abstractZh: 关于医疗保健支出区域差异的原因存在相当大的争议。本研究利用与按服务收费的医疗保险支出相关的患者和医生调查数据，探讨是患者需求方面的因素还是医生供应方面的因素导致了这些差异。研究结果表明，患者需求在解释这些差异方面相对不重要。医生组织因素确实重要，但最重要的因素是医生对治疗的看法。在医疗保险体系中，我们估计有35%的临终关怀支出，以及12%的心脏病患者（以及所有参保人的）支出，与没有临床依据的医生看法有关。

abstract.text: We estimate an insurer-specific preference function which rationalizes hospital referrals for privately-insured births in California. The function is additively separable in: a hospital price paid by the insurer, the distance traveled, and plan and severity-specific hospital fixed effects (capturing hospital quality). We use an inequality estimator that allows for errors in price and detailed hospital-severity interactions and obtain markedly different results than those from a logit. The estimates indicate that insurers with more capitated physicians are more responsive to price. Capitated plans send patients further to utilize similar-quality lower-priced hospitals; but the cost-quality trade-off does not vary with capitation rates.

10.3386/w19333.abstractZh: 我们估计了一个与保险公司相关的偏好函数，该函数用于解释加利福尼亚州私人保险客户分娩时医院转诊的合理性。该函数在以下三个因素之间是可加分的：保险公司支付的医院费用、旅行距离，以及计划类型和病情严重程度相关的医院固定效应（反映医院质量）。我们采用了一种不平等估计方法，该方法允许对价格和详细医院-病情交互作用进行误差处理，并得出了与逻辑模型截然不同的结果。估计结果显示，拥有更多固定费用医生的保险公司对价格的敏感度更高。固定费用计划促使患者前往质量相似但价格较低的医院；但成本与质量的权衡并不随固定费用率的变化而变化。

abstract.text: This paper provides estimates of the economic impact of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) in China and India for the period 2012-2030. Our estimates are derived using WHO's EPIC model of economic growth, which focuses on the negative effects of NCDs on labor supply and capital accumulation. We present results for the five main NCDs (cardiovascular disease, cancer, chronic respiratory disease, diabetes, and mental health). Our undiscounted estimates indicate that the cost of the five main NCDs will total USD 27.8 trillion for China and USD 6.2 trillion for India (in 2010 USD). For both countries, the most costly domains are cardiovascular disease and mental health, followed by respiratory disease. Our analyses also reveal that the costs are much larger in China than in India mainly because of China's higher income and older population. Rough calculations also indicate that WHO's Best Buys for addressing the challenge of NCDs are highly cost-beneficial.

10.3386/w19335.abstractZh: 本文提供了2012年至2030年间中国与印度非传染性疾病（NCDs）经济影响的估算结果。我们的估算基于世界卫生组织EPIC经济增长模型，该模型重点关注NCDs对劳动力供应和资本积累的负面影响。我们针对五种主要NCDs（心血管疾病、癌症、慢性呼吸系统疾病、糖尿病和心理健康问题）进行了分析。未经折现的估算结果显示，这五种主要NCDs在中国的总成本将达到27.8万亿美元，在印度则达到6.2万亿美元（按2010年美元价值计算）。在这两个国家中，心血管疾病和心理健康问题所涉及的成本最高，其次是呼吸系统疾病。我们的分析还表明，由于中国的收入水平和人口老龄化程度较高，中国的相关成本远高于印度。粗略的计算表明，世界卫生组织提出的应对NCDs挑战的最佳方案在成本效益方面非常显著。

abstract.text: Health insurance markets in the United States are characterized by imperfect information, complex products, and substantial search frictions. Insurance agents and brokers play a significant role in helping employers navigate these problems. However, little is known about the relation between the structure of the agent/broker market and access and affordability of insurance. This paper aims to fill this gap by investigating the influence of agents/brokers on health insurance decisions of small firms, which are particularly vulnerable to problems of financing health insurance. Using a unique membership database from the National Association of Health Underwriters together with a nationally representative survey of employers, we find that small firms in more competitive agent/broker markets are more likely to offer health insurance and at lower premiums. Moreover, premiums are less dispersed in more competitive agent/broker markets.

10.3386/w19342.abstractZh: 美国的健康保险市场具有信息不完美、产品复杂以及搜索成本较高的特点。保险代理人和经纪人在这些问题的解决中发挥着重要作用。然而，关于代理/经纪人市场的结构与保险获取性和可负担性之间的关系，目前了解甚少。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过研究代理/经纪人对小型企业健康保险决策的影响，这些企业特别容易面临健康保险融资问题。我们利用全国健康保险协会提供的独特会员数据库，并结合一项具有全国代表性的雇主调查，发现处于竞争更激烈的代理/经纪人市场中的小型企业更有可能提供健康保险，并且保费也更低。此外，在竞争更激烈的代理/经纪人市场中，保费的分布也更加集中。

abstract.text: The rise of childhood obesity in less developed countries is often overlooked. We study the impact of body weight report cards in Mexico. The report cards increased parental knowledge and shifted parental attitudes about children's weight. We observe no meaningful changes in parental behaviors or children's body mass index. Interestingly, parents of children in the most obese classrooms were less likely to report that their obese child weighed too much relative to those in the least obese classrooms. As obesity rates increase, reference points for appropriate body weights may rise, making it more difficult to lower obesity rates.

10.3386/w19344.abstractZh: 在欠发达国家，儿童肥胖问题的上升往往被忽视。我们研究了墨西哥体重报告卡的影响。这些报告卡增加了家长的认知，并改变了家长对孩子体重的态度。然而，我们并未观察到家长行为或儿童体质指数的显著变化。有趣的是，在肥胖最严重的班级中，家长不太可能认为他们的肥胖孩子体重过重，相比之下，在肥胖最少的班级中，家长则更有可能这样认为。随着肥胖率的上升，适当体重的参考标准也可能提高，从而使得降低肥胖率变得更加困难。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act includes four significant, permanent, implicit unemployment assistance programs, plus various implicit subsidies for underemployment, and expanded Medicaid eligibility for adults. Every sector of the economy, and about half of nonelderly adults, is directly affected by at least one of those provisions. This paper calculates the ACA's impact on the average reward to working among nonelderly household heads and spouses. The law increases marginal tax rates by an average of five percentage points (of employee compensation), on top of the marginal tax rates that were already present before it went into effect. The ACA's addition to labor tax wedges is roughly equivalent to doubling both employer and employee payroll tax rates for half of the population.

10.3386/w19365.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》包含四个重要的、永久性的、隐含的失业援助计划，以及针对就业不足的各种隐性补贴，还扩大了成年人的医疗补助资格范围。经济的每个领域，以及大约一半的非老年人成年人，至少会受到其中一个条款的直接影响。本文计算了《平价医疗法案》对非老年人家庭户主和配偶的工作回报平均水平的影响。该法律在原有边际税率的基础上，平均增加了五个百分点的边际税率。该法案对劳动力税收的影响，大致相当于使一半人口的雇主和雇员工资税率翻倍。

abstract.text: Measured in percentage points, the Affordable Care Act will, by 2015, add about fourteen times more to average marginal labor income tax rates nationwide than the Massachusetts health reform added to average rates in Massachusetts following its 2006 statewide health reform. The rate impacts are different between the two laws for several reasons, especially that: the populations subject to the two laws are different, the Affordable Care Act's employer penalty is an order of magnitude greater, before either reform Massachusetts had already been offering more means-tested and employment-tested health insurance assistance than other states had, and the subsidized health insurance plans created by the Massachusetts reform were less substitutable for employer-provided insurance than are the subsidized plans to be created nationwide next year.

10.3386/w19366.abstractZh: 以百分比点计算，到2015年，《平价医疗法案》将使全国平均边际劳动所得税率增加约14倍，而马萨诸塞州2006年健康改革措施对当地平均税率的影响仅为14倍。这两种法律对税率的影响有所不同，原因主要有以下几点：首先，受这两种法律影响的群体不同；其次，《平价医疗法案》中的雇主罚款幅度要大得多；此外，在马萨诸塞州进行改革之前，该州已经提供了比其他州更多的基于经济状况和就业情况的健康保险援助；最后，马萨诸塞州改革措施所创建的补贴型健康保险计划，其替代性不如明年全国范围内将创建的补贴型保险计划。

abstract.text: Generic drugs comprise an increasing share of total prescriptions dispensed in the U.S., rising from nearly 50 percent in 1999 to 75 percent in 2009. The generic drug market has typically been viewed at the wholesale level as a competitive market with price approaching marginal costs. However, the large presence of third party payers as final purchasers may distort prices at the retail level relative to what a standard model of price competition would predict. In this paper, we investigate how generic drug producers compete in the presence of the procurement rules of the Medicaid program. Medicaid reimbursement to pharmacies, like that of other payers, is based on a benchmark price called the average wholesale price (AWP). The AWP is reported by generic producers themselves, and until recently has been subject to essentially no independent verification. As a result, generic producers have had an incentive to compete for pharmacy market share by reporting AWPs that exceed actual average wholesale prices, as this "spread" leads to larger pharmacy profits. In 2000, after a federal government audit of actual wholesale prices of generic products, states were advised to reduce Medicaid reimbursement by as much as 95% for about 400 generic and off-patent drug products. We use variation induced by the timing of this policy along with its differential impact on drug products' Medicaid reimbursement to estimate the impact of this exogenous price change on the market share of targeted products. Our findings indicate that pharmacies did respond to the perverse incentives of the Medicaid program by dispensing products with the highest AWPs. Overall, the Medicaid market share fell by about 45% for targeted drug products as a result of the policy.

10.3386/w19367.abstractZh: 在美国，仿制药在总处方中的占比不断增加，从1999年的近50%上升到2009年的75%。仿制药市场通常被视为在批发层面上的竞争市场，价格接近边际成本。然而，第三方支付机构作为最终购买者的大量存在可能会扭曲零售层面的价格，这与标准的价格竞争模型预测的结果不同。本文研究了在Medicaid计划的采购规则下，仿制药生产商如何竞争。Medicaid对药店的报销依据是一种称为平均批发价格的标准。平均批发价格由仿制药生产商自行报告，直到最近，这一数据几乎没有经过独立的验证。因此，仿制药生产商有动机通过报告高于实际平均批发价格的平均批发价格来争夺药店市场份额，因为这种“价差”会带来更大的利润。2000年，在联邦政府对仿制药实际批发价格进行审计后，各州被建议将Medicaid报销金额减少约95%，涉及大约400种仿制药和非专利药物。我们利用这一政策实施的时间差异及其对药物Medicaid报销的不同影响，来估算这一外部价格变化对目标产品市场份额的影响。我们的研究结果表明，药店确实响应了Medicaid计划的这种不正当激励，提供了最高平均批发价格的产品。总体而言，由于这一政策，目标药物在Medicaid市场中的份额减少了约45%。

abstract.text: Traditional models of insurance choice are predicated on fully informed and rational consumers protecting themselves from exposure to financial risk. In practice, choosing an insurance plan from a set of complex non-linear contracts is a complicated decision often made without full information on several potentially important dimensions. In this paper we combine new administrative data on health plan choices and claims with unique survey data on consumer information and other typically unobserved preference factors in order to separately identify risk preferences, information frictions, and perceived plan hassle costs. The administrative and survey data are linked at the individual level, allowing in-depth investigations of the links between these micro- foundations in both descriptive and choice-model based analyses. We find that consumers lack information on many important dimensions that they are typically assumed to understand, perceive high plan hassle costs, and make choices that depend on these frictions. Moreover, in the context of an expected utility model, including the additional frictions that we measure has direct implications for risk preference estimates, which are typically assumed to be the only source of persistent unobserved preference heterogeneity in such models. In our setting, we show that incorporating measures of these frictions leads to meaningful reductions in estimated consumer risk aversion. This result has both positive and normative implications since risk aversion generally has different welfare implications than information frictions. We assess the welfare impact of a counterfactual menu design and find that the welfare loss from risk exposure when additional frictions are not taken into account is more than double that when they are, illustrating the potential importance of our analysis for policy decisions.

10.3386/w19373.abstractZh: 传统的保险选择模型假设消费者是完全知情且理性的，能够保护自己免受财务风险的影响。但实际上，从一系列复杂的非线性保险合同中选择一份保险计划是一个复杂的决策过程，往往是在缺乏关于多个潜在重要维度的完整信息的情况下做出的。在本文中，我们结合了关于健康计划选择和索赔的新行政数据，以及关于消费者信息和其他通常未被观察到的偏好因素的独特调查数据，以分别识别风险偏好、信息摩擦和感知的保险计划麻烦成本。行政数据和调查数据在个体层面进行了关联，使得我们可以深入探究这些微观基础在描述性分析和选择模型分析中的关系。我们发现，消费者在许多重要维度上缺乏信息，他们通常认为自己能够理解这些维度；他们感知到保险计划的麻烦成本很高；他们的选择也受到这些摩擦的影响。此外，在期望效用模型的背景下，我们所测量的这些额外摩擦对风险偏好的估计有直接影响，而风险偏好通常被认为是此类模型中持续存在的未观察到的偏好异质性的唯一来源。在我们的研究中，我们发现纳入这些摩擦的度量指标能够显著降低消费者风险厌恶的估计值。这一结果既有积极的意义，也有规范性的意义，因为风险厌恶与信息摩擦在福利上的影响通常是不同的。我们评估了一种反事实菜单设计的福利影响，发现当不考虑额外的摩擦时，风险暴露带来的福利损失是考虑这些摩擦时损失的两倍多，这说明了我们的分析对于政策决策可能具有的重要意义。

abstract.text: We study the demand response to non-linear price schedules using data on insurance contracts and prescription drug purchases in Medicare Part D. Consistent with a static response of drug use to price, we document bunching of annual drug spending as individuals enter the famous "donut hole," where insurance becomes discontinuously much less generous on the margin. Consistent with a dynamic response to price, we document a response of drug use to the future out-of-pocket price by using variation in beneficiary birth month which generates variation in contract duration during the first year of eligibility. Motivated by these two facts, we develop and estimate a dynamic model of drug use during the coverage year that allows us to quantify and explore the effects of alternative contract designs on drug expenditures. For example, our estimates suggest that "filling" the donut hole, as required under the Affordable Care Act, will increase annual drug spending by $180 per beneficiary, or about 10%. Moreover, almost half of this increase is "anticipatory," coming from beneficiaries whose spending prior to the policy change would leave them short of reaching the donut hole. We also describe the nature of the utilization response and its heterogeneity across individuals and types of drugs.

10.3386/w19393.abstractZh: 我们研究了消费者对非线性价格安排的需求反应，使用了医疗保险D部分中保险合同和处方药购买数据。与药物使用对价格的静态反应一致，我们发现当个人进入著名的“甜甜圈空档”时，年度药物支出会出现聚集现象，此时保险提供的保障会突然大幅减少。与对价格的动态反应一致，我们通过利用受益人出生月份的变化来研究药物使用对未来自付费用的反应，这种变化会在资格的第一年导致合同期限的变化。基于这两个事实，我们开发并估计了一个关于保险覆盖年度内药物使用的动态模型，以量化并探索不同合同设计对药物支出的影响。例如，我们的估计表明，根据《平价医疗法案》的要求“填补”甜甜圈空档，将使每位受益人的年度药物支出增加180美元，约占10%。此外，这一增加的近一半是“预期性”的，来自那些在政策变更前支出不足，无法达到甜甜圈空档的受益人。我们还描述了利用反应的性质及其在个体和药物类型上的异质性。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of health insurance and new antiviral treatments on HIV testing rates among the U.S. general population using nationally representative data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance Survey (BRFSS) for the years 1993 to 2002. We estimate recursive bivariate probit models with insurance coverage and HIV testing as the dependent variables. We use changes in Medicaid eligibility and distribution of firm size over time within a state as instruments for insurance coverage. The results suggest that (a) insurance coverage increases HIV testing rates, (b) insurance coverage increases HIV testing rates more among the high risk population, and (c) the advent of Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy (HAART) increases the effects of insurance coverage on HIV testing for high risk populations.

10.3386/w19397.abstractZh: 本文利用1993至2002年行为风险因素监测调查（BRFSS）的全国代表性数据，研究了医疗保险和新抗病毒治疗方法对美国普通人群中HIV检测率的影响。我们建立了递归双变量Probit模型，以医疗保险覆盖率和HIV检测率为因变量。我们使用各州内医疗补助资格的变化以及企业规模随时间的变化作为医疗保险覆盖率的工具变量。研究结果表明：(a)医疗保险覆盖率提高了HIV检测率；(b)在高风险人群中，医疗保险覆盖率对HIV检测率的提升作用更为显著；(c)高效抗逆转录病毒疗法（HAART）的问世进一步增强了医疗保险覆盖率对高风险人群HIV检测率的影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies regulated health insurance markets known as exchanges, motivated by their inclusion in the Affordable Care Act (ACA). We use detailed health plan choice and utilization data to model individual-level projected health risk and risk preferences. We combine the estimated joint distribution of risk and risk preferences with a model of competitive insurance markets to predict outcomes under different regulations that govern insurers' ability to use health status information in pricing. We investigate the welfare implications of these regulations with an emphasis on two potential sources of inefficiency: (i) adverse selection and (ii) premium reclassification risk. We find that market unravelling from adverse selection is substantial under the proposed pricing rules in the Affordable Care Act (ACA), implying limited coverage for individuals beyond the lowest coverage (Bronze) health plan permitted. Although adverse selection can be attenuated by allowing (partial) pricing of health status, our estimated risk preferences imply that this would create a welfare loss from reclassification risk that is substantially larger than the gains from increasing within-year coverage, provided that consumers can borrow when young to smooth consumption or that age-based pricing is allowed. We extend the analysis to investigate some related issues, including (i) age-based pricing regulation (ii) exchange participation if the individual mandate is unenforceable and (iii) insurer risk-adjustment transfers.

10.3386/w19399.abstractZh: 本文研究了受《平价医疗法案》推动的规范健康保险市场，即健康保险交易所。我们利用详细的健康计划选择和利用数据来建模个体层面的健康风险预测和风险偏好。我们将估计出的风险和风险偏好的联合分布与竞争性保险市场模型相结合，以预测在不同监管制度下保险公司利用健康状况信息进行定价的能力。我们探讨了这些监管制度的福利影响，重点关注两个潜在的效率低下来源：(i) 逆向选择，以及(ii) 保费重新分类风险。研究发现，在《平价医疗法案》提出的定价规则下，市场因逆向选择而遭受的重大损失意味着个人获得的保险覆盖范围有限，仅涵盖最低级别的“青铜”健康计划。尽管通过允许部分基于健康状况的定价可以减轻逆向选择的影响，但我们的估计风险偏好表明，这种重新分类风险所带来的福利损失，远大于增加年度内保险覆盖范围的收益，前提是消费者能够在年轻时借款以平滑消费支出，或者允许基于年龄的定价。我们进一步扩展了分析，探讨了一些相关问题，包括(i) 基于年龄的定价监管，以及(ii) 如果强制个人参保制度无法实施时交易所的参与情况，还有(iii) 保险公司的风险调整转移。

abstract.text: The impact of insurer competition on welfare, negotiated provider prices, and premiums in the U.S. private health care industry is theoretically ambiguous. Reduced competition may increase the premiums charged by insurers and their payments made to hospitals. However, it may also strengthen insurers' bargaining leverage when negotiating with hospitals, thereby generating offsetting cost decreases. To understand and measure this trade-off, we estimate a model of employer-insurer and hospital-insurer bargaining over premiums and reimbursements, household demand for insurance, and individual demand for hospitals using detailed California admissions, claims, and enrollment data. We simulate the removal of both large and small insurers from consumers' choice sets. Although consumer welfare decreases and premiums typically increase, we find that premiums can fall upon the removal of a small insurer if an employer imposes effective premium constraints through negotiations with the remaining insurers. We also document substantial heterogeneity in hospital price adjustments upon the removal of an insurer, with renegotiated price increases and decreases of as much as 10% across markets.

10.3386/w19401.abstractZh: 保险公司竞争对美国私人医疗保健行业的福利、协商价格以及保费的影响在理论上存在不确定性。竞争减少可能会提高保险公司的收费以及向医院支付的费用。然而，这也可能增强保险公司在与医院谈判时的议价能力，从而带来成本降低的效果。为了理解和衡量这种权衡，我们基于详细的加利福尼亚州住院、理赔和注册数据，建立了一个模型，模拟了雇主与保险公司以及医院与保险公司在保费和报销方面的谈判过程，同时考虑了家庭对保险的需求以及个人对医院的需求。我们模拟了大型和小型保险公司从消费者选择集中被移除的情况。尽管消费者福利下降且保费通常上升，但我们发现，如果雇主通过与剩余保险公司谈判实施有效的保费限制，小型保险公司的保费可能会下降。我们还发现，在保险公司被移除后，医院的价格调整存在显著的异质性，重新谈判后的价格涨幅和降幅可达10%。

abstract.text: We study the effect on nutrition of an exogenous increase in food grain subsidy in rural India resulting from a program targeting the poor. Our analysis suggests that increase in income resulting from the food price subsidy changed consumption patterns in favor of the subsidized grains and certain more expensive sources of calorie, and lowered consumption of coarse grains that are cheaper, yet taste-wise, inferior sources of nutrition, but had no effect on calorie, protein and fat intake in poor households. Further, our analysis shows that households allocated some of the increase in income from food price subsidy to expenditures on non-food items. Estimates of the price effect of food price subsidy on the three measures of nutrition are also negligible. We find evidence that the decline in the price of wheat and rice, changed consumption patterns toward increased consumption of wheat and rice and lower consumption of coarse grains, the unsubsidized staple food. Our analysis thus suggests that food price subsidies are likely to affect agriculture markets without impacting nutrition.

10.3386/w19404.abstractZh: 我们研究了印度农村因针对贫困群体的计划而增加的粮食补贴对营养的影响。我们的分析表明，由于粮食价格补贴导致的收入增加改变了消费模式，使得人们更倾向于购买受补贴的谷物和某些价格较高的高热量食物，同时减少了价格较低但口感较差的粗粮消费。然而，这种补贴对贫困家庭的热量、蛋白质和脂肪摄入量没有影响。此外，我们的分析还显示，家庭将部分因粮食价格补贴增加的收入用于非食品项目的支出。对于粮食价格补贴对三种营养指标的影响，我们的估计结果显示其影响微乎其微。我们发现，小麦和大米价格的下降使得人们更多地消费小麦和大米，而减少了粗粮的消费。因此，我们的分析表明，粮食价格补贴可能会影响农业市场，但不会对营养状况产生实质性影响。

abstract.text: This article examines the long term physical and mental health effects of internal migration focusing on a relatively unique migration experience from Southern and Northeastern regions of Italy to Northwestern regions and to the region around Rome concentrated over a relatively short period from 1950-1970. OLS regression estimates show significant evidence of a migration effect among early-cohort females on physical health. We find no evidence of migration-health effects for the later cohort, nor for males in the early cohort. We use finite mixture models to further explore the possibility of heterogeneous effects and find that there is a significant and substantial improvement in physical and mental health for a fraction of migrant females in the early cohort but not for others. Analysis of the group for which effects are significant suggest that health effects are concentrated among rural females in the early cohort.

10.3386/w19422.abstractZh: 本文探讨了内部迁移对长期身心健康的影响，重点关注从意大利南部和东北部地区迁移到西北部地区以及罗马周边地区的相对独特的迁移经历，这一迁移过程发生在1950至1970年间的相对较短时间内。OLS回归估计显示，早期移民女性在身体健康方面存在显著的迁移效应。我们发现，后期移民群体以及早期移民男性均不存在迁移对健康的显著影响。通过有限混合模型进一步分析，我们发现早期移民女性中有一部分人在身心健康方面取得了显著改善，而其他女性则没有。对具有显著效应的群体进行分析后发现，健康效应主要集中在早期移民中的农村女性身上。

abstract.text: Environmental quality in many developing countries is poor and generates substantial health and productivity costs. However, existing measures of willingness to pay for environmental quality improvements indicate low valuations by affected households. This paper argues that this seeming paradox is the central puzzle at the intersection of environmental and development economics: Given poor environmental quality and high health burdens in developing countries, why is WTP so low? We develop a conceptual framework for understanding this puzzle and propose four potential explanations: (1) due to low income levels, individuals value increases in income more than marginal improvements in environmental quality, (2) the marginal costs of environmental quality improvements are high, (3) political economy factors undermine efficient policy-making, and (4) market failures such as weak property rights and missing capital markets drive a wedge between true and revealed willingness to pay for environmental quality. We review the available literature on each explanation and discuss how the framework also applies to climate change, which is perhaps the most important issue at the intersection of environment and development economics. The paper concludes with a list of promising and unanswered research questions for the emerging sub-field of "envirodevonomics."

10.3386/w19426.abstractZh: 许多发展中国家的环境质量较差，导致巨大的健康与生产力成本。然而，现有关于人们愿意为改善环境质量支付费用的衡量指标表明，受影响家庭的估值较低。本文认为，这种看似矛盾的现象是环境经济学与发展经济学交叉领域的核心难题：在发展中国家环境质量差且健康负担重的情况下，为什么人们的支付意愿如此之低？我们提出了一个概念框架来理解这一难题，并提出了四种可能的解释：(1)由于收入水平较低，人们更重视收入的增加，而非环境质量的边际改善；(2)环境质量改善的边际成本很高；(3)政治经济因素阻碍了有效的政策制定；(4)市场失灵，如产权缺失和资本市场不完善，导致人们对环境质量的真实支付意愿与公开表达意愿之间存在差距。我们回顾了关于这些解释的相关文献，并讨论了该框架如何适用于气候变化问题，而气候变化或许正是环境经济学与发展经济学交叉领域中最重要的问题。本文最后列出了一些有前景但尚未解答的研究问题，这些问题对于新兴的“环境发展经济学”子领域具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We investigate whether private research investments are distorted away from long-term projects. Our theoretical model highlights two potential sources of this distortion: short-termism and the fixed patent term. Our empirical context is cancer research, where clinical trials – and hence, project durations – are shorter for late-stage cancer treatments relative to early-stage treatments or cancer prevention. Using newly constructed data, we document several sources of evidence that together show private research investments are distorted away from long-term projects. The value of life-years at stake appears large. We analyze three potential policy responses: surrogate (non-mortality) clinicaltrial endpoints, targeted R&D subsidies, and patent design.

10.3386/w19430.abstractZh: 我们研究了私人研究投资是否会被扭曲，偏离长期项目。我们的理论模型指出了两种可能导致这种扭曲的因素：短期主义以及固定的专利期限。我们的实证研究对象是癌症研究，其中晚期癌症治疗的临床试验周期相对较短，而早期治疗或癌症预防的临床试验周期则较长。通过新构建的数据，我们发现有若干证据表明私人研究投资确实被扭曲，偏离了长期项目。所涉及的生命年价值相当巨大。我们分析了三种可能的政策应对方案：使用替代性（非死亡率）临床试验终点、定向研发补贴以及专利设计。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of mothers' earnings on birth weight and gestational age of infants. It also analyzes the impact of earnings on mothers' consumption of prenatal medical care, and their propensity to smoke and drink during pregnancy. The paper uses census-division- and year-specific skill-biased technology shocks as an instrument for mothers' earnings and employs a two-sample instrumental variables strategy. About 14 million records of births between 1989 and 2004 are used from the Natality Detail files along with the CPS Annual Demographic Files from the same period. The results reveal that an increase in weekly earnings prompts an increase in prenatal care of low-skill mothers (those who have at most a high school degree) who are not likely to be on Medicaid, and that earnings have a small positive impact on birth weight and gestational age of the newborns of these mothers. An increase in earnings does not influence the health of newborns of high-skill mothers (those with at least some college education). Variations in earnings have no impact on birth weight for mothers who are likely to be on Medicaid.

10.3386/w19434.abstractZh: 本文研究了母亲收入对婴儿出生体重和妊娠年龄的影响。同时，分析了收入对母亲产前医疗护理消费以及孕期吸烟和饮酒倾向的影响。研究采用按人口普查区域和年份划分的技能偏向性技术冲击作为衡量母亲收入的工具，并采用双样本工具变量策略。研究使用了1989年至2004年间来自Natality Detail文件的约1400万份出生记录，以及同期CPS年度人口统计文件。研究结果表明，周收入的增加会促使那些技能较低（至少只有高中学历）且不太可能享受医疗补助的母亲增加产前护理，而收入对这些母亲所生婴儿的出生体重和妊娠年龄有较小的正面影响。收入的增加并不会影响那些技能较高（至少有一些大学教育背景）的母亲所生婴儿的健康状况。对于那些可能享受医疗补助的母亲来说，收入的变化对婴儿出生体重没有影响。

abstract.text: This paper explores the changing role of government involvement in health care financing policy outside the United States. It provides a review of the economics literature in this area to understand the implications of recent policy changes on efficiency, costs and quality. Our review reveals that there has been some convergence in policies adopted across countries to improve financing incentives and encourage efficient use of health services. In the case of risk pooling, all countries with competing pools experience similar difficulties with selection and are adopting more sophisticated forms of risk adjustment. In the case of hospital competition, the key drivers of success appear to be what is competed on and measurable rather than whether the system is public or private. In the case of both the success of performance-related pay for providers and issues resulting from wait times, evidence differs both within and across jurisdictions. However, the evidence does suggest that some governments have effectively reduced wait times when they have chosen explicitly to focus on achieving this goal. Many countries are exploring new ways of generating revenues for health care to enable them to cope with significant cost growth. However, there is little evidence to suggest that collection mechanisms alone are effective in managing the cost or quality of care.

10.3386/w19439.abstractZh: 本文探讨了美国以外地区政府在医疗保健融资政策中角色的变化。通过回顾相关经济学文献，本文旨在了解近期政策变化对效率、成本和质量的影响。研究发现，各国在改善融资激励和促进医疗服务高效利用方面采取了一定的趋同政策。在风险共担方面，所有拥有竞争性风险共担机制的国家都面临着类似的筛选难题，并正在采用更复杂的风险调整方式。在医院竞争方面，成功的关键因素似乎在于竞争的内容以及可衡量性，而非系统属于公共还是私人性质。关于绩效相关薪酬对医疗服务提供者的激励效果以及等待时间带来的问题，不同国家和地区的情况存在差异。不过，有证据表明，一些政府通过明确致力于实现这一目标，有效缩短了等待时间。许多国家正在探索新的收入来源，以应对显著的成本增长。然而，几乎没有证据表明，仅靠收费机制就能有效管理成本或医疗质量。

abstract.text: We estimate price regressions for surgical procedures used to treat colon cancer, a leading cause of cancer mortality. Using a claims database for self-insured employers, we focus on transaction prices, rather than more commonly available billing data that do not reflect actual payments made. Although the responsiveness of prices to hospital performance depends on the impact of quality on the slope of the quantity-demand of the payers, which are not known a priory, it is often assumed that higher performing hospitals are able to command higher prices. To test this hypothesis we construct performance rankings, based on hospital excess-mortality and incorporate them into our price models. We are interested in the type information available to large payers who negotiate prices on behalf of their members. To get a cancer-specific index we emulate the widely-reported risk-adjustment methodology used in the federal Hospital Compare reporting system for ranking cardiac performance. The effects were consistently negative in all models (adverse quality reduces price), though not significant. However, we observe a rational pricing structure whereby higher treatment complexity is reflected in higher price differentials, controlling for patient characteristics and market structure.

10.3386/w19447.abstractZh: 我们针对用于治疗结肠癌的手术程序进行了价格回归分析，结肠癌是癌症死亡的主要原因之一。我们利用自保雇主的索赔数据库，重点关注交易价格，而非那些无法反映实际支付情况的计费数据。尽管价格对医院绩效的响应程度取决于质量对支付者数量需求斜率的影响，而这些因素在事先是未知的，但通常认为表现更好的医院能够收取更高的价格。为了验证这一假设，我们基于医院超额死亡率构建了绩效排名，并将其纳入我们的价格模型中。我们感兴趣的是大型支付者为其成员谈判价格时可用的类型信息。为了获得癌症特定的指数，我们模仿了联邦医院比较报告系统中广泛使用的风险调整方法，用于排名心脏疾病的绩效。在所有模型中，这种效应始终呈负面趋势（不良质量会降低价格），尽管并不显著。然而，我们观察到一种合理的定价结构，即更高的治疗复杂性会反映在更高的价格差异上，同时控制了患者特征和市场结构。

abstract.text: We propose a Bayesian factor analysis model to rank the health of localities. Mortality and morbidity variables empirically contribute to the resulting rank, and population and spatial correlation are incorporated into a measure of uncertainty. We use county-level data from Texas and Wisconsin to compare our approach to conventional rankings that assign deterministic factor weights and ignore uncertainty. Greater discrepancies in rankings emerge for Texas than Wisconsin since the differences between the empirically-derived and deterministic weights are more substantial. Uncertainty is evident in both states but becomes especially large in Texas after incorporating noise from imputing its considerable missing data.

10.3386/w19450.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个贝叶斯因子分析模型来对地方的健康状况进行排名。死亡率和发病率变量在排名中起着实证性的作用，而人口和空间相关性则被纳入不确定性度量中。我们使用德克萨斯州和威斯康星州的县级数据来比较我们的方法与传统的排名方法，后者采用确定性因子权重并忽略不确定性。由于实证得出的权重与确定性权重的差异更大，德克萨斯州的排名差异比威斯康星州更为明显。两种州都存在不确定性，但在德克萨斯州，由于补充了大量缺失数据所带来的噪声影响，不确定性尤其显著。

abstract.text: We estimated the effect of depression on labor market outcomes using data from the 2004-2009 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey. After accounting for the endogeneity of depression through a correlated random effects panel data specification, we found that depression reduces the likelihood of employment. We did not, however, find evidence of a causal relationship between depression and hourly wages or weekly hours worked. Our estimates are substantially smaller than those from previous studies, and imply that depression reduces the probability of employment by 2.6 percentage points. In addition, we examined the effect of depression on work impairment and found that depression increases annual work loss days by about 1.4 days (33 percent), which implies that the annual aggregate productivity loses due to depression-induced absenteeism range from $700 million to 1.4 billion in 2009 USD.

10.3386/w19451.abstractZh: 我们使用2004-2009年医疗支出面板调查的数据，估计了抑郁症对劳动力市场结果的影响。在通过相关随机效应面板数据模型考虑抑郁症的内生性后，我们发现抑郁症降低了就业的可能性。然而，我们没有发现抑郁症与小时工资或每周工作小时数之间存在因果关系。我们的估计值比以往研究的结果要小得多，表明抑郁症使就业概率降低了2.6个百分点。此外，我们还研究了抑郁症对工作损害的影响，发现抑郁症使每年的工作损失天数增加了约1.4天（33%），这意味着由于抑郁症导致的缺勤，2009年美国的年度总生产力损失在7亿美元到14亿美元之间。

abstract.text: We examine six molecules facing initial loss of US exclusivity (LOE, from patent expiration or challenges) between June 2009 and May 2013 that were among the 50 most prescribed molecules in May 2013. We examine prices per day of therapy (from the perspective of average revenue received by retail pharmacy per day of therapy) and utilization separately for four payer types (cash, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, and other third party payer - TPP) and age under vs. 65 and older. We find that quantity substitutions away from the brand are much larger proportionately and more rapid than average price reductions during the first six months following initial LOE. Brands continue to raise prices after generics enter. Expansion of total molecule sales (brand plus generic) following LOE is an increasingly common phenomenon compared with earlier eras. The number of days of therapy in a prescription has generally increased over time. Generic penetration rates are typically highest and most rapid for TPPs, and lowest and slowest for Medicaid. Cash customers and seniors generally pay the highest prices for brands and generics, third party payers and those under 65 pay the lowest prices, with Medicaid and Medicare Part D in between. The presence of an authorized generic during the 180-day exclusivity period has a significant impact on prices and volumes of prescriptions, but this varies across molecules.

10.3386/w19487.abstractZh: 我们研究了在2009年6月至2013年5月期间，面临美国独家授权丧失的六种药物。这些药物在2013年5月是市场上最常被处方的50种药物之一。我们分别研究了每种药物的日治疗费用（从零售药店每天治疗的平均收入角度来看）以及不同支付方类型（现金支付、Medicare Part D、Medicaid和其他第三方支付方）和年龄组下的使用情况。研究发现，在初始独家授权丧失后的前六个月，从品牌药物转向仿制药的比例远高于平均价格下降幅度。仿制药进入市场后，品牌药物的定价继续上升。与早期相比，总药物销售额（品牌药物加仿制药）的扩大已成为一种常见现象。处方中治疗天数总体上随着时间的推移而增加。仿制药的渗透率通常在第三方支付方中最高且增长最快，而在Medicaid中则最低且增长最慢。现金支付者和老年人通常对品牌药物和仿制药的支付价格最高，而第三方支付者和65岁以下的人群则支付最低价格，Medicaid和Medicare Part D则处于中间水平。在180天的独家授权期间，授权仿制药的存在对处方价格和数量有显著影响，但这种影响因药物种类而异。

abstract.text: Estimates of the returns to medical care may reflect not only the efficacy of more intensive care, but also unmeasured differences in patient severity or the productivity of health-care providers. We use a variety of instruments that are plausibly orthogonal to heterogeneity among providers as well as patients to analyze the intensity of care and 30-day survival among Medicare patients hospitalized for heart attack, congestive heart failure and pneumonia. We find that the intensity of care is endogenous for two out of three conditions. The elasticity of 30-day mortality with respect to care intensity increases in magnitude from -0.27 to -0.71 for pneumonia and from -0.16 to -0.33 for congestive heart failure, when we address the identification problem. This finding is consistent with the hypotheses that care intensity at hospitals tends to decrease with hospital productivity, or increase with unmeasured patient severity.

10.3386/w19490.abstractZh: 对医疗护理回报的估计可能不仅反映了更密集护理的有效性，还可能反映了患者病情严重程度或未测量到的医疗服务提供者生产力差异。我们使用多种工具来分析护理强度以及因心脏病发作、充血性心力衰竭和肺炎而住院的医疗保险患者的30天生存率，这些工具与医疗服务提供者之间的异质性以及患者之间的异质性呈正交关系。我们发现，在三种情况中，护理强度是内生的。当我们解决识别问题时，30天死亡率与护理强度之间的弹性分别从-0.27增加到-0.71（针对肺炎）和从-0.16增加到-0.33（针对充血性心力衰竭）。这一发现与以下假设一致：医院中的护理强度往往随着医院生产力下降而下降，或者随着未测量到的患者病情严重程度增加而上升。

abstract.text: This paper assembles new evidence on some of the longer-term consequences of U.S. family planning policies, defined in this paper as those increasing legal or financial access to modern contraceptives. The analysis leverages two large policy changes that occurred during the 1960s and 1970s: first, the interaction of the birth control pill's introduction with Comstock-era restrictions on the sale of contraceptives and the repeal of these laws after Griswold v. Connecticut in 1965; and second, the expansion of federal funding for local family planning programs from 1964 to 1973. Building on previous research that demonstrates both policies' effects on fertility rates, I find suggestive evidence that individuals' access to contraceptives increased their children's college completion, labor force participation, wages, and family incomes decades later.

10.3386/w19493.abstractZh: 本文汇总了关于美国计划生育政策一些长期影响的新证据。本文将计划生育政策定义为那些增加人们获得现代避孕方法的合法或经济机会的政策。分析利用了20世纪60年代和70年代发生的两项重大政策变化：首先，避孕药法的引入与科斯通时代对避孕品的销售限制之间的相互作用，以及1965年格里斯沃尔德诉康涅狄格州案后这些法律的废除；其次，1964年至1973年间联邦对地方计划生育项目的资金扩展。基于先前的研究，这些研究证明了这两项政策对生育率的影响，我发现有证据表明，个人获得避孕方法后，其子女在几十年后完成大学教育、参与劳动力市场的程度、工资和家庭收入都有所提高。

abstract.text: This paper exploits an unusual transportation setting to estimate the value of a statistical life (VSL). We estimate the trade-offs individuals are willing to make between mortality risk and cost as they travel to and from the international airport in Sierra Leone (which is separated from the capital Freetown by a body of water), and choose from among multiple transport options - namely, ferry, helicopter, hovercraft, and water taxi. The setting and original dataset allow us to address some typical omitted variable concerns, and to compare VSL estimates for travelers from different countries, all facing the same choice situation. The average VSL estimate for African travelers in the sample is US$577,000 compared to US$924,000 for non-African travelers. Individual job earnings can largely account for this difference: Africans in the sample typically earn less than non-Africans. The data implies an income elasticity of the VSL of 1.77. These revealed preference VSL estimates from a developing country fill an important gap in the existing literature, and can be used for public policy purposes, including in current debates within Sierra Leone regarding the desirability of constructing new transportation infrastructure.

10.3386/w19494.abstractZh: 本文利用一种独特的交通环境来估算统计生命价值（VSL）。我们研究了个体在前往塞拉利昂国际机场（该机场与首都弗里敦之间隔着一片水域）时，在死亡风险与成本之间的权衡，并让他们从多种交通方式中选择——包括渡轮、直升机、气垫船和水上出租车。该环境及原始数据集使我们能够解决一些典型的遗漏变量问题，并比较来自不同国家的旅行者的VSL估算值，尽管他们面临相同的选择情境。样本中非洲旅行者的平均VSL估算值为577,000美元，而非非洲旅行者的这一数值为924,000美元。这种差异在很大程度上可以归因于个人收入：样本中的非洲人通常收入低于非非洲人。数据表明，VSL的收入弹性为1.77。这些来自发展中国家的揭示性偏好VSL估算值填补了现有文献中的一个重要空白，并可用于公共政策决策，包括在塞拉利昂关于建设新交通基础设施的当前讨论中。

abstract.text: Non-compliance with medication therapy remains an unsolved and expensive problem for health care systems around the world. Yet we know little about the factors that determine a patient's decision to follow treatment recommendations. This study uses a unique panel dataset comprising all prescription drug users, physicians, and all prescription drug sales in Denmark over seven years to analyze the contributions of doctor-, patient-, and drug-specific factors to the adherence decision. Our findings have important implications for the design of incentive schemes targeted at improving chronic disease management.

10.3386/w19496.abstractZh: 不遵守药物治疗仍然是全球医疗系统面临的一个未解决且成本高昂的问题。然而，我们对决定患者是否遵循治疗建议的因素知之甚少。本研究利用了一个独特的面板数据集，该数据集包含了丹麦七年期间所有处方药使用者、医生以及所有处方药销售信息，以分析医生因素、患者因素以及药物特定因素对依从性决策的影响。我们的研究结果对于设计旨在改善慢性病管理的激励方案具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We demonstrate Medicare's influence on private insurers' payments for physicians' services. Using a large administrative change in payments for surgical versus medical care, we find that private prices follow Medicare's lead. A $1 change in Medicare's fees moved private prices by $1.16. A second set of Medicare payment changes, which generated area-specific reimbursement shocks, had a similar effect on private sector prices. Medicare's influence is strongest in areas with concentrated insurers, small physician groups, and competitive physician markets. The public sector's influences on system-wide resource allocation and costs extend well beyond the share of health expenditures it finances directly.

10.3386/w19503.abstractZh: 我们证明了医疗保险对私人保险公司支付医生服务费用的影响。通过对比手术与医疗服务的支付变化，我们发现私人价格会跟随医疗保险的变动。医疗保险费用每变动1美元，私人价格会相应变动1.16美元。另一组医疗保险支付变化，虽然导致地区特定的报销调整，但对私人部门的价格也产生了类似的影响。医疗保险的影响在保险公司集中度较高、医生群体规模较小以及医生市场竞争较为激烈的地区最为明显。公共部门对系统范围内资源分配和成本的影响远远超出了其直接资助的健康支出比例。

abstract.text: Measuring sexual orientation, behavior, and related opinions is difficult because responses are biased towards socially acceptable answers. We test whether measurements are biased even when responses are private and anonymous and use our results to identify sexuality-related norms and how they vary. We run an experiment on 2,516 U.S. participants. Participants were randomly assigned to either a "best practices method" that was computer-based and provides privacy and anonymity, or to a "veiled elicitation method" that further conceals individual responses. Answers in the veiled method preclude inference about any particular individual, but can be used to accurately estimate statistics about the population. Comparing the two methods shows sexuality-related questions receive biased responses even under current best practices, and, for many questions, the bias is substantial. The veiled method increased self-reports of non-heterosexual identity by 65% (p<0.05) and same-sex sexual experiences by 59% (p<0.01). The veiled method also increased the rates of anti-gay sentiment. Respondents were 67% more likely to express disapproval of an openly gay manager at work (p<0.01) and 71% more likely to say it is okay to discriminate against lesbian, gay, or bisexual individuals (p<0.01). The results show non-heterosexuality and anti-gay sentiment are substantially underestimated in existing surveys, and the privacy afforded by current best practices is not always sufficient to eliminate bias. Finally, our results identify two social norms: it is perceived as socially undesirable both to be open about being gay, and to be unaccepting of gay individuals.

10.3386/w19508.abstractZh: 测量性取向、行为及相关观点存在困难，因为回答往往倾向于社会可接受的答案。我们测试了即使在回答是私密且匿名的情况下，测量是否也存在偏差，并利用研究结果来识别与性取向相关的规范及其变化。我们对2,516名美国参与者进行了实验。参与者被随机分配到“最佳实践方法”，该方法基于计算机，提供私密性和匿名性，或者分配到“隐蔽引出方法”，该方法进一步隐藏个人回答。隐蔽方法中的回答无法推断出任何特定个体的信息，但可以用来准确估计关于总体的统计数据。比较这两种方法后发现，即使在当前的最佳实践中，与性取向相关的问题仍然会得到有偏的回答，而且对于许多问题来说，这种偏差相当显著。隐蔽方法使非异性恋身份的自我报告增加了65%（p<0.05），同性性行为的体验增加了59%（p<0.01）。隐蔽方法还增加了反同性恋情绪的发生率。受访者表示，更有可能反对在工作中公开同性恋身份的管理者（p<0.01），并且更有可能认为歧视女同性恋者、男同性恋者或双性恋者是可以接受的（p<0.01）。结果表明，现有调查中对非异性恋性和反同性恋情绪的认知被严重低估了，而当前最佳实践提供的私密性并不总是足以消除偏差。最后，我们的研究结果指出了两种社会规范：公开自己的同性恋身份被认为是不社会可接受的，而对同性恋者持不接受的态度同样被认为是不社会可接受的。

abstract.text: Economic theory predicts that employer-provided retiree health insurance benefits crowd-out household wealth accumulation. Nevertheless, there is little research on the impacts of retiree health insurance on wealth accruals, so this paper utilizes a unique data file on three baseline cohorts from the Health and Retirement Study to explore how employer-provided retiree health insurance may influence net household wealth among public sector employees, where retiree healthcare benefits are still quite prevalent. We find that most full-time public sector employees who anticipate receiving employer-provided health insurance coverage in retirement save less than their private sector uncovered counterparts.

10.3386/w19511.abstractZh: 经济理论预测，雇主提供的退休人员健康保险福利会挤占家庭财富积累。然而，关于退休人员健康保险对财富积累影响的研究很少，因此本文利用“健康与退休研究”中三个基准群体的独特数据文件，探讨雇主提供的退休人员健康保险如何影响公共部门员工的家庭净财富，尤其是在退休人员医疗保健福利仍然相当普遍的情况下。我们发现，大多数预期在退休时获得雇主提供健康保险覆盖的全职公共部门员工，其储蓄金额低于未获得此类福利的私营部门员工。

abstract.text: We estimate a model of drug demand and supply that incorporates insurance, advertising, and competition between branded and generic drugs within and across therapeutic classes. We use data on antiulcer drugs from 1991 to 2010. Our simulations show generics and ``me-too'' drugs each increased consumer welfare more than $100 million in 2010, holding insurance premiums constant. However, insurance payments in 2010 fell by nearly $1 billion due to generics and rose by over $7 billion due to me-too antiulcer drugs.

10.3386/w19522.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个药物需求和供应模型，该模型考虑了保险、广告以及品牌药品与仿制药在各类治疗领域内的竞争关系。我们使用了1991年至2010年间关于抗溃疡药物的数据进行模拟。模拟结果显示，在保险费率保持不变的情况下，仿制药和“同类产品”在2010年分别增加了1亿多美元的消费者福利。然而，由于仿制药的影响，2010年的保险支付金额减少了近10亿美元，而“同类产品”抗溃疡药物则使保险支付金额增加了70多亿美元。

abstract.text: Despite the widespread provision of retiree health insurance for public sector workers, little attention has been paid to its effects on employee retirement. This is in contrast to the large literature on health-insurance-induced "job-lock" in the private sector. I use the introduction of retiree health insurance for public school employees in combination with administrative data on their retirement to identify the effects of retiree health insurance. As expected, the availability of retiree health insurance for older workers allows employees to retire earlier. These behavioral changes have budgetary implications, likely making the programs self-financing rather than costly to taxpayers.

10.3386/w19524.abstractZh: 尽管公共部门的工作者普遍享有退休健康保险，但对其对员工退休的影响却鲜有关注。这与关于私人部门健康保险导致的“工作锁定”现象的大量研究形成对比。我通过结合公共学校员工退休相关的行政数据，来研究退休健康保险的影响。正如预期的那样，为年长工人提供退休健康保险使得员工能够更早退休。这些行为变化对预算产生了影响，可能会使这些项目实现自筹资金，而不是给纳税人带来额外负担。

abstract.text: Standardization of complex products is touted as improving consumer decisions and intensifying price competition, but evidence on standardization is limited. We examine a natural experiment: the standardization of health insurance plans on the Massachusetts Health Insurance Exchange. Pre-standardization, firms had wide latitude to design plans. A regulatory change then required firms to standardize the cost-sharing parameters of plans and offer seven defined options; plans remained differentiated on network, brand, and price. Standardization led consumers on the HIX to choose more generous health insurance plans and led to substantial shifts in brands' market shares. We decompose the sources of this shift into three effects: price, product availability, and valuation. A discrete choice model shows that standardization changed the weights consumers attach to plan attributes (a valuation effect), increasing the salience of tier. The availability effect explains the bulk of the brand shifts. Standardization increased consumer welfare in our models, but firms captured some of the surplus by reoptimizing premiums. We use hypothetical choice experiments to replicate the effect of standardization and conduct alternative counterfactuals.

10.3386/w19527.abstractZh: 复杂产品的标准化被宣传为改善消费者决策并加剧价格竞争，但关于标准化的证据有限。我们研究了一个自然实验：马萨诸塞州健康保险交易所上健康保险计划的标准化。在标准化之前，各公司在设计计划时拥有较大的自由度。随后，监管政策要求公司必须标准化计划的费用分担参数，并提供七种固定选项；计划在网络、品牌和价格方面仍然具有差异化。标准化使得消费者在HIX上选择更慷慨的健康保险计划，并导致品牌市场份额发生显著变化。我们将这种变化的来源分解为三种效应：价格、产品可用性和估值。离散选择模型表明，标准化改变了消费者对计划属性的重视程度（估值效应），提高了等级的重要性。可用性效应解释了品牌市场份额变化的主要部分。在我们的模型中，标准化增加了消费者的福利，但公司通过重新优化保费获得了部分剩余收益。我们使用假设选择实验来复制标准化的效应，并进行了替代性反事实分析。

abstract.text: Traditional economic models of vaccination assume that agents free-ride on the vaccination decision of others. These models show that private vaccination rates are always below the social optimal and even large subsidies cannot achieve disease eradication. In this paper, we build a model where in addition to the desire to free-ride, agents have a desire to conform to the vaccination decisions of their peers. In this model privately optimal vaccination rates can be higher or lower than the social optimal and thus subsidies for vaccination are not always optimal. However, in certain cases, even small subsidies can achieve disease eradication.

10.3386/w19528.abstractZh: 传统的疫苗接种经济模型假设个体会利用他人的疫苗接种决策来从中获益。这些模型表明，私人疫苗接种率始终低于社会最优水平，即使提供大量补贴也无法实现疾病的根除。在本文中，我们构建了一个模型，该模型不仅考虑了个体利用他人决策的动机，还考虑了个体遵循同伴疫苗接种决策的愿望。在这个模型中，私人最优疫苗接种率可能高于或低于社会最优水平，因此疫苗接种补贴并不总是最优的。然而，在某些情况下，即使是少量的补贴也能实现疾病的根除。

abstract.text: In 2008, a group of uninsured low-income adults in Oregon was selected by lottery for the chance to apply for Medicaid. We use this randomized design and 2009 administrative data to evaluate the effect of Medicaid on labor market outcomes and participation in other social safety net programs. We find no significant effect of Medicaid on employment or earnings: our 95 percent confidence intervals allow us to reject that Medicaid causes a decline in employment of more than 4.4 percentage points, or an increase of more than 1.2 percentage points. We find that Medicaid increases receipt of food stamps, but has little, if any, impact on receipt of other government benefits, including SSDI.

10.3386/w19547.abstractZh: 2008年，俄勒冈州的一群未投保的低收入成年人通过抽签获得了申请医疗补助的机会。我们利用这种随机设计和2009年的行政数据来评估医疗补助对劳动力市场结果以及参与其他社会保障项目的效果。研究发现，医疗补助对就业或收入没有显著影响：我们的95%置信区间表明，医疗补助不会导致就业率下降超过4.4个百分点，也不会导致就业率上升超过1.2个百分点。我们发现，医疗补助确实增加了食品券的领取数量，但对其他政府福利的领取几乎没有影响，包括社会保障福利。

abstract.text: Rates of childhood obesity have increased dramatically in the last few decades. Non-causal evidence suggests that childhood obesity is highly persistent over the life cycle. However little in known about the origins of this persistence. In this paper we attempt to answer three questions. First, how do anthropometric measures evolve from birth through primary school? Second, what is the causal effect of past anthropometric outcomes on future anthropometric outcomes? In other words, how important is state dependence in the evolution of anthropometric measures during the early part of the life cycle. Third, how important are time-varying and time invariant factors in the dynamics of childhood anthropometric measures? We find that anthropometric measures are highly persistent from infancy through primary school. Moreover, most of this persistence is driven by unobserved, time invariant factors that are determined prior to birth, consistent with the so-called fetal origins hypothesis. As such, policy interventions designed to improve child anthropometric status will only have meaningful, long-run effects if these time invariant factors are altered. Unfortunately, future research is needed to identify such factors, although evidence suggests that maternal nutrition may play an important role.

10.3386/w19554.abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，儿童肥胖率急剧上升。一些非因果性的证据表明，儿童肥胖在生命周期中具有很强的持久性。然而，关于这种持久性的起源却知之甚少。在本文中，我们试图回答三个问题：首先，人体测量指标从出生到小学阶段是如何变化的？其次，过去的人体测量结果对未来的人体测量结果有何影响？换句话说，在生命周期的早期阶段，状态依赖性在人体测量指标的变化中起着多重要？第三，时间变化因素和时间不变因素在儿童人体测量指标动态中起着多重要？我们发现，人体测量指标从婴儿期到小学阶段都具有很强的持久性。此外，这种持久性主要是由一些未观察到的、时间不变的因素所驱动的，这些因素在出生前就已经确定，这与所谓的胎儿起源假说相一致。因此，旨在改善儿童人体测量状况的政策干预措施只有在改变这些时间不变因素时才能产生有意义的长期效果。遗憾的是，未来还需要研究来识别这些因素，尽管有证据表明母亲的营养可能起着重要作用。

abstract.text: Does the safety net reduce food insecurity in families? In this paper we investigate how the structure of benefits for five major safety net programs - TANF, SSI, EITC, food assistance, and Medicaid - affects low food security in families. We build a calculator for the years 2001-2009 to impute eligibility and benefits for these programs in each state, taking into account cross-program eligibility rules. To identify a causal effect of the safety net, we use simulated eligibility and benefits for a nationally representative sample as instruments for imputed eligibility and potential benefits. We also perform a two-sample instrumental variables estimation in which we use simulated benefits as instruments for actual reported benefits. Focusing on non-immigrant, single-parent families with incomes below 300 percent of the poverty line, the results suggest that each $1000 in cash or food benefits actually received reduces the incidence of low food security by 4 percentage points. These estimates imply that moving from the policies of the 10th percentile state of Kentucky to the 90th percentile state of Vermont would reduce low food security by 1.7 percentage points on a base incidence of 33 percent. We are unable to reject equivalent impacts of cash and food assistance. The results also highlight the importance of jointly considering a full range of safety net programs.

10.3386/w19558.abstractZh: 安全网是否减少了家庭的食物不安全问题？本文研究了五个主要安全网项目——TANF、SSI、EITC、食品援助和Medicaid——的福利结构如何影响家庭的食物不安全问题。我们为2001-2009年期间构建了一个计算器，用于估算各州的资格和福利金额，同时考虑了跨项目的资格规则。为了确定安全网的因果效应，我们使用了全国代表性样本的模拟资格和福利数据作为估算资格和潜在福利的工具。我们还进行了双样本工具变量估计，使用模拟福利作为实际报告福利的工具变量。研究重点关注收入低于贫困线300%的非移民单亲家庭，结果表明，每获得1000美元现金或食品福利，食物不安全问题的发生率就会降低4个百分点。这些估计表明，从肯塔基州这个第10百分位的状态转移到佛蒙特州这个第90百分位的状态，在食物不安全问题发生率为33%的情况下，可以将该问题降低1.7个百分点。我们无法拒绝现金和食品援助具有同等影响的可能性。研究结果还强调了综合考虑全部安全网项目的重要性。

abstract.text: A recent literature has developed that combines two prominent empirical approaches to ex ante policy evaluation: randomized controlled trials (RCT) and structural estimation. The RCT provides a "gold-standard'' estimate of a particular treatment, but only of that treatment. Structural estimation provides the capability to extrapolate beyond the experimental treatment, but is based on untestable assumptions and is subject to structural data mining. Combining the approaches by holding out from the structural estimation exercise either the treatment or control sample allows for external validation of the underlying behavioral model. Although intuitively appealing, this holdout methodology is not well grounded. For instance, it is easy to show that it is suboptimal from a Bayesian perspective. Using a stylized representation of a randomized controlled trial, we provide a formal rationale for the use of a holdout sample in an environment in which data mining poses an impediment to the implementation of the ideal Bayesian analysis and a numerical illustration of the potential benefits of holdout samples.

10.3386/w19565.abstractZh: 近期的相关研究结合了两种著名的经验性政策评估方法：随机对照试验（RCT）和结构估计。随机对照试验能够提供一种“黄金标准”的某种特定处理的估计方法，但仅适用于该处理。而结构估计则能够超越实验处理范围进行推断，但其基础是未经检验的假设，并且容易受到结构性数据挖掘的影响。通过将结构估计部分排除在外，保留处理组或对照组样本，可以对外验证基础行为模型。尽管这种排除方法在直觉上很有吸引力，但实际上并没有充分的依据。例如，从贝叶斯角度来看，这种方法是次优的。通过一种简化的随机对照试验模型，我们为在数据挖掘对理想贝叶斯分析构成障碍的情况下使用排除样本提供了理论依据，并举例说明了排除样本可能带来的潜在好处。

abstract.text: To moderate the rate of growth of retiree health insurance costs, employers can modify plans and move retirees into less expensive plans. We examine policy modifications implemented by the North Carolina State Health Plan. We investigate whether incentives produce the desired plan elections and whether these changes, along with cost shifting, produce the expected reductions in cost growth. Using individual-level administrative data, along with aggregated data on expenditures for retirees, we estimate the effects of the introduction and subsequent repeal of a Comprehensive Wellness Initiative for non-Medicare eligible retirees, as well as increases in coinsurance and copayments and the introduction of a premium for all retirees. Over a third of non-Medicare retirees shifted into the least generous plan between June 2009 and December 2012. The level effects on annual costs and unfunded accrued liabilities were relatively modest, but growth rates were diminished. Increases in the retiree premiums reduced projected costs.

10.3386/w19566.abstractZh: 为了控制退休人员健康保险费用的增长速度，雇主可以调整计划，将退休人员转移到费用较低的计划中。我们研究了北卡罗来纳州健康计划所实施的政策调整。我们调查了这些激励措施是否导致了预期的计划选择，以及这些改变以及费用转移是否带来了预期的成本降低效果。利用个人层面的行政数据，以及退休人员支出的汇总数据，我们评估了针对非Medicare资格的退休人员引入并随后废除全面健康计划的影响，以及增加共付额和保费对全体退休人员的影响。在2009年6月至2012年12月期间，超过三分之一的非Medicare退休人员转投了费用较低的计划。这些调整对年度成本和未资助的应计负债的影响相对温和，但成本增长率有所降低。提高退休人员保费也降低了预计的成本。

abstract.text: Pollution exposure early in life is detrimental to near-term health and an increasing body of evidence suggests that early childhood health influences health and human capital outcomes later in life. This paper reviews the economic research that brings these two literatures together. We begin with a conceptual model that highlights the core relationships across the lifecycle. We then review the literature concerned with such estimates, focusing particularly on identification strategies to mitigate concerns regarding endogenous exposure. The nascent empirical literature provides both direct and indirect evidence that early childhood exposure to pollution significantly impacts later life outcomes. We discuss the potential policy implications of these long-lasting effects, and conclude with a number of promising avenues for future research.

10.3386/w19571.abstractZh: 生命早期接触污染对近期健康有害，越来越多的证据表明，儿童时期的健康状况会影响其后期的生活质量和人力资本发展。本文综述了将这两方面研究联系起来的经济学研究。我们首先提出一个概念模型，以突出生命周期中的核心关系。随后，我们回顾了与这些估计相关的文献，特别关注用于缓解内生性暴露问题的识别策略。新兴的实证文献提供了直接和间接证据，表明儿童时期接触污染会显著影响其后期的生活状况。我们讨论了这些长期影响的潜在政策意义，并提出了一些未来研究的方向。

abstract.text: We analyze the incidence of public-employee health benefits. Because these benefits are negotiated through the political process, relevant labor market institutions deviate significantly from the competitive, private-sector benchmark. Empirically, we find that roughly 15 percent of the cost of recent benefit growth was passed onto school district employees through reductions in wages and salaries. Strong teachers' unions were associated with relatively strong linkages between benefit growth and growth in total compensation. We further find that when economic conditions are poor, straining public budgets, benefit growth is more readily shifted back to public employees. Our analysis is consistent with the view that the costs of public workers' benefits are difficult to monitor, contributing to benefit oriented, and often under-funded, compensation schemes.

10.3386/w19574.abstractZh: 我们分析了公共雇员健康福利的分配情况。由于这些福利是通过政治过程协商确定的，相关劳动力市场制度与私营部门的竞争基准存在显著偏差。实证研究表明，近期福利增长的成本约有15%通过降低工资和薪水转嫁给了学区雇员。强大的教师工会与福利增长与总薪酬增长之间的紧密联系有关。我们进一步发现，在经济状况不佳、公共预算紧张的情况下，福利增长更容易重新分配给公共雇员。我们的分析与这样一种观点一致：公共雇员福利的成本难以监控，这导致了以福利为导向的薪酬制度，且往往资金不足。

abstract.text: Spending on prescription drugs (Rx) represents one of the fastest growing components of U.S. healthcare spending, and has coincided with an expansion of pharmaceutical promotional spending. Most (83%) of Rx promotion is directed at physicians in the form of visits by pharmaceutical representatives (known as detailing) and drug samples provided to physicians' offices. Such promotion has come under increased public scrutiny, with critics contending that physician-directed promotion may play a role in raising healthcare costs and may unduly affect physicians' prescribing habits towards more expensive, and possibly less cost-effective, drugs. In this study, we bring longitudinal evidence to bear upon the question of how detailing impacts physicians' prescribing behaviors. Specifically, we examine prescriptions and promotion for a particular drug class based on a nationally-representative sample of 150,000 physicians spanning 24 months. The use of longitudinal physician-level data allows us to tackle some of the empirical concerns in the extant literature, virtually all of which has relied on aggregate national data. We estimate fixed-effects specifications that bypass stable unobserved physician-specific heterogeneity and address potential targeting bias. In addition, we also assess differential effects at both the extensive and intensive margins of prescribing behaviors, and differential effects across physician- and market-level characteristics, questions which have not been explored in prior work. The estimates suggest that detailing has a significant and positive effect on the number of new scripts written for the detailed drug, with an elasticity magnitude of 0.06. This effect is substantially smaller than those in the literature based on aggregate information, suggesting that most of the observed relationship between physician-directed promotion and drug sales is driven by selection bias. Qualitatively consistent with the literature, we find that detailing impacts selective brand-specific demand but does not have any substantial effects on class-level demand. Results also indicate that most of the detailing response may operate at the extensive margin; detailing affects the probability of prescribing the drug more than it affects the number of prescriptions conditional on any prescribing. We draw some implications from these estimates with respect to effects on healthcare costs and public health.

10.3386/w19592.abstractZh: 处方药支出是美国医疗保健支出中增长最快的组成部分之一，其增长与药品促销支出的扩大同步。其中，83%的处方药促销是通过药品代表进行的拜访以及向医生办公室提供药品样品的形式进行的。这种促销方式受到了公众的更多关注，批评者认为，由医生主导的促销可能会推高医疗成本，并可能过度影响医生对更昂贵且可能不太经济有效的药物的处方行为。在这项研究中，我们提供了纵向数据来探讨拜访行为对医生处方行为的影响。具体来说，我们基于一个代表全国150,000名医生的样本，在24个月内对某一特定药物类别的处方和促销进行了研究。使用纵向的医生级数据使我们能够解决现有文献中存在的部分实证问题，因为现有文献几乎都依赖于汇总性的全国数据。我们采用了固定效应模型，从而避免了稳定的、未观察到的医生特定异质性，并解决了潜在的目标定位偏差问题。此外，我们还评估了在处方行为的广泛和密集层面上的差异效应，以及不同医生和市场层面特征之间的差异效应，这些问题在之前的研究中尚未被探讨。研究结果表明，拜访行为对新处方数量有显著的正面影响，弹性系数为0.06。这种效应比基于总体信息的文献中的效应要小得多，这表明医生主导的推广与药品销售之间观察到的关系，大部分是由选择偏差所驱动的。与文献结果一致的是，我们发现详细的信息对特定品牌的需求有选择性影响，但对类别级别的需求则没有实质性影响。结果还表明，大部分详细信息的响应可能发生在广泛边际上；详细信息对开药的概率的影响大于对开药次数的影响。从这些估计中，我们可以得出一些关于对医疗成本和公共卫生影响的结论。

abstract.text: I examine the relationship across diseases between the long-run growth in the number of publications about a disease and the change in the age-adjusted mortality rate from the disease. The diseases analyzed are almost all the different forms of cancer, i.e. cancer at different sites in the body (lung, colon, breast, etc.). Time-series data on the number of publications pertaining to each cancer site were obtained from PubMed. For articles published since 1975, it is possible to distinguish between publications indicating and not indicating any research funding support. My estimates indicate that mortality rates: (1) are unrelated to the (current or lagged) stock of publications that had not received research funding; (2) are only weakly inversely related to the contemporaneous stock of published articles that received research funding; and (3) are strongly inversely related to the stock of articles that had received research funding and been published 5 and 10 years earlier. The effect after 10 years is 66% larger than the contemporaneous effect. The strong inverse correlation between mortality growth and growth in the lagged number of publications that were supported by research funding is not driven by a small number of outliers.
