10.3386/w19593.abstractZh: 我研究了不同疾病之间，关于某一疾病的出版物数量在长期增长与该疾病年龄调整后的死亡率变化之间的关系。所分析的疾病几乎包括所有形式的癌症，即身体不同部位的癌症（如肺部、结肠、乳腺等）。关于每个癌症部位的出版物数量的时间序列数据来自PubMed。对于1975年以后发表的文章，可以区分出那些未获得研究资金支持的出版物与那些获得了研究资金支持并发表的出版物。我的估计表明，死亡率：(1)与未获得研究资金的出版物数量无关；(2)与同时期获得研究资金支持并发表的出版物数量仅存在弱负相关关系；(3)与5年和10年前获得研究资金支持并发表的出版物数量存在强负相关关系。10年后的影响比同时期的影响大66%。死亡率增长与获得研究资金支持后发布的出版物数量增长之间的强负相关关系并非由少数异常值所驱动。

abstract.text: We use the 1997 Education Law in Turkey that increased compulsory formal schooling from five to eight years to study the effect of women's education on a range of outcomes relating to women's fertility, their children's health and measures of empowerment. We apply an instrumental variables methodology and find that a 10 percentage point increase in the proportion of ever married women with eight years of schooling lowered number of pregnancies per woman by 0.13 and number of children per women by 0.11. There is also some evidence of a decline in child mortality, caused by mother's education, but effects turn statistically insignificant in our preferred models. We also find that a 10 percentage point increase in the proportion with eight years of schooling raised the proportion of women using modern family planning methods by eight to nine percent and the proportion of women with knowledge of their ovulation cycle by five to seven percent. However, we find little evidence that schooling changed women's attitudes towards gender equality.

10.3386/w19597.abstractZh: 我们参考了土耳其1997年颁布的《教育法》，该法律将义务正规教育年限从五年增加到八年，旨在研究女性教育对女性生育能力、子女健康以及女性赋权程度等方面的影响。我们采用了工具变量分析方法，发现：受过八年教育的已婚女性比例每增加10个百分点，每位女性的怀孕次数减少0.13次，子女数量减少0.11个。此外，母亲的受教育程度也有助于降低儿童死亡率，但在我们选择的模型中，这些效应在统计上并不显著。我们还发现：受过八年教育的女性比例每增加10个百分点，使用现代计划生育方法的女性比例增加8%至9%，了解自身排卵周期的女性比例增加5%至7%。然而，我们发现教育对女性对性别平等的态度几乎没有影响。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of malaria on economic development in Africa over the very long run. Using data on the prevalence of the mutation that causes sickle cell disease we measure the impact of malaria on mortality in Africa prior to the period in which formal data were collected. Our estimate is that in the more afflicted regions, malaria lowered the probability of surviving to adulthood by about ten percentage points, which is roughly twice the current burden of the disease. The reduction in malaria mortality has been roughly equal to the reduction in other causes of mortality. We then ask whether the estimated burden of malaria had an effect on economic development in the period before European contact. Examining both mortality and morbidity, we do not find evidence that the impact of malaria would have been very significant. These model-based findings are corroborated by a more statistically-based approach, which shows little evidence of a negative relationship between malaria ecology and population density or other measures of development, using data measured at the level ethnic groups.

10.3386/w19603.abstractZh: 我们研究了疟疾对非洲经济发展的长期影响。通过研究导致镰状细胞病的突变的流行情况，我们测量了疟疾在正式数据收集之前对非洲死亡率的影响。我们的估计是，在受影响最严重的地区，疟疾使存活到成年期的几率降低了约10个百分点，这大约是目前该疾病负担的两倍。疟疾导致的死亡率下降幅度与其他死因导致的下降幅度大致相当。接着，我们探讨了疟疾的估计负担是否对欧洲人接触之前的非洲经济发展产生了影响。通过考察死亡率和发病率，我们没有发现疟疾的影响会非常显著的证据。这些基于模型的发现得到了统计方法的进一步验证，后者表明，使用民族群体层面的数据测量时，疟疾生态与人口密度或其他发展指标之间几乎没有负相关的证据。

abstract.text: When physicians own complementary medical service facilities such as clinical laboratories and imaging centers, they gain financially by referring patients to these service entities. This situation creates an incentive for the physician to exploit the consumers' trust by recommending more services than they would demand under full information. This moral hazard cost, however, may be offset by gains in economies of scope if the complementary services are integrated into the physician's practice. We assess the extent of moral hazard and economies of scope using data from Taiwan, which introduced a "separating" policy, similar to the Stark Law in the US, that restricts physician ownership of pharmacies unless they are fully integrated into the physician's practice. We find that physicians who own pharmacies prescribe 7.6% more drugs than those who do not own pharmacies. Overall, we find no evidence of economies of scope from integration in the treatment of patients with acute respiratory infections, diabetes, or hypertension. Overall the separating policy was ineffective at controlling drug costs as a large number of physicians choose to integrate pharmacies into their practices in order to become exempt from the policy.

10.3386/w19622.abstractZh: 当医生拥有诸如临床实验室和影像中心等互补的医疗服务设施时，他们通过将这些患者推荐给这些服务实体而获得经济收益。这种情况促使医生利用消费者的信任，推荐超出完全信息下所需的服务。然而，这种道德风险成本可以通过将互补服务整合到医生的执业中而带来的规模经济效应来抵消。我们使用台湾的数据来评估道德风险的程度以及规模经济效应，台湾引入了类似美国《斯塔克法案》的“分离”政策，该政策限制医生拥有药店，除非这些药店完全整合到医生的执业中。我们发现，拥有药店的医生处方药物比没有药店的医生多7.6%。总体而言，我们没有发现将药店整合到医生执业中能带来规模经济效应，尤其是在治疗急性呼吸道感染、糖尿病或高血压等疾病时。总的来说，这种分离政策在控制药物成本方面效果不佳，因为大量医生选择将药店整合到他们的执业中，以摆脱该政策的限制。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effect of local immigration enforcement regimes on the migration decisions of the foreign born. Specifically, the analysis uses individual level American Community Survey data to examine the effect of recent 287(g) agreements which allow state and local law enforcement agencies to enforce Federal immigration law. The results suggest that one type of 287(g) agreement - the controversial local "task force" model emphasizing street enforcement - nearly doubles the propensity for the foreign-born to relocate within the United States. The largest effects are observed among non-citizens with college education, suggesting that aggressive enforcement policies may be missing their intended targets. No similar effect is found for the native born. After the extreme case of Maricopa County is excluded, there is no evidence that local enforcement causes the foreign-born to exit the United States or deters their entry from abroad. Rather, 287(g) task force agreements encourage the foreign born to move to a new Census division or region within the United States.

10.3386/w19626.abstractZh: 本文研究了地方移民执法制度对外籍人士迁移决策的影响。具体而言，分析利用美国社区调查数据，考察了近期287(g)协议的效应，该协议允许州和地方执法机构执行联邦移民法律。研究结果表明，其中一种287(g)协议——即具有争议性的“任务组”模式，强调在街头实施执法——使外籍人士在美国境内迁移的倾向几乎翻倍。在受过大学教育的外籍人士中，这种效应最为显著，这表明积极的执法政策可能未能达到预期目标。对于本土出生者则未发现类似效应。在排除了马里科帕县这一极端案例后，没有证据表明地方执法导致外籍人士离开美国或阻止他们从国外入境。相反，287(g)任务组协议实际上鼓励外籍人士迁移到美国境内的新人口普查区或地区。

abstract.text: Conventional theory for private information of adverse selection predicts a positive correlation between insurance coverage and ex post risk. This paper shows the opposite in the life insurance market despite the clear evidence of private information on mortality risk. The reason for this contradictory result is the existence of multiple dimensions of private information. The paper discusses how the private information on insurance preference offsets the effect of the private information on mortality risk. A mixture density model is applied to disentangle these two effects.

10.3386/w19629.abstractZh: 关于逆向选择中私人信息的传统理论预测，保险覆盖程度与事后风险之间存在正相关性。然而，本文在寿险市场中发现相反的情况，尽管有明确的私人死亡风险信息证据。这种矛盾结果的原因在于私人信息的多维度性。文章探讨了保险偏好方面的私人信息如何抵消死亡风险方面私人信息的效应。采用混合密度模型来解析这两种效应之间的关系。

abstract.text: Evidence from behavioral economics reveals that decision-making in health care settings can be affected by circumstances and choice architecture. This paper conducts an analysis of choice of private Medicare plans (Medicare Advantage plans) in Miami-Dade County. We provide a detailed description of the choice of MA plans available in Miami over much of the program's history and the composition of Medicare beneficiaries in Miami over the 2000s. Our analysis suggests that first becoming eligible for Medicare is the key transition point for MA, and that there is significant status quo bias in the MA market. This consumer behavior has important implications for policy that regulates the MA market.

10.3386/w19639.abstractZh: 行为经济学的证据表明，在医疗保健领域，决策过程会受到各种情况和选择结构的影响。本文对迈阿密-戴德县私人医疗保险计划（即医疗保险附加计划）的选择进行了分析。我们详细描述了在迈阿密可用的医疗保险附加计划的历史变化，以及2000年代迈阿密医疗保险受益人的构成情况。我们的分析表明，首次获得医疗保险资格是医疗保险附加计划的关键转折点，并且医疗保险附加市场存在显著的现状偏见。这种消费者行为对监管医疗保险附加市场的政策具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We study the effects of receipts that include personalized ordering suggestions designed to reduce fat and calorie consumption on purchasing behavior at a restaurant chain. We find that customers, in the aggregate, made most of the item substitutions that were encouraged by the messages, such as substituting ham for sausage in a breakfast sandwich, or substituting frozen yogurt for ice cream, though effects on overall calories and fat consumed were small. The results illustrate the potential of emerging information technologies, which allow retailers to tailor product marketing to individual consumers, to contribute in meaningful new ways to the battle against obesity.

10.3386/w19654.abstractZh: 我们研究了包含个性化订购建议的收据对连锁餐厅购买行为的影响，这些建议旨在减少脂肪和卡路里的摄入。研究发现，总体而言，顾客会按照这些建议进行商品替换，例如早餐三明治中用火腿代替香肠，或用冷冻酸奶代替冰淇淋，尽管对总体卡路里和脂肪摄入的影响较小。这些结果说明了新兴信息技术的潜力，该技术使零售商能够针对个体消费者定制产品营销策略，从而为对抗肥胖问题做出有意义的贡献。

abstract.text: I discuss the health transition in the United States, bringing new data to bear on health indicators, and investigating the changing relationship between health, income, and the environment. I argue that scientific advances played an outsize role and that health improvements were largest among the poor. Health improvements were not a precondition for modern economic growth. The gains to health are largest when the economy has moved from "brawn" to "brains" because this is when the wage returns to education are high, leading the healthy to obtain more education. More education may improve use of health knowledge, producing a virtuous cycle.

10.3386/w19685.abstractZh: 我讨论了美国的健康转型问题，通过引入新的数据来研究健康指标，并探讨健康、收入与环境之间关系的变化。我认为科学进步发挥了重要作用，而健康改善在贫困人口中最为显著。健康改善并非现代经济增长的先决条件。当经济从“体力”转向“脑力”时，健康方面的收益最大，因为此时教育的工资回报较高，使得健康的人能够接受更多的教育。更多的教育可能会提高对健康知识的运用，从而形成良性循环。

abstract.text: Why have health care costs moderated in the last decade? Some have suggested the Great Recession alone was the cause, but health expenditure growth in the depths of the recession was nearly identical to growth prior to the recession. Nor can the Affordable Care Act (ACA) can take credit, since the slowdown began prior to its implementation. Instead, we identify three primary causes of the slowdown: the rise in high-deductible insurance plans, state-level efforts to control Medicaid costs, and a general slowdown in the diffusion of new technology, particularly in the Medicare population. A more difficult question is: Will this slowdown continue? Here we are more pessimistic, and not entirely because a similar (and temporary) slowdown occurred in the early 1990s. The primary determinant of long-term growth is the continued development of expensive technology, and there is little evidence of a permanent slowdown in the technology pipeline. Proton beam accelerators are on target to double between 2010 and 2014, while the market for heart-assist devices (costing more than $300,000) is projected to grow rapidly. Accountable care organizations (ACOs) and emboldened insurance companies may yet stifle health care cost growth, but our best estimate over the next two decades is that health care costs will grow at GDP plus 1.2 percent; lower than previous estimates but still on track to cause serious fiscal pain for taxpayers and workers who bear the costs of higher premiums.

10.3386/w19700.abstractZh: 为什么过去十年医疗成本有所放缓？有人认为仅仅是经济大衰退导致了这一趋势，但实际上经济衰退期间医疗支出的增长与衰退前几乎相同。此外，《平价医疗法案》也不能被视为导致医疗成本放缓的原因，因为这一趋势在法案实施之前就已经开始。我们认为，医疗成本放缓主要有三个原因：高免赔额保险计划的增加、各州为控制医疗补助成本所做的努力，以及新技术在医疗领域的普及速度放缓，尤其是在医疗保险领域。一个更棘手的问题是：这种放缓是否会持续？我们认为情况并不乐观，不仅仅是因为在1990年代初也出现过类似的（且是暂时的）放缓。长期增长的主要决定因素仍然是昂贵技术的持续发展，而且几乎没有证据表明技术领域的进步会永久放缓。质子束加速器在2010年至2014年间预计将实现翻倍，而心脏辅助设备的市场（价格超过30万美元）预计将迅速增长。责任医疗组织和更加积极的保险公司或许能够抑制医疗成本的增长，但我们对未来二十年的最佳估计是，医疗成本将以GDP的1.2%的速度增长；虽然低于之前的估计，但仍然会导致纳税人和承担更高保费费用的劳动者面临严重的财政负担。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) will dramatically alter health insurance markets and the sources through which individuals obtain coverage. As the ACA is implemented, it is essential to monitor the intended and the unintended consequences of these regulations. To evaluate the changes in health insurance markets linked to the ACA, it is critical to consistently measure the size and structure of health insurance markets, as well as the performance of participating health insurers, prior to and post-ACA. In this paper we discuss challenges of describing the size, structure, and performance of the individual and small group markets. Next, we discuss improvements in data availability starting in 2010 to address some of these concerns. Finally, using data from the National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC), we evaluate insurance market structure and performance during 2010-2012, focusing on enrollment, the number of participating insurers, premiums, claims spending, MLR, and administrative expenses.

10.3386/w19719.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》（ACA）将极大地改变健康保险市场以及个人获取保险的途径。在《平价医疗法案》实施过程中，监测其预期与非预期的影响至关重要。为了评估与《平价医疗法案》相关的健康保险市场变化，持续衡量健康保险市场的规模与结构，以及参与保险公司的表现，在《平价医疗法案》实施前后都是必要的。本文讨论了描述个人和小团体市场规模、结构和表现所面临的挑战。接下来，我们探讨了自2010年起数据可用性的改善情况，以缓解部分这些问题。最后，利用全国保险委员会协会（NAIC）的数据，我们评估了2010至2012年期间保险市场的结构和表现，重点关注参保人数、参与保险公司数量、保费、理赔支出、平均索赔率以及管理费用。

abstract.text: Disease‐based medical care expenditure indexes are currently of interest to measurement economists and have been the subject of several recent papers. These papers, however, produced widely different results for medical care inflation and also varied in the datasets and methods used, making comparison difficult. In this paper, using two data sources and two different methods for calculating expenditure indexes for the Medicare population, we compare the indexes produced and establish some results that will help guide policymakers in choosing indexes for this population. We compare two methods: the primary diagnosis method and a regression‐based method. The former is preferable because of its transparency but makes stringent demands of the data. We find that when the methods are applied to the same datasets, the primary diagnosis method produces higher average annual aggregate growth rates. The difference implies that the regression‐based method should therefore be employed with caution and only when necessary. We also compare medical care expenditure indexes produced from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey and the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey. The MEPS is the only dataset with diagnoses attached to drug events, which significantly affects the resulting indexes. On balance, however, the MCBS is probably the preferable dataset for Medicare beneficiaries because of its greater sample size and its inclusion of nursing home residents. The optimal index may be a hybrid of the primary diagnosis method applied to Medicare claims and a regression‐based index for pharmaceutical spending. We discuss further avenues for research, such as comparing our results with indexes created with commercial groupers, and what data to use for Medicare private plan enrollees.

10.3386/w19720.abstractZh: 基于疾病的医疗支出指数目前受到计量经济学家的关注，并且已成为几篇近期论文的研究主题。然而，这些论文在医疗支出通胀方面的研究结果存在很大差异，所使用的数据集和方法也各不相同，因此难以进行直接比较。在本文中，我们采用了两个数据来源和两种不同的方法来计算医疗保险参保人群的支出指数，并比较了得出的指数结果，得出了一些有助于政策制定者选择适合该人群的指数的结论。我们比较了两种方法：主要诊断法和基于回归的方法。前者因其透明性而更受青睐，但对其数据的要求也更为严格。我们发现，当这两种方法应用于相同的数据集时，主要诊断法产生的年均综合增长率更高。这一差异表明，基于回归的方法应谨慎使用，且仅在必要时才采用。我们还比较了从医疗保险当前受益人调查和医疗支出面板调查中得出的医疗支出指数。MEPS是唯一包含药物事件相关诊断的数据集，这对最终的指数结果有很大影响。不过，总体而言，由于MEPS的样本量更大，且包含了养老院居民的数据，因此它可能是医疗保险受益人更理想的数据集。最优的指数可能是将主要诊断法应用于医疗保险索赔数据的结果与基于回归的药品支出指数相结合的混合指数。我们还讨论了进一步的研究方向，例如将我们的结果与使用商业数据集得出的指数进行比较，以及对于医疗保险私人计划参保者应使用哪些数据。

abstract.text: This paper exploits a sharp reduction in patient cost sharing at age 70 in Japan, using a regression discontinuity design to examine its effect on utilization, health, and financial risk arising from out-of-pocket expenditures. Due to the national policy, cost sharing is 60-80 percent lower at age 70 than at age 69. I find that both outpatient and inpatient care are price sensitive among the elderly. While I find little impact on mortality and other health outcomes, the results show that reduced cost sharing is associated with lower out-of-pocket expenditures, especially at the right tail of the distribution.

10.3386/w19726.abstractZh: 本文利用回归连续设计，研究了日本在70岁时患者费用分担的显著减少现象，以及这一变化对医疗利用、健康状况和因自付费用而产生的财务风险的影响。由于国家政策的原因，70岁时的费用分担比69岁时低60-80%。研究发现，老年人在门诊和住院护理方面都表现出对价格敏感的特点。虽然对死亡率和其他健康结果的影响较小，但结果表明，费用分担的减少与自付费用的增加有关，尤其是在收入分布较高的群体。

abstract.text: Researchers and policy makers are often interested in estimating how treatments or policy interventions affect the outcomes of those most in need of help. This concern has motivated the increasingly common practice of disaggregating experimental data by groups constructed on the basis of an index of baseline characteristics that predicts the values that individual outcomes would take on in the absence of the treatment. This article shows that substantial biases may arise in practice if the index is estimated, as is often the case, by regressing the outcome variable on baseline characteristics for the full sample of experimental controls. We analyze the behavior of leave-one-out and repeated split sample estimators and show they behave well in realistic scenarios, correcting the large bias problem of the full sample estimator. We use data from the National JTPA Study and the Tennessee STAR experiment to demonstrate the performance of alternative estimators and the magnitude of their biases.

10.3386/w19742.abstractZh: 研究人员和政策制定者通常对评估治疗或政策干预对最需要帮助的人群的影响感兴趣。这种关注促使人们越来越普遍地采用将实验数据按基于基线特征指标构建的群体进行分解的方法，该指标可以预测在没有治疗的情况下个体结果会呈现何种数值。本文指出，如果像通常那样，仅通过回归全样本实验对照组的基线特征变量来估计该指标，则可能会出现重大偏差。我们分析了留一法和重复分割样本估计器的行为，并表明它们在现实场景中表现良好，能够纠正全样本估计器存在的较大偏差问题。我们使用了国家JTPA研究和田纳西STAR实验的数据来展示替代估计器的性能及其偏差的大小。

abstract.text: In this study we examine the importance of assimilation and ethnic enclave residence for smoking outcomes among United States immigrants. We draw data on over 140,000 immigrants from the Current Population Survey Tobacco Use Supplements between 1995 and 2011. Several patterns emerge from our analysis. First we replicate findings from previous studies that show that longer residence in the U.S is associated with improved employment outcomes while ethnic enclave residence may hinder these outcomes. Second, we find that assimilation similarly extends to coverage of employment-based anti-smoking policies such as worksite smoking bans and smoking cessation programs while enclave residence does not substantially influence these outcomes. Third, we document complex relationships between assimilation, enclave residence, and smoking outcomes. Lastly, we find no strong evidence that immigrants reduce their smoking when faced with more restrictive state anti-smoking policies and find counter-intuitive impacts of tobacco taxes. These findings have important policy implications.

10.3386/w19753.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了同化与族裔聚居区居住对美国移民吸烟行为的影响。我们基于1995至2011年的《当前人口调查》烟草使用补充数据，对超过14万移民进行了分析。研究发现，长期居住在美国与更好的就业状况相关，而族裔聚居区居住则可能阻碍这些积极效果。此外，我们发现同化现象同样体现在就业相关的禁烟政策上，如工作场所禁烟令和戒烟计划，而族裔聚居区居住对这些政策的影响并不显著。研究还揭示了同化、族裔聚居区居住与吸烟行为之间的复杂关系。最后，我们发现移民在面对更严格的州级禁烟政策时，并不会减少吸烟行为，同时烟草税的实施也产生了与预期相反的效果。这些发现对政策制定具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Drought is Africa's primary natural disaster and a pervasive source of income risk for poor households. This paper documents the long-run health effects of early life exposure to drought and investigates an important source of heterogeneity in these effects. Combining birth cohort variation in South African Census data with cross-sectional and temporal drought variation, I estimate long-run health impacts of drought exposure among Africans confined to homelands during apartheid. Drought exposure in early childhood significantly raises later life male disability rates by 4% and reduces cohort size. Among a subset of homelands - the TBVC areas - disability effects are double and negative cohort effects are significantly larger. I show that differences in spatial mobility restrictions that influence the extent of migrant networks across TBVC and non-TBVC areas contribute to this heterogeneity. Placebo checks show no differential disability impacts of drought exposure across TBVC and non-TBVC areas after the repeal of migration restrictions. The results show that although drought has significant long-run effects on health human capital, migrant networks in poor economies provide one channel through which families mitigate these negative impacts of local environmental shock.

10.3386/w19756.abstractZh: 干旱是非洲的主要自然灾害，也是贫困家庭收入风险的重要来源。本文记录了早期生活暴露于干旱对健康的长期影响，并探讨了这些影响中重要的异质性来源。通过结合南非人口普查数据中的出生队列差异以及干旱的横向和时序变化，我估计了在种族隔离时期被限制在家园地区的非洲人因干旱暴露而产生的长期健康影响。儿童早期暴露于干旱会显著增加男性后期残疾率4%，并减少群体规模。在部分家园地区——结核病控制区——这种影响是双倍的，而负面群体效应则更为显著。我指出，影响跨结核病控制区与非结核病控制区移民网络范围的空间流动性限制差异，导致了这种异质性。安慰剂检验显示，在废除移民限制后，干旱暴露在结核病控制区与非结核病控制区之间的残疾影响没有差异。结果表明，尽管干旱对健康人力资本有显著的长期影响，但在贫困经济体中，移民网络为家庭提供了缓解当地环境冲击负面影响的途径。

abstract.text: I study the channels through which health insurance influences medical innovation. Following Medicare and Medicaid's passage, I find that U.S.-based medical-equipment patenting rose by 40 to 50 percent relative to both other U.S. patenting and foreign medical-equipment patenting. Within the United States, increases in medical-equipment patenting were most dramatic in states where the Great Society insurance expansions were largest and in which there were large baseline numbers of physicians per resident. Consistent with historical case studies, Medical innovation's determinants extend beyond the potential revenues associated with global market size; a physician driven process of innovation-while-doing appears to play a central role. An extrapolation of the evidence suggests that the last half century's U.S. insurance expansions have driven 25 percent of recent global medical-equipment innovation. In a standard decomposition of health spending growth, this insurance-induced innovation accounts for 15 percent of the long run rise in U.S. health spending in hospitals, physicians' offices, and other clinical settings.

10.3386/w19761.abstractZh: 我研究了健康保险如何影响医疗创新的渠道。在《医疗保险法》和《医疗补助法案》通过之后，我发现美国本土的医疗设备专利数量相对于美国其他领域的专利以及外国医疗设备的专利而言，增加了40%到50%。在美国境内，医疗设备专利数量的增加在那些“伟大社会”保险扩展最为广泛的州最为显著，而且在这些州，每千人口中的医生数量也较多。与历史案例研究一致，医疗创新的决定因素不仅仅局限于与全球市场规模相关的潜在收入；由医生主导的创新过程似乎起着核心作用。根据现有证据推断，过去半个世纪美国保险政策的扩展推动了25%的近期全球医疗设备创新。在标准的健康支出增长分解中，这种由保险政策引发的创新占美国医院、医生诊所和其他临床环境中长期健康支出增长的15%。

abstract.text: Turkey, which is a predominantly Muslim country, enacted an education law in 1997 which increased the compulsory secular education from five to eight years. We employ a unique nation-wide survey of adults in 2012 to investigate the impact of education on religiosity, lifestyles and political preferences by using exposure to the law as an instrument for schooling. The data set includes information about the extent of religiosity, lifestyle choices (e.g. modern, conservative, religious), ethnic background (e.g. Kurd, Turk, Arab) and the religious sect of the respondents (Sunni, Alevite Shii'te, etc.) The results show that the reform had a significant impact on middle school completion for both men and women, with stronger effects on women. An increase in education, generated by exposure to the law, decreases women's propensity to identify themselves as religious. Education also lowers women's tendency to wear a religious head cover (head scarf, religious turban or burka) and it increases their propensity to have a modern lifestyle. Education reduces women's propensity to cast a vote for Islamic parties, but it has no impact on the propensity to vote. Education has no statistically significant impact on men's religiosity or their tendency to vote for Islamic parties. The results are robust to controlling for indicators of individuals' economic well-being as well as variations in empirical specification of the treatment by the law. Using a smaller version of the survey, conducted in 2008, we perform a variety of tests, which demonstrate that the results are not due to a cohort effect. Finally, we show that the effect of education on religiosity and voting preference is not working through migration, residential location or labor force participation.

10.3386/w19769.abstractZh: 土耳其是一个以穆斯林为主的国家，于1997年颁布了一项教育法，将义务教育年限从五年增加到八年。我们采用2012年的一项全国性成人调查，通过考察法律对教育的冲击来研究教育对宗教性、生活方式和政治偏好的影响。数据包括宗教性程度、生活方式选择（如现代、保守、宗教）、种族背景（如库尔德人、土耳其人、阿拉伯人）以及受访者所属的宗教派别（逊尼派、阿列维派、什叶派等）等信息。研究结果显示，这项改革对男女的中学完成率产生了显著影响，且对女性的影响更为明显。由于法律的影响，接受更多教育的女性更倾向于不将自己视为宗教信徒。教育还降低了女性佩戴宗教头饰的倾向，并增加了她们选择现代生活方式的意愿。教育减少了女性投票给伊斯兰政党的倾向，但对投票行为的直接影响并不明显。教育对男性的宗教性或投票给伊斯兰政党的倾向没有显著影响。研究结果在控制个体经济状况指标以及法律实施的具体差异后依然保持稳定。此外，我们通过2008年进行的一项规模较小的调查，进行了多项测试，结果表明这些结果并非由群体效应导致。最后，我们发现教育对宗教性和投票偏好的影响并非通过移民、居住地点或劳动力参与等因素传递。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act's taxes, subsidies, and regulations significantly alter terms of trade in both goods and factor markets. We use a multi-sector (intra-national) trade model to predict and quantify consequences of the Affordable Care Act for the incidence of health insurance coverage and patterns of labor usage. If and when the new exchange plans are competitive with employer-sponsored insurance (ESI), our model suggests that more than 20 million people will leave ESI as a consequence of the law. Behavioral changes that are captured in the model could add about 3 million participants to the new exchange plans: beyond those that would participate solely as the result of employer decisions to stop offering coverage and beyond those who would have been uninsured. Industries and regions will grow, decline, and change coverage on the basis of their relative demand for skilled labor.

10.3386/w19770.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》中的税收、补贴和法规显著改变了商品市场和要素市场的交易条件。我们采用多部门（跨国）贸易模型来预测并量化《平价医疗法案》对健康保险覆盖率和劳动力使用模式的影响。如果新的交换计划能够与雇主提供的保险竞争，我们的模型表明，将有超过2000万人因该法律而放弃使用雇主提供的保险。模型中体现的行为变化可能会使新的交换计划增加约300万参与者：这些新增参与者不仅包括那些因雇主停止提供保险而选择参与的人，还包括那些原本没有保险的人。不同行业和地区的保险需求将因对熟练劳动力的相对需求而发生变化。

abstract.text: This paper develops a new theory of fluctuations—one that helps accommodate the notions of “animal spirits” and “market sentiment” in unique-equilibrium, rational-expectations, macroeconomic models. To this goal, we limit the communication that is embedded in a neoclassical economy by allowing trading to be random and decentralized. We then show that the business cycle may be driven by a certain type of extrinsic shocks which we call sentiments. These shocks formalize shifts in expectations of economic activity without shifts in the underlying preferences and technologies; they are akin to sunspots, but operate in unique-equilibrium models. We further show how communication may help propagate these shocks in a way that resembles the spread of fads and rumors and that gives rise to boom-and-bust phenomena. We finally illustrate the quantitative potential of our insights within a variant of the RBC model.

10.3982/ecta10008.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的波动理论，该理论有助于在独特均衡、理性预期宏观经济模型中容纳“动物精神”和“市场情绪”的概念。为了实现这一目标，我们将新古典经济中的信息传递方式限制为随机且去中心化的形式。随后，我们指出商业周期可能由一种我们称之为“情绪”的外生冲击所驱动。这些冲击实际上是对经济活动预期的变化，而不会改变潜在的偏好和技术；它们类似于太阳黑子，但在独特均衡模型中发挥作用。我们进一步说明了信息传递如何以类似于流行趋势和谣言传播的方式推动这些冲击，从而导致繁荣与萧条的现象。最后，我们通过RBC模型的一个变体，展示了我们这些见解在定量上的潜力。

abstract.text: We investigate the testable implications of the theory of stable matchings. We provide a characterization of the matchings that are rationalizable as stable matchings when agents' preferences are unobserved. The characterization is a simple nonparametric test for stability, in the tradition of revealed preference tests. We also characterize the observed stable matchings when monetary transfers are allowed and the stable matchings that are best for one side of the market: extremal stable matchings. We find that the theory of extremal stable matchings is observationally equivalent to requiring that there be a unique stable matching or that the matching be consistent with unrestricted monetary transfers.

10.3982/ecta10011.abstractZh: 我们研究了稳定匹配理论的可检验含义。我们描述了当代理人的偏好未被观察到时，那些可以合理化为稳定匹配的匹配方式。这种描述是一种简单的非参数稳定性检验方法，属于揭示偏好检验的传统。我们还描述了在允许货币转移的情况下观察到的稳定匹配，以及对于市场一方而言最优的稳定匹配：极端稳定匹配。我们发现，极端稳定匹配的理论在观察上等同于要求存在唯一的稳定匹配，或者匹配结果与不受限制的货币转移一致。

abstract.text: We characterize and prove the existence of Nash equilibrium in a limit order market with a finite number of risk-neutral liquidity providers. We show that if there is sufficient adverse selection, then pointwise optimization (maximizing in p for each q) in a certain nonlinear pricing game produces a Nash equilibrium in the limit order market. The need for a sufficient degree of adverse selection does not vanish as the number of liquidity providers increases. Our formulation of the nonlinear pricing game encompasses various specifications of informed and liquidity trading, including the case in which nature chooses whether the market-order trader is informed or a liquidity trader. We solve for an equilibrium analytically in various examples and also present examples in which the first-order condition for pointwise optimization does not define an equilibrium, because the amount of adverse selection is insufficient.

10.3982/ecta10018.abstractZh: 我们描述了有限数量的风险中性流动性提供者在限价订单市场中存在纳什均衡的情况，并证明了这种均衡的存在。我们指出，如果存在足够多的逆向选择，那么在某种非线性定价游戏中，逐点优化（对每个q分别进行最大化）最终会在限价订单市场中产生纳什均衡。随着流动性提供者数量的增加，对足够逆向选择的需求并不会消失。我们对非线性定价游戏的表述涵盖了各种信息优势和流动性交易的具体情形，包括市场订单交易者是否具备信息优势或作为流动性交易者的情形。我们在多个例子中分析了均衡的存在性，并展示了一些例子中的逐点优化的一阶条件无法定义均衡，因为逆向选择的程度不足。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a symmetry-breaking model of trade with a (large but) finite number of (ex ante) identical countries and a continuum of tradeable goods, which differ in their dependence on local differentiated producer services. Productivity differences across countries arise endogenously through free entry to the local service sector in each country. In any stable equilibrium, the countries sort themselves into specializing in different sets of tradeable goods, and a strict ranking of countries in per capita income, TFP, and the capital-labor ratio emerges endogenously. Furthermore, the distribution of country shares, the Lorenz curve, is unique and analytically solvable in the limit, as the number of countries grows unbounded. Using this limit as an approximation allows us to study what determines the shape of distribution, to perform various comparative statics, and to evaluate the welfare effects of trade.

10.3982/ecta10107.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个对称性破坏的贸易模型，该模型假设存在数量众多但有限的（事先相同的）国家，以及一系列可交易的商品，这些商品在依赖本地差异化生产服务方面存在差异。各国之间的生产力差异是通过自由进入本地服务部门而内生产生的。在任何稳定均衡状态下，各国会自行划分为专门从事不同种类可交易商品的群体，并且人均收入、全要素生产率以及资本劳动比率的严格排序也会内生形成。此外，随着国家数量无限增加，国家份额的分布、洛伦兹曲线在极限情况下是唯一的且可解析求解。利用这一极限作为近似模型，我们可以研究决定分布形态的因素，进行各种比较静态分析，并评估贸易的福利效应。

abstract.text: We study whether priors that admit full surplus extraction (FSE) are generic, an issue that becomes a gauge to evaluate the validity of the current mechanism design paradigm. We consider the space of priors on the universal type space, and thereby relax the assumption of a fixed finite number of types made by Crémer and McLean (1988). We show that FSE priors are topologically generic, contrary to the result of Heifetz and Neeman (2006) that FSE is generically impossible, both geometrically and measure-theoretically. Instead of using the BDP approach or convex combinations of priors adopted in Heifetz and Neeman (2006), we prove our genericity results by showing a robustness property of Crémer–McLean mechanisms.

10.3982/ecta10123.abstractZh: 我们研究是否允许完全超额提取的先验是普遍存在的，这一问题可以作为评估当前机制设计范式有效性的标准。我们考虑了在通用类型空间上的先验空间，从而放宽了Crémer和McLean（1988）关于有限类型数量的假设。我们证明，与Heifetz和Neeman（2006）的结果相反，允许完全超额提取的先验在拓扑上是普遍存在的，无论是在几何上还是测度论上。我们并没有使用Heifetz和Neeman（2006）中采用的贝叶斯决策过程或先验的凸组合方法，而是通过证明Crémer-McLean机制的一种鲁棒性质来证明我们的普遍性结果。

abstract.text: We consider the invertibility (injectivity) of a nonparametric nonseparable demand system. Invertibility of demand is important in several contexts, including identification of demand, estimation of demand, testing of revealed preference, and economic theory exploiting existence of an inverse demand function or (in an exchange economy) uniqueness of Walrasian equilibrium prices. We introduce the notion of “connected substitutes” and show that this structure is sufficient for invertibility. The connected substitutes conditions require weak substitution between all goods and sufficient strict substitution to necessitate treating them in a single demand system. The connected substitutes conditions have transparent economic interpretation, are easily checked, and are satisfied in many standard models. They need only hold under some transformation of demand and can accommodate many models in which goods are complements. They allow one to show invertibility without strict gross substitutes, functional form restrictions, smoothness assumptions, or strong domain restrictions. When the restriction to weak substitutes is maintained, our sufficient conditions are also “nearly necessary” for even local invertibility.

10.3982/ecta10135.abstractZh: 我们研究了非参数非可分离需求系统的可逆性（注入性）。需求的可逆性在多个情境下具有重要意义，包括需求识别、需求估计、显示偏好检验，以及利用逆需求函数的存在性或（在交换经济中）瓦尔拉斯均衡价格的唯一性进行经济理论分析。我们引入了“连通替代品”的概念，并证明这一结构足以保证需求的可逆性。连通替代品条件要求所有商品之间存在弱替代关系，并且需要足够的严格替代关系来将它们视为一个单一的需求系统。这些条件具有清晰的经济学解释，易于验证，并且在许多标准模型中都能得到满足。它们只需在需求的一些变换下成立，并且能够适应许多商品是互补的情况。这些条件允许我们在没有严格的总替代品、函数形式限制、平滑性假设或强域限制的情况下证明可逆性。当保持弱替代品的限制时，我们的充分条件对于局部可逆性也是“几乎必要的”。

abstract.text: We take cohorts of entering freshmen at the United States Air Force Academy and assign half to peer groups designed to maximize the academic performance of the lowest ability students. Our assignment algorithm uses nonlinear peer effects estimates from the historical pre-treatment data, in which students were randomly assigned to peer groups. We find a negative and significant treatment effect for the students we intended to help. We provide evidence that within our “optimally” designed peer groups, students avoided the peers with whom we intended them to interact and instead formed more homogeneous subgroups. These results illustrate how policies that manipulate peer groups for a desired social outcome can be confounded by changes in the endogenous patterns of social interactions within the group.

10.3982/ecta10168.abstractZh: 我们选取了美国空军学院的新生群体，将其中一半学生分配到旨在提升能力最低学生学业表现的同伴小组中。我们的分配算法利用了历史预处理数据中的非线性同伴效应估计，这些数据记录了学生被随机分配到不同同伴小组的情况。我们发现，对于那些我们计划帮助的学生来说，这种分配方式产生了显著的负面效果。我们的研究还表明，在“最优”设计的同伴小组中，学生会避免与那些我们计划让他们互动的同伴交流，而是形成了更加同质化的小组。这些结果说明，旨在实现特定社会结果的政策，可能会受到组内社会互动模式变化的影响。

abstract.text: The aim of this paper is to develop revealed preference tests for Cournot equilibrium. The tests are akin to the widely used revealed preference tests for consumption, but have to take into account the presence of strategic interaction in a game-theoretic setting. The tests take the form of linear programs, the solutions to which also allow us to recover cost information on the firms. To check that these nonparametric tests are sufficiently discriminating to reject real data, we apply them to the market for crude oil.

10.3982/ecta10175.abstractZh: 本文的目的是开发用于库尔诺均衡的显示偏好检验方法。这些检验与广泛使用的消费领域显示偏好检验类似，但必须考虑博弈论环境中战略互动的存在。这些检验以线性程序的形式呈现，其解还允许我们获取有关企业的成本信息。为了验证这些非参数检验是否具有足够的区分能力以拒绝真实数据，我们将其应用于原油市场。

abstract.text: Using centuries of Nile flood data, I document that during deviant Nile floods, Egypt's highest-ranking religious authority was less likely to be replaced and relative allocations to religious structures increased. These findings are consistent with historical evidence that Nile shocks increased this authority's political influence by raising the probability he could coordinate a revolt. I find that the available data provide support for this interpretation and weigh against some of the most plausible alternatives. For example, I show that while Nile shocks increased historical references to social unrest, deviant floods did not increase a proxy for popular religiosity. Together, the results suggest an increase in the political power of religious leaders during periods of economic downturn. [PUBLICATION ABSTRACT]

10.3982/ecta10233.abstractZh: 通过利用数世纪以来的尼罗河洪水数据，我发现，在异常严重的尼罗河洪水期间，埃及最高级别的宗教领袖更不容易被替换，且宗教机构的资金分配相对增加。这些发现与历史证据一致，即尼罗河洪水通过提高宗教领袖协调叛乱的可能性，增强了其政治影响力。我指出，现有数据支持这一解释，并反驳了一些最合理的替代理论。例如，我指出，虽然尼罗河洪水增加了对社会动荡的历史记载，但异常严重的洪水并未增加民众对宗教的虔诚度。综合这些结果，表明在经济衰退时期，宗教领袖的政治权力有所增强。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a new approach to equilibrium selection in repeated games with transfers, supposing that in each period the players bargain over how to play. Although the bargaining phase is cheap talk (following a generalized alternating-offer protocol), sharp predictions arise from three axioms. Two axioms allow the players to meaningfully discuss whether to deviate from their plan; the third embodies a “theory of disagreement”—that play under disagreement should not vary with the manner in which bargaining broke down. Equilibria that satisfy these axioms exist for all discount factors and are simple to construct; all equilibria generate the same welfare. Optimal play under agreement generally requires suboptimal play under disagreement. Whether patient players attain efficiency depends on both the stage game and the bargaining protocol. The theory extends naturally to games with imperfect public monitoring and heterogeneous discount factors, and yields new insights into classic relational contracting questions.

10.3982/ecta10361.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种在包含转移行为的重复博弈中选择均衡的新方法。假设在每个时期，参与者都会就如何参与博弈进行协商。尽管协商阶段只是简单的讨价还价（遵循一种通用的交替报价协议），但三个公理却能给出明确的预测。其中两个公理允许参与者就是否偏离原计划进行有意义的讨论；第三个公理则提出了“分歧理论”——即在不同意见下进行的博弈不应因协商方式的不同而发生变化。满足这些公理的均衡在所有折现因子下都存在，并且易于构建；所有均衡都能产生相同的福利结果。在意见一致的情况下进行最优博弈，通常需要在意见分歧的情况下进行次优博弈。耐心参与博弈的参与者是否能达到效率，取决于阶段博弈和协商协议。该理论自然可以扩展到存在不完美公共监控和异质折现因子的博弈，并为经典的关系契约问题提供了新的见解。

abstract.text: We study a two-stage model where the agent has preferences over menus as in Dekel, Lipman, and Rustichini (2001) in the first period and then makes random choices from menus as in Gul and Pesendorfer (2006) in the second period. Both preference for flexibility in the first period and strictly random choices in the second period can be, respectively, rationalized by subjective state spaces. Our main result characterizes the representation where the two state spaces align, so the agent correctly anticipates her future choices. The joint representation uniquely identifies probabilities over subjective states and magnitudes of utilities across states. We also characterize when the agent completely overlooks some subjective states that realize at the point of choice.

10.3982/ecta10431.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个两阶段模型，其中代理人在第一阶段对菜单有偏好，类似于Dekel、Lipman和Rustichini在2001年提出的模型；在第二阶段，代理人则从菜单中随机选择，类似于Gul和Pesendorfer在2006年提出的模型。第一阶段对灵活性的偏好以及第二阶段严格随机的选择行为，都可以分别通过主观状态空间来合理化。我们的主要结果描述了两种状态空间对齐的情况，即代理人能够准确预测自己的未来选择。这种联合表示方式能够唯一确定主观状态的概率以及不同状态下效用的大小。我们还描述了代理人何时完全忽略了一些在选择时刻才显现的主观状态。

abstract.text: We model a dynamic, competitive market, where in every period, risk-neutral traders trade a one-period bond against an infinitely lived asset, with limited short-selling of the long-term asset. Traders lack structural knowledge and use different “incomplete theories,” all of which give statistically correct beliefs about next period's market price of the long-term asset. The more theories there are in the market, the higher is the equilibrium price of the long-term asset. Investors with more complete theories do not necessarily earn higher returns than those with less complete ones, who can earn above the risk-free rate. We provide two necessary conditions for a trader to earn above the risk-free rate.

10.3982/ecta10499.abstractZh: 我们模拟了一个动态且竞争激烈的市场，在每个时期，风险中性的交易者都会将一期债券与无限存续的资产进行交易，同时长期资产的卖空行为受到限制。交易者缺乏结构性知识，并采用不同的“不完全理论”，所有这些理论都给出了关于下一时期长期资产市场价格的统计上正确的预测。市场上理论越多，长期资产的均衡价格就越高。拥有更完整理论的投资者并不一定比那些拥有较不完整理论的投资者获得更高的回报，后者甚至有可能获得高于无风险利率的回报。我们提出了两个条件，使得交易者能够获得高于无风险利率的回报。

abstract.text: A group of peers must choose one of them to receive a prize; everyone cares only about winning, not about who gets the prize if someone else. An award rule is impartial if one's message never influences whether or not one wins the prize. We explore the consequences of impartiality when each agent nominates a single (other) agent for the prize. On the positive side, we construct impartial nomination rules where both the influence of individual messages and the requirements to win the prize are not very different across agents. Partition the agents in two or more districts, each of size at least 3, and call an agent a local winner if he is nominated by a majority of members of his own district; the rule selects a local winner with the largest support from nonlocal winners, or a fixed default agent in case there is no local winner. On the negative side, impartiality implies that ballots cannot be processed anonymously as in plurality voting. Moreover, we cannot simultaneously guarantee that the winner always gets at least one nomination, and that an agent nominated by everyone else always wins.

10.3982/ecta10523.abstractZh: 一群同龄人必须选出一名候选人获得奖励；每个人只关心获胜，而不关心如果有人获得奖励时谁会得到奖励。如果某种奖励规则不会影响到个人是否赢得奖励，那么这种规则就是公正的。我们探讨了当每个代理人都提名一名其他代理人获得奖励时，公正性的后果。从积极的一面来看，我们构建了两种公正的提名规则，在这些规则中，个人消息的影响以及赢得奖励的要求在不同代理人之间并没有太大差异。将代理人分成多个区域，每个区域至少有3个成员，如果一个代理人被其所在区域的大多数成员提名，那么他就是本地获胜者；该规则会选出获得非本地获胜者最多支持的本地获胜者，如果没有本地获胜者，则选择默认的默认代理人。从消极的一面来看，公正性意味着选票不能像多数投票那样匿名处理。此外，我们无法同时保证获胜者总是至少获得一个提名，以及被其他所有人提名的代理人总是能够获胜。

abstract.text: We present two examples of discounted stochastic games, each with a continuum of states, finitely many players, and actions, that possess no stationary equilibria. The first example has deterministic transitions—an assumption undertaken in most of the early applications of dynamics games in economics—and perfect information, and does not possess even stationary approximate equilibria or Markovian equilibria. The second example satisfies, in addition to stronger regularity assumptions, that all transitions are absolutely continuous with respect to a fixed measure—an assumption that has been widely used in more recent economic applications. This assumption has been undertaken in several positive results on the existence of stationary equilibria in special cases, and in particular, guarantees the existence of stationary approximate equilibria.

10.3982/ecta10530.abstractZh: 我们展示了两个 discounted stochastic games 的例子，每个例子都包含连续的状态、有限数量的玩家和动作，并且没有静态均衡。第一个例子具有确定性转换——这一假设在经济学中动态博弈的早期应用中被广泛采用——并且信息是完全的，甚至没有静态近似均衡或马尔可夫均衡。第二个例子除了满足更强的规律性假设外，还满足所有转换相对于一个固定的测度是绝对连续的——这一假设在最近的经济学应用中被广泛使用。这一假设在几个关于特殊情况下静态均衡存在性的正面结果中被采用，并且特别保证了静态近似均衡的存在。

abstract.text: We develop an asymptotic theory for the pre-averaging estimator when asset price jumps are weakly identified, here modeled as local to zero. The theory unifies the conventional asymptotic theory for continuous and discontinuous semimartingales as two polar cases with a continuum of local asymptotics, and explains the breakdown of the conventional procedures under weak identification. We propose simple bias-corrected estimators for jump power variations, and construct robust confidence sets with valid asymptotic size in a uniform sense. The method is also robust to certain forms of microstructure noise.

10.3982/ecta10534.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于资产价格跳跃弱识别情况下预平均估计量的渐近理论，这里将跳跃模型视为局部零值。该理论将连续半鞅和离散半鞅的传统渐近理论统一为两个极端情况，并通过一系列局部渐近分析来解释在弱识别条件下传统方法的失效。我们提出了简单的偏差校正估计量来处理跳跃功率的变化，并构建了具有有效渐近大小的稳健置信区间。该方法还对某些形式的微观结构噪声具有鲁棒性。

abstract.text: Branch selection is a key decision in a cadet's military career. Cadets at USMA can increase their branch priorities at a fraction of slots by extending their service agreement. This real-life matching problem fills an important gap in the market design literature, providing strong empirical legitimacy to a series of elegant theoretical works on matching with contracts. Although priorities fail a key substitutes condition, the agent-optimal stable mechanism is well defined, and in contrast to the current USMA mechanism it is fair, stable, strategy-proof, and respects improvements in cadet priorities. Adoption of this mechanism benefits cadets and the Army. This new application shows that the matching with contracts model is practically relevant beyond traditional domains that satisfy the substitutes condition.

10.3982/ecta10570.abstractZh: 分支选择是军校学员军事生涯中的一个关键决策。美国军事学院的学生可以通过延长服务协议，以较低的成本提升自己心仪的分支优先顺序。这一现实中的匹配问题填补了市场设计理论中的一个重要空白，为一系列关于合同匹配的理论研究提供了强有力的实证支持。尽管优先顺序未能满足关键的替代条件，但代理人最优的稳定机制仍然清晰明确。与当前美国军事学院的机制相比，这一机制更为公平、稳定、不受策略影响，并且能够适应学员优先顺序的改进。采用这一机制对学员和军队都有益处。这一新的应用表明，合同匹配模型在超越传统领域的实际应用中也具有相关性，只要满足替代条件即可。

abstract.text: Counterfactual distributions are important ingredients for policy analysis and decomposition analysis in empirical economics. In this article, we develop modeling and inference tools for counterfactual distributions based on regression methods. The counterfactual scenarios that we consider consist of ceteris paribus changes in either the distribution of covariates related to the outcome of interest or the conditional distribution of the outcome given covariates. For either of these scenarios, we derive joint functional central limit theorems and bootstrap validity results for regression-based estimators of the status quo and counterfactual outcome distributions. These results allow us to construct simultaneous confidence sets for function-valued effects of the counterfactual changes, including the effects on the entire distribution and quantile functions of the outcome as well as on related functionals. These confidence sets can be used to test functional hypotheses such as no-effect, positive effect, or stochastic dominance. Our theory applies to general counterfactual changes and covers the main regression methods including classical, quantile, duration, and distribution regressions. We illustrate the results with an empirical application to wage decompositions using data for the United States. As a part of developing the main results, we introduce distribution regression as a comprehensive and flexible tool for modeling and estimating the entire conditional distribution. We show that distribution regression encompasses the Cox duration regression and represents a useful alternative to quantile regression. We establish functional central limit theorems and bootstrap validity results for the empirical distribution regression process and various related functionals.

10.3982/ecta10582.abstractZh: 反事实分布是实证经济学中政策分析和分解分析的重要工具。在本文中，我们基于回归方法开发了反事实分布的建模和推断工具。我们考虑的反事实情景包括与结果变量相关的协变量分布或给定协变量时结果的条件分布在“其他条件不变”情况下的变化。对于这两种情景，我们推导出了基于回归的估计量对现状和反事实结果分布的联合函数中心极限定理以及自助法有效性结果。这些结果使我们能够构建反事实变化的函数值效应的同时置信集，包括对整个结果分布和分位数函数的效应，以及相关函数的效应。这些置信集可用于检验诸如无效应、正效应或随机优势等函数假设。我们的理论适用于一般性的反事实变化，并涵盖了包括经典回归、分位数回归、持续时间回归和分布回归在内的主要回归方法。我们通过使用美国数据对工资分解进行实证应用来说明这些结果。作为主要结果的一部分，我们引入了分布回归作为一种全面且灵活的建模和估计整个条件分布的工具。我们表明，分布回归包含了Cox持续时间回归，并且是分位数回归的一个有用替代方法。我们为实证分布回归过程以及各种相关函数建立了函数中心极限定理和自助法有效性结果。

abstract.text: We consider a standard social choice environment with linear utilities and independent, one-dimensional, private types. We prove that for any Bayesian incentive compatible mechanism there exists an equivalent dominant strategy incentive compatible mechanism that delivers the same interim expected utilities for all agents and the same ex ante expected social surplus. The short proof is based on an extension of an elegant result due to Gutmann, Kemperman, Reeds, and Shepp (1991). We also show that the equivalence between Bayesian and dominant strategy implementation generally breaks down when the main assumptions underlying the social choice model are relaxed or when the equivalence concept is strengthened to apply to interim expected allocations.

10.3982/ecta10592.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个具有线性效用函数且各私人类型独立的一维标准社会选择环境。我们证明了对于任何贝叶斯激励兼容机制，都存在一个等效的主导策略激励兼容机制，该机制能够为所有代理人提供相同的临时预期效用，并且能够实现相同的先验预期社会收益。这一简短的证明基于Gutmann、Kemperman、Reeds和Shepp在1991年提出的一个优雅结果的扩展。我们还表明，当社会选择模型的基本假设被放宽，或者当等价概念被加强以适用于临时预期分配时，贝叶斯与主导策略实施之间的等价性通常会被破坏。

abstract.text: What preferences will prevail in a society of rational individuals when preference evolution is driven by the resulting payoffs? We show that when individuals' preferences are their private information, a convex combination of selfishness and morality stands out as evolutionarily stable. We call individuals with such preferences homo moralis. At one end of the spectrum is homo oeconomicus, who acts so as to maximize his or her own payoff. At the opposite end is homo kantiensis, who does what would be “the right thing to do,” in terms of payoffs, if all others would do likewise. We show that the stable degree of morality—the weight placed on the moral goal—is determined by the degree of assortativity in the process whereby individuals are matched to interact.

10.3982/ecta10637.abstractZh: 在理性个体组成的社会中，当偏好演变由所产生的收益驱动时，哪些偏好会占主导地位？我们指出，当个体的偏好属于私人信息时，自私与道德的结合体在进化上是最稳定的。我们将具有这种偏好的个体称为“道德人”。一端是“经济人”，他们的行为旨在最大化自己的收益；另一端是“康德人”，他们会根据收益来判断“正确行为”，前提是所有其他个体也会如此行事。我们证明，道德稳定性的程度——即对道德目标的重视程度——取决于个体之间互动匹配过程中的同配性程度。

abstract.text: This paper derives optimal inheritance tax formulas that capture the key equity-efficiency trade-off, are expressed in terms of estimable sufficient statistics, and are robust to the underlying structure of preferences. We consider dynamic stochastic models with general and heterogeneous bequest tastes and labor productivities. We limit ourselves to simple but realistic linear or two-bracket tax structures to obtain tractable formulas. We show that long-run optimal inheritance tax rates can always be expressed in terms of aggregate earnings and bequest elasticities with respect to tax rates, distributional parameters, and social preferences for redistribution. Those results carry over with tractable modifications to (a) the case with social discounting (instead of steady-state welfare maximization), (b) the case with partly accidental bequests, (c) the standard Barro–Becker dynastic model. The optimal tax rate is positive and quantitatively large if the elasticity of bequests to the tax rate is low, bequest concentration is high, and society cares mostly about those receiving little inheritance. We propose a calibration using micro-data for France and the United States. We find that, for realistic parameters, the optimal inheritance tax rate might be as large as 50%–60%—or even higher for top bequests, in line with historical experience.

10.3982/ecta10712.abstractZh: 本文推导了最优遗产税公式，这些公式能够捕捉关键的股权效率权衡，并以可估计的充足统计量来表示，同时能够适应不同偏好结构。我们考虑了具有一般性和异质性遗产偏好以及劳动生产率的动态随机模型。我们仅采用简单但现实的线性或双档税结构，以获得易于处理的公式。我们证明，长期最优遗产税率总是可以用总收入以及遗产对税率、分配参数和社会对再分配偏好弹性的关系来表示。这些结果可以通过简单的修改应用于：(a) 社会折现的情况（而非稳态福利最大化）；(b) 部分偶然遗产分配的情况；(c) 标准的Barro–Becker王朝模型。如果遗产对税率的弹性较低、遗产集中度较高，且社会主要关注那些继承较少遗产的人，那么最优税率将是正值且数量较大。我们提出了一种使用法国和美国微观数据的校准方法。我们发现，在现实参数下，最优遗产税率可能高达50%–60%，对于最高额遗产来说甚至更高，这与历史经验相符。

abstract.text: We develop a property-rights model of the firm in which production entails a continuum of uniquely sequenced stages. In each stage, a final-good producer contracts with a distinct supplier for the procurement of a customized stage-specific component. Our model yields a sharp characterization for the optimal allocation of ownership rights along the value chain. We show that the incentive to integrate suppliers varies systematically with the relative position (upstream versus downstream) at which the supplier enters the production line. Furthermore, the nature of the relationship between integration and downstreamness depends crucially on the elasticity of demand faced by the final-good producer. Our model readily accommodates various sources of asymmetry across final-good producers and across suppliers within a production line, and we show how it can be taken to the data with international trade statistics. Combining data from the U.S. Census Bureau's Related Party Trade database and estimates of U.S. import demand elasticities from Broda and Weinstein (2006), we find empirical evidence broadly supportive of our key predictions. In the process, we develop two novel measures of the average position of an industry in the value chain, which we construct using U.S. Input-Output Tables.

10.3982/ecta10813.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个企业产权模型，其中生产过程包含一系列独特顺序的阶段。在每个阶段，最终产品生产者与特定的供应商签订合同，以采购特定阶段的定制组件。我们的模型对价值链上所有权的最佳分配进行了精确描述。我们发现，整合供应商的动机会随着供应商进入生产线的相对位置（上游或下游）而系统性地变化。此外，整合与下游位置之间的关系性质，在很大程度上取决于最终产品生产者面临的需求弹性。我们的模型能够轻松适应最终产品生产者之间以及生产线内供应商之间各种不对称情况，并且我们展示了如何将这一模型应用于国际贸易统计数据。结合美国人口普查局的相关方贸易数据库的数据，以及Broda和Weinstein（2006年）对美国进口需求弹性的估计，我们发现这些证据在很大程度上支持了我们的关键预测。在此过程中，我们还提出了两种衡量行业在价值链中平均位置的新方法，这些方法是根据美国的投入产出表构建的。

abstract.text: This paper examines three distinct hypothesis testing problems that arise in the context of identification of some nonparametric models with endogeneity. The first hypothesis testing problem we study concerns testing necessary conditions for identification in some nonparametric models with endogeneity involving mean independence restrictions. These conditions are typically referred to as completeness conditions. The second and third hypothesis testing problems we examine concern testing for identification directly in some nonparametric models with endogeneity involving quantile independence restrictions. For each of these hypothesis testing problems, we provide conditions under which any test will have power no greater than size against any alternative. In this sense, we conclude that no nontrivial tests for these hypothesis testing problems exist.

10.3982/ecta10851.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在识别某些非参数模型与内生性关系时出现的三个不同的假设检验问题。我们首先研究的第一个假设检验问题涉及检验某些非参数模型中涉及均值独立性限制下的识别必要条件。这些条件通常被称为完备性条件。第二个和第三个假设检验问题则涉及直接检验某些非参数模型中涉及分位数独立性限制下的识别问题。对于每一个假设检验问题，我们都提出了条件，根据这些条件，任何检验的效能都不会超过某种特定规模，相对于任何替代假设而言。因此，我们得出结论，这些假设检验问题不存在非平凡性的检验方法。

abstract.text: Across a wide set of non-group insurance markets, applicants are rejected based on observable, often high-risk, characteristics. This paper argues that private information, held by the potential applicant pool, explains rejections. I formulate this argument by developing and testing a model in which agents may have private information about their risk. I first derive a new no-trade result that theoretically explains how private information could cause rejections. I then develop a new empirical methodology to test whether this no-trade condition can explain rejections. The methodology uses subjective probability elicitations as noisy measures of agents beliefs. I apply this approach to three non-group markets: long-term care, disability, and life insurance. Consistent with the predictions of the theory, in all three settings I find significant amounts of private information held by those who would be rejected; I find generally more private information for those who would be rejected relative to those who can purchase insurance; and I show it is enough private information to explain a complete absence of trade for those who would be rejected. The results suggest private information prevents the existence of large segments of these three major insurance markets.

10.3982/ecta10931.abstractZh: 在众多非团体保险市场中，申请者往往因为一些可观察到的、通常具有高风险的特征而被拒绝。本文认为，潜在申请者所持有的私人信息能够解释这些拒绝现象。我通过构建并测试一个模型来阐述这一论点，该模型假设代理人可能掌握有关自身风险的信息。首先，我推导出一个新的无交易结果，从理论上解释了私人信息如何导致拒绝。随后，我开发了一种新的实证方法，以检验这种无交易条件是否能够解释拒绝现象。该方法采用主观概率估计作为代理人信念的噪声度量。我将这种方法应用于三个非团体市场：长期护理、残疾保险和人寿保险。与理论预测一致，我在这三个市场中都发现，被拒绝的人持有大量的私人信息；与能够购买保险的人相比，被拒绝的人通常拥有更多的私人信息；并且，这些私人信息足以解释为什么被拒绝的人完全没有进行任何交易。这些结果表明，私人信息阻止了这三个主要保险市场中的大量细分市场的发展。

abstract.text: We analyze games of incomplete information and offer equilibrium predictions that are valid for, and in this sense robust to, all possible private information structures that the agents may have. The set of outcomes that can arise in equilibrium for some information structure is equal to the set of Bayes correlated equilibria. We completely characterize the set of Bayes correlated equilibria in a class of games with quadratic payoffs and normally distributed uncertainty in terms of restrictions on the first and second moments of the equilibrium action–state distribution. We derive exact bounds on how prior knowledge about the private information refines the set of equilibrium predictions. We consider information sharing among firms under demand uncertainty and find new optimal information policies via the Bayes correlated equilibria. We also reverse the perspective and investigate the identification problem under concerns for robustness to private information. The presence of private information leads to set rather than point identification of the structural parameters of the game.

10.3982/ecta11105.abstractZh: 我们分析了不完全信息下的博弈，并提出了适用于所有可能私人信息结构的均衡预测。在某些信息结构下，均衡可能出现的 outcome 集合等同于贝叶斯相关均衡的集合。我们完全描述了具有二次支付和正态分布不确定性的博弈类中的贝叶斯相关均衡集合，这些描述基于对均衡行动-状态分布的一阶和二阶矩的限制。我们推导出了关于先验知识对私人信息了解如何影响均衡预测集合的精确界限。我们考虑了在需求不确定性下的企业间信息共享问题，并通过贝叶斯相关均衡找到了新的最优信息策略。我们还反过来研究了在关注对私人信息鲁棒性的情况下，识别问题。私人信息的存在导致了对博弈结构参数的集合式而非点式识别。

abstract.text: This paper presents a theoretical and empirical analysis of the role of life expectancy for optimal schooling and lifetime labor supply. The results of a simple prototype Ben-Porath model with age-specific survival rates show that an increase in lifetime labor supply is not a necessary, or a sufficient, condition for greater life expectancy to increase optimal schooling. The observed increase in survival rates during working ages that follows from the “rectangularization” of the survival function is crucial for schooling and labor supply. The empirical results suggest that the relative benefits of schooling have been increasing across cohorts of U.S. men born between 1840 and 1930. A simple quantitative analysis shows that a realistic shift in the survival function can lead to an increase in schooling and a reduction in lifetime labor hours.

10.3982/ecta11169.abstractZh: 本文对预期寿命在最佳教育水平和终身劳动力供给中的作用进行了理论和实证分析。通过简单的Ben-Porath模型及年龄特定存活率的计算，发现终身劳动力供给的增加并非提高预期寿命从而增加最佳教育的必要条件或充分条件。在劳动年龄阶段，由于存活函数的“矩形化”效应导致的存活率提升，对教育和劳动力供给具有关键作用。实证结果表明，1840年至1930年间出生的美国男性各年龄组的教育相对收益一直在增加。简单的定量分析表明，对存活函数进行现实性的调整，能够提升教育水平并减少终身劳动时间。

abstract.text: We develop a network-flow approach for characterizing interim-allocation rules that can be implemented by ex post allocations. Our method can be used to characterize feasible interim allocations in general multi-unit auctions where agents face capacity constraints, both ceilings and floors. Applications include a variety of settings of practical interest, ranging from individual and group-specific capacity constraints, set-aside sale, partnership dissolution, and government license reallocation.

10.3982/ecta11405.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种网络流方法，用于描述可以通过事后分配来实施的临时分配规则。该方法可用于描述一般多单位拍卖中的可行临时分配方案，其中参与方面临容量限制，包括上限和下限。应用范围包括各种具有实际意义的场景，如个人和团体特定的容量限制、预留销售、合作伙伴关系解散以及政府许可证重新分配等。

abstract.text: A choice function is backwards-induction rationalizable if there exists a finite perfect-information extensive-form game such that for each subset of alternatives, the backwards-induction outcome of the restriction of the game to that subset of alternatives coincides with the choice from that subset. We prove that every choice function is backwards-induction rationalizable.

10.3982/ecta11419.abstractZh: 如果一个有限且信息完全完备的扩展形式博弈存在，并且对于每一个备选方案子集，将该博弈限制在該子集上的逆向归纳结果与该子集中选择的方案一致，那么这个选择函数就是逆向归纳可化的。我们证明了每一个选择函数都是逆向归纳可化的。

abstract.text: I investigate the role of demand shocks in the ready-mix concrete industry. Using Census data on more than 15,000 plants, I estimate a model of investment and entry in oligopolistic markets. These estimates are used to simulate the effect of eliminating short-term local demand changes. A policy of smoothing the volatility of demand has a market expansion effect: The model predicts a 39% increase in the number of plants in the industry. Since bigger markets have both more plants and larger plants, a demand-smoothing fiscal policy would increase the share of large plants by 20%. Finally, the policy of smoothing demand reduces entry and exit by 25%, but has no effect on the rate at which firms change their size.

10.3982/ecta6877.abstractZh: 我研究了需求冲击在预拌混凝土行业中的作用。利用人口普查数据，对超过15,000家工厂进行了研究，并构建了一个关于寡头市场中投资和进入模型的估计。这些估计用于模拟消除短期局部需求变化的影响。平滑需求波动的政策具有市场扩张效应：模型预测该行业工厂数量将增加39%。由于更大的市场意味着更多的工厂和更大的工厂规模，因此需求平滑的财政政策将使大型工厂的比例增加20%。最后，需求平滑政策减少了25%的进入和退出情况，但对企业规模变化的速率没有影响。

abstract.text: This paper constructs an e cient, budget-balanced, Bayesian incentive-compatible mechanism for a general dynamic environment with private information.As an intermediate result, we construct an e cient, ex post incentive-compatible mechanism, which is not budget balanced.We also provide conditions under which participation constraints can be satis ed in each period, so that the mechanism can be made self-enforcing if the horizon is in nite and players are su ciently patient.In our dynamic environment, agents observe a sequence of private signals over a number of periods (either nite or countable).In each period, the agents report their private signals, and make public (contractible) and private decisions based on the reports.The probability distribution over future signals may depend on both past signals and past decisions.The construction of an e cient mechanism hinges on the assumption of \private values" (each agent's payo is determined by his own observations).Balancing the budget relies on the assumption of \independent types" (the distribution of each agent's private signals does not depend on the other agents' private information, except through public decisions).

10.3982/ecta6995.abstractZh: 本文构建了一种在具有私人信息的动态环境中，既高效又符合预算平衡且能实现贝叶斯激励兼容的机制。作为中间结果，我们构建了一种高效且事后激励兼容的机制，但该机制并不符合预算平衡的要求。我们还提出了在每个时期满足参与约束的条件，这样如果时间范围无限且参与者足够耐心，该机制就能实现自我强制执行。在我们的动态环境中，代理人会在多个时期内观察到一系列私人信号（可以是无限期或可数的）。在每个时期，代理人会报告他们的私人信号，并根据这些报告做出公开（可协商）和私下的决策。未来信号的概率分布可能取决于过去的信号和决策。构建高效机制的前提是假设“私人价值”的存在（每个代理人的收益由他自己的观察决定）。预算平衡则依赖于“独立类型”的假设（每个代理人的私人信号分布不依赖于其他代理人的私人信息，除非通过公开决策）。

abstract.text: This article investigates how product positioning decisions in the radio industry would be affected if, as has recently been proposed, music stations have to pay fees for musical performance rights. A rich dynamic model, which captures many features of the industry such as multi-station ownership, economies of scope and both vertical and horizontal product differentiation, is formulated, estimated and (approximately) re-solved for different levels of fee, by applying the method of parametric policy function iteration in the context of a dynamic game. The estimated model predicts that fees could have substantial effects on product positioning. For example, if music stations have to pay 10% of their revenues as performance fees – which would be consistent with the fees currently paid by cable and satellite providers – the number of music stations would fall by 11% over a 15 year period. The article also considers how industry characteristics such as heterogeneous listener tastes, multi-station ownership and substantial repositioning costs affect the size and speed of adjustment.

10.3982/ecta7473.abstractZh: 本文探讨了如果像最近提出的那样，音乐电台必须支付音乐表演权费用，这一变化将如何影响广播行业的产品定位决策。本文构建了一个包含多个行业特征的动态模型，包括多电台所有权、范围经济以及垂直和水平的产品差异化。通过应用参数化政策函数迭代方法，本文对不同费用水平下的模型进行了估计和近似求解。估计结果显示，费用可能会对产品定位产生显著影响。例如，如果音乐电台必须将其收入的10%用于支付表演费用——这与目前有线电视和卫星电视提供商所支付的费用一致——那么在15年内，音乐电台的数量将减少11%。本文还考虑了行业特征，如不同的听众口味、多电台所有权以及巨大的重新定位成本，这些因素将影响行业的调整规模和速度。

abstract.text: Recurrent intervals of inattention to the stock market are optimal if consumers incur a utility cost to observe asset values.When consumers observe the value of their wealth, they decide whether to transfer funds between a transactions account from which consumption must be financed and an investment portfolio of equity and riskless bonds.Transfers of funds are subject to a transactions cost that reduces wealth and consists of two components: one is proportional to the amount of assets transferred, and the other is a fixed resource cost.Because it is costly to transfer funds, the consumer may choose not to transfer any funds on a particular observation date.In general, the optimal adjustment rule---including the size and direction of transfers, and the time of the next observation---is state-dependent.Surprisingly, unless the fixed resource cost of transferring funds is large, the consumer's optimal behavior eventually evolves to a situation with a purely time-dependent rule with a constant interval of time between observations.This interval of time can be substantial even for tiny observation costs.When this situation is attained, the standard consumption Euler equation holds between observation dates if the consumer is sufficiently risk averse.

10.3982/ecta7624.abstractZh: 如果消费者在观察资产价值时会产生效用成本，那么对股市的频繁忽视其实是最优的。当消费者观察自己的财富价值时，他们会决定是否将资金从用于消费融资的交易账户转移到股票和无风险债券的投资组合中。资金转移会面临一种交易成本，这种成本会减少财富，并且由两部分组成：一部分与转移的资产数量成正比，另一部分是固定的资源成本。由于转移资金的成本较高，消费者可能会在某个观察日期选择不转移任何资金。一般来说，最优的调整规则——包括转移的大小和方向以及下一次观察的时间——是依赖于状态的。令人惊讶的是，除非转移资金的固定资源成本很高，否则消费者的最优行为最终会演变成一种完全依赖于时间的规则，观察之间的时间间隔是恒定的。即使观察成本很低，这个时间间隔也可能相当大。当达到这种情况时，如果消费者足够厌恶风险，那么在观察日期之间，标准的消费欧拉方程仍然成立。

abstract.text: If voter preferences depend on a noisy state variable, under what conditions do large elections deliver outcomes “as if” the state were common knowledge? While the existing literature models elections using the jury metaphor where a change in information regarding the state induces all voters to switch in favor of only one alternative, we allow for more general preferences where a change in information can induce a switch in favor of either alternative. We show that information is aggregated for any voting rule if, for a randomly chosen voter, the probability of switching in favor of one alternative is strictly greater than the probability of switching away from that alternative for any given change in belief over states. If the preference distribution violates this condition, there exist equilibria that produce outcomes different from the full information outcome with high probability for large classes of voting rules. In other words, unless preferences closely conform to the jury metaphor, information aggregation is not guaranteed to obtain.

10.3982/ecta8311.abstractZh: 如果选民的偏好取决于一个存在噪声的状态变量，那么在什么情况下，大型选举会呈现出“仿佛”该状态是普遍知识的结果？现有文献通常使用“陪审团”这一隐喻来描述选举过程，即关于状态的信息变化会促使所有选民只选择一种替代方案。然而，我们允许更一般的偏好情况，即信息变化可以促使选民选择另一种替代方案。我们证明，对于任何投票规则，如果对于随机选择的选民来说，选择某种替代方案的概率严格大于选择另一种替代方案的概率，那么信息就会进行聚合。如果偏好分布不满足这一条件，那么对于大多数投票规则来说，存在产生与完全信息结果不同的结果的概率很高。换句话说，除非偏好与“陪审团”隐喻非常接近，否则信息聚合并不一定能实现。

abstract.text: Fiscal foresight --the phenomenon that legislative and implementation lags ensure that private agents receive clear signals about the tax rates they face in the future --is intrinsic to the tax policy process.This paper develops an analytical framework to study the econometric implications of fiscal foresight.Simple theoretical examples show that foresight produces equilibrium time series with nonfundamental representations, which misalign the agents' and the econometrician's information sets.Economically meaningful shocks to taxes, therefore, cannot generally be extracted from statistical innovations in conventional ways.Econometric analyses that fail to align agents' and the econometrician's information sets can produce distorted inferences about the effects of tax policies.The paper documents the sensitivity of econometric inferences of tax effects to details about how tax information flows into the economy.We show that alternative assumptions about the information flows that give rise to fiscal foresight can reconcile the diverse empirical findings in the literature on anticipated tax changes.

10.3982/ecta8337.abstractZh: 财政预见——即立法与实施之间的滞后现象，能够确保私人主体获得关于未来税收率的明确信息——是税收政策过程的内在特征。本文构建了一个分析框架，以研究财政预见所带来的计量经济学影响。简单的理论示例表明，财政预见产生的均衡时间序列具有非基本特征，这导致主体与计量经济学家的信息集出现错位。因此，经济上有意义的税收冲击通常无法以传统方式从统计创新中得出。未能使主体与计量经济学家的信息集对齐的计量经济学分析，可能会得出关于税收政策效果的扭曲推断。本文还揭示了计量经济学对税收效果推断的敏感性，以及税收信息如何流入经济的具体细节。我们表明，关于信息流动的不同假设可以调和文献中关于预期税收变化的不同实证研究结果。

abstract.text: Nonseparable panel models are important in a variety of economic settings, including discrete choice. This paper gives identification and estimation results for nonseparable models under time-homogeneity conditions that are like “time is randomly assigned” or “time is an instrument.” Partial-identification results for average and quantile effects are given for discrete regressors, under static or dynamic conditions, in fully nonparametric and in semiparametric models, with time effects. It is shown that the usual, linear, fixed-effects estimator is not a consistent estimator of the identified average effect, and a consistent estimator is given. A simple estimator of identified quantile treatment effects is given, providing a solution to the important problem of estimating quantile treatment effects from panel data. Bounds for overall effects in static and dynamic models are given. The dynamic bounds provide a partial-identification solution to the important problem of estimating the effect of state dependence in the presence of unobserved heterogeneity. The impact of T, the number of time periods, is shown by deriving shrinkage rates for the identified set as T grows. We also consider semiparametric, discrete-choice models and find that semiparametric panel bounds can be much tighter than nonparametric bounds. Computationally convenient methods for semiparametric models are presented. We propose a novel inference method that applies in panel data and other settings and show that it produces uniformly valid confidence regions in large samples. We give empirical illustrations.

10.3982/ecta8405.abstractZh: 不可分离面板模型在多种经济环境中都具有重要意义，包括离散选择模型。本文给出了在时间一致性条件下，针对不可分离模型的识别与估计结果，这些条件类似于“时间被随机分配”或“时间作为工具变量”。对于离散回归变量，在静态或动态条件下，无论是完全非参数模型还是半参数模型中，都给出了平均效应和分位数效应的部分识别结果，同时考虑了时间效应。研究表明，通常的线性固定效应估计量并非识别平均效应的一致估计量，而本文给出了一个一致估计量。此外，还给出了识别分位数处理效应的简单估计量，为从面板数据中估计分位数处理效应这一重要问题提供了解决方案。文中还给出了静态和动态模型中总体效应的界限，动态界限为在存在未观测异质性时，估计状态依赖性效应提供了部分识别解决方案。通过推导随着时间周期数T增长时识别集合的收缩率，本文还研究了T的影响。同时，我们考虑了半参数离散选择模型，发现半参数面板界限通常比非参数界限更为严格。文中还提出了适用于半参数模型的计算便捷方法。我们提出了一种新颖的推断方法，该方法适用于面板数据及其他场景，并证明该方法在大样本中能够产生一致有效的置信区间。最后，文中还给出了实证案例说明。

abstract.text: In this paper, we use indirect inference to estimate a joint model of earnings, employment, job changes, wage rates, and work hours over a career. We use the model to address a number of important questions in labor economics, including the source of the experience profile of wages, the response of job changes to outside wage offers, and the effects of seniority on job changes. We also study the dynamic response of wage rates, hours, and earnings to various shocks, and measure the relative contributions of the shocks to the variance of earnings in a given year and over a lifetime. We find that human capital accounts for most of the growth of earnings over a career, although job seniority and job mobility also play significant roles. Unemployment shocks have a large impact on earnings in the short run, as well as a substantial long-term effect that operates through the wage rate. Shocks associated with job changes and unemployment make a large contribution to the variance of career earnings and operate mostly through the job-specific error components of wages and hours.

10.3982/ecta8415.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们采用间接推断方法，来估计一个关于收入、就业、工作变动、工资率和工作小时数的联合模型，这些变量在职业生涯中发生变化。我们利用该模型来探讨劳动经济学中的几个重要问题，包括工资经验的来源、工作变动对外部工资报价的反应，以及资历对工作变动的影响。我们还研究了工资率、工作小时数和收入对各种冲击的动态响应，并衡量了这些冲击在特定年份和整个生命周期中对收入方差的相对贡献。我们发现，人力资本在职业生涯中收入增长中起着重要作用，尽管工作资历和工作流动性也扮演着重要角色。失业冲击在短期内对收入有重大影响，同时在长期上也会产生显著的影响，这种影响通过工资率体现出来。与工作变动和失业相关的冲击对职业收入的方差有较大的贡献，并且主要通过工资和工作小时数的特定误差成分来发挥作用。

abstract.text: This paper is concerned with robust estimation under moment restrictions. A moment restriction model is semiparametric and distribution-free; therefore it imposes mild assumptions. Yet it is reasonable to expect that the probability law of observations may have some deviations from the ideal distribution being modeled, due to various factors such as measurement errors. It is then sensible to seek an estimation procedure that is robust against slight perturbation in the probability measure that generates observations. This paper considers local deviations within shrinking topological neighborhoods to develop its large sample theory, so that both bias and variance matter asymptotically. The main result shows that there exists a computationally convenient estimator that achieves optimal minimax robust properties. It is semiparametrically efficient when the model assumption holds, and, at the same time, it enjoys desirable robust properties when it does not.

10.3982/ecta8617.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在矩限制条件下的稳健估计问题。矩限制模型是一种半参数模型，并且具有分布无关性；因此，它只需要一些简单的假设。然而，由于测量误差等各种因素，观测值的概率分布可能会与理想分布有所偏差。因此，寻找一种能够抵御概率分布轻微扰动影响的估计方法是非常合理的。本文考虑了在收缩拓扑邻域内发生的局部偏差，从而发展出大样本理论，使得偏差和方差在渐近意义上都具有重要性。主要结果表明，存在一种计算上方便且能实现最优最小最大稳健性质的估计方法。当模型假设成立时，该方法具有半参数效率；而当模型假设不成立时，它仍然具有理想的稳健性质。

abstract.text: This paper considers random coefficients binary choice models. The main goal is to estimate the density of the random coefficients nonparametrically. This is an ill-posed inverse problem characterized by an integral transform. A new density estimator for the random coefficients is developed, utilizing Fourier–Laplace series on spheres. This approach offers a clear insight on the identification problem. More importantly, it leads to a closed form estimator formula that yields a simple plug-in procedure requiring no numerical optimization. The new estimator, therefore, is easy to implement in empirical applications, while being flexible about the treatment of unobserved heterogeneity. Extensions including treatments of nonrandom coefficients and models with endogeneity are discussed.

10.3982/ecta8675.abstractZh: 本文探讨了随机系数二元选择模型。主要目标是非参数地估计随机系数的密度。这是一个病态的逆问题，其特点是通过积分变换来解决。文中提出了一种新的随机系数密度估计方法，该方法利用球面上的傅里叶-拉普拉斯级数。这种方法为识别问题提供了清晰的思路。更重要的是，它提供了一种封闭形式的估计公式，只需简单的插值过程，无需数值优化。因此，这种新的估计方法在实证应用中易于实施，同时能够灵活处理未观测到的异质性。文中还讨论了包括非随机系数处理以及具有内生性模型在内的扩展问题。

abstract.text: We develop a practical and novel method for inference on intersection bounds, namely bounds defined by either the infimum or supremum of a parametric or nonparametric function, or, equivalently, the value of a linear programming problem with a potentially infinite constraint set. We show that many bounds characterizations in econometrics, for instance bounds on parameters under conditional moment inequalities, can be formulated as intersection bounds. Our approach is especially convenient for models comprised of a continuum of inequalities that are separable in parameters, and also applies to models with inequalities that are nonseparable in parameters. Since analog estimators for intersection bounds can be severely biased in finite samples, routinely underestimating the size of the identified set, we also offer a median-bias-corrected estimator of such bounds as a by-product of our inferential procedures. We develop theory for large sample inference based on the strong approximation of a sequence of series or kernel-based empirical processes by a sequence of “penultimate” Gaussian processes. These penultimate processes are generally not weakly convergent, and thus are non-Donsker. Our theoretical results establish that we can nonetheless perform asymptotically valid inference based on these processes. Our construction also provides new adaptive inequality/moment selection methods. We provide conditions for the use of nonparametric kernel and series estimators, including a novel result that establishes strong approximation for any general series estimator admitting linearization, which may be of independent interest.

10.3982/ecta8718.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种实用且新颖的推断方法，用于求解交集界限，即由参数函数或非参数函数的下确界或上确界定义的界限，或者等价地，由具有潜在无限约束集的线性规划问题的值所定义的界限。我们证明，在计量经济学中许多界限表征，例如条件矩不等式下参数的界限，都可以被表述为交集界限。我们的方法特别适用于由一系列在参数上可分离的不等式构成的模型，也适用于那些在参数上不可分离的不等式模型。由于在有限样本情况下，用于求解交集界限的类似估计量可能会严重偏差，从而经常低估被识别集合的大小，我们还提出了一种中位数偏差校正估计量，作为我们推理程序的副产品。我们基于一系列基于系列或核的经验过程被一系列“前倒数”高斯过程强逼近的理论，发展了大样本推断方法。这些前倒数过程通常不是弱收敛的，因此是非Donsker过程。我们的理论结果表明，我们仍然可以基于这些过程进行渐近有效的推断。我们的构造还提供了新的自适应不等式/矩选择方法。我们提供了使用非参数核和系列估计量的条件，包括一个新颖的结果，该结果建立了任何允许线性化的通用系列估计量的强逼近性，这可能具有独立的兴趣。

abstract.text: This paper proposes two new estimators for determining the number of factors (r) in static approximate factor models. We exploit the well-known fact that the r largest eigenvalues of the variance matrix of N response variables grow unboundedly as N increases, while the other eigenvalues remain bounded. The new estimators are obtained simply by maximizing the ratio of two adjacent eigenvalues. Our simulation results provide promising evidence for the two estimators.

10.3982/ecta8968.abstractZh: 本文提出了两种新的估计方法，用于确定静态近似因子模型中的因子数量（r）。我们利用了这样一个众所周知的事实：当N增加时，N个响应变量的方差矩阵中最大的r个特征值会无限增长，而其他特征值则保持有限。这两种新的估计方法是通过最大化两个相邻特征值之比来获得的。我们的模拟结果为这两种估计方法提供了有希望的证据。

abstract.text: We argue that positive co-movements between land prices and business investment are a driving force behind the broad impact of land-price dynamics on the macroeconomy. We develop an economic mechanism that captures the co-movements by incorporating two key features into a DSGE model: We introduce land as a collateral asset in firms' credit constraints, and we identify a shock that drives most of the observed fluctuations in land prices. Our estimates imply that these two features combine to generate an empirically important mechanism that amplifies and propagates macroeconomic fluctuations through the joint dynamics of land prices and business investment.

10.3982/ecta8994.abstractZh: 我们认为，土地价格与商业投资之间的正向联动是土地价格动态对宏观经济产生广泛影响的驱动力。我们开发了一种经济机制，通过将两个关键特征纳入DSGE模型来捕捉这种联动关系：我们将土地作为企业信贷约束中的抵押资产，并识别出一种能够驱动土地价格大部分波动的冲击因素。我们的估计表明，这两个特征结合在一起，形成了一个在实证上具有重要意义的机制，能够通过土地价格与商业投资的联合动态放大并传播宏观经济波动。

abstract.text: A dynamic structural model of labor supply, welfare participation, and food stamp participation is estimated using the 1992, 1993, and 1996 panels of the Survey of Income and Program Participation. Details of various policies including welfare time limits, work requirements, and Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) are incorporated formally in the budget constraint. Policy simulations reveal that the economy accounts for half of the increase in the labor supply of female heads of family between 1992 and 1999. A time limit results in a larger efficiency gain than a work requirement or a direct reduction in welfare benefits. A reform package can lead to both a reduction in the government expenditure and an improvement in utility. The EITC expansion results in a substantial efficiency gain among individuals with the lowest expected wage. These individuals are almost unaffected by the economic expansion, but their income and utility increase significantly under the reform package.

10.3982/ecta9075.abstractZh: 本文采用1992年、1993年和1996年的《收入与计划参与调查》数据，构建了一个关于劳动力供给、福利参与和食品券领取行为的动态结构模型。模型中正式纳入了各种政策因素，包括福利时间限制、工作要求以及劳动所得税收抵免（EITC）。政策模拟结果显示，在1992年至1999年间，经济因素对女性家庭主妇劳动力供给的增加起到了重要作用，其贡献占比为一半。时间限制政策带来的效率提升幅度大于工作要求或直接削减福利措施。一项改革方案可以同时减少政府支出并提高效用。扩大EITC政策能够显著提升预期工资最低群体的效率，这些群体几乎不受经济扩张的影响，但在改革方案下，他们的收入和效用都会显著增加。

abstract.text: It is well known that, in misspecified parametric models, the maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) is consistent for the pseudo-true value and has an asymptotically normal sampling distribution with “sandwich” covariance matrix. Also, posteriors are asymptotically centered at the MLE, normal, and of asymptotic variance that is, in general, different than the sandwich matrix. It is shown that due to this discrepancy, Bayesian inference about the pseudo-true parameter value is, in general, of lower asymptotic frequentist risk when the original posterior is substituted by an artificial normal posterior centered at the MLE with sandwich covariance matrix. An algorithm is suggested that allows the implementation of this artificial posterior also in models with high dimensional nuisance parameters which cannot reasonably be estimated by maximizing the likelihood.

10.3982/ecta9097.abstractZh: 众所周知，在错误指定的参数模型中，最大似然估计量对于伪真实值具有一致性，并且其抽样分布具有“三明治”协方差矩阵，且分布呈渐近正态分布。此外，后验分布渐近地集中在最大似然估计量上，且方差渐近地呈正态分布，不过这种渐近方差通常与三明治协方差矩阵不同。研究表明，由于这种差异，当用以最大似然估计量为中心、具有三明治协方差矩阵的人造正态分布替代原始后验时，关于伪真实参数值的贝叶斯推断的渐近频率风险通常会降低。文中还提出了一种算法，该算法允许在具有高维干扰参数的模型中实现这种人造后验分布，这些参数无法通过最大化似然来合理估计。

abstract.text: Few microfinance-funded businesses grow beyond subsistence entrepreneurship. This paper considers one possible explanation: that the structure of existing microfinance contracts may discourage risky but high-expected-return investments. To explore this possibility, I develop a theory that unifies models of investment choice, informal risk-sharing, and formal financial contracts. I then test the predictions of this theory using a series of experiments with clients of a large microfinance institution in India.
