The experiments confirm the theoretical predictions that joint liability creates two potential inefficiencies. First, borrowers free-ride on their partners, making risky investments without compensating partners for this risk. Second, the addition of peer-monitoring overcompensates, leading to sharp reductions in risk-taking and profitability. Equity-like financing, in which partners share both the benefits and risks of more profitable projects, overcomes both of these inefficiencies and merits further testing in the field.

10.3982/ecta9100.abstractZh: 很少有由小额信贷资助的企业能够发展到超越自给自足的创业水平。本文提出了一种可能的解释：现有小额信贷合同的结构可能会抑制风险高但预期回报高的投资。为了探讨这一可能性，我提出了一个理论，将投资选择、非正式风险分担和正式金融合同模型结合起来。随后，我通过一系列实验来验证这一理论的预测，这些实验是在印度一家大型小额信贷机构的客户身上进行的。实验结果证实了理论预测，即连带责任会导致两个潜在效率低下的情况。首先，借款人会利用合作伙伴的优势进行高风险投资，而不对合作伙伴承担的风险进行补偿。其次，引入同行监督机制会过度补偿，导致风险承担能力和盈利能力显著下降。类似股权融资的方式，即合作伙伴共同承担更有利可图项目的收益和风险，能够克服这两种效率低下的问题，值得在实地进一步验证。

abstract.text: In this note, we prove an equilibrium existence theorem for games with discontinuous payoffs and convex and compact strategy spaces. It generalizes the classical result of Reny (1999), as well as the recent paper of McLennan, Monteiro, and Tourky (2011). Our conditions are simple and easy to verify. Importantly, examples of spatial location models show that our conditions allow for economically meaningful payoff discontinuities, that are not covered by other conditions in the literature.

10.3982/ecta9125.abstractZh: 在这篇论文中，我们证明了对于具有不连续收益和凸紧策略空间的博弈，均衡存在的定理。这一结果推广了Reny在1999年提出的经典结果，以及McLennan、Monteiro和Tourky在2011年发表的论文。我们的条件简单且易于验证。重要的是，通过空间位置模型的例子表明，我们的条件允许出现经济上有意义的收益不连续性，而这些不连续性在其他文献中的条件中并未被涵盖。

abstract.text: Different people use language in different ways. We capture this by making language competence—the set of messages an agent can use and understand—private information. Our primary focus is on common-interest games. Communication generally remains possible; it may be severely impaired even with common knowledge that language competence is adequate; and, indeterminacy of meaning, the confounding of payoff-relevant information with information about language competence, is optimal.

10.3982/ecta9183.abstractZh: 不同的人使用语言的方式各不相同。我们将语言能力——即一个主体能够使用和理解的信息集合——视为私有信息。我们的主要关注点是共同兴趣游戏。通常情况下，沟通仍然是可能的；即使知道语言能力是充足的，沟通也可能受到严重阻碍；而且，意义的模糊性，即支付相关信息与语言能力信息之间的混淆，是理想的。

abstract.text: We study the role of incomplete information and outside options in determining bargaining postures and surplus division in repeated bargaining between a long-run player and a sequence of short-run players. The outside option is not only a disagreement point but reveals information privately held by the long-run player. In equilibrium, the uninformed short-run players' offers do not always respond to changes in reputation and the informed long-run player's payoffs are discontinuous. The long-run player invokes inefficient random outside options repeatedly in order to build reputation to a level where the subsequent short-run players succumb to his extraction of a larger payoff, but he also runs the risk of losing reputation and relinquishing bargaining power. We investigate equilibrium properties when the discount factor goes to 1 and when the informativeness of outside option diffuses. In both cases, bargaining outcomes become more inefficient and the limit reputation building probabilities are interior.

10.3982/ecta9200.abstractZh: 我们研究了不完整信息和外部选项在长期玩家与一系列短期玩家之间重复谈判中，对谈判姿态和剩余分配的影响。外部选项不仅是一个分歧点，还揭示了长期玩家私有的信息。在均衡状态下，不知情的短期玩家的提议并不总是能反映声誉的变化，而知情的长期玩家的收益是不连续的。长期玩家会反复利用低效的随机外部选项来建立声誉，以至于后续的短期玩家会屈服于他更大的收益索取，但他也会面临失去声誉和谈判权力的风险。我们研究了当折现因子趋近于1以及外部选项的信息含量扩散时，均衡特性如何变化。在这两种情况下，谈判结果都变得更加低效，声誉建立的概率都是内部性的。

abstract.text: We consider a general representation of the delegation problem, with and without money burning, and provide sufficient and necessary conditions under which an interval allocation is optimal. We also apply our results to the theory of trade agreements among privately informed governments. For both perfect and monopolistic competition settings, we provide conditions under which tariff caps are optimal. [PUBLICATION ABSTRACT]

10.3982/ecta9288.abstractZh: 我们考虑了委托问题的一般表述方式，包括存在和不存在资金消耗的情况，并提出了区间分配最优化的充分必要条件。我们还将我们的研究结果应用于私人知情政府之间贸易协议的理论。对于完全竞争和垄断竞争两种情形，我们提出了关税上限最优化的条件。[出版物摘要]

abstract.text: In this paper, we propose an instrumental variable approach to constructing confidence sets (CS's) for the true parameter in models defined by conditional moment inequalities/equalities. We show that by properly choosing instrument functions, one can transform conditional moment inequalities/equalities into unconditional ones without losing identification power. Based on the unconditional moment inequalities/equalities, we construct CS's by inverting Cramér–von Mises-type or Kolmogorov–Smirnov-type tests. Critical values are obtained using generalized moment selection (GMS) procedures. We show that the proposed CS's have correct uniform asymptotic coverage probabilities. New methods are required to establish these results because an infinite-dimensional nuisance parameter affects the asymptotic distributions. We show that the tests considered are consistent against all fixed alternatives and typically have power against n−1/2-local alternatives to some, but not all, sequences of distributions in the null hypothesis. Monte Carlo simulations for five different models show that the methods perform well in finite samples.

10.3982/ecta9370.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种利用工具变量方法来构建置信集的方法，用于由条件矩不等式/等式定义的模型中获取真实参数的估计值。我们表明，通过正确选择工具函数，可以将条件矩不等式/等式转换为无条件矩不等式/等式，同时不损失识别能力。基于无条件矩不等式/等式，我们通过反转Cramér–von Mises型或Kolmogorov–Smirnov型检验来构建置信集。临界值是通过广义矩选择（GMS）程序获得的。我们证明所提出的置信集具有正确的均匀渐近覆盖概率。由于无限维的干扰参数会影响渐近分布，因此需要新的方法来验证这些结果。我们表明，所考虑的检验对所有固定替代假设都是一致的，并且通常对零假设中某些但不是所有分布序列的n−1/2局部替代假设具有足够的检验功效。针对五种不同模型的蒙特卡洛模拟表明，这些方法在有限样本情况下表现良好。

abstract.text: We consider the estimation of dynamic panel data models in the presence of incidental parameters in both dimensions: individual fixed-effects and time fixed-effects, as well as incidental parameters in the variances. We adopt the factor analytical approach by estimating the sample variance of individual effects rather than the effects themselves. In the presence of cross-sectional heteroskedasticity, the factor method estimates the average of the cross-sectional variances instead of the individual variances. The method thereby eliminates the incidental-parameter problem in the means and in the variances over the cross-sectional dimension. We further show that estimating the time effects and heteroskedasticities in the time dimension does not lead to the incidental-parameter bias even when T and N are comparable. Moreover, efficient and robust estimation is obtained by jointly estimating heteroskedasticities.

10.3982/ecta9409.abstractZh: 我们考虑在存在偶然参数的情况下，对动态面板数据模型进行估计，这些偶然参数存在于两个维度：个体固定效应和时间固定效应，以及方差中的偶然参数。我们采用因子分析法，通过估计个体效应的样本方差而不是效应本身来进行估计。在存在横截面异方差性的情况下，因子方法估计的是横截面方差的平均值，而不是个体方差。这样，该方法消除了横截面维度上均值和方差中的偶然参数问题。我们进一步证明，即使在T和N可比的情况下，对时间维度中的时间效应和异方差性进行估计也不会导致偶然参数偏差。此外，通过联合估计异方差性，可以获得高效且稳健的估计结果。

abstract.text: We introduce and apply a new nonparametric approach to identification and inference on data from ascending auctions. We exploit variation in the number of bidders across auctions to nonparametrically identify useful bounds on seller profit and bidder surplus using a general model of correlated private values that nests the standard IPV model. We also translate our identified bounds into closed form and asymptotically valid confidence intervals for several economic measures of interest. Applying our methods to much-studied U.S. Forest Service timber auctions, we find evidence of correlation among values after controlling for a rich vector of relevant auction covariates; this correlation causes expected profit, the profit-maximizing reserve price, and bidder surplus to be substantially lower than conventional (IPV) analysis of the data would suggest. ∗ We are very thankful to the editor Jean-Marc Robin and three anonymous referees for their insightful feedback;

10.3982/ecta9431.abstractZh: 我们引入并应用了一种新的非参数方法，用于识别和分析递增拍卖数据。我们利用不同拍卖中投标者数量的变化，通过一种包含标准IPV模型的相关私人价值的一般模型，非参数地确定了卖方利润和投标者剩余的有用界限。我们还将这些确定的界限转化为封闭形式的渐近有效置信区间，用于评估多个经济指标。将我们的方法应用于广泛研究的美国森林服务部门木材拍卖，我们发现，在控制了大量相关拍卖协变量后，各价值之间存在相关性；这种相关性导致预期利润、利润最大化的保留价格以及投标者剩余远低于传统（IPV）数据分析所预测的数值。我们非常感谢编辑Jean-Marc Robin和三位匿名审稿人的宝贵意见。

abstract.text: We propose a bubble game that involves sequential trading of an asset commonly known to be valueless. Because no trader is ever sure to be last in the market sequence, the game allows for a bubble at the Nash equilibrium when there is no cap on the maximum price. We run experiments both with and without a price cap. Structural estimation of behavioral game theory models suggests that quantal responses and analogy-based expectations are important drivers of speculation.

10.3982/ecta9433.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个泡沫游戏，该游戏涉及对一种通常被认为无价值的资产进行连续交易。由于没有任何交易者能够确定自己会在市场序列中处于最后的位置，因此该游戏在不存在最高价格限制的情况下，其纳什均衡点会出现泡沫现象。我们进行了有无价格限制的实验。行为博弈论模型的结构性估计表明，量化反应和基于类比的预期是投机行为的重要驱动因素。

abstract.text: The impact of R&D on growth through spillovers has been a major topic of economic research over the last thirty years. A central problem in the literature is that firm performance is affected by two countervailing “spillovers” : a positive effect from technology (knowledge) spillovers and a negative business stealing effects from product market rivals. We develop a general framework incorporating these two types of spillovers and implement this model using measures of a firm's position in technology space and productmarket space. Using panel data on U.S. firms, we show that technology spillovers quantitatively dominate, so that the gross social returns to R&D are at least twice as high as the private returns. We identify the causal effect of R&D spillovers by using changes in federal and state tax incentives for R&D. We also find that smaller firms generate lower social returns to R&D because they operate more in technological niches. Finally, we detail the desirable properties of an ideal spillover measure and how existing approaches, including our new Mahalanobis measure, compare to these criteria.

10.3982/ecta9466.abstractZh: 过去三十年间，研发对经济增长的影响通过溢出效应这一主题一直是经济学研究的重要课题。文献中的一个核心问题是，企业绩效受到两种相互矛盾的“溢出效应”的影响：一种是来自技术（知识）溢出的正面效应，另一种是来自产品市场竞争对手的负面业务窃取效应。我们构建了一个包含这两种溢出效应的通用框架，并使用企业技术领域和产品市场领域的指标来实施该模型。通过对美国企业的面板数据进行分析，我们发现技术溢出效应在数量上占据主导地位，因此研发的总社会回报至少是私人回报的两倍。我们通过研究联邦和州政府对研发活动的税收激励变化，确定了研发溢出效应的因果效应。此外，我们还发现小型企业由于更多地在技术细分市场中运营，因此产生的研发社会回报较低。最后，我们详细阐述了理想溢出效应的衡量标准，并比较了现有方法，包括我们的新马氏距离度量方法，与这些标准之间的差距。

abstract.text: We study repeated Bayesian games with communication and observable actions in which the players' privately known payoffs evolve according to an irreducible Markov chain whose transitions are independent across players. Our main result implies that, generically, any Pareto-efficient payoff vector above a stationary minmax value can be approximated arbitrarily closely in a perfect Bayesian equilibrium as the discount factor goes to 1. As an intermediate step, we construct an approximately efficient dynamic mechanism for long finite horizons without assuming transferable utility.

10.3982/ecta9557.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有通信和可观察行为的重复贝叶斯博弈，其中玩家的私人收益根据一个不可约的马尔可夫链演变，该链的转换在玩家之间是独立的。我们的主要结果表明，一般来说，任何高于稳定最小最大值的帕累托有效收益向量，在折扣因子趋近于1时，可以在完美贝叶斯均衡中被任意接近地近似。作为中间步骤，我们构建了一个近似有效的动态机制，适用于长期有限的时间范围，且无需假设可转移效用。

abstract.text: We study the asymptotic distribution of three-step estimators of a finite-dimensional parameter vector where the second step consists of one or more nonparametric regressions on a regressor that is estimated in the first step. The first-step estimator is either parametric or nonparametric. Using Newey's (1994) path-derivative method, we derive the contribution of the first-step estimator to the influence function. In this derivation, it is important to account for the dual role that the first-step estimator plays in the second-step nonparametric regression, that is, that of conditioning variable and that of argument.

10.3982/ecta9609.abstractZh: 我们研究了有限维参数向量的三步估计量的渐近分布，其中第二步包括对第一步中估计出的回归变量进行一个或多个非参数回归。第一步的估计量可以是参数估计量或非参数估计量。利用Newey在1994年提出的路径导数方法，我们推导了第一步估计量对影响函数的贡献。在这一推导过程中，需要考虑到第一步估计量在第二步非参数回归中的双重角色，即作为条件变量和作为参数变量的角色。

abstract.text: We investigate the role of deeply-rooted pre-colonial ethnic institutions in shaping comparative regional development within African countries. We combine information on the spatial distribution of ethnicities before colonization with regional variation in contemporary economic performance, as proxied by satellite images of light density at night. We document a strong association between pre-colonial ethnic political centralization and regional development. This pattern is not driven by differences in local geographic features or by other observable ethnic-specific cultural and economic variables. The strong positive association between pre-colonial political complexity and contemporary development obtains also within pairs of adjacent ethnic homelands with different legacies of pre-colonial political institutions.

10.3982/ecta9613.abstractZh: 我们研究了根深蒂固的殖民前民族制度在非洲国家区域发展中所起的作用。我们将殖民前各民族的空间分布信息与当代经济绩效的区域差异结合起来，后者通过夜间光密度卫星图像来反映。我们发现，殖民前民族的政治集权程度与区域发展之间存在强烈的关联。这种关联并非由当地地理特征的差异或其他可观察到的民族特定文化和经济变量所驱动。即使在那些殖民前政治制度传承不同的相邻民族领地之间，殖民前政治复杂性与当代发展之间也存在强烈的正相关关系。

abstract.text: Dynamic models of ambiguity aversion are increasingly popular in applied work. This paper shows that there is a strong interdependence in such models between the ambiguity attitude and the preference for the timing of the resolution of uncertainty, as defined by the classic work of Kreps and Porteus (1978). The modeling choices made in the domain of ambiguity aversion influence the set of modeling choices available in the domain of timing attitudes. The main result is that the only model of ambiguity aversion that exhibits indifference to timing is the maxmin expected utility of Gilboa and Schmeidler (1989). This paper examines the structure of the timing nonindifference implied by the other commonly used models of ambiguity aversion. This paper also characterizes the indifference to long-run risk, a notion introduced by Duffie and Epstein (1992). The interdependence of ambiguity and timing that this paper identifies is of interest both conceptually and practically—especially for economists using these models in applications.

10.3982/ecta9619.abstractZh: 动态模型在应用经济学研究中越来越受到重视。本文指出，在这类模型中，模糊性态度与不确定性解决时机偏好之间存在强烈的相互依赖性，这一关系与Kreps和Porteus在1978年提出的经典理论一致。在模糊性态度领域所做的建模选择会影响在时机态度领域可使用的建模选择。主要结论是，唯一一个对时机选择无偏见的模糊性态度模型是Gilboa和Schmeidler在1989年提出的maxmin期望效用模型。本文还探讨了其他常用模糊性态度模型所隐含的时机非无差异性结构。此外，本文还描述了Duffie和Epstein在1992年提出的对长期风险的无差异性概念。本文所揭示的模糊性与时机选择的相互依赖性在概念上和实践上都具有重要意义，尤其对于在应用中使用这些模型的经济学家来说。

abstract.text: This paper extends the subjective expected utility model of decision making under uncertainty to include incomplete beliefs and tastes. The main results are two axiomatizations of the multiprior expected multiutility representations of preference relations under uncertainty. The paper also introduces new axiomatizations of Knightian uncertainty and the expected multiutility model with complete beliefs.

10.3982/ecta9621.abstractZh: 本文将不确定性下的决策主观期望效用模型扩展至包含不完全信念和偏好。主要成果包括两种对不确定性下偏好关系的多先验期望多效用表示式的公理化表述。此外，本文还提出了关于奈特不确定性以及具有完全信念下的期望多效用模型的新公理化描述。

abstract.text: We derive the analogue of the classic Arrow-Pratt approximation of the certainty equivalent under model uncertainty as defined by the smooth model of decision making under ambiguity of Klibanoff, Marinacci and Mukerji (2005). We study its scope via a portfolio allocation exercise that delivers a tractable mean-variance model adjusted for model uncertainty. In a problem with a risk-free asset, a risky asset, and an ambiguous asset, we find that portfolio rebalancing in response to higher model uncertainty only depends on the ambiguous asset's alpha, setting the performance of the risky asset as benchmark. In addition, the portfolios recommended by our model are not systematically conservative on the share held in the ambiguous asset: indeed, in general, it is not true that greater ambiguity reduces the optimal demand for the ambiguous asset. The analytical tractability of the enhanced Arrow-Pratt approximation renders our model especially well suited for calibration exercises aimed at exploring the consequences of ambiguity aversion on equilibrium asset prices.

10.3982/ecta9678.abstractZh: 我们推导了经典Arrow-Pratt近似方法的类比，该方法用于描述在模型不确定性下的确定性等价，该方法由Klibanoff、Marinacci和Mukerji在2005年提出的关于在模糊性情境下决策制定的平滑模型定义。我们通过一个投资组合分配练习来研究其适用范围，该练习提供了一个适用于模型不确定性的可处理的平均-方差模型。在一个包含无风险资产、风险资产以及模糊性资产的问题中，我们发现，为了应对更高的模型不确定性而进行投资组合重新调整，仅取决于模糊性资产的阿尔法值，从而将风险资产的表现作为基准。此外，我们模型推荐的投资组合在模糊性资产中的持有比例并不系统性地保守：实际上，一般来说，更大的模糊性并不会降低对模糊性资产的最优需求。这种增强的Arrow-Pratt近似方法的分析可处理性使得我们的模型特别适合用于校准练习，以探索模糊性厌恶对均衡资产价格的影响。

abstract.text: We study selection rules: the procedures committees use to choose whether to place an issue on their agenda. At the selection stage of the model, committee members are uncertain about their final preferences. They only know the probability that they will prefer the proposal to the status quo at the decision stage. This probability is private information. Then the probability that the proposal is adopted conditional on a voter being pivotal and eventually preferring the proposal increases at a faster rate with the selection rule than the same probability conditional on her eventually preferring the status quo. To compensate for that, voters become more conservative when the selection rule is more stringent. The decision rule has the opposite effect. We describe optimal rules at the limit when there is a linear cost of organizing the final election.

10.3982/ecta9709.abstractZh: 我们研究了选择规则：即委员会用来决定是否将某个议题列入议程的程序。在模型的选择阶段，委员会成员对其最终偏好并不确定。他们只知道在决策阶段选择该提案而非现状的概率，这一概率是私人信息。然后，如果选民是关键选民并且最终选择该提案，那么该提案被采纳的概率随着选择规则的严格程度而迅速增加。为了弥补这一点，当选择规则更严格时，选民会变得更加保守。而决策规则则会产生相反的效果。我们描述了在组织最终选举的成本为线性时的最优规则。

abstract.text: Belief disagreements have been suggested as a major contributing factor to the recent subprime mortgage crisis. This paper theoretically evaluates this hypothesis. I assume that optimists have limited wealth and take on leverage so as to take positions in line with their beliefs. To have a significant effect on asset prices, they need to borrow from traders with pessimistic beliefs using loans collateralized by the asset itself. Since pessimists do not value the collateral as much as optimists do, they are reluctant to lend, which provides an endogenous constraint on optimists' ability to borrow and to influence asset prices. I demonstrate that the tightness of this constraint depends on the nature of belief disagreements. Optimism concerning the probability of downside states has no or little effect on asset prices because these types of optimism are disciplined by this constraint. Instead, optimism concerning the relative probability of upside states could have significant effects on asset prices. This asymmetric disciplining effect is robust to allowing for short selling because pessimists that borrow the asset face a similar endogenous constraint. These results emphasize that what investors disagree about matters for asset prices, to a greater extent than the level of disagreements. When richer contracts are available, relatively complex contracts that resemble some of the recent financial innovations in the mortgage market endogenously emerge to facilitate betting.

10.3982/ecta9956.abstractZh: 信念分歧被认为是近期次贷危机的一个重要因素。本文从理论角度对这一假设进行了评估。我假设乐观主义者拥有有限的财富，并采用杠杆作用来根据他们的信念进行投资。为了对资产价格产生显著影响，他们需要向信念悲观的交易者借款，且借款的抵押物为资产本身。由于悲观主义者对抵押物的估值不如乐观主义者高，他们不愿借款，这就为乐观主义者借款和影响资产价格的能力设定了内生性的限制。我证明，这种限制的严格程度取决于信念分歧的性质。对于下行概率的乐观态度对资产价格几乎没有影响，因为这种乐观态度受到内生性的限制。相反，对于上行概率的乐观态度可能对资产价格产生显著影响。这种不对称的限制效应在允许卖空的情况下仍然成立，因为借款使用该资产的悲观主义者也面临类似的内生性限制。这些结果强调了投资者在资产价格问题上分歧的重要性，而非分歧的程度。当存在更复杂的合约时，类似于近期抵押贷款市场中的金融创新，会内生性地出现一些复杂的合约，以促进投机活动。

abstract.text: We study European banks' demand for short-term funds (liquidity) during the summer 2007 subprime market crisis. We use bidding data from the European Central Bank's auctions for one-week loans, their main channel of monetary policy implementation. Our analysis provides a high-frequency, disaggregated perspective on the 2007 crisis, which was previously studied through comparisons of collateralized and uncollateralized interbank money market rates which do not capture the heterogeneous impact of the crisis on individual banks. Through a model of bidding, we show that banks' bids reflect their cost of obtaining short-term funds elsewhere (e.g., in the interbank market) as well as a strategic response to other bidders. The strategic response is empirically important: while a naïve interpretation of the raw bidding data may suggest that virtually all banks suffered an increase in the cost of short-term funding, we find that, for about one third of the banks, the change in bidding behavior was simply a strategic response. We also find considerable heterogeneity in the short-term funding costs among banks: for over one third of the bidders, funding costs increased by more than 20 basis points, and funding costs vary widely with respect to the country-of-origin. The funding costs we estimate using bidding data are also predictive of market- and accounting-based measures of bank performance, reinforcing the usefulness of “revealed preference” information contained in bids.

10.3982/ecta9973.abstractZh: 我们研究了2007年夏季次贷市场危机期间欧洲银行对短期资金（流动性）的需求。我们利用了欧洲中央银行拍卖的一周期贷款数据，这些数据是货币政策实施的主要渠道。我们的分析提供了对2007年危机的高频、细分视角，而此前的研究仅通过比较有担保和无担保银行间货币市场利率来探讨危机对个别银行的影响，未能捕捉到危机对不同银行的不同影响。通过 bidding模型的分析，我们发现银行的出价反映了它们在其他渠道（如银行间市场）获取短期资金的成本，以及对其他投标者的策略性反应。这种策略性反应在实证上具有重要意义：虽然对原始投标数据的简单解读可能表明几乎所有银行的短期融资成本都有所增加，但我们发现，大约三分之一的银行，其投标行为的改变实际上是一种策略性反应。我们还发现，不同银行之间的短期融资成本存在显著差异：超过三分之一的投标者，其融资成本增加了20多个基点，而且融资成本还因国家来源的不同而存在很大差异。我们利用投标数据估算的融资成本，也能够预测基于市场和会计指标的银行绩效，这进一步证明了投标中蕴含的“揭示性偏好”信息的实用性。

abstract.text: This paper studies a dynamic agency problem which includes limited liability, moral hazard and adverse selection. The paper develops a robust approach to dynamic contracting based on calibrating the payoffs that would have been delivered by simple benchmark contracts that are attractive but infeasible, due to limited liability constraints. The resulting dynamic contracts are detail-free and satisfy robust performance bounds independently of the underlying process for returns, which need not be i.i.d. or even ergodic.

10.3982/ecta9987.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个包含有限责任、道德风险与逆向选择的动态代理问题。文章提出了一种基于校准的方法来处理动态契约问题，该方法通过调整简单基准契约所带来的收益来实现，这些基准契约虽然具有吸引力，但由于有限责任的限制而难以实施。最终得到的动态契约无需详细描述，并且能够满足稳健的性能约束，这些约束与收益过程的底层特性无关，这些过程不必是独立同分布或甚至是遍历的。

abstract.text: We study how the management practices that bureaucrats operate under correlate to the quantity and quality of public services delivered. We do so in a developing country context, exploiting data from the Nigerian Civil Service. For 4700 public sector projects, we have hand coded independent engineering assessments of each project’s completion rate and delivered quality. We supplement this with a survey eliciting management practices for bureaucrats in the 63 civil service organizations responsible for these projects, following the approach of Bloom and Van Reenen [2007]. https://openalex.org/W2526378848.abstractZh: 我们研究了官僚机构所遵循的管理实践与所提供的公共服务的数量和质量之间的关联。我们的研究是在一个发展中国家进行的，利用了尼日利亚公务员系统的数据。对于4700个公共部门项目，我们手动编码了每个项目的完成率以及服务质量方面的独立评估。此外，我们还通过调查收集了负责这些项目的63个公务员机构中官僚机构的管理实践信息，采用了Bloom和Van Reenen[2007]的方法。管理实践非常重要：官僚机构自主权增加一个标准差，项目完成率会显著提高18%；而与激励和监控相关的管理实践增加一个标准差，项目完成率则会显著降低14%。这些结果表明，激励措施和监控带来的负面影响是由于官僚机构需要同时处理多项任务，且激励措施的目标定位不准确，以及这些管理实践包含了主观绩效评估的要素，从而为官僚机构的不当行为留下了空间。我们的研究结果为小型政府如何有效管理提供了新的见解。
